theorems.name: Comparison.Article.commutant_two
theorems.statement:
theorem commutant_two (X : Matrix Two Two ℂ)
    (hX : ∀ U : Matrix Four Four ℂ, U * Uᴴ = 1 → U * J * Uᵀ = J → X * (U ⊗ₖ U) = (U ⊗ₖ U) * X) :
    X = (star (rel 0) ⬝ᵥ (X *ᵥ rel 0)) • ((1 / 4 : ℂ) • Eop) +
      (star (rel 6) ⬝ᵥ (X *ᵥ rel 6)) • ((1 / 2 : ℂ) • (1 + swap)) +
      (star (rel 1) ⬝ᵥ (X *ᵥ rel 1)) • ((1 / 2 : ℂ) • (1 - swap) - (1 / 4 : ℂ) • Eop)
theorems.description:
**Proposition 13, second line: an operator on two systems that commutes with every `U ⊗ U`,
`U ∈ Sp(2)`, is a combination of the singlet, the symmetric and the vector states `Π₀ = E/4`, `Π_F = (1 + P)/2`, `Π_L = (1 − P)/2 − E/4`,
that is of `1`, `P` and `E`.**

`Ω_X² = AB/(C_LC_R)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Article.pencil_ratio
theorems.statement: theorem pencil_ratio (ΩX Ωe : ℝ) (hX : 0 < ΩX) (he : 0 < Ωe) : ΩX / Ωe = √(ΩX ^ 2 / Ωe ^ 2)
theorems.description: **`m_X/m_e = Ω_X/Ω_e`**: the ratio of two positive zeros is the root of the ratio of their `Ω²`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Article.lsign_zero
theorems.statement: theorem lsign_zero (u : Fin 5) : lsign u 0 = 1

theorems.name: Comparison.Article.kept_by_turns_iff
theorems.statement:
theorem kept_by_turns_iff (v : Two → ℂ) :
    (∀ U : Matrix Four Four ℂ, U * Uᴴ = 1 → U * J * Uᵀ = J → (U ⊗ₖ U) *ᵥ v = v) ↔
      ∃ c : ℂ, v = c • Ω
theorems.description: **Proposition 9: the rotations of `Sp(2)` keep exactly the line of the singlet.**

theorems.name: Comparison.Article.partial_trace_singlet
theorems.statement:
theorem partial_trace_singlet (i j : Four) :
    ∑ k : Four, Ω (i, k) * star (Ω (j, k)) = (1 / 4 : ℂ) * (if i = j then 1 else 0)
theorems.description: **Each system alone is in the mixed state `1/4`:** `(Tr₂ |Ω⟩⟨Ω|)_{ij} = Σ_k Ω_{ik} Ω̄_{jk} = δ_{ij}/4`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Article.trace_Y
theorems.statement: theorem trace_Y (b d : Fin 6) : (Ybasis b * Ybasis d).trace = if b = d then 4 else 0

theorems.name: Comparison.Article.L_eq_Y
theorems.statement: theorem L_eq_Y : L = ∑ b : Fin 6, Ybasis b ⊗ₖ Ybasis b

theorems.name: Comparison.Article.orthonormal_iff
theorems.statement:
theorem orthonormal_iff (O : Matrix (Fin 6) (Fin 6) ℝ) :
    (∀ a c : Fin 6, (1 / 4 : ℂ) * ((∑ b, (O a b : ℂ) • Ybasis b) * (∑ d, (O c d : ℂ) • Ybasis d)).trace =
      if a = c then 1 else 0) ↔ O * Oᵀ = 1
theorems.description: **Orthonormal in `(1/4) tr(XY)` exactly when the coefficients are orthogonal.**

theorems.name: Comparison.Article.sum_kron
theorems.statement:
theorem sum_kron {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (A : ι → Matrix Four Four ℂ) (B : Matrix Four Four ℂ) :
    (∑ i ∈ s, A i) ⊗ₖ B = ∑ i ∈ s, A i ⊗ₖ B

theorems.name: Comparison.Article.kron_sum
theorems.statement:
theorem kron_sum {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (A : Matrix Four Four ℂ) (B : ι → Matrix Four Four ℂ) :
    A ⊗ₖ (∑ i ∈ s, B i) = ∑ i ∈ s, A ⊗ₖ B i

theorems.name: Comparison.Article.comparison_every_basis
theorems.statement:
theorem comparison_every_basis (O : Matrix (Fin 6) (Fin 6) ℝ)
    (hO : ∀ a c : Fin 6, (1 / 4 : ℂ) *
      ((∑ b, (O a b : ℂ) • Ybasis b) * (∑ d, (O c d : ℂ) • Ybasis d)).trace = if a = c then 1 else 0) :
    L = ∑ a, (∑ b, (O a b : ℂ) • Ybasis b) ⊗ₖ (∑ d, (O a d : ℂ) • Ybasis d)
theorems.description: **Proposition 11: `L = Σ_α X_α ⊗ X_α` for every orthonormal basis of `ℝ1 ⊕ Q`.**

theorems.name: Comparison.Article.six_injective
theorems.statement: theorem six_injective : Function.Injective six

theorems.name: Comparison.Article.norm_six
theorems.statement:
theorem norm_six (t : Fin 6 → ℂ) :
    star (∑ a, t a • rel (six a)) ⬝ᵥ (∑ a, t a • rel (six a)) = ∑ a, ((Complex.normSq (t a) : ℝ) : ℂ)
theorems.description: **`‖v‖² = |t₀|² + Σ_s |t_s|²`** for `v = Σ_a t_a e_a` on the six.

theorems.name: Comparison.Article.p1_six_iff
theorems.statement:
theorem p1_six_iff (t₀ : ℂ) (t : Fin 5 → ℂ) :
    t₀ ^ 2 - ∑ s, t s ^ 2 = ((Complex.normSq t₀ + ∑ s, Complex.normSq (t s) : ℝ) : ℂ) ↔
      t₀.im = 0 ∧ ∀ s, (t s).re = 0
theorems.description:
**P1's real six as a set:** `t₀² − Σ t_s² = |t₀|² + Σ |t_s|²` exactly when `t₀` is real and every `t_s`
imaginary.

theorems.name: Comparison.Article.star_relOf
theorems.statement: theorem star_relOf (M : Matrix Four Four ℂ) : star (relOf M) = relOf (M.map star)

theorems.name: Comparison.Article.map_star_mul
theorems.statement: theorem map_star_mul (M N : Matrix Four Four ℂ) : (M * N).map star = M.map star * N.map star

theorems.name: Comparison.Article.MΩ_map_star
theorems.statement: theorem MΩ_map_star : MΩ.map star = MΩ

theorems.name: Comparison.Article.J_MΩ_J
theorems.statement: theorem J_MΩ_J : J * MΩ * Jᵀ = MΩ

theorems.name: Comparison.Article.thetaTwo_six
theorems.statement: theorem thetaTwo_six (a : Fin 6) : thetaTwo (rel (six a)) = rel (six a)
theorems.description: `Θ ⊗ Θ` keeps the singlet and the five vector states.

theorems.name: Comparison.Article.p3_six_iff
theorems.statement:
theorem p3_six_iff (t : Fin 6 → ℂ) :
    thetaTwo (∑ a, t a • rel (six a)) = ∑ a, t a • rel (six a) ↔ ∀ a, (t a).im = 0
theorems.description: **P3's real six as a set:** `(Θ ⊗ Θ)v = v` exactly when every coordinate is real.

theorems.name: Comparison.Article.charge_step3
theorems.statement:
theorem charge_step3 : ∀ h k : Fin 5, h ≠ k → ∀ t : Fin 5, ∀ r : Fin 16,
    charge3 h k (transition t r) + charge3 h k r =
      qline3 h k t * (2 * (if t ∈ disagreeSet r then 1 else 0) - 1)

theorems.name: Comparison.Article.charge_step
theorems.statement:
theorem charge_step (h k : Fin 5) (hk : h ≠ k) (t : Fin 5) (r : Fin 16) :
    charge h k (transition t r) + charge h k r =
      ((qline3 h k t : ℚ) / 3) * (2 * (if t ∈ disagreeSet r then 1 else 0) - 1)
theorems.description: **Proposition 65: the charge a step gives off**, `Q(S △ T_t) + Q(S) = q_t(2[t ∈ S] − 1)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Article.lastDirection_step_neutral
theorems.statement:
theorem lastDirection_step_neutral (h k : Fin 5) (hk : h ≠ k) (r : Fin 16) :
    charge h k (transition h r) = -charge h k r
theorems.description: **The step along the last-step direction alone gives off no charge.**

theorems.name: Comparison.Article.electric_coupling
theorems.description:
**The electric coupling at the clock:** `α₀ = 27/3700`, `1/α₀ = 137.037`, and
`1/α = 3700/27 − (37/120) h/(297 + N_h)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Article.history_12345_closed
theorems.statement: theorem history_12345_closed : ∀ r : Fin 16, transition 4 (transition 3 (transition 2 (transition 1 (transition 0 r)))) = r
theorems.description: **The walk `12345` is closed:** a step along each of the five directions in turn returns.

theorems.name: Comparison.Article.square_closed
theorems.statement: theorem square_closed : ∀ a b : Fin 5, ∀ r : Fin 16, transition b (transition a (transition b (transition a r))) = r
theorems.description: **Every square is closed:** `abab` returns.

theorems.name: Comparison.Article.flat_sign_no_clock
theorems.statement: theorem flat_sign_no_clock (z : Fin 16 → ℂ) (hz : ∀ t x, z (transition t x) = -z x) : z = 0
theorems.description:
**Proposition 91: the flat sign `q ≡ −1` has no common phase.** A phase `z` with `z_{t·x} = −z_x` on every
link closes the squares (`(−1)⁴ = 1`) but not the walk `12345` (`(−1)⁵ = −1`), so it vanishes.

theorems.name: Comparison.Article.flat_sign_squares
theorems.statement:
theorem flat_sign_squares (a b : Fin 5) (r : Fin 16) : ((-1 : ℂ)) ^ 4 = 1 ∧ (-1 : ℂ) ^ 5 = -1 ∧
    transition b (transition a (transition b (transition a r))) = r

theorems.name: Comparison.Article.pairing_irreps
theorems.statement:
theorem pairing_irreps :
    (1 / 4 : ℂ) • ∑ i, B3 i 0 • XTheta i = ArticleStatements.projSinglet ∧
      (1 / 4 : ℂ) • ∑ i, B3 i 1 • XTheta i = ArticleStatements.projSymmetric ∧
      (1 / 4 : ℂ) • ∑ i, B3 i 2 • XTheta i = ArticleStatements.projVector
theorems.description: **The projectors `Π₀ = E/4`, `Π_F = (1 + P)/2`, `Π_L = (1 − P)/2 − E/4` are `(1/4) Σ_i (B₃)_{ia} X_i`.**

theorems.name: Comparison.Article.pairing_gram_diag
theorems.statement:
theorem pairing_gram_diag :
    B3ᵀ * gramTheta * B3 = Matrix.diagonal ![1, 10, 5] ∧ (3 : ℕ) * (1 + 10 + 5) = 48
theorems.description: **`B₃ᵀ G_Θ B₃ = diag(1, 10, 5)`**, the Gram matrix of the three projectors in `τ`, and `3(1 + 10 + 5) = 48`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Article.K_sq
theorems.statement: theorem K_sq {c : Fin 5} (hc : c ≠ 1) : Kturn c * Kturn c = -1

theorems.name: Comparison.Article.K_anticomm
theorems.statement:
theorem K_anticomm {a b : Fin 5} (ha : a ≠ 1) (hb : b ≠ 1) (hab : a ≠ b) :
    Kturn a * Kturn b = -(Kturn b * Kturn a)

theorems.name: Comparison.Article.K_comm_lastDirection
theorems.statement: theorem K_comm_lastDirection {c : Fin 5} (h0 : c ≠ 0) : Kturn c * γ 0 = γ 0 * Kturn c

theorems.name: Comparison.Article.pairings_on_side
theorems.statement:
theorem pairings_on_side :
    (γ 1 * γ 2) * (γ 3 * γ 4) = γ 0 ∧ (γ 1 * γ 3) * (γ 2 * γ 4) = -γ 0 ∧
      (γ 1 * γ 4) * (γ 2 * γ 3) = γ 0
theorems.description:
**The three pairings:** `(γ₁γ₂)(γ₃γ₄) = γ_h`, `(γ₁γ₃)(γ₂γ₄) = −γ_h`, `(γ₁γ₄)(γ₂γ₃) = γ_h`, so on the side
`γ_h = 1` each pairing has `γ_aγ_b = ±γ_cγ_d`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Article.trace_γv
theorems.statement: theorem trace_γv (n : Fin 5 → ℝ) : (γv n).trace = 0

theorems.name: Comparison.Article.eigen_null_cone
theorems.statement:
theorem eigen_null_cone (n : Fin 5 → ℝ) (ω : ℝ) :
    (∃ v : Four → ℂ, v ≠ 0 ∧ γv n *ᵥ v = (ω : ℂ) • v) ↔ ω ^ 2 = ∑ s, n s ^ 2
theorems.description: **Proposition 164: `ω` is an eigenvalue of `Σ_s t_s γ_s` exactly when `ω² = |t|²`.**

theorems.name: Comparison.Article.step_energy
theorems.statement:
theorem step_energy {h j : Fin 5} (hj : h ≠ j) (μ k ω : ℝ) :
    ((μ : ℂ) • γ h + (k : ℂ) • γ j) * ((μ : ℂ) • γ h + (k : ℂ) • γ j) =
        ((μ ^ 2 + k ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) • (1 : Matrix Four Four ℂ) ∧
      ((∃ v : Four → ℂ, v ≠ 0 ∧ ((μ : ℂ) • γ h + (k : ℂ) • γ j) *ᵥ v = (ω : ℂ) • v) ↔
        ω ^ 2 = μ ^ 2 + k ^ 2)
theorems.description:
**A step that holds `h` and moves along `j`:** `H = μγ_h + kγ_j` has `H² = (μ² + k²) 1`, and `ω` is one of
its energies exactly when `ω² = μ² + k²`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Article.planeX_sq
theorems.statement: theorem planeX_sq : (γ 0 * γ 1) * (γ 0 * γ 1) = -1

theorems.name: Comparison.Article.rot_conj_anti
theorems.statement:
theorem rot_conj_anti {X g : Matrix Four Four ℂ} (hXX : X * X = -1) (hg : g * X = -(X * g)) (c s : ℂ) :
    (c • (1 : Matrix Four Four ℂ) + s • X) * g * (c • 1 - s • X) =
      (c ^ 2 - s ^ 2) • g + (2 * c * s) • (X * g)

theorems.name: Comparison.Article.rot_conj_comm
theorems.statement:
theorem rot_conj_comm {X g : Matrix Four Four ℂ} (hXX : X * X = -1) (hg : g * X = X * g) (c s : ℂ)
    (hcs : c ^ 2 + s ^ 2 = 1) :
    (c • (1 : Matrix Four Four ℂ) + s • X) * g * (c • 1 - s • X) = g

theorems.name: Comparison.Article.chiralR_neg
theorems.statement:
theorem chiralR_neg (θ : ℝ) :
    chiralR (-θ) = ((Real.cos (θ / 2) : ℝ) : ℂ) • (1 : Matrix Four Four ℂ) -
      ((Real.sin (θ / 2) : ℝ) : ℂ) • (γ 0 * γ 1)

theorems.name: Comparison.Article.half_angle
theorems.statement:
theorem half_angle (θ : ℝ) :
    ((Real.cos (θ / 2) : ℝ) : ℂ) ^ 2 - ((Real.sin (θ / 2) : ℝ) : ℂ) ^ 2 = ((Real.cos θ : ℝ) : ℂ) ∧
      2 * ((Real.cos (θ / 2) : ℝ) : ℂ) * ((Real.sin (θ / 2) : ℝ) : ℂ) = ((Real.sin θ : ℝ) : ℂ) ∧
      ((Real.cos (θ / 2) : ℝ) : ℂ) ^ 2 + ((Real.sin (θ / 2) : ℝ) : ℂ) ^ 2 = 1

theorems.name: Comparison.Article.chiralR_inv
theorems.statement: theorem chiralR_inv (θ : ℝ) : chiralR θ * chiralR (-θ) = 1

theorems.name: Comparison.Article.chiral_γ0
theorems.statement:
theorem chiral_γ0 (θ : ℝ) :
    chiralR θ * γ 0 * chiralR (-θ) = ((Real.cos θ : ℝ) : ℂ) • γ 0 - ((Real.sin θ : ℝ) : ℂ) • γ 1

theorems.name: Comparison.Article.chiral_γ1
theorems.statement:
theorem chiral_γ1 (θ : ℝ) :
    chiralR θ * γ 1 * chiralR (-θ) = ((Real.cos θ : ℝ) : ℂ) • γ 1 + ((Real.sin θ : ℝ) : ℂ) • γ 0

theorems.name: Comparison.Article.chiral_γc
theorems.statement:
theorem chiral_γc (θ : ℝ) {c : Fin 5} (h0 : c ≠ 0) (h1 : c ≠ 1) :
    chiralR θ * γ c * chiralR (-θ) = γ c

theorems.name: Comparison.Article.chiral_rotation
theorems.statement:
theorem chiral_rotation (θ m m₅ p₂ p₃ p₄ : ℝ) :
    chiralR θ * ((p₂ : ℂ) • γ 2 + (p₃ : ℂ) • γ 3 + (p₄ : ℂ) • γ 4 + (m : ℂ) • γ 0 + (m₅ : ℂ) • γ 1) *
        chiralR (-θ) =
      (p₂ : ℂ) • γ 2 + (p₃ : ℂ) • γ 3 + (p₄ : ℂ) • γ 4 +
        ((m * Real.cos θ + m₅ * Real.sin θ : ℝ) : ℂ) • γ 0 +
        ((m₅ * Real.cos θ - m * Real.sin θ : ℝ) : ℂ) • γ 1 ∧
      (m * Real.cos θ + m₅ * Real.sin θ) ^ 2 + (m₅ * Real.cos θ - m * Real.sin θ) ^ 2 = m ^ 2 + m₅ ^ 2 ∧
      ((p₂ : ℂ) • γ 2 + (p₃ : ℂ) • γ 3 + (p₄ : ℂ) • γ 4 + (m : ℂ) • γ 0 + (m₅ : ℂ) • γ 1) *
        ((p₂ : ℂ) • γ 2 + (p₃ : ℂ) • γ 3 + (p₄ : ℂ) • γ 4 + (m : ℂ) • γ 0 + (m₅ : ℂ) • γ 1) =
        ((p₂ ^ 2 + p₃ ^ 2 + p₄ ^ 2 + m ^ 2 + m₅ ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) • (1 : Matrix Four Four ℂ)
theorems.description: **Proposition 165: the chiral rotation keeps `p` and the rest mass.**

theorems.name: Comparison.Article.Jet.sub_isBigO

theorem Jet.sub_isBigO {f g : ℝ → A} {c₀ c₁ c₂ : A} (hf : Jet f c₀ c₁ c₂) (hg : Jet g c₀ c₁ c₂) :

theorems.name: Comparison.Article.gauge_first_variation
theorems.statement:
theorem gauge_first_variation (κ : ℝ) (j θ η : Fin 40 → ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => gaugeAction κ j (θ + t • η))
      (∑ l, η l * (2 * κ * ((cRealᵀ * cReal) *ᵥ θ) l - j l)) 0
theorems.description: **The first variation of the gauge action** in the direction `η`: `Σ_l η_l (2κ (CᵀCθ)_l − j_l)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Article.sum_mul_self_eq_zero
theorems.statement: theorem sum_mul_self_eq_zero {n : ℕ} {w : Fin n → ℝ} (h : ∑ l, w l * w l = 0) : w = 0

theorems.name: Comparison.Article.gauge_stationary_iff
theorems.statement:
theorem gauge_stationary_iff (κ : ℝ) (j θ : Fin 40 → ℝ) :
    Stationary (gaugeAction κ j) θ ↔ (2 * κ) • ((cRealᵀ * cReal) *ᵥ θ) = j
theorems.description: **`δ_θ Γ = 0` iff `2κ CᵀC θ = j`:** Maxwell's inhomogeneous equations on the cells.

theorems.name: Comparison.Article.current_conserved
theorems.statement:
theorem current_conserved {κ : ℝ} {j θ : Fin 40 → ℝ} (h : Stationary (gaugeAction κ j) θ) :
    gradCᵀ *ᵥ j = 0
theorems.description: **The current is conserved:** a current that sources a stationary field has `gradᵀ j = 0`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Article.gauge_invariant
theorems.statement:
theorem gauge_invariant (κ : ℝ) (j θ : Fin 40 → ℝ) (χ : Fin 16 → ℝ) :
    gaugeAction κ j (θ + gradC *ᵥ χ) = gaugeAction κ j θ - (gradCᵀ *ᵥ j) ⬝ᵥ χ ∧
      (gradCᵀ *ᵥ j = 0 → gaugeAction κ j (θ + gradC *ᵥ χ) = gaugeAction κ j θ)
theorems.description:
**Gauge invariance:** the flux does not see a gradient, so `Γ(θ + grad χ) = Γ(θ) − ⟨gradᵀ j, χ⟩`, and the
action is invariant when the current is conserved.

theorems.name: Comparison.Article.normSq_line
theorems.statement:
theorem normSq_line (a b : ℂ) (t : ℝ) :
    Complex.normSq (a + (t : ℂ) * b) =
      Complex.normSq a + t * (2 * (a * (starRingEnd ℂ) b).re) + t ^ 2 * Complex.normSq b

theorems.name: Comparison.Article.hasDerivAt_normSq_line
theorems.statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_normSq_line (a b : ℂ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => Complex.normSq (a + (t : ℂ) * b)) (2 * (a * (starRingEnd ℂ) b).re) 0

theorems.name: Comparison.Article.hop_by_parts
theorems.statement:
theorem hop_by_parts (φ η : Fin 16 → ℂ) :
    ∑ l, (φ (linkV l) - φ (linkU l)) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (η (linkV l) - η (linkU l)) =
      ∑ x, lapC φ x * (starRingEnd ℂ) (η x)
theorems.description: Summation by parts on the cells: `Σ_l a_l conj(η_{v_l} − η_{u_l}) = Σ_x (Lφ)_x conj η_x`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Article.scalar_first_variation
theorems.statement:
theorem scalar_first_variation (lam c : ℝ) (s φ η : Fin 16 → ℂ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => scalarAction lam c s (φ + t • η))
      (∑ x, 2 * (scalarEq lam c s φ x * (starRingEnd ℂ) (η x)).re) 0
theorems.description:
**The first variation of the scalar's action** in the direction `η`:
`Σ_x 2 Re(E_x conj η_x)` with `E_x` the field equation.

theorems.name: Comparison.Article.scalar_stationary_iff
theorems.statement:
theorem scalar_stationary_iff (lam c : ℝ) (s φ : Fin 16 → ℂ) :
    Stationary (scalarAction lam c s) φ ↔ ∀ x, scalarEq lam c s φ x = 0
theorems.description: **`δ_φ Γ = 0` iff the scalar's equation holds at every vertex.**

theorems.name: Comparison.Article.local_form
theorems.statement:
theorem local_form (κ lam c : ℝ) (j : Fin 40 → ℝ) (s : Fin 16 → ℂ) (θ : Fin 40 → ℝ) (φ : Fin 16 → ℂ) :
    Stationary (localAction κ lam c j s) (θ, φ) ↔
      (2 * κ) • ((cRealᵀ * cReal) *ᵥ θ) = j ∧ ∀ x, scalarEq lam c s φ x = 0
theorems.description:
**Proposition 63 on the cells: `δΓ = 0` gives the field equations.** The assembled action is stationary in
all its fields together exactly when Maxwell's equations `2κ CᵀC θ = j` and the scalar's equation
`(Lφ)_x + 2λ(|φ_x|² − c)φ_x + s_x = 0` hold.

theorems.name: Comparison.Article.potential_minimum
theorems.statement:
theorem potential_minimum {lam : ℝ} (hl : 0 < lam) (c r : ℝ) :
    0 ≤ lam * (r - c) ^ 2 ∧ (lam * (r - c) ^ 2 = 0 ↔ r = c)
theorems.description: **The potential is least exactly on `|φ|² = c`** (`c = v²/2`).

theorems.name: Comparison.Article.potential_about_minimum
theorems.statement:
theorem potential_about_minimum (lam v h : ℝ) :
    lam * ((v + h) ^ 2 / 2 - v ^ 2 / 2) ^ 2 = lam * v ^ 2 * h ^ 2 + lam * v * h ^ 3 + lam * h ^ 4 / 4
theorems.description:
**About the minimum** `φ = (v + h)/√2` the potential is `λv²h² + λvh³ + λh⁴/4`: the radial mode has
`m_H² = 2λv²`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Article.dirac_mass_shell
theorems.statement:
theorem dirac_mass_shell (O : Matrix (Fin 5) (Fin 5) ℝ) (hO : O * Oᵀ = 1) (p : Fin 4 → ℝ) (M : ℝ) :
    (∃ ψ : Four → ℂ, ψ ≠ 0 ∧ diracOp O p M *ᵥ ψ = 0) ↔ ∑ μ, p μ ^ 2 = M ^ 2
theorems.description:
**The first-order equation is on the mass shell:** the chart's Dirac operator has a nonzero null vector
exactly when `Σ_μ p_μ² = M²`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Article.marked_signed_excursion
theorems.statement:
theorem marked_signed_excursion (z x y : ℝ) (h : |3 * z ^ 2 * x * y / 16| < 1) :
    HasSum (fun m : ℕ => (-(z ^ 4 * x * y ^ 2) / 16) * (-(3 * z ^ 2 * x * y) / 16) ^ m)
      (-(z ^ 4 * x * y ^ 2) / (16 + 3 * z ^ 2 * x * y))
theorems.description: **The marked signed excursion** as the sum of its first returns: `Σ_m (−z⁴xy²/16)(−3z²xy/16)^m`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Article.marked_signed_excursion_one
theorems.statement:
theorem marked_signed_excursion_one (z : ℝ) :
    -(z ^ 4 * 1 * 1 ^ 2) / (16 + 3 * z ^ 2 * 1 * 1) = -z ^ 4 / (16 + 3 * z ^ 2)
theorems.description: At `x = y = 1` the marked signed excursion is `Φ(z) = −z⁴/(16 + 3z²)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Article.excursion_marked_factor
theorems.statement:
theorem excursion_marked_factor (x y : ℝ) (hy : y ≠ 2) (hD : 4 - 3 * x * Hpgf y ≠ 0) :
    excursionF 1 x y = x ^ 2 * Hpgf y / (4 - 3 * x * Hpgf y)
theorems.description: **The marked excursion at `z = 1`:** `F(1; x, y) = x² H(y)/(4 − 3x H(y))`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Article.excursion_by_arrivals
theorems.statement:
theorem excursion_by_arrivals (x H : ℝ) (h : |3 * x * H / 4| < 1) :
    HasSum (fun m : ℕ => (1 / 4 * (3 / 4) ^ m) * (x ^ (m + 2) * H ^ (m + 1))) (x ^ 2 * H / (4 - 3 * x * H))
theorems.description:
**By arrivals at the vector states:** `x²H/(4 − 3xH) = Σ_{q ≥ 2} (1/4)(3/4)^{q−2} x^q H^{q−1}`: `P(Q = q) =
(1/4)(3/4)^{q−2}` and `E[y^P | Q = q] = H(y)^{q−1}`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Article.Hpgf_hasDerivAt

theorems.name: Comparison.Article.H_moments

    Hpgf 1 = 1 ∧ deriv Hpgf 1 = 5 / 2 ∧ deriv (deriv Hpgf) 1 = 6 ∧

theorems.name: Comparison.Article.arrivals_mean
theorems.statement:
theorem arrivals_mean :
    HasSum (fun m : ℕ => 1 / 4 * (3 / 4 : ℝ) ^ m) 1 ∧
      HasSum (fun m : ℕ => ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (1 / 4 * (3 / 4 : ℝ) ^ m)) 4
theorems.description: **`E(Q − 1) = 4`:** `Σ_{q ≥ 2} (q − 1)(1/4)(3/4)^{q−2} = 4`, and the arrivals' law sums to one.

theorems.name: Comparison.Article.expected_conditional_variance
theorems.statement:
theorem expected_conditional_variance :
    HasSum (fun m : ℕ => (1 / 4 * (3 / 4 : ℝ) ^ m) * (((m : ℝ) + 1) * (9 / 4))) 9 ∧ (84 : ℝ) - 30 ^ 2 / 12 = 9
theorems.description: **`E Var(P|Q) = (9/4) E(Q − 1) = 9 = Var P − Cov²/Var Q`.**

theorems.name: Comparison.Article.pieces_sit
theorems.statement:
theorem pieces_sit :
    -- an excursion: the singlet holds nothing; `{}` (count) and `{n}` (amplitude)
    (dividedSetOf 0 = sHere ∧ twin sHere = sSinglet) ∧
    -- a step along `t`: `{t, n}` and `{t}`
    (∀ t : Fin 5, dividedSetOf (lineIdx t) = {0, t.succ} ∧ twin {0, t.succ} = {t.succ}) ∧
    -- the last-step direction `h` (line 0): `{h, n}` and `{h}`; the line `k` (line 1): `{k, n}` and `{k}`
    (dividedSetOf (lineIdx 0) = sLastDirectionSinglet ∧ twin sLastDirectionSinglet = sLastDirection) ∧
    (dividedSetOf (lineIdx 1) = sLineSinglet ∧ twin sLineSinglet = sLine) ∧
    -- the plane `F = {h, k}` (two-spinor state 6): `F` and `C`, the same division as `F + {n}`
    (dividedSetOf 6 = sF ∧ twin sF = sFn ∧ sFnᶜ = sC) ∧
    -- any plane `{a, b}`: `{a, b}` and `{a, b, n}`
    (∀ k : Fin 16, 6 ≤ k.val → dividedSetOf k = heldDiv k ∧ (dividedSetOf k).card = 2 ∧
      twin (dividedSetOf k) = insert 0 (dividedSetOf k)) ∧
    -- a count on the even divided set, an amplitude on its odd counterpart
    (∀ k : Fin 16, signS (dividedSetOf k) = 1 ∧ signS (twin (dividedSetOf k)) = -1)
theorems.description: **Proposition 43: where each piece sits.**

theorems.name: Comparison.Article.held_by_a_line

before it (Proposition 27): the last-step direction's line reverses the four other lines, `θ_{T_h} = −θ_{h, n}`, and the plane
reverses its two lines.

theorems.name: Comparison.Article.realQ_entries
theorems.statement:
theorem realQ_entries (X : Matrix Four Four ℝ) (hX : X ∈ realQ) :
    X = X (0, 0) (0, 0) • realLines 0 + X (0, 0) (1, 0) • realLines 1 + X (0, 0) (1, 1) • realLines 2

theorems.name: Comparison.Article.finrank_realQ
theorems.statement: theorem finrank_realQ : Module.finrank ℝ realQ = 3
theorems.description: **With real P1 there are three lines:** `dim Q = 3`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Article.realLines_clifford
theorems.statement:
theorem realLines_clifford (i j : Fin 3) :
    realLines i * realLines j + realLines j * realLines i = (if i = j then 2 else 0 : ℝ) • 1
theorems.description: The three real lines anticommute and square to one: every distinction squares to a number.

theorems.name: Comparison.Article.I_Θ_anticomm
theorems.statement: theorem I_Θ_anticomm (v : Four → ℂ) : Θ (Complex.I • v) = -(Complex.I • Θ v)

theorems.name: Comparison.Article.real_half_det
theorems.statement:
theorem real_half_det {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] (q : Matrix n n ℝ) (D : Finset n)
    (hq : q * q = Matrix.diagonal fun i => if i ∈ D then -1 else 1) :
    q.det ^ 2 = (-1) ^ D.card ∧ Even D.card
theorems.description: **`(det q)² = (−1)^k`**: a real `q` whose square reverses `k` directions has `k` even.

theorems.name: Comparison.Article.realProducts_linearIndependent
theorems.statement: theorem realProducts_linearIndependent : LinearIndependent ℝ realProducts

theorems.name: Comparison.Article.realProducts_symm
theorems.statement: theorem realProducts_symm (p : Fin 3 × Fin 3) : (realProducts p)ᵀ = realProducts p

theorems.name: Comparison.Article.realProducts_nine
theorems.statement:
theorem realProducts_nine :
    Module.finrank ℝ (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range realProducts)) = 9 ∧
      (epsR ⊗ₖ epsR)ᵀ = epsR ⊗ₖ epsR ∧
      (∀ p, ((epsR ⊗ₖ epsR) * realProducts p).trace = 0) ∧
      epsR ⊗ₖ epsR ∉ Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range realProducts)
theorems.description:
**`ε ⊗ ε` is symmetric and orthogonal to every product of symmetric operators**, and the ten
together are independent: the products span nine of the ten symmetric operators.

theorems.name: Comparison.Article.complexProducts_all
theorems.statement:
theorem complexProducts_all :
    Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range fun p : Fin 4 × Fin 4 => pauli p.1 ⊗ₖ pauli p.2) = hermitian
theorems.description:
**On `ℂ² ⊗ ℂ²` the products of Hermitian operators span all sixteen Hermitian operators**: each of the
sixteen observables is `±` a product of two Pauli matrices (`Elements/Observables.lean`: `obs_eq_pauli`).

theorems.name: Comparison.Article.level_derivatives
theorems.statement:
theorem level_derivatives :
    iteratedDeriv 1 deltaLevel = (fun S => f1 (yR S)) ∧
      iteratedDeriv 2 deltaLevel = (fun S => f2 (yR S)) ∧
      iteratedDeriv 3 deltaLevel = (fun S => f3 (yR S)) ∧
      iteratedDeriv 4 deltaLevel = (fun S => f4 (yR S))
theorems.description: **The derivatives of the level:** `δ₁^{(k)}(S) = f_k(e^{δ₁(S)})` for `k = 1, …, 4`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Article.level_taylor
theorems.statement:
theorem level_taylor :
    deltaLevel 0 = 0 ∧ iteratedDeriv 1 deltaLevel 0 = 1 / 5 ∧ iteratedDeriv 2 deltaLevel 0 / 2 = -6 / 125 ∧
      iteratedDeriv 3 deltaLevel 0 / 6 = 2 / 3125 ∧ iteratedDeriv 4 deltaLevel 0 / 24 = 43 / 31250 ∧
      (43 / 31250 : ℝ) = 0.0013760

theorems.name: Comparison.Article.eigen_four
theorems.statement:
theorem eigen_four (S₁ S₂ c : ℝ) (hd : 0 ≤ (S₁ - S₂) ^ 2 + 4 * c * S₁ * S₂) :
    eigenPlus S₁ S₂ c ^ 4 + eigenMinus S₁ S₂ c ^ 4 =
      (1 - c) * (S₁ ^ 4 + S₂ ^ 4) + c * (S₁ + S₂) ^ 4 - 2 * c * (1 - c) * S₁ ^ 2 * S₂ ^ 2
theorems.description: **`Tr R⁴ = (1 − c)(S₁⁴ + S₂⁴) + c(S₁ + S₂)⁴ − 2c(1 − c)S₁²S₂²`.**

theorems.name: Comparison.Article.fourth_order_difference
theorems.statement:
theorem fourth_order_difference (S₁ S₂ c d4 : ℝ) (hd : 0 ≤ (S₁ - S₂) ^ 2 + 4 * c * S₁ * S₂) :
    levelT4 d4 (eigenPlus S₁ S₂ c) + levelT4 d4 (eigenMinus S₁ S₂ c) -
        ((1 - c) * (levelT4 d4 S₁ + levelT4 d4 S₂) + c * levelT4 d4 (S₁ + S₂)) =
      -2 * c * (1 - c) * d4 * S₁ ^ 2 * S₂ ^ 2
theorems.description:
**The fourth-order difference (Eq. (48), Proposition 189):** on the two eigenvalues of `R`, the level's
fourth-order polynomial differs from `(1 − c)δ_L + cδ_M` by exactly `−2c(1 − c)d₄S₁²S₂²`; the orders one to
three agree.

theorems.name: Comparison.Article.equal_coupling_charpoly
theorems.statement:
theorem equal_coupling_charpoly (n : ℕ) (S g : ℝ) :
    (S • eqG n g).charpoly = (X - C ((1 - g) * S)) ^ n * (X - C ((1 + n * g) * S))
theorems.description: **The equal-coupling eigenvalues for every `n`:** `det(X − S G) = (X − (1 − g)S)ⁿ (X − (1 + ng)S)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Article.equal_coupling_trace
theorems.statement:
theorem equal_coupling_trace (n : ℕ) (S g : ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ) :
    trF f (S • eqG n g) = n * f ((1 - g) * S) + f ((1 + n * g) * S)
theorems.description: **Eq. (49):** `Tr δ₁(R) = n δ₁((1 − g)S) + δ₁((1 + ng)S)` for `n + 1` lines of equal level and coupling.

    X (i, j) (k, l) = X (0, j) (0, l)
theorems.description: **An operator of the side depends only on the second factor.**

theorems.name: Comparison.Article.sideP_kron
theorems.statement: theorem sideP_kron : sideP = halfOnes ⊗ₖ (1 : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ)

theorems.name: Comparison.Article.K_side
theorems.statement:
theorem K_side :
    Kturn 2 * sideP = (-I) • (halfOnes ⊗ₖ σ₁) ∧ Kturn 3 * sideP = (-I) • (halfOnes ⊗ₖ σ₂) ∧
      Kturn 4 * sideP = (-I) • (halfOnes ⊗ₖ σ₃)

theorems.name: Comparison.Article.side_span
theorems.statement:
theorem side_span (X : Matrix Four Four ℂ) (hX : sideP * X * sideP = X) :
    X = (X (0, 0) (0, 0) + X (0, 1) (0, 1)) • sideP +
      (I * (X (0, 0) (0, 1) + X (0, 1) (0, 0))) • (Kturn 2 * sideP) +
      (X (0, 1) (0, 0) - X (0, 0) (0, 1)) • (Kturn 3 * sideP) +
      (I * (X (0, 0) (0, 0) - X (0, 1) (0, 1))) • (Kturn 4 * sideP)
theorems.description: **Proposition 99: `1, K₁, K₂, K₃` span the operators of the side.**

theorems.name: Comparison.Article.K_on_side
theorems.statement: theorem K_on_side {c : Fin 5} (h0 : c ≠ 0) : sideP * (Kturn c * sideP) = Kturn c * sideP
theorems.description: Each `K_c` keeps the side: `Π K_c Π = K_c Π`.

theorem Wtwo_deriv₁ {N : ℕ} (P₁ P₂ : Fin N → ℝ) (J₂ : ℝ) (h : ∀ x, 1 - J₂ * P₂ x ≠ 0) :

theorems.description: The first derivative in `J₁` at `J₁ = 0`, for `J₂` with every `1 − J₂P₂(x) ≠ 0`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Article.curvature_split
theorems.statement:
theorem curvature_split {θ : Matrix n n ℂ} {d : ℕ} (Ak Am : Fin d → Matrix n n ℂ)
    (dAk dAm : Fin d → Fin d → Matrix n n ℂ) (hk : ∀ μ, IsKept θ (Ak μ)) (hm : ∀ μ, IsMoved θ (Am μ))
    (hdk : ∀ μ ν, IsKept θ (dAk μ ν)) (hdm : ∀ μ ν, IsMoved θ (dAm μ ν)) (μ ν : Fin d) :
    (dAk μ ν + dAm μ ν) + brk (Ak μ + Am μ) (Ak ν + Am ν) =
        (dAk μ ν + brk (Ak μ) (Ak ν) + brk (Am μ) (Am ν)) +
          (dAm μ ν + brk (Ak μ) (Am ν) + brk (Am μ) (Ak ν)) ∧
      IsKept θ (dAk μ ν + brk (Ak μ) (Ak ν) + brk (Am μ) (Am ν)) ∧
      IsMoved θ (dAm μ ν + brk (Ak μ) (Am ν) + brk (Am μ) (Ak ν))
theorems.description:
**Proposition 40: the curvature split.** With `A = A_k + A_m` and `dA = dA_k + dA_m` split by the division,
the curvature `F_{μν} = dA_{μν} + [A_μ, A_ν]` is `F_k + F_m` with `F_k = dA_k + [A_k, A_k] + [A_m, A_m]` kept and
`F_m = dA_m + [A_k, A_m] + [A_m, A_k]` moved.

theorems.name: Comparison.Article.bch_second_order
theorems.statement:
theorem bch_second_order (a₁ a₂ a₃ a₄ : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    (a₁ * a₁ + a₂ * a₂ + a₃ * a₃ + a₄ * a₄) +
        2 * (a₂ * a₁ + a₃ * a₁ + a₃ * a₂ + a₄ * a₁ + a₄ * a₂ + a₄ * a₃) =
      (a₁ + a₂ + a₃ + a₄) * (a₁ + a₂ + a₃ + a₄) +
        (brk a₂ a₁ + brk a₃ a₁ + brk a₃ a₂ + brk a₄ a₁ + brk a₄ a₂ + brk a₄ a₃)
theorems.description: **The second order of `e^{a₄}e^{a₃}e^{a₂}e^{a₁}`** (twice): `Σ aᵢ² + 2Σ_{i>j} aᵢaⱼ = (Σ aᵢ)² + Σ_{i>j} [aᵢ, aⱼ]`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Article.log_hol_second_order
theorems.statement:
theorem log_hol_second_order (S Y C : Matrix n n ℂ) (hY : (2 : ℂ) • Y = S * S + C) :
    Y - (1 / 2 : ℂ) • (S * S) = (1 / 2 : ℂ) • C
theorems.description:
**`log hol` through the second order.** If `hol = 1 + tS + t²Y + …` with `2Y = S² + C`, then
`log hol = (hol − 1) − (hol − 1)²/2 + …` has first coefficient `S` and second coefficient `Y − S²/2 = C/2`:
`log hol = Σ aᵢ + ½ Σ_{i>j} [aᵢ, aⱼ] + O(a³)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Article.seesaw_root
theorems.statement:
theorem seesaw_root {X d : ℝ} (hX : 0 < X) :
    0 ≤ seesawX X d ∧ seesawX X d * (X + seesawX X d) = d ^ 2 ∧
      ∀ y : ℝ, 0 ≤ y → y * (X + y) = d ^ 2 → y = seesawX X d
theorems.description: **The seesaw root:** `x = 2d²/(X + (X² + 4d²)^{1/2})` is the one nonnegative root of `x(X + x) = d²`.

theorem neutrino_seesaw :
    seesawX qXR 0 = 0 ∧
      (qM2 / (qMp * 1000000)) * (qXR + qM2 / (qMp * 1000000)) = qY2 ^ 2 ∧
      (qM3 / (qMp * 1000000)) * (qXR + qM3 / (qMp * 1000000)) = qY3 ^ 2 ∧
      qY2 = √qRho * qY3
theorems.description: **The neutral roots:** `x_i(X_R + x_i) = δ_i²` for the three neutral lines, `δ = (0, ρ^{1/2}, 1) δ₃`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Article.seesaw_ratio
theorems.statement:
theorem seesaw_ratio {X y ρ : ℝ} (hX : 0 < X) (hρ0 : 0 ≤ ρ) (hρ1 : ρ ≤ 1) (hy : y ≠ 0) :
    0 ≤ seesawX X (√ρ * y) / seesawX X y - ρ ∧
      seesawX X (√ρ * y) / seesawX X y - ρ ≤ ρ * (1 - ρ) * y ^ 2 / X ^ 2
theorems.description: **`m₂/m₃ = ρ` up to `ρ(1 − ρ)δ₃²/X_R²`:** the ratio of the two seesaw roots with `δ₂² = ρ δ₃²`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Article.neutrino_sum_beside_bounds
theorems.description:
**Proposition 187.** With `m₁ = 0` the splittings are `m₂² = 7.4178·10⁻⁵` and `m₃² = 2.5199·10⁻³` eV², at
`+0.38` and `+0.40` standard deviations of JUNO 2026 (`7.388(78)·10⁻⁵`, `2.509(+27)·10⁻³`); the least sum the measured
splittings allow is `0.05869(26)` eV; the bound `0.081` eV stands above `Σ m_ν`, and the bound `0.055` eV lies
`0.0037` eV below the least sum.

      deutD_share = 2 / 51 ∧
      qMud = (16 * qMus + qGl) / 17 - qUB * (qMus - qGl) / (20 + 13 * qUB) ∧
      qMus = qMup + qMun ∧ qGl = qMn / (qMp + qMn) ∧ qUB = qBd / qMp ∧
      ((0.8574382335185 : ℝ) < qMud ∧ qMud < 0.8574382335195)
theorems.description:
**Proposition 124: the deuteron.** `u_B = B_d/m_p = χ_A^{1/2} a³ [1 − (1 − k₃) ε₂]` with `χ_A = 13/12` and
`1 − k₃ = 41/40`, `B_d = 2.2245664631` MeV; `m_d/m_p = 1 + m_n/m_p − u_B = 1.99900750127`; the pole matrix at
`g = α_s²/Ψ₁ = 7/18` has the poles `−2/9` and `49/9`, and the D share at the low pole is `P_D = 2/51`;
`μ_d = (16μ_S + g_L)/17 − u_B(μ_S − g_L)/(20 + 13u_B) = 0.857438233519`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Article.crossed_plane
theorems.statement:
theorem crossed_plane :
    Comparison.Law.wS Comparison.Law.sC = Complex.I ∧
      Comparison.Law.bS Comparison.Law.sHere + Comparison.Law.wS Comparison.Law.sC = 7 / 16 + Complex.I ∧
      deltaQ = Complex.arg (7 + 16 * Complex.I) ∧ deltaQ = Real.arctan (16 / 7) ∧ deltaQ = qDeltaQ5 ∧
      ((1.158385 : ℝ) < deltaQ ∧ deltaQ < 1.158395) ∧
      Complex.arg (7 / 16 - Complex.I) = -deltaQ
theorems.description:
**Proposition 50: the complex weight.** `b + w_C = 7/16 + i` with `w_C = i`; `δ_q = arg(7 + 16i) =
arctan(16/7) = π/2 − arctan(7/16) = 1.15839`, and with the other orientation `w = −i`, `−1.15839`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Article.line_factor
theorems.statement:
theorem line_factor :
    lineFactor (1 / 4) = 2 ∧ lineFactor (Complex.I / 4) = 3 / 4 * (1 + Complex.I) ∧
      Complex.arg (lineFactor (Complex.I / 4)) = π / 4 ∧
      Real.tan (π / 8) ^ 2 = 3 - 2 * √2 ∧ ((0.1715725 : ℝ) < 3 - 2 * √2 ∧ 3 - 2 * √2 < 0.1715735) ∧
      ∀ m : ℕ, (lineFactor (Complex.I ^ (2 * m) / 4)).im = 0 ∧ 0 < (lineFactor (Complex.I ^ (2 * m) / 4)).re
theorems.description:
**Proposition 51: the line factor at the last-step direction's phase.** `1 + 3u + 4u²` is `2` at `u = 1/4` and
`(3/4)(1 + i)` at `u = i/4`, of phase `π/4` (half phase `π/8`); `tan²(π/8) = 3 − 2√2 = 0.171573`; at every even
divided set (`u = i^{|S|}/4`, `|S|` even) it is real and positive.

theorems.name: Comparison.Article.tanh_eq
theorems.statement: theorem tanh_eq (x : ℝ) : Real.tanh x = (Real.exp (2 * x) - 1) / (Real.exp (2 * x) + 1)

theorems.name: Comparison.Article.echoes
theorems.statement:
theorem echoes :
    Real.tanh (Real.log 2) = 3 / 5 ∧ Real.tanh (Real.log 2 / 2) = 1 / 3 ∧
      Real.tanh (Real.log 2 / 4) = 3 - 2 * √2 ∧ 3 - 2 * √2 = Real.tan (π / 8) ^ 2
theorems.description:
**Proposition 97: the reflections are radar steps.** `tanh log 2 = 3/5`, `tanh(log 2/2) = 1/3`,
`tanh(log 2/4) = 3 − 2√2 = tan²(π/8)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Article.sign_mul
theorems.statement:
theorem sign_mul {X a b : A} {s t : ℤ} (ha : X * a = s • (a * X)) (hb : X * b = t • (b * X)) :
    X * (a * b) = (s * t) • ((a * b) * X)
theorems.description: If `X a = s (a X)` and `X b = t (b X)` with integer signs, then `X (ab) = st (ab) X`.

theorems.name: Comparison.ArticleStatements.Phase.gauge_flat
theorems.statement:
theorem gauge_flat (q : Fin m → ℂ) (hq : ∀ a, star (q a) * q a = 1) (a b c : Fin m) :
    star (q b) * q c = star (star (q a) * q b) * (star (q a) * q c) ∧
      (star (q a) * q b) * (star (q b) * q c) * star (star (q a) * q c) = 1
theorems.description:
**A flat set of pair phases:** from unit numbers `q_a` at the lines, `q_ab = conj(q_a) q_b` gives
`q_bc = conj(q_ab) q_ac` and `q_ab q_bc conj(q_ac) = 1`.

theorems.name: Comparison.ArticleStatements.Phase.Gq_apply
theorems.statement:
theorem Gq_apply (q : Fin m → ℂ) (hq : ∀ a, star (q a) * q a = 1) (s : ℂ) (a b : Fin m) :
    (diagonal (fun i => star (q i)) * Gplus m s * diagonal q) a b =
      if a = b then 1 else star (q a) * q b * s
theorems.description: **`G_q = D_q† G₊ D_q`** has `1` on the diagonal and `q_ab s` off it.

theorems.name: Comparison.ArticleStatements.Phase.charpoly_Gq
theorems.statement:
theorem charpoly_Gq (q : Fin m → ℂ) (hq : ∀ a, star (q a) * q a = 1) (s x : ℂ) :
    (x • (1 : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℂ) - diagonal (fun i => star (q i)) * Gplus m s * diagonal q).det =
      (x • (1 : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℂ) - Gplus m s).det
theorems.description:
**Every vertex-phase choice is the same bound state in a changed frame:** `G_q` and `G₊` have the same
characteristic polynomial.

theorems.name: Comparison.ArticleStatements.trace_eq_sum_rel
theorems.statement:
theorem trace_eq_sum_rel (X : Matrix Two Two ℂ) :
    X.trace = ∑ k, star (rel k) ⬝ᵥ (X *ᵥ rel k)
theorems.description: The trace is the sum over the sixteen two-spinor states, an orthonormal basis.

theorems.name: Comparison.ArticleStatements.tau_eq_sum_nonnone
theorems.statement:
theorem tau_eq_sum_nonnone (X : Matrix Two Two ℂ) :
    tau X = (∑ k ∈ Finset.univ.erase 0, star (rel k) ⬝ᵥ (X *ᵥ rel k)) / 15
theorems.description: **`τ` is the mean over the fifteen two-spinor states other than the singlet.**

theorems.name: Comparison.ArticleStatements.tau_of_singlet
theorems.statement: theorem tau_of_singlet (X : Matrix Two Two ℂ) (hX : X *ᵥ Ω = 0) : tau X = X.trace / 15

theorems.name: Comparison.ArticleStatements.tau_sub
theorems.statement: theorem tau_sub (X Y : Matrix Two Two ℂ) : tau (X - Y) = tau X - tau Y

theorems.name: Comparison.ArticleStatements.tau_smul
theorems.statement: theorem tau_smul (c : ℂ) (X : Matrix Two Two ℂ) : tau (c • X) = c * tau X

theorems.name: Comparison.ArticleStatements.trace_γγ
theorems.statement: theorem trace_γγ (a c : Fin 5) : (γ a * γ c).trace = if a = c then 4 else 0

theorems.name: Comparison.ArticleStatements.exists_other
theorems.statement: theorem exists_other (e a c : Fin 5) : ∃ d : Fin 5, d ≠ e ∧ d ≠ a ∧ d ≠ c

theorems.name: Comparison.ArticleStatements.trace_γγγ
theorems.statement: theorem trace_γγγ (e a c : Fin 5) : (γ e * γ a * γ c).trace = 0
theorems.description: **Three lines have no trace:** `Tr(γ_e γ_a γ_c) = 0`; a fourth line anticommutes with all three.

theorems.name: Comparison.ArticleStatements.trace_kron
theorems.statement:
theorem trace_kron (A B C D : Matrix Four Four ℂ) :
    ((A ⊗ₖ B) * (C ⊗ₖ D)).trace = (A * C).trace * (B * D).trace

theorems.name: Comparison.ArticleStatements.trace_kron3
theorems.statement:
theorem trace_kron3 (A B C D E F : Matrix Four Four ℂ) :
    ((A ⊗ₖ B) * (C ⊗ₖ D) * (E ⊗ₖ F)).trace = (A * C * E).trace * (B * D * F).trace

theorems.name: Comparison.ArticleStatements.gradeOp_rel
theorems.statement:
theorem gradeOp_rel (k : Fin 16) :
    gradeOp *ᵥ rel k = ((disagreeSet k).card : ℂ) • rel k

theorems.name: Comparison.ArticleStatements.gradeOp_singlet
theorems.statement: theorem gradeOp_singlet : gradeOp *ᵥ Ω = 0

theorems.name: Comparison.ArticleStatements.trace_count
theorems.statement: theorem trace_count (u : Fin 5) : (count u).trace = 8

theorems.name: Comparison.ArticleStatements.trace_gradeOp
theorems.statement: theorem trace_gradeOp : gradeOp.trace = 40

theorems.name: Comparison.ArticleStatements.tau_grade
theorems.statement: theorem tau_grade : tau gradeOp = 8 / 3

theorems.name: Comparison.ArticleStatements.clockOp_diag_rel
theorems.statement:
theorem clockOp_diag_rel (s : Fin 5 → ℂ) (hs : ∑ a, s a = 0) (k : Fin 16) :
    clockOp (Matrix.diagonal s) *ᵥ rel k = (∑ a ∈ disagreeSet k, s a) • rel k
theorems.description:
**On the two-spinor states a diagonal traceless source is the sum of its values on the disagreeing lines:**
`H_S e = (Σ_(a∈R) s_a) e` for the two-spinor state `e` disagreeing on `R`.

theorems.name: Comparison.ArticleStatements.sum_sym_γγ
theorems.statement:
theorem sum_sym_γγ (T : Matrix (Fin 5) (Fin 5) ℂ) (hT : Tᵀ = T) :
    ∑ a, ∑ b, T a b • (γ a * γ b) = T.trace • (1 : Matrix Four Four ℂ)
theorems.description: `Σ_(a,b) T_ab γ_a γ_b = Tr T` for a symmetric `T`.

theorems.name: Comparison.ArticleStatements.clockOp_mulVec_singlet
theorems.statement:
theorem clockOp_mulVec_singlet (T : Matrix (Fin 5) (Fin 5) ℂ) :
    clockOp T *ᵥ Ω = (-(1 / 2) : ℂ) • relOf ((∑ a, ∑ b, T a b • (γ a * γ b)) * MΩ)
theorems.description: `H_T Ω = −½ ((Σ_(a,b) T_ab γ_a γ_b) ⊗ 1) Ω`.

theorems.name: Comparison.ArticleStatements.clockOp_singlet
theorems.statement:
theorem clockOp_singlet (T : Matrix (Fin 5) (Fin 5) ℂ) (hT : Tᵀ = T) (htr : T.trace = 0) :
    clockOp T *ᵥ Ω = 0
theorems.description: **A symmetric traceless source leaves the singlet at rest:** `H_T Ω = 0`.

theorems.name: Comparison.ArticleStatements.trace_mul_clock
theorems.statement:
theorem trace_mul_clock (Y : Matrix Two Two ℂ) (S : Matrix (Fin 5) (Fin 5) ℂ) :
    (Y * clockOp S).trace =
      ∑ p : Fin 5 × Fin 5, (-(1 / 2) * S p.1 p.2) * (Y * (γ p.1 ⊗ₖ γ p.2)).trace

theorems.name: Comparison.ArticleStatements.trace_mul_clock_clock
theorems.statement:
theorem trace_mul_clock_clock (Y : Matrix Two Two ℂ) (S T : Matrix (Fin 5) (Fin 5) ℂ) :
    (Y * clockOp S * clockOp T).trace = ∑ p : Fin 5 × Fin 5, ∑ q : Fin 5 × Fin 5,
      (-(1 / 2) * S p.1 p.2) * (-(1 / 2) * T q.1 q.2) *
        (Y * (γ p.1 ⊗ₖ γ p.2) * (γ q.1 ⊗ₖ γ q.2)).trace

theorems.name: Comparison.ArticleStatements.trace_clockOp
theorems.statement: theorem trace_clockOp (S : Matrix (Fin 5) (Fin 5) ℂ) : (clockOp S).trace = 0

theorems.name: Comparison.ArticleStatements.trace_clock_clock
theorems.statement:
theorem trace_clock_clock (S T : Matrix (Fin 5) (Fin 5) ℂ) :
    (clockOp S * clockOp T).trace = 4 * ∑ p : Fin 5 × Fin 5, S p.1 p.2 * T p.1 p.2
theorems.description: `Tr(H_S H_T) = 4 Σ_(a,b) S_ab T_ab`.

theorems.name: Comparison.ArticleStatements.trace_γγ_clock_clock
theorems.statement:
theorem trace_γγ_clock_clock (e : Fin 5) (S T : Matrix (Fin 5) (Fin 5) ℂ) :
    ((γ e ⊗ₖ γ e) * clockOp S * clockOp T).trace = 0
theorems.description: `Tr((γ_e ⊗ γ_e) H_S H_T) = 0`.

theorems.name: Comparison.ArticleStatements.trace_grade_clock_clock
theorems.statement:
theorem trace_grade_clock_clock (S T : Matrix (Fin 5) (Fin 5) ℂ) :
    (gradeOp * clockOp S * clockOp T).trace = 10 * ∑ p : Fin 5 × Fin 5, S p.1 p.2 * T p.1 p.2
theorems.description: `Tr(N H_S H_T) = 10 Σ_(a,b) S_ab T_ab`.

theorems.name: Comparison.ArticleStatements.trace_γγ_clock
theorems.statement:
theorem trace_γγ_clock (u : Fin 5) (S : Matrix (Fin 5) (Fin 5) ℂ) :
    ((γ u ⊗ₖ γ u) * clockOp S).trace = -8 * S u u
theorems.description: `Tr((γ_u ⊗ γ_u) H_S) = −8 S_uu`.

theorems.name: Comparison.ArticleStatements.trace_grade_clock
theorems.statement:
theorem trace_grade_clock (S : Matrix (Fin 5) (Fin 5) ℂ) :
    (gradeOp * clockOp S).trace = 4 * S.trace
theorems.description: `Tr(N H_S) = 4 Tr S`.

theorems.name: Comparison.ArticleStatements.sum_pairs_eq_trace
theorems.statement:
theorem sum_pairs_eq_trace (S T : Matrix (Fin 5) (Fin 5) ℂ) (hT : Tᵀ = T) :
    ∑ p : Fin 5 × Fin 5, S p.1 p.2 * T p.1 p.2 = (S * T).trace
theorems.description: `Σ_(a,b) S_ab T_ab = Tr(ST)` for a symmetric `T`.

theorems.name: Comparison.ArticleStatements.tau_clock
theorems.statement:
theorem tau_clock (S : Matrix (Fin 5) (Fin 5) ℂ) (hS : Sᵀ = S) (htr : S.trace = 0) :
    tau (clockOp S) = 0
theorems.description: **`τ(H_S) = 0`**: a symmetric traceless current has zero mean.

theorems.name: Comparison.ArticleStatements.tau_grade_clock
theorems.statement:
theorem tau_grade_clock (S : Matrix (Fin 5) (Fin 5) ℂ) (hS : Sᵀ = S) (htr : S.trace = 0) :
    tau (gradeOp * clockOp S) = 0
theorems.description: **`τ(N H_S) = 0`**: a symmetric traceless current has no covariance with the grade.

theorems.name: Comparison.ArticleStatements.tau_clock_clock
theorems.statement:
theorem tau_clock_clock (S T : Matrix (Fin 5) (Fin 5) ℂ) (hT : Tᵀ = T) (htr : T.trace = 0) :
    tau (clockOp S * clockOp T) = (4 / 15) * (S * T).trace

theorems.name: Comparison.ArticleStatements.tau_grade_clock_clock
theorems.statement:
theorem tau_grade_clock_clock (S T : Matrix (Fin 5) (Fin 5) ℂ) (hT : Tᵀ = T) (htr : T.trace = 0) :
    tau (gradeOp * clockOp S * clockOp T) = (2 / 3) * (S * T).trace

theorems.name: Comparison.ArticleStatements.kappa_eq
theorems.statement:
theorem kappa_eq (S T : Matrix (Fin 5) (Fin 5) ℂ) (hT : Tᵀ = T) (htr : T.trace = 0) :
    kappa S T = -(2 / 45) * (S * T).trace
theorems.description:
**The mixed moment: `κ(N, H_S, H_T) = τ[(N − 8/3) H_S H_T] = −(2/45) Tr(ST)`** for a
symmetric traceless `T`.

theorems.name: Comparison.ArticleStatements.cumulant
theorems.statement:
theorem cumulant (S T : Matrix (Fin 5) (Fin 5) ℂ) (hS : Sᵀ = S) (hSt : S.trace = 0) (hT : Tᵀ = T)
    (hTt : T.trace = 0) :
    tau (gradeOp * clockOp S * clockOp T) - tau gradeOp * tau (clockOp S * clockOp T)
      - tau (clockOp S) * tau (gradeOp * clockOp T) - tau (clockOp T) * tau (gradeOp * clockOp S)
      + 2 * tau gradeOp * tau (clockOp S) * tau (clockOp T) = -(2 / 45) * (S * T).trace
theorems.description:
**The connected third moment is `κ`:** with zero means the full cumulant
`τ(NH_SH_T) − τ(N)τ(H_SH_T) − τ(H_S)τ(NH_T) − τ(H_T)τ(NH_S) + 2τ(N)τ(H_S)τ(H_T)` is `−(2/45) Tr(ST)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.ArticleStatements.subTurn_transpose
theorems.statement:
theorem subTurn_transpose (P : Matrix (Fin 5) (Fin 5) ℂ) (r : ℂ) (hP : Pᵀ = P) :
    (subTurn P r)ᵀ = subTurn P r

theorems.name: Comparison.ArticleStatements.subTurn_trace
theorems.statement:
theorem subTurn_trace (P : Matrix (Fin 5) (Fin 5) ℂ) (r : ℂ) (hP : P.trace = r) :
    (subTurn P r).trace = 0

theorems.name: Comparison.ArticleStatements.subTurn_mul_trace
theorems.statement:
theorem subTurn_mul_trace (P Q : Matrix (Fin 5) (Fin 5) ℂ) (r s : ℂ) (hP : P.trace = r)
    (hQ : Q.trace = s) :
    (subTurn P r * subTurn Q s).trace = (25 * (P * Q).trace - 5 * r * s) / 16

theorems.name: Comparison.ArticleStatements.mixed_moment_subspaces
theorems.statement:
theorem mixed_moment_subspaces (P Q : Matrix (Fin 5) (Fin 5) ℂ) (r s : ℂ) (hQ : Qᵀ = Q)
    (hPr : P.trace = r) (hQs : Q.trace = s) :
    kappa (subTurn P r) (subTurn Q s) = (r * s - 5 * (P * Q).trace) / 72
theorems.description: **The mixed moment of two subspaces:** `κ = (rs − 5 Tr(P_DP_E))/72`.

theorems.name: Comparison.ArticleStatements.mixed_moment_complement
theorems.statement:
theorem mixed_moment_complement (P : Matrix (Fin 5) (Fin 5) ℂ) (r : ℂ) (hP : Pᵀ = P)
    (hPP : P * P = P) (hPr : P.trace = r) :
    kappa (subTurn P r) (subTurn (1 - P) (5 - r)) = r * (5 - r) / 72
theorems.description: **A subspace against its complement:** `κ = r(5 − r)/72` for a symmetric projector of trace `r`.

theorems.name: Comparison.ArticleStatements.lineProj_transpose
theorems.statement: theorem lineProj_transpose (h : Fin 5 → ℝ) : (lineProj h)ᵀ = lineProj h

theorems.name: Comparison.ArticleStatements.lineProj_trace
theorems.statement: theorem lineProj_trace (h : Fin 5 → ℝ) (hh : ∑ a, h a ^ 2 = 1) : (lineProj h).trace = 1

theorems.name: Comparison.ArticleStatements.lineProj_mul_trace
theorems.statement:
theorem lineProj_mul_trace (h k : Fin 5 → ℝ) :
    (lineProj h * lineProj k).trace = ((∑ a, h a * k a : ℝ) : ℂ) ^ 2

theorems.name: Comparison.ArticleStatements.ownTurn_transpose
theorems.statement: theorem ownTurn_transpose (h : Fin 5 → ℝ) : (ownTurn h)ᵀ = ownTurn h

theorems.name: Comparison.ArticleStatements.ownTurn_trace
theorems.statement: theorem ownTurn_trace (h : Fin 5 → ℝ) (hh : ∑ a, h a ^ 2 = 1) : (ownTurn h).trace = 0

theorems.name: Comparison.ArticleStatements.mixed_moment_lines
theorems.statement:
theorem mixed_moment_lines (h k : Fin 5 → ℝ) (hh : ∑ a, h a ^ 2 = 1) (hk : ∑ a, k a ^ 2 = 1) :
    kappa (ownTurn h) (ownTurn k) = (1 - 5 * ((∑ a, h a * k a : ℝ) : ℂ) ^ 2) / 72

theorems.name: Comparison.ArticleStatements.mixed_moment_orth
theorems.statement:
theorem mixed_moment_orth (h k : Fin 5 → ℝ) (hh : ∑ a, h a ^ 2 = 1) (hk : ∑ a, k a ^ 2 = 1)
    (hhk : ∑ a, h a * k a = 0) : kappa (ownTurn h) (ownTurn k) = 1 / 72
theorems.description: **Two orthogonal lines: `κ = 1/72`.**

theorems.name: Comparison.ArticleStatements.subTurn_eq_sum
theorems.statement:
theorem subTurn_eq_sum {m : ℕ} (v : Fin m → Fin 5 → ℝ) :
    subTurn (∑ i, lineProj (v i)) m = ∑ i, ownTurn (v i)
theorems.description:
**The rotation of the span of lines is the sum of their own rotations:**
`(5 Σ_i v_iv_iᵀ − m)/4 = Σ_i (5v_iv_iᵀ − 1)/4`.

theorems.name: Comparison.ArticleStatements.kappa_sum
theorems.statement:
theorem kappa_sum {m n : ℕ} (S : Fin m → Matrix (Fin 5) (Fin 5) ℂ) (T : Fin n → Matrix (Fin 5) (Fin 5) ℂ)
    (hT : ∀ j, (T j)ᵀ = T j) (htr : ∀ j, (T j).trace = 0) :
    kappa (∑ i, S i) (∑ j, T j) = ∑ i, ∑ j, kappa (S i) (T j)
theorems.description: `κ` is additive in each source.

theorems.name: Comparison.ArticleStatements.kappa_orth_sets
theorems.statement:
theorem kappa_orth_sets {m n : ℕ} (v : Fin m → Fin 5 → ℝ) (w : Fin n → Fin 5 → ℝ)
    (hv : ∀ i, ∑ a, v i a ^ 2 = 1) (hw : ∀ j, ∑ a, w j a ^ 2 = 1)
    (hvw : ∀ i j, ∑ a, v i a * w j a = 0) :
    kappa (subTurn (∑ i, lineProj (v i)) m) (subTurn (∑ j, lineProj (w j)) n) = (m * n : ℂ) / 72
theorems.description: **`m` lines against `n` lines orthogonal to them: `κ = mn/72`**, one `1/72` for each cross pair.

theorems.name: Comparison.ArticleStatements.kappa_one_against_four
theorems.statement:
theorem kappa_one_against_four (P : Matrix (Fin 5) (Fin 5) ℂ) (hP : Pᵀ = P) (hPP : P * P = P)
    (hPr : P.trace = 1) :
    kappa (subTurn P 1) (subTurn (1 - P) (5 - 1)) = 1 / 18 ∧
      (1 / 18 : ℝ) = -(∑' n, signedLaw n) / (1 + ∑' n, signedLaw n)
theorems.description: **One line against its other four: `κ = 4/72 = 1/18 = −Φ(1)/(1 + Φ(1))`**, `Φ(1) = −1/19`.

theorems.name: Comparison.ArticleStatements.kappa_plane_against_colour
theorems.statement:
theorem kappa_plane_against_colour (P : Matrix (Fin 5) (Fin 5) ℂ) (hP : Pᵀ = P) (hPP : P * P = P)
    (hPr : P.trace = 2) :
    kappa (subTurn P 2) (subTurn (1 - P) (5 - 2)) = 1 / 12 ∧
      (1 / 12 : ℂ) = -(∑' n, (signedLaw n : ℂ) * I ^ n) / (1 + ∑' n, (signedLaw n : ℂ) * I ^ n)
theorems.description: **The plane against its colour: `κ = 6/72 = 1/12 = −Φ(i)/(1 + Φ(i))`**, `Φ(i) = −1/13`.

theorems.name: Comparison.ArticleStatements.interior_factor
theorems.description: **The interior factor:** `1 + κ(F, C) = 1 + 6 · (1/72) = 13/12`.

theorems.name: Comparison.ArticleStatements.Radar.det_conj_action
theorems.statement:
theorem det_conj_action (A X : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) (hA : A.det = 1) :
    (A * X * Aᴴ).det = X.det
theorems.description: **`det(AXA†) = det X`** for `det A = 1`.

theorems.name: Comparison.ArticleStatements.Radar.conj_action_hermitian
theorems.statement:
theorem conj_action_hermitian (A X : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) (hX : Xᴴ = X) :
    (A * X * Aᴴ)ᴴ = A * X * Aᴴ
theorems.description: The action keeps Hermitian matrices Hermitian.

theorems.name: Comparison.ArticleStatements.Radar.sl2_kernel
theorems.statement:
theorem sl2_kernel (A : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) (hdet : A.det = 1) (h1 : A * Aᴴ = 1)
    (hs1 : A * σ₁ * Aᴴ = σ₁) (hs3 : A * σ₃ * Aᴴ = σ₃) : A = 1 ∨ A = -1
theorems.description: **The kernel is `{±1}`:** an `A` with `det A = 1` fixing `1`, `σ₁` and `σ₃` under `X ↦ AXA†` is `±1`.

theorems.name: Comparison.ArticleStatements.Radar.two_pos_real
theorems.statement: theorem two_pos_real : (0 : ℝ) < 2

theorems.name: Comparison.ArticleStatements.Radar.radar_velocity
theorems.statement: theorem radar_velocity : Real.tanh (Real.log 2) = 3 / 5
theorems.description: **`tanh ξ = 3/5 = v`** with `ξ = log 2`.

theorems.name: Comparison.ArticleStatements.Radar.radar_gamma
theorems.statement: theorem radar_gamma : Real.cosh (Real.log 2) = 5 / 4 ∧ 1 / Real.sqrt (1 - (3 / 5 : ℝ) ^ 2) = 5 / 4

theorems.name: Comparison.ArticleStatements.Radar.radar_echo
theorems.statement: theorem radar_echo : Real.exp (2 * Real.log 2) = 4
theorems.description: **The echo ratio `e^(2ξ) = 4`**: an echo sent at one returns at four.

theorems.name: Comparison.ArticleStatements.Radar.sqrt_two_mul_self
theorems.statement: theorem sqrt_two_mul_self : Real.sqrt 2 * Real.sqrt 2 = 2

theorems.name: Comparison.ArticleStatements.Radar.tanh_quarter
theorems.statement: theorem tanh_quarter : Real.tanh (Real.log 2 / 4) = 3 - 2 * Real.sqrt 2

theorems.name: Comparison.ArticleStatements.Radar.tan_sq_pi_div_eight
theorems.statement: theorem tan_sq_pi_div_eight : Real.tan (Real.pi / 8) ^ 2 = 3 - 2 * Real.sqrt 2

theorems.name: Comparison.ArticleStatements.Radar.radar_quarter
theorems.statement: theorem radar_quarter : Real.tanh (Real.log 2 / 4) = Real.tan (Real.pi / 8) ^ 2
theorems.description: **`tanh(ξ/4) = tan²(π/8)`** for the radar step `ξ = log 2`.

theorems.name: Comparison.ArticleStatements.Record.Prec_eq_norm
theorems.statement:
theorem Prec_eq_norm (A : ι → ℂ) (r : ι → κ → ℂ) :
    Prec A r = star (∑ b, A b • r b) ⬝ᵥ (∑ a, A a • r a)
theorems.description: **`P_record = ‖Σ_a A_a r_a‖²`.**

theorems.name: Comparison.ArticleStatements.Record.Prec_orthonormal
theorems.statement:
theorem Prec_orthonormal [DecidableEq ι] (A : ι → ℂ) (r : ι → κ → ℂ)
    (hr : ∀ a b, star (r b) ⬝ᵥ r a = if a = b then 1 else 0) :
    Prec A r = ∑ a, A a * star (A a)
theorems.description: **Orthogonal records add counts:** `P_record = Σ_a A_a conj(A_a)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.ArticleStatements.Record.Prec_identical
theorems.statement:
theorem Prec_identical (A : ι → ℂ) (s : κ → ℂ) (hs : star s ⬝ᵥ s = 1) :
    Prec A (fun _ => s) = (∑ a, A a) * star (∑ a, A a)
theorems.description: **Identical records add amplitudes:** with one unit record `s`, `P_record = (Σ_a A_a) conj(Σ_a A_a)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.ArticleStatements.Record.Pdetect_eq
theorems.statement:
theorem Pdetect_eq {n p q : Type*} [Fintype n] [Fintype p] [Fintype q]
    (G : Matrix n n ℂ) (X : Matrix n p ℂ) (Y : Matrix n q ℂ) :
    (Gᴴ * (Y * Yᴴ) * G * (X * Xᴴ)).trace = ((Yᴴ * G * X)ᴴ * (Yᴴ * G * X)).trace
theorems.description:
**The doubled kernel's detection probability is a squared length:**
`Tr(G†FGρ) = Tr((Y†GX)†(Y†GX))` for `ρ = XX†`, `F = YY†`.

theorems.name: Comparison.ArticleStatements.Record.trace_conjTranspose_mul_self
theorems.statement:
theorem trace_conjTranspose_mul_self {p q : Type*} [Fintype p] [Fintype q] (M : Matrix p q ℂ) :
    (Mᴴ * M).trace = ∑ j, ∑ i, star (M i j) * M i j
theorems.description: The squared length is a sum of squared moduli: `Tr(M†M) = Σ_(i,j) |M_ij|²`.

theorems.name: Comparison.ArticleStatements.Series.summable_term
theorems.statement:

theorems.name: Comparison.ArticleStatements.herm_bound
theorems.statement:
theorem herm_bound (G : Matrix ι ι ℂ) (hH : Gᴴ = G) (hG : G * G = 1) (x : ι → ℂ) (c : ℂ)
    (hc : star c = c) (hc2 : c * c = 1) :
    star (x + c • (G *ᵥ x)) ⬝ᵥ (x + c • (G *ᵥ x)) =
      2 * (star x ⬝ᵥ x) + 2 * c * (star x ⬝ᵥ (G *ᵥ x))
theorems.description: `⟨x + cΓx, x + cΓx⟩ = 2⟨x, x⟩ + 2c⟨x, Γx⟩` for a Hermitian involution `Γ` and real `c` with `c² = 1`.

theorems.name: Comparison.ArticleStatements.lawK_quad
theorems.statement:
theorem lawK_quad (Γ : Fin 5 → Matrix ι ι ℂ) (hH : ∀ t, (Γ t)ᴴ = Γ t) (hG : ∀ t, Γ t * Γ t = 1)
    (u : ℝ) (x : ι → ℂ) :
    star x ⬝ᵥ (lawK Γ u *ᵥ x) =
      (((1 + 4 * u ^ 2) * (star x ⬝ᵥ x).re - u * ∑ t, (star x ⬝ᵥ (Γ t *ᵥ x)).re : ℝ) : ℂ)
theorems.description: The quadratic form of `K(u)` is real: `⟨x, K(u)x⟩ = (1 + 4u²)⟨x, x⟩ − uΣ_t⟨x, Γ_tx⟩`.

    (u : ℝ) (hu0 : 0 ≤ u) (hu : u < 1 / 4) : (lawK Γ u).PosDef
theorems.description: **`K(u)` is positive definite for `0 ≤ u < 1/4`**, with any five Hermitian involutions.

theorems.name: Comparison.ArticleStatements.lawWeight_pos
theorems.statement:
theorem lawWeight_pos (Γ : Fin 5 → Matrix ι ι ℂ) (hH : ∀ t, (Γ t)ᴴ = Γ t) (hG : ∀ t, Γ t * Γ t = 1)
    (u : ℝ) (hu0 : 0 ≤ u) (hu : u < 1 / 4) : 0 < (1 - (u : ℂ) • stepOp Γ).det
theorems.description:
**The law's weight of every unitary connection is a positive number below the critical step:**
`0 < det(I − uB[U])` for `0 ≤ u < 1/4` (Ihara and Bass with the positivity of `K(u)` and of `1 − uΓ_t`).

theorems.name: Comparison.ArticleStatements.exists_real_of_pos
theorems.statement: theorem exists_real_of_pos {z : ℂ} (hz : 0 < z) : ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ z = r
theorems.description: A positive complex number (in the order of `ℂ`) is a positive real number.

theorems.name: Comparison.ArticleStatements.lawWeight_real
theorems.statement:
theorem lawWeight_real (Γ : Fin 5 → Matrix ι ι ℂ) (hH : ∀ t, (Γ t)ᴴ = Γ t) (hG : ∀ t, Γ t * Γ t = 1)
    (u : ℝ) (hu0 : 0 ≤ u) (hu : u < 1 / 4) :
    ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ (1 - (u : ℂ) • stepOp Γ).det = r
theorems.description: **The weight `det(I − uB[U])` is a positive real number** for `0 ≤ u < 1/4`.

theorems.name: Comparison.ArticleStatements.law_pos
theorems.statement:
theorem law_pos (Γ : Fin 5 → Matrix ι ι ℂ) (hH : ∀ t, (Γ t)ᴴ = Γ t) (hG : ∀ t, Γ t * Γ t = 1)
    (u : ℝ) (hu0 : 0 ≤ u) (hu : u < 1 / 4) : 0 < ((1 - (u : ℂ) • stepOp Γ).det)⁻¹
theorems.description: **The law itself, `Z[U] = det(I − uB[U])⁻¹`, is positive** for `0 ≤ u < 1/4`.

theorems.name: Comparison.ArticleStatements.arg_eq_zero_of_pos
theorems.statement: theorem arg_eq_zero_of_pos {z : ℂ} (hz : 0 < z) : Complex.arg z = 0
theorems.description: A positive complex number has argument zero.

theorems.name: Comparison.ArticleStatements.arg_lawWeight
theorems.statement:
theorem arg_lawWeight (Γ : Fin 5 → Matrix ι ι ℂ) (hH : ∀ t, (Γ t)ᴴ = Γ t) (hG : ∀ t, Γ t * Γ t = 1)
    (u : ℝ) (hu0 : 0 ≤ u) (hu : u < 1 / 4) : Complex.arg (1 - (u : ℂ) • stepOp Γ).det = 0
theorems.description: **A closed weight carries no phase:** `arg det(I − uB[U]) = 0` for `0 ≤ u < 1/4`.

theorems.name: Comparison.ArticleStatements.conjConn_herm
theorems.statement:
theorem conjConn_herm (Γ : Fin 5 → Matrix ι ι ℂ) (hH : ∀ t, (Γ t)ᴴ = Γ t) (t : Fin 5) :
    (conjConn Γ t)ᴴ = conjConn Γ t

theorems.name: Comparison.ArticleStatements.conjConn_sq
theorems.statement:
theorem conjConn_sq (Γ : Fin 5 → Matrix ι ι ℂ) (hG : ∀ t, Γ t * Γ t = 1) (t : Fin 5) :
    conjConn Γ t * conjConn Γ t = 1

theorems.name: Comparison.ArticleStatements.stepOp_conj
theorems.statement:
theorem stepOp_conj (Γ : Fin 5 → Matrix ι ι ℂ) :
    stepOp (conjConn Γ) = (stepOp Γ).map (starRingEnd ℂ)

theorems.name: Comparison.ArticleStatements.lawWeight_conj
theorems.statement:
theorem lawWeight_conj (Γ : Fin 5 → Matrix ι ι ℂ) (u : ℝ) :
    (1 - (u : ℂ) • stepOp (conjConn Γ)).det = starRingEnd ℂ ((1 - (u : ℂ) • stepOp Γ).det)
theorems.description: **Time reversal conjugates the law's weight:** `det(I − uB[Ū]) = conj det(I − uB[U])` for real `u`.

theorems.name: Comparison.ArticleStatements.lawWeight_conj_eq
theorems.statement:
theorem lawWeight_conj_eq (Γ : Fin 5 → Matrix ι ι ℂ) (hH : ∀ t, (Γ t)ᴴ = Γ t)
    (hG : ∀ t, Γ t * Γ t = 1) (u : ℝ) (hu0 : 0 ≤ u) (hu : u < 1 / 4) :
    (1 - (u : ℂ) • stepOp (conjConn Γ)).det = (1 - (u : ℂ) • stepOp Γ).det
theorems.description:
**The closed weights are real, so time reversal keeps them:** `det(I − uB[Ū]) = det(I − uB[U])`
for `0 ≤ u < 1/4`.

theorems.name: Comparison.ArticleStatements.sectorSum_sectors
theorems.statement:
theorem sectorSum_sectors (r : C → ℝ) (q : C → ℤ) (θ : ℝ) :
    sectorSum r q θ = ∑ n ∈ Finset.univ.image q,
      (sectorWeight r q n : ℂ) * Complex.exp (((n : ℝ) * θ : ℝ) * Complex.I)
theorems.description: **`Z(θ) = Σ_n a_n e^(inθ)`**: the sum over configurations is the sum over sectors.

theorems.name: Comparison.ArticleStatements.sectorWeight_pos
theorems.statement:
theorem sectorWeight_pos (r : C → ℝ) (q : C → ℤ) (hr : ∀ c, 0 < r c) (n : ℤ)
    (hn : ∃ c, q c = n) : 0 < sectorWeight r q n
theorems.description: **Every inhabited sector has a positive weight**, `a_n > 0`.

theorems.name: Comparison.ArticleStatements.sectorWeight_eq_zero
theorems.statement:
theorem sectorWeight_eq_zero (r : C → ℝ) (q : C → ℤ) (n : ℤ) (hn : ¬∃ c, q c = n) :
    sectorWeight r q n = 0
theorems.description: An empty sector has weight zero.

theorems.name: Comparison.ArticleStatements.sectorWeight_symm
theorems.statement:
theorem sectorWeight_symm (r : C → ℝ) (q : C → ℤ) (τ : C ≃ C) (hq : ∀ c, q (τ c) = -q c)
    (hrτ : ∀ c, r (τ c) = r c) (n : ℤ) : sectorWeight r q (-n) = sectorWeight r q n
theorems.description: **`a_(−n) = a_n`** when an involution reverses the charge and keeps the weight.

theorems.name: Comparison.ArticleStatements.sectorSum_zero
theorems.statement: theorem sectorSum_zero (r : C → ℝ) (q : C → ℤ) : sectorSum r q 0 = ((∑ c, r c : ℝ) : ℂ)

theorems.name: Comparison.ArticleStatements.norm_sectorSum_le
theorems.statement:
theorem norm_sectorSum_le (r : C → ℝ) (q : C → ℤ) (hr : ∀ c, 0 ≤ r c) (θ : ℝ) :
    ‖sectorSum r q θ‖ ≤ ∑ c, r c
theorems.description: **`|Z(θ)| ≤ Z(0)`** for nonnegative weights.

theorems.name: Comparison.ArticleStatements.sin_sum_zero
theorems.statement:
theorem sin_sum_zero (r : C → ℝ) (q : C → ℤ) (τ : C ≃ C) (hq : ∀ c, q (τ c) = -q c)
    (hrτ : ∀ c, r (τ c) = r c) (θ : ℝ) : ∑ c, r c * Real.sin (q c * θ) = 0
theorems.description:
The odd part cancels: `Σ_U r_U sin(q_U θ) = 0` when an involution reverses the charge and keeps
the weight.

theorems.name: Comparison.ArticleStatements.sectorSum_eq_cos
theorems.statement:
theorem sectorSum_eq_cos (r : C → ℝ) (q : C → ℤ) (τ : C ≃ C) (hq : ∀ c, q (τ c) = -q c)
    (hrτ : ∀ c, r (τ c) = r c) (θ : ℝ) :
    sectorSum r q θ = ((∑ c, r c * Real.cos (q c * θ) : ℝ) : ℂ)
theorems.description: **`Z(θ)` is real: `Z(θ) = Σ_U r_U cos(q_U θ)`.**

theorems.name: Comparison.ArticleStatements.norm_sectorSum_eq_iff
theorems.statement:
theorem norm_sectorSum_eq_iff (r : C → ℝ) (q : C → ℤ) (hr : ∀ c, 0 < r c) (τ : C ≃ C)
    (hq : ∀ c, q (τ c) = -q c) (hrτ : ∀ c, r (τ c) = r c) (h0 : ∃ c, q c = 0)
    (h1 : ∃ c, q c = 1) (θ : ℝ) :
    ‖sectorSum r q θ‖ = ∑ c, r c ↔ ∃ k : ℤ, θ = k * (2 * Real.pi)
theorems.description:
**The sum over sectors is largest exactly at `θ ∈ 2πℤ`:** `|Z(θ)| = Z(0)` if and only if
`θ = 2πk`, when the sectors `0` and `1` are inhabited.

theorems.name: Comparison.ArticleStatements.norm_sectorSum_lt
theorems.statement:
theorem norm_sectorSum_lt (r : C → ℝ) (q : C → ℤ) (hr : ∀ c, 0 < r c) (τ : C ≃ C)
    (hq : ∀ c, q (τ c) = -q c) (hrτ : ∀ c, r (τ c) = r c) (h0 : ∃ c, q c = 0)
    (h1 : ∃ c, q c = 1) (θ : ℝ) (hθ : ∀ k : ℤ, θ ≠ k * (2 * Real.pi)) :
    ‖sectorSum r q θ‖ < ∑ c, r c
theorems.description: **Away from `2πℤ` the sum over sectors is strictly smaller:** `|Z(θ)| < Z(0)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.ArticleStatements.hasDerivAt_cosSum
theorems.statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_cosSum (r : C → ℝ) (q : C → ℤ) (θ : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun y => ∑ c, r c * Real.cos (q c * y))
      (∑ c, -(r c * q c * Real.sin (q c * θ))) θ

theorems.name: Comparison.ArticleStatements.hasDerivAt_sinSum
theorems.statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_sinSum (r : C → ℝ) (q : C → ℤ) (θ : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun y => ∑ c, -(r c * q c * Real.sin (q c * y)))
      (∑ c, -(r c * (q c : ℝ) ^ 2 * Real.cos (q c * θ))) θ

theorems.name: Comparison.ArticleStatements.negLog_hasDerivAt
theorems.statement:
theorem negLog_hasDerivAt (r : C → ℝ) (q : C → ℤ) (θ : ℝ)
    (hf : 0 < ∑ c, r c * Real.cos (q c * θ)) :
    HasDerivAt (fun y => -Real.log (∑ c, r c * Real.cos (q c * y)))
      (-((∑ c, -(r c * q c * Real.sin (q c * θ))) / ∑ c, r c * Real.cos (q c * θ))) θ
theorems.description: The derivative of `−log Z` where `Z > 0`: `−Z′/Z`.

theorems.name: Comparison.ArticleStatements.negLog_second
theorems.statement:
theorem negLog_second (r : C → ℝ) (q : C → ℤ) (hR : 0 < ∑ c, r c) :
    HasDerivAt
      (fun y => -((∑ c, -(r c * q c * Real.sin (q c * y))) / ∑ c, r c * Real.cos (q c * y)))
      ((∑ c, r c * (q c : ℝ) ^ 2) / ∑ c, r c) 0

theorems.name: Comparison.ArticleStatements.negLog_deriv_zero
theorems.statement:
theorem negLog_deriv_zero (r : C → ℝ) (q : C → ℤ) (hR : 0 < ∑ c, r c) :
    deriv (fun y => -Real.log (∑ c, r c * Real.cos (q c * y))) 0 = 0
theorems.description: **`θ = 0` is a stationary point of `−log Z`.**

theorems.name: Comparison.ArticleStatements.negLog_second_deriv
theorems.statement:
theorem negLog_second_deriv (r : C → ℝ) (q : C → ℤ) (hR : 0 < ∑ c, r c) :
    deriv (deriv (fun y => -Real.log (∑ c, r c * Real.cos (q c * y)))) 0 =
      (∑ c, r c * (q c : ℝ) ^ 2) / ∑ c, r c
theorems.description: **`(−log Z)″(0) = Σ_U q_U² r_U / Σ_U r_U`.**

theorems.name: Comparison.ArticleStatements.curvature_pos
theorems.statement:
theorem curvature_pos (r : C → ℝ) (q : C → ℤ) (hr : ∀ c, 0 < r c) (h1 : ∃ c, q c = 1) :
    0 < (∑ c, r c * (q c : ℝ) ^ 2) / ∑ c, r c
theorems.description: **The curvature at `θ = 0` is positive** when the unit sector is inhabited.

theorems.name: Comparison.ArticleStatements.law_τ_of_conj
theorems.statement:
theorem law_τ_of_conj {C : Type*} (Γ : C → Fin 5 → Matrix ι ι ℂ) (τ : C ≃ C)
    (h : ∀ c, Γ (τ c) = conjConn (Γ c)) (u : ℝ) (c : C) :
    (1 - (u : ℂ) • stepOp (Γ (τ c))).det = starRingEnd ℂ ((1 - (u : ℂ) • stepOp (Γ c)).det)
theorems.description: Time reversal by conjugating every link conjugates the law's weight, as a sector source asks.

theorems.name: Comparison.ArticleStatements.SectorSource.weight_pos

source_context.command: variable {C : Type*} [Fintype C] (S : SectorSource ι C)

theorems.statement: theorem weight_pos (u : ℝ) (hu0 : 0 ≤ u) (hu : u < 1 / 4) (c : C) : 0 < S.weight u c

theorems.name: Comparison.ArticleStatements.SectorSource.weight_eq

source_context.command: variable {C : Type*} [Fintype C] (S : SectorSource ι C)

theorems.statement:
theorem weight_eq (u : ℝ) (hu0 : 0 ≤ u) (hu : u < 1 / 4) (c : C) :
    S.weight u c = (S.wt u c : ℂ)

theorems.name: Comparison.ArticleStatements.SectorSource.wt_pos

source_context.command: variable {C : Type*} [Fintype C] (S : SectorSource ι C)

theorems.statement: theorem wt_pos (u : ℝ) (hu0 : 0 ≤ u) (hu : u < 1 / 4) (c : C) : 0 < S.wt u c

theorems.name: Comparison.ArticleStatements.SectorSource.wt_τ

source_context.command: variable {C : Type*} [Fintype C] (S : SectorSource ι C)

theorems.statement: theorem wt_τ (u : ℝ) (hu0 : 0 ≤ u) (hu : u < 1 / 4) (c : C) : S.wt u (S.τ c) = S.wt u c
theorems.description: Time reversal keeps each configuration's weight (the closed weights are real).

theorems.name: Comparison.ArticleStatements.SectorSource.Ztop_eq

source_context.command: variable {C : Type*} [Fintype C] (S : SectorSource ι C)

theorems.statement:
theorem Ztop_eq (u : ℝ) (hu0 : 0 ≤ u) (hu : u < 1 / 4) (θ : ℝ) :
    S.Ztop u θ = sectorSum (S.wt u) S.q θ

theorems.name: Comparison.ArticleStatements.SectorSource.a_eq

source_context.command: variable {C : Type*} [Fintype C] (S : SectorSource ι C)

theorems.statement:
theorem a_eq (u : ℝ) (hu0 : 0 ≤ u) (hu : u < 1 / 4) (n : ℤ) :
    S.a u n = (sectorWeight (S.wt u) S.q n : ℂ)

theorems.name: Comparison.ArticleStatements.SectorSource.prop115

source_context.command: variable {C : Type*} [Fintype C] (S : SectorSource ι C)

theorems.statement:
theorem prop115 (u : ℝ) (hu0 : 0 ≤ u) (hu : u < 1 / 4) :
    (∀ n : ℤ, (∃ c, S.q c = n) → 0 < S.a u n) ∧
    (∀ n : ℤ, S.a u (-n) = S.a u n) ∧
    (∀ θ : ℝ, S.Ztop u θ = ∑ n ∈ Finset.univ.image S.q,
      S.a u n * Complex.exp (((n : ℝ) * θ : ℝ) * Complex.I)) ∧
    (∀ θ : ℝ, S.Ztop u θ = ((∑ c, S.wt u c * Real.cos (S.q c * θ) : ℝ) : ℂ)) ∧
    S.Ztop u 0 = ((S.Ztop u 0).re : ℂ) ∧
    (∀ θ : ℝ, ‖S.Ztop u θ‖ ≤ (S.Ztop u 0).re)
theorems.description:
**Proposition 115, the sum over sectors**, for `0 ≤ u < 1/4`: every inhabited sector has a positive
weight `a_n`; `a_(−n) = a_n`; `Z_top(θ) = Σ_n a_n e^(inθ)`; `Z_top(θ) = Σ_U w_U det(I − uB[U]) cos(q_U θ)`
is real; `Z_top(0)` is real and `|Z_top(θ)| ≤ Z_top(0)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.ArticleStatements.SectorSource.prop115_max_iff

source_context.command: variable {C : Type*} [Fintype C] (S : SectorSource ι C)

theorems.statement:
theorem prop115_max_iff (u : ℝ) (hu0 : 0 ≤ u) (hu : u < 1 / 4) (h0 : ∃ c, S.q c = 0)
    (h1 : ∃ c, S.q c = 1) (θ : ℝ) :
    0 < (S.Ztop u 0).re ∧
      (‖S.Ztop u θ‖ = (S.Ztop u 0).re ↔ ∃ k : ℤ, θ = k * (2 * Real.pi))
theorems.description:
**Proposition 115, equality only at zero angle:** with the sectors `0` and `1` inhabited,
`Z_top(0) > 0` and `|Z_top(θ)| = Z_top(0)` exactly when `θ ∈ 2πℤ`.

theorems.name: Comparison.ArticleStatements.SectorSource.prop115_curvature

source_context.command: variable {C : Type*} [Fintype C] (S : SectorSource ι C)

theorems.statement:
theorem prop115_curvature (u : ℝ) (hu0 : 0 ≤ u) (hu : u < 1 / 4) (h1 : ∃ c, S.q c = 1) :
    deriv (fun θ => -Real.log (S.Ztop u θ).re) 0 = 0 ∧
    deriv (deriv (fun θ => -Real.log (S.Ztop u θ).re)) 0 =
      (∑ c, S.wt u c * (S.q c : ℝ) ^ 2) / ∑ c, S.wt u c ∧
    0 < (∑ c, S.wt u c * (S.q c : ℝ) ^ 2) / ∑ c, S.wt u c
theorems.description:
**Proposition 115, the curvature:** on the real line `Z_top(θ) = Re Z_top(θ)`, `θ = 0` is a stationary
point of `−log Z_top` and `(−log Z_top)″(0) = Σ_U q_U² w_U det(I − uB[U]) / Σ_U w_U det(I − uB[U]) > 0`
when the unit sector is inhabited.

theorems.name: Comparison.ArticleStatements.SectorSource.closedWeights_prod_pos

source_context.command: variable {C : Type*} [Fintype C] (S : SectorSource ι C)

theorems.statement:
theorem closedWeights_prod_pos {m : Type*} [Fintype m] (Γm : m → Fin 5 → Matrix ι ι ℂ)
    (hH : ∀ j t, (Γm j t)ᴴ = Γm j t) (hG : ∀ j t, Γm j t * Γm j t = 1) (um : m → ℝ)
    (hu0 : ∀ j, 0 ≤ um j) (hu : ∀ j, um j < 1 / 4) :
    0 < ∏ j, (1 - (um j : ℂ) • stepOp (Γm j)).det
theorems.description: **A product of closed weights is a positive number**, so it carries no phase.

theorems.name: Comparison.ArticleStatements.SectorSource.theta_bar_zero

source_context.command: variable {C : Type*} [Fintype C] (S : SectorSource ι C)

theorems.statement:
theorem theta_bar_zero (u : ℝ) (hu0 : 0 ≤ u) (hu : u < 1 / 4) (h0 : ∃ c, S.q c = 0)
    (h1 : ∃ c, S.q c = 1) (θ : ℝ) (hmax : ‖S.Ztop u θ‖ = (S.Ztop u 0).re) (detM : ℂ)
    (hM : 0 < detM) : ∃ k : ℤ, θ + Complex.arg detM = k * (2 * Real.pi)
theorems.description:
**θ̄ = 0 where the sum over sectors is largest.** If `|Z_top(θ)| = Z_top(0)` and the mass determinant
`det(M_uM_d)` is a positive number (for instance a product of closed weights, `closedWeights_prod_pos`),
then `θ̄ = θ + arg det(M_uM_d) ∈ 2πℤ`.

theorems.name: Comparison.ArticleStatements.Reversal.kron_map_star
theorems.statement: theorem kron_map_star (A B : Matrix Four Four ℂ) : (A ⊗ₖ B).map star = A.map star ⊗ₖ B.map star

theorems.name: Comparison.ArticleStatements.Reversal.JJ_map_star
theorems.statement: theorem JJ_map_star : (J ⊗ₖ J).map star = J ⊗ₖ J

theorems.name: Comparison.ArticleStatements.Reversal.JJ_mul_JJ
theorems.statement: theorem JJ_mul_JJ : (J ⊗ₖ J) * (J ⊗ₖ J) = 1

theorems.name: Comparison.ArticleStatements.Reversal.star_mulVec_two
theorems.statement: theorem star_mulVec_two (M : Matrix Two Two ℂ) (v : Two → ℂ) : star (M *ᵥ v) = M.map star *ᵥ star v

theorems.name: Comparison.ArticleStatements.Reversal.Θ₂_Θ₂
theorems.statement: theorem Θ₂_Θ₂ (v : Two → ℂ) : Θ₂ (Θ₂ v) = v
theorems.description: **`Θ₂² = +1`** on two systems.

theorems.name: Comparison.ArticleStatements.Reversal.JJ_mul_conjL
theorems.statement: theorem JJ_mul_conjL : (J ⊗ₖ J) * L.map star = L * (J ⊗ₖ J)

theorems.name: Comparison.ArticleStatements.Reversal.Θ₂_L
theorems.statement: theorem Θ₂_L (v : Two → ℂ) : Θ₂ (L *ᵥ v) = L *ᵥ Θ₂ v
theorems.description: **The quaternionic structure commutes with the comparison:** `Θ₂(Lv) = L(Θ₂v)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.ArticleStatements.Reversal.map_star_eq
theorems.statement: theorem map_star_eq (M : Matrix Two Two ℂ) : M.map star = (Mᴴ)ᵀ

theorems.name: Comparison.ArticleStatements.Reversal.exp_map_star
theorems.statement: theorem exp_map_star (X : Matrix Two Two ℂ) : exp (X.map star) = (exp X).map star
theorems.description: **The conjugate of `exp X` is `exp X̄`.**

theorems.name: Comparison.ArticleStatements.Reversal.time_reversal
theorems.statement:
theorem time_reversal (t : ℝ) (v : Two → ℂ) :
    Θ₂ (exp ((-((t : ℂ) * I)) • L) *ᵥ v) = exp (((t : ℂ) * I) • L) *ᵥ Θ₂ v
theorems.description:
**Time reversal:** `Θ₂(e^(−itL) v) = e^(itL) Θ₂v` for real `t`, i.e.
`(Θ ⊗ Θ) e^(−itL) (Θ ⊗ Θ)⁻¹ = e^(itL)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.ArticleStatements.sum_isospin6_sq
theorems.statement: theorem sum_isospin6_sq : ∀ h k : Fin 5, h ≠ k → ∑ r, isospin6 h k r ^ 2 = 72

theorems.name: Comparison.ArticleStatements.sum_charge3_sq
theorems.statement: theorem sum_charge3_sq : ∀ h k : Fin 5, h ≠ k → ∑ r, charge3 h k r ^ 2 = 48

theorems.name: Comparison.ArticleStatements.sum_colour2_sq
theorems.statement: theorem sum_colour2_sq : ∀ c₁ c₂ : Fin 5, c₁ ≠ c₂ → ∑ r, colour2 c₁ c₂ r ^ 2 = 8

theorems.name: Comparison.ArticleStatements.sum_isospin_sq
theorems.statement: theorem sum_isospin_sq (h k : Fin 5) (hk : h ≠ k) : ∑ r, isospin h k r ^ 2 = 2
theorems.description: **`Σ T₃² = 2`** on the sixteen two-spinor states.

theorems.name: Comparison.ArticleStatements.trace_charge_sq
theorems.statement: theorem trace_charge_sq (h k : Fin 5) (hk : h ≠ k) : ∑ r, charge h k r ^ 2 = 16 / 3
theorems.description: **`Σ Q² = 16/3`** on the sixteen two-spinor states.

theorems.name: Comparison.ArticleStatements.sum_colour_sq
theorems.statement: theorem sum_colour_sq (c₁ c₂ : Fin 5) (hc : c₁ ≠ c₂) : ∑ r, colour c₁ c₂ r ^ 2 = 2
theorems.description: **`Σ T_c² = 2`** on the sixteen two-spinor states.

theorems.name: Comparison.ArticleStatements.trace_isospin_sq
theorems.statement: theorem trace_isospin_sq (h k : Fin 5) (hk : h ≠ k) : (∑ r, isospin h k r ^ 2) / 16 = 1 / 8

theorems.name: Comparison.ArticleStatements.trace_colour_sq
theorems.statement: theorem trace_colour_sq (c₁ c₂ : Fin 5) (hc : c₁ ≠ c₂) : (∑ r, colour c₁ c₂ r ^ 2) / 16 = 1 / 8

theorems.name: Comparison.ArticleStatements.one_trace
theorems.statement:
theorem one_trace (h k c₁ c₂ : Fin 5) (hk : h ≠ k) (hc : c₁ ≠ c₂) :
    (∑ r, isospin h k r ^ 2) / 16 = (∑ r, colour c₁ c₂ r ^ 2) / 16
theorems.description: **One trace:** the weak isospin and every colour generator have the same normalized square trace.

theorems.name: Comparison.ArticleStatements.weak_angle_source
theorems.statement:
theorem weak_angle_source (h k : Fin 5) (hk : h ≠ k) :
    (∑ r, isospin h k r ^ 2) / (∑ r, charge h k r ^ 2) = 3 / 8
theorems.description: **`sin²θ = Tr T₃² / Tr Q² = 3/8`** at the source.

theorems.name: Comparison.card_arcs

theorems.name: Comparison.arcs_leaving

theorems.name: Comparison.arcs_entering

theorems.name: Comparison.arc_rows
theorems.statement: theorem arc_rows (a : State × State) : ∑ b ∈ arcs, arcStep a b = 1
theorems.description: **Every row sums to one.**

theorems.name: Comparison.arc_cols
theorems.statement: theorem arc_cols (b : State × State) : ∑ a ∈ arcs, arcStep a b = 1
theorems.description: **Every column sums to one:** the uniform law on the arcs is stationary.

theorems.name: Comparison.passage_equations
theorems.statement:
theorem passage_equations (a b : State × State) :
    (1 : ℚ) = (if b = a then 1 else 0) + ∑ c ∈ arcs, 1 * (if b = a then 0 else arcStep c b)
theorems.description:
**The passage equations:** for every arc `a`, the all-ones vector `v` solves
`v(b) = [b = a] + Σ_c v(c) P_a(c, b)`, `P_a` the step with the column of `a` removed.

theorems.name: Comparison.landing_unique_Z
theorems.statement:
theorem landing_unique_Z : ∀ t s h k : Fin 5, t ≠ s → h ≠ k →
    (γZ t * γZ s = γZ h * γZ k ↔ t = h ∧ s = k)

theorems.name: Comparison.MΩ_mul_J
theorems.statement: theorem MΩ_mul_J : MΩ * J = (1 / 2 : ℂ) • 1

theorems.name: Comparison.landing_unique
theorems.statement:
theorem landing_unique (h k t s : Fin 5) (hk : h ≠ k) (ts : t ≠ s) :
    (γ t ⊗ₖ γ s) *ᵥ Ω = planeRel h k ↔ t = h ∧ s = k
theorems.description:
**The landing:** of the twenty arcs out of the singlet, `(∅, t) → (T_s, s)`, the cross term
`(γ_t ⊗ γ_s)Ω` is `+e_hk` exactly when `t = h` and `s = k`.

theorems.name: Comparison.landing_hidden
theorems.statement:
theorem landing_hidden : ∀ h k : Fin 5, h ≠ k →
    inExcursion h (0, h) = false ∧ Continues (0, h) (transition k 0, k)
theorems.description: **The landing is a hidden step:** it leaves the closed state `(∅, h)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.det_six_root
theorems.statement:
theorem det_six_root (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    ((t ^ ((6 : ℕ)⁻¹ : ℝ)) • (1 : Matrix (Fin 6) (Fin 6) ℝ)).det = t

theorems.name: Comparison.gramTerm_one_direction
theorems.statement:
theorem gramTerm_one_direction (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 < t) :
    -Real.log (t ^ ((6 : ℕ)⁻¹ : ℝ)) = Real.log (1 / t) / 6 ∧
      Real.log (1 / (2 / 5 : ℝ)) / 6 = (1 / 6) * Real.log (5 / 2)
theorems.description:
**The Gram-determinant term of one direction:** `−log t^{1/6} = log(1/t)/L(Ω)`, and at `t = 2/5` it is
`(1/6) log(5/2)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.gramN_levels
theorems.description:
**The pairings of `n` amplitudes:** levels `1 − 2/n` on `(1, 1, 1)` and `1 + 1/n` on its
complement, ratio `(n + 1)/(n − 2)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.gramN_four
theorems.statement: theorem gramN_four : gramN 4 = gram3

theorems.name: Comparison.five_lines_only
theorems.statement:
theorem five_lines_only (k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) :
    ((2 * k + 1 : ℤ) * (2 ^ k - 2) = 2 * (2 ^ k + 1)) ↔ k = 2
theorems.description:
**Only at five lines:** with `d = 2k + 1` lines and a holder of `n = 2^k` amplitudes,
`d/2 = (n + 1)/(n − 2)`, i.e. `d(n − 2) = 2(n + 1)`, holds exactly for `k = 2`.

theorems.name: Comparison.kept_by_lastDirection
theorems.statement:
theorem kept_by_lastDirection : ∀ h : Fin 5,
    (Finset.univ.filter fun x : Fin 5 ⊕ Fin 10 =>
      ((plane x).1 ∈ ({0, h.succ} : Finset (Fin 6)) ↔
        (plane x).2 ∈ ({0, h.succ} : Finset (Fin 6)))).card = 7
theorems.description: **The rotations `{h, n}` keeps:** `iγ_h` and the six `γ_sγ_t` of the four other lines.

theorems.name: Comparison.kept_rels
theorems.statement:
theorem kept_rels : ∀ h : Fin 5,
    (Finset.univ.filter fun x : Fin 5 ⊕ Fin 10 =>
      ((plane x).1 ∈ ({0, h.succ} : Finset (Fin 6)) ↔
        (plane x).2 ∈ ({0, h.succ} : Finset (Fin 6)))).image genIdx = Bhbar h
theorems.description: **Their two-spinor states are `B_h̄`.**

theorems.name: Comparison.moved_by_singlet
theorems.statement:
theorem moved_by_singlet :
    (Finset.univ.filter fun x : Fin 5 ⊕ Fin 10 =>
      ¬((plane x).1 ∈ ({0} : Finset (Fin 6)) ↔ (plane x).2 ∈ ({0} : Finset (Fin 6)))).image
        genIdx = BL ∧
    (Finset.univ.filter fun x : Fin 5 ⊕ Fin 10 =>
      ¬((plane x).1 ∈ ({0} : Finset (Fin 6)) ↔ (plane x).2 ∈ ({0} : Finset (Fin 6)))).card = 5
theorems.description: **`{n}` moves the five `iγ_s`, whose two-spinor states are `B_L`; it keeps the ten symmetric states.**

theorems.name: Comparison.kept_iff_plane

theorem kept_iff_plane (D : Finset (Fin 6)) (x : Fin 5 ⊕ Fin 10) :
    Kept D x ↔ ((plane x).1 ∈ D ↔ (plane x).2 ∈ D)

theorems.name: Comparison.gen_rel
theorems.statement:
theorem gen_rel (x : Fin 5 ⊕ Fin 10) :
    (gen x ⊗ₖ (1 : Matrix Four Four ℂ)) *ᵥ Ω = (I * (relPhase (genIdx x))⁻¹) • rel (genIdx x) ∧
      I * (relPhase (genIdx x))⁻¹ ≠ 0
theorems.description: **The two-spinor state of a rotation:** `(gen x ⊗ 1)Ω = c·e_{genIdx x}` with `c = i/phase ≠ 0`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Bhbar_agree
theorems.statement:
theorem Bhbar_agree (h : Fin 5) (k : Fin 16) (hk : k ≠ 0) :
    k ∈ Bhbar h ↔ (γ h ⊗ₖ γ h) *ᵥ rel k = rel k
theorems.description: **`B_h̄` are the two-spinor states other than the singlet on which `γ_h ⊗ γ_h` is `+1`.**

theorems.name: Comparison.excursion_leaves_singlet
theorems.statement: theorem excursion_leaves_singlet : ∀ (t : Fin 5) (k : Fin 16), transition t k = 0 ↔ k = transition t 0
theorems.description:
**An excursion leaves and re-enters the singlet through the vector states:** `S △ T_t = ∅` only for
`S = T_t`.

theorems.name: Comparison.commutant_singlet
theorems.statement:
theorem commutant_singlet (X : Matrix (Fin 6) (Fin 6) ℝ) (hanti : Xᵀ = -X)
    (hkept : X * thetaD {0} = thetaD {0} * X)
    (hcent : ∀ b c : Fin 6, (b ∈ ({0} : Finset (Fin 6)) ↔ c ∈ ({0} : Finset (Fin 6))) →
      X * unitTurn b c = unitTurn b c * X) : X = 0
theorems.description:
**The commutant at `{n}`:** a kept rotation of P1's real six that commutes with every kept unit
rotation is zero.

theorems.name: Comparison.commutant_lastDirection
theorems.statement:
theorem commutant_lastDirection (h : Fin 5) (X : Matrix (Fin 6) (Fin 6) ℝ) (hanti : Xᵀ = -X)
    (hkept : X * thetaD {0, h.succ} = thetaD {0, h.succ} * X)
    (hcent : ∀ b c : Fin 6, (b ∈ ({0, h.succ} : Finset (Fin 6)) ↔
      c ∈ ({0, h.succ} : Finset (Fin 6))) → X * unitTurn b c = unitTurn b c * X) :
    X = X 0 h.succ • unitTurn 0 h.succ
theorems.description:
**The commutant at `{h, n}`:** such a rotation is a multiple of the rotation of the plane `(n, h)`,
the clock `iγ_h`.

theorems.name: Comparison.BL_from_plane
theorems.statement:
theorem BL_from_plane : ∀ h k : Fin 5, h ≠ k →

    (BL.filter fun r => nPlane h k r = 2 ∧ nOut h k r = 2).card = 3
