theorems.name: Comparison.Bhbar_charges
theorems.statement:
theorem Bhbar_charges : ∀ h k : Fin 5, h ≠ k →
    ((Bhbar h).filter fun r => charge3 h k r = 2).card = 3 ∧
    ((Bhbar h).filter fun r => charge3 h k r = -2).card = 3 ∧
    ((Bhbar h).filter fun r => charge3 h k r = 0).card = 1
theorems.description: **`B_h̄` from the plane:** `Q = 2/3` three times, `−2/3` three times, `0` once.

theorems.name: Comparison.availableTransitions_Bhbar
theorems.statement: theorem availableTransitions_Bhbar : ∀ h : Fin 5, ((excursionStates h).filter fun s => s.1 ∈ Bhbar h).card = 34
theorems.description: **`34` of the `74` available directed edges hold a two-spinor state of `B_h̄`:** `R_ud = 34/74 = 17/37`.

theorems.name: Comparison.untaken
theorems.statement:
theorem untaken : ∀ t' s : Fin 5, t' ≠ s →
    ((Finset.univ.erase t').erase s = outside t' s ∧ (outside t' s).card = 3)
theorems.description: **The continuations not taken are the lines outside the plane of the step.**

theorems.name: Comparison.untaken_lastDirection
theorems.statement: theorem untaken_lastDirection : ∀ t' h : Fin 5, t' ≠ h → h ∉ outside t' h
theorems.description: **At a step along `h` the three untaken lines are other than `h`.**

theorems.name: Comparison.untaken_slope
theorems.statement:
theorem untaken_slope (d : ℝ) (hd : d ≠ 1) :
    HasDerivAt (fun u : ℝ => 1 + (d - 1) * u ^ 2 - d * u) (-(d - 2)) (1 / (d - 1))
theorems.description:
**`d − 2` is minus the slope of the long-range factor at its zero:**
`∂_u[1 + (d − 1)u² − du] = −(d − 2)` at `u = 1/(d − 1)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.edges_count
theorems.statement:
theorem edges_count :
    (Finset.univ.filter fun p : Fin 16 × Fin 16 => p.1 < p.2 ∧ Adjacent p.1 p.2).card = 40 ∧
      2 * (40 - 16) = 3 * 16
theorems.description:
**At five lines on the sixteen two-spinor states:** `m = 40` (the Clebsch graph),
`2(m − n) = 48 = 3Eℓ`.

theorems.name: Comparison.colour_product
theorems.statement:
theorem colour_product (h k c₁ c₂ c₃ : Fin 5) (hn : [h, k, c₁, c₂, c₃].Nodup) :
    γ c₁ * γ c₂ * γ c₃ = -((orderSign [h, k, c₁, c₂, c₃] : ℂ) • (γ h * γ k))
theorems.description:
**Three colour lines multiply to the plane `hk`:** for the ordering `(h, k, c₁, c₂, c₃)`,
`γ_{c₁}γ_{c₂}γ_{c₃} = −sgn · γ_hγ_k`.

theorems.name: Comparison.colour_product_oriented
theorems.statement:
theorem colour_product_oriented (h k c₁ c₂ c₃ : Fin 5) (hn : [h, k, c₁, c₂, c₃].Nodup)

    γ c₁ * γ c₂ * γ c₃ = -(γ h * γ k)
theorems.description: **In an orientation with `γ_hγ_kγ_{c₁}γ_{c₂}γ_{c₃} = 1`, `γ_{c₁}γ_{c₂}γ_{c₃} = −γ_hγ_k`.**

theorems.name: Comparison.colour_product_model
theorems.statement: theorem colour_product_model : γ 2 * γ 3 * γ 4 = -(γ 0 * γ 1)
theorems.description: **In the model:** `γ₂γ₃γ₄ = −γ₀γ₁`.

theorems.name: Comparison.levi3_values
theorems.statement:
theorem levi3_values : levi3 0 1 2 = 1 ∧ levi3 1 2 0 = 1 ∧ levi3 2 0 1 = 1 ∧ levi3 1 0 2 = -1 ∧
    levi3 0 2 1 = -1 ∧ levi3 2 1 0 = -1

theorems.name: Comparison.three_orders
theorems.statement:
theorem three_orders {R : Type*} [Ring R] (x y z : R) (hxy : x * y = -(y * x))
    (hxz : x * z = -(z * x)) (hyz : y * z = -(z * y)) :
    y * x * z = -(x * y * z) ∧ x * z * y = -(x * y * z) ∧ y * z * x = x * y * z ∧
      z * x * y = x * y * z ∧ z * y * x = -(x * y * z)
theorems.description:
In any ring, three pairwise anticommuting elements: every order of their product is the
sign of the order times `xyz`.

theorems.name: Comparison.eps_lines
theorems.statement:
theorem eps_lines (c : Fin 3 → Fin 5) (hc : Function.Injective c) :
    ∑ a, ∑ b, ∑ d, (levi3 a b d : ℂ) • (γ (c a) * γ (c b) * γ (c d)) =
      (6 : ℂ) • (γ (c 0) * γ (c 1) * γ (c 2))
theorems.description: **`ε^{abc}γ_aγ_bγ_c = 6γ_{c₁}γ_{c₂}γ_{c₃}`** for three different lines `c₁, c₂, c₃`.

theorems.name: Comparison.baryon_lands_on_plane
theorems.statement:
theorem baryon_lands_on_plane (h k c₁ c₂ c₃ : Fin 5) (hn : [h, k, c₁, c₂, c₃].Nodup) :
    ((γ c₁ * γ c₂ * γ c₃) ⊗ₖ (1 : Matrix Four Four ℂ)) *ᵥ Ω =
      -((orderSign [h, k, c₁, c₂, c₃] : ℂ) • planeRel h k)
theorems.description: **The baryon's antisymmetric state lands on the plane `hk`:** `(γ_{c₁}γ_{c₂}γ_{c₃} ⊗ 1)Ω = −sgn · e_{hk}`.

theorems.name: Comparison.baryon_lands_on_plane_model
theorems.statement:
theorem baryon_lands_on_plane_model :
    ((γ 2 * γ 3 * γ 4) ⊗ₖ (1 : Matrix Four Four ℂ)) *ᵥ Ω = -planeRel 0 1
theorems.description: In the model: `(γ₂γ₃γ₄ ⊗ 1)Ω = −e_{01}`.

theorems.name: Comparison.planeRel_eq
theorems.statement: theorem planeRel_eq (h k : Fin 5) : planeRel h k = relOf (γ h * γ k * MΩ)

theorems.name: Comparison.γ_conj_plane
theorems.statement:
theorem γ_conj_plane (s h k : Fin 5) (hk : h ≠ k) :
    γ s * γ h * γ k * γ s =
      (if s ∈ ({h, k} : Finset (Fin 5)) then -1 else 1 : ℂ) • (γ h * γ k)
theorems.description: A line `γ_s` turns `γ_hγ_k` into `∓γ_hγ_k`: minus exactly when `s` is a line of the plane.

theorems.name: Comparison.L_planeRel
theorems.statement: theorem L_planeRel (h k : Fin 5) (hk : h ≠ k) : L *ᵥ planeRel h k = (2 : ℂ) • planeRel h k
theorems.description: **The comparison on a symmetric state:** `L e_{hk} = 2 e_{hk}`.

theorems.name: Comparison.meson_either_end
theorems.statement: theorem meson_either_end (c : Fin 5) : (γ c ⊗ₖ 1) *ᵥ Ω = (1 ⊗ₖ γ c) *ᵥ Ω
theorems.description: **A line closes with its conjugate from either end:** `(γ_c ⊗ 1)Ω = (1 ⊗ γ_c)Ω`.

theorems.name: Comparison.card_outside
theorems.statement: theorem card_outside (h k : Fin 5) (hk : h ≠ k) : (outside h k).card = 3

theorems.name: Comparison.meson_lands_on_singlet
theorems.statement:
theorem meson_lands_on_singlet (h k : Fin 5) (hk : h ≠ k) :
    ∑ c ∈ outside h k, (γ c ⊗ₖ γ c) *ᵥ Ω = (3 : ℂ) • Ω
theorems.description: **The meson's bound state lands on the singlet:** `Σ_{c ∈ C} (γ_c ⊗ γ_c)Ω = 3Ω`.

theorems.name: Comparison.L_singlet
theorems.statement: theorem L_singlet : L *ᵥ Ω = (6 : ℂ) • Ω
theorems.description: **The singlet has the comparison `6`:** `L Ω = 6Ω`.

theorems.name: Comparison.closed_target_list
theorems.statement:
theorem closed_target_list : ∀ h : Fin 5, ∀ s ∈ setApart h, ∀ s' ∈ setApart h,
    Continues s s' → s' = (lastDirectionRel h, h)

theorems.name: Comparison.closed_target
theorems.statement:
theorem closed_target (h : Fin 5) (s s' : State) (hs : ¬InAvailableTransitions h s) (hs' : ¬InAvailableTransitions h s')
    (hc : Continues s s') : s' = (lastDirectionRel h, h)
theorems.description: **Inside the six closed states a step only lands on the undo `(T_h, h)`.**

theorems.name: Comparison.undo_closed
theorems.statement: theorem undo_closed (h : Fin 5) : ¬InAvailableTransitions h (lastDirectionRel h, h)

theorems.name: Comparison.closed_from_undo_list
theorems.statement: theorem closed_from_undo_list : ∀ h : Fin 5, ∀ s' ∈ setApart h, ¬Continues (lastDirectionRel h, h) s'

theorems.name: Comparison.closed_from_undo
theorems.statement:
theorem closed_from_undo (h : Fin 5) (s' : State) (hs' : ¬InAvailableTransitions h s') :

theorems.description: **Nothing leaves the undo inside the six closed states.**

theorems.name: Comparison.blockDD_row
theorems.statement: theorem blockDD_row (i j : {s // ¬InAvailableTransitions h s}) (hi : i ≠ undoD h) : blockDD h w i j = 0

theorems.name: Comparison.blockDD_col
theorems.statement: theorem blockDD_col (i : {s // ¬InAvailableTransitions h s}) : blockDD h w i (undoD h) = 0

theorems.description: **`det(1 − uB_DD[w]) = 1`** for every `u` and every `w`.

theorems.name: Comparison.closed_inverse
theorems.statement:
theorem closed_inverse (u : R) :
    (1 - u • blockDD h w) * (1 + u • blockDD h w) = 1 ∧
      (1 + u • blockDD h w) * (1 - u • blockDD h w) = 1

theorems.name: Comparison.toBlock_one_sub_diag
theorems.statement:
theorem toBlock_one_sub_diag (p : State → Prop) (u : R) :
    (1 - u • stepT w).toBlock p p = 1 - u • (stepT w).toBlock p p

theorems.name: Comparison.toBlock_one_sub_off
theorems.statement:
theorem toBlock_one_sub_off (p : State → Prop) (u : R) :
    (1 - u • stepT w).toBlock p (fun s => ¬p s) = -(u • (stepT w).toBlock p fun s => ¬p s)

theorems.name: Comparison.toBlock_one_sub_off'
theorems.statement:
theorem toBlock_one_sub_off' (p : State → Prop) (u : R) :
    (1 - u • stepT w).toBlock (fun s => ¬p s) p = -(u • (stepT w).toBlock (fun s => ¬p s) p)

theorems.name: Comparison.det_availableTransitions
theorems.statement:
theorem det_availableTransitions (u : R) :
    (1 - u • stepT w).det =
      (1 - u • (stepT w).toBlock (InAvailableTransitions h) (InAvailableTransitions h) -
        u ^ 2 • ((stepT w).toBlock (InAvailableTransitions h) (fun s => ¬InAvailableTransitions h s) *
          (stepT w).toBlock (fun s => ¬InAvailableTransitions h s) (InAvailableTransitions h)) -
        u ^ 3 • ((stepT w).toBlock (InAvailableTransitions h) (fun s => ¬InAvailableTransitions h s) * blockDD h w *
          (stepT w).toBlock (fun s => ¬InAvailableTransitions h s) (InAvailableTransitions h))).det
theorems.description:
**The available transitions are a closed level of the law:** for every `u` and every rotation `w` on the steps,
`det(1 − uB[w]) = det(1 − uB_AA − u²B_AD B_DA − u³B_AD B_DD B_DA)`, the determinant of `S_h(u)` on
the seventy-four.

theorems.name: Comparison.availableTransitions_counts
theorems.statement:
theorem availableTransitions_counts : ∀ h : Fin 5,
    (Finset.univ.filter fun p : State × State =>
      inExcursion h p.1 = true ∧ inExcursion h p.2 = true ∧ Continues p.1 p.2).card = 276 ∧
    (Finset.univ.filter fun p : State × State =>
      inExcursion h p.1 = true ∧ inExcursion h p.2 = false ∧ Continues p.1 p.2).card = 20 ∧
    (Finset.univ.filter fun p : State × State =>
      inExcursion h p.1 = false ∧ inExcursion h p.2 = true ∧ Continues p.1 p.2).card = 20 ∧
    (Finset.univ.filter fun p : State × State =>
      inExcursion h p.1 = false ∧ inExcursion h p.2 = false ∧ Continues p.1 p.2).card = 4
theorems.description: **The steps by blocks:** `A → A` 276, `A → D` 20, `D → A` 20, `D → D` 4.

theorems.name: Comparison.availableTransitions_steps
theorems.description: **`296` transitions and `24` hidden steps in the `320` of a cycle; `40/37` steps per transition.**

theorems.name: Comparison.stepQ_mulVec_one

theorems.name: Comparison.stepQ_vecMul_one
theorems.statement: theorem stepQ_vecMul_one : (1 : State → ℚ) ᵥ* stepQ = (4 : ℚ) • 1

theorems.name: Comparison.mulVec_split
theorems.statement:
theorem mulVec_split (M : Matrix State State ℚ) (q p : State → Prop) [DecidablePred p]
    (i : {s // q s}) :
    (M *ᵥ (1 : State → ℚ)) i = (M.toBlock q p *ᵥ (1 : {s // p s} → ℚ)) i +
      (M.toBlock q (fun s => ¬p s) *ᵥ (1 : {s // ¬p s} → ℚ)) i

theorems.name: Comparison.vecMul_split
theorems.statement:

      ((1 : {s // ¬p s} → ℚ) ᵥ* M.toBlock (fun s => ¬p s) q) j

theorems.description: **The uniform law is stationary for the watched walk:** every column of `W` sums to one.

theorems.name: Comparison.gram3_eq

theorems.name: Comparison.trace_gram
theorems.statement: theorem trace_gram : gram3.trace = 3 ∧ (1 / 2 : ℚ) / 3 = 1 / 6 ∧ (5 / 4 : ℚ) / 3 = 5 / 12

theorems.name: Comparison.det_F0

theorem det_F0 : ((4 / 5 : ℚ) • gram3).det = 2 / 5 ∧

theorems.name: Comparison.gramTerm_forms
theorems.description:
**The closed Gram-determinant term:** `(1/6) log(5/2) = −(1/6) log det F₀ = (1/3) artanh(3/7) =
Σ_i ρ_i log((5/12)/ρ_i)`, with `artanh x = ½ log((1 + x)/(1 − x))`.

theorems.name: Comparison.stepT_one_eq
theorems.statement: theorem stepT_one_eq : stepT (fun _ _ => (1 : ℂ)) = stepOp transitionMat
theorems.description: The plain step is the step of Book X with the transitions of Proposition 14.

theorems.name: Comparison.weight_moves_zero
theorems.statement:
theorem weight_moves_zero (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 < t) :
    (1 - ((1 / (4 * t) : ℝ) : ℂ) • ((t : ℂ) • stepT (fun _ _ => (1 : ℂ)))).det = 0 ∧
      (∀ u : ℝ, 0 ≤ u → u < 1 / (4 * t) →
        (1 - (u : ℂ) • ((t : ℂ) • stepT (fun _ _ => (1 : ℂ)))).det ≠ 0) ∧
      Real.log (4 * (1 / (4 * t))) = Real.log (1 / t)
theorems.description:
**A weight `t` on every step moves the zero to `1/(4t)`:** `det(1 − u·tB)` vanishes at
`u = 1/(4t)` and nowhere on `[0, 1/(4t))`; so `log(4u_c) = log(1/t)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.L_in_pairings
theorems.statement:
theorem L_in_pairings :

theorems.name: Comparison.trace_L_sq

theorems.name: Comparison.volume_eq

theorem volume_eq {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (B : Finset (Fin 16)) (a : R) :

theorems.name: Comparison.volume_BL

theorems.name: Comparison.volume_Bhbar

theorem volume_Bhbar {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (h : Fin 5) (a : R) :
    volume (Bhbar h) a = -a ^ 7

theorems.name: Comparison.deriv_volume_Bhbar

theorem deriv_volume_Bhbar (h : Fin 5) (a : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => volume (Bhbar h) x) (-(7 * a ^ 6)) a ∧
      -(-(7 * a ^ 6)) / 16 = (7 / 16) * a ^ 6

theorems.name: Comparison.opened_volumes
theorems.statement:
theorem opened_volumes {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (h : Fin 5) (a : R) :
    ∑ k ∈ Bhbar h, (sgnL k : R) * ∏ k' ∈ (Bhbar h).erase k, a * (sgnL k' : R) = -(7 * a ^ 6)
theorems.description: **The seven opened six-volumes:** `Σ_{k ∈ B_h̄} sgn L(e_k) Π_{k' ≠ k} a·sgn L(e_k') = −7a⁶`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Bhbar_closed
theorems.statement:
theorem Bhbar_closed : ∀ h : Fin 5, ∀ k l : Fin 16, h ∉ disagreeSet k → h ∉ disagreeSet l →
    ∃ m : Fin 16, h ∉ disagreeSet m ∧ disagreeSet m = symmDiff (disagreeSet k) (disagreeSet l)
theorems.description: **With the singlet, the eight two-spinor states that avoid `h` are closed under `△`.**

theorems.name: Comparison.card_avoid
theorems.statement:
theorem card_avoid :
    ∀ h : Fin 5, (Finset.univ.filter fun k : Fin 16 => h ∉ disagreeSet k).card = 8

theorems.name: Comparison.singlet_neighbours
theorems.statement:
theorem singlet_neighbours : ∀ t : Fin 5, disagreeSet (transition t 0) = Finset.univ.erase t ∧
    Lvalue (transition t 0) = -2
theorems.description: **The five transitions from the singlet reach the five vector states.**

theorems.name: Comparison.contact_factor
theorems.statement: theorem contact_factor : 32 * Real.pi / 9 = 8 * Real.pi / 3 * (4 / 3)

theorems.name: Comparison.spin_weights
theorems.statement:
theorem spin_weights (v w : Fin 2 × Fin 2 → ℂ) (hv : ∀ a b, v (a, b) = v (b, a))
    (hw : ∀ a b, w (a, b) = -w (b, a)) :
    ((1 / 4 : ℂ) • dot2) *ᵥ v = (1 / 4 : ℂ) • v ∧ ((1 / 4 : ℂ) • dot2) *ᵥ w = (-3 / 4 : ℂ) • w
theorems.description:
**The spin weights:** `s₁·s₂ = σ₁·σ₂/4` is `1/4` on the symmetric states and `−3/4` on the
antisymmetric ones.

theorems.name: Comparison.partner_split
theorems.description:
**The two spin partners:** `P = M̄ − (3/4)Δ`, `V = M̄ + (1/4)Δ` give `(3V + P)/4 = M̄` and
`V − P = Δ`.

theorems.name: Comparison.annihilation_small
theorems.statement: theorem annihilation_small : 0 < 1 - Real.log 2 ∧ (1 - Real.log 2) / Real.pi < 1 / 10
theorems.description: **The annihilation share is small:** `0 < 1 − ln 2` and `(1 − ln 2)/π < 1/10`.

theorems.name: Comparison.availableTransitions_free_ratio
theorems.statement:
theorem availableTransitions_free_ratio (md R p : ℝ) (hmd : md ≠ 0) :
    (md - R * md) / (p * md - (R * md + md) / 2) = (1 - R) / (p - (1 + R) / 2)
theorems.description: **The ratio independent of the available transitions:** `(m_d − m_u)/(m_s − m̂) = (1 − R)/(p − (1 + R)/2)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.availableTransitions_free_values
theorems.statement: theorem availableTransitions_free_values : (1 - 17 / 37 : ℚ) = 20 / 37 ∧ (1 + 17 / 37 : ℚ) / 2 = 27 / 37

theorems.name: Comparison.charge_products
theorems.statement:
theorem charge_products :

theorems.description: The charges of the five levels: `u, c` `2/3`; `d, s, b` `−1/3`.

theorems.name: Comparison.heavy_baryons
theorems.statement:
theorem heavy_baryons (M mp : ℝ) :
    (M + mp / 3 + 4 * (5 / 96 * mp)) - (M + mp / 3) = 5 / 24 * mp ∧ (M + mp / 3) - M = mp / 3
theorems.description:
**The heavy baryons of the one share:** `Λ_Q = M̄ + λ`, `Σ̄_Q = M̄ + λ + 4A`, with
`A = (5/96)m_p`, `λ = m_p/3`: `Σ̄_Q − Λ_Q = (5/24)m_p`.

theorems.name: Comparison.pair_on_singlet
theorems.statement:
theorem pair_on_singlet (h t : Fin 5) :
    (γ h ⊗ₖ γ t) *ᵥ Ω = ((γ h * γ t) ⊗ₖ (1 : Matrix Four Four ℂ)) *ᵥ Ω
theorems.description: `(γ_h ⊗ γ_t)Ω = (γ_hγ_t ⊗ 1)Ω`: a line on the second system moves to the first.

theorems.name: Comparison.singlet_inner_plane
theorems.statement:
theorem singlet_inner_plane (h t : Fin 5) :
    star Ω ⬝ᵥ (((γ h * γ t) ⊗ₖ (1 : Matrix Four Four ℂ)) *ᵥ Ω) = if h = t then 1 else 0

theorems.name: Comparison.transition_weight
theorems.statement:
theorem transition_weight (h t : Fin 5) :
    star Ω ⬝ᵥ ((L + γ h ⊗ₖ γ t) *ᵥ Ω) = 6 + if t = h then 1 else 0
theorems.description: **Prop. 86, the transition's weight:** `⟨Ω, (L + γ_h ⊗ γ_t)Ω⟩ = 6 + δ_th`.

theorems.name: Comparison.transition_inventory
theorems.statement:
theorem transition_inventory : ∀ h : Fin 5,
    ∑ p ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun p : State × State => inExcursion h p.1 = true ∧ Continues p.1 p.2),
      (6 + if p.2.2 = h then 1 else 0) = 1836
theorems.description:
**The inventory on the transitions:** `Σ_transitions (6 + [along h]) = 6M + C_h = 1836`, each transition counted
once.

theorems.name: Comparison.inventory_by_lines
theorems.statement:
theorem inventory_by_lines (h : Fin 5) :
    ∑ t, (alongCount h t : ℚ) * (6 + if t = h then 1 else 0) = 1836

theorems.statement:
theorem availableTransitions_diag (h t : Fin 5) :

theorems.name: Comparison.inventory_trace
theorems.statement: theorem inventory_trace (h : Fin 5) : (296 / 5 : ℚ) * (availableTransitionsDiag h * weightX h).trace = 1836

theorems.name: Comparison.inventory_rates
theorems.description:
**The rates:** `1836/296 = 6 + 15/74` per transition; `6·74/5 + 3 = 91.8` per excursion; `320/16 = 20`
excursions in a stationary cycle; `20·91.8 = 1836`.

theorems.name: Comparison.pole_of_count
theorems.statement:
theorem pole_of_count (c j m ζ : ℝ) (hc : c ≠ 0) :
    c * (j * m / c) - j * m = 0 ∧
      (ζ ≠ j * m / c → (ζ - j * m / c) / (c * ζ - j * m) = 1 / c) ∧
      HasDerivAt (fun j' : ℝ => j' * m / c) (m / c) j ∧
      HasDerivAt (fun j' : ℝ => -(c * ζ - j' * m)) m j
theorems.description:
**A pole carries the inverse of its count, a source the count itself:** `S(ζ, j) = cζ − jm`
vanishes at `ζ₀ = jm/c`, has `(ζ − ζ₀)/S(ζ, j) = 1/c` away from it, and `ζ₀` moves with slope
`m/c`.

theorems.name: Comparison.rest_poles
theorems.description:
**The rest poles:** `1/σ = 74/75` on `h`, `1/η = 296/295` on the others; every line alike,
`(σ + 4η)/5 = 1`; `σ − 1 = 4(1 − η) = 1/74`.

theorems.name: Comparison.record_count
theorems.statement:
theorem record_count : ∀ h j : Fin 5,
    (Finset.univ.filter fun s : State =>
      (inExcursion h s = true ∨ s = (lastDirectionRel h, h)) ∧ s.2 ≠ j).card = 60
theorems.description: **With the record `(T_h, h)` added, every line is asked sixty times.**

theorems.name: Comparison.three_readings
theorems.statement:
theorem three_readings (h : Fin 5) :
    (296 / 5 : ℚ) * ∑ t, (if t = h then σc else ηc) * (6 + if t = h then 1 else 0) = 1836 ∧
    (296 / 5 : ℚ) * ∑ t, (if t = h then σc else ηc)⁻¹ * (6 + if t = h then 1 else 0) =
      40588112 / 22125 ∧
    (300 / 5 : ℚ) * ∑ t, ((6 : ℚ) + if t = h then 1 else 0) = 1860
theorems.description:
**The three readings of `X = L(Ω) + P_h`:** the source `(M/5) Tr R_h X = 1836`, the pole
`(M/5) Tr R_h⁻¹ X = 40588112/22125`, every line alike `(300/5) Tr X = 1860`.

theorems.name: Comparison.invSqrt3_mul_self

theorems.description: A sum over the eight rotations: the seven and the eighth.

theorems.name: Comparison.last_mul

theorem last_mul (i j k l : Fin 3) :
    ((invSqrt3 / 2) • d8) i j * ((invSqrt3 / 2) • d8) k l = (1 / 12) * (d8 i j * d8 k l)

      (1 / 12) * (d8 i j * d8 k l)

theorems.name: Comparison.gen3_conjTranspose
theorems.statement: theorem gen3_conjTranspose (a : Fin 8) : (gen3 a)ᴴ = gen3 a

theorems.name: Comparison.gen3_trace
theorems.statement: theorem gen3_trace (a : Fin 8) : (gen3 a).trace = 0

theorems.name: Comparison.gen3_trace_mul

theorem gen3_trace_mul (a b : Fin 8) :
    (gen3 a * gen3 b).trace = if a = b then 1 / 2 else 0
theorems.description: **`Tr T^aT^b = δ_ab/2`.**

theorems.name: Comparison.fierz
theorems.statement:
theorem fierz (i j k l : Fin 3) :
    ∑ a, gen3 a i j * gen3 a k l =
      (1 / 2 : ℂ) * ((if i = l ∧ j = k then 1 else 0) -
        (1 / 3) * (if i = j ∧ k = l then 1 else 0))
theorems.description: **`Σ_a T^a_ij T^a_kl = ½(δ_il δ_jk − ⅓ δ_ij δ_kl)`.**

theorems.name: Comparison.casimir
theorems.statement: theorem casimir : ∑ a, gen3 a * gen3 a = (4 / 3 : ℂ) • (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℂ)
theorems.description: **The colour charge of a line:** `C_F = Σ_a T^aT^a = (4/3)·1`.

theorems.name: Comparison.star_gen3
theorems.statement: theorem star_gen3 (a : Fin 8) (k l : Fin 3) : star (gen3 a k l) = gen3 a l k

theorems.name: Comparison.meson_pair
theorems.statement: theorem meson_pair : mesonPair *ᵥ deltaVec = (-4 / 3 : ℂ) • deltaVec
theorems.description: **A line and its conjugate in `δ`: `T₁·T₂ = −4/3`.**

theorems.name: Comparison.pair_eq
theorems.statement: theorem pair_eq : pairOp = (1 / 2 : ℂ) • (swap3 - (1 / 3 : ℂ) • 1)
theorems.description: **`T₁·T₂ = ½(P − ⅓)` on two lines.**

theorems.name: Comparison.swap3_mulVec
theorems.statement: theorem swap3_mulVec (v : Fin 3 × Fin 3 → ℂ) : swap3 *ᵥ v = fun p => v (p.2, p.1)

theorems.name: Comparison.pair_antisymm
theorems.statement:
theorem pair_antisymm (v : Fin 3 × Fin 3 → ℂ) (hv : ∀ a b, v (a, b) = -v (b, a)) :
    pairOp *ᵥ v = (-2 / 3 : ℂ) • v
theorems.description: **A pair inside `ε` (antisymmetric): `T₁·T₂ = −2/3`.**

theorems.name: Comparison.pair_symm
theorems.statement:
theorem pair_symm (v : Fin 3 × Fin 3 → ℂ) (hv : ∀ a b, v (a, b) = v (b, a)) :
    pairOp *ᵥ v = (1 / 3 : ℂ) • v
theorems.description: **The symmetric pair: `T₁·T₂ = +1/3`.**

theorems.name: Comparison.pair01_eq
theorems.statement:
theorem pair01_eq (T : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℂ) (i j k : Fin 3) :
    pair01 T i j k = (1 / 2 : ℂ) * (T j i k - (1 / 3) * T i j k)

theorems.name: Comparison.pair02_eq
theorems.statement:
theorem pair02_eq (T : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℂ) (i j k : Fin 3) :
    pair02 T i j k = (1 / 2 : ℂ) * (T k j i - (1 / 3) * T i j k)

theorems.name: Comparison.baryon_line
theorems.statement:
theorem baryon_line (i j k : Fin 3) :
    pair01 epsT i j k = (-2 / 3 : ℂ) * epsT i j k ∧ pair02 epsT i j k = (-2 / 3 : ℂ) * epsT i j k ∧
      pair01 epsT i j k + pair02 epsT i j k = (-4 / 3 : ℂ) * epsT i j k
theorems.description:
**Each line of `ε` holds `−C_F`:** its two pairs give `−2/3 − 2/3 = −4/3`, as the meson's one
pair does.

theorems.name: Comparison.dot2_eq
theorems.statement: theorem dot2_eq : dot2 = (2 : ℂ) • swap2 - 1

theorems.name: Comparison.swap2_mulVec
theorems.statement: theorem swap2_mulVec (v : Fin 2 × Fin 2 → ℂ) : swap2 *ᵥ v = fun p => v (p.2, p.1)

theorems.name: Comparison.swap2_sq
theorems.statement: theorem swap2_sq : swap2 * swap2 = 1

theorems.name: Comparison.dot2_sq
theorems.statement: theorem dot2_sq : (dot2 - 1) * (dot2 + (3 : ℂ) • 1) = 0
theorems.description: **The two values:** `(σ₁·σ₂ − 1)(σ₁·σ₂ + 3) = 0`.

theorems.name: Comparison.dot2_agree
theorems.statement:
theorem dot2_agree (v : Fin 2 × Fin 2 → ℂ) (hv : ∀ a b, v (a, b) = v (b, a)) :
    dot2 *ᵥ v = v

theorems.name: Comparison.dot2_differ

theorem dot2_differ (v : Fin 2 × Fin 2 → ℂ) (hv : ∀ a b, v (a, b) = -v (b, a)) :

theorems.description: **Two last-step directions that differ count `−3`:** `σ₁·σ₂ v = −3v` for every antisymmetric `v`.

theorems.name: Comparison.dot3_mulVec

theorem dot3_mulVec (v : LastDirections3 → ℂ) :

theorems.description: **`Σ_{i<j} σ_i·σ_j = 2(P₁₂ + P₁₃ + P₂₃) − 3`** on every state.

theorems.name: Comparison.dot3_agree
theorems.statement:
theorem dot3_agree (v : LastDirections3 → ℂ) (h12 : swap12 v = v) (h13 : swap13 v = v)
    (h23 : swap23 v = v) : dot3 *ᵥ v = (3 : ℂ) • v
theorems.description: **All three last-step directions agree: `+3`.**

theorems.name: Comparison.dot3_differ
theorems.statement:
theorem dot3_differ (v : LastDirections3 → ℂ) (h : swapSum v = 0) :
    dot3 *ᵥ v = (-3 : ℂ) • v
theorems.description: **One last-step direction differs: `−3`** on every state whose three swaps sum to zero.

theorems.name: Comparison.dot3_example
theorems.statement: theorem dot3_example : dot3 *ᵥ oneDiffers = (-3 : ℂ) • oneDiffers

theorems.name: Comparison.dot3_example_agree
theorems.statement: theorem dot3_example_agree : dot3 *ᵥ allAgree = (3 : ℂ) • allAgree

theorems.name: Comparison.swapSum_twice
theorems.statement: theorem swapSum_twice (v : LastDirections3 → ℂ) : swapSum (swapSum v) = (3 : ℂ) • swapSum v
theorems.description: The three swaps twice: `Q² = 3Q` (no state of three last-step directions is odd under every swap).

theorems.name: Comparison.swapSum_smul
theorems.statement: theorem swapSum_smul (c : ℂ) (v : LastDirections3 → ℂ) : swapSum (c • v) = c • swapSum v

theorems.name: Comparison.dot3_sq

theorem dot3_sq (v : LastDirections3 → ℂ) :

theorems.description: **The three last-step directions take two values:** `(dot3 − 3)(dot3 + 3) = 0` on every state.

theorems.name: Comparison.lastDirection_cost
theorems.statement:
theorem lastDirection_cost (m u A : ℝ) (hN : m = 3 * u - 3 * A) (hΔ : 3 * u + 3 * A = 3 * (7 / 16) * m) :
    A = 5 / 96 * m ∧ u = 37 / 96 * m ∧ u - A = m / 3 ∧ 4 * A = 5 / 24 * m
theorems.description:
**The last-step direction cost and one share per light line:** `m_p = 3u − 3A` (the nucleon, last-step directions `−3`) and
`3u + 3A = 3b m_p` (the Δ, last-step directions `+3`, `b = 7/16`) give `A = (5/96)m_p`, `u = (37/96)m_p`, and the

theorems.name: Comparison.latticeGen_nodup

theorems.name: Comparison.lattice_words

**The lattice words of shape `(k, k, k)`:** a finite set of `(latticeGen k (3k)).length`
words.
