theorems.name: Comparison.class_steps
theorems.statement:
theorem class_steps : ∀ s : State,
    (stype s = 0 → (Finset.univ.filter fun s' => Continues s s' ∧ stype s' = 1).card = 4) ∧
    (stype s = 1 → (Finset.univ.filter fun s' => Continues s s' ∧ stype s' = 3).card = 4) ∧
    (stype s = 2 → (Finset.univ.filter fun s' => Continues s s' ∧ stype s' = 0).card = 1 ∧
      (Finset.univ.filter fun s' => Continues s s' ∧ stype s' = 3).card = 3) ∧
    (stype s = 3 → (Finset.univ.filter fun s' => Continues s s' ∧ stype s' = 2).card = 1 ∧
      (Finset.univ.filter fun s' => Continues s s' ∧ stype s' = 4).card = 3) ∧
    (stype s = 4 → (Finset.univ.filter fun s' => Continues s s' ∧ stype s' = 2).card = 2 ∧
      (Finset.univ.filter fun s' => Continues s s' ∧ stype s' = 4).card = 2)
theorems.description: **The steps between the classes**, counted on all eighty states.

theorems.name: Comparison.excursion_system
theorems.statement:
theorem excursion_system (z x y : ℝ) (hD : excursionDen z x y ≠ 0) :
    z ^ 3 * x * y * (1 + z * y) / excursionDen z x y =
        z * y * (z ^ 2 * x * (1 + z * y) / excursionDen z x y) ∧
      2 * z * (2 - z * y) / excursionDen z x y =
        z / 4 + 3 / 4 * z * y * (z ^ 2 * x * (1 + z * y) / excursionDen z x y) ∧
      z ^ 2 * x * (1 + z * y) / excursionDen z x y =
        1 / 4 * z * x * (2 * z * (2 - z * y) / excursionDen z x y) +
          3 / 4 * z * y * (2 * z ^ 2 * x / excursionDen z x y) ∧
      2 * z ^ 2 * x / excursionDen z x y =
        2 / 4 * z * x * (2 * z * (2 - z * y) / excursionDen z x y) +
          2 / 4 * z * y * (2 * z ^ 2 * x / excursionDen z x y) ∧
      z * x * (z ^ 3 * x * y * (1 + z * y) / excursionDen z x y) = excursionF z x y
theorems.description:
**The first-step equations and their solution:** with `D = excursionDen z x y`,
`g₁ = z³xy(1 + zy)/D`, `g₂ = 2z(2 − zy)/D`, `g₃ = z²x(1 + zy)/D`, `g₄ = 2z²x/D` solve `g₁ = zy g₃`,
`g₂ = z/4 + (3/4)zy g₃`, `g₃ = (1/4)zx g₂ + (3/4)zy g₄`, `g₄ = (2/4)zx g₂ + (2/4)zy g₄`, and the
excursion is `zx g₁ = F(z, x, y)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.excursion_system_unique
theorems.statement:
theorem excursion_system_unique (z x y g₁ g₂ g₃ g₄ : ℝ) (hD : excursionDen z x y ≠ 0)
    (h2 : 2 - z * y ≠ 0)
    (e₁ : g₁ = z * y * g₃) (e₂ : g₂ = z / 4 + 3 / 4 * z * y * g₃)
    (e₃ : g₃ = 1 / 4 * z * x * g₂ + 3 / 4 * z * y * g₄)
    (e₄ : g₄ = 2 / 4 * z * x * g₂ + 2 / 4 * z * y * g₄) :
    z * x * g₁ = excursionF z x y
theorems.description: **The first-step equations have no other solution.**

theorems.name: Comparison.GP_eq
theorems.statement: theorem GP_eq (y : ℝ) : GP y = excursionF 1 1 y

theorems.name: Comparison.GP_one
theorems.statement: theorem GP_one : GP 1 = 1

theorems.name: Comparison.GP_deriv
theorems.statement: theorem GP_deriv : HasDerivAt GP 10 1

theorems.name: Comparison.GP_denominator
theorems.statement: theorem GP_denominator (x : ℝ) : 16 - 11 * x - 3 * x ^ 2 = -3 * (x - xc) * (x - xc')

theorems.name: Comparison.xc_gt_one
theorems.statement: theorem xc_gt_one : 1 < xc

theorems.name: Comparison.xc'_neg
theorems.statement: theorem xc'_neg : xc' < 0

theorems.name: Comparison.GP_denom_pos
theorems.statement: theorem GP_denom_pos (x : ℝ) (h0 : 0 ≤ x) (h1 : x ≤ 1) : 0 < 16 - 11 * x - 3 * x ^ 2
theorems.description: **`G_P` has no pole on `[0, 1]`.**

theorems.name: Comparison.xc_root
theorems.statement: theorem xc_root : 3 * xc ^ 2 + 11 * xc - 16 = 0

theorems.name: Comparison.regression
theorems.statement:
theorem regression (x y : ℝ) (hx : x ≠ 2) (hD : excursionDen 1 y x ≠ 0) :
    excursionF 1 y x = y ^ 2 * gapF x / (4 - 3 * y * gapF x) ∧
      GP x = gapF x / (4 - 3 * gapF x)
theorems.description:
**The regression law:** with `x` per visit to the symmetric states and `y` per arrival at the vector states,
`F(1; y, x) = y²h(x)/(4 − 3y h(x))`, and `G_P = h/(4 − 3h)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.pole_condition
theorems.statement: theorem pole_condition (x : ℝ) (hx : x ≠ 2) : 3 / 4 * gapF x = 1 ↔ 3 * x ^ 2 + 11 * x - 16 = 0
theorems.description: **The vector pole condition:** `(3/4)h(x) = 1 ⟺ 3x² + 11x − 16 = 0` (for `x ≠ 2`).

theorems.name: Comparison.pion_radius
theorems.statement:
theorem pion_radius (lam : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun q : ℝ => GP (Real.exp (-(q * lam ^ 2) / 6))) (10 * (-(lam ^ 2) / 6)) 0 ∧
      -6 * (10 * (-(lam ^ 2) / 6)) = 10 * lam ^ 2
theorems.description:
**The pion's radius:** with `e^{−Q²λ²/6}` per visit to the symmetric states, `d/dQ² G_P(e^{−Q²λ²/6}) = −10λ²/6`
at `Q² = 0`; so `r_π² = −6·(−10λ²/6) = 10λ² = E P λ²`.

theorems.name: Comparison.vector_pole
theorems.statement:
theorem vector_pole (lam q : ℝ) (hl : lam ≠ 0) :
    Real.exp (-(q * lam ^ 2) / 6) = xc ↔ -q = 6 * Real.log xc / lam ^ 2
theorems.description: **The vector pole:** `e^{−Q²λ²/6} = x_c` exactly at `−Q² = 6 log(x_c)/λ²`.

theorems.name: Comparison.rotSix_eq_sum
theorems.statement:
theorem rotSix_eq_sum (p : Fin 6 × Fin 6) (hp : p.1 ≠ p.2) (c : Fin 6) :
    rotSix p c = ∑ d, ((rotMat p d c : ℤ) : ℂ) • sixP1 d

theorems.name: Comparison.gen_acts_matrix
theorems.statement:
theorem gen_acts_matrix (x : Fin 5 ⊕ Fin 10) (c : Fin 6) :
    act (gen x) (sixP1 c) = ∑ d, ((rotMat (plane x) d c : ℤ) : ℂ) • sixP1 d
theorems.description: **The matrix of each generator on P1's real six is the rotation of its plane.**

theorems.name: Comparison.rot_comm_iff
theorems.statement:
theorem rot_comm_iff (D : Finset (Fin 6)) (p : Fin 6 × Fin 6) (hp : p.1 ≠ p.2) :
    rotMat p * divSign D = divSign D * rotMat p ↔ (p.1 ∈ D ↔ p.2 ∈ D)
theorems.description: The plane rotation commutes with the sign exactly when the plane lies in one part.

theorems.name: Comparison.rot_anticomm_iff
theorems.statement:
theorem rot_anticomm_iff (D : Finset (Fin 6)) (p : Fin 6 × Fin 6) (hp : p.1 ≠ p.2) :
    rotMat p * divSign D = -(divSign D * rotMat p) ↔ ¬(p.1 ∈ D ↔ p.2 ∈ D)
theorems.description: The plane rotation anticommutes with the sign exactly when the plane joins the two parts.

theorems.name: Comparison.kept_iff
theorems.statement:
theorem kept_iff (D : Finset (Fin 6)) (x : Fin 5 ⊕ Fin 10) :
    Kept D x ↔ ((plane x).1 ∈ D ↔ (plane x).2 ∈ D)

theorems.name: Comparison.moved_iff
theorems.statement:
theorem moved_iff (D : Finset (Fin 6)) (x : Fin 5 ⊕ Fin 10) :
    Moved D x ↔ ¬((plane x).1 ∈ D ↔ (plane x).2 ∈ D)

theorems.name: Comparison.kept_xor_moved
theorems.statement: theorem kept_xor_moved (D : Finset (Fin 6)) (x : Fin 5 ⊕ Fin 10) : Kept D x ↔ ¬Moved D x
theorems.description: Every generator is kept or moved, and not both.

theorems.name: Comparison.card_kept_plane
theorems.statement:
theorem card_kept_plane : ∀ D : Finset (Fin 6),
    (Finset.univ.filter fun x : Fin 5 ⊕ Fin 10 => ((plane x).1 ∈ D ↔ (plane x).2 ∈ D)).card =
      D.card.choose 2 + (6 - D.card).choose 2

theorems.name: Comparison.card_moved_plane
theorems.statement:
theorem card_moved_plane : ∀ D : Finset (Fin 6),
    (Finset.univ.filter fun x : Fin 5 ⊕ Fin 10 => ¬((plane x).1 ∈ D ↔ (plane x).2 ∈ D)).card =
      D.card * (6 - D.card)

theorems.name: Comparison.card_kept
theorems.statement:
theorem card_kept (D : Finset (Fin 6)) :
    (Finset.univ.filter (Kept D)).card = D.card.choose 2 + (6 - D.card).choose 2
theorems.description: **Kept rotations of a division:** `C(k,2) + C(6−k,2)`, `k` the number of divided directions.

theorems.name: Comparison.card_moved
theorems.statement:
theorem card_moved (D : Finset (Fin 6)) :
    (Finset.univ.filter (Moved D)).card = D.card * (6 - D.card)
theorems.description: **Moved rotations of a division:** `k (6 − k)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.kept_compl
theorems.statement: theorem kept_compl (D : Finset (Fin 6)) (x : Fin 5 ⊕ Fin 10) : Kept Dᶜ x ↔ Kept D x
theorems.description: A division and its complement keep and move the same rotations.

theorems.name: Comparison.card_kept_compl
theorems.statement:
theorem card_kept_compl (D : Finset (Fin 6)) :
    (Finset.univ.filter (Kept Dᶜ)).card = (Finset.univ.filter (Kept D)).card

theorems.name: Comparison.four_kinds
theorems.statement:
theorem four_kinds (D : Finset (Fin 6)) :
    (D.card = 0 → (Finset.univ.filter (Kept D)).card = 15 ∧
        (Finset.univ.filter (Moved D)).card = 0) ∧
    (D.card = 1 → (Finset.univ.filter (Kept D)).card = 10 ∧
        (Finset.univ.filter (Moved D)).card = 5) ∧
    (D.card = 2 → (Finset.univ.filter (Kept D)).card = 7 ∧
        (Finset.univ.filter (Moved D)).card = 8) ∧
    (D.card = 3 → (Finset.univ.filter (Kept D)).card = 6 ∧
        (Finset.univ.filter (Moved D)).card = 9)
theorems.description:
**The four types of division under the fifteen rotations**, by the size `k` of the smaller part:
kept/moved `15/0, 10/5, 7/8, 6/9`.

theorems.name: Comparison.card_kept_ten_plane
theorems.statement:
theorem card_kept_ten_plane : ∀ D : Finset (Fin 6),
    (Finset.univ.filter fun f : Fin 10 =>
        ((plane (Sum.inr f)).1 ∈ D ↔ (plane (Sum.inr f)).2 ∈ D)).card =
      (D.erase 0).card.choose 2 + (5 - (D.erase 0).card).choose 2

theorems.name: Comparison.card_moved_ten_plane
theorems.statement:
theorem card_moved_ten_plane : ∀ D : Finset (Fin 6),
    (Finset.univ.filter fun f : Fin 10 =>
        ¬((plane (Sum.inr f)).1 ∈ D ↔ (plane (Sum.inr f)).2 ∈ D)).card =
      (D.erase 0).card * (5 - (D.erase 0).card)

theorems.name: Comparison.card_kept_ten
theorems.statement:
theorem card_kept_ten (D : Finset (Fin 6)) :
    (Finset.univ.filter fun f : Fin 10 => Kept D (Sum.inr f)).card =
      (D.erase 0).card.choose 2 + (5 - (D.erase 0).card).choose 2
theorems.description:
**With the singlet fixed**, among the ten rotations that keep the singlet, a division keeps
`C(r,2) + C(5−r,2)`, `r` the number of divided lines.

theorems.name: Comparison.card_moved_ten
theorems.statement:
theorem card_moved_ten (D : Finset (Fin 6)) :
    (Finset.univ.filter fun f : Fin 10 => Moved D (Sum.inr f)).card =
      (D.erase 0).card * (5 - (D.erase 0).card)
theorems.description: ... and moves `r (5 − r)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.six_divisions
theorems.statement:
theorem six_divisions :
    [(∅ : Finset (Fin 6)), {0}, {1}, {0, 1}, {1, 2}, {0, 1, 2}].map
      (fun D => ((Finset.univ.filter (Kept D)).card, (Finset.univ.filter (Moved D)).card,
        (Finset.univ.filter fun f : Fin 10 => Kept D (Sum.inr f)).card,
        (Finset.univ.filter fun f : Fin 10 => Moved D (Sum.inr f)).card)) =
    [(15, 0, 10, 0), (10, 5, 10, 0), (10, 5, 6, 4), (7, 8, 6, 4), (7, 8, 4, 6), (6, 9, 4, 6)]
theorems.description:
**Six divisions with the singlet fixed**: point `∅`, point with the singlet `{0}`, line `{1}`,
line with the singlet `{0, 1}`, plane `{1, 2}`, plane with the singlet `{0, 1, 2}`; under the fifteen
they are of types `0, 1, 1, 2, 2, 3`, and among the ten they keep/move `10/0, 10/0, 6/4, 6/4,
4/6, 4/6`.

theorems.name: Comparison.P3_division_keeps_ten
theorems.statement:
theorem P3_division_keeps_ten (x : Fin 5 ⊕ Fin 10) :
    Kept {1, 2, 3, 4, 5} x ↔ x.isRight
theorems.description:
**P3's own division**, the five directions divided and the singlet undivided, keeps exactly the ten symmetric
states and moves the five `i γ_s`, which turn the singlet into the lines.

theorems.name: Comparison.half_mul_self
theorems.statement: theorem half_mul_self (D : Finset (Fin 6)) : half D * half D = signD D

theorems.name: Comparison.half_transpose_mul
theorems.statement: theorem half_transpose_mul (D : Finset (Fin 6)) : (half D)ᵀ * half D = signD D
theorems.description: **`q_Dᵀ q_D = θ_D`:** the square root of the sign squares to the sign also with the transpose.

theorems.name: Comparison.half_conjTranspose_mul
theorems.statement: theorem half_conjTranspose_mul (D : Finset (Fin 6)) : (half D)ᴴ * half D = 1
theorems.description: **`q_D† q_D = 1`:** the square root of the sign keeps lengths.

theorems.name: Comparison.signD_mul_self
theorems.statement: theorem signD_mul_self (D : Finset (Fin 6)) : signD D * signD D = 1

theorems.name: Comparison.half_pow_four
theorems.statement: theorem half_pow_four (D : Finset (Fin 6)) : half D ^ 4 = 1

theorems.name: Comparison.half_mul_half_compl
theorems.statement:
theorem half_mul_half_compl (D : Finset (Fin 6)) :
    half D * half Dᶜ = I • (1 : Matrix (Fin 6) (Fin 6) ℂ)
theorems.description: **The square roots of the two parts make the quarter turn:** `q_D q_{D′} = i`.

theorems.name: Comparison.combo_eq
theorems.statement:
theorem combo_eq (D : Finset (Fin 6)) (α β : ℂ) :
    α • (1 : Matrix (Fin 6) (Fin 6) ℂ) + β • signD D =
      Matrix.diagonal fun c => if c ∈ D then α - β else α + β

theorems.name: Comparison.halves_iff
theorems.statement:
theorem halves_iff (D : Finset (Fin 6)) (hD : D.Nonempty) (hD' : Dᶜ.Nonempty) (α β : ℂ) :
    (α • (1 : Matrix (Fin 6) (Fin 6) ℂ) + β • signD D) *
        (α • (1 : Matrix (Fin 6) (Fin 6) ℂ) + β • signD D) = signD D ↔
      α ^ 2 + β ^ 2 = 0 ∧ 2 * α * β = 1
theorems.description:
**The square roots made from the sign alone:** for a division that divides something and not
everything, `(α + β θ_D)² = θ_D` exactly when `α² + β² = 0` and `2αβ = 1`.

theorems.name: Comparison.halves_solutions
theorems.description: **There are exactly four square roots:** `±((1+i)/2, (1−i)/2)` and `±((1−i)/2, (1+i)/2)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.half_eq
theorems.statement:
theorem half_eq (D : Finset (Fin 6)) :
    half D = ((1 + I) / 2) • (1 : Matrix (Fin 6) (Fin 6) ℂ) + ((1 - I) / 2) • signD D
theorems.description: The half is made from the sign: `q_D = (1+i)/2 + ((1−i)/2) θ_D`.

theorems.name: Comparison.no_real_half
theorems.statement: theorem no_real_half (α β : ℝ) : ¬ (α ^ 2 + β ^ 2 = 0 ∧ 2 * α * β = 1)
theorems.description: **No real half:** no real `α, β` have `α² + β² = 0` and `2αβ = 1`.

theorems.name: Comparison.metric
theorems.statement:
theorem metric (D : Finset (Fin 6)) (z : Fin 6 → ℂ) :
    (half D *ᵥ z) ⬝ᵥ (half D *ᵥ z) = ∑ c, (if c ∈ D then -1 else 1) * z c ^ 2
theorems.description:
**The metric of a division:** `p(q_D z) = Σ_{D′} z² − Σ_D z²`, with `p = Σ z²` on P1's real
six (the bilinear form, no conjugation).

theorems.name: Comparison.half_on_sets
theorems.statement:
theorem half_on_sets (D S : Finset (Fin 6)) :
    ∏ c ∈ S, (if c ∈ D then I else 1) = I ^ (S ∩ D).card
theorems.description: **The half on the sixty-four sets:** the set `S` is multiplied by `i^{|S ∩ D|}`.

theorems.name: Comparison.sets_count
theorems.statement:
theorem sets_count :
    (Finset.univ.filter fun S : Finset (Fin 6) => S.card % 4 = 0).card = 16 ∧
    (Finset.univ.filter fun S : Finset (Fin 6) => S.card % 4 = 1).card = 12 ∧
    (Finset.univ.filter fun S : Finset (Fin 6) => S.card % 4 = 2).card = 16 ∧
    (Finset.univ.filter fun S : Finset (Fin 6) => S.card % 4 = 3).card = 20
theorems.description: **`i^{|S|}` is `1, i, −1, −i` on `16, 12, 16, 20` of the sixty-four sets.**

theorems.name: Comparison.pf_conj
theorems.statement:
theorem pf_conj (U M : Matrix Four Four ℂ) (hM : Mᵀ = -M) :
    pf (U * M * Uᵀ) = U.det * pf M
theorems.description: **The Pfaffian law:** `Pf(U M Uᵀ) = det U · Pf M` for every antisymmetric `M`.

theorems.name: Comparison.pf_smul
theorems.statement: theorem pf_smul (c : ℂ) (M : Matrix Four Four ℂ) : pf (c • M) = c ^ 2 * pf M

theorems.name: Comparison.det_eq_one_of_keeps_J
theorems.statement: theorem det_eq_one_of_keeps_J (U : Matrix Four Four ℂ) (h : U * J * Uᵀ = J) : U.det = 1
theorems.description: **The rotations that keep the join have determinant one** (Prop. 6).

theorems.name: Comparison.sq_eq_det_of_keeps_J_up_to
theorems.statement:
theorem sq_eq_det_of_keeps_J_up_to (U : Matrix Four Four ℂ) (c : ℂ)
    (h : U * J * Uᵀ = c • J) : c ^ 2 = U.det
theorems.description: If `U J Uᵀ = c J` then `c² = det U`.

theorems.name: Comparison.kron_mulVec_Ω
theorems.statement: theorem kron_mulVec_Ω (U : Matrix Four Four ℂ) : (U ⊗ₖ U) *ᵥ Ω = relOf (U * MΩ * Uᵀ)
theorems.description: `U ⊗ U` carries the singlet to the two-spinor state with matrix `U M_Ω Uᵀ`.

theorems.name: Comparison.keeps_singlet_iff
theorems.statement: theorem keeps_singlet_iff (U : Matrix Four Four ℂ) : (U ⊗ₖ U) *ᵥ Ω = Ω ↔ U * J * Uᵀ = J
theorems.description: **The rotations that keep the singlet:** `(U ⊗ U) Ω = Ω ⟺ U J Uᵀ = J`.

theorems.name: Comparison.kron_swap_comm
theorems.statement: theorem kron_swap_comm (U : Matrix Four Four ℂ) : (U ⊗ₖ U) * swap = swap * (U ⊗ₖ U)

theorems.name: Comparison.Eop_mulVec
theorems.statement: theorem Eop_mulVec (w : Two → ℂ) : Eop *ᵥ w = (4 * (star Ω ⬝ᵥ w)) • Ω

theorems.name: Comparison.kron_unitary
theorems.statement:
theorem kron_unitary (U : Matrix Four Four ℂ) (hU : U * Uᴴ = 1) :
    (U ⊗ₖ U)ᴴ * (U ⊗ₖ U) = 1

theorems.name: Comparison.mul_Eop
theorems.statement:
theorem mul_Eop (A : Matrix Two Two ℂ) :
    A * Eop = Matrix.of fun p q => 4 * (A *ᵥ Ω) p * star (Ω q)

theorems.name: Comparison.Eop_mul
theorems.statement:
theorem Eop_mul (A : Matrix Two Two ℂ) :
    Eop * A = Matrix.of fun p q => 4 * Ω p * (star Ω ᵥ* A) q

theorems.name: Comparison.keeps_L_iff
theorems.statement:
theorem keeps_L_iff (U : Matrix Four Four ℂ) (hU : U * Uᴴ = 1) (hdet : U.det = 1) :
    (U ⊗ₖ U) * L = L * (U ⊗ₖ U) ↔ U * J * Uᵀ = J ∨ U * J * Uᵀ = -J
theorems.description:
**The rotations that keep the comparison:** a unitary `U` of determinant one keeps `L` exactly
when `U J Uᵀ = J` or `U J Uᵀ = −J`.

theorems.name: Comparison.neg_iff_I_smul
theorems.statement:
theorem neg_iff_I_smul (U : Matrix Four Four ℂ) :
    U * J * Uᵀ = -J ↔ (I • U) * J * (I • U)ᵀ = J
theorems.description: `U J Uᵀ = −J` exactly when `i U` keeps the join: the second set is `i·Sp(2)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.trace_mul_γ_eq
theorems.statement:
theorem trace_mul_γ_eq (ρ : Matrix Four Four ℂ) (hρ : ρᴴ = ρ) (s : Fin 5) :
    (ρ * γ s).trace = (mixedLine ρ s : ℂ)

theorems.name: Comparison.sum_mixedLine_sq_le
theorems.statement:
theorem sum_mixedLine_sq_le (ρ : Matrix Four Four ℂ) (hρ : ρ.PosSemidef) (htr : ρ.trace = 1) :
    ∑ s, mixedLine ρ s ^ 2 ≤ 1
theorems.description: **The line of a mixed state has length at most one.**

theorems.name: Comparison.trace_kron_mul_kron
theorems.statement:
theorem trace_kron_mul_kron (A B C D : Matrix Four Four ℂ) :
    ((A ⊗ₖ B) * (C ⊗ₖ D)).trace = (A * C).trace * (B * D).trace

theorems.name: Comparison.trace_prod_disagreement
theorems.statement:
theorem trace_prod_disagreement (ρ σ : Matrix Four Four ℂ) (hρ : ρᴴ = ρ) (hσ : σᴴ = σ)
    (hρ1 : ρ.trace = 1) (hσ1 : σ.trace = 1) :
    ((ρ ⊗ₖ σ) * disagreement).trace =
      ((5 - ∑ s, mixedLine ρ s * mixedLine σ s : ℝ) : ℂ)
theorems.description: **The disagreement of two mixed states taken separately** is `5 − m(ρ)·m(σ)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.disagreement_mixed_ge
theorems.statement:
theorem disagreement_mixed_ge (ρ σ : Matrix Four Four ℂ) (hρ : ρ.PosSemidef)
    (hσ : σ.PosSemidef) (hρ1 : ρ.trace = 1) (hσ1 : σ.trace = 1) :
    4 ≤ ((ρ ⊗ₖ σ) * disagreement).trace.re
theorems.description: **Two mixed states taken separately disagree by at least four.**

theorems.name: Comparison.disagreement_mixture_ge
theorems.statement:
theorem disagreement_mixture_ge {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (p : ι → ℝ) (hp : ∀ i, 0 ≤ p i)
    (hp1 : ∑ i, p i = 1) (ρ σ : ι → Matrix Four Four ℂ) (hρ : ∀ i, (ρ i).PosSemidef)
    (hσ : ∀ i, (σ i).PosSemidef) (hρ1 : ∀ i, (ρ i).trace = 1) (hσ1 : ∀ i, (σ i).trace = 1) :
    4 ≤ ((∑ i, (p i : ℂ) • (ρ i ⊗ₖ σ i)) * disagreement).trace.re
theorems.description: **Every mixture of pairs prepared apart disagrees by at least four.**

theorems.name: Comparison.pauli_conjTranspose
theorems.statement: theorem pauli_conjTranspose (a : Fin 4) : (pauli a)ᴴ = pauli a

theorems.name: Comparison.trace_pauli_mul
theorems.statement:
theorem trace_pauli_mul (a b : Fin 4) :
    (pauli a * pauli b).trace = if a = b then 2 else 0

theorems.name: Comparison.obs_lineIdx
theorems.statement: theorem obs_lineIdx (s : Fin 5) : obs (lineIdx s) = γ s

theorems.name: Comparison.obs_eq_pauli
theorems.statement:
theorem obs_eq_pauli (k : Fin 16) :
    obs k = obsSign k • (pauli (obsA k) ⊗ₖ pauli (obsB k))

theorems.name: Comparison.obs_conjTranspose
theorems.statement: theorem obs_conjTranspose (k : Fin 16) : (obs k)ᴴ = obs k
theorems.description: The sixteen observables are Hermitian.

theorems.name: Comparison.trace_obs_mul
theorems.statement: theorem trace_obs_mul (k l : Fin 16) : (obs k * obs l).trace = if k = l then 4 else 0
theorems.description: The sixteen observables are orthonormal: `tr(X_k X_l) = 4 δ_kl`.

theorems.name: Comparison.obs_linearIndependent
theorems.statement: theorem obs_linearIndependent : LinearIndependent ℂ obs

theorems.name: Comparison.obs_linearIndependent_real
theorems.statement: theorem obs_linearIndependent_real : LinearIndependent ℝ obs
theorems.description: The sixteen observables are linearly independent over the real numbers.

theorems.name: Comparison.obs_span
theorems.statement: theorem obs_span : Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range obs) = ⊤
theorems.description: The sixteen observables span all `4 × 4` matrices over `ℂ`.

theorems.name: Comparison.expand
theorems.statement: theorem expand (X : Matrix Four Four ℂ) : X = ∑ k, τ (X * obs k) • obs k
theorems.description: Every matrix is `Σ_k τ(X X_k) X_k`.

theorems.name: Comparison.eq_zero_of_trace
theorems.statement: theorem eq_zero_of_trace (B : Matrix Four Four ℂ) (h : ∀ k, (B * obs k).trace = 0) : B = 0

theorems.name: Comparison.star_trace_mul_of_hermitian
theorems.statement:
theorem star_trace_mul_of_hermitian {X Y : Matrix Four Four ℂ} (hX : Xᴴ = X) (hY : Yᴴ = Y) :
    star (X * Y).trace = (X * Y).trace

theorems.name: Comparison.trace_mul_re_of_hermitian
theorems.statement:
theorem trace_mul_re_of_hermitian {X Y : Matrix Four Four ℂ} (hX : Xᴴ = X) (hY : Yᴴ = Y) :
    (((X * Y).trace.re : ℝ) : ℂ) = (X * Y).trace
theorems.description: The trace of a product of two Hermitian matrices is real.

theorems.name: Comparison.τ_re_of_hermitian
theorems.statement:
theorem τ_re_of_hermitian {X Y : Matrix Four Four ℂ} (hX : Xᴴ = X) (hY : Yᴴ = Y) :
    (((τ (X * Y)).re : ℝ) : ℂ) = τ (X * Y)
theorems.description: `τ(XY)` is real for Hermitian `X` and `Y`.

theorems.name: Comparison.hermitian_expand
theorems.statement:
theorem hermitian_expand (X : Matrix Four Four ℂ) (hX : Xᴴ = X) :
    X = ∑ k, (((τ (X * obs k)).re : ℝ) : ℂ) • obs k
theorems.description: Every Hermitian matrix is a real combination of the sixteen, with coefficients `τ(X X_k)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.span_obs_eq_hermitian
theorems.statement: theorem span_obs_eq_hermitian : Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range obs) = hermitian
theorems.description:
**16 = 1 + 5 + 10.** The one, the five directions and the ten `i γ_s γ_t` span exactly the
Hermitian matrices over the real numbers.

theorems.name: Comparison.finrank_hermitian
theorems.statement: theorem finrank_hermitian : Module.finrank ℝ hermitian = 16
theorems.description: The Hermitian `4 × 4` matrices form a real space of dimension `16 = 1 + 5 + 10`.

theorems.name: Comparison.obs_mul_J
theorems.statement: theorem obs_mul_J (k : Fin 16) : obs k * J = obsParity k • (J * (obs k).map star)
theorems.description:
The one and the five directions commute with the quaternionic structure (`X J = J X̄`); the ten `i γ_s γ_t`
anticommute with it (`X J = -J X̄`).

theorems.name: Comparison.map_star_mul
theorems.statement:
theorem map_star_mul (A B : Matrix Four Four ℂ) :
    (A * B).map star = A.map star * B.map star

theorems.name: Comparison.trace_map_star
theorems.statement: theorem trace_map_star (A : Matrix Four Four ℂ) : (A.map star).trace = star A.trace

theorems.name: Comparison.J_conjTranspose_mul
theorems.statement: theorem J_conjTranspose_mul : Jᴴ * J = 1

theorems.name: Comparison.trace_mul_obs_eq_zero
theorems.statement:
theorem trace_mul_obs_eq_zero {a : Matrix Four Four ℂ} (ha : IsDistinction a) {k : Fin 16}
    (hk : obsParity k = -1) : (a * obs k).trace = 0
theorems.description: A distinction has no component along the ten `i γ_s γ_t`.

theorems.name: Comparison.trace_γ_mul_obs
theorems.statement:
theorem trace_γ_mul_obs (s : Fin 5) (k : Fin 16) :
    (γ s * obs k).trace = if lineIdx s = k then 4 else 0

theorems.name: Comparison.eq_sum_coord
theorems.statement:
theorem eq_sum_coord (a : Matrix Four Four ℂ) (ha : IsDistinction a) :
    a = ∑ s, (coord a s : ℂ) • γ s
theorems.description: **Every distinction is `Σ t_s γ_s`** with real `t_s = τ(a γ_s)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.sum_isDistinction
theorems.statement: theorem sum_isDistinction (t : Fin 5 → ℝ) : IsDistinction (∑ s, (t s : ℂ) • γ s)
theorems.description: Any real combination of the five directions is a distinction.

theorems.name: Comparison.distinction_iff
theorems.statement:
theorem distinction_iff (a : Matrix Four Four ℂ) :
    IsDistinction a ↔ ∃ t : Fin 5 → ℝ, a = ∑ s, (t s : ℂ) • γ s
theorems.description: **The distinctions are exactly the real combinations of the five directions.**

theorems.name: Comparison.coord_sum
theorems.statement: theorem coord_sum (t : Fin 5 → ℝ) : coord (∑ s, (t s : ℂ) • γ s) = t
theorems.description: The coordinates of `Σ t_s γ_s` are `t`: the five directions are a basis of the distinctions.

theorems.name: Comparison.sq_sum
theorems.statement:
theorem sq_sum (t : Fin 5 → ℂ) :
    (∑ s, t s • γ s) * (∑ s, t s • γ s) = (∑ s, t s ^ 2) • (1 : Matrix Four Four ℂ)
theorems.description: **The square of a combination of the five directions is `|t|² · 1`** (Clifford).

theorems.name: Comparison.distinction_sq
theorems.statement:
theorem distinction_sq (a : Matrix Four Four ℂ) (ha : IsDistinction a) :
    a * a = ((∑ s, coord a s ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) • (1 : Matrix Four Four ℂ)
theorems.description: **Every distinction squares to a number:** `a² = |t|² · 1` with `t` its coordinates.

theorems.name: Comparison.P3_holds
theorems.statement:
theorem P3_holds : (∃ a, IsDistinction a ∧ a ≠ 0) ∧
    ∀ a, IsDistinction a → ∃ c : ℝ, a * a = (c : ℂ) • (1 : Matrix Four Four ℂ)
theorems.description: Some distinction is not zero, and every distinction squares to a real number.

theorems.name: Comparison.Jn_two
theorems.statement: theorem Jn_two : Jn 2 = J
theorems.description: At `n = 2` the standard join is the join `J` of Book I.

theorems.name: Comparison.isDistinctionN_two
theorems.statement: theorem isDistinctionN_two (a : Matrix Four Four ℂ) : IsDistinctionN 2 a ↔ IsDistinction a

theorems.name: Comparison.P3_two
theorems.statement: theorem P3_two : P3 2
theorems.description: At `n = 2`, P3 holds.

theorems.name: Comparison.not_P3_zero
theorems.statement: theorem not_P3_zero : ¬ P3 0
theorems.description: At `n = 0` there is nothing to distinguish.

theorems.name: Comparison.distinctionN_one_eq_zero
theorems.statement:
theorem distinctionN_one_eq_zero (a : Matrix (Fin 1 × Fin 2) (Fin 1 × Fin 2) ℂ)
    (ha : IsDistinctionN 1 a) : a = 0
theorems.description: At `n = 1` every distinction is zero.

theorems.name: Comparison.not_P3_one
theorems.statement: theorem not_P3_one : ¬ P3 1

theorems.name: Comparison.diagEntries_sum
theorems.statement: theorem diagEntries_sum (m : ℕ) : ∑ i, diagEntries m i = 0

theorems.name: Comparison.diagEntries_zero
theorems.statement: theorem diagEntries_zero (m : ℕ) : diagEntries m ⟨0, by omega⟩ = 1

theorems.name: Comparison.diagEntries_two
theorems.statement: theorem diagEntries_two (m : ℕ) : diagEntries m ⟨2, by omega⟩ = 0

theorems.name: Comparison.diagWitness_map_star
theorems.statement: theorem diagWitness_map_star (m : ℕ) : (diagWitness m).map star = diagWitness m

theorems.name: Comparison.diagWitness_isDistinction
theorems.statement: theorem diagWitness_isDistinction (m : ℕ) : IsDistinctionN (m + 3) (diagWitness m)
theorems.description: For `n = m + 3 ≥ 3`, `diag(1, -1, 0, …) ⊗ 1` is a distinction.

theorems.name: Comparison.diagWitness_sq_ne
theorems.statement:
theorem diagWitness_sq_ne (m : ℕ) (c : ℂ) :
    diagWitness m * diagWitness m ≠
      c • (1 : Matrix (Fin (m + 3) × Fin 2) (Fin (m + 3) × Fin 2) ℂ)
theorems.description: For `n = m + 3 ≥ 3` the square of `diag(1, -1, 0, …) ⊗ 1` is not a number.

theorems.name: Comparison.not_P3_of_three_le
theorems.statement: theorem not_P3_of_three_le (n : ℕ) (hn : 3 ≤ n) : ¬ P3 n

theorems.name: Comparison.one_model
theorems.statement: theorem one_model (n : ℕ) : P3 n ↔ n = 2
theorems.description:
**One model.** On `ℂ^{2n}` with the standard join, some distinction is not zero and every
distinction squares to a number exactly when `n = 2`: four amplitudes.

theorems.name: Comparison.Partner.coord_apply

source_context.command: variable {H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [FiniteDimensional ℂ H]

theorems.statement:
theorem coord_apply [DecidableEq ι] (b : OrthonormalBasis ι ℂ H) (a : H →ₗ[ℂ] H) (v : H) (p : ι) :
    ⟪b p, a v⟫_ℂ = (LinearMap.toMatrixOrthonormal b a *ᵥ fun q => ⟪b q, v⟫_ℂ) p
theorems.description: The coordinates of `a v` are the matrix of `a` times the coordinates of `v`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Partner.eq_of_coord

source_context.command: variable {H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [FiniteDimensional ℂ H]

theorems.statement:
theorem eq_of_coord (b : OrthonormalBasis ι ℂ H) {v w : H}
    (h : ∀ p, ⟪b p, v⟫_ℂ = ⟪b p, w⟫_ℂ) : v = w

theorems.name: Comparison.Partner.exists_coord

source_context.command: variable {H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [FiniteDimensional ℂ H]

theorems.statement:
theorem exists_coord (b : OrthonormalBasis ι ℂ H) (x : ι → ℂ) :
    ∃ v : H, ∀ p, ⟪b p, v⟫_ℂ = x p

theorems.name: Comparison.Partner.star_mulVec_map

source_context.command: variable {H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [FiniteDimensional ℂ H]

theorems.statement:
theorem star_mulVec_map (M : Matrix ι ι ℂ) (x : ι → ℂ) :
    star (M *ᵥ x) = M.map star *ᵥ star x

theorems.name: Comparison.Partner.isDistinctionH_iff

source_context.command: variable {H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [FiniteDimensional ℂ H]

theorems.statement:
theorem isDistinctionH_iff {n : ℕ} (b : OrthonormalBasis (Fin n × Fin 2) ℂ H)
    (hb : ∀ k, b (k, 1) = -T.Θ (b (k, 0))) (a : H →ₗ[ℂ] H) :
    T.IsDistinctionH a ↔ IsDistinctionN n (LinearMap.toMatrixOrthonormal b a)
theorems.description: **In a normal basis, a distinction of `(H, Θ)` is a distinction of the standard model.**

theorems.name: Comparison.Partner.P3H_iff

source_context.command: variable {H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [FiniteDimensional ℂ H]

theorems.statement:
theorem P3H_iff {n : ℕ} (b : OrthonormalBasis (Fin n × Fin 2) ℂ H)
    (hb : ∀ k, b (k, 1) = -T.Θ (b (k, 0))) : T.P3H ↔ P3 n
theorems.description: **P3 for `(H, Θ)` is P3 for the standard model of the same size.**

theorems.name: Comparison.Partner.one_model_general

source_context.command: variable {H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [FiniteDimensional ℂ H]

theorems.statement: theorem one_model_general : T.P3H ↔ Module.finrank ℂ H = 4
theorems.description:
**One model (Prop. 23).** For every system `H` with a quaternionic structure, some distinction is not zero and
every distinction squares to a number exactly when `H` has four complex dimensions.

theorems.name: Comparison.J_transpose
theorems.statement: theorem J_transpose : Jᵀ = -J
theorems.description: The join is alternating: `Jᵀ = -J`.

theorems.name: Comparison.J_map_star
theorems.statement: theorem J_map_star : J.map star = J
theorems.description: The join is real.

theorems.name: Comparison.J_conjTranspose
theorems.statement: theorem J_conjTranspose : Jᴴ = -J

theorems.name: Comparison.J_mul_J
theorems.statement: theorem J_mul_J : J * J = -1

theorems.name: Comparison.J_mul_conjTranspose
theorems.statement: theorem J_mul_conjTranspose : J * Jᴴ = 1
theorems.description: The join is unitary.

theorems.name: Comparison.Θ_Θ
theorems.statement: theorem Θ_Θ (v : Four → ℂ) : Θ (Θ v) = -v
theorems.description: The conjugate of the conjugate is `-v`: `Θ² = -1`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Θ_orth
theorems.statement: theorem Θ_orth (v : Four → ℂ) : star v ⬝ᵥ Θ v = 0
theorems.description: Every state is orthogonal to its conjugate: `⟨v, Θ v⟩ = 0`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Θ_norm
theorems.statement: theorem Θ_norm (v : Four → ℂ) : star (Θ v) ⬝ᵥ Θ v = star v ⬝ᵥ v
theorems.description: The conjugate is as long as the state: `⟨Θ v, Θ v⟩ = ⟨v, v⟩`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Θ_add
theorems.statement: theorem Θ_add (v w : Four → ℂ) : Θ (v + w) = Θ v + Θ w

theorems.name: Comparison.Θ_smul
theorems.statement: theorem Θ_smul (c : ℂ) (v : Four → ℂ) : Θ (c • v) = star c • Θ v
theorems.description: The quaternionic structure map is antilinear.

theorems.name: Comparison.star_mulVec'
theorems.statement:
theorem star_mulVec' (a : Matrix Four Four ℂ) (v : Four → ℂ) :
    star (a *ᵥ v) = a.map star *ᵥ star v

theorems.name: Comparison.commutes_Θ_iff
theorems.statement:
theorem commutes_Θ_iff (a : Matrix Four Four ℂ) :
    (∀ v, a *ᵥ Θ v = Θ (a *ᵥ v)) ↔ a * J = J * a.map star
theorems.description: Commuting with the quaternionic structure map is the matrix identity `a J = J ā`.

theorems.name: Comparison.γ_conjTranspose
theorems.statement: theorem γ_conjTranspose (s : Fin 5) : (γ s)ᴴ = γ s

theorems.name: Comparison.γ_trace
theorems.statement: theorem γ_trace (s : Fin 5) : (γ s).trace = 0

theorems.name: Comparison.γ_mul_J
theorems.statement: theorem γ_mul_J (s : Fin 5) : γ s * J = J * (γ s).map star

theorems.name: Comparison.γ_isDistinction
theorems.statement: theorem γ_isDistinction (s : Fin 5) : IsDistinction (γ s)
theorems.description: Each of the five directions is a distinction.

theorems.name: Comparison.clifford
theorems.statement:
theorem clifford (s t : Fin 5) :
    γ s * γ t + γ t * γ s = (if s = t then (2 : ℂ) else 0) • (1 : Matrix Four Four ℂ)
theorems.description: The Clifford relation: `γ_s γ_t + γ_t γ_s = 2 δ_st`.

theorems.name: Comparison.γ_mul_self
theorems.statement: theorem γ_mul_self (s : Fin 5) : γ s * γ s = 1
theorems.description: Each line squares to one.

theorems.name: Comparison.γ_anticomm
theorems.statement: theorem γ_anticomm {s t : Fin 5} (h : s ≠ t) : γ s * γ t = -(γ t * γ s)
theorems.description: Perpendicular lines anticommute.

theorems.name: Comparison.γ_prod
theorems.statement: theorem γ_prod : γ 0 * γ 1 * γ 2 * γ 3 * γ 4 = 1
theorems.description: The product of the five directions is a number: `γ₀ γ₁ γ₂ γ₃ γ₄ = 1`.

theorems.name: Comparison.γv_mul_self
theorems.statement:
theorem γv_mul_self (n : Fin 5 → ℝ) :
    γv n * γv n = ((∑ s, n s ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) • (1 : Matrix Four Four ℂ)

theorems.name: Comparison.γv_add
theorems.statement: theorem γv_add (n m : Fin 5 → ℝ) : γv (n + m) = γv n + γv m

theorems.name: Comparison.γv_neg
theorems.statement: theorem γv_neg (n : Fin 5 → ℝ) : γv (-n) = -γv n

theorems.name: Comparison.anticomm_γv
theorems.statement:
theorem anticomm_γv (n m : Fin 5 → ℝ) :
    γv n * γv m + γv m * γv n = ((2 * ∑ s, n s * m s : ℝ) : ℂ) • (1 : Matrix Four Four ℂ)
theorems.description: **Perpendicular lines anticommute:** `γ(n) γ(m) + γ(m) γ(n) = 2 (n·m)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.side_mul_self
theorems.statement: theorem side_mul_self (n : Fin 5 → ℝ) (hn : ∑ s, n s ^ 2 = 1) : side n * side n = side n

theorems.name: Comparison.side_add_side_neg
theorems.statement: theorem side_add_side_neg (n : Fin 5 → ℝ) : side n + side (-n) = 1

theorems.name: Comparison.side_mul_side_neg
theorems.statement: theorem side_mul_side_neg (n : Fin 5 → ℝ) (hn : ∑ s, n s ^ 2 = 1) : side n * side (-n) = 0

theorems.name: Comparison.trace_side
theorems.statement: theorem trace_side (n : Fin 5 → ℝ) : (side n).trace = 2
theorems.description: **Each side has two dimensions:** `tr Q_n = 2`.

theorems.name: Comparison.overlap
theorems.statement:
theorem overlap (n m : Fin 5 → ℝ) (hn : ∑ s, n s ^ 2 = 1) :
    side n * side m * side n = (((1 + ∑ s, n s * m s) / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) • side n
theorems.description: **The overlap of two sides:** `Q_n Q_m Q_n = ((1 + n·m) / 2) Q_n` for unit `n`.

theorems.name: Comparison.overlap_symm
theorems.statement:
theorem overlap_symm (n m : Fin 5 → ℝ) :
    ∑ s, n s * m s = ∑ s, m s * n s
theorems.description: The overlap is the same number with the two lines exchanged.

theorems.name: Comparison.J_conjTranspose_mul'
theorems.statement: theorem J_conjTranspose_mul' : Jᴴ * J = 1

theorems.name: Comparison.partnerOp_eq_self_iff
theorems.statement:
theorem partnerOp_eq_self_iff (X : Matrix Four Four ℂ) (hX : Xᴴ = X) :
    partnerOp X = X ↔ X * J = J * X.map star
theorems.description: **A Hermitian operator is its own conjugate exactly when it commutes with the quaternionic structure.**

theorems.name: Comparison.partnerOp_γ
theorems.statement: theorem partnerOp_γ (s : Fin 5) : partnerOp (γ s) = γ s

theorems.name: Comparison.partnerOp_one
theorems.statement: theorem partnerOp_one : partnerOp 1 = 1

theorems.name: Comparison.transposeTwo_kron
theorems.statement: theorem transposeTwo_kron (X Y : Matrix Four Four ℂ) : transposeTwo (X ⊗ₖ Y) = X ⊗ₖ Yᵀ

theorems.name: Comparison.partnerTwo_kron
theorems.statement: theorem partnerTwo_kron (X Y : Matrix Four Four ℂ) : partnerTwo (X ⊗ₖ Y) = X ⊗ₖ partnerOp Y

theorems.name: Comparison.partnerTwo_add
theorems.statement:
theorem partnerTwo_add (M N : Matrix Two Two ℂ) :
    partnerTwo (M + N) = partnerTwo M + partnerTwo N

theorems.name: Comparison.partnerTwo_smul
theorems.statement:
theorem partnerTwo_smul (c : ℂ) (M : Matrix Two Two ℂ) :
    partnerTwo (c • M) = c • partnerTwo M

theorems.name: Comparison.partnerTwo_sum
theorems.statement:
theorem partnerTwo_sum (f : Fin 5 → Matrix Two Two ℂ) :
    partnerTwo (∑ s, f s) = ∑ s, partnerTwo (f s)

theorems.name: Comparison.partnerTwo_swap
theorems.statement: theorem partnerTwo_swap : partnerTwo swap = Eop
theorems.description: **Taking the quaternionic structure on one system turns the swap into `E`.**

theorems.name: Comparison.partnerTwo_Eop
theorems.statement: theorem partnerTwo_Eop : partnerTwo Eop = swap
theorems.description: **... and `E` into the swap.**

theorems.name: Comparison.partnerTwo_L
theorems.statement: theorem partnerTwo_L : partnerTwo L = L
theorems.description: **Taking the quaternionic structure on one system keeps the comparison** (P2 (b)).

theorems.name: Comparison.partnerTwo_swap_singlet
theorems.statement: theorem partnerTwo_swap_singlet : partnerTwo ((2 : ℂ) • (swap + Eop)) = (2 : ℂ) • (Eop + swap)
theorems.description: The same, read through the swap and the singlet: `2(P + E) ↦ 2(E + P)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Partner.inner_Θ_self
theorems.statement: theorem inner_Θ_self (v : H) : ⟪T.Θ v, v⟫_ℂ = 0

theorems.name: Comparison.Partner.inner_self_Θ
theorems.statement: theorem inner_self_Θ (v : H) : ⟪v, T.Θ v⟫_ℂ = 0
theorems.description: **Every state is perpendicular to its conjugate.**

theorems.name: Comparison.Partner.norm_Θ
theorems.statement: theorem norm_Θ (v : H) : ‖T.Θ v‖ = ‖v‖
theorems.description: **The conjugate is as long as the state.**

theorems.name: Comparison.Partner.inner_Θ_right_of
theorems.statement: theorem inner_Θ_right_of (x w : H) (h : ⟪T.Θ x, w⟫_ℂ = 0) : ⟪x, T.Θ w⟫_ℂ = 0
theorems.description: If `w ⊥ Θ x` then `Θ w ⊥ x`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Partner.inner_Θ_Θ_of
theorems.statement: theorem inner_Θ_Θ_of (x w : H) (h : ⟪x, w⟫_ℂ = 0) : ⟪T.Θ x, T.Θ w⟫_ℂ = 0
theorems.description: If `w ⊥ x` then `Θ w ⊥ Θ x`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Partner.finrank_eq
theorems.statement:
theorem finrank_eq {n : ℕ} (b : OrthonormalBasis (Fin n × Fin 2) ℂ H) :
    Module.finrank ℂ H = 2 * n
theorems.description: `dim H = 2n`: a system with a quaternionic structure has an even number of complex dimensions.

theorems.name: Comparison.Partner.exists_pairs
theorems.statement:
theorem exists_pairs (d : ℕ) : ∀ K : Submodule ℂ H, Module.finrank ℂ K = d →
    (∀ x ∈ K, T.Θ x ∈ K) →
    ∃ n : ℕ, ∃ u : Fin n → H, (∀ k, u k ∈ K) ∧ (∀ k, ‖u k‖ = 1) ∧
      (∀ k l, k ≠ l → ⟪u k, u l⟫_ℂ = 0 ∧ ⟪u k, T.Θ (u l)⟫_ℂ = 0) ∧ 2 * n = d
theorems.description:
**The pairs of a quaternionic structure.** Every subspace `K` kept by `Θ` has unit vectors `u₁, …, u_n` in
`K` such that `u_k` is perpendicular to `u_l` and to `Θ u_l` for `k ≠ l`, with `2n = dim K`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Partner.pairs_orthonormal
theorems.statement:
theorem pairs_orthonormal {n : ℕ} (u : Fin n → H) (h1 : ∀ k, ‖u k‖ = 1)
    (h2 : ∀ k l, k ≠ l → ⟪u k, u l⟫_ℂ = 0 ∧ ⟪u k, T.Θ (u l)⟫_ℂ = 0) :
    Orthonormal ℂ (T.pairs u)

theorems.name: Comparison.Partner.exists_normal_basis
theorems.statement:
theorem exists_normal_basis :
    ∃ n : ℕ, ∃ b : OrthonormalBasis (Fin n × Fin 2) ℂ H, ∀ k, b (k, 1) = -T.Θ (b (k, 0))
theorems.description:
**The normal form of the quaternionic structure** (Prop. 1 (iii)): `H` has an orthonormal basis
`u₁, −Θu₁, …, u_n, −Θu_n`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Partner.Jn_mulVec
theorems.statement:
theorem Jn_mulVec (n : ℕ) (w : Fin n × Fin 2 → ℂ) (k : Fin n) (a : Fin 2) :
    (Jn n *ᵥ w) (k, a) = ε a 0 * w (k, 0) + ε a 1 * w (k, 1)

theorems.name: Comparison.Partner.coord_Θ
theorems.statement:
theorem coord_Θ {n : ℕ} (b : OrthonormalBasis (Fin n × Fin 2) ℂ H)
    (hb : ∀ k, b (k, 1) = -T.Θ (b (k, 0))) (v : H) (p : Fin n × Fin 2) :
    ⟪b p, T.Θ v⟫_ℂ = (Jn n *ᵥ fun q => star ⟪b q, v⟫_ℂ) p
theorems.description:
**In the normal basis the quaternionic structure is `J_n K`:** the coordinates `⟪b p, Θ v⟫` of `Θ v` are
`J_n` times the conjugate coordinates of `v`.

theorems.name: Comparison.γ_mul_J_transpose
theorems.statement: theorem γ_mul_J_transpose (s : Fin 5) : (γ s * J)ᵀ = -(γ s * J)

theorems.name: Comparison.sixP3_transpose
theorems.statement: theorem sixP3_transpose (a : Fin 6) : (sixP3 a)ᵀ = -sixP3 a
theorems.description: **The six directions are antisymmetric** (P3's form).

theorems.name: Comparison.smul_γ_mul_J_transpose
theorems.statement: theorem smul_γ_mul_J_transpose (s : Fin 5) : (I • (γ s * J))ᵀ = -(I • (γ s * J))

theorems.name: Comparison.sixP1_transpose
theorems.statement: theorem sixP1_transpose (a : Fin 6) : (sixP1 a)ᵀ = -sixP1 a
theorems.description: P1's real six are antisymmetric.

theorems.name: Comparison.pf_J
theorems.statement: theorem pf_J : pf J = 1

theorems.name: Comparison.sign_of_time
theorems.statement:
theorem sign_of_time (t₀ : ℂ) (t : Fin 5 → ℂ) :
    pf (t₀ • J + ∑ s, t s • (γ s * J)) / pf J = t₀ ^ 2 - ∑ s, t s ^ 2
theorems.description:
**The sign of time.** On the singlet and the five directions,
`Pf(t₀ J + Σ t_s γ_s J) / Pf J = t₀² − Σ t_s²`: one plus sign and five minus signs.

theorems.name: Comparison.pf_P1_six
theorems.statement:
theorem pf_P1_six (t₀ : ℂ) (t : Fin 5 → ℂ) :
    pf (t₀ • J + ∑ s, t s • (I • (γ s * J))) / pf J = t₀ ^ 2 + ∑ s, t s ^ 2
theorems.description:
**With the extra `i` on the lines (P1's real six) the Pfaffian is the length:**
`Pf(t₀ J + Σ t_s (i γ_s J)) / Pf J = t₀² + Σ t_s²`.

theorems.name: Comparison.det_fin_four
theorems.statement:
theorem det_fin_four (a b c d e f g h i j k l m n o p : ℂ) :
    (!![a, b, c, d; e, f, g, h; i, j, k, l; m, n, o, p] : Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) ℂ).det =
      a * (f * (k * p - l * o) - g * (j * p - l * n) + h * (j * o - k * n))
      - b * (e * (k * p - l * o) - g * (i * p - l * m) + h * (i * o - k * m))
      + c * (e * (j * p - l * n) - f * (i * p - l * m) + h * (i * n - j * m))
      - d * (e * (j * o - k * n) - f * (i * o - k * m) + g * (i * n - j * m))
theorems.description: The determinant of a `4 × 4` matrix, by its first row.

theorems.name: Comparison.det_four
theorems.description: A matrix on `Four` has the determinant of its `Fin 4` form.

theorems.name: Comparison.det_eq_pf_sq
theorems.statement: theorem det_eq_pf_sq (M : Matrix Four Four ℂ) (hM : Mᵀ = -M) : M.det = pf M ^ 2
theorems.description: **`det M = (Pf M)²` for an antisymmetric `4 × 4` matrix.**

theorems.name: Comparison.det_J
theorems.statement: theorem det_J : J.det = 1

theorems.name: Comparison.det_cone
theorems.statement:
theorem det_cone (t₀ : ℂ) (t : Fin 5 → ℂ) :
    (t₀ • (1 : Matrix Four Four ℂ) + ∑ s, t s • γ s).det = (t₀ ^ 2 - ∑ s, t s ^ 2) ^ 2
theorems.description: **The cone of the one and the five directions:** `det(t₀ + Σ t_s γ_s) = (t₀² − Σ t_s²)²`.

theorems.name: Comparison.genIdx_injective
theorems.statement: theorem genIdx_injective : Function.Injective genIdx

theorems.name: Comparison.obs_trace
theorems.statement: theorem obs_trace (k : Fin 16) : (obs k).trace = if k = 0 then 4 else 0

theorems.name: Comparison.genIdx_ne_zero
theorems.statement: theorem genIdx_ne_zero (x : Fin 5 ⊕ Fin 10) : genIdx x ≠ 0

theorems.name: Comparison.gen_mem
theorems.statement: theorem gen_mem (x : Fin 5 ⊕ Fin 10) : gen x ∈ su4

theorems.name: Comparison.gen_linearIndependent
theorems.statement: theorem gen_linearIndependent : LinearIndependent ℝ gen

theorems.name: Comparison.su4_eq_span
theorems.statement: theorem su4_eq_span : su4 = Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range gen)
theorems.description: Every generator is a real combination of the fifteen.

theorems.name: Comparison.finrank_su4
theorems.statement: theorem finrank_su4 : Module.finrank ℝ su4 = 15
theorems.description: **There are fifteen rotations:** the generators form a real space of dimension 15.

theorems.name: Comparison.obs_transpose
theorems.statement: theorem obs_transpose (k : Fin 16) : (obs k)ᵀ = (obs k).map star

theorems.name: Comparison.obsParity_sq
theorems.statement: theorem obsParity_sq (k : Fin 16) : obsParity k * obsParity k = 1

theorems.name: Comparison.obs_join
theorems.statement:
theorem obs_join (k : Fin 16) :
    obs k * J + J * (obs k)ᵀ = (1 + obsParity k) • (obs k * J)
theorems.description: `X J + J Xᵀ = (1 + parity) X J` on the sixteen observables.

theorems.name: Comparison.line_turns_singlet
theorems.statement: theorem line_turns_singlet (s : Fin 5) : joinMap (gen (Sum.inl s)) = (2 * I) • (γ s * J)
theorems.description: **The five `i γ_s` move the join:** `X J + J Xᵀ = 2 i γ_s J`.

theorems.name: Comparison.plane_keeps_singlet
theorems.statement: theorem plane_keeps_singlet (f : Fin 10) : joinMap (gen (Sum.inr f)) = 0
theorems.description: **The ten symmetric states keep the join:** `X J + J Xᵀ = 0`.

theorems.name: Comparison.γ_linearIndependent_real
theorems.statement: theorem γ_linearIndependent_real : LinearIndependent ℝ γ

theorems.name: Comparison.sp2_eq_span
theorems.statement: theorem sp2_eq_span : sp2 = Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range fun f : Fin 10 => gen (Sum.inr f))
theorems.description: **The rotations that keep the join are the ten symmetric states.**

theorems.name: Comparison.finrank_sp2
theorems.statement: theorem finrank_sp2 : Module.finrank ℝ sp2 = 10
theorems.description: **Ten of the fifteen rotations keep the join.**

theorems.name: Comparison.fifteen_eq_ten_add_five
theorems.statement:
theorem fifteen_eq_ten_add_five :
    Module.finrank ℝ su4 = Module.finrank ℝ sp2 + 5
theorems.description: The five that move the join, and the ten that keep it, make all fifteen.

theorems.name: Comparison.keeps_partner_iff
theorems.statement:
theorem keeps_partner_iff (U : Matrix Four Four ℂ) (hU : U * Uᴴ = 1) :
    (∀ v, U *ᵥ Θ v = Θ (U *ᵥ v)) ↔ U * J * Uᵀ = J
theorems.description: **A unitary keeps the quaternionic structure exactly when it keeps the join:** `U Θ = Θ U ⟺ U J Uᵀ = J`.

theorems.name: Comparison.planeLines_ne
theorems.statement: theorem planeLines_ne (f : Fin 10) : (planeLines f).1 ≠ (planeLines f).2

theorems.name: Comparison.gen_inl
theorems.statement: theorem gen_inl (s : Fin 5) : gen (Sum.inl s) = I • γ s

theorems.name: Comparison.gen_inr
theorems.statement: theorem gen_inr (f : Fin 10) : gen (Sum.inr f) = -(γ (planeLines f).1 * γ (planeLines f).2)

theorems.name: Comparison.sixP1_zero
theorems.statement: theorem sixP1_zero : sixP1 0 = J

theorems.name: Comparison.sixP1_succ
theorems.statement: theorem sixP1_succ (u : Fin 5) : sixP1 u.succ = I • (γ u * J)

theorems.name: Comparison.J_mul_γ_transpose
theorems.statement: theorem J_mul_γ_transpose (s : Fin 5) : J * (γ s)ᵀ = γ s * J

theorems.name: Comparison.J_mul_plane_transpose
theorems.statement: theorem J_mul_plane_transpose (a b : Fin 5) : J * (γ a * γ b)ᵀ = γ b * γ a * J

theorems.name: Comparison.act_line_singlet
theorems.statement: theorem act_line_singlet (s : Fin 5) : act (I • γ s) J = (2 : ℂ) • (I • (γ s * J))
theorems.description: A line turns the singlet toward itself: `i γ_s · J = 2 (i γ_s J)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.act_line_line
theorems.statement:
theorem act_line_line (s u : Fin 5) :
    act (I • γ s) (I • (γ u * J)) = if s = u then (-2 : ℂ) • J else 0
theorems.description:
A line turns itself back to the singlet and leaves the other lines:
`i γ_s · (i γ_u J) = -2 δ_su J`.

theorems.name: Comparison.comm_plane
theorems.statement:
theorem comm_plane (u a b : Fin 5) (hab : a ≠ b) :
    γ u * (γ a * γ b) - γ a * γ b * γ u =
      if u = a then (2 : ℂ) • γ b else if u = b then (-2 : ℂ) • γ a else 0
theorems.description: The plane commutator: `[γ_u, γ_a γ_b]` is `2 γ_b`, `-2 γ_a` or `0`.

theorems.name: Comparison.act_plane_line
theorems.statement:
theorem act_plane_line (a b u : Fin 5) (hab : a ≠ b) :
    act (-(γ a * γ b)) (I • (γ u * J)) =
      if u = a then (2 : ℂ) • (I • (γ b * J))
      else if u = b then (-2 : ℂ) • (I • (γ a * J)) else 0
theorems.description: A plane rotations the lines: `(−γ_a γ_b) · (i γ_u J) = i [γ_u, γ_a γ_b] J`.

theorems.name: Comparison.plane_lt
theorems.statement: theorem plane_lt (x : Fin 5 ⊕ Fin 10) : (plane x).1 < (plane x).2

theorems.name: Comparison.plane_bijective
theorems.statement:
theorem plane_bijective :
    Function.Injective plane ∧ ∀ p : Fin 6 × Fin 6, p.1 < p.2 → ∃ x, plane x = p
theorems.description: **The fifteen generators and the fifteen planes of the six correspond one to one.**

theorems.name: Comparison.plane_fst_eq_zero_iff
theorems.statement: theorem plane_fst_eq_zero_iff (x : Fin 5 ⊕ Fin 10) : (plane x).1 = 0 ↔ x.isLeft
theorems.description: The ten symmetric states are exactly the planes that do not contain the singlet.

theorems.name: Comparison.gen_acts
theorems.statement: theorem gen_acts (x : Fin 5 ⊕ Fin 10) (c : Fin 6) : act (gen x) (sixP1 c) = rotSix (plane x) c
theorems.description:
**The fifteen rotations turn P1's real six as the fifteen rotations of planes:** each generator
turns exactly its plane.

theorems.name: Comparison.sum_two
theorems.statement: theorem sum_two (f : Two → ℂ) : ∑ p, f p = ∑ x : Four, ∑ y : Four, f (x, y)
theorems.description: A sum over two systems is a double sum, one system at a time.

theorems.name: Comparison.relOf_injective
theorems.statement: theorem relOf_injective : Function.Injective relOf

theorems.name: Comparison.relOf_add
theorems.statement: theorem relOf_add (M N : Matrix Four Four ℂ) : relOf (M + N) = relOf M + relOf N

theorems.name: Comparison.relOf_smul
theorems.statement: theorem relOf_smul (c : ℂ) (M : Matrix Four Four ℂ) : relOf (c • M) = c • relOf M

theorems.name: Comparison.kron_mulVec_relOf
theorems.statement:
theorem kron_mulVec_relOf (A B M : Matrix Four Four ℂ) :
    (A ⊗ₖ B) *ᵥ relOf M = relOf (A * M * Bᵀ)
theorems.description: `(A ⊗ B)` acts on the matrix of a two-spinor state as `M ↦ A M Bᵀ`.

theorems.name: Comparison.dot_relOf
theorems.statement:
theorem dot_relOf (M N : Matrix Four Four ℂ) :
    star (relOf M) ⬝ᵥ relOf N = (Mᴴ * N).trace
theorems.description: The inner product of two two-spinor states is `tr(M† N)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Ω_eq_sum
theorems.statement:
theorem Ω_eq_sum :
    Ω = (1 / 2 : ℂ) • ∑ j : Four, fun p : Two =>
      (Pi.single j (1 : ℂ) : Four → ℂ) p.1 * Θ (Pi.single j 1) p.2
theorems.description: `Ω = ½ Σ_j u_j ⊗ Θ u_j` for the standard basis `u_j`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Ω_basis_free
theorems.statement:
theorem Ω_basis_free (U : Matrix Four Four ℂ) (hU : U * Uᴴ = 1) :
    (1 / 2 : ℂ) • ∑ j : Four, (fun p : Two => U p.1 j * Θ (fun i => U i j) p.2) = Ω
theorems.description:
The singlet is the same in every orthonormal basis: for every unitary `U` with columns `u_j`,
`½ Σ_j u_j ⊗ Θ u_j = Ω`.

theorems.name: Comparison.MΩ_mul_conjTranspose
theorems.statement: theorem MΩ_mul_conjTranspose : MΩ * MΩᴴ = (1 / 4 : ℂ) • (1 : Matrix Four Four ℂ)

theorems.name: Comparison.Ω_norm
theorems.statement: theorem Ω_norm : star Ω ⬝ᵥ Ω = 1
theorems.description: The singlet has length one.

theorems.name: Comparison.map_star_eq_transpose
theorems.statement: theorem map_star_eq_transpose {a : Matrix Four Four ℂ} (ha : aᴴ = a) : a.map star = aᵀ
theorems.description: For a Hermitian matrix, `ā = aᵀ`.

theorems.name: Comparison.γ_mul_J_eq
theorems.statement: theorem γ_mul_J_eq (s : Fin 5) : γ s * J = J * (γ s)ᵀ

theorems.name: Comparison.MΩ_mul_γ_transpose
theorems.statement: theorem MΩ_mul_γ_transpose (s : Fin 5) : MΩ * (γ s)ᵀ = γ s * MΩ
theorems.description: On the matrix of the singlet: `M_Ω γ_sᵀ = γ_s M_Ω`.

theorems.name: Comparison.same_from_either_thing
theorems.statement: theorem same_from_either_thing (s : Fin 5) : (1 ⊗ₖ γ s) *ᵥ Ω = (γ s ⊗ₖ 1) *ᵥ Ω
theorems.description: **A line acts on the singlet the same from either system:** `(1 ⊗ γ_s) Ω = (γ_s ⊗ 1) Ω`.

theorems.name: Comparison.swap_relOf
theorems.statement: theorem swap_relOf (M : Matrix Four Four ℂ) : swap *ᵥ relOf M = relOf Mᵀ

theorems.name: Comparison.L_eq_swap_singlet
theorems.statement: theorem L_eq_swap_singlet : L = (2 : ℂ) • (swap + Eop)
theorems.description: **The comparison is the swap and the singlet:** `L = 2 (P + E)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.rel_eq_relOf
theorems.statement: theorem rel_eq_relOf (k : Fin 16) : rel k = relOf (relOp k * MΩ)

theorems.name: Comparison.rel_zero
theorems.statement: theorem rel_zero : rel 0 = Ω

theorems.name: Comparison.γ_conj_line_ne
theorems.statement: theorem γ_conj_line_ne {u s : Fin 5} (h : u ≠ s) : γ u * γ s * γ u = -γ s

theorems.name: Comparison.γ_conj_plane_left
theorems.statement:
theorem γ_conj_plane_left {s t : Fin 5} (h : s ≠ t) :
    γ s * (γ s * γ t) * γ s = -(γ s * γ t)

theorems.name: Comparison.γ_conj_plane_right
theorems.statement:
theorem γ_conj_plane_right {s t : Fin 5} (h : s ≠ t) :
    γ t * (γ s * γ t) * γ t = -(γ s * γ t)

theorems.name: Comparison.γ_conj_plane_out
theorems.statement:
theorem γ_conj_plane_out {u s t : Fin 5} (hs : u ≠ s) (ht : u ≠ t) :
    γ u * (γ s * γ t) * γ u = γ s * γ t

theorems.name: Comparison.γ_conj_relOp
theorems.statement:
theorem γ_conj_relOp (u : Fin 5) (k : Fin 16) :
    γ u * relOp k * γ u = (if u ∈ disagreeSet k then -1 else 1 : ℂ) • relOp k
theorems.description: A line `γ_u` turns `B_k` into `∓ B_k`: minus exactly when the two-spinor state disagrees on `u`.

theorems.name: Comparison.agreement
theorems.statement:
theorem agreement (u : Fin 5) (k : Fin 16) :
    (γ u ⊗ₖ γ u) *ᵥ rel k = (if u ∈ disagreeSet k then -1 else 1 : ℂ) • rel k
theorems.description:
**Agreement and disagreement:** `γ_u ⊗ γ_u` is `-1` on a two-spinor state that disagrees on `u` and
`+1` on one that agrees on it.

theorems.name: Comparison.count_rel
theorems.statement:
theorem count_rel (u : Fin 5) (k : Fin 16) :
    count u *ᵥ rel k = (if u ∈ disagreeSet k then 1 else 0 : ℂ) • rel k
theorems.description: `n_u e = [u ∈ S] e`: the two-spinor state `e` disagrees exactly on the lines of `S`.

theorems.name: Comparison.sum_sign
theorems.statement:
theorem sum_sign (D : Finset (Fin 5)) :
    ∑ u : Fin 5, (if u ∈ D then -1 else 1 : ℂ) = 5 - 2 * D.card

theorems.name: Comparison.L_rel
theorems.statement:
theorem L_rel (k : Fin 16) :
    L *ᵥ rel k = ((6 : ℂ) - 2 * (disagreeSet k).card) • rel k
theorems.description: **The comparison on the sixteen two-spinor states:** `L e = (1 + agree − disagree) e = (6 − 2|S|) e`.

theorems.name: Comparison.relOp_eq_obs
theorems.statement: theorem relOp_eq_obs (k : Fin 16) : relOp k = relPhase k • obs k

theorems.name: Comparison.trace_relOp
theorems.statement:
theorem trace_relOp (k l : Fin 16) :
    ((relOp k)ᴴ * relOp l).trace = if k = l then 4 else 0

theorems.name: Comparison.rel_inner
theorems.statement: theorem rel_inner (k l : Fin 16) : star (rel k) ⬝ᵥ rel l = if k = l then 1 else 0
theorems.description: **The sixteen two-spinor states are orthonormal.**

theorems.name: Comparison.rel_linearIndependent
theorems.statement: theorem rel_linearIndependent : LinearIndependent ℂ rel

theorems.name: Comparison.rel_span
theorems.statement: theorem rel_span : Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range rel) = ⊤
theorems.description: The sixteen two-spinor states span all two-spinor states of two systems.

theorems.name: Comparison.L_rel'
theorems.statement: theorem L_rel' (k : Fin 16) : L *ᵥ rel k = ((Lvalue k : ℤ) : ℂ) • rel k

theorems.name: Comparison.eigenspace_L
theorems.statement:
theorem eigenspace_L (μ : ℤ) :
    Module.End.eigenspace (Matrix.toLin' L) (μ : ℂ) =
      Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range fun k : {k : Fin 16 // Lvalue k = μ} => rel k.1)
theorems.description: The eigenspace of `L` for `μ` is spanned by the two-spinor states with value `μ`.

theorems.name: Comparison.finrank_eigenspace_L
Comparison.finrank_eigenspace_L_six
theorems.statement:
theorem finrank_eigenspace_L_six :
    Module.finrank ℂ (Module.End.eigenspace (Matrix.toLin' L) 6) = 1
theorems.description: **The comparison takes the value 6 once** (the singlet).

theorems.name: Comparison.finrank_eigenspace_L_two
theorems.statement:
theorem finrank_eigenspace_L_two :
    Module.finrank ℂ (Module.End.eigenspace (Matrix.toLin' L) 2) = 10
theorems.description: **The comparison takes the value 2 ten times** (the symmetric states).

theorems.name: Comparison.finrank_eigenspace_L_neg_two
theorems.statement:
theorem finrank_eigenspace_L_neg_two :
    Module.finrank ℂ (Module.End.eigenspace (Matrix.toLin' L) (-2)) = 5
theorems.description: **The comparison takes the value −2 five times** (the lines).

theorems.name: Comparison.eigenspace_L_other
theorems.statement:
theorem eigenspace_L_other (μ : ℂ) (h6 : μ ≠ 6) (h2 : μ ≠ 2) (hm2 : μ ≠ -2) :
    Module.End.eigenspace (Matrix.toLin' L) μ = ⊥
theorems.description: **The comparison takes no other value.**

theorems.name: Comparison.disagreement_eq_zero_iff
theorems.statement:
theorem disagreement_eq_zero_iff (v : Two → ℂ) :
    disagreement *ᵥ v = 0 ↔ ∃ c : ℂ, v = c • Ω
theorems.description: **The singlet is the only two-spinor state with no disagreement:** `(6 − L) v = 0 ⟺ v ∈ ℂ Ω`.

theorems.name: Comparison.disagreement_sum_sq
theorems.statement:
theorem disagreement_sum_sq :
    disagreement = (1 / 2 : ℂ) • ∑ s, (γ s ⊗ₖ 1 - 1 ⊗ₖ γ s) * (γ s ⊗ₖ 1 - 1 ⊗ₖ γ s)
theorems.description:
**The disagreement is half the sum of the squared differences along the five directions:**
`6 − L = ½ Σ_s (γ_s ⊗ 1 − 1 ⊗ γ_s)²`.

theorems.name: Comparison.kron_mulVec_prodRel
theorems.statement:
theorem kron_mulVec_prodRel (A B : Matrix Four Four ℂ) (a b : Four → ℂ) :
    (A ⊗ₖ B) *ᵥ prodRel a b = prodRel (A *ᵥ a) (B *ᵥ b)

theorems.name: Comparison.dot_prodRel
theorems.statement:
theorem dot_prodRel (a b c d : Four → ℂ) :
    star (prodRel a b) ⬝ᵥ prodRel c d = (star a ⬝ᵥ c) * (star b ⬝ᵥ d)

theorems.name: Comparison.lineOf_im
theorems.statement: theorem lineOf_im (a : Four → ℂ) (s : Fin 5) : (star a ⬝ᵥ (γ s *ᵥ a)).im = 0
theorems.description: `⟨a, γ_s a⟩` is real.

theorems.name: Comparison.dot_γ_eq
theorems.statement:
theorem dot_γ_eq (a : Four → ℂ) (s : Fin 5) :
    star a ⬝ᵥ (γ s *ᵥ a) = (lineOf a s : ℂ)

theorems.name: Comparison.dot_self_eq
theorems.statement: theorem dot_self_eq (a : Four → ℂ) : star a ⬝ᵥ a = (normSq a : ℂ)

theorems.name: Comparison.sum_lineOf_sq
theorems.statement: theorem sum_lineOf_sq (a : Four → ℂ) : ∑ s, lineOf a s ^ 2 = normSq a ^ 2
theorems.description: **Every state lies on one line:** `Σ_s ⟨a, γ_s a⟩² = ⟨a, a⟩²`.

theorems.name: Comparison.lineOf_unit
theorems.statement: theorem lineOf_unit (a : Four → ℂ) (ha : normSq a = 1) : ∑ s, lineOf a s ^ 2 = 1
theorems.description: **The line of a unit state is a unit vector:** every state lies on the plus side of one line.

theorems.name: Comparison.normSq_nonneg
theorems.statement: theorem normSq_nonneg (a : Four → ℂ) : 0 ≤ normSq a

theorems.name: Comparison.disagreement_prodRel
theorems.statement:
theorem disagreement_prodRel (a b : Four → ℂ) :
    star (prodRel a b) ⬝ᵥ (disagreement *ᵥ prodRel a b) =
      ((5 * normSq a * normSq b - ∑ s, lineOf a s * lineOf b s : ℝ) : ℂ)
theorems.description: The disagreement of the product `a ⊗ b` is `5 |a|² |b|² − m(a)·m(b)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.disagreement_prodRel_ge
theorems.statement:
theorem disagreement_prodRel_ge (a b : Four → ℂ) (ha : normSq a = 1) (hb : normSq b = 1) :
    4 ≤ (star (prodRel a b) ⬝ᵥ (disagreement *ᵥ prodRel a b)).re
theorems.description:
**Two systems prepared apart disagree by at least four:** for unit states `a` and `b`, the
disagreement of `a ⊗ b` is at least `4`.

theorems.name: Comparison.card_excursionStates
theorems.statement: theorem card_excursionStates (h : Fin 5) : (excursionStates h).card = 74
theorems.description: **Seventy-four states.**

theorems.name: Comparison.undo_state_only_from_place
theorems.statement:
theorem undo_state_only_from_place (h : Fin 5) (s : State) (hs : Continues s (lastDirectionRel h, h)) :
    s.1 = 0
theorems.description: **The undo state `(T_h, h)` is reached only from the start's vertex, by the step `h`.**

theorems.name: Comparison.mem_preds
theorems.statement: theorem mem_preds : ∀ s s' : State, s ∈ preds s' ↔ Continues s s'

theorems.name: Comparison.mem_succs
theorems.statement: theorem mem_succs : ∀ s s' : State, s' ∈ succs s ↔ Continues s s'

theorems.name: Comparison.excursionStates_eq_reach
theorems.statement: theorem excursionStates_eq_reach : ∀ (h : Fin 5) (s : State), reach h 3 s = inExcursion h s
theorems.description: **Every state but the six set apart is reached, within four steps.**

theorems.name: Comparison.mem_setApart
theorems.statement: theorem mem_setApart : ∀ (h : Fin 5) (s : State), s ∈ setApart h ↔ inExcursion h s = false

theorems.name: Comparison.setApart_short
theorems.statement:
theorem setApart_short : ∀ h : Fin 5, ∀ e₁ ∈ setApart h, ∀ e₂ ∈ setApart h, ∀ e₃ ∈ setApart h,
    ¬(Continues e₁ e₂ ∧ Continues e₂ e₃)
theorems.description: No walk stays three steps among the six set apart, so the paths above are all the excursions.

theorems.name: Comparison.watched_inflow
theorems.statement: theorem watched_inflow : ∀ (h : Fin 5) (s' : State), inExcursion h s' → watchedIn64 h s' = 64
theorems.description:
**The uniform law on the seventy-four is stationary for the walk watched on them:** every
state of the seventy-four receives the total weight one.

theorems.name: Comparison.watched_outflow
theorems.statement: theorem watched_outflow : ∀ (h : Fin 5) (s : State), inExcursion h s → watchedOut64 h s = 64
theorems.description: Every state of the seventy-four gives the total weight one: the watched walk loses nothing.

theorems.name: Comparison.availableTransitions_along
theorems.statement: theorem availableTransitions_along : ∀ h : Fin 5, alongCount h h = 60 ∧ ∀ j, j ≠ h → alongCount h j = 59
theorems.description: **Sixty along the last-step direction, fifty-nine along each other line.**

theorems.name: Comparison.availableTransitions_total
theorems.statement: theorem availableTransitions_total : ∀ h : Fin 5, ∑ j, alongCount h j = 296
theorems.description: **`M = 296 = 4 · 74` continuations.**

theorems.name: Comparison.availableTransitions_shares
theorems.statement:
theorem availableTransitions_shares (h : Fin 5) :
    let M : ℚ

theorems.name: Comparison.availableTransitions_up
theorems.statement:
theorem availableTransitions_up :
    ∀ h : Fin 5, ((excursionStates h).filter fun s => h ∉ disagreeSet s.1).card = 34
theorems.description: **`34` of the seventy-four leave the last-step direction undivided:** `R_ud = 34/74 = 17/37`.

theorems.name: Comparison.doubled_det

source_context.command:

  [DecidableEq q]

theorems.statement:
theorem doubled_det (K : Matrix n n ℂ) [Invertible K] (X : Matrix n p ℂ) (Y : Matrix n q ℂ)
    (s t : ℂ) : (doubled K X Y s t).det = K.det * Kᴴ.det * (1 - (t * s) • bornM K X Y).det
theorems.description: **`det 𝔻(s, t) = det K · det K† · det(1 − ts M)`.**

theorems.name: Comparison.bornM_trace

source_context.command:

  [DecidableEq q]

theorems.statement:
theorem bornM_trace (K : Matrix n n ℂ) [Invertible K] (X : Matrix n p ℂ) (Y : Matrix n q ℂ) :
    (bornM K X Y).trace =
      ((∑ i, ∑ j, Complex.normSq ((Yᴴ * ⅟K * X) i j) : ℝ) : ℂ)
theorems.description: **`tr(G†YY†GXX†) = ‖Y†GX‖²`.**

theorems.name: Comparison.bornM_trace_nonneg

source_context.command:

  [DecidableEq q]

theorems.statement:
theorem bornM_trace_nonneg (K : Matrix n n ℂ) [Invertible K] (X : Matrix n p ℂ)
    (Y : Matrix n q ℂ) :
    0 ≤ ∑ i, ∑ j, Complex.normSq ((Yᴴ * ⅟K * X) i j)
theorems.description: The trace is real and not negative.

theorems.name: Comparison.det_coeff_one

  [DecidableEq q]

    ((1 - (Polynomial.X : Polynomial ℂ) • M.map Polynomial.C).det).coeff 1 = -M.trace
theorems.description: The coefficient of `x` in `det(1 − xM)` is `−tr M`.

theorems.name: Comparison.born_log_deriv

  [DecidableEq q]

    HasDerivAt (fun x : ℂ => -Complex.log (1 - x • M).det) M.trace 0
theorems.description: **`d/dx[−log det(1 − xM)]` at `0` is `tr M`.**

theorems.name: Comparison.born_mixed

source_context.command:

  [DecidableEq q]

theorems.statement:
theorem born_mixed (M : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    (∀ s : ℂ, HasDerivAt (fun t : ℂ => -Complex.log (1 - (s * t) • M).det) (s * M.trace) 0) ∧
      HasDerivAt (fun s : ℂ => s * M.trace) M.trace 0
theorems.description:
**The first mixed coefficient:** for every `s`, `∂_t[−log det(1 − stM)]_{t=0} = s·tr M`, and the
`s`-derivative of that at `0` is `tr M`.

theorems.name: Comparison.det_mul_det_conjTranspose

  [DecidableEq q]

theorem det_mul_det_conjTranspose (K : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    K.det * Kᴴ.det = ((Complex.normSq K.det : ℝ) : ℂ)
theorems.description: `det K · det K† = |det K|²`.

theorems.name: Comparison.log_doubled

source_context.command:
variable {n p q : Type*} [Fintype n] [Fintype p] [Fintype q] [DecidableEq n] [DecidableEq p]
  [DecidableEq q]

theorems.statement:
theorem log_doubled (K : Matrix n n ℂ) [Invertible K] (X : Matrix n p ℂ) (Y : Matrix n q ℂ)
    (s t : ℂ) (hne : (1 - (t * s) • bornM K X Y).det ≠ 0) :
    -Complex.log (doubled K X Y s t).det =
      -(Real.log (Complex.normSq K.det) : ℂ) - Complex.log (1 - (t * s) • bornM K X Y).det
theorems.description: **`−log det 𝔻(s, t) = −log |det K|² − log det(1 − ts M)`.**

theorems.name: Comparison.schur_det

theorems.description: **`det K = det D · det S`.**

theorems.name: Comparison.schurR_diff

source_context.command:
variable {𝕜 : Type*} [Field 𝕜] {m n : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq m]
  [DecidableEq n]
variable (A : Matrix m m 𝕜) (B : Matrix m n 𝕜) (C : Matrix n m 𝕜) (D : Matrix n n 𝕜) [Invertible D]

theorems.statement:
theorem schurR_diff (A' : Matrix m m 𝕜) (B' : Matrix m n 𝕜) (C' : Matrix n m 𝕜)
    (D' : Matrix n n 𝕜) [Invertible D'] :
    schurR C' D' - schurR C D =
      -(schurQ D * (fromBlocks A' B' C' D' - fromBlocks A B C D) * schurR C' D')
theorems.description: `R' − R = −Q (K' − K) R'`: with `K' = K + tK_a`, `R_a = −Q K_a R`.

theorems.name: Comparison.schurL_diff

source_context.command:
variable {𝕜 : Type*} [Field 𝕜] {m n : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq m]
  [DecidableEq n]
variable (A : Matrix m m 𝕜) (B : Matrix m n 𝕜) (C : Matrix n m 𝕜) (D : Matrix n n 𝕜) [Invertible D]

theorems.statement:
theorem schurL_diff (A' : Matrix m m 𝕜) (B' : Matrix m n 𝕜) (C' : Matrix n m 𝕜)
    (D' : Matrix n n 𝕜) [Invertible D'] :
    schurL B' D' - schurL B D =
      -(schurL B D * (fromBlocks A' B' C' D' - fromBlocks A B C D) * schurQ D')
theorems.description: `L' − L = −L (K' − K) Q'`: with `K' = K + tK_a`, `L_a = −L K_a Q`.

theorems.name: Comparison.residue_simple_zero

source_context.command: variable {𝕜 : Type*} [Field 𝕜] {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]

theorems.statement:
theorem residue_simple_zero (S₀ Sζ M N : Matrix n n 𝕜) (r ℓ : n → 𝕜) (hr : r ≠ 0) (hℓ : ℓ ≠ 0)
    (hkerR : ∀ v, S₀ *ᵥ v = 0 → ∃ c : 𝕜, v = c • r)
    (hkerL : ∀ w, w ᵥ* S₀ = 0 → ∃ c : 𝕜, w = c • ℓ)
    (hℓS : ℓ ᵥ* S₀ = 0)
    (h1 : S₀ * M = 0) (h2 : M * S₀ = 0) (h3 : S₀ * N + Sζ * M = 1) :
    ℓ ⬝ᵥ (Sζ *ᵥ r) ≠ 0 ∧ M = (ℓ ⬝ᵥ (Sζ *ᵥ r))⁻¹ • vecMulVec r ℓ
theorems.description:
**The residue at a simple zero:** if `S(ζ)⁻¹ = M/(ζ − ζ₀) + N + ⋯` with `S(ζ) = S₀ + (ζ − ζ₀)S_ζ + ⋯`,
so that `S₀M = 0`, `MS₀ = 0` and `S₀N + S_ζM = 1`, and the kernels of `S₀` on both sides are spanned by
`r` and `ℓ`, then `ℓ S_ζ r ≠ 0` and `M = r ℓ/(ℓ S_ζ r)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.zero_shift

source_context.command: variable {𝕜 : Type*} [Field 𝕜] {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]

theorems.statement:
theorem zero_shift (S₀ Sζ Sa : Matrix n n 𝕜) (ℓ v : n → 𝕜) (ζ J : 𝕜) (hℓS : ℓ ᵥ* S₀ = 0)
    (hv : (S₀ + ζ • Sζ + J • Sa) *ᵥ v = 0) :
    ζ * (ℓ ⬝ᵥ (Sζ *ᵥ v)) = -(J * (ℓ ⬝ᵥ (Sa *ᵥ v)))
theorems.description:
**The shift of the zero with a source:** if `(S₀ + ζS_ζ + JS_a)v = 0` and `ℓS₀ = 0`, then
`ζ (ℓ S_ζ v) = −J (ℓ S_a v)`; at `v = r`, `dζ₀/dJ_a = −ℓS_ar/(ℓS_ζr)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.coin_apply
theorems.statement: theorem coin_apply (i j : Fin 5) : coin i j = if i = j then -3 / 5 else 2 / 5
theorems.description: The coin's entries: the reflection `−3/5` back along the undo, `2/5` along each other change.

theorems.name: Comparison.coin_mul_self
theorems.statement: theorem coin_mul_self : coin * coin = 1
theorems.description: **The coin is an involution:** `σ² = 1`.

theorems.name: Comparison.coin_orthogonal
theorems.statement: theorem coin_orthogonal : coinᵀ * coin = 1

theorems.statement: theorem coin_column (j : Fin 5) : ∑ i, coin i j ^ 2 = 1
theorems.description: Every column of the coin has length one: `(3/5)² + 4 (2/5)² = 1`.

theorems.name: Comparison.coin_mulVec_ones
theorems.statement: theorem coin_mulVec_ones : coin *ᵥ (fun _ => 1) = fun _ => 1
theorems.description: The coin keeps the mean line: `σ 𝟙 = 𝟙`.

theorems.name: Comparison.coin_trace
theorems.statement: theorem coin_trace : coin.trace = -3

theorems.name: Comparison.ones5_mul_self
theorems.statement: theorem ones5_mul_self : ones5 * ones5 = (5 : ℚ) • ones5

theorems.name: Comparison.involutions_ones
theorems.statement:
theorem involutions_ones (α β : ℚ) :
    (α • (1 : Matrix (Fin 5) (Fin 5) ℚ) + β • ones5) * (α • 1 + β • ones5) = 1 ↔
      (α = 1 ∧ β = 0) ∨ (α = -1 ∧ β = 0) ∨ (α = -1 ∧ β = 2 / 5) ∨ (α = 1 ∧ β = -2 / 5)
theorems.description:
**The involutions made of `1` and `𝟙𝟙ᵀ`:** `(α + β 𝟙𝟙ᵀ)² = 1` exactly for `±1` and
`±σ`; `σ` itself is `α = −1, β = 2/5`.

theorems.name: Comparison.coin_eq
theorems.statement: theorem coin_eq : coin = (-1 : ℚ) • (1 : Matrix (Fin 5) (Fin 5) ℚ) + (2 / 5 : ℚ) • ones5
theorems.description: The coin is `−1 + (2/5) 𝟙𝟙ᵀ`, one of the two involutions `±σ` that are not `±1`.

theorems.name: Comparison.undoState_undoState
theorems.statement: theorem undoState_undoState (s : State) : undoState (undoState s) = s

theorems.name: Comparison.stepU_eq

theorems.description: **`U = (2/5) B − (3/5) R`:** four continuations with `2/5`, the undo with the reflection `−3/5`.

theorems.name: Comparison.undoR_transpose
theorems.statement: theorem undoR_transpose : undoRᵀ = undoR

theorems.name: Comparison.undoR_mul_self
theorems.statement: theorem undoR_mul_self : undoR * undoR = 1
theorems.description: **The undo is an involution:** `R² = 1`.

theorems.name: Comparison.stepU_eq_mul
theorems.statement: theorem stepU_eq_mul : stepU = undoR * coinLastDirection
theorems.description: `U` is the undo-shift after the coin on the last-step direction: `U = R (1 ⊗ σ)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.coinLastDirection_orthogonal
theorems.statement: theorem coinLastDirection_orthogonal : coinLastDirectionᵀ * coinLastDirection = 1

theorems.name: Comparison.stepU_orthogonal
theorems.statement: theorem stepU_orthogonal : stepUᵀ * stepU = 1
theorems.description: **The coin on the eighty states is orthogonal:** `Uᵀ U = 1`.

theorems.name: Comparison.turnOf_apply
theorems.statement:
theorem turnOf_apply (Γ : Ten → A) (M : Matrix Ten Ten ℝ) :
    turnOf Γ M = ∑ x, ∑ y, ((1 / 4 : ℝ) * M x y) • (Γ x * Γ y)

theorems.name: Comparison.triple_comm
theorems.statement:
theorem triple_comm (Γ : Ten → A) (hΓ : IsTen Γ) (x y z : Ten) :
    Γ x * Γ y * Γ z - Γ z * (Γ x * Γ y) =
      (if y = z then (2 : ℝ) else 0) • Γ x - (if x = z then (2 : ℝ) else 0) • Γ y

theorems.name: Comparison.turnOf_comm_line
theorems.statement:
theorem turnOf_comm_line (Γ : Ten → A) (hΓ : IsTen Γ) (M : Matrix Ten Ten ℝ) (hM : Mᵀ = -M)
    (z : Ten) : turnOf Γ M * Γ z - Γ z * turnOf Γ M = ∑ x, M x z • Γ x
theorems.description: **A rotation moves a line:** `[ρ(M), Γ_z] = Σ_x M_xz Γ_x` for antisymmetric `M`.

theorems.name: Comparison.lines_indep
theorems.statement:
theorem lines_indep [Nontrivial A] (Γ : Ten → A) (hΓ : IsTen Γ) (a : Ten → ℝ)
    (h : ∑ x, a x • Γ x = 0) : a = 0
theorems.description: **The ten lines are independent:** `Σ a_x Γ_x = 0` only for `a = 0`.

theorems.name: Comparison.turnOf_eq_zero
theorems.statement:
theorem turnOf_eq_zero [Nontrivial A] (Γ : Ten → A) (hΓ : IsTen Γ) (M : Matrix Ten Ten ℝ)
    (hM : Mᵀ = -M) (h0 : turnOf Γ M = 0) : M = 0
theorems.description: **A rotation is known by its matrix:** `ρ(M) = 0` only for `M = 0` (antisymmetric `M`).

theorems.name: Comparison.turnOf_lie
theorems.statement:
theorem turnOf_lie (Γ : Ten → A) (hΓ : IsTen Γ) (M N : Matrix Ten Ten ℝ) (hM : Mᵀ = -M) :
    turnOf Γ M * turnOf Γ N - turnOf Γ N * turnOf Γ M = turnOf Γ (M * N - N * M)
theorems.description: **The rotations close under the commutator:** `[ρ(M), ρ(N)] = ρ([M, N])`.

theorems.name: Comparison.mem_commWith
theorems.statement:
theorem mem_commWith {X : Type*} [Ring X] [Algebra ℝ X] (C Y : X) :
    Y ∈ commWith C ↔ Y * C = C * Y

theorems.name: Comparison.tenCode_injective
theorems.statement: theorem tenCode_injective : Function.Injective tenCode

theorems.name: Comparison.turnOf_planeMat
theorems.statement:
theorem turnOf_planeMat (Γ : Ten → A) (hΓ : IsTen Γ) (p : TenPairs) :
    turnOf Γ (planeMat p) = (1 / 2 : ℝ) • (Γ p.1.1 * Γ p.1.2)
theorems.description: `ρ(E_xy − E_yx) = ½ Γ_xΓ_y` for `x ≠ y`.

theorems.name: Comparison.planeMat_mem
theorems.statement: theorem planeMat_mem (p : TenPairs) : planeMat p ∈ skewTen

theorems.name: Comparison.turnsTen_eq_span
theorems.statement:
theorem turnsTen_eq_span (Γ : Ten → A) (hΓ : IsTen Γ) :
    turnsTen Γ =
      Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range fun p : TenPairs => (1 / 2 : ℝ) • (Γ p.1.1 * Γ p.1.2))
theorems.description: **The forty-five `½Γ_xΓ_y` (`x < y`) span the rotations.**

theorems.name: Comparison.range_turnOf_skewCoord

theorems.name: Comparison.turnOf_cxJ
theorems.statement: theorem turnOf_cxJ (Γ : Ten → A) (hΓ : IsTen Γ) : turnOf Γ cxJ = (1 / 2 : ℝ) • pairSum Γ
theorems.description: `ρ(J) = ½ Σ_t Γ_tΓ_{5+t}`.

theorems.name: Comparison.cxJ_comm_skew
theorems.statement:
theorem cxJ_comm_skew (M : Matrix Ten Ten ℝ) (hM : Mᵀ = -M) :
    (M * cxJ - cxJ * M)ᵀ = -(M * cxJ - cxJ * M)

theorems.name: Comparison.keepL_eq
theorems.statement:
theorem keepL_eq [Nontrivial A] (Γ : Ten → A) (hΓ : IsTen Γ) :
    turnsTen Γ ⊓ commWith (pairSum Γ) = keepJ.map (turnOf Γ)
theorems.description:
**The rotations that keep the comparison are those of the complex structure:**
`so(10) ∩ {X : X Σ_tΓ_tΓ_{5+t} = Σ_tΓ_tΓ_{5+t} X} = ρ(u(5))`.

theorems.name: Comparison.finrank_keepL
theorems.statement:
theorem finrank_keepL [Nontrivial A] (Γ : Ten → A) (hΓ : IsTen Γ) :
    Module.finrank ℝ (turnsTen Γ ⊓ commWith (pairSum Γ) : Submodule ℝ A) = 25
theorems.description: **The rotations that keep the comparison: `u(5)`, dimension 25.**

theorems.name: Comparison.tenLine_isTen
theorems.statement: theorem tenLine_isTen : IsTen tenLine

theorems.name: Comparison.pairSum_tenLine
theorems.statement: theorem pairSum_tenLine : pairSum tenLine = I • ((L - 1) ⊗ₖ σ₃)

theorems.name: Comparison.commWith_I_smul
theorems.statement:

theorems.name: Comparison.pair_turns_finrank

theorems.description:
**On `H ⊗ H ⊗ ℂ²` the forty-five rotations of the ten lines of a pair span `so(10)`, dimension
45.**

theorems.name: Comparison.pair_keepL_finrank

theorem pair_keepL_finrank :
    Module.finrank ℝ (turnsTen tenLine ⊓ commWith ((L - 1) ⊗ₖ σ₃) : Submodule ℝ _) = 25
theorems.description: **The rotations that keep the comparison `(L − 1) ⊗ σ_z`: `u(5)`, dimension 25.**

theorems.name: Comparison.kron_neg'
theorems.statement:
theorem kron_neg' {m n p q : Type*} (A : Matrix m n ℂ) (B : Matrix p q ℂ) :
    A ⊗ₖ (-B) = -(A ⊗ₖ B)

theorems.name: Comparison.sub_kron'
theorems.statement:
theorem sub_kron' {m n p q : Type*} (A B : Matrix m n ℂ) (C : Matrix p q ℂ) :
    (A - B) ⊗ₖ C = A ⊗ₖ C - B ⊗ₖ C

theorems.name: Comparison.σ₃_mul_σ₃
theorems.statement: theorem σ₃_mul_σ₃ : σ₃ * σ₃ = 1

theorems.name: Comparison.σ₁_σ₃_anti
theorems.statement: theorem σ₁_σ₃_anti : σ₁ * σ₃ = -(σ₃ * σ₁)

theorems.name: Comparison.σ₂_σ₃_anti
theorems.statement: theorem σ₂_σ₃_anti : σ₂ * σ₃ = -(σ₃ * σ₂)

theorems.name: Comparison.chirality_sq
theorems.statement: theorem chirality_sq : chirality * chirality = 1

theorems.statement: theorem tenLine_chirality (x : Ten) : tenLine x * chirality = -(chirality * tenLine x)
theorems.description: Each of the ten lines exchanges the two halves.

theorems.name: Comparison.turnOf_chirality

theorem turnOf_chirality (M : Matrix Ten Ten ℝ) :
    turnOf tenLine M * chirality = chirality * turnOf tenLine M
theorems.description: Every rotation keeps the two halves.

theorems.name: Comparison.comparison_chirality

      turnsTen tenLine ⊓ commWith ((L - 1) ⊗ₖ σ₃)
theorems.description: **Keeping `L` on both halves is keeping the comparison `(L − 1) ⊗ σ_z`.**

theorems.name: Comparison.pair_keepL_finrank'

theorems.description: **The rotations of the ten lines of a pair that keep `L`: `u(5)`, dimension 25.**

theorems.statement: theorem zc_diag (R : Matrix (Fin 5) (Fin 5) ℝ) (t : Fin 5) : zc R t t = I * (R t t : ℂ)

theorems.name: Comparison.sum_ιε
theorems.statement:
theorem sum_ιε (c : Fin 5 → Fin 5 → ℂ) :
    ∑ s, ∑ t, c s t • (ιx s * εx t : FockE) =
      (∑ s, c s s) • (1 : FockE) - ∑ s, ∑ t, c t s • (εx s * ιx t : FockE)
theorems.description: `ι_s ε_t = δ_st − ε_t ι_s`, summed with any coefficients.

theorems.name: Comparison.fock_term
theorems.statement:
theorem fock_term (a b : ℝ) (s t : Fin 5) :
    ((1 / 4 : ℝ) * a) • (fockLine (Sum.inl s) * fockLine (Sum.inl t)) +
        ((1 / 4 : ℝ) * -b) • (fockLine (Sum.inl s) * fockLine (Sum.inr t)) +
      (((1 / 4 : ℝ) * b) • (fockLine (Sum.inr s) * fockLine (Sum.inl t)) +
        ((1 / 4 : ℝ) * a) • (fockLine (Sum.inr s) * fockLine (Sum.inr t))) =
      ((a / 2 : ℂ) + (b / 2 : ℂ) * I) • (εx s * ιx t : FockE) +
        ((a / 2 : ℂ) - (b / 2 : ℂ) * I) • (ιx s * εx t : FockE)
theorems.description: One term of `ρ(uFive R)`: `¼(A a_sa_t − B a_sb_t + B b_sa_t + A b_sb_t)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.fock_normal
theorems.statement:
theorem fock_normal (R : Matrix (Fin 5) (Fin 5) ℝ) :
    turnOf fockLine (uFive R) =
      ∑ s, ∑ t, zc R s t • (εx s * ιx t : FockE) - ((1 / 2 : ℂ) * ∑ t, zc R t t) • (1 : FockE)
theorems.description:
**The normal form of a rotation of five complex lines:**
`ρ(uFive R) = Σ_{s,t} Z_st ε_sι_t − ½ tr Z`, `Z = A + iB`: on `Λℂ⁵`, `u(5)` acts as on the
exterior powers, twisted by `det^{−1/2}`.

theorems.name: Comparison.epsIota_self

theorem epsIota_self {T : Finset (Fin 5)} {t : Fin 5} (ht : t ∈ T) :
    (εx t * ιx t : FockE) (Pi.single T 1) = Pi.single T 1

theorems.name: Comparison.epsIota_out

theorem epsIota_out {T : Finset (Fin 5)} (s : Fin 5) {t : Fin 5} (ht : t ∉ T) :
