**A quarter of the comparison is the swap:** `e^{−iπL/4} = −iP` on each of the sixteen
two-spinor states.

theorems.name: Comparison.irreps
theorems.statement:
theorem irreps :
    (∀ k : Fin 16, (disagreeSet k).card = 0 ∨ (disagreeSet k).card = 2 ∨
      (disagreeSet k).card = 4) ∧
    (Finset.univ.filter fun k : Fin 16 => (disagreeSet k).card = 0).card = 1 ∧
    (Finset.univ.filter fun k : Fin 16 => (disagreeSet k).card = 2).card = 10 ∧
    (Finset.univ.filter fun k : Fin 16 => (disagreeSet k).card = 4).card = 5
theorems.description: **Singlet, symmetric and vector states:** the sixteen two-spinor states disagree on `0`, `2` or `4` lines, `1 + 10 + 5`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Eop_rel
theorems.statement: theorem Eop_rel (k : Fin 16) : Eop *ᵥ rel k = (if k = 0 then (4 : ℂ) else 0) • rel k

theorems.name: Comparison.irrep_projectors
theorems.statement:
theorem irrep_projectors (k : Fin 16) :
    ((1 / 4 : ℂ) • Eop) *ᵥ rel k = (if (disagreeSet k).card = 0 then 1 else 0 : ℂ) • rel k ∧
    ((1 / 2 : ℂ) • (1 + swap)) *ᵥ rel k =
      (if (disagreeSet k).card = 2 then 1 else 0 : ℂ) • rel k ∧
    ((1 / 2 : ℂ) • (1 - swap) - (1 / 4 : ℂ) • Eop) *ᵥ rel k =
      (if (disagreeSet k).card = 4 then 1 else 0 : ℂ) • rel k
theorems.description:
**The projectors onto the singlet, the symmetric and the vector states:** `Π₀ = E/4`, `Π_F = (1 + P)/2`, `Π_L = (1 − P)/2 − E/4` are
one on the singlet, the symmetric states and the vector states respectively, zero on the rest.

theorems.name: Comparison.outer_mulVec
theorems.statement: theorem outer_mulVec (u v w : Fin 5 → ℂ) : outer u v *ᵥ w = (star v ⬝ᵥ w) • u

theorems.name: Comparison.star_lastDirection_lastDirection
theorems.statement: theorem star_lastDirection_lastDirection : star lastDirectionVec ⬝ᵥ lastDirectionVec = 1

theorems.name: Comparison.star_other_lastDirection
theorems.statement: theorem star_other_lastDirection : star otherVec ⬝ᵥ lastDirectionVec = 0

theorems.name: Comparison.sqLen_smul
theorems.statement: theorem sqLen_smul (c : ℂ) (v : Fin 5 → ℂ) : sqLen (c • v) = Complex.normSq c * sqLen v

theorems.name: Comparison.sqLen_neg
theorems.statement: theorem sqLen_neg (v : Fin 5 → ℂ) : sqLen (-v) = sqLen v

theorems.name: Comparison.sqLen_lastDirection
theorems.statement: theorem sqLen_lastDirection : sqLen lastDirectionVec = 1

theorems.name: Comparison.sqLen_other
theorems.statement: theorem sqLen_other : sqLen otherVec = 1

theorems.name: Comparison.lastDirection_weights
theorems.statement:
theorem lastDirection_weights :
    sqLen ((I • outer lastDirectionVec lastDirectionVec) *ᵥ lastDirectionVec) = 1 ∧
    sqLen ((I • outer otherVec otherVec) *ᵥ lastDirectionVec) = 0 ∧
    sqLen (((I / Real.sqrt 2) • (outer lastDirectionVec otherVec + outer otherVec lastDirectionVec)) *ᵥ lastDirectionVec) =
      1 / 2 ∧
    sqLen (((1 / Real.sqrt 2 : ℂ) • (outer lastDirectionVec otherVec - outer otherVec lastDirectionVec)) *ᵥ
      lastDirectionVec) = 1 / 2 ∧
    ∀ X : Matrix (Fin 5) (Fin 5) ℂ, (∀ i j, 3 ≤ j.val → X i j = 0) → X *ᵥ lastDirectionVec = 0
theorems.description:
**The last-step direction's weights:** of the four rotations of the plane, `i hh†`, `i kk†`, `i(hk† + kh†)/√2`,
`(hk† − kh†)/√2`, the first moves the last-step direction with weight `1`, the second leaves it, the last two
with `½` each; the rotations of the three outside lines fix it.

theorems.name: Comparison.lastDirection_share
theorems.statement: theorem lastDirection_share : (3 : ℚ) / 13 * (1 - 3 / 13) = 30 / 169
theorems.description: **Three of the thirteen move the last-step direction:** `w_h = 3/13` and `χ_h = w_h(1 − w_h) = 30/169`.

theorems.name: Comparison.traceless_gram
theorems.description:
**Without the common phase:** the Gram form of the two diagonal rotations on the last-step direction,
`[[½, g], [g, 3/10]]` with `g² = (½)²(3/5)`, has determinant `0` and trace `4/5`; then
`sin²θ = 1 − (½)/(4/5) = 3/8`.

theorems.name: Comparison.hypercharge_turn
theorems.description:
The hypercharge as a rotation: `Y = diag(−⅓, −⅓, −⅓, ½, ½)` has `|Y|² = 5/6`; the rotation `iY/|Y|`
sends the last-step direction to `(i/2)h/|Y|`, of squared length `3/10`, and its real product with the rotation
`i(hh† − kk†)/√2` is `½(3/5)^{1/2}`.

theorems.name: Comparison.disagreeSet_planeRel
theorems.statement: theorem disagreeSet_planeRel : ∀ i : Fin 10, disagreeSet (planeRel i) = planeSet i

theorems.name: Comparison.planeRel_onto
theorems.statement: theorem planeRel_onto : ∀ k : Fin 16, (disagreeSet k).card = 2 ↔ ∃ i, planeRel i = k
theorems.description: The symmetric states are exactly the two-spinor states that disagree on two lines.

theorems.name: Comparison.plane_step_outside
theorems.statement:
theorem plane_step_outside : ∀ i : Fin 10, ∀ c : Fin 5, c ∉ planeSet i →
    ∃ j, transition c (planeRel i) = planeRel j ∧ planeSet j = univ \ insert c (planeSet i)
theorems.description:
**From a plane, the step along an outside line lands on the plane of the other two outside
lines.**

theorems.name: Comparison.plane_step_inside
theorems.statement:
theorem plane_step_inside : ∀ i : Fin 10, ∀ c ∈ planeSet i,
    (disagreeSet (transition c (planeRel i))).card = 4
theorems.description: From a plane, the step along one of its own lines lands on a vector state.

theorems.name: Comparison.petersen_steps
theorems.statement:
theorem petersen_steps : ∀ i j : Fin 10,
    (∃ c, transition c (planeRel i) = planeRel j) ↔ Disjoint (planeSet i) (planeSet j)
theorems.description: **Two symmetric states are one step apart exactly when they are disjoint.**

theorems.name: Comparison.petersen_degree
theorems.statement:
theorem petersen_degree : ∀ i : Fin 10,
    (univ.filter fun j => Disjoint (planeSet i) (planeSet j)).card = 3
theorems.description: Three steps at each plane.

theorems.name: Comparison.petersen_srg
theorems.statement: theorem petersen_srg : petAdj * petAdj = (2 : ℤ) • 1 - petAdj + J10
theorems.description:
**The Petersen graph:** `A² = 2 − A + J` (three neighbours, none in common for neighbours,
one in common otherwise).

theorems.name: Comparison.planeLap_eigen
theorems.statement: theorem planeLap_eigen : planeLapZ * eigV = eigV * diagonal eigD

theorems.name: Comparison.eigV_eigW
theorems.statement: theorem eigV_eigW : eigV * eigW = (30 : ℤ) • 1

theorems.name: Comparison.planeLap_diagonalized
theorems.statement:
theorem planeLap_diagonalized :
    ∃ V W : Matrix (Fin 10) (Fin 10) ℚ, V * W = 1 ∧
      planeLap = V * (diagonal (fun i => (eigD i : ℚ)) * W)
theorems.description: **`Δ_F` is diagonalized:** `Δ_F = V D V⁻¹` with `D = diag(0, 2, 2, 2, 2, 2, 5, 5, 5, 5)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.planeLap_charpoly
theorems.statement: theorem planeLap_charpoly : planeLap.charpoly = X * (X - 2) ^ 5 * (X - 5) ^ 4
theorems.description:
**The spectrum of `Δ_F`:** `det(X − Δ_F) = X (X − 2)⁵ (X − 5)⁴`: `0` once, `2` five times,
`5` four times.

theorems.name: Comparison.contrast_sum
theorems.statement:
theorem contrast_sum {R : Type*} [CommSemiring R] (x : R) :
    ∑ i ∈ univ.filter (fun i : Fin 10 => eigD i ≠ 0), x ^ (eigD i).toNat =
      5 * x ^ 2 + 4 * x ^ 5
theorems.description: **The nine contrasts:** over the eigenvalues other than `0`, `Σ x^λ = 5x² + 4x⁵`.

theorems.name: Comparison.projectors
theorems.statement:
theorem projectors :
    P0Z * P0Z = (10 : ℤ) • P0Z ∧ P2Z * P2Z = (6 : ℤ) • P2Z ∧ P5Z * P5Z = (15 : ℤ) • P5Z ∧
    P0Z * P2Z = 0 ∧ P0Z * P5Z = 0 ∧ P2Z * P5Z = 0 ∧
    (3 : ℤ) • P0Z + (5 : ℤ) • P2Z + (2 : ℤ) • P5Z = (30 : ℤ) • 1 ∧
    planeLapZ * P0Z = 0 ∧ planeLapZ * P2Z = (2 : ℤ) • P2Z ∧ planeLapZ * P5Z = (5 : ℤ) • P5Z ∧
    P0Z.trace = 10 * 1 ∧ P2Z.trace = 6 * 5 ∧ P5Z.trace = 15 * 4
theorems.description:
**The eigenprojectors:** `P₀ = J/10`, `P₂ = (4 + 2A − J)/6`, `P₅ = (5 − 5A + J)/15` are
idempotent, orthogonal, add to one, `Δ_F` is `0, 2, 5` on them, and their traces (ranks) are
`1, 5, 4`. Written times `10, 6, 15`.

theorems.name: Comparison.pairPlane_spec
theorems.statement: theorem pairPlane_spec : ∀ a b : Fin 5, a ≠ b → planeSet (pairPlane a b) = {a, b}

theorems.name: Comparison.planeA_ne_planeB
theorems.statement: theorem planeA_ne_planeB : ∀ i : Fin 10, planeA i ≠ planeB i

theorems.name: Comparison.planeSet_inj
theorems.statement: theorem planeSet_inj : ∀ i j : Fin 10, planeSet i = planeSet j → i = j

theorems.name: Comparison.planeSet_actF
theorems.statement:
theorem planeSet_actF (g : Equiv.Perm (Fin 5)) (i : Fin 10) :
    planeSet (actF g i) = (planeSet i).map g.toEmbedding

theorems.name: Comparison.actF_mul
theorems.statement:
theorem actF_mul (g h : Equiv.Perm (Fin 5)) (i : Fin 10) :
    actF (g * h) i = actF g (actF h i)

theorems.name: Comparison.actF_one
theorems.statement: theorem actF_one (i : Fin 10) : actF 1 i = i

theorems.name: Comparison.actF_inv_actF
theorems.statement: theorem actF_inv_actF (g : Equiv.Perm (Fin 5)) (i : Fin 10) : actF g⁻¹ (actF g i) = i

theorems.name: Comparison.actF_actF_inv
theorems.statement: theorem actF_actF_inv (g : Equiv.Perm (Fin 5)) (i : Fin 10) : actF g (actF g⁻¹ i) = i

theorems.name: Comparison.actF_inj
theorems.statement: theorem actF_inj (g : Equiv.Perm (Fin 5)) {i j : Fin 10} : actF g i = actF g j ↔ i = j

theorems.name: Comparison.planeLap_relabel
theorems.statement:
theorem planeLap_relabel (g : Equiv.Perm (Fin 5)) (i j : Fin 10) :
    planeLapZ (actF g i) (actF g j) = planeLapZ i j
theorems.description: **`Δ_F` is unchanged by every relabelling of the lines.**

theorems.name: Comparison.planeLap_comm_perm
theorems.statement: theorem planeLap_comm_perm (g : Equiv.Perm (Fin 5)) : planeLapZ * permF g = permF g * planeLapZ
theorems.description: **`Δ_F` commutes with the relabellings.**

theorems.name: Comparison.planes_char
theorems.statement:
theorem planes_char (g : Equiv.Perm (Fin 5)) :
    fixF g = 1 + chi41 g + chi32 g ∧ fixL g = 1 + chi41 g
theorems.description: The symmetric states carry `1 + χ_[4,1] + χ_[3,2]`, the lines `1 + χ_[4,1]`.

theorems.name: Comparison.trace_P0
theorems.statement: theorem trace_P0 : ∀ g : Equiv.Perm (Fin 5), (P0Z * permF g).trace = 10 * 1
theorems.description: **The relabellings on the eigenspace of `0`:** the constant, character `1`.

theorems.name: Comparison.trace_P2
theorems.statement: theorem trace_P2 : ∀ g : Equiv.Perm (Fin 5), (P2Z * permF g).trace = 6 * chi32 g
theorems.description: **The relabellings on the eigenspace of `2` have the character `χ_[3,2]`.**

theorems.name: Comparison.trace_P5
theorems.statement: theorem trace_P5 : ∀ g : Equiv.Perm (Fin 5), (P5Z * permF g).trace = 15 * chi41 g
theorems.description: **The relabellings on the eigenspace of `5` have the character `χ_[4,1]`.**

theorems.name: Comparison.char_norms
theorems.statement:
theorem char_norms :
    ∑ g : Equiv.Perm (Fin 5), chi32 g ^ 2 = 120 ∧ ∑ g : Equiv.Perm (Fin 5), chi41 g ^ 2 = 120 ∧
    ∑ g : Equiv.Perm (Fin 5), chi32 g * chi41 g = 0 ∧ ∑ g : Equiv.Perm (Fin 5), chi32 g = 0 ∧
    ∑ g : Equiv.Perm (Fin 5), chi41 g = 0 ∧ ∑ g : Equiv.Perm (Fin 5), sgn g * chi32 g = 0 ∧
    ∑ g : Equiv.Perm (Fin 5), sgn g * chi41 g = 0 ∧ ∑ g : Equiv.Perm (Fin 5), sgn g = 0
theorems.description:
**Each part is one irreducible:** `Σ_g χ_[3,2]² = Σ_g χ_[4,1]² = 120`; the two, the
unchanged character and the sign are orthogonal.

theorems.name: Comparison.k_sum
theorems.statement: theorem k_sum : ∑ g : Equiv.Perm (Fin 5), kk g = 120

theorems.name: Comparison.k_values
theorems.statement: theorem k_values : kk 1 = 27 ∧ kk exch = 5 ∧ kk cyc5 = 2 ∧ kk cyc3 = -3

theorems.name: Comparison.edges_are_steps
theorems.statement:
theorem edges_are_steps : ∀ i j : Fin 10, i < j →
    (Disjoint (planeSet i) (planeSet j) ↔ ∃ e, edgeEnds e = (i, j))

theorems.name: Comparison.ends_two
theorems.statement: theorem ends_two : ∀ e : Fin 15, (univ.filter fun i => OnEdge i e).card = 2

theorems.name: Comparison.card_of_perfect
theorems.statement: theorem card_of_perfect {S : Finset (Fin 15)} (hS : IsPerfectMatching S) : S.card = 5
theorems.description: A perfect matching has five edges.

theorems.name: Comparison.perfect_five
theorems.statement:
theorem perfect_five :
    ((univ : Finset (Fin 15)).powersetCard 5).filter IsPerfectMatching = matchings

theorems.name: Comparison.perfect_matchings
theorems.statement: theorem perfect_matchings (S : Finset (Fin 15)) : IsPerfectMatching S ↔ S ∈ matchings
theorems.description: **The Petersen graph has exactly six perfect matchings.**

theorems.name: Comparison.T_formula
theorems.statement: theorem T_formula : ∀ g : Equiv.Perm (Fin 5), keptMatchings g = 1 + sgn g * chi32 g
theorems.description:
**`T(g) = 1 + sgn g·χ_[3,2](g)`:** the relabellings permute the six matchings with the
character `1 + χ_[2,2,1]`.

theorems.name: Comparison.T_values
theorems.statement:
theorem T_values :
    keptMatchings 1 = 6 ∧ keptMatchings exch = 0 ∧ keptMatchings exch2 = 2 ∧
    keptMatchings cyc3 = 0 ∧ keptMatchings cyc3exch = 0 ∧ keptMatchings cyc4 = 2 ∧
    keptMatchings cyc5 = 1
theorems.description:
On the identity, an exchange, two exchanges, a 3-cycle, a 3-cycle with an exchange, a 4-cycle
and a 5-cycle: `T = 6, 0, 2, 0, 0, 2, 1`, `χ_[3,2] = 5, 1, 1, −1, 1, −1, 0`, `sgn = +, −, +, +, −, −, +`.

theorems.name: Comparison.chi32_values
theorems.statement:
theorem chi32_values :
    chi32 1 = 5 ∧ chi32 exch = 1 ∧ chi32 exch2 = 1 ∧ chi32 cyc3 = -1 ∧ chi32 cyc3exch = 1 ∧
    chi32 cyc4 = -1 ∧ chi32 cyc5 = 0

theorems.name: Comparison.sgn_values
theorems.statement:
theorem sgn_values :
    sgn 1 = 1 ∧ sgn exch = -1 ∧ sgn exch2 = 1 ∧ sgn cyc3 = 1 ∧ sgn cyc3exch = -1 ∧
    sgn cyc4 = -1 ∧ sgn cyc5 = 1

theorems.name: Comparison.sgn_sq
theorems.statement: theorem sgn_sq (g : Equiv.Perm (Fin 5)) : sgn g * sgn g = 1

theorems.name: Comparison.k_second_form
theorems.statement:
theorem k_second_form (g : Equiv.Perm (Fin 5)) :
    kk g = 1 + sgn g * (5 * keptMatchings g - 4)
theorems.description: **The second form:** `120 k(g) = 1 + sgn g·(5T(g) − 4)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.sadj_apply
theorems.statement: theorem sadj_apply (x y : Fin 16) : sadj x y = (sadjZ x y : ℝ)

theorems.name: Comparison.sadj_symm
theorems.statement: theorem sadj_symm (x y : Fin 16) : sadj x y = sadj y x

theorems.name: Comparison.sadj_sq
theorems.statement: theorem sadj_sq : sadj * sadj = (5 : ℝ) • (1 : Matrix (Fin 16) (Fin 16) ℝ)

theorems.name: Comparison.linkM_apply
theorems.statement: theorem linkM_apply (l : Fin 40) (x y : Fin 16) : linkM l x y = (linkZ l x y : ℝ)

theorems.name: Comparison.phaseMat_apply
theorems.statement:
theorem phaseMat_apply (θ : Fin 40 → ℝ) (x y : Fin 16) :
    phaseMat θ x y = ∑ l, θ l * (linkZ l x y : ℝ)

theorems.name: Comparison.linkZ_antisymm
theorems.statement: theorem linkZ_antisymm (l : Fin 40) (x y : Fin 16) : linkZ l y x = -linkZ l x y

theorems.name: Comparison.phaseMat_antisymm
theorems.statement: theorem phaseMat_antisymm (θ : Fin 40 → ℝ) (x y : Fin 16) : phaseMat θ y x = -phaseMat θ x y

theorems.name: Comparison.circ_eq
theorems.statement: theorem circ_eq (θ : Fin 40 → ℝ) (q : Fin 40) : circ θ q = ∑ l, θ l * (cZ q l : ℝ)

theorems.name: Comparison.plaqSq_eq
theorems.statement: theorem plaqSq_eq (θ : Fin 40 → ℝ) : plaqSq θ = ∑ l, ∑ m, θ l * θ m * (GZ l m : ℝ)

theorems.name: Comparison.circ_grad
theorems.statement:
theorem circ_grad (φ : Fin 16 → ℝ) (q : Fin 40) :
    circ (fun l => φ (linkV l) - φ (linkU l)) q = 0
theorems.description: **`C · grad = 0`:** a gradient of phases sums to zero around every square.

theorems.name: Comparison.linkM_eq
theorems.statement:
theorem linkM_eq (l : Fin 40) :
    linkM l = Matrix.single (linkU l) (linkV l) 1 - Matrix.single (linkV l) (linkU l) 1

theorems.name: Comparison.hadamard_linkM
theorems.statement:
theorem hadamard_linkM (l : Fin 40) :
    Matrix.hadamard sadj (linkM l) = sadj (linkU l) (linkV l) • linkM l

theorems.name: Comparison.Hm_eq
theorems.statement:
theorem Hm_eq (θ : Fin 40 → ℝ) :
    Hm θ = ∑ l, (θ l * sadj (linkU l) (linkV l)) • linkM l

theorems.name: Comparison.trace4_single
theorems.statement:
theorem trace4_single (A : Matrix (Fin 16) (Fin 16) ℝ) (a b c d : Fin 16) :
    (A * Matrix.single a b 1 * A * Matrix.single c d 1).trace = A d a * A b c

theorems.name: Comparison.trace_linkM
theorems.statement:
theorem trace_linkM (A : Matrix (Fin 16) (Fin 16) ℝ) (l m : Fin 40) :
    (A * linkM l * A * linkM m).trace =
      A (linkV m) (linkU l) * A (linkV l) (linkU m) - A (linkU m) (linkU l) * A (linkV l) (linkV m) -
        A (linkV m) (linkV l) * A (linkU l) (linkU m) + A (linkU m) (linkV l) * A (linkU l) (linkV m)

theorems.name: Comparison.trace_quad
theorems.statement:
theorem trace_quad (G G' : Matrix (Fin 16) (Fin 16) ℝ) (x y : Fin 40 → ℝ)
    (M N : Fin 40 → Matrix (Fin 16) (Fin 16) ℝ) :
    (G * (∑ l, x l • M l) * G' * (∑ m, y m • N m)).trace =
      ∑ l, ∑ m, x l * y m * (G * M l * G' * N m).trace

theorems.name: Comparison.T4_expand
theorems.statement:
theorem T4_expand (θ : Fin 40 → ℝ) :
    (sadj * Hm θ * sadj * Hm θ).trace = ∑ l, ∑ m, θ l * θ m * (B4Z l m : ℝ)
theorems.description: **`tr(A(A∘Θ)A(A∘Θ)) = Σ_{ℓ,m} θ_ℓθ_m B₄(ℓ, m)`.**

theorems.name: Comparison.T4_eq
theorems.statement:
theorem T4_eq (θ : Fin 40 → ℝ) :
    (sadj * Hm θ * sadj * Hm θ).trace = 10 * linkSq θ - 2 * plaqSq θ
theorems.description: **The four-step closed walks against the squares:** `tr(A Hm A Hm) = 10Σθ² − 2‖Cθ‖²`.

theorems.name: Comparison.phase_sq_expand
theorems.statement:
theorem phase_sq_expand (θ : Fin 40 → ℝ) :
    ∑ x, ∑ y, sadj x y * sadj x y * phaseMat θ x y * phaseMat θ x y = 2 * linkSq θ

theorems.name: Comparison.trace_AW
theorems.statement: theorem trace_AW (θ : Fin 40 → ℝ) : (sadj * Wm θ).trace = 2 * linkSq θ
theorems.description: `tr(A W) = 2Σθ²`.

theorems.name: Comparison.trace_HH
theorems.statement: theorem trace_HH (θ : Fin 40 → ℝ) : (Hm θ * Hm θ).trace = -(2 * linkSq θ)
theorems.description: `tr(H²) = −2Σθ²`.

theorems.name: Comparison.trace_W
theorems.statement: theorem trace_W (θ : Fin 40 → ℝ) : (Wm θ).trace = 0

theorems.name: Comparison.trace_AHH
theorems.statement: theorem trace_AHH (θ : Fin 40 → ℝ) : (sadj * Hm θ * Hm θ).trace = 0
theorems.description: `tr(AH²) = 0`: there are no triangles.

theorems.name: Comparison.trace_HAH
theorems.statement: theorem trace_HAH (θ : Fin 40 → ℝ) : (Hm θ * sadj * Hm θ).trace = 0

theorems.name: Comparison.Kinv_spec
theorems.statement:
theorem Kinv_spec (u a : ℝ) (hΔ : a ^ 2 - 5 * u ^ 2 ≠ 0) :
    (a • (1 : Matrix (Fin 16) (Fin 16) ℝ) - u • sadj) *
      ((a ^ 2 - 5 * u ^ 2)⁻¹ • (a • 1 + u • sadj)) = 1
theorems.description: `(a − uA)(a + uA)/Δ = 1`: the inverse of `K = a − uA` is `(a + uA)/Δ`, `Δ = a² − 5u²`.

theorems.name: Comparison.trace_toC
theorems.statement: theorem trace_toC (X : Matrix (Fin 16) (Fin 16) ℝ) : (toC X).trace = ((X.trace : ℝ) : ℂ)

theorems.name: Comparison.trace_KW
theorems.statement:
theorem trace_KW (u a : ℝ) (θ : Fin 40 → ℝ) :
    (((a ^ 2 - 5 * u ^ 2)⁻¹ • (a • (1 : Matrix (Fin 16) (Fin 16) ℝ) + u • sadj)) * Wm θ).trace =
      (a ^ 2 - 5 * u ^ 2)⁻¹ * (u * (2 * linkSq θ))

theorems.name: Comparison.trace_KHKH
theorems.statement:
theorem trace_KHKH (u a : ℝ) (θ : Fin 40 → ℝ) :
    (((a ^ 2 - 5 * u ^ 2)⁻¹ • (a • (1 : Matrix (Fin 16) (Fin 16) ℝ) + u • sadj)) * Hm θ *
        ((a ^ 2 - 5 * u ^ 2)⁻¹ • (a • 1 + u • sadj)) * Hm θ).trace =
      ((a ^ 2 - 5 * u ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2 * (a ^ 2 * (-(2 * linkSq θ)) +
        u ^ 2 * (10 * linkSq θ - 2 * plaqSq θ))

theorems.name: Comparison.S2_eq
theorems.statement:
theorem S2_eq (u a : ℝ) (θ : Fin 40 → ℝ) (hΔ : a ^ 2 - 5 * u ^ 2 ≠ 0) :
    S2 u a θ = ((-(u ^ 4 / (a ^ 2 - 5 * u ^ 2) ^ 2) * plaqSq θ : ℝ) : ℂ)
theorems.description: **`S₂ = −(u⁴/Δ²)‖Cθ‖²`** for every `θ`: the `Σθ²` terms cancel because `Δ = a² − 5u²`.

theorems.name: Comparison.kappa_eq
theorems.description: **`u⁴/Δ² = κ(w)/2`** with `κ(w) = 2w⁴/(1 − 5w²)²`, `w = u/a`.

theorems.name: Comparison.sadjZ_eq
theorems.statement:
theorem sadjZ_eq :
    sadjZ = Matrix.of fun x y => ∑ t : Fin 5, if x = transition t y then transitionSign t y else 0
theorems.description: The table is the signed step: `A_{k'k} = Σ_t [k' = transition t k] ν(k, t)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.sadjZ_transpose
theorems.statement: theorem sadjZ_transpose : sadjZᵀ = sadjZ

theorems.name: Comparison.sadjZ_symm
theorems.statement: theorem sadjZ_symm (x y : Fin 16) : sadjZ x y = sadjZ y x

theorems.name: Comparison.sadjZ_diag
theorems.statement: theorem sadjZ_diag : ∀ x : Fin 16, sadjZ x x = 0

theorems.name: Comparison.sadjZ_sq
theorems.statement: theorem sadjZ_sq : sadjZ * sadjZ = (5 : ℤ) • (1 : Matrix (Fin 16) (Fin 16) ℤ)

theorems.name: Comparison.sadjZ_tri
theorems.statement: theorem sadjZ_tri : ∀ x y z : Fin 16, sadjZ x y * sadjZ y z * sadjZ z x = 0
theorems.description: **No triangles.**

theorems.name: Comparison.links_ok
theorems.statement:
theorem links_ok : ∀ l : Fin 40,
    linkU l < linkV l ∧ sadjZ (linkU l) (linkV l) * sadjZ (linkU l) (linkV l) = 1

theorems.name: Comparison.links_complete
theorems.statement:
theorem links_complete : ∀ x y : Fin 16, x < y → sadjF x y ≠ 0 →
    ∃ l : Fin 40, linkU l = x ∧ linkV l = y
theorems.description: **The table lists exactly the forty links.**

theorems.name: Comparison.links_distinct
theorems.statement: theorem links_distinct : ∀ l m : Fin 40, linkU l = linkU m → linkV l = linkV m → l = m

theorems.name: Comparison.squares_closed
theorems.statement:
theorem squares_closed : ∀ q : Fin 40,
    sqS q ≠ sqT q ∧ transition (sqT q) (sqVert q 3) = sqX q

theorems.name: Comparison.squares_complete
theorems.statement:
theorem squares_complete : ∀ (x : Fin 16) (s t : Fin 5), s ≠ t →
    ∃ q : Fin 40, square x s t = square (sqX q) (sqS q) (sqT q)
theorems.description: **The table lists exactly the forty squares** of Proposition 38.

theorems.name: Comparison.squares_distinct
theorems.statement:
theorem squares_distinct : ∀ q q' : Fin 40,
    square (sqX q) (sqS q) (sqT q) = square (sqX q') (sqS q') (sqT q') → q = q'

theorems.name: Comparison.B4Z_eq
theorems.statement: theorem B4Z_eq : ∀ l m : Fin 40, B4Z l m = 10 * (if l = m then 1 else 0) - 2 * GZ l m
theorems.description: **The four-step walks against the squares:** `B₄ = 10·1 − 2CᵀC`.

theorems.name: Comparison.NZ_eq
theorems.statement:
theorem NZ_eq : ∀ l m : Fin 40,
    ∑ x : Fin 16, ∑ y : Fin 16, sadjZ x y * sadjZ x y * linkZ l x y * linkZ m x y =
      2 * (if l = m then 1 else 0)
theorems.description: `Σ_{x,y} A_xy² (E_ℓ)_xy (E_m)_xy = 2δ_ℓm`.

theorems.name: Comparison.cZ_div
theorems.statement:
theorem cZ_div : ∀ (q : Fin 40) (x : Fin 16),
    ∑ l : Fin 40, cZ q l * ((if linkV l = x then 1 else 0) - (if linkU l = x then 1 else 0)) = 0
theorems.description: A gradient sums to zero around every square.

theorems.name: Comparison.wordSum_zero
theorems.statement: theorem wordSum_zero : wordSum Γ 0 = 1

theorems.name: Comparison.wordSum_one
theorems.statement: theorem wordSum_one : wordSum Γ 1 = ∑ t, Γ t

theorems.name: Comparison.step_word
theorems.statement:
theorem step_word (hΓ : ∀ t, Γ t * Γ t = 1) (g : Fin 5) (w : List (Fin 5)) :
    (∑ t, Γ t) * (if Reduced (g :: w) then ((g :: w).map Γ).prod else 0) =
      (∑ t, if Reduced (t :: g :: w) then ((t :: g :: w).map Γ).prod else 0) +
        (if Reduced (g :: w) then (w.map Γ).prod else 0)
theorems.description: One more step on a reduced word: `A · Γ_w = Σ_{t ≠ head} Γ_{t :: w} + Γ_{tail w}`.

theorems.name: Comparison.count_first
theorems.statement:
theorem count_first (w : List (Fin 5)) (x : A) :
    (∑ t : Fin 5, if Reduced (t :: w) then x else 0) =
      if w = [] then (5 : ℕ) • x else if Reduced w then (4 : ℕ) • x else 0
theorems.description:
The sum over the first steps of a word: `Σ_t [t :: w reduced] = 5` for the empty word and
`4 [w reduced]` otherwise.

theorems.name: Comparison.wordSum_rec
theorems.statement:
theorem wordSum_rec (hΓ : ∀ t, Γ t * Γ t = 1) (n : ℕ) :
    (∑ t, Γ t) * wordSum Γ (n + 1) =
      wordSum Γ (n + 2) + (if n = 0 then (5 : ℕ) else 4) • wordSum Γ n
theorems.description: **The lemma of five involutions:** `A N_{n+1} = N_{n+2} + c_n N_n` with `c₀ = 5`, `c_n = 4`.

theorems.name: Comparison.wordSum_gf
theorems.statement:
theorem wordSum_gf (hΓ : ∀ t, Γ t * Γ t = 1) :
    wordSum Γ 0 = 1 ∧ wordSum Γ 1 = (∑ t, Γ t) * wordSum Γ 0 ∧
    ∀ n, wordSum Γ (n + 2) + (4 : ℕ) • wordSum Γ n - (∑ t, Γ t) * wordSum Γ (n + 1) =
      if n = 0 then -1 else 0
theorems.description:
**`((1 + 4u²) − uA) Σ N_n uⁿ = 1 − u²`, coefficient by coefficient:** `N₀ = 1`, `N₁ = A N₀`, and
`N_{n+2} + 4N_n − A N_{n+1} = −[n = 0]`.

theorems.name: Comparison.returns_plus
theorems.description:
**The returns of the unsigned walk:** with `a = 1 + 4u²`, the diagonal entry of the resolvent
over the characters gives `R₊ = (1 − 2u − 3u² − 12u³)/((1 − 4u)(a − u)(a + 3u))`.

theorems.name: Comparison.excursion_from_returns
theorems.description:
**The excursion from the returns:** `1 − 1/R₊ = 16u⁴(1 + 4u)/(1 − 2u − 3u² − 12u³)`, which is
`F(4u) = (4u)⁴(1 + 4u)/(16 − 8(4u) − 3(4u)² − 3(4u)³)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.returns_minus
theorems.description:
**The returns of the signed walk:** `R₋ = 1 + (4/5)[(1 − u²) a/(a² − 5u²) − 1]
= (1 + 3u²)/(1 + 3u² + 16u⁴)`, with `a = 1 + 4u²`.

theorems.name: Comparison.signed_excursion_from_returns
theorems.description: **The signed excursion from the returns:** `1 − 1/R₋ = −16u⁴/(1 + 3u²) = Φ(4u)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.sign_relations
theorems.statement:
theorem sign_relations :
    (∀ i, γ i * γ i = 1) ∧ (∀ i j, i ≠ j → γ i * γ j = -(γ j * γ i)) ∧
      γ 0 * γ 1 * γ 2 * γ 3 * γ 4 = 1
theorems.description: **The sign relations:** `t_i² = 1`, `t_it_j = −t_jt_i` for `i ≠ j`, and `t₁t₂t₃t₄t₅ = 1`.

theorems.name: Comparison.idem_pow
theorems.statement:
theorem idem_pow {p : A} (hp : p * p = p) : ∀ k : ℕ, 0 < k → p ^ k = p
  | 1, _ => pow_one p
  | k + 2, _ => by rw [pow_succ, idem_pow hp (k + 1) (Nat.succ_pos k), hp]

/-- **The central sign splits:** for `c² = 1`, `p± = (1 ± c)/2` are orthogonal idempotents with
`p₊ + p₋ = 1` and `p₊ − p₋ = c`. -/
theorem centralSign_split [Invertible (2 : A)] (c : A) (hc : c * c = 1) :
    IdemSplit (⅟2 * (1 + c)) (⅟2 * (1 - c)) ∧ ⅟2 * (1 + c) - ⅟2 * (1 - c) = c

theorems.name: Comparison.centralSign_split
theorems.statement:
theorem centralSign_split [Invertible (2 : A)] (c : A) (hc : c * c = 1) :
    IdemSplit (⅟2 * (1 + c)) (⅟2 * (1 - c)) ∧ ⅟2 * (1 + c) - ⅟2 * (1 - c) = c
theorems.description:
**The central sign splits:** for `c² = 1`, `p± = (1 ± c)/2` are orthogonal idempotents with
`p₊ + p₋ = 1` and `p₊ − p₋ = c`.

theorems.name: Comparison.det_split
theorems.statement:
theorem det_split {p q : A} (h : IdemSplit p q) [Nonempty ι] (X Y : Matrix ι ι A) :
    (p • X + q • Y).det = p * X.det + q * Y.det
theorems.description: **`det(pX + qY) = p det X + q det Y`** for a split `p + q = 1`.

theorems.name: Comparison.mul_split
theorems.statement:
theorem mul_split {p q : A} (h : IdemSplit p q) (X Y X' Y' : Matrix ι ι A) :
    (p • X + q • Y) * (p • X' + q • Y') = p • (X * X') + q • (Y * Y')
theorems.description: `(pX + qY)(pX' + qY') = p XX' + q YY'`.

theorems.name: Comparison.signTransitionC_split
theorems.statement:
theorem signTransitionC_split {p q c : A} (hsum : p + q = 1) (hc : p - q = c) (t : Fin 5) :
    signTransitionC c t = p • signTransitionC 1 t + q • signTransitionC (-1) t

theorems.name: Comparison.stepOp_add_smul
theorems.statement:
theorem stepOp_add_smul {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] (Γ Γ' : Fin 5 → Matrix V V A)
    (a b : A) : stepOp (fun t => a • Γ t + b • Γ' t) = a • stepOp Γ + b • stepOp Γ'

theorems.name: Comparison.law_matrix_split
theorems.statement:
theorem law_matrix_split [Invertible (2 : A)] (c u : A) (hc : c * c = 1) :
    (1 : Matrix (Fin 16 × Fin 5) (Fin 16 × Fin 5) A) - u • stepOp (signTransitionC c) =
      (⅟2 * (1 + c)) • (1 - u • stepOp (signTransitionC (1 : A))) +
        (⅟2 * (1 - c)) • (1 - u • stepOp (signTransitionC (-1 : A)))
theorems.description: **The law splits by the central sign:** `det(I − uB_c) = p₊ det(I − uB₊) + p₋ det(I − uB₋)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.law_split
theorems.statement:
theorem law_split [Invertible (2 : A)] (c u : A) (hc : c * c = 1) :
    (1 - u • stepOp (signTransitionC c)).det =
      ⅟2 * (1 + c) * (1 - u • stepOp (signTransitionC (1 : A))).det +
        ⅟2 * (1 - c) * (1 - u • stepOp (signTransitionC (-1 : A))).det

theorems.name: Comparison.resolvent_split
theorems.statement:
theorem resolvent_split [Invertible (2 : A)] (c u : A) (hc : c * c = 1)
    (Zp Zm : Matrix (Fin 16 × Fin 5) (Fin 16 × Fin 5) A)
    (hp : (1 - u • stepOp (signTransitionC (1 : A))) * Zp = 1)
    (hm : (1 - u • stepOp (signTransitionC (-1 : A))) * Zm = 1) :
    (1 - u • stepOp (signTransitionC c)) * ((⅟2 * (1 + c)) • Zp + (⅟2 * (1 - c)) • Zm) = 1
theorems.description: **The resolvent splits by the central sign:** `(I − uB_c)⁻¹ = p₊Z₊ + p₋Z₋`.

theorems.name: Comparison.det_block_sym
theorems.statement:
theorem det_block_sym (A₀ A₁ : Matrix ι ι A) :
    (fromBlocks A₀ A₁ A₁ A₀).det = (A₀ + A₁).det * (A₀ - A₁).det
theorems.description: **`det [[A₀, A₁], [A₁, A₀]] = det(A₀ + A₁) det(A₀ − A₁)`.**

theorems.name: Comparison.signTransition_plus
theorems.statement: theorem signTransition_plus (t : Fin 5) : signTransitionC (1 : ℂ) t = transitionMat t
theorems.description: **`B₊ = B[1]`** is the walk of Proposition 26.

theorems.name: Comparison.law_norm
theorems.statement:
theorem law_norm {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (u : ℂ) (Bp Bm : Matrix ι ι ℂ) :
    (fromBlocks (1 - u • ((1 / 2 : ℂ) • (Bp + Bm))) (-(u • ((1 / 2 : ℂ) • (Bp - Bm))))
      (-(u • ((1 / 2 : ℂ) • (Bp - Bm)))) (1 - u • ((1 / 2 : ℂ) • (Bp + Bm)))).det =
      (1 - u • Bp).det * (1 - u • Bm).det
theorems.description:
**The operator `I − uB_c` on `𝒞⁸⁰` in the basis `(1, c)`** has the matrix
`[[I − uB₀, −uB₁], [−uB₁, I − uB₀]]` with `B₀ = (B₊ + B₋)/2`, `B₁ = (B₊ − B₋)/2`, and its determinant
is `det(I − uB₊) det(I − uB₋)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.transitionSign_pm
theorems.statement: theorem transitionSign_pm : ∀ (t : Fin 5) (k : Fin 16), transitionSign t k = 1 ∨ transitionSign t k = -1

theorems.name: Comparison.lineOnRel_relMat
theorems.statement: theorem lineOnRel_relMat (t : Fin 5) : lineOnRel t * relMat = relMat * signTransitionC (-1 : ℂ) t

theorems.name: Comparison.relMat_unitary
theorems.statement: theorem relMat_unitary : relMatᴴ * relMat = 1

theorems.name: Comparison.relSq_unitary
theorems.statement: theorem relSq_unitary : relSqᴴ * relSq = 1

theorems.name: Comparison.relSq_unitary'
theorems.statement: theorem relSq_unitary' : relSq * relSqᴴ = 1

theorems.name: Comparison.onRel_relSq
theorems.statement: theorem onRel_relSq (Y : Matrix Two Two ℂ) : onRel Y * relSq = (Y * relMat).submatrix e16 id

theorems.name: Comparison.signTransition_eq_conj
theorems.statement:
theorem signTransition_eq_conj (t : Fin 5) :
    signTransitionC (-1 : ℂ) t = relSqᴴ * onRel (lineOnRel t) * relSq

theorems.name: Comparison.onRel_sum
theorems.statement: theorem onRel_sum (Y : Fin 5 → Matrix Two Two ℂ) : onRel (∑ t, Y t) = ∑ t, onRel (Y t)

theorems.name: Comparison.det_conj_unitary
theorems.statement:
theorem det_conj_unitary {X Y : Matrix (Fin 16) (Fin 16) ℂ} (hX : X = relSqᴴ * Y * relSq)
    (a u : ℂ) : (a • (1 : Matrix (Fin 16) (Fin 16) ℂ) - u • X).det = (a • 1 - u • Y).det

theorems.name: Comparison.onRel_det
theorems.statement: theorem onRel_det (Y : Matrix Two Two ℂ) : (onRel Y).det = Y.det

theorems.name: Comparison.signTransition_mul_self
theorems.statement: theorem signTransition_mul_self (t : Fin 5) : signTransitionC (-1 : ℂ) t * signTransitionC (-1 : ℂ) t = 1

theorems.name: Comparison.det_one_sub_signTransition
theorems.statement:
theorem det_one_sub_signTransition (t : Fin 5) (u : ℂ) :
    (1 - u • signTransitionC (-1 : ℂ) t).det = (1 - u ^ 2) ^ 8

theorems.name: Comparison.det_vertex_signTransition
theorems.statement:
theorem det_vertex_signTransition (u : ℂ) :
    ((1 + 4 * u ^ 2) • (1 : Matrix (Fin 16) (Fin 16) ℂ) - u • ∑ t, signTransitionC (-1 : ℂ) t).det =
      (1 + 3 * u ^ 2 + 16 * u ^ 4) ^ 8

theorems.name: Comparison.D_minus_rel
theorems.statement:
theorem D_minus_rel (u : ℂ) :
    (1 - u • stepOp (signTransitionC (-1 : ℂ))).det = (1 - u ^ 2) ^ 24 * (1 + 3 * u ^ 2 + 16 * u ^ 4) ^ 8
theorems.description:
**In the two-spinor state basis, the signed step `B₋ = B[ν]` has the determinant `D₋`:**
`det(I − uB[ν]) = (1 − u²)²⁴(1 + 3u² + 16u⁴)⁸`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Jx_single
theorems.statement:
theorem Jx_single (a : Fin n) (S : Finset (Fin n)) :
    Jx (R := R) a (Pi.single S (1 : R)) =
      extSign (R := R) a (S.erase a) • (Pi.single (symmDiff S {a}) (1 : R) : Finset (Fin n) → R)

theorems.name: Comparison.comm_mul
theorems.statement:
theorem comm_mul {A : Type*} [Ring A] (T X Y : A) :
    T * (X * Y) - X * Y * T = (T * X - X * T) * Y + X * (T * Y - Y * T)
theorems.description: The commutator obeys the product rule: `[T, XY] = [T, X]Y + X[T, Y]`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Tx_comm_chain
theorems.statement:
theorem Tx_comm_chain {a b c : Fin n} (hab : a ≠ b) (hbc : b ≠ c) (hac : a ≠ c) :
    Tx (R := R) a b * Tx b c - Tx b c * Tx a b = Tx a c
theorems.description:
**The parallel rotations close as the rotations of the six:** `[T_ab, T_bc] = T_ac` for distinct
`a, b, c`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Tx_comm_disjoint
theorems.statement:
theorem Tx_comm_disjoint {a b c d : Fin n} (hac : a ≠ c) (had : a ≠ d) (hbc : b ≠ c)
    (hbd : b ≠ d) : Tx (R := R) a b * Tx c d - Tx c d * Tx a b = 0
theorems.description: **Rotations of disjoint planes commute:** `[T_ab, T_cd] = 0` for `{a, b} ∩ {c, d} = ∅`.

theorems.name: Comparison.rotor_mul
theorems.statement:
theorem rotor_mul {a b : Fin n} (hab : a ≠ b) (θ θ' : ℝ) :
    rotor a b θ * rotor a b θ' = rotor a b (θ + θ')

theorems.name: Comparison.rotor_two_pi
theorems.statement: theorem rotor_two_pi (a b : Fin n) : rotor a b (2 * Real.pi) = -1
theorems.description: **Spin one half:** `R(2π) = −1`, while the rotation of the plane is the identity.

theorems.name: Comparison.rotor_zero
theorems.statement: theorem rotor_zero (a b : Fin n) : rotor a b 0 = 1

theorems.name: Comparison.Jx_JJ
theorems.statement:
theorem Jx_JJ {a b : Fin n} (hab : a ≠ b) :
    Jx (R := ℝ) a * (Jx a * Jx b) = Jx b ∧ (Jx (R := ℝ) a * Jx b) * Jx a = -Jx b ∧
    Jx (R := ℝ) b * (Jx a * Jx b) = -Jx a ∧ (Jx (R := ℝ) a * Jx b) * Jx b = Jx a

theorems.name: Comparison.rotor_conj_a
theorems.statement:
theorem rotor_conj_a {a b : Fin n} (hab : a ≠ b) (θ : ℝ) :
    rotor a b θ * Jx a * rotor a b (-θ) = Real.cos θ • Jx a - Real.sin θ • Jx b
theorems.description: **The step turns its plane:** `R(ϑ) J_a R(−ϑ) = cos ϑ J_a − sin ϑ J_b`.

theorems.name: Comparison.rotor_conj_b
theorems.statement:
theorem rotor_conj_b {a b : Fin n} (hab : a ≠ b) (θ : ℝ) :
    rotor a b θ * Jx b * rotor a b (-θ) = Real.sin θ • Jx a + Real.cos θ • Jx b
theorems.description: `R(ϑ) J_b R(−ϑ) = sin ϑ J_a + cos ϑ J_b`.

theorems.name: Comparison.half_loop_sq
theorems.statement:
theorem half_loop_sq (D : Finset (Fin 6)) {x y : Fin 6} (hxy : x ≠ y) :
    (halfStep D x * halfStep D y) * (halfStep D x * halfStep D y) =
      (-((if x ∈ D then -1 else 1 : ℂ) * (if y ∈ D then -1 else 1))) • 1
theorems.description: **`(f_xf_y)² = −θ_D(x)θ_D(y)`** for `x ≠ y`: `−1` within a side, `+1` across.

theorems.name: Comparison.loop_counts
theorems.statement:
theorem loop_counts : ∀ D : Finset (Fin 6),
    (Finset.univ.filter fun p : Fin 6 × Fin 6 => p.1 < p.2 ∧ (p.1 ∈ D ↔ p.2 ∈ D)).card =
      D.card.choose 2 + (6 - D.card).choose 2 ∧
    (Finset.univ.filter fun p : Fin 6 × Fin 6 => p.1 < p.2 ∧ ¬(p.1 ∈ D ↔ p.2 ∈ D)).card =
      D.card * (6 - D.card)
theorems.description: **Within a side and across:** `C(k,2) + C(6−k,2)` planes keep the sides, `k(6 − k)` cross.

theorems.name: Comparison.phase_compl
theorems.statement:
theorem phase_compl (S : Finset (Fin 6)) :
    Complex.I ^ Sᶜ.card = -star (Complex.I ^ S.card)
theorems.description:
**Calling the other part divided turns the phase into `−` its conjugate:**
`i^{|Sᶜ|} = −\overline{i^{|S|}}`.

theorems.name: Comparison.kept_entry
theorems.statement:
theorem kept_entry (D : Finset (Fin n)) (X : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ)
    (hX : X * thetaD D = thetaD D * X) {a b : Fin n} (hab : ¬(a ∈ D ↔ b ∈ D)) : X a b = 0
theorems.description: **A kept rotation has no entry across the division.**

theorems.name: Comparison.comm_unitTurn_entry
theorems.statement:
theorem comm_unitTurn_entry (X : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) {a b c : Fin n} (hab : a ≠ b)
    (hac : a ≠ c) (hbc : b ≠ c) :
    (X * unitTurn b c - unitTurn b c * X) a c = X a b
theorems.description: `[X, E_bc − E_cb]` at `(a, c)` is `X_ab` when `a ∉ {b, c}`.

theorems.name: Comparison.central_entry
theorems.statement:
theorem central_entry (D : Finset (Fin n)) (X : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ)
    (hcent : ∀ b c : Fin n, (b ∈ D ↔ c ∈ D) → X * unitTurn b c = unitTurn b c * X)
    {a b c : Fin n} (hab : a ≠ b) (hac : a ≠ c) (hbc : b ≠ c) (hside : b ∈ D ↔ c ∈ D) :
    X a b = 0
theorems.description: **A central kept rotation has no entry on a side with a third direction.**

theorems.name: Comparison.clock_dividedSet
theorems.statement:
theorem clock_dividedSet (D : Finset (Fin n)) (X : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ)
    (hkept : X * thetaD D = thetaD D * X)
    (hcent : ∀ b c : Fin n, (b ∈ D ↔ c ∈ D) → X * unitTurn b c = unitTurn b c * X)
    {a b : Fin n} (hab : a ≠ b) (hX : X a b ≠ 0) :
    (a ∈ D ↔ b ∈ D) ∧ ∀ c, (c ∈ D ↔ a ∈ D) → c = a ∨ c = b
theorems.description:
**A clock sits on a side of exactly two directions:** a nonzero entry `X_ab` of a kept rotation
that commutes with every kept unit rotation has `a, b` on one side and no third direction there.

theorems.name: Comparison.genZ_map
theorems.statement: theorem genZ_map (x : Fin 5 ⊕ Fin 10) : (genZ x).map GaussianInt.toComplex = gen x

theorems.name: Comparison.genZ_comm_of_disjoint
theorems.statement:
theorem genZ_comm_of_disjoint :
    ∀ x y : Fin 5 ⊕ Fin 10, PlaneDisjoint x y → genZ x * genZ y = genZ y * genZ x

theorems.name: Comparison.gen_comm_of_disjoint
theorems.statement:
theorem gen_comm_of_disjoint (x y : Fin 5 ⊕ Fin 10) (h : PlaneDisjoint x y) :
    gen x * gen y = gen y * gen x
theorems.description: **Rotations of disjoint planes commute.**

theorems.name: Comparison.clock_line_kept
theorems.statement: theorem clock_line_kept : ∀ h : Fin 5, Kept {0, h.succ} (Sum.inl h)
theorems.description: The clock of a line, `iγ_h`, is kept by `{h, n}`.

theorems.name: Comparison.kept_line_cases
theorems.statement:
theorem kept_line_cases : ∀ (h : Fin 5) (x : Fin 5 ⊕ Fin 10),
    ((plane x).1 ∈ ({0, h.succ} : Finset (Fin 6)) ↔ (plane x).2 ∈ ({0, h.succ} : Finset (Fin 6))) →
      x = Sum.inl h ∨ PlaneDisjoint (Sum.inl h) x

theorems.name: Comparison.clock_line_central
theorems.statement:
theorem clock_line_central (h : Fin 5) (x : Fin 5 ⊕ Fin 10) (hx : Kept {0, h.succ} x) :
    gen (Sum.inl h) * gen x = gen x * gen (Sum.inl h)
theorems.description: **The clock of a line commutes with every rotation its division keeps.**

theorems.name: Comparison.clock_line_moved
theorems.statement: theorem clock_line_moved : ∀ h : Fin 5, Moved {h.succ} (Sum.inl h)
theorems.description: **At `{h}` the clock of the line is moved.**

theorems.name: Comparison.clock_plane_kept
theorems.statement:
theorem clock_plane_kept (f : Fin 10) :
    Kept {(planeLines f).1.succ, (planeLines f).2.succ} (Sum.inr f)
theorems.description: The plane's rotation is kept by the plane's division.

theorems.name: Comparison.kept_plane_cases
theorems.statement:
theorem kept_plane_cases : ∀ (f : Fin 10) (x : Fin 5 ⊕ Fin 10),
    ((plane x).1 ∈ ({(planeLines f).1.succ, (planeLines f).2.succ} : Finset (Fin 6)) ↔
      (plane x).2 ∈ ({(planeLines f).1.succ, (planeLines f).2.succ} : Finset (Fin 6))) →
      x = Sum.inr f ∨ PlaneDisjoint (Sum.inr f) x

theorems.name: Comparison.clock_plane_central
theorems.statement:
theorem clock_plane_central (f : Fin 10) (x : Fin 5 ⊕ Fin 10)
    (hx : Kept {(planeLines f).1.succ, (planeLines f).2.succ} x) :
    gen (Sum.inr f) * gen x = gen x * gen (Sum.inr f)
theorems.description: **The plane's rotation commutes with every rotation the plane's division keeps.**

theorems.name: Comparison.clock_plane_moved
theorems.statement: theorem clock_plane_moved (f : Fin 10) : Moved {(planeLines f).1.succ} (Sum.inr f)
theorems.description: **At `{h}` the plane's rotation is moved.**

theorems.name: Comparison.expIγ_add
theorems.statement: theorem expIγ_add (a b : ℝ) (h : Fin 5) : expIγ a h * expIγ b h = expIγ (a + b) h

theorems.name: Comparison.expIγ_unitary
theorems.statement: theorem expIγ_unitary (a : ℝ) (h : Fin 5) : expIγ a h * expIγ (-a) h = 1

theorems.name: Comparison.quarter_turn
theorems.statement: theorem quarter_turn (h : Fin 5) : expIγ (Real.pi / 2) h = I • γ h
theorems.description: **One step along the last-step direction is a quarter turn of the clock:** `e^{i(π/2)γ_h} = iγ_h`.

theorems.name: Comparison.one_kron_line_singlet
theorems.statement:
theorem one_kron_line_singlet (c d : ℂ) (h : Fin 5) :
    ((1 : Matrix Four Four ℂ) ⊗ₖ (c • 1 + d • γ h)) *ᵥ Ω =
      ((c • 1 + d • γ h) ⊗ₖ (1 : Matrix Four Four ℂ)) *ᵥ Ω
theorems.description: `(1 ⊗ X) Ω = (X ⊗ 1) Ω` for `X = c + d γ_h`.

theorems.name: Comparison.clock_turns_singlet
theorems.statement:
theorem clock_turns_singlet (a : ℝ) (h : Fin 5) :
    (expIγ a h ⊗ₖ expIγ a h) *ᵥ Ω =
      (Real.cos (2 * a) : ℂ) • Ω + (Real.sin (2 * a) : ℂ) • (I • ((γ h ⊗ₖ 1) *ᵥ Ω))
theorems.description:
**The clock turns the singlet toward the last-step direction:**
`(e^{iaγ_h} ⊗ e^{iaγ_h}) Ω = cos 2a · Ω + sin 2a · i ℓ_h`, `ℓ_h = (γ_h ⊗ 1) Ω`.

theorems.name: Comparison.gammaDZ_map
theorems.statement: theorem gammaDZ_map (D : Finset (Fin 5)) : (gammaDZ D).map GaussianInt.toComplex = gammaD D

theorems.name: Comparison.JZ_map
theorems.statement: theorem JZ_map : JZ.map GaussianInt.toComplex = J

theorems.name: Comparison.gammaDZ_J_transpose
theorems.statement:
theorem gammaDZ_J_transpose : ∀ D : Finset (Fin 5),
    (gammaDZ D * JZ)ᵀ = (countSign D.card : GaussianInt) • (gammaDZ D * JZ)

theorems.name: Comparison.gammaDZ_C_sq
theorems.statement:
theorem gammaDZ_C_sq : ∀ D : Finset (Fin 5),
    (gammaDZ D * JZ) * (gammaDZ D * JZ).map star = (countSign D.card : GaussianInt) • 1

theorems.name: Comparison.map_intSmul
theorems.statement:
theorem map_intSmul (c : ℤ) (M : Matrix Four Four GaussianInt) :
    ((c : GaussianInt) • M).map GaussianInt.toComplex = (c : ℂ) • M.map GaussianInt.toComplex
theorems.description: **`(γ_D J)ᵀ = s_r γ_D J`.**

theorems.name: Comparison.gammaD_J_eq
theorems.statement:
theorem gammaD_J_eq (D : Finset (Fin 5)) :
    gammaD D * J = (gammaDZ D * JZ).map GaussianInt.toComplex

theorems.name: Comparison.gammaD_J_transpose
theorems.statement:
theorem gammaD_J_transpose (D : Finset (Fin 5)) :
    (gammaD D * J)ᵀ = (countSign D.card : ℂ) • (gammaD D * J)

theorems.name: Comparison.C_sq
theorems.statement:
theorem C_sq (D : Finset (Fin 5)) (v : Four → ℂ) :
    Cop D (Cop D v) = (countSign D.card : ℂ) • v

theorems.name: Comparison.amplitude_symm
theorems.statement:
theorem amplitude_symm (D : Finset (Fin 5)) (v w : Four → ℂ) :
    star (Cop D v) ⬝ᵥ w = (countSign D.card : ℂ) * (star (Cop D w) ⬝ᵥ v)
theorems.description:
**The reading of an odd division is bilinear and (anti)symmetric:**
`⟨C_D v, w⟩ = s_r ⟨C_D w, v⟩`.

theorems.name: Comparison.hermFormZ
theorems.statement:
theorem hermFormZ : ∀ D : Finset (Fin 5), D.card % 2 = 0 →
    ((iZ ^ (D.card * (D.card - 1) / 2)) • gammaDZ D)ᴴ =
      (iZ ^ (D.card * (D.card - 1) / 2)) • gammaDZ D

theorems.name: Comparison.hermForm_hermitian
theorems.statement:
theorem hermForm_hermitian (D : Finset (Fin 5)) (hD : D.card % 2 = 0) :
    (hermForm D)ᴴ = hermForm D
theorems.description: **An even division reads a state as a count:** `h_D` is Hermitian, so `⟨v, h_D v⟩` is real.

theorems.name: Comparison.onesK_G_sq
theorems.statement:
theorem onesK_G_sq (G : Matrix (Fin 5) (Fin 5) K) :
    (onesK * G) * (onesK * G) = (∑ i, ∑ j, G i j) • (onesK * G)

theorems.name: Comparison.coinAt_sq
theorems.statement:
theorem coinAt_sq (G : Matrix (Fin 5) (Fin 5) K) (hL : ∑ i, ∑ j, G i j ≠ 0) :
    coinAt G * coinAt G = 1
theorems.description: **The coin read at any divided set is an involution:** `σ_G² = 1` whenever `L ≠ 0`.

theorems.name: Comparison.dividedSetL
theorems.statement:
theorem dividedSetL (S : Finset (Fin 5)) (odd : Bool) :
    ∑ i, ∑ j, (dividedSetG S odd : Matrix (Fin 5) (Fin 5) K) i j =
      if odd then 5 - 2 * (S.card : K) else 5

theorems.name: Comparison.coinAt_echo
theorems.statement:
theorem coinAt_echo (G : Matrix (Fin 5) (Fin 5) K) (hG : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → G i j = 0) (t : Fin 5)
    (ht : G t t = 1) : coinAt G t t = 2 / (∑ i, ∑ j, G i j) - 1
theorems.description: **The reflection off the divided set:** the diagonal entry of `σ` at a line outside `S` is `2/L − 1`.

theorems.name: Comparison.plane_departures
theorems.statement:
theorem plane_departures :
    ((Finset.univ ×ˢ Finset.univ).filter fun p : State × State =>
        (disagreeSet p.1.1).card = 2 ∧ Continues p.1 p.2).card = 200 ∧
    ((Finset.univ ×ˢ Finset.univ).filter fun p : State × State =>
        (disagreeSet p.1.1).card = 2 ∧ Continues p.1 p.2 ∧
          (disagreeSet p.2.1).card = 4).card = 80 ∧
    ((Finset.univ ×ˢ Finset.univ).filter fun p : State × State =>
        (disagreeSet p.1.1).card = 2 ∧ Continues p.1 p.2 ∧
          (disagreeSet p.2.1).card = 2).card = 120 ∧
    ∀ k : Fin 16, (disagreeSet k).card = 2 →
      ((Finset.univ ×ˢ Finset.univ).filter fun p : State × State =>
        (disagreeSet p.1.1).card = 2 ∧ Continues p.1 p.2 ∧ p.2.1 = k).card = 12
theorems.description:
**The departures from the symmetric states:** of the `200` continuations from the fifty symmetric states, `80`
reach a vector state and `120` a plane, `12` each plane.

theorems.name: Comparison.degreeProj_apply
theorems.statement:
theorem degreeProj_apply (k : ℕ) (v : Finset (Fin n) → R) (T : Finset (Fin n)) :
    degreeProj k v T = if T.card = k then v T else 0

theorems.name: Comparison.εε_degree
theorems.statement:
theorem εε_degree (a b : Fin n) (v : Finset (Fin n) → R) (T : Finset (Fin n)) :
    (εx a * εx b : Module.End R (Finset (Fin n) → R)) (degreeProj T.card v) T = 0
theorems.description: Two directions more change the degree.

theorems.name: Comparison.ιι_degree
theorems.statement:
theorem ιι_degree (a b : Fin n) (v : Finset (Fin n) → R) (T : Finset (Fin n)) :
    (ιx a * ιx b : Module.End R (Finset (Fin n) → R)) (degreeProj T.card v) T = 0
theorems.description: Two directions fewer change the degree.

theorems.name: Comparison.Tx_degree
theorems.statement:
theorem Tx_degree (a b : Fin n) (v : Finset (Fin n) → R) (T : Finset (Fin n)) :
    Tx a b (degreeProj T.card v) T = Tx a b v T
theorems.description: The rotation keeps the degree.

theorems.name: Comparison.Tx_eq_sum_degrees
theorems.statement:
theorem Tx_eq_sum_degrees {a b : Fin n} (hab : a ≠ b) :
    Tx (R := R) a b = ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), degreeProj k * (Jx a * Jx b) * degreeProj k
theorems.description: **Proposition 36:** `T_ab = Σ_k Π_k J_a J_b Π_k` for `a ≠ b`.

theorems.name: Comparison.ιx_single
theorems.statement:
theorem ιx_single (a : Fin n) (S : Finset (Fin n)) :
    ιx (R := R) a (Pi.single S 1) =
      if a ∈ S then extSign (R := R) a (S.erase a) • (Pi.single (S.erase a) 1 : Finset (Fin n) → R)
      else 0
theorems.description:
**One direction fewer on a basis set:** `ι_a f_S = (−1)^{#{c ∈ S : c < a}} f_{S ∖ {a}}` for
`a ∈ S`, zero otherwise.

theorems.name: Comparison.Tx_single_singlet
theorems.statement:
theorem Tx_single_singlet {a b : Fin n} {S : Finset (Fin n)} (ha : a ∉ S) (hb : b ∉ S) :
    Tx (R := R) a b (Pi.single S 1) = 0
theorems.description: The rotation of `(a, b)` kills a set holding neither `a` nor `b`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Tx_single_both
theorems.statement:
theorem Tx_single_both {a b : Fin n} (hab : a ≠ b) {S : Finset (Fin n)} (ha : a ∈ S)
    (hb : b ∈ S) : Tx (R := R) a b (Pi.single S 1) = 0
theorems.description: The rotation of `(a, b)` kills a set holding both.

theorems.name: Comparison.Tx_εx_self_left
theorems.statement:
theorem Tx_εx_self_left {a b : Fin n} (hab : a ≠ b) :
    Tx (R := R) a b * εx a = εx a * Tx a b - εx b

theorems.name: Comparison.Tx_εx_self_right
theorems.statement:
theorem Tx_εx_self_right {a b : Fin n} (hab : a ≠ b) :
    Tx (R := R) a b * εx b = εx b * Tx a b + εx a

theorems.name: Comparison.Tx_εa_singlet
theorems.statement:
theorem Tx_εa_singlet {a b : Fin n} (hab : a ≠ b) {S : Finset (Fin n)} (ha : a ∉ S) (hb : b ∉ S) :
    Tx (R := R) a b (εx a (Pi.single S 1)) = -εx b (Pi.single S 1)
theorems.description: On a set holding neither, `T ε_a f = −ε_b f` and `T ε_b f = ε_a f`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Tx_εb_singlet
theorems.statement:
theorem Tx_εb_singlet {a b : Fin n} (hab : a ≠ b) {S : Finset (Fin n)} (ha : a ∉ S) (hb : b ∉ S) :
    Tx (R := R) a b (εx b (Pi.single S 1)) = εx a (Pi.single S 1)

theorems.name: Comparison.single_eq_εx
theorems.statement:
theorem single_eq_εx {a : Fin n} {S : Finset (Fin n)} (ha : a ∈ S) :
    (Pi.single S 1 : Finset (Fin n) → R) =
      extSign (R := R) a (S.erase a) • εx a (Pi.single (S.erase a) 1)
theorems.description: A set holding `a` is `± ε_a` of the set without it.

theorems.name: Comparison.Tx_cube
theorems.statement: theorem Tx_cube {a b : Fin n} (hab : a ≠ b) : Tx (R := R) a b * Tx a b * Tx a b = -Tx a b
theorems.description: **`T_ab³ = −T_ab`** for `a ≠ b`.

theorems.name: Comparison.exp_smul_of_cube
theorems.statement:
theorem exp_smul_of_cube {𝔸 : Type*} [NormedRing 𝔸] [NormedAlgebra ℝ 𝔸] [CompleteSpace 𝔸]
    (T : 𝔸) (hT : T * T * T = -T) (θ : ℝ) :
    NormedSpace.exp (θ • T) = 1 + Real.sin θ • T + (1 - Real.cos θ) • (T * T)
theorems.description: **In a complete normed real algebra, `T³ = −T` gives `e^{ϑT} = 1 + sin ϑ T + (1 − cos ϑ)T²`.**

theorems.name: Comparison.turnGen_eq_unitTurn
theorems.statement: theorem turnGen_eq_unitTurn (a b : Fin n) : turnGen a b = unitTurn a b

theorems.name: Comparison.turnGen_sq
theorems.statement:
theorem turnGen_sq {a b : Fin n} (hab : a ≠ b) :
    turnGen a b * turnGen a b = -(Matrix.single a a 1 + Matrix.single b b 1)

theorems.name: Comparison.turnGen_cube
theorems.statement:
theorem turnGen_cube {a b : Fin n} (hab : a ≠ b) :
    turnGen a b * turnGen a b * turnGen a b = -turnGen a b

theorems.name: Comparison.planeRot_apply
theorems.statement:
theorem planeRot_apply {a b : Fin n} (hab : a ≠ b) (θ : ℝ) (i j : Fin n) :
    planeRot a b θ i j =
      (if i = j then 1 else 0) + Real.sin θ * ((if a = i ∧ b = j then 1 else 0) -
        (if b = i ∧ a = j then 1 else 0)) -
        (1 - Real.cos θ) *
          ((if a = i ∧ a = j then 1 else 0) + (if b = i ∧ b = j then 1 else 0))

theorems.name: Comparison.planeRot_col_a
theorems.statement:
theorem planeRot_col_a {a b : Fin n} (hab : a ≠ b) (θ : ℝ) :
    (planeRot a b θ).col a = Real.cos θ • Pi.single a 1 - Real.sin θ • Pi.single b 1

theorems.name: Comparison.planeRot_col_b
theorems.statement:
theorem planeRot_col_b {a b : Fin n} (hab : a ≠ b) (θ : ℝ) :
    (planeRot a b θ).col b = Real.sin θ • Pi.single a 1 + Real.cos θ • Pi.single b 1

theorems.name: Comparison.planeRot_col_other
theorems.statement:
theorem planeRot_col_other {a b c : Fin n} (hab : a ≠ b) (hca : c ≠ a) (hcb : c ≠ b) (θ : ℝ) :
    (planeRot a b θ).col c = Pi.single c 1

theorems.name: Comparison.εv_sub
theorems.statement: theorem εv_sub {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (v w : Fin n → R) : εv (v - w) = εv v - εv w

theorems.name: Comparison.colStep_rot_a
theorems.statement:
theorem colStep_rot_a {a b : Fin n} (hab : a ≠ b) (θ : ℝ) :
    colStep (planeRot a b θ) a = Real.cos θ • εx a - Real.sin θ • εx b

theorems.name: Comparison.colStep_rot_b
theorems.statement:
theorem colStep_rot_b {a b : Fin n} (hab : a ≠ b) (θ : ℝ) :
    colStep (planeRot a b θ) b = Real.sin θ • εx a + Real.cos θ • εx b

theorems.name: Comparison.colStep_rot_other
theorems.statement:
theorem colStep_rot_other {a b c : Fin n} (hab : a ≠ b) (hca : c ≠ a) (hcb : c ≠ b) (θ : ℝ) :
    colStep (planeRot a b θ) c = εx c

theorems.name: Comparison.extMap_rot_singlet
theorems.statement:
theorem extMap_rot_singlet {a b : Fin n} (hab : a ≠ b) (θ : ℝ) {S : Finset (Fin n)} (ha : a ∉ S)
    (hb : b ∉ S) : extMap (planeRot a b θ) (Pi.single S 1) = Pi.single S 1
theorems.description: The rotation fixes a set holding neither `a` nor `b`.

theorems.name: Comparison.extMap_rot_εx
theorems.statement:
theorem extMap_rot_εx {a b : Fin n} (hab : a ≠ b) (θ : ℝ) {S : Finset (Fin n)} (ha : a ∉ S)
    (hb : b ∉ S) (c : Fin n) :
    extMap (planeRot a b θ) (εx c (Pi.single S 1)) = colStep (planeRot a b θ) c (Pi.single S 1)
theorems.description: `Λ(R) ε_c f = ε(Re_c) f` on a set held fixed by `R`.

theorems.name: Comparison.extMap_planeRot
theorems.statement:
theorem extMap_planeRot {a b : Fin n} (hab : a ≠ b) (θ : ℝ) :
    extMap (planeRot a b θ) =
      1 + Real.sin θ • Tx a b + (1 - Real.cos θ) • (Tx (R := ℝ) a b * Tx a b)
theorems.description: **`Λ(planeRot a b ϑ) = 1 + sin ϑ T_ab + (1 − cos ϑ)T_ab²`.**

theorems.name: Comparison.matrix_exp_smul_of_cube
theorems.statement:
theorem matrix_exp_smul_of_cube {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (M : Matrix ι ι ℝ)
    (hM : M * M * M = -M) (θ : ℝ) :
    NormedSpace.exp (θ • M) = 1 + Real.sin θ • M + (1 - Real.cos θ) • (M * M)
theorems.description: `e^{ϑM} = 1 + sin ϑ M + (1 − cos ϑ)M²` for a real matrix with `M³ = −M`.

theorems.name: Comparison.exp_unitTurn
theorems.statement:
theorem exp_unitTurn {a b : Fin n} (hab : a ≠ b) (θ : ℝ) :
    NormedSpace.exp (θ • unitTurn a b) = planeRot a b θ
theorems.description: **`e^{ϑ(E_ab − E_ba)}` is the rotation of the plane `(a, b)` by `ϑ`.**

theorems.name: Comparison.exp_parallel_turn
theorems.statement:
theorem exp_parallel_turn {a b : Fin n} (hab : a ≠ b) (θ : ℝ) :
    NormedSpace.exp (θ • LinearMap.toMatrixAlgEquiv' (Tx (R := ℝ) a b)) =
      LinearMap.toMatrixAlgEquiv' (extMap (NormedSpace.exp (θ • unitTurn a b)))
theorems.description: **Proposition 36:** `e^{ϑ T_ab} = Λ(e^{ϑ(E_ab − E_ba)})` for `a ≠ b`, as matrices on the sets.

theorems.name: Comparison.disagreeSet_transition
theorems.statement:
theorem disagreeSet_transition (t : Fin 5) (k : Fin 16) :
    disagreeSet (transition t k) = symmDiff (disagreeSet k) (Finset.univ.erase t)
theorems.description:
**Elements, Prop. 14:** the change `t` turns agreement into disagreement and back on the four
lines other than `t`: `S ↦ S △ ([5] ∖ {t})`.

theorems.name: Comparison.transition_transition
theorems.statement: theorem transition_transition (t : Fin 5) (k : Fin 16) : transition t (transition t k) = k
theorems.description: A change done twice is no change.

theorems.name: Comparison.transition_ne
theorems.statement: theorem transition_ne (t : Fin 5) (k : Fin 16) : transition t k ≠ k
theorems.description: No change leaves a two-spinor state where it is.

theorems.name: Comparison.transition_eq_transition_iff
theorems.statement: theorem transition_eq_transition_iff (t t' : Fin 5) (k : Fin 16) : transition t k = transition t' k ↔ t = t'
theorems.description: The five changes lead from each two-spinor state to five different two-spinor states.

theorems.name: Comparison.transitionSign_transition
theorems.statement: theorem transitionSign_transition (t : Fin 5) (k : Fin 16) : transitionSign t (transition t k) * transitionSign t k = 1
theorems.description: The sign of a change done twice: `transitionSign t (transition t k) * transitionSign t k = 1`.

theorems.name: Comparison.γZ_map
theorems.statement: theorem γZ_map (t : Fin 5) : (γZ t).map GaussianInt.toComplex = γ t

theorems.name: Comparison.relOpZ_map
theorems.statement: theorem relOpZ_map (k : Fin 16) : (relOpZ k).map GaussianInt.toComplex = relOp k

theorems.name: Comparison.γZ_mul_relOpZ
theorems.statement:
theorem γZ_mul_relOpZ : ∀ (t : Fin 5) (k : Fin 16),
    γZ t * relOpZ k = (transitionSign t k : GaussianInt) • relOpZ (transition t k)

theorems.name: Comparison.γ_mul_relOp
theorems.statement:
theorem γ_mul_relOp (t : Fin 5) (k : Fin 16) :
    γ t * relOp k = (transitionSign t k : ℂ) • relOp (transition t k)
theorems.description:
**A line applied to one system moves a two-spinor state to a two-spinor state:**
`γ_t B_k = (transitionSign t k) B_{transition t k}`.

theorems.name: Comparison.line_moves_rel
theorems.statement:
theorem line_moves_rel (t : Fin 5) (k : Fin 16) :
    (γ t ⊗ₖ (1 : Matrix Four Four ℂ)) *ᵥ rel k = (transitionSign t k : ℂ) • rel (transition t k)
theorems.description: **Elements, Prop. 14 on the two-spinor states:** `(γ_t ⊗ 1) e_k = ± e_{transition t k}`.

theorems.name: Comparison.adjacent_symm
theorems.statement: theorem adjacent_symm (k l : Fin 16) : Adjacent k l ↔ Adjacent l k

theorems.name: Comparison.card_neighbours
theorems.statement: theorem card_neighbours (k : Fin 16) : (Finset.univ.filter (Adjacent k)).card = 5
theorems.description: Every two-spinor state has five neighbours.

theorems.name: Comparison.common_neighbours
theorems.statement:
theorem common_neighbours (k l : Fin 16) (h : k ≠ l) :
    (Finset.univ.filter fun m => Adjacent k m ∧ Adjacent l m).card =
      if Adjacent k l then 0 else 2
theorems.description:
**The Clebsch graph:** two neighbours have no neighbour in common, two other two-spinor states have
two.

theorems.name: Comparison.card_edges
theorems.statement:
theorem card_edges :
    (Finset.univ.filter fun p : Fin 16 × Fin 16 => p.1 < p.2 ∧ Adjacent p.1 p.2).card = 40
theorems.description: The sixteen two-spinor states and their transitions have forty pairs of neighbours.

theorems.name: Comparison.card_state
theorems.statement: theorem card_state : Fintype.card State = 80

theorems.name: Comparison.card_continuations
theorems.statement:
theorem card_continuations (s : State) :
    (Finset.univ.filter (Continues s)).card = 4
theorems.description: **Every state has exactly four continuations.**

theorems.name: Comparison.card_predecessors
theorems.statement:
theorem card_predecessors (s' : State) :
    (Finset.univ.filter fun s => Continues s s').card = 4
theorems.description: **Exactly four states lead to each state.**

theorems.name: Comparison.undo_returns
theorems.statement: theorem undo_returns (k : Fin 16) (t : Fin 5) : transition t (transition t k) = k
theorems.description: The continuation by the change just made would undo it: it returns to the two-spinor state before.

theorems.name: Comparison.trace_γ_mul_γ
theorems.statement: theorem trace_γ_mul_γ (s t : Fin 5) : (γ s * γ t).trace = if s = t then 4 else 0

theorems.name: Comparison.γ_mul_γ_scalar_iff
theorems.statement:
theorem γ_mul_γ_scalar_iff (s t : Fin 5) :
    (∃ c : ℂ, γ s * γ t = c • (1 : Matrix Four Four ℂ)) ↔ s = t
theorems.description: **Proposition 24, first part:** `γ_s γ_t` is a number exactly when `s = t`.

theorems.name: Comparison.mem_words
theorems.statement: theorem mem_words {n : ℕ} {w : List (Fin 5)} : w ∈ words n ↔ w.length = n

theorems.name: Comparison.sum_words_succ
theorems.statement:
theorem sum_words_succ {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] (n : ℕ) (f : List (Fin 5) → M) :
    ∑ w ∈ words (n + 1), f w = ∑ t, ∑ w ∈ words n, f (t :: w)

theorems.name: Comparison.card_words
theorems.statement: theorem card_words (n : ℕ) : (words n).card = 5 ^ n

theorems.name: Comparison.reduced_nil
theorems.statement: theorem reduced_nil : Reduced []

theorems.name: Comparison.reduced_single
theorems.statement: theorem reduced_single (t : Fin 5) : Reduced [t]

theorems.name: Comparison.reduced_cons_cons
theorems.statement:
theorem reduced_cons_cons (s t : Fin 5) (w : List (Fin 5)) :
    Reduced (s :: t :: w) ↔ s ≠ t ∧ Reduced (t :: w)

theorems.name: Comparison.reduced_of_cons
theorems.statement: theorem reduced_of_cons {t : Fin 5} {w : List (Fin 5)} (h : Reduced (t :: w)) : Reduced w

theorems.name: Comparison.reducedFrom_succ
theorems.statement:
theorem reducedFrom_succ (n : ℕ) (g : Fin 5) :
    reducedFrom (n + 1) g = ∑ g', if g' = g then 0 else reducedFrom n g'

theorems.name: Comparison.reducedFrom_eq
theorems.statement: theorem reducedFrom_eq (n : ℕ) (g : Fin 5) : reducedFrom n g = 4 ^ n

theorems.name: Comparison.card_reduced
theorems.statement: theorem card_reduced (n : ℕ) : ((words (n + 1)).filter Reduced).card = 5 * 4 ^ n
theorems.description: **`5 · 4ⁿ` walks of length `n + 1`.**

theorems.name: Comparison.push_reduced
theorems.statement: theorem push_reduced (t : Fin 5) {w : List (Fin 5)} (hw : Reduced w) : Reduced (push t w)

theorems.name: Comparison.reduce_reduced
theorems.statement: theorem reduce_reduced (w : List (Fin 5)) : Reduced (reduce w)

theorems.name: Comparison.push_push
theorems.statement: theorem push_push (t : Fin 5) {w : List (Fin 5)} (hw : Reduced w) : push t (push t w) = w

theorems.name: Comparison.reduce_of_reduced
theorems.statement: theorem reduce_of_reduced {w : List (Fin 5)} (hw : Reduced w) : reduce w = w

theorems.name: Comparison.reduce_append
theorems.statement: theorem reduce_append (u v : List (Fin 5)) : reduce (u ++ v) = u.foldr push (reduce v)

theorems.name: Comparison.reduce_cancel
theorems.statement:
theorem reduce_cancel (u v : List (Fin 5)) (t : Fin 5) :
    reduce (u ++ t :: t :: v) = reduce (u ++ v)
theorems.description: Removing a pair `tt` anywhere does not change the reduced word.

theorems.name: Comparison.reduce_eq_of_cancel
theorems.statement:
theorem reduce_eq_of_cancel {w w' : List (Fin 5)} (h : Relation.ReflTransGen Cancel w w') :
    reduce w = reduce w'

theorems.name: Comparison.cancel_cons
theorems.statement:
theorem cancel_cons {w w' : List (Fin 5)} (t : Fin 5) (h : Cancel w w') :
    Cancel (t :: w) (t :: w')

theorems.name: Comparison.cancels_cons
theorems.statement:
theorem cancels_cons {w w' : List (Fin 5)} (t : Fin 5) (h : Relation.ReflTransGen Cancel w w') :
    Relation.ReflTransGen Cancel (t :: w) (t :: w')

theorems.name: Comparison.cancels_to_reduce
theorems.statement: theorem cancels_to_reduce (w : List (Fin 5)) : Relation.ReflTransGen Cancel w (reduce w)
theorems.description: Every word reduces to its reduced word by removing pairs `tt`.

theorems.name: Comparison.unique_reduced
theorems.statement:
theorem unique_reduced {w w' : List (Fin 5)} (h : Relation.ReflTransGen Cancel w w')
    (hw' : Reduced w') : w' = reduce w
theorems.description: **Proposition 24:** every word reduces, by removing pairs `tt`, to exactly one reduced word.

theorems.name: Comparison.relOfWord_cons
theorems.statement:
theorem relOfWord_cons (t : Fin 5) (w : List (Fin 5)) :
    relOfWord (t :: w) = transition t (relOfWord w)

theorems.name: Comparison.γword_eq
theorems.statement:
theorem γword_eq (w : List (Fin 5)) :
    (w.map γ).prod = (coef w : ℂ) • relOp (relOfWord w)

theorems.name: Comparison.history_rel
theorems.statement:
theorem history_rel (w : List (Fin 5)) :
    ((w.map γ).prod ⊗ₖ (1 : Matrix Four Four ℂ)) *ᵥ Ω = (coef w : ℂ) • rel (relOfWord w)
theorems.description:
**Proposition 25:** the two-spinor state of a moment to an earlier one is `± e_S` with `S` given by the
steps between them: `(γ_w ⊗ 1) Ω = coef w • e_{relOfWord w}`.

theorems.name: Comparison.coef_sq
theorems.statement: theorem coef_sq (w : List (Fin 5)) : coef w * coef w = 1

theorems.name: Comparison.disagreeSet_relOfWord
theorems.statement:
theorem disagreeSet_relOfWord (w : List (Fin 5)) :
    disagreeSet (relOfWord w) = w.foldr (fun t S => symmDiff S (Finset.univ.erase t)) ∅
theorems.description: The disagreement set reached: `T_{t_k} △ ⋯ △ T_{t_1}`.

theorems.name: Comparison.disagreeSet_injective
theorems.statement: theorem disagreeSet_injective : Function.Injective disagreeSet

theorems.name: Comparison.relOfWord_append
theorems.statement:
theorem relOfWord_append (u v : List (Fin 5)) :
    relOfWord (u ++ v) = u.foldr transition (relOfWord v)
theorems.description:
The two-spinor states of moments compose: the steps of `u` after those of `v` reach
`relOfWord u` moved from `relOfWord v`.

theorems.name: Comparison.relOfWord_surjective
theorems.statement:
theorem relOfWord_surjective :
    ∀ k : Fin 16, ∃ w : List (Fin 5), w.length ≤ 2 ∧ relOfWord w = k
theorems.description:
**The vertices of a line:** every one of the sixteen two-spinor states is reached from the singlet by at
most two steps.

theorems.name: Comparison.at_place_iff
theorems.statement:
theorem at_place_iff (w : List (Fin 5)) :
    relOfWord w = 0 ↔ ∃ c : ℂ, ((w.map γ).prod ⊗ₖ (1 : Matrix Four Four ℂ)) *ᵥ Ω = c • Ω
theorems.description:
**Two moments are at one vertex exactly when the two-spinor state between them is the singlet:**
`relOfWord w = 0 ⟺ (γ_w ⊗ 1) Ω ∈ ℂ Ω`.

theorems.name: Comparison.lump_e_norm
theorems.statement: theorem lump_e_norm (n : ℕ) : ((lumpSeq n).e : ℝ) / 4 ^ n = excursionLaw (n + 1)

theorems.name: Comparison.lump_b_norm
theorems.statement: theorem lump_b_norm (n : ℕ) : ((lumpSeq n).b : ℝ) / 4 ^ n = excursionLaw (n + 2)

theorems.name: Comparison.lump_a_norm
theorems.statement: theorem lump_a_norm (n : ℕ) : ((lumpSeq n).a : ℝ) / 4 ^ n = if n = 0 then 1 else 0

theorems.name: Comparison.hasSum_lump_a
theorems.statement: theorem hasSum_lump_a : HasSum (fun n => ((lumpSeq n).a : ℝ) / 4 ^ n) 1

theorems.name: Comparison.hasSum_lump_e
theorems.statement: theorem hasSum_lump_e : HasSum (fun n => ((lumpSeq n).e : ℝ) / 4 ^ n) 1

theorems.name: Comparison.hasSum_lump_b
theorems.statement: theorem hasSum_lump_b : HasSum (fun n => ((lumpSeq n).b : ℝ) / 4 ^ n) 1

theorems.name: Comparison.hasSum_lump_c
theorems.statement: theorem hasSum_lump_c : HasSum (fun n => ((lumpSeq n).c : ℝ) / 4 ^ n) 1

theorems.name: Comparison.hasSum_lump_d
theorems.statement: theorem hasSum_lump_d : HasSum (fun n => ((lumpSeq n).d : ℝ) / 4 ^ n) 1

theorems.name: Comparison.tyInd_sum
theorems.statement:
theorem tyInd_sum :
    ∀ s : State, tyInd 1 s + tyInd 2 s + tyInd 3 s + tyInd 4 s + tyInd 0 s = 1
theorems.description: Every state lies in exactly one class.

theorems.name: Comparison.visits_per_state
theorems.statement:
theorem visits_per_state (s : State) :
    HasSum (fun n => (stateCount n s : ℝ) / (5 * 4 ^ n)) (1 / 5)
theorems.description:
**Every one of the eighty states is visited `1/5` times per excursion** (the excursion's first step
uniform over the five directions, then four continuations each `1/4`).

theorems.name: Comparison.visits_of_set
theorems.statement:
theorem visits_of_set (S : Finset State) :
    HasSum (fun n => (∑ s ∈ S, (stateCount n s : ℝ)) / (5 * 4 ^ n)) (S.card / 5)

theorems.name: Comparison.plane_visits
theorems.statement:
theorem plane_visits :
    HasSum (fun n => (∑ s ∈ univ.filter (fun s : State => (disagreeSet s.1).card = 2),
      (stateCount n s : ℝ)) / (5 * 4 ^ n)) 10
theorems.description: **Ten symmetric states per excursion.**

theorems.name: Comparison.line_visits
theorems.statement:
theorem line_visits :
    HasSum (fun n => (∑ s ∈ univ.filter (fun s : State => (disagreeSet s.1).card = 4),
      (stateCount n s : ℝ)) / (5 * 4 ^ n)) 5
theorems.description: **Five vector states per excursion.**

theorems.name: Comparison.place_visits
theorems.statement:
theorem place_visits :
    HasSum (fun n => (∑ s ∈ univ.filter (fun s : State => s.1 = 0),
      (stateCount n s : ℝ)) / (5 * 4 ^ n)) 1
theorems.description: **One arrival at the start's vertex per excursion: the excursion closes once.**

theorems.name: Comparison.all_visits
theorems.statement:
theorem all_visits :
    HasSum (fun n => (∑ s : State, (stateCount n s : ℝ)) / (5 * 4 ^ n)) 16
theorems.description: **All eighty: `80/5 = 16` steps per excursion**, the mean excursion of `excursion_mean` read by Kac.

theorems.name: Comparison.availableTransitions_visits
theorems.statement:
theorem availableTransitions_visits (h : Fin 5) :
    HasSum (fun n => (∑ s ∈ excursionStates h, (stateCount n s : ℝ)) / (5 * 4 ^ n)) (74 / 5)
theorems.description: **`h`'s seventy-four states are visited `74/5` times per excursion.**

theorems.name: Comparison.steps_along_lastDirection
theorems.statement:
theorem steps_along_lastDirection (h : Fin 5) :
    HasSum (fun n => (∑ s ∈ (excursionStates h).filter (fun s => s.2 ≠ h), (stateCount n s : ℝ)) /
      (5 * 4 ^ n) / 4) 3
theorems.description:
**`E_H = C_h/20 = 3`:** from each of the sixty states of the seventy-four whose last-step direction is not `h`
the continuation goes along `h` with `1/4`; per excursion, `(60/5)/4 = 3` steps along `h`.

theorems.name: Comparison.steps_along_lastDirection_count
theorems.statement:
theorem steps_along_lastDirection_count : (60 : ℚ) / 20 = 3 ∧ ((16 : ℚ) - 1) / 5 = 3 ∧
    (16 : ℚ) / 5 - 1 / 5 = 3
theorems.description: `3 = (E ℓ − 1)/5`: of the `16/5` steps along `h` per excursion, the first step gives `1/5`.

theorems.name: Comparison.ones5_mul_ones5
theorems.statement: theorem ones5_mul_ones5 : ones5 * ones5 = (5 : ℚ) • ones5

theorems.name: Comparison.lastDirectionStep_pow
theorems.statement:
theorem lastDirectionStep_pow (k : ℕ) :
    lastDirectionStep ^ k = (1 / 5 : ℚ) • ones5 + ((-1 / 4 : ℚ) ^ k) • (1 - (1 / 5 : ℚ) • ones5)

theorems.name: Comparison.lastDirection_stationary
theorems.statement: theorem lastDirection_stationary (j : Fin 5) : ∑ i, (1 / 5 : ℚ) * lastDirectionStep i j = 1 / 5
theorems.description: **The uniform law is stationary for the last-step directions.**

theorems.name: Comparison.lastDirection_cov
theorems.statement:
theorem lastDirection_cov (h : Fin 5) (k : ℕ) :
    (1 / 5 : ℚ) * (lastDirectionStep ^ k) h h - (1 / 5) ^ 2 = (4 / 25) * (-1 / 4) ^ k
theorems.description: **The steps along one line:** `Cov(X₀, X_k) = (1/5)(Hᵏ)_hh − (1/5)² = (4/25)(−1/4)ᵏ`.

theorems.name: Comparison.lastDirection_spread
theorems.statement:
theorem lastDirection_spread :
    HasSum (fun k : ℕ => (if k = 0 then (1 : ℝ) else 2) * ((4 / 25) * (-1 / 4) ^ k))
      (12 / 125)
theorems.description: **The spread of the steps along one line:** `σ² = Σ_{k ∈ ℤ} Cov(X₀, X_{|k|}) = 12/125`.

theorems.name: Comparison.marks_centred
theorems.description:
**The centred marks:** with `ℓ = P + Q + 1`, `(P − (10/16)ℓ, Q − (5/16)ℓ)` is `M (P, Q)` plus a
constant, so its covariance is `M [[84, 30], [30, 12]] Mᵀ = [[39/16, −45/32], [−45/32, 63/64]]`.

theorems.name: Comparison.marks_length
theorems.description:
With `ℓ = P + Q + 1`: `Var ℓ = Var P + Var Q + 2 Cov = 84 + 12 + 60 = 156` (`excursion_variance`), and
the means `(10, 5)` of `plane_visits`, `line_visits` give `E ℓ = 10 + 5 + 1 = 16` (`excursion_mean`).

theorems.name: Comparison.flux_count
theorems.description: **`2(m − n) = 48 = n(d − 2)`:** `m = 40` links (`card_edges`), `n = 16` two-spinor states, `d = 5`.

theorems.name: Comparison.y_pow
theorems.statement:
theorem y_pow (σ : ℤ) (hσ : σ = 1 ∨ σ = -1) (u : ℂ) (ℓ k : ℕ) :
    (-(σ : ℂ) * u ^ ℓ) ^ k = (if Even k then 1 else -(σ : ℂ)) * (u ^ k) ^ ℓ
theorems.description:
**The repeated excursion read at the powers of the last-step direction's phase:** with `σ = ±1`,
`(−σu^ℓ)ᵏ = (uᵏ)^ℓ` for even `k` and `−σ(uᵏ)^ℓ` for odd `k`.

theorems.name: Comparison.norm_four_u_pow
theorems.statement: theorem norm_four_u_pow (k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) : ‖(4 : ℂ) * (I / 4) ^ k‖ ≤ 1

theorems.name: Comparison.p_odd
theorems.statement:
theorem p_odd (k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) :
    HasSum (fun n => (signedLaw n : ℂ) * (4 * (I / 4) ^ k) ^ n)
      (-(4 * (I / 4) ^ k) ^ 4 / (16 + 3 * (4 * (I / 4) ^ k) ^ 2))
theorems.description: **`p_k` for odd `k`:** `Σ_n φ(n)(4uᵏ)ⁿ = Φ(4uᵏ) = −z⁴/(16 + 3z²)` at `z = 4uᵏ`.

theorems.name: Comparison.p_even
theorems.description: **`p_k` for even `k`:** `Σ_n f(n)(4uᵏ)ⁿ = F(4uᵏ)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.p_one
theorems.statement: theorem p_one : HasSum (fun n => -(signedLaw n : ℂ) * (4 * (I / 4)) ^ n) (1 / 13)

theorems.name: Comparison.p_two
theorems.statement: theorem p_two : HasSum (fun n => (excursionLaw n : ℂ) * (4 * (I / 4) ^ 2) ^ n) (1 / 6096)

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.rt_eq
theorems.statement: theorem rt_eq : rt = ((Real.sqrt 2 / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.halfStep_eq_expIγ
theorems.statement: theorem halfStep_eq_expIγ (k : Fin 5) : halfStep k = expIγ (Real.pi / 4) k
theorems.description: `H_k = e^{iπγ_k/4} = cos(π/4) + i sin(π/4) γ_k`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.halfStep_sq
theorems.statement: theorem halfStep_sq (k : Fin 5) : halfStep k * halfStep k = I • γ k

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.expIγ_conjTranspose
theorems.statement: theorem expIγ_conjTranspose (a : ℝ) (h : Fin 5) : (expIγ a h)ᴴ = expIγ (-a) h

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.halfStep_conjTranspose
theorems.statement: theorem halfStep_conjTranspose (k : Fin 5) : (halfStep k)ᴴ = expIγ (-(Real.pi / 4)) k

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.halfStep_unitary
theorems.statement: theorem halfStep_unitary (k : Fin 5) : halfStep k * (halfStep k)ᴴ = 1
theorems.description: `H_k` is unitary.

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.γ_mul_expIγ
theorems.statement:
theorem γ_mul_expIγ (a : ℝ) {h k : Fin 5} (hhk : h ≠ k) :
    γ h * expIγ a k = expIγ (-a) k * γ h
theorems.description: A line anticommuting with `γ_k` passes the rotation `e^{iaγ_k}` reversed.

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.expIγ_mul_γ
theorems.statement:
theorem expIγ_mul_γ (a : ℝ) {h k : Fin 5} (hhk : h ≠ k) :
    expIγ a k * γ h = γ h * expIγ (-a) k

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.halfStep_carries_clock
theorems.statement:
theorem halfStep_carries_clock {h k : Fin 5} (hhk : h ≠ k) :
    halfStep k * (I • γ h) * (halfStep k)ᴴ = γ h * γ k
theorems.description:
**the square-root step carries the own clock of `{n, h}` onto the common clock of the plane
`{h, k}`:** `H_k (iγ_h) H_k† = γ_hγ_k`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.quaternion_triple
theorems.statement:
theorem quaternion_triple {h k : Fin 5} (hhk : h ≠ k) :
    (I • γ h) * (I • γ h) = -1 ∧ (γ h * γ k) * (γ h * γ k) = -1 ∧ (I • γ k) * (I • γ k) = -1 ∧
    (I • γ h) * (γ h * γ k) = I • γ k ∧ (γ h * γ k) * (I • γ k) = I • γ h ∧
    (I • γ k) * (I • γ h) = γ h * γ k
theorems.description:
**The two clocks and the line's quarter step are one quaternion triple:**
`T₁ = iγ_h`, `T₂ = γ_hγ_k`, `T₃ = iγ_k` with `T_a² = −1`, `T₁T₂ = T₃`, `T₂T₃ = T₁`, `T₃T₁ = T₂`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.halfStep_on_singlet
theorems.statement:
theorem halfStep_on_singlet (k : Fin 5) :
    (halfStep k ⊗ₖ halfStep k) *ᵥ Ω = I • ((γ k ⊗ₖ 1) *ᵥ Ω)
theorems.description: `H_k ⊗ H_k` takes the singlet to `iℓ_k`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.halfStep_on_lastDirection
theorems.statement:
theorem halfStep_on_lastDirection (k : Fin 5) :
    (halfStep k ⊗ₖ halfStep k) *ᵥ (I • ((γ k ⊗ₖ 1) *ᵥ Ω)) = -Ω
theorems.description: `H_k ⊗ H_k` takes `iℓ_k` to `−Ω`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.one_kron_expIγ_singlet
theorems.statement:
theorem one_kron_expIγ_singlet (a : ℝ) (k : Fin 5) :
    ((1 : Matrix Four Four ℂ) ⊗ₖ expIγ a k) *ᵥ Ω = (expIγ a k ⊗ₖ (1 : Matrix Four Four ℂ)) *ᵥ Ω

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.halfStep_on_other
theorems.statement:
theorem halfStep_on_other {k t : Fin 5} (htk : t ≠ k) :
    (halfStep k ⊗ₖ halfStep k) *ᵥ ((γ t ⊗ₖ 1) *ᵥ Ω) = (γ t ⊗ₖ 1) *ᵥ Ω
theorems.description: `H_k ⊗ H_k` fixes the vector states `ℓ_t`, `t ≠ k`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.thetaD_compl
theorems.statement: theorem thetaD_compl (D : Finset (Fin 6)) : thetaD Dᶜ = -thetaD D

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.keptAt_compl
theorems.statement:
theorem keptAt_compl (D : Finset (Fin 6)) (X : Matrix (Fin 6) (Fin 6) ℝ) :
    KeptAt Dᶜ X ↔ KeptAt D X

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.centralAt_compl
theorems.statement:
theorem centralAt_compl (D : Finset (Fin 6)) (X : Matrix (Fin 6) (Fin 6) ℝ) :
    CentralAt Dᶜ X ↔ CentralAt D X

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.unitTurn_comm_thetaD
theorems.statement:
theorem unitTurn_comm_thetaD (D : Finset (Fin 6)) (b c : Fin 6) (h : b ∈ D ↔ c ∈ D) :
    unitTurn b c * thetaD D = thetaD D * unitTurn b c

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.card_of_central
theorems.statement:
theorem card_of_central {D : Finset (Fin 6)} {X : Matrix (Fin 6) (Fin 6) ℝ} (hX : CentralAt D X)
    (hne : X ≠ 0) : D.card = 2 ∨ D.card = 4
theorems.description:
**Only a part of two directions carries a clock:** a nonzero central kept rotation forces `|D| = 2`
or `|D| = 4`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.unitTurn_mul_apply
theorems.statement:
theorem unitTurn_mul_apply {n : ℕ} (a b : Fin n) (Y : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (i j : Fin n) :
    (unitTurn a b * Y) i j = (if i = a then Y b j else 0) - (if i = b then Y a j else 0)

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.mul_unitTurn_apply
theorems.statement:
theorem mul_unitTurn_apply {n : ℕ} (a b : Fin n) (Y : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (i j : Fin n) :
    (Y * unitTurn a b) i j = (if j = b then Y i a else 0) - (if j = a then Y i b else 0)

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.unitTurn_central_pair
theorems.statement:
theorem unitTurn_central_pair {a b : Fin 6} (hab : a ≠ b) :
    CentralAt {a, b} (unitTurn a b)
theorems.description: At a part of two directions `{a, b}` the unit rotation of that plane is a central kept rotation.

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.central_kept_iff_card
theorems.statement:
theorem central_kept_iff_card (D : Finset (Fin 6)) :
    (∃ X, CentralAt D X ∧ X ≠ 0) ↔ D.card = 2 ∨ D.card = 4
theorems.description: **The kept rotations of a division have a nonzero central element exactly at type `2¦4`.**

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.no_clock_one_five
theorems.statement:
theorem no_clock_one_five (D : Finset (Fin 6)) (hD : D.card = 1) (X : Matrix (Fin 6) (Fin 6) ℝ)
    (hX : CentralAt D X) : X = 0
theorems.description:
**The last-step direction alone has no clock:** a division of type `1¦5` (one direction divided) keeps
`so(5)`, whose centre is zero.

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.no_clock_zero_three
theorems.statement:
theorem no_clock_zero_three (D : Finset (Fin 6)) (hD : D.card = 0 ∨ D.card = 3)
    (X : Matrix (Fin 6) (Fin 6) ℝ) (hX : CentralAt D X) : X = 0
theorems.description: The types `0¦6` and `3¦3` have no clock either.

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.det_conj_rect
theorems.statement:
theorem det_conj_rect {m n : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n]
    (e : n ≃ m) (T : Matrix m n ℂ) (M : Matrix m m ℂ) :
    (Tᴴ * M * T).det = (Tᴴ * T).det * M.det
theorems.description: `det(T†MT) = det(T†T) det M` when `T` has as many rows as columns.

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.Wc_apply
theorems.statement:
theorem Wc_apply (x S : Fin 16) :
    Wc x S = (1 / 4 : ℂ) * (-1) ^ (disagreeSet x ∩ disagreeSet S).card

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.charTable_symm
theorems.statement: theorem charTable_symm : charTableᵀ = charTable

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.Wc_transpose
theorems.statement: theorem Wc_transpose : Wcᵀ = Wc

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.Wc_conjTranspose
theorems.statement: theorem Wc_conjTranspose : Wcᴴ = Wc

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.Wc_orth
theorems.statement: theorem Wc_orth : Wc * Wc = 1

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.Hp_unitary
theorems.statement: theorem Hp_unitary : Hpᴴ * Hp = 1

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.Hp_L
theorems.statement: theorem Hp_L : Hpᴴ * L * Hp = Matrix.diagonal fun k => ((Lvalue k : ℤ) : ℂ)

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.A_eq
theorems.statement: theorem A_eq : A16 = Wc * Matrix.diagonal (fun l => ((charValue l : ℤ) : ℂ)) * Wc

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.Tk_unitary
theorems.statement: theorem Tk_unitary : Tkᴴ * Tk = 1
theorems.description: **`T` is unitary.**

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.Tk_kernel
theorems.statement: theorem Tk_kernel : Tkᴴ * disagreement * Tk = (5 : ℂ) • 1 - A16
theorems.description: **The disagreement is the transitions' operator:** `T†(6I − L)T = 5I − A`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.chi_eq
theorems.statement: theorem chi_eq (u : ℂ) (hu : u ≠ 0) : chi u = (1 - u) * (1 - 4 * u) / u

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.two_card
theorems.statement: theorem two_card : Fintype.card Two = Fintype.card (Fin 16)

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.det_gap
theorems.statement: theorem det_gap (c : ℂ) : (disagreement + c • 1).det = c * (c + 4) ^ 10 * (c + 8) ^ 5

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.law_bass_form
theorems.statement:
theorem law_bass_form (u : ℂ) :
    (1 - u • stepOp transitionMat).det =
