      (1 - u ^ 2) ^ 24 * ((1 + 4 * u ^ 2) • (1 : Matrix (Fin 16) (Fin 16) ℂ) - u • A16).det
theorems.description: **The Bass form:** `det(I − uB) = (1 − u²)²⁴ det[(1 + 4u²)I − uA]`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.law_gap
theorems.statement:
theorem law_gap (u : ℂ) (hu : u ≠ 0) :
    (1 - u • stepOp transitionMat).det = (1 - u ^ 2) ^ 24 * u ^ 16 * (disagreement + chi u • 1).det
theorems.description:
**The law is the comparison with one movable gap:**
`det(I − uB) = (1 − u²)²⁴ u¹⁶ det[(6I − L) + χ(u)I]`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.kN_gap
theorems.statement: theorem kN_gap (N u : ℂ) (hu : u ≠ 0) : WholePicture.kN N u = u * (2 * N + chi u)
theorems.description: **The grade factors read the gap:** `k_N(u) = u(2N + χ(u))`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.chi_quarters
theorems.statement:
theorem chi_quarters :
    chi (1 / 4) = 0 ∧ chi (I / 4) = -5 - 3 * I ∧ chi (-1 / 4) = -10 ∧ chi (-I / 4) = -5 + 3 * I
theorems.description: **The gap at the four points `u = i^d/4`:** `χ(i^k/4) = 0, −5 − 3i, −10, −5 + 3i`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.kN_plane_gap
theorems.statement:
theorem kN_plane_gap (N : ℂ) :
    chi (-1 / 4) = -10 ∧ WholePicture.kN N (-1 / 4) = (-1 / 4) * (2 * N + chi (-1 / 4)) ∧
      WholePicture.kN N (-1 / 4) = (5 - N) / 2

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.transmission_echo
theorems.statement:
theorem transmission_echo :
    1 / WholePicture.kR 0 (-1 / 4) = 2 / 5 ∧
      WholePicture.kR 2 (-1 / 4) / WholePicture.kR 0 (-1 / 4) = 3 / 5 ∧
      1 / WholePicture.kR 2 (-1 / 4) = 2 / 3 ∧
      WholePicture.kR 4 (-1 / 4) / WholePicture.kR 2 (-1 / 4) = 1 / 3
theorems.description:
**The transmission and the reflection at a plane and at a line:** `t = 1/k₀ = 2/5`, `e = k₂/k₀ = 3/5`,
`t_ℓ = 1/k₂ = 2/3`, `e_ℓ = k₄/k₂ = 1/3`, all at `u = −1/4`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.kappa_gap_values
theorems.description:
`κ(χ) = 2/[(χ + 5)² − 5]²` is `1/200` at the singlet and the plane (`χ = 0, −10`) and `1/98` at the
last-step direction and colour (`χ = −5 ∓ 3i`).

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.own_transformation
theorems.statement:
theorem own_transformation {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] (A : Matrix n n ℂ) (u v : ℂ)
    (hu : u ≠ 0) (hv : v ≠ 0) :
    (1 / v) • ((1 + 4 * v ^ 2) • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) - v • A) =
      (1 / u) • ((1 + 4 * u ^ 2) • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) - u • A) + (chi v - chi u) • 1
theorems.description:
**The law's own transformation is a shift of the gap:**
`K(v)/v = K(u)/u + [χ(v) − χ(u)] I` for `K(u) = (1 + 4u²) − uA` and any operator `A`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.hasDerivAt_div_lapse
theorems.statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_div_lapse (E N : ℝ) (hN : N ≠ 0) :
    HasDerivAt (fun N' : ℝ => E / N') (-(E / N ^ 2)) N
theorems.description: `d/dN (E/N) = −E/N²`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.lapse_partials
theorems.statement:
theorem lapse_partials (k : ℝ → F) (k' : F) (E N : ℝ) (hN : N ≠ 0)
    (hk : HasDerivAt k k' (E / N)) :
    HasDerivAt (fun N' => k (E / N')) (-(E / N ^ 2) • k') N ∧
      HasDerivAt (fun E' => k (E' / N)) ((1 / N) • k') E ∧
      N • (-(E / N ^ 2) • k') = -(E • ((1 / N) • k'))
theorems.description:
**The lapse's two partial derivatives:** for `K(E, N) = k(E/N)`,
`∂_N K = −(E/N²) k′(E/N)`, `∂_E K = (1/N) k′(E/N)`, and `N ∂_N K = −E ∂_E K`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.lapse_zero_scales
theorems.statement:
theorem lapse_zero_scales {M : Type*} (k : ℝ → M) (P : M → Prop) (N : ℝ) (hN : N ≠ 0) (E : ℝ) :
    P (k (E / N)) ↔ ∃ E₁, P (k (E₁ / 1)) ∧ E = N * E₁
theorems.description:
**The zeros move in proportion:** `E` is a zero of `K(·, N)` exactly when `E = N E₁` for a zero
`E₁` of `K(·, 1)`; any property of the kernel (singular, a given null vector) is read at `E/N`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.lapse_rate
theorems.statement: theorem lapse_rate (E₁ : ℝ) : HasDerivAt (fun N : ℝ => N * E₁) E₁ 1
theorems.description: `E_X(N) = N E_X(1)` gives `dE_X/dN = E_X(1)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.lapse_displacement
theorems.statement:
theorem lapse_displacement (k : ℝ → F) (k' : F) (E : ℝ) (hk : HasDerivAt k k' E)
    (pair : F →ₗ[ℝ] ℂ) (hs : pair k' ≠ 0) :
    HasDerivAt (fun N' : ℝ => k (E / N')) (-E • k') 1 ∧
      HasDerivAt (fun E' : ℝ => k (E' / 1)) k' E ∧
      -(pair (-E • k')) / pair k' = E
theorems.description:
**The lapse couples to the rest energy:** at a simple zero, the displacement of the zero by the
lapse, `−λ(∂_N K)/λ(∂_E K)` at `N = 1` (Prop. S57 with the source `N`), is `E` itself.

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.LOmega_inner
theorems.statement: theorem LOmega_inner : star Ω ⬝ᵥ (L *ᵥ Ω) = 6

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.chi_near_zero
theorems.statement:
theorem chi_near_zero (δ : ℂ) (hδ : δ ≠ 1 / 4) :
    chi (1 / 4 - δ) = 12 * δ + 16 * δ ^ 2 / (1 / 4 - δ)
theorems.description: **Near the one zero:** `χ(1/4 − δ) = 12δ + 16δ²/(1/4 − δ)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.chi_mass_shell
theorems.description:
**The gap is half the mass squared:** at `u = 1/4 − ε²m²/24`,
`χ = ε²m²/2 + 16δ²/(1/4 − δ)` with `δ = ε²m²/24`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.chi_near_zero_bound
theorems.description: The remainder is of second order: `0 ≤ χ(1/4 − δ) − 12δ ≤ 128δ²` for real `0 ≤ δ ≤ 1/8`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.lawPoly_eq
theorems.statement: theorem lawPoly_eq : WholePicture.lawPoly = lawD

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.one_arc_explicit
theorems.statement:
theorem one_arc_explicit (p q : State) (harc : Continues q p) (θ u : ℂ) :
    (1 - u • WholePicture.Bmark p q (Complex.exp (-Complex.I * θ))).det =
      lawD.eval u + (Complex.exp (-Complex.I * θ) - 1) * u * (derivative lawD).eval u / 320
theorems.description:
**Formula (29), one arc marked exactly:** at every one of the 320 arcs `q → p`,
`D_θ(u) = D(u) + (e^{−iθ} − 1) u D′(u)/320`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.Nucleon.permZ_mul
theorems.statement: theorem permZ_mul (π σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3)) : permZ π * permZ σ = permZ (π * σ)

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.Nucleon.casimirZ
theorems.statement: theorem casimirZ : sz2Z * sz2Z + 2 • (spZ * smZ + smZ * spZ) = 3 • 1 + 4 • transZ
theorems.description: **`4S² = 3 + 4T`** on the spins of three lines (Dirac's exchange identity summed).

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.Nucleon.transZ_sq
theorems.statement: theorem transZ_sq : transZ * transZ = 3 • transZ
theorems.description: **`T² = 3T`**: three spins one half carry no totally antisymmetric part.

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.Nucleon.perm_transZ
theorems.statement: theorem perm_transZ : ∀ π : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3), permZ π * transZ = transZ * permZ π

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.Nucleon.perm_d2Z
theorems.statement: theorem perm_d2Z : ∀ π : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3), permZ π * d2Z = d2Z * permZ π

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.Nucleon.trans_d2Z
theorems.statement: theorem trans_d2Z : transZ * d2Z = d2Z * transZ

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.Nucleon.doubletZ
theorems.statement: theorem doubletZ : c3Z * (d2Z * d2Z) = 2 • (c3Z * d2Z)
theorems.description: **`(3 − T)(S_z² − 1/4) = 0`**, doubled: on spin one half `S_z = ±1/2`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.Nucleon.perm_c3Z
theorems.statement: theorem perm_c3Z : ∀ π : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3), permZ π * c3Z = c3Z * permZ π

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.Nucleon.c3_d2Z
theorems.statement: theorem c3_d2Z : c3Z * d2Z = d2Z * c3Z

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.Nucleon.c3_sqZ
theorems.statement: theorem c3_sqZ : c3Z * c3Z = 3 • c3Z

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.Nucleon.trans_c3Z
theorems.statement: theorem trans_c3Z : transZ * c3Z = 0

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.Nucleon.sum_trace_one
theorems.statement: theorem sum_trace_one : (∑ π : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3), (permZ π).trace * (permZ π).trace) = 120

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.Nucleon.sum_trace_PN
theorems.statement:
theorem sum_trace_PN :
    (∑ π : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3), (permZ π * c3Z).trace * (permZ π).trace) = 72

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.Nucleon.sum_trace_Pp
theorems.statement:
theorem sum_trace_Pp :
    (∑ π : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3), (permZ π * (c3Z * d2Z)).trace * (permZ π * d2Z).trace) = 72

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.Nucleon.sum_trace_charge
theorems.statement:
theorem sum_trace_charge :
    (∑ π : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3),
      (permZ π * (c3Z * d2Z)).trace * (permZ π * (d2Z * d2Z)).trace) = 144

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.Nucleon.sum_trace_axial
theorems.statement:
theorem sum_trace_axial :
    (∑ r : Fin 3, ∑ π : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3),
      (permZ π * (c3Z * d2Z * szZ r)).trace * (permZ π * (d2Z * szZ r)).trace) = 120

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.Nucleon.trace_toQ
theorems.statement: theorem trace_toQ (M : Matrix Sp Sp ℤ) : (toQ M).trace = (M.trace : ℚ)

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.Nucleon.R_mul
theorems.statement: theorem R_mul (π σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3)) : R π * R σ = R (π * σ)

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.Nucleon.C3_eq
theorems.statement: theorem C3_eq : C3 = (3 : ℚ) • 1 - T

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.Nucleon.Dq_eq
theorems.statement: theorem Dq_eq : Dq = (1 / 2 : ℚ) • toQ d2Z

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.Nucleon.S2_eq
theorems.statement: theorem S2_eq : S2 = (3 / 4 : ℚ) • 1 + T

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.Nucleon.T_sq

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.Nucleon.R_T
theorems.statement: theorem R_T (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3)) : R π * T = T * R π

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.Nucleon.R_C3
theorems.statement: theorem R_C3 (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3)) : R π * C3 = C3 * R π

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.Nucleon.R_Dq
theorems.statement: theorem R_Dq (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3)) : R π * Dq = Dq * R π

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.Nucleon.R_S2
theorems.statement: theorem R_S2 (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3)) : R π * S2 = S2 * R π

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.Nucleon.C3_sq
theorems.statement: theorem C3_sq : C3 * C3 = (3 : ℚ) • C3

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.Nucleon.T_C3
theorems.statement: theorem T_C3 : T * C3 = 0

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.Nucleon.S2_C3
theorems.statement: theorem S2_C3 : S2 * C3 = (3 / 4 : ℚ) • C3

theorems.statement: theorem C3_Dq_sq : C3 * (Dq * Dq) = C3 * Dq

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.Nucleon.U_mul
theorems.statement: theorem U_mul (π σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3)) : U π * U σ = U (π * σ)

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.Nucleon.card_perm3
theorems.statement: theorem card_perm3 : (Finset.univ : Finset (Equiv.Perm (Fin 3))).card = 6

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.Nucleon.Psym_idem
theorems.statement: theorem Psym_idem : Psym * Psym = Psym
theorems.description: **`P_sym` is a projector.**

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.Nucleon.Psym_kron
theorems.statement:
theorem Psym_kron (X Y : Matrix Sp Sp ℚ) :
    Psym * (X ⊗ₖ Y) = (1 / 6 : ℚ) • ∑ π, (R π * X) ⊗ₖ (R π * Y)
theorems.description: `P_sym (X ⊗ Y) = (1/6) Σ_π (R_π X) ⊗ (R_π Y)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.Nucleon.trace_Psym_kron
theorems.statement:
theorem trace_Psym_kron (X Y : Matrix Sp Sp ℚ) :
    (Psym * (X ⊗ₖ Y)).trace = (1 / 6 : ℚ) * ∑ π, (R π * X).trace * (R π * Y).trace

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.Nucleon.kron_comm_Psym
theorems.statement:
theorem kron_comm_Psym (X Y : Matrix Sp Sp ℚ) (hX : ∀ π, R π * X = X * R π)
    (hY : ∀ π, R π * Y = Y * R π) : (X ⊗ₖ Y) * Psym = Psym * (X ⊗ₖ Y)
theorems.description: `X ⊗ Y` commutes with `P_sym` when `X` and `Y` commute with every `R_π`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.Nucleon.Psym_swap
theorems.statement:
theorem Psym_swap (τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3)) (hτ : τ * τ = 1) :
    Psym * (R τ ⊗ₖ (1 : Matrix Sp Sp ℚ)) = Psym * ((1 : Matrix Sp Sp ℚ) ⊗ₖ R τ)
theorems.description:
**The swaps of two lines read the same on the spins as on the isospins of a symmetric state:**
`P_sym (R_τ ⊗ 1) = P_sym (1 ⊗ R_τ)` for `τ² = 1`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.Nucleon.Psym_T
theorems.statement: theorem Psym_T : Psym * (T ⊗ₖ (1 : Matrix Sp Sp ℚ)) = Psym * ((1 : Matrix Sp Sp ℚ) ⊗ₖ T)

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.Nucleon.sub_kron

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.Nucleon.kron_sub
theorems.statement: theorem kron_sub (A B C : Matrix Sp Sp ℚ) : C ⊗ₖ (A - B) = C ⊗ₖ A - C ⊗ₖ B

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.Nucleon.Psym_C3

theorems.statement:
theorem kron_one_mul (A B : Matrix Sp Sp ℚ) :
    (A ⊗ₖ (1 : Matrix Sp Sp ℚ)) * (B ⊗ₖ (1 : Matrix Sp Sp ℚ)) = (A * B) ⊗ₖ (1 : Matrix Sp Sp ℚ)

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.Nucleon.PN_eq

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.Nucleon.C3_comm_Psym

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.det_one_sub_signed_involution
theorems.statement:
theorem det_one_sub_signed_involution {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (Γ S : Matrix V V ℂ) (hΓ : Γ * Γ = 1) (hS : S * S = 1) (hSΓ : S * Γ * S = -Γ)
    (m : ℕ) (hV : Fintype.card V = 2 * m) (u : ℂ) : (1 - u • Γ).det = (1 - u ^ 2) ^ m
theorems.description: **An involution reversed by a sign has `det(1 − uΓ) = (1 − u²)^m` on `2m` states.**

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.sheetSign_sq
theorems.statement: theorem sheetSign_sq : sheetSign (N := N) * sheetSign = 1

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.transitionN_sheet
theorems.statement: theorem transitionN_sheet (t : Fin 5) (x : GroupsContinuumLaw.VN N) : (GroupsContinuumLaw.transitionN t x).2 = !x.2

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.det_GammaN
theorems.statement:
theorem det_GammaN (t : Fin 5) (u : ℂ) :
    (1 - u • GroupsContinuumLaw.GammaN (N := N) t).det = (1 - u ^ 2) ^ (N ^ 4)
theorems.description: **Every transition of the chart:** `det(1 − uΓ_t) = (1 − u²)^{N⁴}`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.det_vertex_poly
theorems.statement:
theorem det_vertex_poly {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] (A : Matrix V V ℂ) (u : ℂ) :
    ((1 + 4 * u ^ 2) • (1 : Matrix V V ℂ) - u • A).det =
      (((1 + 4 * (X : ℂ[X]) ^ 2) • (1 : Matrix V V ℂ[X]) - (X : ℂ[X]) • A.map C).det).eval u
theorems.description: `det((1 + 4u²) − uA)` is a polynomial in `u`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.chart_counts
theorems.statement:
theorem chart_counts :
    Fintype.card (GroupsContinuumLaw.VN N) = 2 * N ^ 4 ∧ Fintype.card (GroupsContinuumLaw.ZN N × Fin 5) = 5 * N ^ 4
theorems.description:
The vertices and the links of the chart: `V = 2N⁴`, `E = 5N⁴` (each link has one end on the sheet
`0` and a direction).

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.chart_three
theorems.statement:
theorem chart_three :
    Fintype.card (GroupsContinuumLaw.VN 3) = 162 ∧ Fintype.card (GroupsContinuumLaw.ZN 3 × Fin 5) = 405
theorems.description: The script's chart, `N = 3`: `162` vertices and `405` links.

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.chart_bass
theorems.statement:
theorem chart_bass (u : ℂ) :
    (1 - u • GroupsContinuumLaw.chartStep (N := N)).det =
      (1 - u ^ 2) ^ (3 * N ^ 4) *
        ((1 + 4 * u ^ 2) • (1 : Matrix (GroupsContinuumLaw.VN N) (GroupsContinuumLaw.VN N) ℂ) -
          u • ∑ t, GroupsContinuumLaw.GammaN (N := N) t).det
theorems.description:
**The Bass identity on the law's own chart:**
`det(I − uB_chart) = (1 − u²)^{E − V} det[(1 + 4u²)I − uA_chart]`, `E − V = 3N⁴`, for every `u`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.normSq_F
theorems.statement:
theorem normSq_F (x : Fin 5 → ℝ) :
    Complex.normSq (∑ t, Complex.exp ((x t : ℂ) * Complex.I)) =
      (∑ t, Real.cos (x t)) ^ 2 + (∑ t, Real.sin (x t)) ^ 2
theorems.description: `|F|² = (Σ cos x_t)² + (Σ sin x_t)²` for `F = Σ_t e^{i x_t}`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.hop_sum
theorems.statement:
theorem hop_sum (x : Fin 5 → ℝ) :
    25 - ((∑ t, Real.cos (x t)) ^ 2 + (∑ t, Real.sin (x t)) ^ 2) =
      ∑ s, ∑ t, (if s = t then 0 else 1 - Real.cos (x s - x t))
theorems.description: **The hop sum:** `25 − |F|² = Σ_{s ≠ t} [1 − cos(x_s − x_t)]`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.hop_sum_F
theorems.statement:
theorem hop_sum_F (x : Fin 5 → ℝ) :
    25 - Complex.normSq (∑ t, Complex.exp ((x t : ℂ) * Complex.I)) =
      ∑ s, ∑ t, (if s = t then 0 else 1 - Real.cos (x s - x t))
theorems.description: **`25 − |F(k)|² = Σ_{hops} (1 − cos k·h)`** with `x_t = k·v_t`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.hop_sum_lam
theorems.statement:
theorem hop_sum_lam (p : Fin 5 → ℝ) :
    (25 - ((∑ t, Real.cos (p t)) ^ 2 + (∑ t, Real.sin (p t)) ^ 2)) / 5 = GroupsContinuumLaw.lam 1 p
theorems.description: The hop sum over five is `5 λ₁`, symbol at unit step.

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.chart_symbol_second_order
theorems.statement:
theorem chart_symbol_second_order (p : Fin 5 → ℝ) (hp : ∑ i, p i = 0) :
    0 ≤ GroupsContinuumLaw.norm2 p - (25 - ((∑ t, Real.cos (p t)) ^ 2 + (∑ t, Real.sin (p t)) ^ 2)) / 5 ∧
      GroupsContinuumLaw.norm2 p - (25 - ((∑ t, Real.cos (p t)) ^ 2 + (∑ t, Real.sin (p t)) ^ 2)) / 5 ≤
        GroupsContinuumLaw.norm2 p ^ 2 / 6
theorems.description:
**`Q(k) = M² + |k|² + O(|k|⁴)` in every direction:** `0 ≤ |k|² − (25 − |F|²)/5 ≤ |k|⁴/6` for
`k` in the chart's four directions (`Σ_t k·v_t = 0`).

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.dot_vline
theorems.statement: theorem dot_vline (a b : Fin 5) : vline a ⬝ᵥ vline b = (if a = b then 1 else 0) - 1 / 5

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.vline_self
theorems.statement: theorem vline_self (h : Fin 5) : vline h ⬝ᵥ vline h = 4 / 5

theorems.statement:
theorem hop_dot_vline (h t : Fin 5) :

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.pvec_perp
theorems.statement: theorem pvec_perp (h t : Fin 5) : pvec h t ⬝ᵥ vline h = 0
theorems.description: `p_t ⊥ v_h`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.hop_projects
theorems.statement: theorem hop_projects (h s t : Fin 5) : projOff h (vline s - vline t) = pvec h s - pvec h t
theorems.description: **The hops project onto the differences of the `p_t`:** `P(v_s − v_t) = p_s − p_t`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.pvec_explicit
theorems.statement:
theorem pvec_explicit (h t : Fin 5) (ht : t ≠ h) :
    pvec h t = (Pi.single t 1 - Pi.single h 1) + (5 / 4 : ℚ) • vline h
theorems.description: `p_t = e_t − e_h + (5/4) v_h` for `t ≠ h`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.pvec_gram
theorems.statement:
theorem pvec_gram (h s t : Fin 5) (hs : s ≠ h) (ht : t ≠ h) :
    pvec h s ⬝ᵥ pvec h t = (if s = t then 1 else 0) - 1 / 4
theorems.description: **The Gram matrix of the projected hops:** `p_s·p_t = δ_st − 1/4` for `s, t ≠ h`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.pvec_sum
theorems.statement: theorem pvec_sum (h : Fin 5) : ∑ t, pvec h t = 0
theorems.description: The projected hops sum to zero.

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.gram_det
theorems.description: **The Gram determinant of three projected hops is `1/4`.**

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.gram_three
theorems.statement:
theorem gram_three (h a b c : Fin 5) (ha : a ≠ h) (hb : b ≠ h) (hc : c ≠ h) (hab : a ≠ b)
    (hac : a ≠ c) (hbc : b ≠ c) :
    (Matrix.of fun i j : Fin 3 => pvec h (![a, b, c] i) ⬝ᵥ pvec h (![a, b, c] j)) =
      !![3 / 4, -1 / 4, -1 / 4; -1 / 4, 3 / 4, -1 / 4; -1 / 4, -1 / 4, 3 / 4]
theorems.description: The Gram matrix of `p_a, p_b, p_c` for three distinct lines other than `h`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.cell_volume
theorems.statement: theorem cell_volume : Real.sqrt (1 / 4) = 1 / 2
theorems.description: **The cell across `v_h` has volume `V₃ = √(1/4) = 1/2`.**

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.schur_symbol
theorems.description:
**The two-sheet kernel:** `det [[a, −uF], [−uF̄, a]] = a² − u²|F|²`, and its Schur complement
`a − u²|F|²/a = ρQ`, `ρ = 5u²/a`, `Q = M² + (25 − |F|²)/5`, `M² = ((1/u + 4u)² − 25)/5 = χ(χ + 10)/5`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.continuation_lastDirection
theorems.statement:
theorem continuation_lastDirection (ω : ℝ) :
    (Real.exp (-(2 * ω / Real.sqrt 5)) + 4 * Real.exp (ω / (2 * Real.sqrt 5))) *
        (Real.exp (2 * ω / Real.sqrt 5) + 4 * Real.exp (-(ω / (2 * Real.sqrt 5)))) =
      17 + 8 * Real.cosh (Real.sqrt 5 * ω / 2)
theorems.description:
**Along the last-step direction's direction:** `k = iωv̂_h` gives `k·v_h = 2iω/√5`, `k·v_t = −iω/(2√5)`, and
`F(k)F(−k) = (e^{−2ω/√5} + 4e^{ω/(2√5)})(e^{2ω/√5} + 4e^{−ω/(2√5)}) = 17 + 8cosh(√5ω/2)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.rest_on_chart
theorems.statement:
theorem rest_on_chart (M2 ω : ℝ) :
    M2 + (25 - (17 + 8 * Real.cosh (Real.sqrt 5 * ω / 2))) / 5 = 0 ↔
      Real.cosh (Real.sqrt 5 * ω / 2) = 1 + 5 * M2 / 8
theorems.description:
**The rest pole along the last-step direction:** `Q(iωv̂_h) = M² + (25 − |F|²)/5 = 0` exactly when
`cosh(√5ω/2) = 1 + 5M²/8`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.exp_sub_one_le
theorems.statement: theorem exp_sub_one_le (t : ℝ) : Real.exp t - 1 ≤ t * Real.exp t

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.one_add_sq_half_le_cosh
theorems.statement: theorem one_add_sq_half_le_cosh (x : ℝ) (hx : 0 ≤ x) : 1 + x ^ 2 / 2 ≤ Real.cosh x
theorems.description: `cosh x ≥ 1 + x²/2` for `x ≥ 0`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.rest_frequency
theorems.statement:
theorem rest_frequency (M ω : ℝ) (hM : 0 < M) (hω : 0 ≤ ω)
    (h : Real.cosh (Real.sqrt 5 * ω / 2) = 1 + 5 * M ^ 2 / 8) :
    ω ≤ M ∧ M - ω ≤ 5 / 8 * Real.exp (5 * M ^ 2 / 8) * M ^ 3
theorems.description:
**A line at rest along the last-step direction turns at its mass:** if `cosh(√5ω/2) = 1 + 5M²/8` with
`ω ≥ 0` and `M > 0`, then `ω ≤ M` and `M − ω ≤ (5/8)e^{5M²/8}M³`: `ω = M + O(M³)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.wS_ne_zero
theorems.statement: theorem wS_ne_zero (S : Finset (Fin 6)) : wS S ≠ 0

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.eS_line

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.excursion_moment_values

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.clock_spread_is_excursion
theorems.statement:
theorem clock_spread_is_excursion :
    (1 / 10) * ∑ i, clockGap sLastDirectionSinglet i ^ 2 - ((1 / 10) * ∑ i, clockGap sLastDirectionSinglet i) ^ 2 =
        ((excursionVarP - excursionVarQ) ^ 2 + 4 * excursionCov ^ 2) / (3 * excursionEl) ^ 2 ∧
      (1 / 10) * ∑ i, clockGap sLastDirectionSinglet i = (excursionVarP + excursionVarQ) / (3 * excursionEl) ∧
      ((excursionVarP - excursionVarQ) ^ 2 + 4 * excursionCov ^ 2) / (3 * excursionEl) ^ 2 = 61 / 16
theorems.description:
**(70) The clock's spread and mean are the excursion's:**
`Var D = [(Var P − Var Q)² + 4Cov²]/(3Eℓ)² = 61/16`, `E_D = (Var P + Var Q)/(3Eℓ) = 2`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.hOv_is_tilt

theorems.description: The clock's `h` is that overlap at the clock's own rate `ν = 9/4000`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.exp_sub_one_le'
theorems.statement: theorem exp_sub_one_le' (t : ℝ) : Real.exp t - 1 ≤ t * Real.exp t

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.cosh_sub_one_bounds

theorems.description: `y²/2 ≤ cosh y − 1 ≤ (y²/2) e^{y²/2}`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.clockGap_range
theorems.statement: theorem clockGap_range (i : Fin 10) : 1 / 4 ≤ clockGap sLastDirectionSinglet i ∧ clockGap sLastDirectionSinglet i ≤ 19 / 4
theorems.description: The ten gaps lie in `[1/4, 19/4]`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.clockPair_cosh

theorem clockPair_cosh (ν : ℝ) :

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.clock_pair_variance
theorems.statement:
theorem clock_pair_variance :
    (1 / 100) * ∑ i, ∑ j, (clockGap sLastDirectionSinglet j - clockGap sLastDirectionSinglet i) ^ 2 / 2 = 61 / 16

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.clock_pair_bounds
theorems.statement:
theorem clock_pair_bounds (ν : ℝ) :
    61 / 16 * ν ^ 2 ≤ clockPair ν - 1 ∧ clockPair ν - 1 ≤ 61 / 16 * ν ^ 2 * Real.exp (81 * ν ^ 2 / 8)
theorems.description:
**The clock's two tilts, bounded at every `ν`:**
`(61/16)ν² ≤ P(ν) − 1 ≤ (61/16)ν² e^{81ν²/8}`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.clock_sweep_limit
theorems.statement:
theorem clock_sweep_limit :
    Tendsto (fun ν : ℝ => -Real.log (clockTilt ν) / ν ^ 2) (𝓝[≠] 0) (𝓝 (3 / 2 * (61 / 16)))
theorems.description: **(70) The clock as its tilt varies:** `−log h(ν)/ν² → (3/2) Var D = (3/2)(61/16)` as `ν → 0`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.detF0_is_transmission
theorems.statement:
theorem detF0_is_transmission :

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.tS_hn
theorems.statement: theorem tS_hn : tS sLastDirectionSinglet = 2 / 5

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.W_minor

    (Matrix.diagonal fun _ : sC => tS sLastDirectionSinglet ^ 16 * (295 / 296 : ℝ) ^ 3).det =
      (2 / 5 : ℝ) ^ 48 * (295 / 296) ^ 9
theorems.description:
**(73) Gravity's amplitude as the minor on the word `C`:**
`W = det_C(t@{h,n}^{Eℓ} η^{E_H}) = (2/5)⁴⁸(295/296)⁹`, one typical excursion (`Eℓ = 16` steps, `E_H = 3`
transitions along the last-step direction) on each of the three lines outside the plane.

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.real_sum_plane
theorems.statement:
theorem real_sum_plane (f : Finset (Fin 5) → ℤ) :

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.total_weight
theorems.statement: theorem total_weight (p q : ℝ) : ∑ S ∈ evenSets, wt p q S = 10 * p + 5 * q

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.ex_N
theorems.statement: theorem ex_N (p q : ℝ) : ex p q gradeN = (20 * p + 20 * q) / (10 * p + 5 * q)

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.ex_N2
theorems.statement:
theorem ex_N2 (p q : ℝ) :
    ex p q (fun S => gradeN S * gradeN S) = (40 * p + 80 * q) / (10 * p + 5 * q)

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.varN_eq
theorems.statement:
theorem varN_eq (p q : ℝ) (hp : 0 < p) (hq : 0 < q) :
    cv p q gradeN gradeN = 8 * p * q / (2 * p + q) ^ 2

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.ex_hh
theorems.statement:
theorem ex_hh (p q : ℝ) (a b : Fin 5) :
    ex p q (fun S => hl a S * hl b S) =
      (p * (if a = b then 60 else -15) + q * (if a = b then 20 else -5)) /
        (16 * (10 * p + 5 * q))

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.ex_Nhh
theorems.statement:
theorem ex_Nhh (p q : ℝ) (a b : Fin 5) :
    ex p q (fun S => gradeN S * (hl a S * hl b S)) =
      (p * (if a = b then 120 else -30) + q * (if a = b then 80 else -20)) /
        (16 * (10 * p + 5 * q))

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.sweep_lines
theorems.statement:
theorem sweep_lines (p q : ℝ) (hp : 0 < p) (hq : 0 < q) (a b : Fin 5) :
    cv p q gradeN (fun S => hl a S * hl b S) =
      CW p q / 72 * (1 - 5 * (if a = b then 1 else 0))
theorems.description: **One line against one line:** `Cov(N, H_aH_b) = (C_W/72)(1 − 5δ_ab)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.ex_sum
theorems.statement:
theorem ex_sum {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (p q : ℝ) (g : ι → Finset (Fin 5) → ℝ) :
    ex p q (fun S => ∑ i ∈ s, g i S) = ∑ i ∈ s, ex p q (g i)

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.cv_sum
theorems.statement:
theorem cv_sum {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (p q : ℝ) (f : Finset (Fin 5) → ℝ)
    (g : ι → Finset (Fin 5) → ℝ) :
    cv p q f (fun S => ∑ i ∈ s, g i S) = ∑ i ∈ s, cv p q f (g i)

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.HD_eq
theorems.statement: theorem HD_eq (D S : Finset (Fin 5)) : HD D S = ∑ a ∈ D, hl a S

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.trace_projD_mul
theorems.statement:
theorem trace_projD_mul (D E : Finset (Fin 5)) :
    ((projD D) * (projD E)).trace = ((D ∩ E).card : ℝ)
theorems.description: `tr P_D P_E = |D ∩ E|` for the coordinate projectors.

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.double_count
theorems.statement:
theorem double_count (D E : Finset (Fin 5)) :
    ∑ x ∈ D, ∑ y ∈ E, (1 - 5 * (if x = y then (1 : ℝ) else 0)) =
      (D.card : ℝ) * E.card - 5 * (D ∩ E).card

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.sweep
theorems.statement:
theorem sweep (p q : ℝ) (hp : 0 < p) (hq : 0 < q) (D E : Finset (Fin 5)) :
    JDE p q D E = CW p q / 72 * (D.card * E.card - 5 * ((projD D) * (projD E)).trace)
theorems.description:
**A response and its clock in one gap:** for coordinate divided sets `D, E` and any positive grade
weights, `𝒥_DE = Cov(N, H_D H_E) = (C_W/72)(|D||E| − 5 tr P_D P_E)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.sweep_zero
theorems.statement: theorem sweep_zero (a b : Fin 5) (hab : a ≠ b) : JDE (1 / 4) (1 / 8) {a} {b} = 1 / 100
theorems.description: At `χ = 0` the pair of directions on opposite sides's response is `1/100`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.sweep_ratios
theorems.statement:
theorem sweep_ratios (p q : ℝ) (hp : 0 < p) (hq : 0 < q) :
    JDE p q {0} {1} / CW p q = 1 / 72 ∧
      JDE p q {0} {1, 2, 3, 4} / CW p q = 1 / 18 ∧
      ((1 / 18 : ℝ) : ℂ) = -Law.Phi 1 / (1 + Law.Phi 1) ∧
      JDE p q {0, 1} {2, 3, 4} / CW p q = 1 / 12 ∧
      ((1 / 12 : ℝ) : ℂ) = -Law.Phi Complex.I / (1 + Law.Phi Complex.I)
theorems.description:
**One ratio for every value of the gap:** `𝒥/C_W = 1/72` for a pair of directions on opposite sides, `4/72 = −Φ(1)/(1 + Φ(1))`
for a line against the other four, `6/72 = −Φ(i)/(1 + Φ(i))` for a plane against its three outside
lines, at every positive `p, q`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.crossing_g_sq
theorems.statement:
theorem crossing_g_sq (p q : ℝ) (hp : 0 < p) (hq : 0 < q) :
    JDE p q {0} {1} / CW p q = 1 / 72 ∧
      ((1 / 72 : ℝ) : ℂ) = -Law.Phi 1 / (4 * (1 + Law.Phi 1)) ∧
      ((1 / 72 : ℝ) : ℂ) = -Law.Phi Complex.I / (6 * (1 + Law.Phi Complex.I)) ∧
      (1 / 72 : ℝ) = (1 / 3) ^ 2 / 8
theorems.description:
**Formula (27):** `g² = 1/72 = −Φ(1)/[4(1 + Φ(1))] = −Φ(i)/[6(1 + Φ(i))] = e_ℓ²/8`, `e_ℓ = 1/3`,
and the pair of directions on opposite sides's response against its clock is that number at every `p, q > 0`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Formulas.sweep_limit
theorems.statement:
theorem sweep_limit :
    Tendsto (fun χ : ℝ => (χ + 4) * (χ + 8) / (8 * (3 * χ + 20) ^ 2)) atTop (𝓝 (1 / 72)) ∧
      Tendsto (fun χ : ℝ => 9 * (χ + 4) * (χ + 8) / (3 * χ + 20) ^ 2) atTop (𝓝 1)
theorems.description:
**For every value of the gap:** as `χ → ∞` the response of the pair of directions on opposite sides tends to `1/72` and its
clock to `1`.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.antiherm_entry

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.trY
theorems.statement: theorem trY : ∑ S ∈ relSets, chargeZ y6 S = 0
theorems.description: **`Tr Y = 0` over the sixteen.**

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.trY3

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.trY_colour

theorem trY_colour :
    ∑ S ∈ relSets.filter (fun S => (S.filter fun s : Fin 5 => s.val < 3).card = 1 ∨
      (S.filter fun s : Fin 5 => s.val < 3).card = 2), chargeZ y6 S = 0
theorems.description: **Colour triplets and antitriplets with `Y`: `2·⅙ − ⅔ + ⅓ = 0`.**

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.trY_weak
theorems.statement:
theorem trY_weak :
    ∑ S ∈ relSets.filter (fun S => (3 ∈ S ∧ 4 ∉ S) ∨ (3 ∉ S ∧ 4 ∈ S)), chargeZ y6 S = 0
theorems.description: **Weak doublets with `Y`: `3·⅙ − ½ = 0`.**

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.lastDirection_neutral
theorems.statement: theorem lastDirection_neutral : chargeZ q3 {0, 1, 2, 4} = 0
theorems.description: `ℓ_h = f_{C ∪ {k}}` is neutral.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.hypercharge_table
theorems.statement:
theorem hypercharge_table :
    (relSets.filter fun S => chargeZ y6 S = 0).card = 1 ∧
    (relSets.filter fun S => chargeZ y6 S = -4).card = 3 ∧
    (relSets.filter fun S => chargeZ y6 S = 1).card = 6 ∧
    (relSets.filter fun S => chargeZ y6 S = 6).card = 1 ∧
    (relSets.filter fun S => chargeZ y6 S = 2).card = 3 ∧
    (relSets.filter fun S => chargeZ y6 S = -3).card = 2
theorems.description:
The hypercharges of the sixteen: `0` (the singlet), `−⅔` three times, `⅙` six times, `1`, `⅓`
three times, `−½` twice (here times six).

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.kLoc_sq

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.colour_transfer

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.doubled_coefficient

    (kLocᵀ * (detY * detYᵀ) * kLoc * (prepX * prepXᵀ)).trace = 1 / 72
theorems.description: **The doubled determinant's mixed coefficient:** `tr(Kᵀ YYᵀ K XXᵀ) = ‖T‖²_HS = 8/24² = 1/72`.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.sum_diag_one
theorems.statement:
theorem sum_diag_one (f : Unit × Fin 8 → Unit × Fin 8 → ℝ) (c : ℝ) (hf : ∀ i j, f i j = if i = j then c else 0) :
    ∑ i, ∑ j, f i j = 8 * c

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.singlet_amplitude
theorems.statement:
theorem singlet_amplitude :
    ∑ i, ∑ j, adjointSinglet i j * (detYᵀ * kLoc * prepX) i j = 1 / (3 * Real.sqrt 8) ∧
      (∑ i, ∑ j, adjointSinglet i j * (detYᵀ * kLoc * prepX) i j) ^ 2 = 1 / 72 ∧
      ∑ i, ∑ j, adjointSinglet i j ^ 2 = 1
theorems.description: **The singlet amplitude:** `⟨Ω₈, vec T⟩ = 1/(3√8)`, its square `1/72`, and `‖Ω₈‖ = 1`.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.scattering_transfer
theorems.description:
**The native coin's reflection gives the scattering amplitude** `3I₈/40`, with `‖·‖² = 9/200`:
crossing changes the reflection.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.g6_self
theorems.statement: theorem g6_self (v : Fin 6 → ℝ) : g6 v v = r2 v - s2 v

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.g6_comm
theorems.statement: theorem g6_comm (v w : Fin 6 → ℝ) : g6 v w = g6 w v

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.eq_zero_of_r2_s2
theorems.statement: theorem eq_zero_of_r2_s2 (v : Fin 6 → ℝ) (hr : r2 v = 0) (hs : s2 v = 0) : v = 0

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.cone_radius
theorems.statement: theorem cone_radius (v : Fin 6 → ℝ) (hv : OnCone v) : 0 < r2 v ∧ s2 v = r2 v
theorems.description: **On the cone the plane part is positive and equals the other part.**

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.r2_smul
theorems.statement: theorem r2_smul (a : ℝ) (v : Fin 6 → ℝ) : r2 (a • v) = a ^ 2 * r2 v

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.s2_smul
theorems.statement: theorem s2_smul (a : ℝ) (v : Fin 6 → ℝ) : s2 (a • v) = a ^ 2 * s2 v

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.normalized_on_torus
theorems.statement: theorem normalized_on_torus (v : Fin 6 → ℝ) (hv : OnCone v) : r2 (nrm v) = 1 ∧ s2 (nrm v) = 1
theorems.description: **The normalized representative lies on `S¹ × S³`.**

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.torus_on_cone
theorems.statement: theorem torus_on_cone (x : Fin 6 → ℝ) (hr : r2 x = 1) (hs : s2 x = 1) : OnCone x
theorems.description: **Every point of `S¹ × S³` is balanced.**

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.normalized_ray_iff
theorems.statement:
theorem normalized_ray_iff (v w : Fin 6 → ℝ) (hv : OnCone v) (hw : OnCone w) :
    (∃ a : ℝ, a ≠ 0 ∧ w = a • v) ↔ nrm w = nrm v ∨ nrm w = -nrm v
theorems.description:
**Two balanced vectors span one ray exactly when their normalized representatives agree up to
sign:** the balanced directions are `(S¹ × S³)/ℤ₂`.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.clock_is_central
theorems.statement: theorem clock_is_central (v : Fin 6 → ℝ) : frame v 0 = J6 *ᵥ v
theorems.description: **The clock is the central kept rotation applied to `v`:** `frame 0 = J v`.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.frame_orthonormal
theorems.statement:
theorem frame_orthonormal (v : Fin 6 → ℝ) (hr : r2 v = 1) (hs : s2 v = 1) (i j : Fin 4) :
    g6 (frame v i) (frame v j) = if i = j then (if i = 0 then 1 else -1) else 0
theorems.description: **The frame is `g`-orthonormal with signs `(+, −, −, −)`** at a normalized `v`.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.frame_perp
theorems.statement: theorem frame_perp (v : Fin 6 → ℝ) (i : Fin 4) : g6 v (frame v i) = 0
theorems.description: **The frame is orthogonal to `v`.**

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.vbar_props
theorems.statement:
theorem vbar_props (v : Fin 6 → ℝ) (hr : r2 v = 1) (hs : s2 v = 1) :
    g6 v (vbar v) = 1 ∧ g6 (vbar v) (vbar v) = 0 ∧ ∀ i, g6 (vbar v) (frame v i) = 0

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.g6_add_left
theorems.statement: theorem g6_add_left (x y z : Fin 6 → ℝ) : g6 (x + y) z = g6 x z + g6 y z

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.g6_smul_left
theorems.statement: theorem g6_smul_left (a : ℝ) (x z : Fin 6 → ℝ) : g6 (a • x) z = a * g6 x z

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.decomposition_explicit
theorems.statement:
theorem decomposition_explicit (v : Fin 6 → ℝ) (hr : r2 v = 1) (hs : s2 v = 1) (w : Fin 6 → ℝ)
    (hw : g6 v w = 0) :
    w = g6 w (vbar v) • v + g6 w (frame v 0) • frame v 0 + (-g6 w (frame v 1)) • frame v 1 +
      (-g6 w (frame v 2)) • frame v 2 + (-g6 w (frame v 3)) • frame v 3
theorems.description: The explicit expansion of `w ⊥ v` in the basis `v, Jv, iu, ju, ku`.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.cone_decomposition
theorems.statement:
theorem cone_decomposition (v : Fin 6 → ℝ) (hr : r2 v = 1) (hs : s2 v = 1) (w : Fin 6 → ℝ)
    (hw : g6 v w = 0) :
    ∃! c : Fin 5 → ℝ, w = c 0 • v + c 1 • frame v 0 + c 2 • frame v 1 + c 3 • frame v 2 +
      c 4 • frame v 3
theorems.description:
**`v` and the frame form a basis of `v^⊥`:** every `w ⊥ v` is `c₀v + c₁Jv + c₂iu + c₃ju + c₄ku` for
exactly one `c`.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.cone_tangent_radical
theorems.statement:
theorem cone_tangent_radical (v : Fin 6 → ℝ) (hr : r2 v = 1) (hs : s2 v = 1) (w : Fin 6 → ℝ)
    (hw : g6 v w = 0) : (∀ z, g6 v z = 0 → g6 w z = 0) ↔ ∃ a : ℝ, w = a • v
theorems.description: **The radical of `g` on `v^⊥` is the line of `v`** (at a normalized balanced `v`).

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.cone_section_change
theorems.statement:
theorem cone_section_change (v w z : Fin 6 → ℝ) (f a b : ℝ) (hv : g6 v v = 0) (hw : g6 v w = 0)
    (hz : g6 v z = 0) : g6 (f • w + a • v) (f • z + b • v) = f ^ 2 * g6 w z
theorems.description:
**A change of section multiplies the quotient metric by `f²`:** for `v` null and `w, z ⊥ v`,
`g(fw + av, fz + bv) = f² g(w, z)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.unitTurn_comm_theta
theorems.statement:
theorem unitTurn_comm_theta {n : ℕ} (D : Finset (Fin n)) (b c : Fin n) (h : b ∈ D ↔ c ∈ D) :
    unitTurn b c * thetaD D = thetaD D * unitTurn b c

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.unitTurn_kept
theorems.statement: theorem unitTurn_kept (b c : Fin 6) (h : b ∈ heldPlane ↔ c ∈ heldPlane) : Kept6 (unitTurn b c)

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.third_direction
theorems.statement:
theorem third_direction : ∀ a b : Fin 6, a ∉ heldPlane → b ∉ heldPlane → a ≠ b →
    ∃ c : Fin 6, c ∉ heldPlane ∧ c ≠ a ∧ c ≠ b

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.central_entry_zero
theorems.statement:
theorem central_entry_zero (X : Matrix (Fin 6) (Fin 6) ℝ) (hX : CentralKept6 X) (a b : Fin 6)
    (hab : a ≠ b) (hnot : ¬((a = 1 ∧ b = 0) ∨ (a = 0 ∧ b = 1))) : X a b = 0

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.central_kept_iff
theorems.statement: theorem central_kept_iff (X : Matrix (Fin 6) (Fin 6) ℝ) : CentralKept6 X ↔ ∃ a : ℝ, X = a • J6
theorems.description: **The centre of the kept rotations of the held plane is the line of `J`.**

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.balanced_cone
theorems.statement:
theorem balanced_cone (v : Fin 6 → ℝ) (hv : OnCone v) (hr : r2 v = 1) :
    s2 v = 1 ∧
      (∀ i j, g6 (frame v i) (frame v j) = if i = j then (if i = 0 then 1 else -1) else 0) ∧
      (∀ i, g6 v (frame v i) = 0) ∧
      frame v 0 = J6 *ᵥ v ∧
      (∀ w, g6 v w = 0 → ∃! c : Fin 5 → ℝ, w = c 0 • v + c 1 • frame v 0 + c 2 • frame v 1 +
        c 3 • frame v 2 + c 4 • frame v 3) ∧
      (∀ X, CentralKept6 X ↔ ∃ a : ℝ, X = a • J6)
theorems.description:
**The balanced cone of the held plane, with its clock.** For a balanced `v` normalized to `|d| = 1`:
`|u| = 1` (a point of `S¹ × S³`); the frame `Jv, iu, ju, ku` is orthogonal to `v`, `g`-orthonormal
with signs `(+, −, −, −)`, and with `v` a basis of `v^⊥`, so the quotient `v^⊥/ℝv` has signature
`(1, 3)`; its one positive direction is `Jv`, the rotation of the held plane; and the kept rotations that
commute with all kept rotations are exactly the multiples of `J`.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.continuum_limit
theorems.statement:
theorem continuum_limit :
    (∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (hN : 2 ∣ N),
      (chartStep (N := N) * liftM hN : Matrix (VN N × Fin 5) (Fin 16 × Fin 5) ℂ) =
        liftM hN * stepOp transitionMat) ∧
    (∀ {n : Type} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] (F G : Matrix n n ℂ) (u ε : ℂ), u ≠ 0 → ε ≠ 0 →
      1 + 4 * u ^ 2 ≠ 0 →
      (1 + 4 * u ^ 2) • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) - (u ^ 2 / (1 + 4 * u ^ 2)) • (F * G) =
        schurScale u ε • normalizedQ F G u ε) ∧
    (∀ (ε M : ℝ), ε ≠ 0 → ∀ (μ : Measure (Fin 5 → ℝ)), (∀ᵐ p ∂μ, ∑ i, p i = 0) →
      ∀ f : (Fin 5 → ℝ) → ℂ, AEStronglyMeasurable f μ →
      eLpNorm (fun p => ((latticeMult ε M p - continuumMult M p : ℝ) : ℂ) * f p) 2 μ ≤
        ENNReal.ofReal (normConst ε) * eLpNorm f 2 μ) ∧
    (∀ ε Ω : ℝ, ε ≠ 0 →
      ((uPole ε Ω)⁻¹ + 4 * uPole ε Ω) ^ 2 = 25 + 5 * ε ^ 2 * kappaR ε Ω ∧
        0 < uPole ε Ω ∧ uPole ε Ω ≤ 1 / 4) ∧
    (∀ v : Fin 6 → ℝ, OnCone v → r2 v = 1 →
      s2 v = 1 ∧
      (∀ i j, g6 (frame v i) (frame v j) = if i = j then (if i = 0 then 1 else -1) else 0) ∧
      (∀ i, g6 v (frame v i) = 0) ∧
      frame v 0 = J6 *ᵥ v ∧
      (∀ w, g6 v w = 0 → ∃! c : Fin 5 → ℝ, w = c 0 • v + c 1 • frame v 0 + c 2 • frame v 1 +
        c 3 • frame v 2 + c 4 • frame v 3) ∧
      (∀ X, CentralKept6 X ↔ ∃ a : ℝ, X = a • J6))
theorems.description: **The continuum limit, as one theorem.**

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.transitions_per_relation
theorems.statement:
theorem transitions_per_relation : ∀ (r : Fin 5) (U : Fin 16),
    (Finset.univ.filter fun p : State × State => p.1.1 = U ∧ Continues p.1 p.2 ∧ p.2.2 = r).card =
      4
theorems.description: The transitions along `r` at the two-spinor state `U`: one from each last-step direction other than `r`.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.coupling_R1
theorems.statement:
theorem coupling_R1 :
    (∀ (u : Fin 5) (k : Fin 16),
      (γ u ⊗ₖ γ u) *ᵥ rel k = (if u ∈ disagreeSet k then -1 else 1 : ℂ) • rel k) ∧
    (∀ (u : Fin 5) (k : Fin 16),
      count u *ᵥ rel k = (if u ∈ disagreeSet k then 1 else 0 : ℂ) • rel k) ∧
    (∀ k l : Fin 16, star (rel k) ⬝ᵥ rel l = if k = l then 1 else 0)

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.coupling_R2
theorems.statement:
theorem coupling_R2 :
    (∀ (n : ℕ) (D : Finset (Fin n)) (a b : Fin n), a ∈ D → b ∉ D →
      massForm D (unitTurn a b) (unitTurn a b) = 2) ∧
    (∀ h : Fin 5, Moved {h.succ} (Sum.inl h)) ∧
    (∀ (r : Fin 5) (U : Fin 16), movesTurn (relDiv U) 0 r.succ = decide (r ∈ disagreeSet U)) ∧
    (∀ r : Fin 5, (Finset.univ.filter fun U : Fin 16 => U ≠ 0 ∧ r ∈ disagreeSet U).card = 8)

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.coupling_R3
theorems.statement:
theorem coupling_R3 :
    (∀ r : Fin 5,
      (turns6.filter fun p => movesTurn {0, r.succ} p.1 p.2 = true).card = 8 ∧
        (turns6.filter fun p => movesTurn {0, r.succ} p.1 p.2 = false).card = 7) ∧
    (∀ (r : Fin 5) (U : Fin 16), U ≠ 0 →
      movesTurn {0, r.succ} (relTurn U).1 (relTurn U).2 = decide (r ∈ disagreeSet U)) ∧
    (∀ {n : Type} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] (S₁ S₂ : ℝ) (M : Matrix n n ℝ),
      (1 - levelOp S₁ S₂ 0 ⊗ₖ M).det = (1 - S₁ • M).det * (1 - S₂ • M).det) ∧
    (∀ {n : Type} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] (S₁ S₂ : ℝ), S₂ ≠ 0 → S₁ + S₂ ≠ 0 →
      ∀ M : Matrix n n ℝ, (1 - levelOp S₁ S₂ 1 ⊗ₖ M).det = (1 - (S₁ + S₂) • M).det)

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.coupling_R4
theorems.statement:
theorem coupling_R4 :
    (∀ r : Fin 5, ∑ s : State, ∑ s' : State,
      (if Continues s s' ∧ s'.2 = r ∧ s.1 ≠ 0 then 1 else 0 : ℕ) = 60) ∧
    (∀ (r : Fin 5) (U : Fin 16),
      (Finset.univ.filter fun p : State × State => p.1.1 = U ∧ Continues p.1 p.2 ∧
        p.2.2 = r).card = 4) ∧
    (∀ h : Fin 5, alongCount h h = 60 ∧ ∀ j, j ≠ h → alongCount h j = 59) ∧
    ((16 : ℚ) - 1) / 5 = 3

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.coupling_R5
theorems.statement:
theorem coupling_R5 (r : Fin 5) :
    ((1 : State → ℚ) ⬝ᵥ ((stepsAlong r * lamR r * offSinglet) *ᵥ 1)) /
        ((1 : State → ℚ) ⬝ᵥ ((stepsAlong r * offSinglet) *ᵥ 1)) = 32 / 60 ∧
    ∑ U ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun U : Fin 16 => U ≠ 0), (4 / 60 : ℚ) • (recordG r U ⊙ recordG r U) =
      1 + (8 / 15 : ℚ) • ((Matrix.of fun _ _ => (1 : ℚ)) - 1)

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.coupling_R6
theorems.statement:
theorem coupling_R6 :
    (∀ h : Fin 5, ((1 : State → ℚ) ⬝ᵥ ((stepsAlong h * lamR h * availableTransitionsProj h) *ᵥ 1)) /
        ((1 : State → ℚ) ⬝ᵥ ((stepsAlong h * availableTransitionsProj h) *ᵥ 1)) = 8 / 15) ∧
    (∀ r : Fin 5, ((1 : State → ℚ) ⬝ᵥ ((stepsAlong r * lamR r * offSinglet) *ᵥ 1)) /
        ((1 : State → ℚ) ⬝ᵥ ((stepsAlong r * offSinglet) *ᵥ 1)) = 8 / 15)

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.coupling_derived
theorems.statement: theorem coupling_derived : (32 : ℚ) / 60 = 8 / 15 ∧ 1 - (8 : ℚ) / 15 = 7 / 15
theorems.description: **The coupling derived:** `c = 32/60 = 8/15` and `1 − c = 7/15`.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.Euler.HasPer.mul
theorems.statement: theorem HasPer.mul {f : ℕ → α} {k : ℕ} (h : HasPer f k) (m : ℕ) : HasPer f (m * k)

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.Euler.HasPer.sub
theorems.statement:
theorem HasPer.sub {f : ℕ → α} {k l : ℕ} (hk : HasPer f k) (hl : HasPer f l) (hkl : k ≤ l) :
    HasPer f (l - k)

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.Euler.HasPer.mod
theorems.statement:
theorem HasPer.mod {f : ℕ → α} {k l : ℕ} (hk : HasPer f k) (hl : HasPer f l) :
    HasPer f (l % k)

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.Euler.HasPer.gcd
theorems.statement:
theorem HasPer.gcd {f : ℕ → α} {k l : ℕ} (hk : HasPer f k) (hl : HasPer f l) :
    HasPer f (Nat.gcd k l)

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.Euler.HasPer.mod_eq
theorems.statement: theorem HasPer.mod_eq {f : ℕ → α} {d : ℕ} (h : HasPer f d) (n : ℕ) : f n = f (n % d)

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.Euler.ext_per
theorems.statement: theorem ext_per {r : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r) (c : Fin r → α) : HasPer (ext hr c) r

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.Euler.ext_lt
theorems.statement: theorem ext_lt {r : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r) (c : Fin r → α) (j : Fin r) : ext hr c j = c j

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.Euler.minPer_spec
theorems.statement:
theorem minPer_spec {r : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r) (c : Fin r → α) :
    0 < minPer hr c ∧ HasPer (ext hr c) (minPer hr c)

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.Euler.minPer_le
theorems.statement:
theorem minPer_le {r : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r) (c : Fin r → α) {k : ℕ} (hk : 0 < k)
    (h : HasPer (ext hr c) k) : minPer hr c ≤ k

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.Euler.minPer_dvd_of
theorems.statement:
theorem minPer_dvd_of {r : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r) (c : Fin r → α) {k : ℕ} (hk : 0 < k)
    (h : HasPer (ext hr c) k) : minPer hr c ∣ k
theorems.description: **The least period divides every period**, in particular `r`.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.Euler.minPer_dvd
theorems.statement: theorem minPer_dvd {r : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r) (c : Fin r → α) : minPer hr c ∣ r

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.Euler.minPer_congr
theorems.statement:
theorem minPer_congr {r s : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r) (hs : 0 < s) (c : Fin r → α) (e : Fin s → α)
    (h : ext hr c = ext hs e) : minPer hr c = minPer hs e
theorems.description: The least period depends only on the periodic extension.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.Euler.ext_rep
theorems.statement:
theorem ext_rep {d r : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) (hr : 0 < r) (hdr : d ∣ r) (p : Fin d → α) :
    ext hr (rep hd p r) = ext hd p

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.Euler.ext_root
theorems.statement:
theorem ext_root {r : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r) (c : Fin r → α) {d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d)
    (hdr : d ∣ r) (hper : HasPer (ext hr c) d) :
    ext hd (root (Nat.le_of_dvd hr hdr) c) = ext hr c
theorems.description: **A word is the power of its root at its least period.**

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.Euler.rep_root
theorems.statement:
theorem rep_root {r : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r) (c : Fin r → α) {d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) (hdr : d ∣ r)
    (hper : HasPer (ext hr c) d) : rep hd (root (Nat.le_of_dvd hr hdr) c) r = c

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.Euler.root_rep
theorems.statement:
theorem root_rep {d r : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) (hr : 0 < r) (hdr : d ∣ r) (p : Fin d → α) :
    root (Nat.le_of_dvd hr hdr) (rep hd p r) = p

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.Euler.minPer_root
theorems.statement:
theorem minPer_root {r : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r) (c : Fin r → α) :
    minPer (minPer_spec hr c).1 (root (Nat.le_of_dvd hr (minPer_dvd hr c)) c) = minPer hr c
theorems.description: **The root of a word at its least period is primitive.**

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.Euler.minPer_rep
theorems.statement:
theorem minPer_rep {d r : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) (hr : 0 < r) (hdr : d ∣ r) (p : Fin d → α) :
    minPer hr (rep hd p r) = minPer hd p
theorems.description: **The power of a primitive word has the same least period.**

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.Euler.sum_words

source_context.command: variable {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] {R : Type*} [AddCommMonoid R]

theorems.statement:
theorem sum_words {r : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r) (F : (Fin r → α) → R) :
    ∑ c : Fin r → α, F c =
      ∑ d ∈ r.divisors.attach, ∑ p ∈ (Finset.univ.filter fun p : Fin d.1 → α =>
          minPer (Nat.pos_of_mem_divisors d.2) p = d.1),
        F (rep (Nat.pos_of_mem_divisors d.2) p r)
theorems.description: **`Σ_c F(c) = Σ_{d ∣ r} Σ_{p primitive of length d} F(p^{r/d})`.**

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.Euler.prod_cons_walk

source_context.command: variable {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] {R : Type*} [CommRing R]

theorems.statement:
theorem prod_cons_walk (M : Matrix α α R) (n : ℕ) (y : α) (v : Fin (n + 1) → α) :
    ∏ j : Fin (n + 1), M ((Fin.cons y v : Fin (n + 2) → α) j.succ)
      ((Fin.cons y v : Fin (n + 2) → α) j.castSucc) =
      M (v 0) y * ∏ j : Fin n, M (v j.succ) (v j.castSucc)

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.Euler.cons_last

source_context.command: variable {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] {R : Type*} [CommRing R]

theorems.statement:
theorem cons_last (n : ℕ) (y : α) (v : Fin (n + 1) → α) :
    (Fin.cons y v : Fin (n + 2) → α) (Fin.last (n + 1)) = v (Fin.last n)

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.Euler.pow_apply_walks

source_context.command: variable {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] {R : Type*} [CommRing R]

theorems.statement:
theorem pow_apply_walks (M : Matrix α α R) (n : ℕ) (a b : α) :
    (M ^ n) b a = ∑ v : Fin (n + 1) → α,
      if v 0 = a ∧ v (Fin.last n) = b then ∏ j : Fin n, M (v j.succ) (v j.castSucc) else 0
theorems.description: **The walk formula:** `(Mⁿ)_{ba} = Σ_v [v₀ = a, vₙ = b] Π_j M(v_{j+1}, v_j)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.Euler.trace_pow_walks

source_context.command: variable {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] {R : Type*} [CommRing R]

theorems.statement:
theorem trace_pow_walks (M : Matrix α α R) (n : ℕ) :
    (M ^ n).trace = ∑ v : Fin (n + 1) → α,
      if v (Fin.last n) = v 0 then ∏ j : Fin n, M (v j.succ) (v j.castSucc) else 0
theorems.description: `Tr Mⁿ` as the sum over closed walks.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.Euler.snoc_succ_eq_ext

source_context.command: variable {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] {R : Type*} [CommRing R]

theorems.statement:
theorem snoc_succ_eq_ext {r : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r) (c : Fin r → α) (j : Fin r) :
    (Fin.snoc c (c ⟨0, hr⟩) : Fin (r + 1) → α) j.succ = ext hr c (j + 1)

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.Euler.trace_pow_eq_sum

source_context.command: variable {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] {R : Type*} [CommRing R]

theorems.statement:
theorem trace_pow_eq_sum (M : Matrix α α R) {r : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r) :
    (M ^ r).trace = ∑ c : Fin r → α, cycW M hr c
theorems.description: **`Tr M^r = Σ_{closed words c} Π_j M(c_{j+1}, c_j)`.**

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.Euler.prod_range_per

source_context.command: variable {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] {R : Type*} [CommRing R]

theorems.statement:
theorem prod_range_per (g : ℕ → R) {d : ℕ} (hg : HasPer g d) (q : ℕ) :
    ∏ j ∈ Finset.range (d * q), g j = (∏ j ∈ Finset.range d, g j) ^ q
theorems.description: A product over `d·q` steps of a `d`-periodic factor.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.Euler.cycW_rep

source_context.command: variable {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] {R : Type*} [CommRing R]

theorems.statement:
theorem cycW_rep (M : Matrix α α R) {d r : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) (hr : 0 < r) (hdr : d ∣ r)
    (p : Fin d → α) : cycW M hr (rep hd p r) = (cycW M hd p) ^ (r / d)
theorems.description: **The weight of a power is the power of the weight.**

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.Euler.euler_coefficient

source_context.command: variable {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] {R : Type*} [CommRing R]

theorems.statement:
theorem euler_coefficient (M : Matrix α α R) {r : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r) :
    (M ^ r).trace = ∑ d ∈ r.divisors.attach, ∑ p ∈ (Finset.univ.filter fun p : Fin d.1 → α =>
        minPer (Nat.pos_of_mem_divisors d.2) p = d.1),
      (cycW M (Nat.pos_of_mem_divisors d.2) p) ^ (r / d.1)
theorems.description: **Every closed walk counted once:** `Tr M^r = Σ_{d ∣ r} Σ_{p primitive, |p| = d} w(p)^{r/d}`.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.Euler.euler_log_coefficient

source_context.command: variable {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] {R : Type*} [CommRing R]

theorems.statement:
theorem euler_log_coefficient (M : Matrix α α ℂ) {r : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r) :
    (M ^ r).trace / r = ∑ d ∈ r.divisors.attach, ∑ p ∈ (Finset.univ.filter
        fun p : Fin d.1 → α => minPer (Nat.pos_of_mem_divisors d.2) p = d.1),
      (1 / (d.1 : ℂ)) * ((cycW M (Nat.pos_of_mem_divisors d.2) p) ^ (r / d.1) /
        ((r / d.1 : ℕ) : ℂ))
theorems.description:
**The Euler product, coefficient by coefficient:** the coefficient of `u^r` in
`log det(I − uM)⁻¹ = Σ_r u^r Tr M^r / r` is that of `Σ_{p primitive} (1/|p|) Σ_k (u^{|p|} w(p))^k/k`.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.Euler.ext_rot
theorems.statement:
theorem ext_rot {d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) (p : Fin d → α) (k n : ℕ) :
    ext hd (rot hd p k) n = ext hd p (n + k)

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.Euler.rot_injective_prim
theorems.statement:
theorem rot_injective_prim {d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) (p : Fin d → α) (hp : minPer hd p = d)
    {k l : ℕ} (hk : k < d) (hl : l < d) (h : rot hd p k = rot hd p l) : k = l
theorems.description: **The rotations of a primitive word are distinct:** its class has exactly `|p|` members.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.Euler.prod_range_shift
theorems.statement:
theorem prod_range_shift (g : ℕ → R) {d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) (hg : HasPer g d) (k : ℕ) :
    ∏ j ∈ Finset.range d, g (j + k) = ∏ j ∈ Finset.range d, g j
theorems.description: A product over a window of `d` steps of a `d`-periodic factor does not depend on the window.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.Euler.cycW_rot
theorems.statement:
theorem cycW_rot [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] (M : Matrix α α R) {d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d)
    (p : Fin d → α) (k : ℕ) : cycW M hd (rot hd p k) = cycW M hd p
theorems.description: The weight is the same along the class.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.Euler.holL_succ

source_context.command:
variable {α ι : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
  {R : Type*} [CommRing R]

theorems.statement: theorem holL_succ (A : ℕ → Matrix ι ι R) (n : ℕ) : holL A (n + 1) = A n * holL A n

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.Euler.holL_add

source_context.command:
variable {α ι : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
  {R : Type*} [CommRing R]

theorems.statement:
theorem holL_add (A : ℕ → Matrix ι ι R) (m n : ℕ) :
    holL A (m + n) = holL (fun j => A (m + j)) n * holL A m

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.Euler.holL_apply_walks

source_context.command:
variable {α ι : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
  {R : Type*} [CommRing R]

theorems.statement:
theorem holL_apply_walks (A : ℕ → Matrix ι ι R) (n : ℕ) (a b : ι) :
    holL A n b a = ∑ v : Fin (n + 1) → ι,
      if v 0 = a ∧ v (Fin.last n) = b then ∏ j : Fin n, A j (v j.succ) (v j.castSucc) else 0
theorems.description: **The walk formula for an ordered product.**

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.Euler.trace_holL_eq_sum

source_context.command:
variable {α ι : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
  {R : Type*} [CommRing R]

theorems.statement:
theorem trace_holL_eq_sum (A : ℕ → Matrix ι ι R) {r : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r) :
    (holL A r).trace = ∑ i : Fin r → ι,
      ∏ j ∈ Finset.range r, A j (ext hr i (j + 1)) (ext hr i j)
theorems.description: `Tr (A_{r−1} ⋯ A_0) = Σ_{closed index words i} Π_j (A_j)_{i_{j+1} i_j}`.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.Euler.ext_pair

source_context.command:
variable {α ι : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
  {R : Type*} [CommRing R]

theorems.statement:
theorem ext_pair {r : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r) (c : Fin r → α) (i : Fin r → ι) (n : ℕ) :
    ext hr (fun j => (c j, i j)) n = (ext hr c n, ext hr i n)

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.Euler.trace_pow_block

source_context.command:
variable {α ι : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
  {R : Type*} [CommRing R]

theorems.statement:
theorem trace_pow_block (M : Matrix (α × ι) (α × ι) R) {r : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r) :
    (M ^ r).trace = ∑ c : Fin r → α, (hol M hr c).trace
theorems.description: **`Tr B^r = Σ_{closed histories c} Tr hol(c)`.**

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.Euler.holL_per

source_context.command:
variable {α ι : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
  {R : Type*} [CommRing R]

theorems.statement:
theorem holL_per (A : ℕ → Matrix ι ι R) {d : ℕ} (hA : HasPer A d) (q : ℕ) :
    holL A (d * q) = (holL A d) ^ q

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.Euler.hol_rep

source_context.command:
variable {α ι : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
  {R : Type*} [CommRing R]

theorems.statement:
theorem hol_rep (M : Matrix (α × ι) (α × ι) R) {d r : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) (hr : 0 < r)
    (hdr : d ∣ r) (p : Fin d → α) : hol M hr (rep hd p r) = (hol M hd p) ^ (r / d)
theorems.description: **The holonomy of a repetition is the power of the holonomy.**

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.Euler.euler_holonomy

source_context.command:
variable {α ι : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
  {R : Type*} [CommRing R]

theorems.statement:
theorem euler_holonomy (M : Matrix (α × ι) (α × ι) R) {r : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r) :
    (M ^ r).trace = ∑ d ∈ r.divisors.attach, ∑ p ∈ (Finset.univ.filter fun p : Fin d.1 → α =>
        minPer (Nat.pos_of_mem_divisors d.2) p = d.1),
      ((hol M (Nat.pos_of_mem_divisors d.2) p) ^ (r / d.1)).trace
theorems.description:
**Every closed walk counted once, with its holonomy:**
`Tr B^r = Σ_{d ∣ r} Σ_{ℓ primitive, |ℓ| = d} Tr (hol ℓ)^{r/d}`.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.Euler.euler_holonomy_log

source_context.command:
variable {α ι : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
  {R : Type*} [CommRing R]

theorems.statement:
theorem euler_holonomy_log (M : Matrix (α × ι) (α × ι) ℂ) {r : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r) :
    (M ^ r).trace / r = ∑ d ∈ r.divisors.attach, ∑ p ∈ (Finset.univ.filter
        fun p : Fin d.1 → α => minPer (Nat.pos_of_mem_divisors d.2) p = d.1),
      (1 / (d.1 : ℂ)) * (((hol M (Nat.pos_of_mem_divisors d.2) p) ^ (r / d.1)).trace /
        ((r / d.1 : ℕ) : ℂ))
theorems.description:
**The Euler product with holonomy, coefficient by coefficient:** the coefficient of `u^r` in
`log det(I − uB)⁻¹ = Σ_r u^r Tr B^r/r` equals that of
`Σ_{ℓ primitive} (1/|ℓ|) Σ_k u^{k|ℓ|} Tr(hol ℓ)^k / k = −Σ_{[ℓ]} log det(1 − u^{|ℓ|} hol ℓ)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.Euler.trace_hol_rot

source_context.command:
variable {α ι : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
  {R : Type*} [CommRing R]

theorems.statement:
theorem trace_hol_rot (M : Matrix (α × ι) (α × ι) R) {d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) (p : Fin d → α)
    (k : ℕ) : (hol M hd (rot hd p k)).trace = (hol M hd p).trace
theorems.description: The trace of the holonomy is the same at every rotation of the walk.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.tangent_grade_is_lastDirection
theorems.statement: theorem tangent_grade_is_lastDirection : γ 1 * γ 2 * γ 3 * γ 4 = γ 0
theorems.description: **The tangent grading is the last-step direction:** `γ₁γ₂γ₃γ₄ = γ₀`.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.double_grade_is_agreement
theorems.statement: theorem double_grade_is_agreement : doubleGrade = lastDirectionAgreement
theorems.description: **The double grading is the last-step direction-agreement operator.**

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.lastDirection_agreement_singlet
theorems.statement: theorem lastDirection_agreement_singlet : lastDirectionAgreement *ᵥ Ω = Ω
theorems.description: **The last-step direction agreement fixes the singlet.**

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.marked_bass_singlet
theorems.statement:
theorem marked_bass_singlet (u s : ℂ) :
    ((1 + u + 4 * u ^ 2) • (1 : Matrix Two Two ℂ) - u • L - s • lastDirectionAgreement) *ᵥ Ω =
      (1 - 5 * u + 4 * u ^ 2 - s) • Ω
theorems.description:
**The marked Bass operator on the singlet:** `(1 + u + 4u²) − uL − s γ₀⊗γ₀` has the eigenvalue
`1 − 5u + 4u² − s` on `Ω`.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.lc5_eps4
theorems.statement: theorem lc5_eps4 : ∀ μ ν ρ σ : Fin 4, lc5 0 μ.succ ν.succ ρ.succ σ.succ = eps4 μ ν ρ σ

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.external_oriented_trace
theorems.statement:
theorem external_oriented_trace (μ ν ρ σ : Fin 4) :
    (γ 1 * γ 2 * γ 3 * γ 4 * γ μ.succ * γ ν.succ * γ ρ.succ * γ σ.succ).trace =
      4 * (eps4 μ ν ρ σ : ℂ)
theorems.description: **The external oriented trace:** `tr(χ₅χ_μχ_νχ_ρχ_σ) = 4ε_{μνρσ}`.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.gamma_trace_zero
theorems.statement: theorem gamma_trace_zero (a : Fin 5) : (γ a).trace = 0

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.trace_one_four
theorems.statement: theorem trace_one_four : (1 : Matrix Four Four ℂ).trace = 4

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.double_grade_trace_zero
theorems.statement: theorem double_grade_trace_zero : doubleGrade.trace = 0
theorems.description: **The double grading has trace zero.**

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.internalCurv_pairs
theorems.statement:
theorem internalCurv_pairs (F : Fin 4 → Fin 4 → Fin 5 → Fin 5 → ℂ) (μ ν : Fin 4) :
    internalCurv F μ ν = (1 / 4 : ℂ) • ∑ p : Fin 5 × Fin 5, F μ ν p.1 p.2 • (γ p.1 * γ p.2)

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.tr_internal
theorems.statement:
theorem tr_internal (F : Fin 4 → Fin 4 → Fin 5 → Fin 5 → ℂ) (μ ν ρ σ : Fin 4) :
    (γ 0 * (internalCurv F μ ν * internalCurv F ρ σ)).trace =
      (1 / 4 : ℂ) * ∑ p : Fin 5 × Fin 5, ∑ q : Fin 5 × Fin 5,
        (lc5 0 p.1 p.2 q.1 q.2 : ℂ) * (F μ ν p.1 p.2 * F ρ σ q.1 q.2)

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.tr_external
theorems.statement:
theorem tr_external (μ ν ρ σ : Fin 4) :
    (γ 0 * (γ μ.succ * γ ν.succ * (γ ρ.succ * γ σ.succ))).trace = 4 * (eps4 μ ν ρ σ : ℂ)

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.pauliCurv_pairs
theorems.statement:
theorem pauliCurv_pairs (F : Fin 4 → Fin 4 → Fin 5 → Fin 5 → ℂ) :
    pauliCurv F = (1 / 2 : ℂ) • ∑ P : Fin 4 × Fin 4,
      (γ P.1.succ * γ P.2.succ) ⊗ₖ internalCurv F P.1 P.2

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.double_grade_curvature_square
theorems.statement:
theorem double_grade_curvature_square (F : Fin 4 → Fin 4 → Fin 5 → Fin 5 → ℂ) :
    (doubleGrade * (pauliCurv F * pauliCurv F)).trace =
      (1 / 4 : ℂ) * ∑ P : Fin 4 × Fin 4, ∑ Q : Fin 4 × Fin 4, ∑ p : Fin 5 × Fin 5,
        ∑ q : Fin 5 × Fin 5, (eps4 P.1 P.2 Q.1 Q.2 : ℂ) * (lc5 0 p.1 p.2 q.1 q.2 : ℂ) *
          (F P.1 P.2 p.1 p.2 * F Q.1 Q.2 q.1 q.2)
theorems.description:
**The double-graded curvature response is the complementary-plane wedge:**
`tr((χ₅ ⊗ γ₀) E E) = ¼ Σ ε_{μνρσ} ε_{0abcd} F^{ab}_{μν} F^{cd}_{ρσ}` for every curvature `F`.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.double_grade_is_wedge
theorems.statement:
theorem double_grade_is_wedge (F : Fin 4 → Fin 4 → Fin 5 → Fin 5 → ℂ) :
    (doubleGrade * (pauliCurv F * pauliCurv F)).trace = wedgeLastDirection F
theorems.description: The last-step direction-graded wedge `¼ Σ ε_{μνρσ} ε_{0abcd} F^{ab}_{μν} F^{cd}_{ρσ}` as the response.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.cubic_trace
theorems.statement:
theorem cubic_trace {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] (E H : Matrix n n ℂ) (s t : ℂ) :
    ((t • E + s • H) ^ 3).trace = t ^ 3 * (E * E * E).trace + 3 * t ^ 2 * s * (H * E * E).trace +
      3 * t * s ^ 2 * (E * H * H).trace + s ^ 3 * (H * H * H).trace
theorems.description:
**The cubic term of the marked logarithm:** `tr((tE + sH)³) = t³tr E³ + 3t²s tr(HE²) +
3ts² tr(EH²) + s³ tr H³`; in `Σ_n tr((tE + sH)ⁿ)/n` the coefficient of `st²` is `tr(HE²)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.g12_sq

theorems.statement: theorem g34_g1 : γ 3 * γ 4 * γ 1 = γ 1 * (γ 3 * γ 4)

theorems.statement: theorem g12_g34_comm : γ 3 * γ 4 * (γ 1 * γ 2) = γ 1 * γ 2 * (γ 3 * γ 4)

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.g12_g34
theorems.statement: theorem g12_g34 : γ 1 * γ 2 * (γ 3 * γ 4) = γ 0

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.E0_sq
theorems.statement: theorem E0_sq : E0 * E0 = (2 : ℂ) • (1 : Matrix Two Two ℂ) + (2 : ℂ) • (γ 0 ⊗ₖ γ 0)

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.square_versus_wedge
theorems.statement:
theorem square_versus_wedge :
    (((1 : Matrix Four Four ℂ) ⊗ₖ γ 0) * (E0 * E0)).trace = 0 ∧
      (doubleGrade * (E0 * E0)).trace = 32
theorems.description: **The square pairing and the wedge differ:** `tr((1 ⊗ γ₀)E₀²) = 0`, `tr((χ₅ ⊗ γ₀)E₀²) = 32`.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.lambda_ell_sq
theorems.statement:
theorem lambda_ell_sq (ℓ : ℝ) (hℓ : ℓ ≠ 0) (Λ : ℝ) :
    (24 / ℓ ^ 4 = (4 / ℓ ^ 2) * (2 * Λ)) ↔ Λ * ℓ ^ 2 = 3
theorems.description:
**`Λℓ² = 3`:** once the wedge is selected, the volume term `24/ℓ⁴` is `(4/ℓ²)·2Λ` exactly when
`Λℓ² = 3` (`WholePicture.lambda_three`; the cross coefficient is `WholePicture.curvature_identity`).

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.disp4_apply
theorems.statement:
theorem disp4_apply (w : Fin 4 → Fin 5) (i : Fin 5) :

theorems.statement: theorem dl_self (a : Fin 5) : dl a a = 1

theorems.statement: theorem dl_ne {a i : Fin 5} (h : a ≠ i) : dl a i = 0

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.dl_cases
theorems.statement: theorem dl_cases (a i : Fin 5) : dl a i = 0 ∨ dl a i = 1

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.no_local_four_cycle
theorems.statement: theorem no_local_four_cycle (w : Fin 4 → Fin 5) (h : cyc4 w) : disp w ≠ 0
theorems.description: **No closed non-backtracking word of length four.**

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.square_disp
