theorem square_disp (s t : Fin 5) :
    disp ![s, t, s, t] = fun i => 2 * (dl s i - dl t i)
theorems.description: **The base square `s,t,s,t` lifts to the displacement `2(e_s − e_t)`** (26).

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.square_disp_ne
theorems.statement: theorem square_disp_ne (s t : Fin 5) (hst : s ≠ t) : disp ![s, t, s, t] ≠ 0

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.local_six_cycle_iff
theorems.statement:
theorem local_six_cycle_iff (w : Fin 6 → Fin 5) :
    cyc6 w ∧ disp w = 0 ↔
      w 0 ≠ w 1 ∧ w 0 ≠ w 2 ∧ w 1 ≠ w 2 ∧ w 3 = w 0 ∧ w 4 = w 1 ∧ w 5 = w 2
theorems.description: **The closed six-words are exactly `s,t,r,s,t,r` with three distinct lines.**

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.local_six_cycle_count
theorems.statement:
theorem local_six_cycle_count :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun w : Fin 6 → Fin 5 => cyc6 w ∧ disp w = 0)).card = 60
theorems.description: **Sixty rooted oriented closed six-words per vertex.**

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.triple_sq_ring
theorems.statement:
theorem triple_sq_ring {R : Type*} [Ring R] (a b c : R) (ha : a * a = 1) (hb : b * b = 1)
    (hc : c * c = 1) (hab : b * a = -(a * b)) (hac : c * a = -(a * c)) (hbc : c * b = -(b * c)) :
    a * b * c * a * b * c = -1

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.closed_word_sign
theorems.statement:
theorem closed_word_sign (w : Fin 6 → Fin 5) (h : cyc6 w ∧ disp w = 0) :
    wordGamma6 w = -1
theorems.description: **Every closed six-word carries the Clifford product `−1`.**

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.closed_word_trace
theorems.statement:
theorem closed_word_trace (w : Fin 6 → Fin 5) (h : cyc6 w ∧ disp w = 0) :
    (wordGamma6 w).trace = -4

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.bN_eq_dl
theorems.statement: theorem bN_eq_dl (t : Fin 5) (i : Fin 4) : bN (N := N) t i = ((dl t i.castSucc : ℤ) : ZMod N)

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.walk4_zero
theorems.statement:
theorem walk4_zero (w : Fin 4 → Fin 5) (z : ZN N) :
    walk4 w (z, false) = (z + fun i => ((disp w i.castSucc : ℤ) : ZMod N), false)

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.walk6_zero
theorems.statement:
theorem walk6_zero (w : Fin 6 → Fin 5) (z : ZN N) :
    walk6 w (z, false) = (z + fun i => ((disp w i.castSucc : ℤ) : ZMod N), false)

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.disp4_sum
theorems.statement: theorem disp4_sum (w : Fin 4 → Fin 5) : ∑ i, disp w i = 0

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.disp6_sum
theorems.statement: theorem disp6_sum (w : Fin 6 → Fin 5) : ∑ i, disp w i = 0

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.disp4_bound
theorems.statement: theorem disp4_bound (w : Fin 4 → Fin 5) (i : Fin 5) : |disp w i| ≤ 2

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.disp6_bound
theorems.statement: theorem disp6_bound (w : Fin 6 → Fin 5) (i : Fin 5) : |disp w i| ≤ 3

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.cast_eq_zero_of_small
theorems.statement:
theorem cast_eq_zero_of_small (d : ℤ) (B : ℕ) (hd : |d| ≤ B) (hN : B < N) :
    ((d : ZMod N) = 0 ↔ d = 0)

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.disp_zero_of_chart
theorems.statement:
theorem disp_zero_of_chart {d : Fin 5 → ℤ} (hs : ∑ i, d i = 0)
    (h : ∀ i : Fin 4, d i.castSucc = 0) : d = 0
theorems.description: A displacement vanishing on the four chart coordinates vanishes, because its sum is zero.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.walk4_closes_iff
theorems.statement:
theorem walk4_closes_iff (hN : 3 ≤ N) (w : Fin 4 → Fin 5) (z : ZN N) :
    walk4 w (z, false) = (z, false) ↔ disp w = 0

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.four_words_open
theorems.statement:
theorem four_words_open (hN : 3 ≤ N) (w : Fin 4 → Fin 5) (hw : cyc4 w) (z : ZN N) :
    walk4 w (z, false) ≠ (z, false)
theorems.description: **On every chart with `N ≥ 3` no non-backtracking four-word closes.**

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.square_wraps_at_two
theorems.statement: theorem square_wraps_at_two (s t : Fin 5) (x : VN 2) : walk4 ![s, t, s, t] x = x
theorems.description: **At `N = 2` the base square is a wrapping loop.**

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.hex_closes_iff
theorems.statement:
theorem hex_closes_iff (hN : 7 ≤ N) (w : Fin 6 → Fin 5) (z : ZN N) :
    walk6 w (z, false) = (z, false) ↔ disp w = 0
theorems.description: **For `N ≥ 7` a six-word closes on the chart iff its displacement vanishes.**

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.hexagon_closes
theorems.statement: theorem hexagon_closes (s t r : Fin 5) (x : VN N) : walk6 ![s, t, r, s, t, r] x = x
theorems.description: The hexagon `s,t,r,s,t,r` closes on every chart and from either sheet.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.area_eq_wedge
theorems.statement:
theorem area_eq_wedge (s t r : Fin 5) :
    area s t r = wedge (fun i => dl s i - dl t i) (fun j => dl r j - dl t j)

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.hexagon_shoelace
theorems.statement:
theorem hexagon_shoelace {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (vs vt vr : Fin 5 → R) :
    (∑ k : Fin 6, wedge (hexPos vs vt vr k) (hexPos vs vt vr (k + 1))) =
      2 • wedge (vs - vt) (vr - vt)
theorems.description: **The shoelace sum of the hexagon is twice `(v_s − v_t) ∧ (v_r − v_t)`.**

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.card_hex_triples
theorems.statement:
theorem card_hex_triples :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun p : Fin 5 × Fin 5 × Fin 5 => p.1 < p.2.1 ∧ p.2.1 < p.2.2)).card = 10
theorems.description: The ten triples `s < t < r`.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.sum_triples
theorems.statement:
theorem sum_triples {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] (f : Fin 5 → Fin 5 → Fin 5 → M) :
    (∑ s : Fin 5, ∑ t : Fin 5, ∑ r : Fin 5, if s < t ∧ t < r then f s t r else 0) =
      f 0 1 2 + f 0 1 3 + f 0 1 4 + f 0 2 3 + f 0 2 4 + f 0 3 4 + f 1 2 3 + f 1 2 4 + f 1 3 4 +
        f 2 3 4
theorems.description: The sum over `s < t < r` written out.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.hexagon_area_tensor_int
theorems.statement:
theorem hexagon_area_tensor_int : ∀ i j k l : Fin 5,
    5 * (area 0 1 2 i j * area 0 1 2 k l + area 0 1 3 i j * area 0 1 3 k l +
      area 0 1 4 i j * area 0 1 4 k l + area 0 2 3 i j * area 0 2 3 k l +
      area 0 2 4 i j * area 0 2 4 k l + area 0 3 4 i j * area 0 3 4 k l +
      area 1 2 3 i j * area 1 2 3 k l + area 1 2 4 i j * area 1 2 4 k l +
      area 1 3 4 i j * area 1 3 4 k l + area 2 3 4 i j * area 2 3 4 k l) =
      (5 * dl i k - 1) * (5 * dl j l - 1) - (5 * dl i l - 1) * (5 * dl j k - 1)
theorems.description: The area tensor, integral form: `5 Σ_{s<t<r} a_{ij} a_{kl} = (5δ_ik − 1)(5δ_jl − 1) − (5δ_il − 1)(5δ_jk − 1)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.hexagon_area_tensor
theorems.statement:
theorem hexagon_area_tensor (i j k l : Fin 5) :
    (∑ s : Fin 5, ∑ t : Fin 5, ∑ r : Fin 5,
      if s < t ∧ t < r then (area s t r i j : ℚ) * area s t r k l else 0) =
      5 * (P5 i k * P5 j l - P5 i l * P5 j k)
theorems.description:
**The hexagon area tensor** (27): `Σ_{s<t<r} a_{str,ij} a_{str,kl} = 5(P_ik P_jl − P_il P_jk)`,
for all `i, j, k, l`, i.e. `Σ a ⊗ a = 5 I` on `Λ²(𝟏^⊥)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.hexagon_area_norm
theorems.statement:
theorem hexagon_area_norm : ∀ s t r : Fin 5, s ≠ t → t ≠ r → s ≠ r →
    (∑ i : Fin 5, ∑ j : Fin 5, if i < j then area s t r i j ^ 2 else 0) = 3
theorems.description: **Each hexagon area has norm squared three.**

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.cellBasis_gram
theorems.statement:
theorem cellBasis_gram :
    cellBasis * cellBasisᵀ = 1 + replicateCol (Fin 1) (fun _ : Fin 4 => (1 : ℤ)) *
      replicateRow (Fin 1) (fun _ : Fin 4 => (1 : ℤ))

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.cell_volume_det
theorems.statement: theorem cell_volume_det : (cellBasis * cellBasisᵀ).det = 5
theorems.description: **`det(b bᵀ) = 5`: the cell volume is `√5 ε⁴`.**

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.sum_dl_dl
theorems.statement:
theorem sum_dl_dl (a b : Fin 5) (G : Fin 5 → Fin 5 → ℝ) :
    (∑ i : Fin 5, ∑ j : Fin 5, (dl a i : ℝ) * dl b j * G i j) = G a b

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.flux_pairing
theorems.statement:
theorem flux_pairing (F : Fin 5 → Fin 5 → ℝ) (hA : ∀ i j, F j i = -F i j) (s t r : Fin 5) :
    (∑ i : Fin 5, ∑ j : Fin 5, (area s t r i j : ℝ) * F i j) = 2 * flux F s t r
theorems.description: **The flux is the pairing with the area:** `Σ_{ij} a_{str,ij} F_ij = 2(F_sr − F_st − F_tr)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.hexagon_flux_sum
theorems.statement:
theorem hexagon_flux_sum (F : Fin 5 → Fin 5 → ℝ) (hA : ∀ i j, F j i = -F i j)
    (hR : ∀ i, ∑ j, F i j = 0) :
    (∑ s : Fin 5, ∑ t : Fin 5, ∑ r : Fin 5, if s < t ∧ t < r then flux F s t r ^ 2 else 0) =
      5 / 2 * ∑ i : Fin 5, ∑ j : Fin 5, F i j ^ 2
theorems.description: **Hexagon flux sum:** for `F ∈ Λ²(𝟏^⊥)`, `Σ_{s<t<r} φ_{str}² = (5/2) Σ_{ij} F_ij² = 5|F|²`.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.hexagon_density
theorems.statement:
theorem hexagon_density (u ε : ℝ) (hε : ε ≠ 0) (F : Fin 5 → Fin 5 → ℝ)
    (hA : ∀ i j, F j i = -F i j) (hR : ∀ i, ∑ j, F i j = 0) :
    (∑ s : Fin 5, ∑ t : Fin 5, ∑ r : Fin 5,
        if s < t ∧ t < r then u ^ 6 * (ε ^ 2 * flux F s t r) ^ 2 else 0) / (√5 * ε ^ 4) =
      √5 * u ^ 6 * (1 / 2 * ∑ i : Fin 5, ∑ j : Fin 5, F i j ^ 2) ∧
    (∑ s : Fin 5, ∑ t : Fin 5, ∑ r : Fin 5,
        if s < t ∧ t < r then u ^ 6 * (ε ^ 2 * flux F s t r) ^ 2 else 0) / (√5 * ε ^ 4) =
      √5 / 2 * u ^ 6 * ∑ i : Fin 5, ∑ j : Fin 5, F i j ^ 2
theorems.description:
**The hexagon density** (28): with `φ_{str} = ε² (F_sr − F_st − F_tr)`, the ten hexagons of a
cell divided by the cell volume `√5 ε⁴` give `√5 u⁶ |F|²_{Λ²} = (√5/2) u⁶ F_{μν}F_{μν}`.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.two_orientations
theorems.statement:
theorem two_orientations (u φ : ℝ) :
    -((u : ℂ) ^ 6 * Complex.exp (φ * Complex.I)) - (u : ℂ) ^ 6 * Complex.exp (-φ * Complex.I) =
      ((-2 * u ^ 6 * Real.cos φ : ℝ) : ℂ)
theorems.description:
An unoriented signed hexagon: its two orientations, each with Clifford sign `−1`, contribute
`−2u⁶ cos φ`.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.hexagon_quadratic_part
theorems.statement:
theorem hexagon_quadratic_part (u φ : ℝ) :
    |(-2 * u ^ 6 * Real.cos φ) - (-2 * u ^ 6 + u ^ 6 * φ ^ 2)| ≤ u ^ 6 * φ ^ 4 / 12
theorems.description: **The quadratic part of `−2u⁶ cos φ` is `u⁶φ²`**, with remainder at most `u⁶φ⁴/12`.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.density_values
theorems.statement:
theorem density_values (h : Fin 5) :
    densityQ h h = 75 / 74 ∧ (∀ s, s ≠ h → densityQ h s = 295 / 296) ∧ ∑ s, densityQ h s = 5
theorems.description: **The available transitions density:** `75/74` on the last-step direction, `295/296` on each other line, summing to five.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.marked_entry
theorems.statement:
theorem marked_entry (h : Fin 5) (i j : State) :
    markedR h i j = lawR i j * (if InAvailableTransitions h j ∧ i.2 = h then 1 else 0)

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.marked_zero_of_lastDirection
theorems.statement: theorem marked_zero_of_lastDirection (h : Fin 5) (i j : State) (hj : j.2 = h) : markedR h i j = 0

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.no_undo_on_mark
theorems.statement:
theorem no_undo_on_mark (h : Fin 5) :
    markedR h * lastDirectionProj h = 0 ∧ lastDirectionProj h * markedR h = markedR h
theorems.description: **A marked step comes from another remembered last-step direction:** `A_h E_h = 0`, `E_h A_h = A_h`.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.incoming_outgoing_vertices
theorems.statement:
theorem incoming_outgoing_vertices (h : Fin 5) :
    vin h = Real.log (2 / 5) • lawR + Real.log (295 / 296) • markedR h ∧
      vout h = Real.log (2 / 5) • lawR + Real.log (75 / 74) • markedR h
theorems.description:
**The two preparations from the one available-transition density:** `V_in` vertices `η` and `V_out` vertices `σ`
on the sixty marked arcs.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.incoming_vertex_entry
theorems.statement:
theorem incoming_vertex_entry (h : Fin 5) (i j : State) :
    vin h i j = lawR i j *
      (Real.log (2 / 5) + (if InAvailableTransitions h j ∧ i.2 = h then 1 else 0) * Real.log (295 / 296))
theorems.description: Entry form: `V_in = P ∘ [log t + H_h log η]`.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.sum_boole_pairs
theorems.statement:
theorem sum_boole_pairs (P : State → State → Prop) [DecidableRel P] :
    ∑ i, ∑ j, (if P i j then (1 : ℝ) else 0) =
      ((Finset.univ.filter fun x : State × State => P x.1 x.2).card : ℝ)

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.card_marked
theorems.statement:
theorem card_marked : ∀ h : Fin 5,
    (Finset.univ.filter fun x : State × State =>
      Continues x.2 x.1 ∧ InAvailableTransitions h x.2 ∧ x.1.2 = h).card = 60

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.card_arcs_rows
theorems.statement:
theorem card_arcs_rows :
    (Finset.univ.filter fun x : State × State => Continues x.2 x.1).card = 320

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.sum_lawR
theorems.statement: theorem sum_lawR : ∑ i, ∑ j, lawR i j = 80

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.sum_marked
theorems.statement: theorem sum_marked (h : Fin 5) : ∑ i, ∑ j, markedR h i j = 15

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.vertex_rates
theorems.statement:
theorem vertex_rates (h : Fin 5) :
    (∑ i, ∑ j, vin h i j) / 80 = Real.log (2 / 5) + 3 / 16 * Real.log (295 / 296) ∧
      (∑ i, ∑ j, vout h i j) / 80 = Real.log (2 / 5) + 3 / 16 * Real.log (75 / 74)
theorems.description: **The rates of the two preparations:** `log t + (3/16) log η` and `log t + (3/16) log σ`.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.preparations_differ
theorems.description:
**The two preparations give different colour words:** `W_out/W_in = (60/59)⁹ > 1`, and their
rates differ by `(3/16) log(60/59) > 0`.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.card_Ret
theorems.statement: theorem card_Ret : Fintype.card (Ret h) = 74

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.card_Hid
theorems.statement: theorem card_Hid : Fintype.card (Hid h) = 6

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.rowA
theorems.statement: theorem rowA : bAA h *ᵥ (1 : Ret h → ℚ) = (4 : ℚ) • 1 - bAD h *ᵥ 1

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.rowD
theorems.statement: theorem rowD : bDA h *ᵥ (1 : Ret h → ℚ) = (4 : ℚ) • 1 - bDD h *ᵥ 1

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.colA
theorems.statement: theorem colA : (1 : Ret h → ℚ) ᵥ* bAA h = (4 : ℚ) • 1 - (1 : Hid h → ℚ) ᵥ* bDA h

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.colD
theorems.statement: theorem colD : (1 : Ret h → ℚ) ᵥ* bAD h = (4 : ℚ) • 1 - (1 : Hid h → ℚ) ᵥ* bDD h

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.hidden_square_zero
theorems.statement: theorem hidden_square_zero : bDD h * bDD h = 0
theorems.description: **The hidden step squares to zero:** `B_DD² = 0`.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.totDD_all
theorems.statement:
theorem totDD_all : ∀ h : Fin 5,
    (1 : {s : State // ¬InAvailableTransitions h s} → ℚ) ⬝ᵥ (blockDD h (fun _ _ => (1 : ℚ)) *ᵥ 1) = 4

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.dot_one_one_Hid
theorems.statement: theorem dot_one_one_Hid : (1 : Hid h → ℚ) ⬝ᵥ (1 : Hid h → ℚ) = 6

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.dot_one_one_Ret
theorems.statement: theorem dot_one_one_Ret : (1 : Ret h → ℚ) ⬝ᵥ (1 : Ret h → ℚ) = 74

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.nilv
theorems.statement: theorem nilv (v : Hid h → ℚ) : bDD h *ᵥ (bDD h *ᵥ v) = 0

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.tot2
theorems.statement: theorem tot2 : (1 : Ret h → ℚ) ⬝ᵥ ((bAD h * bDA h) *ᵥ 1) = 64

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.tot3
theorems.statement: theorem tot3 : (1 : Ret h → ℚ) ⬝ᵥ ((bAD h * bDD h * bDA h) *ᵥ 1) = 64

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.tot1
theorems.statement: theorem tot1 : (1 : Ret h → ℚ) ⬝ᵥ (bAA h *ᵥ 1) = 276

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.reduced_clock
theorems.statement: theorem reduced_clock : (1 / 74 : ℚ) * ((1 : Ret h → ℚ) ⬝ᵥ (Sz h *ᵥ 1)) = -40 / 37
theorems.description: **The reduced clock:** `ℓ_A S_z r_A = −40/37` with `r_A = 𝟏`, `ℓ_A = 𝟏ᵀ/74`.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.ea_ed_one
theorems.statement: theorem ea_ed_one : ea h *ᵥ (1 : Ret h → ℚ) + ed h *ᵥ (1 : Hid h → ℚ) = 1

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.one_ea_ed
theorems.statement: theorem one_ea_ed : (1 : State → ℚ) ᵥ* ea h = 1 ∧ (1 : State → ℚ) ᵥ* ed h = 1

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.constant_lifts
theorems.statement:
theorem constant_lifts :
    liftR h *ᵥ (1 : Ret h → ℚ) = 1 ∧ (1 : Ret h → ℚ) ᵥ* liftL h = 1
theorems.description: **The constant lifts:** `R 𝟏_A = 𝟏` and `𝟏_A L = 𝟏`.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.reduced_source
theorems.statement:
theorem reduced_source (V : Matrix State State ℚ) :
    (1 / 74 : ℚ) * ((1 : Ret h → ℚ) ⬝ᵥ ((-(liftL h * V * liftR h)) *ᵥ 1)) =
        -((1 : State → ℚ) ⬝ᵥ (V *ᵥ 1)) / 74 ∧
      ((1 / 74 : ℚ) * ((1 : Ret h → ℚ) ⬝ᵥ ((-(liftL h * V * liftR h)) *ᵥ 1))) /
          ((1 / 74 : ℚ) * ((1 : Ret h → ℚ) ⬝ᵥ (Sz h *ᵥ 1))) =
        ((1 : State → ℚ) ⬝ᵥ (V *ᵥ 1)) / 80
theorems.description:
**Every arc source keeps its rate through the bound state:** for every source `V` on the eighty
states, `ℓ_A (−L V R) r_A = −ΣV/74`, and the ratio to the clock `ℓ_A S_z r_A` is `ΣV/80`.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.sum_markedQ
theorems.statement: theorem sum_markedQ : (1 : State → ℚ) ⬝ᵥ (markedQ h *ᵥ 1) = 15

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.marked_numerator
theorems.statement:
theorem marked_numerator :
    (1 / 74 : ℚ) * ((1 : Ret h → ℚ) ⬝ᵥ ((-(liftL h * markedQ h * liftR h)) *ᵥ 1)) = -15 / 74 ∧
      ((1 / 74 : ℚ) * ((1 : Ret h → ℚ) ⬝ᵥ ((-(liftL h * markedQ h * liftR h)) *ᵥ 1))) /
          ((1 / 74 : ℚ) * ((1 : Ret h → ℚ) ⬝ᵥ (Sz h *ᵥ 1))) = 3 / 16
theorems.description: **The marked numerator:** `ℓ_A(−L A_h R) r_A = −15/74`; **its ratio to the clock is `3/16`.**

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.excursion_clock_transport
theorems.statement: theorem excursion_clock_transport : (74 / 5 : ℚ) * (40 / 37) = 16 ∧ (15 / 74 : ℚ) / (40 / 37) = 3 / 16
theorems.description:
**The clock's conversion:** a stationary excursion holds `74/5` watched steps and `16` original
steps, `(74/5)(40/37) = 16`, and `(15/74)/(40/37) = 3/16`.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.Sred_one
theorems.statement: theorem Sred_one : Sred h 1 = 1 - watchedW h
theorems.description: The watched walk is `I − S(1)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.reduced_residue
theorems.statement:
theorem reduced_residue :
    Sred h 1 * resM h = 0 ∧ resM h * Sred h 1 = 0 ∧
      ∀ i j : Ret h, resM h i j =
        -(1 * (1 / 74)) / ((1 / 74 : ℚ) * ((1 : Ret h → ℚ) ⬝ᵥ (Sz h *ᵥ 1)))
theorems.description:
**The residue `1/80`:** `M = 𝟏𝟏ᵀ/80` has `S(1)M = M S(1) = 0`, and `M = −r ℓ/(ℓ S_z r)` with
`r = 𝟏`, `ℓ = 𝟏ᵀ/74`.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.colour_word
theorems.statement: theorem colour_word (q : ℝ) : (Matrix.diagonal fun _ : Fin 3 => q).det = q ^ 3
theorems.description: **The complete colour word is a determinant:** `det(q I₃) = q³`.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.W_three_excursions
theorems.description:
**The one-colour end and the three-colour word:** `q = t¹⁶η³` and `q³ = t⁴⁸η⁹`, `t = 2/5`,
`η = 295/296`.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.omegaE_pos
theorems.statement: theorem omegaE_pos : 0 < omegaE

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.pencil_entries_iff
theorems.statement:
theorem pencil_entries_iff (Ω CL CR A B : ℝ) (hC : CL * CR ≠ 0) :
    (pencil Ω CL CR A B).det = 0 ↔ A * B = Ω ^ 2 * (CL * CR)
theorems.description: **The pencil of a mass `Ω` is any `(C_L, C_R, A, B)` with `AB = Ω² C_LC_R`.**

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.mass_pencil
theorems.statement:
theorem mass_pencil (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) :
    (∀ ζ : ℝ, (pencil ζ 1 1 (R * omegaE) (R * omegaE)).det = 0 ↔
      ζ = R * omegaE ∨ ζ = -(R * omegaE)) ∧
    (R * omegaE) / omegaE = R
theorems.description: **The pencil of a mass of ratio `R`:** zeros `±R/320`, ratio `R`.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.bnd_pos
theorems.statement: theorem bnd_pos {x a b : ℝ} (h : Bnd x a b) (ha : 0 < a) : 0 < x

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.electron_pencil
theorems.statement:
theorem electron_pencil :
    (∀ ζ : ℝ, (pencil ζ 1 1 (1 * omegaE) (1 * omegaE)).det = 0 ↔
      ζ = 1 * omegaE ∨ ζ = -(1 * omegaE)) ∧ (1 * omegaE) / omegaE = 1
theorems.description: The electron: `R = 1`, the unit.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.proton_pencil
theorems.statement:
theorem proton_pencil :
    (∀ ζ : ℝ, (pencil ζ 1 1 (qRp * omegaE) (qRp * omegaE)).det = 0 ↔
      ζ = qRp * omegaE ∨ ζ = -(qRp * omegaE)) ∧ (qRp * omegaE) / omegaE = qRp
theorems.description: **The proton's pencil**, `R = m_p/m_e = 6M + C_h + (1/6)log(5/2) − a⁵ − ba⁶`.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.neutron_pencil
theorems.statement:
theorem neutron_pencil :
    (∀ ζ : ℝ, (pencil ζ 1 1 (qRp * qRn * omegaE) (qRp * qRn * omegaE)).det = 0 ↔
      ζ = qRp * qRn * omegaE ∨ ζ = -(qRp * qRn * omegaE)) ∧
    (qRp * qRn * omegaE) / omegaE = qRp * qRn
theorems.description: **The neutron's pencil**, `R = (m_p/m_e)(m_n/m_p)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.muon_pencil
theorems.statement:
theorem muon_pencil :
    (∀ ζ : ℝ, (pencil ζ 1 1 (qRmu * omegaE) (qRmu * omegaE)).det = 0 ↔
      ζ = qRmu * omegaE ∨ ζ = -(qRmu * omegaE)) ∧ (qRmu * omegaE) / omegaE = qRmu
theorems.description: **The muon's pencil**, `R = m_μ/m_e = 3⁵ e^{−9/56} M_Q(ν)^{1/6}`.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.tau_pencil
theorems.statement:
theorem tau_pencil :
    (∀ ζ : ℝ, (pencil ζ 1 1 (qRmu * qRtau * omegaE) (qRmu * qRtau * omegaE)).det = 0 ↔
      ζ = qRmu * qRtau * omegaE ∨ ζ = -(qRmu * qRtau * omegaE)) ∧
    (qRmu * qRtau * omegaE) / omegaE = qRmu * qRtau
theorems.description: **The tau's pencil**, `R = (m_μ/m_e)(m_τ/m_μ)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.coeff_table
theorems.statement:
theorem coeff_table : ∀ (x : Fin 16) (s : Fin 5) (l : Fin 40),
    coeff l (transition s x) x = if l = linkTab x s then sgnTab x s else 0

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.coeff_antisymm
theorems.statement: theorem coeff_antisymm : ∀ (l : Fin 40) (x y : Fin 16), coeff l x y = -coeff l y x

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.sgn_sq
theorems.statement: theorem sgn_sq : ∀ (x : Fin 16) (s : Fin 5), sgnTab x s * sgnTab x s = 1

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.fibre_two
theorems.statement:
theorem fibre_two : ∀ l : Fin 40,
    (Finset.univ.filter fun p : Fin 16 × Fin 5 => linkTab p.1 p.2 = l).card = 2

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.incZ_table
theorems.statement:
theorem incZ_table : ∀ (x : Fin 16) (l : Fin 40),
    incZ x l = -∑ s, (if linkTab x s = l then sgnTab x s else 0)

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.phase_transition
theorems.statement:
theorem phase_transition (θ : Fin 40 → ℝ) (x : Fin 16) (s : Fin 5) :
    phase16 θ (transition s x) x = (sgnTab x s : ℝ) * θ (linkTab x s)
theorems.description: **One step traverses one link:** `δ_s(x) = sgn · θ_ℓ`.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.phase_antisymm
theorems.statement: theorem phase_antisymm (θ : Fin 40 → ℝ) (x y : Fin 16) : phase16 θ x y = -phase16 θ y x

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.sum_delta
theorems.statement:
theorem sum_delta (θ : Fin 40 → ℝ) (x : Fin 16) :
    ∑ s, phase16 θ (transition s x) x = -divR θ x
theorems.description: **The five steps from a vertex carry minus its divergence:** `Σ_s δ_s(x) = −div θ (x)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.delta_sq_sum
theorems.statement:
theorem delta_sq_sum (θ : Fin 40 → ℝ) :
    ∑ x, ∑ s, phase16 θ (transition s x) x ^ 2 = 2 * sqL θ
theorems.description: **Every link is met from both its ends:** `Σ_x Σ_s δ_s(x)² = 2‖θ‖²`.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.phase_poisson
theorems.statement:
theorem phase_poisson (θ : Fin 40 → ℝ) (hdiv : ∀ x, divR θ x = 0) :
    (∀ x t, ∑ s, (if s = t then 0 else phase16 θ (transition s x) x) = phase16 θ x (transition t x)) ∧
      (∀ x s, phase16 θ (transition s x) (transition s (transition s x)) = phase16 θ (transition s x) x)
theorems.description:
**The conditional mean and the traversed phase:** for a divergence-free `θ`,
`Σ_{s≠t} δ_s(x) = a(x, t)` (so `E[δ | (x,t)] = a/4`) and `a(transition s x, s) = δ_s(x)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.place_identity
theorems.statement:
theorem place_identity (d : Fin 5 → ℝ) (hd : ∑ s, d s = 0) :
    ∑ t, ∑ s, (if s = t then 0 else (4 * d s + d t) ^ 2) = 60 * ∑ s, d s ^ 2
theorems.description:
The identity behind the variance at one vertex: for five numbers summing to zero,
`Σ_{s≠t} (4δ_s + δ_t)² = 60 Σ δ²`.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.phase_variance
theorems.statement:
theorem phase_variance (θ : Fin 40 → ℝ) (hdiv : ∀ x, divR θ x = 0) :
    (∑ x, ∑ t, ∑ s, (if s = t then 0 else
        ((4 * phase16 θ (transition s x) x - phase16 θ x (transition t x)) / 3) ^ 2)) / 320 =
      sqL θ / 24
theorems.description:
**The variance of the phase insertion:** for every divergence-free `θ` (so for `θ_cyc`),
`(1/320) Σ_{arcs} ((4δ − a)/3)² = ‖θ‖²/24`.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.cyc_variance
theorems.statement:
theorem cyc_variance (θ : Fin 40 → ℝ) :
    (∑ x, ∑ t, ∑ s, (if s = t then 0 else
        ((4 * phase16 (thetaCyc θ) (transition s x) x - phase16 (thetaCyc θ) x (transition t x)) / 3) ^ 2)) / 320 =
      sqL (thetaCyc θ) / 24
theorems.description: **The variance of `θ_cyc`:** the cyclic part of any phases has the variance `‖θ_cyc‖²/24`.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.common_denominator
theorems.description: **The common denominator:** `48 = 3 · 16 = 16(5 − 2) = 2(40 − 16)`; the cycle rank is `25`.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.regular_variance_algebra
theorems.statement:
theorem regular_variance_algebra (n d Q : ℝ) (hn : n ≠ 0) (hd : 2 < d) :
    (((d - 1) ^ 2 + 1) * (2 * Q / (n * d)) - 2 * (d - 1) * (2 * Q / (n * d * (d - 1)))) /
        (d - 2) ^ 2 = 2 * Q / (n * (d - 2))
theorems.description:
**On a `d`-regular graph:** the moments `Eδ² = Ea² = 2Q/(nd)`, `E(aδ) = Ea²/(d − 1)` give
`σ² = ((d−1)²Eδ² − 2(d−1)E(aδ) + Ea²)/(d − 2)² = 2Q/(n(d − 2))`.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.exists_isometry_map
theorems.statement:
theorem exists_isometry_map (K₁ K₂ : Submodule ℝ E6)
    (h : Module.finrank ℝ K₁ = Module.finrank ℝ K₂) :
    ∃ φ : E6 ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E6, ∀ x, x ∈ K₂ ↔ ∃ y ∈ K₁, φ y = x

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.exists_rotation_map
theorems.statement:
theorem exists_rotation_map (K₁ K₂ : Submodule ℝ E6)
    (h : Module.finrank ℝ K₁ = Module.finrank ℝ K₂) :
    ∃ φ : E6 ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E6, LinearMap.det φ.toLinearMap = 1 ∧ ∀ x, x ∈ K₂ ↔ ∃ y ∈ K₁, φ y = x
theorems.description: **`SO(6)` takes every `k`-plane of the six to every other.**

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.su4_moves_planes
theorems.statement:
theorem su4_moves_planes (K₁ K₂ : Submodule ℝ E6)
    (h : Module.finrank ℝ K₁ = Module.finrank ℝ K₂) :
    ∃ U : SU4, ∀ x, x ∈ K₂ ↔ ∃ y ∈ K₁, rot6Hom U y = x
theorems.description: **The fifteen rotations take every `k`-plane of P1's real six to every other.**

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.dDiag_inv
theorems.statement: theorem dDiag_inv (ε : Fin 6 → ℝ) : dDiagInv ε * dDiag ε = 1

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.rf_scalar
theorems.statement:
theorem rf_scalar (e1 e2 x : ℝ) (h1 : e1 = 1 ∨ e1 = -1) (h2 : e2 = 1 ∨ e2 = -1) :
    (if e1 = 1 then (1 : ℂ) else -I) * ((1 / 2 : ℂ) * ((x : ℂ) + (e1 : ℂ) * x * e2) +
      I * ((1 / 2 : ℂ) * ((x : ℂ) - (e1 : ℂ) * x * e2))) * (if e2 = 1 then (1 : ℂ) else I) =
      ((if e1 = 1 ∧ e2 = -1 then -x else x : ℝ) : ℂ)

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.real_form_conj
theorems.statement:
theorem real_form_conj (ε : Fin 6 → ℝ) (hε : ∀ i, ε i = 1 ∨ ε i = -1)
    (X : Matrix (Fin 6) (Fin 6) ℝ) :
    dDiagInv ε * ((1 / 2 : ℂ) • (X.map ofReal + diagonal (fun i => (ε i : ℂ)) * X.map ofReal *
        diagonal (fun i => (ε i : ℂ))) +
      I • ((1 / 2 : ℂ) • (X.map ofReal - diagonal (fun i => (ε i : ℂ)) * X.map ofReal *
        diagonal (fun i => (ε i : ℂ))))) * dDiag ε = (realFormMap ε X).map ofReal
theorems.description:
**The kept rotations plus `i` times the moved rotations, conjugated by `D`, are real and are the
matrices `realFormMap ε X`.**

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.realFormMap_mem
theorems.statement:
theorem realFormMap_mem (ε : Fin 6 → ℝ) (hε : ∀ i, ε i = 1 ∨ ε i = -1)
    (X : Matrix (Fin 6) (Fin 6) ℝ) (hX : Xᵀ = -X) :
    (realFormMap ε X)ᵀ * diagonal ε + diagonal ε * realFormMap ε X = 0
theorems.description:
**The changed matrices keep the metric `η = diag(ε)`**: `Yᵀη + ηY = 0`, the Lie algebra
`so(6 − k, k)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.realFormMap_invol
theorems.statement:
theorem realFormMap_invol (ε : Fin 6 → ℝ) (X : Matrix (Fin 6) (Fin 6) ℝ) :
    realFormMap ε (realFormMap ε X) = X

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.realFormMap_onto
theorems.statement:
theorem realFormMap_onto (ε : Fin 6 → ℝ) (hε : ∀ i, ε i = 1 ∨ ε i = -1)
    (Y : Matrix (Fin 6) (Fin 6) ℝ) (hY : Yᵀ * diagonal ε + diagonal ε * Y = 0) :
    (realFormMap ε Y)ᵀ = -realFormMap ε Y ∧ realFormMap ε (realFormMap ε Y) = Y
theorems.description: **Every element of `so(6 − k, k)` comes from a rotation of the six.**

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.null_signature
theorems.statement:
theorem null_signature (a : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin p)) (b : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin q))
    (ha : ‖a‖ = 1) (hb : ‖b‖ = 1) (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin p)) (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin q))
    (hw : gpq (a, b) (x, y) = 0) :
    (∃ c : ℝ, ∃ x' ∈ (ℝ ∙ a)ᗮ, ∃ y' ∈ (ℝ ∙ b)ᗮ, x = x' + c • a ∧ y = y' + c • b ∧
        gpq (x, y) (x, y) = ‖x'‖ ^ 2 - ‖y'‖ ^ 2) ∧
    (∀ (c d : ℝ) (x' x'' : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin p)), x' ∈ (ℝ ∙ a)ᗮ → x'' ∈ (ℝ ∙ a)ᗮ →
        x' + c • a = x'' + d • a → c = d ∧ x' = x'')
theorems.description:
**At a normalized null vector the tangent space splits**: `w = x' + y' + c v` with `x' ⊥ a`,
`y' ⊥ b`, uniquely, and `g(w, w) = |x'|² − |y'|²`.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.finrank_perp
theorems.statement:
theorem finrank_perp (a : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (p + 1))) (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    Module.finrank ℝ (ℝ ∙ a)ᗮ = p
theorems.description: The two parts of the tangent space have dimensions `p − 1` and `q − 1`.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.null_normalize
theorems.statement:
theorem null_normalize (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin p) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin q)) (hv : v ≠ 0)
    (hn : ‖v.1‖ = ‖v.2‖) : 0 < ‖v.1‖ ∧ ‖(nrmPQ v).1‖ = 1 ∧ ‖(nrmPQ v).2‖ = 1
theorems.description: **A balanced vector normalizes onto `S^{p−1} × S^{q−1}`.**

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.null_line_iff
theorems.statement:
theorem null_line_iff (v w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin p) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin q)) (hv : v ≠ 0)
    (hvn : ‖v.1‖ = ‖v.2‖) (hw : w ≠ 0) (hwn : ‖w.1‖ = ‖w.2‖) :
    (∃ c : ℝ, c ≠ 0 ∧ w = c • v) ↔ (nrmPQ w = nrmPQ v ∨ nrmPQ w = -nrmPQ v)
theorems.description:
**Two balanced vectors span one line exactly when their normalized representatives agree up to
sign**: the balanced lines are `(S^{p−1} × S^{q−1})/ℤ₂`.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.lawQ_row
theorems.statement: theorem lawQ_row (p : State) : ∑ q, lawQ p q = 1

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.lawQ_col
theorems.statement: theorem lawQ_col (q : State) : ∑ p, lawQ p q = 1

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.law_projection
theorems.statement: theorem law_projection : lawQ * PiQ = PiQ ∧ PiQ * lawQ = PiQ ∧ PiQ * PiQ = PiQ
theorems.description: **The stationary projector:** `PΠ = ΠP = Π² = Π`.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.sum_arcs
theorems.statement:
theorem sum_arcs (X : State → State → ℚ) :
    ∑ e ∈ arcs, X e.2 e.1 = ∑ p, ∑ q, if Continues q p then X p q else 0

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.PiQ_sandwich
theorems.statement:
theorem PiQ_sandwich (M : Matrix State State ℚ) (a b : State) :
    (PiQ * M * PiQ) a b = (∑ p, ∑ q, M p q) / 6400

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.arc_rate_projection
theorems.statement:
theorem arc_rate_projection (X : State → State → ℚ) :
    PiQ * markedLaw X * PiQ = rate X • PiQ
theorems.description: **The rate is the projected marked walk:** `Π (P ∘ X) Π = ν(X) Π`.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.primitive_rateOn
theorems.statement: theorem primitive_rateOn (e : State × State) (he : e ∈ A) : rateOn A (arcMark e) = 1 / 320

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.rateOn_nat
theorems.statement:
theorem rateOn_nat (X : State → State → ℕ) :
    rateOn A (fun p q => (X p q : ℚ)) = (natTotalOn A X : ℚ) / 320

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.nat_rateOn_ge
theorems.statement:
theorem nat_rateOn_ge (X : State → State → ℕ) (h : 0 < natTotalOn A X) :
    (1 : ℚ) / 320 ≤ rateOn A (fun p q => (X p q : ℚ))

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.nat_rateOn_eq_iff
theorems.statement:
theorem nat_rateOn_eq_iff (X : State → State → ℕ) :
    rateOn A (fun p q => (X p q : ℚ)) = 1 / 320 ↔
      ∃ e ∈ A, X e.2 e.1 = 1 ∧ ∀ f ∈ A, f ≠ e → X f.2 f.1 = 0

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.rate_eq_rateOn
theorems.statement: theorem rate_eq_rateOn (X : State → State → ℚ) : rate X = rateOn arcs X
theorems.description: **The rate of a mark:** `ν(X) = (1/320) Σ_{q → p} X_{pq}` (over the 320 arcs).

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.primitive_rate
theorems.statement: theorem primitive_rate (e : State × State) (he : e ∈ arcs) : rate (arcMark e) = 1 / 320
theorems.description: **A single marked arc has the rate `1/320`.**

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.natTotal_eq
theorems.statement: theorem natTotal_eq (X : State → State → ℕ) : natTotal X = natTotalOn arcs X

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.nat_rate_ge
theorems.statement:
theorem nat_rate_ge (X : State → State → ℕ) (h : 0 < natTotal X) :
    (1 : ℚ) / 320 ≤ rate (fun p q => (X p q : ℚ))
theorems.description: **The least rate of a nonnegative integral mark is `1/320`.**

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.nat_rate_eq_iff
theorems.statement:
theorem nat_rate_eq_iff (X : State → State → ℕ) :
    rate (fun p q => (X p q : ℚ)) = 1 / 320 ↔
      ∃ e ∈ arcs, X e.2 e.1 = 1 ∧ ∀ f ∈ arcs, f ≠ e → X f.2 f.1 = 0
theorems.description: **The rate `1/320` is attained exactly by one arc carrying one unit.**

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.real_marks_no_minimum
theorems.statement:
theorem real_marks_no_minimum (e : State × State) (he : e ∈ arcs) (ε : ℚ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ r : ℚ, 0 < r ∧ rate (fun p q => r * arcMark e p q) = r / 320 ∧ r / 320 < ε
theorems.description: **Real marks have no least positive rate:** `ν(r X_e) = r/320` for every rational `r > 0`.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.shared_source_projection
theorems.statement:
theorem shared_source_projection {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (p A Gt Gg : Matrix n n ℂ) (jt jg ν : ℂ)
    (ha : p * A * p = ν • p) (ht : Gt * p = p) (hg : Gg * p = p) :
    p * (A * ((1 + jt) • Gt + jg • Gg)) * p = ((1 + jt + jg) * ν) • p
theorems.description:
**One numerator for both legs:** if `ΠAΠ = νΠ` and both legs fix `Π`, then
`Π A((1 + j_t)G_t + j_g G_g) Π = (1 + j_t + j_g) ν Π`.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.beta_sq
theorems.statement: theorem beta_sq : beta * beta = 1

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.beta_hermitian
theorems.statement: theorem beta_hermitian : betaᴴ = beta

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.clock_projectors
theorems.statement:
theorem clock_projectors :
    clockPos * clockPos = clockPos ∧ clockNeg * clockNeg = clockNeg ∧ clockPos * clockNeg = 0 ∧
      clockPos + clockNeg = 1 ∧ beta * clockPos = clockPos ∧ beta * clockNeg = -clockNeg

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.rest_resolvent
theorems.statement:
theorem rest_resolvent (ν z : ℂ) (hp : z - ν ≠ 0) (hm : z + ν ≠ 0) :
    restK ν z * ((z - ν)⁻¹ • clockPos + (z + ν)⁻¹ • clockNeg) = 1
theorems.description:
**Its resolvent:** `K_X(z)⁻¹ = (z − ν)⁻¹ Π₊ + (z + ν)⁻¹ Π₋`; the positive pole `ν` has the
residue `Π₊`.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.beta_eq
theorems.statement: theorem beta_eq : beta = σ₂ ⊗ₖ (1 : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ)

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.rest_det
theorems.statement: theorem rest_det (ν z : ℂ) : (restK ν z).det = (z ^ 2 - ν ^ 2) ^ 2
theorems.description: **The determinant of the pencil:** `det K_X(z) = (z² − ν²)²`.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.rest_poles_iff
theorems.statement: theorem rest_poles_iff (ν z : ℂ) : (restK ν z).det = 0 ↔ z = ν ∨ z = -ν
theorems.description: **The poles of the rest pencil are `±ν`.**

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.least_positive_pole
theorems.statement:
theorem least_positive_pole (X : State → State → ℕ) (h : 0 < natTotal X) :
    (restK (rate (fun p q => (X p q : ℚ)) : ℂ) (rate (fun p q => (X p q : ℚ)) : ℂ)).det = 0 ∧
      (1 : ℚ) / 320 ≤ rate (fun p q => (X p q : ℚ)) ∧
      (rate (fun p q => (X p q : ℚ)) = 1 / 320 ↔
        ∃ e ∈ arcs, X e.2 e.1 = 1 ∧ ∀ f ∈ arcs, f ≠ e → X f.2 f.1 = 0)
theorems.description:
**The least positive pole among the nonnegative integral marks is `1/320`:** the completed pencil of
a nonnegative integral mark with positive total has its positive pole at `ν(X) ≥ 1/320`, with equality
exactly for one arc carrying one unit.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.cos_neg_I_mul
theorems.statement: theorem cos_neg_I_mul (y : ℝ) : Complex.cos (-(Complex.I * (y : ℂ))) = (cosh y : ℂ)

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.sqrt2_ne
theorems.statement: theorem sqrt2_ne : (√2 : ℝ) ≠ 0

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.lamC_eq
theorems.statement:
theorem lamC_eq (ε : ℂ) (p : Fin 5 → ℂ) :
    lamC ε p = 2 / (5 * ε ^ 2) *
      ((1 - Complex.cos (ε * (p 0 - p 1))) + (1 - Complex.cos (ε * (p 0 - p 2))) +
        (1 - Complex.cos (ε * (p 0 - p 3))) + (1 - Complex.cos (ε * (p 0 - p 4))) +
        (1 - Complex.cos (ε * (p 1 - p 2))) + (1 - Complex.cos (ε * (p 1 - p 3))) +
        (1 - Complex.cos (ε * (p 1 - p 4))) + (1 - Complex.cos (ε * (p 2 - p 3))) +
        (1 - Complex.cos (ε * (p 2 - p 4))) + (1 - Complex.cos (ε * (p 3 - p 4))))

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.continued_rest_symbol
theorems.statement:
theorem continued_rest_symbol (ε w : ℝ) (hε : ε ≠ 0) :
    lamC ε (fun i => -Complex.I * w * restDir i) = -(kappaR ε w : ℂ)
theorems.description: **The continued rest symbol:** `λ_ε(−iωn) = −κ_ε(ω)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.sPole_ge
theorems.statement: theorem sPole_ge (ε Ω : ℝ) : 5 ≤ sPole ε Ω

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.rest_pole_parameter
theorems.statement:
theorem rest_pole_parameter (ε Ω : ℝ) (hε : ε ≠ 0) :
    ((uPole ε Ω)⁻¹ + 4 * uPole ε Ω) ^ 2 = 25 + 5 * ε ^ 2 * kappaR ε Ω
theorems.description: **The exact tuning to the rest zero:** `(u⁻¹ + 4u)² = 25 + 5ε²κ_ε(Ω)` at `u = uPole ε Ω`.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.uPole_bounds
theorems.statement: theorem uPole_bounds (ε Ω : ℝ) : 0 < uPole ε Ω ∧ uPole ε Ω ≤ 1 / 4

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.rest_zero
theorems.statement:
theorem rest_zero (ε Ω : ℝ) (hε : ε ≠ 0) :
    ((((uPole ε Ω)⁻¹ + 4 * uPole ε Ω) ^ 2 - 25) / (5 * ε ^ 2) : ℝ) = kappaR ε Ω ∧
      ((((uPole ε Ω)⁻¹ + 4 * uPole ε Ω) ^ 2 - 25) / (5 * ε ^ 2) : ℂ) +
        lamC ε (fun i => -Complex.I * Ω * restDir i) = 0
theorems.description:
**The rest zero:** at `u = uPole ε Ω` the intercept equals `κ_ε(Ω)`, so the normalized scalar
`M_ε(u)² + λ_ε(p)` vanishes at the continued rest momentum `p = −iΩn`.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.mass_parameter_inverse
theorems.statement:
theorem mass_parameter_inverse (ε M : ℝ) :
    let s
theorems.description:
**The kinetic mass parameter:** `s = √(25 + 5ε²M²)`, `u = 2/(s + √(s² − 16))` has
`(u⁻¹ + 4u)² = 25 + 5ε²M²` and `0 < u ≤ 1/4`.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.kinetic_series
theorems.description:
**The kinetic-intercept series to fourth order:** `u_K = 1/4 − x/24 + 49x²/4320` solves
`(1 + 4u²)² = u²(25 + 5x)` up to `x³` (`x = ε²M²`); the certificate is exact.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.rest_series
theorems.description:
**The rest-pole series to fourth order:** `u_P = 1/4 − x/24 + 13x²/1728` solves
`1 + 4u² = u s` with `s = 5 + x/2 + x²/48 + O(x³)` (`x = ε²Ω²`, `s = 3 + 2cosh(εΩ/√2)`) up to
`x³`; the certificate is exact.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.Zpole_eq
theorems.statement:
theorem Zpole_eq (ε Ω : ℝ) (hε : ε ≠ 0) (hΩ : Ω ≠ 0) :
    Zpole ε Ω = √2 * (2 * cosh (ε * Ω / √2) + 3) * sinh (ε * Ω / √2) / (5 * ε * Ω)

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.kappa_hasDerivAt
theorems.statement:
theorem kappa_hasDerivAt (ε w : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (kappaR ε)
      (4 / (5 * ε ^ 2) * (ε / √2) * sinh (ε * w / √2) * (2 * cosh (ε * w / √2) + 3)) w

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.rest_kinetic_derivative
theorems.statement:
theorem rest_kinetic_derivative (ε Ω : ℝ) (hε : ε ≠ 0) (hΩ : Ω ≠ 0) :
    HasDerivAt (fun w => kappaR ε Ω - kappaR ε w) (-2 * Ω * Zpole ε Ω) Ω
theorems.description:
**The rest pole is simple:** `d/dω [κ_ε(Ω) − κ_ε(ω)]` at `ω = Ω` is `−2ΩZ_ε(Ω)`, so the scalar
`κ_ε(Ω) − κ_ε(ω)` has the residue `−1/(2ΩZ_ε(Ω))`.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.Zpole_pos
theorems.statement: theorem Zpole_pos (ε Ω : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) (hΩ : 0 < Ω) : 0 < Zpole ε Ω
theorems.description: **The residue factor is positive** for `ε, Ω > 0`.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.bass_resolvent

source_context.command: variable {e v : Type*} [Fintype e] [Fintype v] [DecidableEq e] [DecidableEq v]

theorems.statement:
theorem bass_resolvent (u : ℂ) (T : Matrix e e ℂ) (X : Matrix e v ℂ) (Y : Matrix v e ℂ)
    (Ge : Matrix e e ℂ) (Gv : Matrix v v ℂ) (hT : T * T = 1) (hYX : Y * X = (5 : ℂ) • 1)
    (hev : Ge * (1 - u • (T * (X * Y - 1))) = 1)
    (hv : Gv * ((1 + 4 * u ^ 2) • (1 : Matrix v v ℂ) - u • (Y * T * X)) = 1)
    (hu : 1 - u ^ 2 ≠ 0) :
    Gv = (1 - u ^ 2)⁻¹ • (1 + u • (Y * Ge * T * X))
theorems.description:
**The Bass resolvent:** if `Ge` is a left inverse of `K_e = 1 − uT(XY − 1)` and `Gv` a left
inverse of `K_v = (1 + 4u²) − uYTX`, with `T² = 1`, `YX = 5` and `1 − u² ≠ 0`, then
`Gv = (1 − u²)⁻¹ (1 + u Y Ge T X)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.stepOp_bass_resolvent
theorems.statement:
theorem stepOp_bass_resolvent (Γ : Fin 5 → Matrix V V ℂ) (hΓ : ∀ t, Γ t * Γ t = 1) (u : ℂ)
    (hu : 1 - u ^ 2 ≠ 0) (hB : IsUnit (1 - u • stepOp Γ).det)
    (hK : IsUnit ((1 + 4 * u ^ 2) • (1 : Matrix V V ℂ) - u • ∑ t, Γ t).det) :
    ((1 + 4 * u ^ 2) • (1 : Matrix V V ℂ) - u • ∑ t, Γ t)⁻¹ =
      (1 - u ^ 2)⁻¹ • (1 + u • (rowY V ℂ * (1 - u • stepOp Γ)⁻¹ * blockDiagonal Γ * colX V ℂ))
theorems.description:
**The resolvent of the vertex operator from the step**, for any five involutions `Γ_t`:
`K_v⁻¹ = (1 − u²)⁻¹ (1 + u Y (1 − uB)⁻¹ T X)`, `B = stepOp Γ`, `T = blockDiagonal Γ`.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.normalized_schur
theorems.statement:
theorem normalized_schur (F G : Matrix n n ℂ) (u ε : ℂ) (hu : u ≠ 0) (hε : ε ≠ 0)
    (ha : 1 + 4 * u ^ 2 ≠ 0) :
    (1 + 4 * u ^ 2) • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) - (u ^ 2 / (1 + 4 * u ^ 2)) • (F * G) =
      schurScale u ε • normalizedQ F G u ε
theorems.description:
**The exact Schur identity:** eliminating the second sheet,
`(1 + 4u²)I − (u²/(1 + 4u²)) FG = ρ (M_ε(u)² + L_ε)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.normalized_schur_inverse
theorems.statement:
theorem normalized_schur_inverse (F G : Matrix n n ℂ) (u ε : ℂ) (hu : u ≠ 0) (hε : ε ≠ 0)
    (ha : 1 + 4 * u ^ 2 ≠ 0) (hQ : IsUnit (normalizedQ F G u ε).det) :
    (normalizedQ F G u ε)⁻¹ = schurScale u ε • ((sheetK F G u)⁻¹).toBlocks₁₁
theorems.description:
**The first-sheet block of the inverse is the normalized Green operator:**
`Q⁻¹ = ρ (K⁻¹)₁₁`.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.kinetic_sum_of_squares
theorems.statement:
theorem kinetic_sum_of_squares (U : Fin 5 → Matrix n n ℂ) (hU : ∀ t, U t * (U t)ᴴ = 1) :
    (25 : ℂ) • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) - (∑ t, U t) * (∑ t, U t)ᴴ =
      ∑ s : Fin 5, ∑ t : Fin 5, if s < t then (U s - U t) * (U s - U t)ᴴ else 0
theorems.description:
**The kinetic part is a sum of squares:** for five unitaries `U_t`, with `F = Σ U_t`,
`25 I − F F* = Σ_{s<t} (U_s − U_t)(U_s − U_t)*`.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.affine_change
theorems.statement:
theorem affine_change (F G : Matrix n n ℂ) (u v ε : ℂ) :
    normalizedQ F G v ε - normalizedQ F G u ε =
      (massIntercept v ε - massIntercept u ε) • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ)
theorems.description: **The affine change of the step weight shifts only the mass intercept.**

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.imaginary_quarter_intercept
theorems.statement:
theorem imaginary_quarter_intercept (ε : ℂ) (hε : ε ≠ 0) :
    ε ^ 2 * massIntercept (Complex.I / 4) ε = -34 / 5
theorems.description: At the point `u = i/4` the intercept is `M_ε²ε² = −34/5`.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.Zint_real

source_context.command: open MeasureTheory Complex Matrix Comparison Comparison.ArticleStatements

theorems.statement:
theorem Zint_real (w : Ω → ℝ) (q : Ω → ℤ) (hw : Integrable w μ) (hqm : Measurable q)
    (τ : Ω ≃ᵐ Ω) (hτ : MeasurePreserving τ μ μ) (hq : ∀ U, q (τ U) = -q U)
    (hwτ : ∀ U, w (τ U) = w U) (θ : ℝ) :
    Zint μ w q θ = ((∫ U, w U * Real.cos ((q U : ℝ) * θ) ∂μ : ℝ) : ℂ)
theorems.description: **The sector sum is real:** `Z(θ) = ∫ w cos(qθ)`.

source_context.command: open MeasureTheory Complex Matrix Comparison Comparison.ArticleStatements

theorems.statement:
theorem aSector_pos (w : Ω → ℝ) (q : Ω → ℤ) (hw : Integrable w μ) (hqm : Measurable q)
    (hw0 : ∀ U, 0 < w U) (n : ℤ) (hn : 0 < μ {U | q U = n}) : 0 < aSector μ w q n
theorems.description: **Every sector of positive measure has a positive weight.**

source_context.command: open MeasureTheory Complex Matrix Comparison Comparison.ArticleStatements

theorems.statement:
theorem aSector_symm (w : Ω → ℝ) (q : Ω → ℤ) (hqm : Measurable q) (τ : Ω ≃ᵐ Ω)
    (hτ : MeasurePreserving τ μ μ) (hq : ∀ U, q (τ U) = -q U) (hwτ : ∀ U, w (τ U) = w U)

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.Zint_max_iff

source_context.command: open MeasureTheory Complex Matrix Comparison Comparison.ArticleStatements

theorems.statement:
theorem Zint_max_iff (w : Ω → ℝ) (q : Ω → ℤ) (hw : Integrable w μ) (hqm : Measurable q)
    (hw0 : ∀ U, 0 < w U) (τ : Ω ≃ᵐ Ω) (hτ : MeasurePreserving τ μ μ) (hq : ∀ U, q (τ U) = -q U)
    (hwτ : ∀ U, w (τ U) = w U) (h0 : 0 < μ {U | q U = 0}) (h1 : 0 < μ {U | q U = 1}) (θ : ℝ) :
    ‖Zint μ w q θ‖ = ∫ U, w U ∂μ ↔ ∃ k : ℤ, θ = k * (2 * Real.pi)
theorems.description:
**The angle of the sectors is zero:** with the sectors `0` and `1` of positive measure,
`|Z(θ)| = Z(0)` exactly when `θ ∈ 2πℤ`.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.law_sector_integral

source_context.command: open MeasureTheory Complex Matrix Comparison Comparison.ArticleStatements

theorems.statement:
theorem law_sector_integral {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (Γ : Ω → Fin 5 → Matrix ι ι ℂ) (hH : ∀ U t, (Γ U t)ᴴ = Γ U t)
    (hG : ∀ U t, Γ U t * Γ U t = 1) (u : ℝ) (hu0 : 0 ≤ u) (hu : u < 1 / 4) (q : Ω → ℤ)
    (hqm : Measurable q) (hw : Integrable (fun U => ((1 - (u : ℂ) • stepOp (Γ U)).det).re) μ)
    (τ : Ω ≃ᵐ Ω) (hτ : MeasurePreserving τ μ μ) (hq : ∀ U, q (τ U) = -q U)
    (hΓτ : ∀ U, Γ (τ U) = conjConn (Γ U)) (h0 : 0 < μ {U | q U = 0})
    (h1 : 0 < μ {U | q U = 1}) (θ : ℝ) :
    (∀ U, 0 < ((1 - (u : ℂ) • stepOp (Γ U)).det).re) ∧
    ‖Zint μ (fun U => ((1 - (u : ℂ) • stepOp (Γ U)).det).re) q θ‖ ≤
      ∫ U, ((1 - (u : ℂ) • stepOp (Γ U)).det).re ∂μ ∧
    (‖Zint μ (fun U => ((1 - (u : ℂ) • stepOp (Γ U)).det).re) q θ‖ =
      ∫ U, ((1 - (u : ℂ) • stepOp (Γ U)).det).re ∂μ ↔ ∃ k : ℤ, θ = k * (2 * Real.pi))
theorems.description:
**Prop. 115 as an integral over the connections:** for a measurable family of unitary
connections, the law's weight `Re det(I − uB[Γ U])` is positive, and the sector integral is real, at
most its value at `θ = 0`, and equal to it only at `θ ∈ 2πℤ`.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.rot6Hom_apply
theorems.statement: theorem rot6Hom_apply (U : SU4) (t : E6) : rot6Hom U t = rot6V U t

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.kron_six
theorems.statement:
theorem kron_six (U : SU4) (t : E6) :
    ((U : Matrix Four Four ℂ) ⊗ₖ (U : Matrix Four Four ℂ)) *ᵥ relOf (ι6 t) =
      relOf (ι6 (rot6Hom U t))
theorems.description: In the two-system language: `U ⊗ U` carries the two-spinor state of `ι(t)` to that of `ι(R_U t)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.gE_toLp
theorems.statement: theorem gE_toLp (f : Fin 5 → ℝ) : gE (WithLp.toLp 2 f) = ∑ s, ((f s : ℝ) : ℂ) • γ s

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.gE_add
theorems.statement: theorem gE_add (x y : E5) : gE (x + y) = gE x + gE y

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.gE_smul
theorems.statement: theorem gE_smul (c : ℝ) (x : E5) : gE (c • x) = (c : ℂ) • gE x

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.gE_neg
theorems.statement: theorem gE_neg (x : E5) : gE (-x) = -gE x

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.gE_sub
theorems.statement: theorem gE_sub (x y : E5) : gE (x - y) = gE x - gE y

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.coord_gE
theorems.statement: theorem coord_gE (x : E5) : coord (gE x) = x.ofLp

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.gE_injective
theorems.statement: theorem gE_injective : Function.Injective gE

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.gE_isDistinction
theorems.statement: theorem gE_isDistinction (x : E5) : IsDistinction (gE x)

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.gE_hermitian
theorems.statement: theorem gE_hermitian (x : E5) : (gE x)ᴴ = gE x

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.gE_sq
theorems.statement: theorem gE_sq (x : E5) : gE x * gE x = ((∑ s, x s ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) • (1 : Matrix Four Four ℂ)

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.gE_anti
theorems.statement:
theorem gE_anti (x y : E5) :
    gE x * gE y + gE y * gE x = ((2 * ∑ s, x s * y s : ℝ) : ℂ) • (1 : Matrix Four Four ℂ)

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.gE_single
theorems.statement: theorem gE_single (s : Fin 5) : gE (EuclideanSpace.single s 1) = γ s

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.mat_mul
theorems.statement: theorem mat_mul (U V : Sp2) : mat (U * V) = mat U * mat V

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.mat_one
theorems.statement: theorem mat_one : mat 1 = 1

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.mat_inv
theorems.statement: theorem mat_inv (U : Sp2) : mat U⁻¹ = star (mat U)

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.sp2_unitary
theorems.statement: theorem sp2_unitary (U : Sp2) : mat U * star (mat U) = 1

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.sp2_unitary'
theorems.statement: theorem sp2_unitary' (U : Sp2) : star (mat U) * mat U = 1

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.sp2_keepJ
theorems.statement: theorem sp2_keepJ (U : Sp2) : mat U * J * (mat U)ᵀ = J

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.sp2_partner
theorems.statement: theorem sp2_partner (U : Sp2) : ∀ v, mat U *ᵥ Θ v = Θ (mat U *ᵥ v)

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.sp2_det
theorems.statement: theorem sp2_det (U : Sp2) : (mat U).det = 1
theorems.description: **The ten rotations have determinant one.**

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.conj_isDistinction
theorems.statement:
theorem conj_isDistinction (U : Sp2) {a : Matrix Four Four ℂ} (ha : IsDistinction a) :
    IsDistinction (mat U * a * star (mat U))
theorems.description: A rotation of `Sp(2)` carries a distinction to a distinction.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.sp2_conj_line
theorems.statement: theorem sp2_conj_line (U : Sp2) (x : E5) : gE (rotV U x) = mat U * gE x * star (mat U)

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.rotV_add
theorems.statement: theorem rotV_add (U : Sp2) (x y : E5) : rotV U (x + y) = rotV U x + rotV U y

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.rotV_smul
theorems.statement: theorem rotV_smul (U : Sp2) (c : ℝ) (x : E5) : rotV U (c • x) = c • rotV U x

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.rotV_sumsq
theorems.statement: theorem rotV_sumsq (U : Sp2) (x : E5) : ∑ s, rotV U x s ^ 2 = ∑ s, x s ^ 2

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.rotV_norm
theorems.statement: theorem rotV_norm (U : Sp2) (x : E5) : ‖rotV U x‖ = ‖x‖

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.rotE_apply
theorems.statement: theorem rotE_apply (U : Sp2) (x : E5) : rotE U x = rotV U x

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.rotV_one
theorems.statement: theorem rotV_one (x : E5) : rotV 1 x = x

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.rotV_mul
theorems.statement: theorem rotV_mul (U V : Sp2) (x : E5) : rotV (U * V) x = rotV U (rotV V x)

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.rotHom_apply
theorems.statement: theorem rotHom_apply (U : Sp2) (x : E5) : rotHom U x = rotV U x

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.inner_E5
theorems.statement: theorem inner_E5 (x y : E5) : inner ℝ x y = ∑ s, x s * y s

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.norm_sq_E5
theorems.statement: theorem norm_sq_E5 (x : E5) : ‖x‖ ^ 2 = ∑ s, x s ^ 2

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.refl_apply
theorems.statement:
theorem refl_apply (u x : E5) :
    (ℝ ∙ u)ᗮ.reflection x = x - (2 * (inner ℝ u x / ‖u‖ ^ 2)) • u
theorems.description: The reflection in `u^⊥`: `ρ_u x = x − (2⟨u, x⟩/‖u‖²) u`.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.mat_lineElt
theorems.statement: theorem mat_lineElt (v : E5) (hv : ∑ s, v s ^ 2 = 1) : mat (lineElt v hv) = gE v

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.rot_lineElt
theorems.statement:
theorem rot_lineElt (v : E5) (hv : ∑ s, v s ^ 2 = 1) (x : E5) :
    rotV (lineElt v hv) x = -((ℝ ∙ v)ᗮ.reflection x)
theorems.description: **A unit line acts on the five directions as minus the reflection in its perpendicular.**

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.plane_turn
theorems.statement:
theorem plane_turn (a b : Fin 5) (hab : a ≠ b) (c s : ℂ) :
    (c • (1 : Matrix Four Four ℂ) + s • (γ a * γ b)) * γ a *
        (c • (1 : Matrix Four Four ℂ) - s • (γ a * γ b)) =
      (c ^ 2 - s ^ 2) • γ a - (2 * c * s) • γ b
theorems.description:
**The generator `½γ_aγ_b` turns the plane `(a, b)`:** `c + sγ_aγ_b` carries `γ_a` to
`(c² − s²)γ_a − 2cs γ_b`.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.comm_obs
theorems.statement:
theorem comm_obs (M : Matrix Four Four ℂ) (h : ∀ s, γ s * M = M * γ s) (k : Fin 16) :
    Commute (obs k) M

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.commute_all
theorems.statement:
theorem commute_all (M : Matrix Four Four ℂ) (h : ∀ s, γ s * M = M * γ s)
    (A : Matrix Four Four ℂ) : Commute A M

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.scalar_of_comm
theorems.statement:
theorem scalar_of_comm (M : Matrix Four Four ℂ) (h : ∀ s, γ s * M = M * γ s) :
    ∃ c : ℂ, M = c • (1 : Matrix Four Four ℂ)
theorems.description: **What commutes with the five directions is a number.**

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.conj_gamma_of_rot
theorems.statement:
theorem conj_gamma_of_rot (U : Sp2) (hU : ∀ x, rotV U x = x) (s : Fin 5) :
    γ s * mat U = mat U * γ s

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.rot_ker
theorems.statement: theorem rot_ker (U : Sp2) : rotHom U = 1 ↔ mat U = 1 ∨ mat U = -1
theorems.description: **The kernel: `R_U = 1` exactly when `U = ±1`.**

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.no_reversal
theorems.statement: theorem no_reversal (V : Sp2) (hV : ∀ x, rotV V x = -x) : False
theorems.description: A rotation that reverses every line does not exist: `γ₀γ₁γ₂γ₃γ₄ = 1`.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.det_refl
theorems.statement: theorem det_refl (v : E5) : LinearMap.det (refl v).toLinearMap = if v = 0 then 1 else -1

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.realize
theorems.statement:
theorem realize (l : List E5) :
    ∃ W : Sp2, ∀ x, (l.map refl).prod x = ((-1 : ℝ) ^ nz l) • rotV W x
theorems.description: **Every product of reflections is `±R_W`** for some `W ∈ Sp(2)`, with sign `(−1)^{nz}`.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.det_prod_refl
theorems.statement:
theorem det_prod_refl (l : List E5) :
    LinearMap.det ((l.map refl).prod).toLinearMap = (-1 : ℝ) ^ nz l

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.rotV_neg
theorems.statement: theorem rotV_neg (W : Sp2) (x : E5) : rotV W (-x) = -rotV W x

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.rot_det
theorems.statement: theorem rot_det (U : Sp2) : LinearMap.det (rotHom U).toLinearMap = 1
theorems.description: **`det R_U = 1`: the ten rotations give rotations.**

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.rot_onto
theorems.statement:
theorem rot_onto (φ : E5 ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E5) (hφ : LinearMap.det φ.toLinearMap = 1) :
    ∃ U : Sp2, rotHom U = φ
theorems.description: **`Sp(2)` maps onto `SO(5)`.**

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.sp2_mod_sign_is_SO5
theorems.statement:
theorem sp2_mod_sign_is_SO5 :
    (∀ U : Sp2, LinearMap.det (rotHom U).toLinearMap = 1) ∧
    (∀ φ : E5 ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E5, LinearMap.det φ.toLinearMap = 1 → ∃ U : Sp2, rotHom U = φ) ∧
    (∀ U : Sp2, rotHom U = 1 ↔ mat U = 1 ∨ mat U = -1)
theorems.description: **`Sp(2)/{±1} = SO(5)`**, in one statement.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.det_reflection_zero
theorems.statement:
theorem det_reflection_zero {F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [InnerProductSpace ℝ F]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ F] :
    LinearMap.det ((ℝ ∙ (0 : F))ᗮ.reflection).toLinearMap = 1

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.det_reflection_ne
theorems.statement:
theorem det_reflection_ne {F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [InnerProductSpace ℝ F]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ F] {v : F} (hv : v ≠ 0) :
    LinearMap.det ((ℝ ∙ v)ᗮ.reflection).toLinearMap = -1

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.det_prod_reflection_pm
theorems.statement:
theorem det_prod_reflection_pm {F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [InnerProductSpace ℝ F]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ F] (l : List F) :
    LinearMap.det ((l.map fun v => (ℝ ∙ v)ᗮ.reflection).prod).toLinearMap = 1 ∨
      LinearMap.det ((l.map fun v => (ℝ ∙ v)ᗮ.reflection).prod).toLinearMap = -1

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.det_isometry_pm
theorems.statement:
theorem det_isometry_pm {F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [InnerProductSpace ℝ F]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ F] (φ : F ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] F) :
    LinearMap.det φ.toLinearMap = 1 ∨ LinearMap.det φ.toLinearMap = -1
theorems.description: **The determinant of an isometry is `±1`** (Cartan–Dieudonné).

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.det_mul_isometry
theorems.statement:
theorem det_mul_isometry {F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [InnerProductSpace ℝ F]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ F] (φ ψ : F ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] F) :
    LinearMap.det (φ * ψ).toLinearMap =
      LinearMap.det φ.toLinearMap * LinearMap.det ψ.toLinearMap

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.toSU4_coe
theorems.statement: theorem toSU4_coe (W : Sp2) : ((toSU4 W : SU4) : Matrix Four Four ℂ) = mat W

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.embL_zero
theorems.statement: theorem embL_zero (x : E5) : embL x 0 = 0

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.embL_succ
theorems.statement: theorem embL_succ (x : E5) (j : Fin 5) : embL x j.succ = x j

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.tailL_embL
theorems.statement: theorem tailL_embL (x : E5) : tailL (embL x) = x

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.e0_zero
theorems.statement: theorem e0_zero : e0 0 = 1

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.e0_succ
theorems.statement: theorem e0_succ (j : Fin 5) : e0 j.succ = 0

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.decomp_six
theorems.statement: theorem decomp_six (t : E6) : t = t 0 • e0 + embL (tailL t)

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.sumsq_embL
theorems.statement: theorem sumsq_embL (x : E5) : ∑ a, embL x a ^ 2 = ∑ j, x j ^ 2

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.norm_embL
theorems.statement: theorem norm_embL (x : E5) : ‖embL x‖ = ‖x‖

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.ι6_e0
theorems.statement: theorem ι6_e0 : ι6 e0 = J

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.ι6_embL
theorems.statement: theorem ι6_embL (x : E5) : ι6 (embL x) = I • (gE x * J)

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.ι6_add_smul
theorems.statement: theorem ι6_add_smul (a : ℝ) (x : E5) : ι6 (a • e0 + embL x) = (a : ℂ) • J + I • (gE x * J)

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.J_transpose_sp2
theorems.statement: theorem J_transpose_sp2 (W : Sp2) : J * (mat W)ᵀ = star (mat W) * J

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.rot6_sp2_e0
theorems.statement: theorem rot6_sp2_e0 (W : Sp2) : rot6V (toSU4 W) e0 = e0

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.rot6_sp2_emb
theorems.statement: theorem rot6_sp2_emb (W : Sp2) (x : E5) : rot6V (toSU4 W) (embL x) = embL (rotV W x)
theorems.description: **A rotation of `Sp(2)` turns the five `iℓ_s` as it turns the five directions.**

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.toSU4_sp2OfFix
theorems.statement: theorem toSU4_sp2OfFix (V : SU4) (h : rot6V V e0 = e0) : toSU4 (sp2OfFix V h) = V

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.stabilizer_singlet
theorems.statement:
theorem stabilizer_singlet (U : SU4) :
    rot6Hom U e0 = e0 ↔ (U : Matrix Four Four ℂ) * J * (U : Matrix Four Four ℂ)ᵀ = J
theorems.description: **The rotations that keep the singlet are `Sp(2)`.**

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.b6_zero
theorems.statement: theorem b6_zero : b6 0 = e0

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.b6_succ
theorems.statement: theorem b6_succ (s : Fin 5) : b6 s.succ = embL (b5 s)

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.det_block
theorems.statement:
theorem det_block (f : E6 →ₗ[ℝ] E6) (g : E5 →ₗ[ℝ] E5) (h0 : f e0 = e0)
    (h1 : ∀ x, f (embL x) = embL (g x)) : LinearMap.det f = LinearMap.det g
theorems.description: **A map that fixes `e₀` and acts on the five as `g` has the determinant of `g`.**

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.rot6_sp2_det
theorems.statement: theorem rot6_sp2_det (W : Sp2) : LinearMap.det (rot6Hom (toSU4 W)).toLinearMap = 1

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.Kmat_sq
theorems.statement: theorem Kmat_sq (m : E5) (hm : ∑ k, m k ^ 2 = 1) : Kmat m * Kmat m = -1

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.Kmat_star
theorems.statement: theorem Kmat_star (m : E5) : star (Kmat m) = -Kmat m

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.gE_J_transpose
theorems.statement: theorem gE_J_transpose (m : E5) : J * (gE m)ᵀ = gE m * J

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.boostM_sq
theorems.statement:
theorem boostM_sq (c s : ℝ) (m : E5) (hm : ∑ k, m k ^ 2 = 1) :
    boostM c s m * boostM c s m = boostM (c ^ 2 - s ^ 2) (2 * c * s) m

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.boostM_star
theorems.statement:
theorem boostM_star (c s : ℝ) (m : E5) :
    star (boostM c s m) = (c : ℂ) • (1 : Matrix Four Four ℂ) - (s : ℂ) • Kmat m

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.boostM_unitary
theorems.statement:
theorem boostM_unitary (c s : ℝ) (m : E5) (hcs : c ^ 2 + s ^ 2 = 1) (hm : ∑ k, m k ^ 2 = 1) :
    boostM c s m * star (boostM c s m) = 1

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.boostM_det
theorems.statement:
theorem boostM_det (c s : ℝ) (m : E5) (hcs : c ^ 2 + s ^ 2 = 1) (hm : ∑ k, m k ^ 2 = 1) :
    (boostM c s m).det = 1

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.boost_coe
theorems.statement:
theorem boost_coe (c s : ℝ) (m : E5) (hcs : c ^ 2 + s ^ 2 = 1) (hm : ∑ k, m k ^ 2 = 1) :
    ((boost c s m hcs hm : SU4) : Matrix Four Four ℂ) = boostM c s m

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.boostM_J
theorems.statement:
theorem boostM_J (c s : ℝ) (m : E5) (hm : ∑ k, m k ^ 2 = 1) :
    boostM c s m * J * (boostM c s m)ᵀ =
      ((c ^ 2 - s ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) • J + I • (gE ((2 * c * s) • m) * J)

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.rot6_boost
theorems.statement:
theorem rot6_boost (c s : ℝ) (m : E5) (hcs : c ^ 2 + s ^ 2 = 1) (hm : ∑ k, m k ^ 2 = 1) :
    rot6V (boost c s m hcs hm) e0 = (c ^ 2 - s ^ 2) • e0 + embL ((2 * c * s) • m)
theorems.description: **The boost turns `e₀` to `(c² − s²) e₀ + 2cs·m`.**

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.turn_singlet
theorems.statement:
theorem turn_singlet (a : ℝ) (s : Fin 5) :
    (boostM (Real.cos a) (Real.sin a) (EuclideanSpace.single s 1) ⊗ₖ
        boostM (Real.cos a) (Real.sin a) (EuclideanSpace.single s 1)) *ᵥ Ω =
      (Real.cos (2 * a) : ℂ) • Ω + (Real.sin (2 * a) : ℂ) • (I • ((γ s ⊗ₖ 1) *ᵥ Ω))
theorems.description:
**`(e^{iaγ_s} ⊗ e^{iaγ_s}) Ω = cos 2a Ω + sin 2a iℓ_s`**, with `e^{iaγ_s} = cos a + i sin a γ_s`
and `ℓ_s = (γ_s ⊗ 1) Ω`.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.sumsq_tail
theorems.statement: theorem sumsq_tail (n : E6) : ∑ a, n a ^ 2 = n 0 ^ 2 + ∑ j, tailL n j ^ 2

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.exists_boost
theorems.statement:
theorem exists_boost (n : E6) (hn : ∑ a, n a ^ 2 = 1) :
    ∃ (c s : ℝ) (m : E5) (hcs : c ^ 2 + s ^ 2 = 1) (hm : ∑ k, m k ^ 2 = 1),
      0 ≤ s ∧ rot6V (boost c s m hcs hm) e0 = n

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.places_of_singlet
theorems.statement: theorem places_of_singlet (n : E6) (hn : ‖n‖ = 1) : ∃ U : SU4, rot6Hom U e0 = n
theorems.description: **`SU(4)` takes `Ω` to every unit vector of the six: the vertices of the singlet are `S⁵`.**

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.boost_half
theorems.statement:
theorem boost_half (c s : ℝ) (m : E5) (hcs : c ^ 2 + s ^ 2 = 1) (hm : ∑ k, m k ^ 2 = 1)
    (hs : 0 ≤ s) : ∃ (c' s' : ℝ) (hcs' : c' ^ 2 + s' ^ 2 = 1),
      boost c s m hcs hm = boost c' s' m hcs' hm * boost c' s' m hcs' hm
theorems.description: The half boost.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.rot6_boost_det
theorems.statement:
theorem rot6_boost_det (c s : ℝ) (m : E5) (hcs : c ^ 2 + s ^ 2 = 1) (hm : ∑ k, m k ^ 2 = 1)
    (hs : 0 ≤ s) : LinearMap.det (rot6Hom (boost c s m hcs hm)).toLinearMap = 1

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.su4_star_mul
theorems.statement: theorem su4_star_mul (U : SU4) : star U * U = 1

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.su4_mul_star
theorems.statement: theorem su4_mul_star (U : SU4) : U * star U = 1

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.rot6_det
theorems.statement: theorem rot6_det (U : SU4) : LinearMap.det (rot6Hom U).toLinearMap = 1
theorems.description: **`det R_U = 1`: the fifteen rotations give rotations.**

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.rot6_onto
theorems.statement:
theorem rot6_onto (φ : E6 ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E6) (hφ : LinearMap.det φ.toLinearMap = 1) :
    ∃ U : SU4, rot6Hom U = φ
theorems.description: **`SU(4)` maps onto `SO(6)`.**

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.rot6_ker
theorems.statement:
theorem rot6_ker (U : SU4) :
    rot6Hom U = 1 ↔ (U : Matrix Four Four ℂ) = 1 ∨ (U : Matrix Four Four ℂ) = -1
theorems.description: **The kernel: `R_U = 1` exactly when `U = ±1`.**

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.su4_mod_sign_is_SO6
theorems.statement:
theorem su4_mod_sign_is_SO6 :
    (∀ U : SU4, LinearMap.det (rot6Hom U).toLinearMap = 1) ∧
    (∀ φ : E6 ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E6, LinearMap.det φ.toLinearMap = 1 → ∃ U : SU4, rot6Hom U = φ) ∧
    (∀ U : SU4, rot6Hom U = 1 ↔ (U : Matrix Four Four ℂ) = 1 ∨ (U : Matrix Four Four ℂ) = -1)
theorems.description: **`SU(4)/{±1} = SO(6)`**, in one statement.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.iOne_unitary
theorems.statement:
theorem iOne_unitary :
    (I • (1 : Matrix Four Four ℂ)) * star (I • (1 : Matrix Four Four ℂ)) = 1

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.iOne_det
theorems.statement: theorem iOne_det : (I • (1 : Matrix Four Four ℂ)).det = 1

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.rot6_i
theorems.statement: theorem rot6_i (t : E6) : rot6Hom iOne t = -t

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.cos_le_quartic
theorems.statement: theorem cos_le_quartic (x : ℝ) : cos x ≤ 1 - x ^ 2 / 2 + x ^ 4 / 24
theorems.description: **`cos x ≤ 1 − x²/2 + x⁴/24`** for every real `x`.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.two_div_pi_sq_le
theorems.statement: theorem two_div_pi_sq_le (x : ℝ) (hx : |x| ≤ π) : 2 * x ^ 2 / π ^ 2 ≤ 1 - cos x
theorems.description: **`2x²/π² ≤ 1 − cos x`** for `|x| ≤ π`.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.pairSum_eq
theorems.statement:
theorem pairSum_eq (f : Fin 5 → Fin 5 → ℝ) :
    pairSum f = f 0 1 + f 0 2 + f 0 3 + f 0 4 + f 1 2 + f 1 3 + f 1 4 + f 2 3 + f 2 4 + f 3 4

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.norm2_nonneg
theorems.statement: theorem norm2_nonneg (p : Fin 5 → ℝ) : 0 ≤ norm2 p

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.norm2_expand
theorems.statement:
theorem norm2_expand (p : Fin 5 → ℝ) :
    norm2 p = p 0 ^ 2 + p 1 ^ 2 + p 2 ^ 2 + p 3 ^ 2 + p 4 ^ 2

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.last_of_sum
theorems.statement: theorem last_of_sum (p : Fin 5 → ℝ) (hp : ∑ i, p i = 0) : p 4 = -(p 0 + p 1 + p 2 + p 3)

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.roots_quadratic
theorems.statement:
theorem roots_quadratic (p : Fin 5 → ℝ) (hp : ∑ i, p i = 0) :
    pairSum (fun s t => (p s - p t) ^ 2) = 5 * norm2 p

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.pair_le_two_norm
theorems.statement:
theorem pair_le_two_norm (p : Fin 5 → ℝ) (s t : Fin 5) (hst : s ≠ t) :
    (p s - p t) ^ 2 ≤ 2 * norm2 p

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.roots_quartic_bound
theorems.statement:
theorem roots_quartic_bound (p : Fin 5 → ℝ) (hp : ∑ i, p i = 0) :
    pairSum (fun s t => (p s - p t) ^ 4) ≤ 10 * norm2 p ^ 2

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.basis_root_lower
theorems.statement:
theorem basis_root_lower (p : Fin 5 → ℝ) (hp : ∑ i, p i = 0) :
    norm2 p ≤ (p 0 - p 4) ^ 2 + (p 1 - p 4) ^ 2 + (p 2 - p 4) ^ 2 + (p 3 - p 4) ^ 2

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.lam_nonneg
theorems.statement: theorem lam_nonneg (ε : ℝ) (p : Fin 5 → ℝ) : 0 ≤ lam ε p

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.pair_error
theorems.description: One pair: `0 ≤ d²/5 − (2/(5ε²))(1 − cos εd) ≤ ε²d⁴/60`.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.lambda_error
theorems.statement:
theorem lambda_error (ε : ℝ) (hε : ε ≠ 0) (p : Fin 5 → ℝ) (hp : ∑ i, p i = 0) :
    0 ≤ norm2 p - lam ε p ∧ norm2 p - lam ε p ≤ ε ^ 2 / 6 * norm2 p ^ 2

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.lambda_cell_lower
theorems.statement:
theorem lambda_cell_lower (ε : ℝ) (hε : ε ≠ 0) (p : Fin 5 → ℝ) (hp : ∑ i, p i = 0)
    (hcell : ∀ i : Fin 4, |ε * (p i.castSucc - p 4)| ≤ π) :
    4 / (5 * π ^ 2) * norm2 p ≤ lam ε p
theorems.description: **On the reciprocal cell the symbol is elliptic:** `λ_ε(p) ≥ 4|p|²/(5π²)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.inverse_symbol_bound
theorems.statement:
theorem inverse_symbol_bound (ε M : ℝ) (hε : ε ≠ 0) (p : Fin 5 → ℝ) (hp : ∑ i, p i = 0)
    (hcell : ∀ i : Fin 4, |ε * (p i.castSucc - p 4)| ≤ π) :
    |(M ^ 2 + lam ε p)⁻¹ - (M ^ 2 + norm2 p)⁻¹| ≤ normConst ε
theorems.description: **On the cell, the lattice and continuum resolvent symbols differ by at most `5π²ε²/24`.**

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.outside_cell_inverse_bound
theorems.statement:
theorem outside_cell_inverse_bound (ε M : ℝ) (p : Fin 5 → ℝ)
    (hout : ∃ i : Fin 4, π ≤ |ε * (p i.castSucc - p 4)|) :
    (M ^ 2 + norm2 p)⁻¹ ≤ 2 * ε ^ 2 / π ^ 2
theorems.description: **Off the cell the continuum symbol is small:** `(M² + |p|²)⁻¹ ≤ 2ε²/π²`.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.two_div_pi_sq_le_normConst
theorems.statement: theorem two_div_pi_sq_le_normConst (ε : ℝ) : 2 * ε ^ 2 / π ^ 2 ≤ normConst ε

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.multiplier_bound
theorems.statement:
theorem multiplier_bound (ε M : ℝ) (hε : ε ≠ 0) (p : Fin 5 → ℝ) (hp : ∑ i, p i = 0) :
    |latticeMult ε M p - continuumMult M p| ≤ normConst ε
theorems.description: **The two multipliers differ by at most `5π²ε²/24` at every momentum of `W`.**

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.lam_continuous
theorems.statement: theorem lam_continuous (ε : ℝ) : Continuous (lam ε)

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.norm2_continuous
theorems.statement: theorem norm2_continuous : Continuous norm2

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.latticeMult_measurable
theorems.statement: theorem latticeMult_measurable (ε M : ℝ) : Measurable (latticeMult ε M)

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.continuumMult_measurable
theorems.statement: theorem continuumMult_measurable (M : ℝ) : Measurable (continuumMult M)

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.resolvent_norm_bound
theorems.statement:
theorem resolvent_norm_bound (ε M : ℝ) (hε : ε ≠ 0) (μ : Measure (Fin 5 → ℝ))
    (hμ : ∀ᵐ p ∂μ, ∑ i, p i = 0) (f : (Fin 5 → ℝ) → ℂ) (hf : AEStronglyMeasurable f μ) :
    eLpNorm (fun p => ((latticeMult ε M p - continuumMult M p : ℝ) : ℂ) * f p) 2 μ ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (normConst ε) * eLpNorm f 2 μ
theorems.description:
**The norm bound on the interpolated resolvents:** for every measure on the momenta carried by `W`
(the Lebesgue measure of `W`, or the finite Fourier modes of a periodic torus), the difference of the
interpolated lattice resolvent and the continuum resolvent, acting by multiplication on the Fourier
side, has `‖(R_ε − R_0) f‖₂ ≤ (5π²ε²/24) ‖f‖₂`.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.γv_isDistinction
theorems.statement: theorem γv_isDistinction (n : Fin 5 → ℝ) : IsDistinction (γv n)

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.commutes_lin
theorems.statement:
theorem commutes_lin (X Y : Matrix Four Four ℂ) (hX : X * J = J * X.map star)
    (hY : Y * J = J * Y.map star) (a b : ℝ) :
    ((a : ℂ) • X + (b : ℂ) • Y) * J = J * ((a : ℂ) • X + (b : ℂ) • Y).map star

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.one_commutes
theorems.statement: theorem one_commutes : (1 : Matrix Four Four ℂ) * J = J * (1 : Matrix Four Four ℂ).map star

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.side_isQProj
theorems.statement: theorem side_isQProj (n : Fin 5 → ℝ) (hn : ∑ s, n s ^ 2 = 1) : IsQProj (side n)
theorems.description: **Each side of a unit line is a quaternionic line.**

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.qproj_eq_side
theorems.statement:
theorem qproj_eq_side (P : Matrix Four Four ℂ) (hP : IsQProj P) :
    ∃ n : Fin 5 → ℝ, ∑ s, n s ^ 2 = 1 ∧ P = side n
theorems.description: **Every quaternionic line is the side of a unit line.**

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.side_injective
theorems.statement: theorem side_injective : Function.Injective side

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.twistor_projector
theorems.statement:
theorem twistor_projector (ψ : Four → ℂ) :
    (normSq ψ : ℂ) • (1 : Matrix Four Four ℂ) + γv (lineOf ψ) =
      (2 : ℂ) • (vecMulVec ψ (star ψ) + vecMulVec (Θ ψ) (star (Θ ψ)))

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.side_lineOf
theorems.statement:
theorem side_lineOf (ψ : Four → ℂ) (hψ : normSq ψ = 1) :
    side (lineOf ψ) = vecMulVec ψ (star ψ) + vecMulVec (Θ ψ) (star (Θ ψ))
theorems.description: **`Q_{n(ψ)} = |ψ⟩⟨ψ| + |Θψ⟩⟨Θψ|`** for a unit state.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.lineOf_phase
theorems.statement:
theorem lineOf_phase (c : ℂ) (ψ : Four → ℂ) (s : Fin 5) :
    lineOf (c • ψ) s = Complex.normSq c * lineOf ψ s
theorems.description: The line of a state depends only on the state up to a factor: `n(cψ) = |c|² n(ψ)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.vecMulVec_mulVec'
theorems.statement:
theorem vecMulVec_mulVec' (a b v : Four → ℂ) :
    vecMulVec a (star b) *ᵥ v = (star b ⬝ᵥ v) • a

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.dot_Θ_self
theorems.statement: theorem dot_Θ_self (ψ : Four → ℂ) : star (Θ ψ) ⬝ᵥ ψ = 0

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.normSq_Θ
theorems.statement: theorem normSq_Θ (ψ : Four → ℂ) : star (Θ ψ) ⬝ᵥ Θ ψ = star ψ ⬝ᵥ ψ

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.side_lineOf_fixes
theorems.statement:
theorem side_lineOf_fixes (ψ : Four → ℂ) (hψ : normSq ψ = 1) :
    side (lineOf ψ) *ᵥ ψ = ψ ∧ side (lineOf ψ) *ᵥ Θ ψ = Θ ψ
theorems.description: The side of `n(ψ)` holds `ψ` and `Θψ`.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.lineOf_of_side
theorems.statement:
theorem lineOf_of_side (n : Fin 5 → ℝ) (hn : ∑ s, n s ^ 2 = 1) (φ : Four → ℂ)
    (hφ : normSq φ = 1) (h : side n *ᵥ φ = φ) : lineOf φ = n
theorems.description: On the plus side of a unit line, a unit state has that line.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.fibre_iff
theorems.statement:
theorem fibre_iff (ψ φ : Four → ℂ) (hψ : normSq ψ = 1) (hφ : normSq φ = 1) :
    lineOf φ = lineOf ψ ↔ ∃ a b : ℂ, φ = a • ψ + b • Θ ψ
theorems.description: **The fibre: for unit states, `n(φ) = n(ψ)` iff `φ ∈ span{ψ, Θψ}`.**

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.L_two
theorems.statement: theorem L_two : L = (2 : ℂ) • swap + (2 : ℂ) • Eop

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.ward_local
theorems.statement:
theorem ward_local :
    gravityLeg - clockLeg =
      ((6 : ℂ) • (1 : Matrix Two Two ℂ) - L) * ((1 / 32 : ℂ) • ((3 : ℂ) • L + (2 : ℂ) • 1))
theorems.description: **The local Ward identity at the singlet:** `Γ_g − Γ_t = (6I − L)(3L + 2I)/32`.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.ward_bass
theorems.statement:
theorem ward_bass :
    gravityLeg - clockLeg = bass16 (1 / 4) * ((1 / 8 : ℂ) • ((3 : ℂ) • L + (2 : ℂ) • 1))
theorems.description: The same identity with the critical Bass operator `K₁₆(1/4) = (6I − L)/4`.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.ward_legs
theorems.statement:
theorem ward_legs :
    ArticleStatements.projSinglet * clockLeg = ArticleStatements.projSinglet ∧
      clockLeg * ArticleStatements.projSinglet = ArticleStatements.projSinglet ∧
      ArticleStatements.projSinglet * gravityLeg = ArticleStatements.projSinglet ∧
      gravityLeg * ArticleStatements.projSinglet = ArticleStatements.projSinglet
theorems.description: **Both vertices are one on the singlet:** `Π Γ_t = Γ_t Π = Π Γ_g = Γ_g Π = Π`, `Π = E/4`.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.Eop_mulVec_singlet
theorems.statement: theorem Eop_mulVec_singlet : Eop *ᵥ Ω = (4 : ℂ) • Ω

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.Ω_ne_zero
theorems.statement: theorem Ω_ne_zero : Ω ≠ 0

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.legs_on_singlet
theorems.statement: theorem legs_on_singlet : clockLeg *ᵥ Ω = Ω ∧ gravityLeg *ᵥ Ω = Ω
theorems.description: **The legs are one on the singlet:** `Γ_t Ω = Ω` and `Γ_g Ω = Ω`.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.ward_normalization_unique
theorems.statement:
theorem ward_normalization_unique (c d : ℂ) (hc : (c • swap) *ᵥ Ω = Ω)
    (hd : (d • Eop) *ᵥ Ω = Ω) : c = -1 ∧ d = 1 / 4
theorems.description:
**The normalization is unique:** a multiple of `P` or of `E` that is one on `Ω` is `−P` or
`E/4`.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.L_mulVec_singlet
theorems.statement: theorem L_mulVec_singlet : L *ᵥ Ω = (6 : ℂ) • Ω

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.two_source_singlet
theorems.statement:
theorem two_source_singlet (u jt jg m : ℂ) :
    (bass16 u - (jt * m) • clockLeg - (jg * m) • gravityLeg) *ᵥ Ω =
      (1 - 5 * u + 4 * u ^ 2 - m * (jt + jg)) • Ω
theorems.description:
**One numerator for both sources:** the singlet block of `K₁₆(u) − j_t m Γ_t − j_g m Γ_g` is
`1 − 5u + 4u² − m(j_t + j_g)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.singletCol_sandwich
theorems.statement:
theorem singletCol_sandwich (Γ : Matrix Two Two ℂ) :
    singletColᴴ * Γ * singletCol = Matrix.of fun _ _ => star Ω ⬝ᵥ (Γ *ᵥ Ω)

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.connector_sandwich
theorems.statement:
theorem connector_sandwich {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] (Γ : Matrix Two Two ℂ)
    (M : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    (connector n)ᴴ * (Γ ⊗ₖ M) * connector n =
