      (Matrix.of fun _ _ => star Ω ⬝ᵥ (Γ *ᵥ Ω) : Matrix Unit Unit ℂ) ⊗ₖ M
theorems.description: **The connector glues any internal matrix to a leg:** `V†(Γ ⊗ M)V = ⟨Ω, ΓΩ⟩ ⊗ M`.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.unit_one
theorems.statement: theorem unit_one : (Matrix.of fun _ _ => (1 : ℂ) : Matrix Unit Unit ℂ) = 1

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.connector_leg
theorems.statement:
theorem connector_leg {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] (M : Matrix n n ℂ) :
    (connector n)ᴴ * (clockLeg ⊗ₖ M) * connector n = (1 : Matrix Unit Unit ℂ) ⊗ₖ M ∧
      (connector n)ᴴ * (gravityLeg ⊗ₖ M) * connector n = (1 : Matrix Unit Unit ℂ) ⊗ₖ M
theorems.description: **Both legs glue the same internal matrix:** `V†(Γ_t ⊗ M)V = V†(Γ_g ⊗ M)V = 1 ⊗ M`.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.proj_reverse
theorems.statement: theorem proj_reverse : Π_F * Π₀ = 0 ∧ Π_L * Π₀ = 0 ∧ Π_L * Π_F = 0

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.proj_mul
theorems.statement:
theorem proj_mul (a b c a' b' c' : ℂ) :
    (a • Π₀ + b • Π_F + c • Π_L) * (a' • Π₀ + b' • Π_F + c' • Π_L) =
      (a * a') • Π₀ + (b * b') • Π_F + (c * c') • Π_L
theorems.description: Products of combinations of the three orthogonal projectors multiply their coefficients.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.one_proj
theorems.statement: theorem one_proj : (1 : Matrix Two Two ℂ) = (1 : ℂ) • Π₀ + (1 : ℂ) • Π_F + (1 : ℂ) • Π_L

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.kb_eq
theorems.statement: theorem kb_eq : kb = (0 : ℂ) • Π₀ + (1 : ℂ) • Π_F + (2 : ℂ) • Π_L

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.swap_eq_proj
theorems.statement: theorem swap_eq_proj : swap = (-1 : ℂ) • Π₀ + (1 : ℂ) • Π_F + (-1 : ℂ) • Π_L

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.regulated_inverse
theorems.statement:
theorem regulated_inverse (μ : ℂ) (h0 : μ ≠ 0) (h1 : μ + 1 ≠ 0) (h2 : μ + 2 ≠ 0) :
    (kb + μ • (1 : Matrix Two Two ℂ)) * (μ⁻¹ • Π₀ + (μ + 1)⁻¹ • Π_F + (μ + 2)⁻¹ • Π_L) = 1
theorems.description: **The regulated inverse:** `(K_b + μ)(μ⁻¹Π₀ + (μ+1)⁻¹Π_F + (μ+2)⁻¹Π_L) = 1`.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.same_pole_different_regular
theorems.statement:
theorem same_pole_different_regular (μ : ℂ) :
    clockLeg * (μ⁻¹ • Π₀ + (μ + 1)⁻¹ • Π_F + (μ + 2)⁻¹ • Π_L) * clockLeg -
      gravityLeg * (μ⁻¹ • Π₀ + (μ + 1)⁻¹ • Π_F + (μ + 2)⁻¹ • Π_L) * gravityLeg =
      (μ + 1)⁻¹ • Π_F + (μ + 2)⁻¹ • Π_L
theorems.description:
**Same pole, different regular part:** with `G = μ⁻¹Π₀ + (μ+1)⁻¹Π_F + (μ+2)⁻¹Π_L`,
`Γ_t G Γ_t − Γ_g G Γ_g = (μ+1)⁻¹Π_F + (μ+2)⁻¹Π_L`: the singlet poles cancel, the regular parts stay.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.regular_singlet_certificate
theorems.statement:
theorem regular_singlet_certificate :
    kb * (Π_F + (1 / 2 : ℂ) • Π_L) = 1 - Π₀ ∧ (Π_F + (1 / 2 : ℂ) • Π_L).trace = 25 / 2
theorems.description: **The regular part at the singlet:** `K_b(Π_F + Π_L/2) = 1 − Π₀` and `tr(Π_F + Π_L/2) = 25/2`.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.schur_equation_ideal

source_context.command: variable {𝕜 : Type*} [Field 𝕜] {m n : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n]

theorems.statement:
theorem schur_equation_ideal (A : Matrix m m 𝕜) (B : Matrix m n 𝕜) (C : Matrix n m 𝕜)
    (D : Matrix n n 𝕜) [Invertible D] (U V : Matrix (m ⊕ n) (m ⊕ n) 𝕜) :
    schurL B D * (U * fromBlocks A B C D + fromBlocks A B C D * V) * schurR C D =
      (schurL B D * U * retainIn 𝕜 m n) * schurS A B C D +
        schurS A B C D * ((retainIn 𝕜 m n)ᵀ * V * schurR C D)
theorems.description:
**A difference in the equation ideal survives elimination:** if two source derivatives differ by
`UK + KV`, then `L(UK + KV)R = (L U I_A) S + S (I_Aᵀ V R)`. No invertibility of `S` is assumed.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.ward_mod_equation

source_context.command: variable {𝕜 : Type*} [Field 𝕜] {m n : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n]

theorems.statement:
theorem ward_mod_equation {p : Type*} [Fintype p] (K A C G T : Matrix p p 𝕜) (l r : p → 𝕜)
    (hL : l ᵥ* K = 0) (hR : K *ᵥ r = 0) (hV : G - T = A * K + K * C) :
    l ⬝ᵥ (G *ᵥ r) = l ⬝ᵥ (T *ᵥ r)
theorems.description: An equation-ideal difference has equal contractions on shell (any operator `K`).

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.schur_equation_ideal_on_shell

source_context.command: variable {𝕜 : Type*} [Field 𝕜] {m n : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n]

theorems.statement:
theorem schur_equation_ideal_on_shell (A : Matrix m m 𝕜) (B : Matrix m n 𝕜) (C : Matrix n m 𝕜)
    (D : Matrix n n 𝕜) [Invertible D] (U V : Matrix (m ⊕ n) (m ⊕ n) 𝕜) (r l : m → 𝕜)
    (hr : schurS A B C D *ᵥ r = 0) (hl : l ᵥ* schurS A B C D = 0) :
    l ⬝ᵥ ((schurL B D * (U * fromBlocks A B C D + fromBlocks A B C D * V) * schurR C D) *ᵥ r) =
      0
theorems.description:
**On shell the two numerators agree after elimination:** contracting with null vectors of `S`
kills the reduced difference.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.schur_homogeneous

source_context.command: variable {𝕜 : Type*} [Field 𝕜] {m n : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n]

theorems.statement:
theorem schur_homogeneous (A : Matrix m m 𝕜) (B : Matrix m n 𝕜) (C : Matrix n m 𝕜)
    (D : Matrix n n 𝕜) (c : 𝕜) (hc : c ≠ 0) (hD : IsUnit D.det) :
    c • A - (c • B) * (c • D)⁻¹ * (c • C) = c • (A - B * D⁻¹ * C)
theorems.description:
**Lapse covariance survives elimination:** the Schur complement of `c·K` is `c` times that of
`K` (the inverse of `D` written as the matrix inverse).

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.schur_lapse_jet

source_context.command: variable {𝕜 : Type*} [Field 𝕜] {m n : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n]

theorems.statement:
theorem schur_lapse_jet (A : Matrix m m 𝕜) (B : Matrix m n 𝕜) (C : Matrix n m 𝕜)
    (D : Matrix n n 𝕜) [Invertible D] (Kz KN : Matrix (m ⊕ n) (m ⊕ n) 𝕜) (z : 𝕜)
    (hN : KN = fromBlocks A B C D - z • Kz) :
    schurL B D * KN * schurR C D = schurS A B C D - z • (schurL B D * Kz * schurR C D)
theorems.description: **The lapse jet survives elimination:** if `K_N = K − z K_z` then `L K_N R = S − z (L K_z R)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.on_shell_lapse_charge

source_context.command: variable {𝕜 : Type*} [Field 𝕜] {m n : Type*} [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n]

theorems.statement:
theorem on_shell_lapse_charge {p : Type*} [Fintype p] (K Kz KN : Matrix p p 𝕜) (l r : p → 𝕜) (z : 𝕜)
    (hR : K *ᵥ r = 0) (hN : KN = K - z • Kz) (hd : l ⬝ᵥ (Kz *ᵥ r) ≠ 0) :
    -(l ⬝ᵥ (KN *ᵥ r)) / (l ⬝ᵥ (Kz *ᵥ r)) = z
theorems.description:
**At a rest zero the normalized lapse charge is the rest frequency:** if `K r = 0` and
`K_N = K − z K_z`, then `−(ℓ K_N r)/(ℓ K_z r) = z`.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.selfS_lapse
theorems.statement:
theorem selfS_lapse (w N m0 d v : ℝ) (hN : N ≠ 0) (hwd : w - N * d ≠ 0) :
    selfS w N m0 d v = N * selfS (w / N) 1 m0 d v
theorems.description: **The dressed pencil is lapse covariant:** `S(ω, N) = N S(ω/N, 1)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw.dressed_ward
theorems.statement:
theorem dressed_ward (M m0 d v : ℝ) (hMd : M ≠ d) (hpole : M - m0 - v ^ 2 / (M - d) = 0) :
    (m0 + 2 * v ^ 2 / (M - d) + d * v ^ 2 / (M - d) ^ 2) / (1 + v ^ 2 / (M - d) ^ 2) = M
theorems.description:
**The normalized lapse charge at the dressed pole is the dressed pole:** with
`M − m₀ − v²/(M − d) = 0`, `(m₀ + 2v²/(M−d) + d v²/(M−d)²)/(1 + v²/(M−d)²) = M`.

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.Bridge.singletLine_mul_self
theorems.statement: theorem singletLine_mul_self (s : Fin 5) : singletLine s * singletLine s = -1
theorems.description: `(J_nJ_s)² = −1` in the even part.

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.Bridge.two_leg_conj
theorems.statement:
theorem two_leg_conj (s : Fin 5) (Y : CliffordAlgebra.even Q6) :
    evenToFour (singletLine s * Y * (-singletLine s)) = γ s * evenToFour Y * γ s
theorems.description:
**The physical step's conjugation is the two-leg conjugation:** for every even word `Y`,
`φ(J_nJ_s · Y · (−J_nJ_s)) = γ_s φ(Y) γ_s`.

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.Bridge.meeting_word_carried
theorems.statement:
theorem meeting_word_carried (s : Fin 5) (k : Fin 16) :
    singletLine s * evenEquivFour.symm (relOp k) * (-singletLine s) =
      ((if s ∈ disagreeSet k then -1 else 1 : ℝ)) • evenEquivFour.symm (relOp k)
theorems.description:
**A meeting's even vertical word is carried by the two legs with its agreement sign:**
`J_nJ_s · Y_k · (J_nJ_s)⁻¹ = ε_s(k) Y_k`, `Y_k` the even word that Proposition 37 sends to `B_k`.

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.quarter_sq
theorems.statement: theorem quarter_sq (D : Finset (Fin 6)) (x : Fin 6) : quarter D x * quarter D x = sgn D x

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.halfStep_eq
theorems.statement: theorem halfStep_eq (D : Finset (Fin 6)) (x : Fin 6) : halfStep D x = quarter D x • Jx x

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.joint_split
theorems.statement:
theorem joint_split (D : Finset (Fin 6)) {x y : Fin 6} (hxy : x ≠ y) :
    halfStep D x * halfStep D y =
      (quarter D x * quarter D y) • (Tx x y + εx x * εx y + ιx x * ιx y)
theorems.description:
**The joint step of a plane:** two square-root steps are one generator of their plane and a change of two
directions, `f_x f_y = i^{[x∈D]+[y∈D]} (T_xy + ε_xε_y + ι_xι_y)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.joint_parallel
theorems.statement:
theorem joint_parallel (D : Finset (Fin 6)) {x y : Fin 6} (hxy : x ≠ y) :
    ∑ k ∈ Finset.range 7, degreeProj k * (halfStep D x * halfStep D y) * degreeProj k =
      parTurn D x y
theorems.description:
**The parallel projection:** the part of two square-root steps that keeps the number of divided
directions is the generator of their plane, `Σ_k Π_k f_x f_y Π_k = i^{[x∈D]+[y∈D]} T_xy`.

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.joint_loop
theorems.statement:
theorem joint_loop (D : Finset (Fin 6)) {x y : Fin 6} (hxy : x ≠ y) :
    (halfStep D x * halfStep D y) * (halfStep D x * halfStep D y) =
      (-(sgn D x * sgn D y)) • 1
theorems.description: **The vertical projection, the loop:** `(f_x f_y)² = −θ_D(x)θ_D(y)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.parTurn_cube
theorems.statement:
theorem parTurn_cube (D : Finset (Fin 6)) {x y : Fin 6} (hxy : x ≠ y) :
    parTurn D x y * parTurn D x y * parTurn D x y = (-(sgn D x * sgn D y)) • parTurn D x y
theorems.description: **The two at once:** `X³ = (f_x f_y)² X`, the generator's cube is the plane's loop times the generator.

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.parTurn_cube_loop
theorems.statement:
theorem parTurn_cube_loop (D : Finset (Fin 6)) {x y : Fin 6} (hxy : x ≠ y) :
    parTurn D x y * parTurn D x y * parTurn D x y =
      ((halfStep D x * halfStep D y) * (halfStep D x * halfStep D y)) * parTurn D x y
theorems.description: `X³ = (f_x f_y)² X` written with the loop itself.

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.loop_kept_iff
theorems.statement:
theorem loop_kept_iff (D : Finset (Fin 6)) {x y : Fin 6} (hxy : x ≠ y) :
    (halfStep D x * halfStep D y) * (halfStep D x * halfStep D y) =
      (if (x ∈ D ↔ y ∈ D) then (-1 : ℂ) else 1) • 1
theorems.description:
**Kept exactly where the loop is `−1`:** the loop is `−1` on the planes within a side
(`θ_D(x) = θ_D(y)`, kept generators) and `+1` on the planes across (moved generators).

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.parTurn_rotation
theorems.statement:
theorem parTurn_rotation (D : Finset (Fin 6)) {x y : Fin 6} (hxy : x ≠ y) (h : x ∈ D ↔ y ∈ D) :
    parTurn D x y * parTurn D x y * parTurn D x y = -parTurn D x y
theorems.description: The generator is a rotation (`X³ = −X`) on a kept plane.

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.parTurn_boost
theorems.statement:
theorem parTurn_boost (D : Finset (Fin 6)) {x y : Fin 6} (hxy : x ≠ y) (h : ¬(x ∈ D ↔ y ∈ D)) :
    parTurn D x y * parTurn D x y * parTurn D x y = parTurn D x y
theorems.description: The generator is a boost (`X³ = X`) on a moved plane.

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.whole_sq
theorems.statement:
theorem whole_sq (D : Finset (Fin 6)) :
    (List.ofFn (halfStep D)).prod * (List.ofFn (halfStep D)).prod = ((-1 : ℂ) ^ (D.card + 1)) • 1
theorems.description:
**The whole:** `f₀ ⋯ f₅ = i^{|D|} w` squares to `(−1)^{|D|+1}`: a phase at even `|D|`, a scale
at odd `|D|` (Propositions 35, 86).

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.mixed_q1
theorems.statement: theorem mixed_q1 (z : ℂ) : z * 1 = Complex.I * z ↔ z = 0

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.mixed_s1
theorems.statement: theorem mixed_s1 (z : ℂ) : z * 1 = -1 * z ↔ z = 0

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.mixed_q2
theorems.statement: theorem mixed_q2 (z : ℂ) : z * Complex.I = 1 * z ↔ z = 0

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.mixed_s2
theorems.statement: theorem mixed_s2 (z : ℂ) : z * -1 = 1 * z ↔ z = 0

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.commute_quarter_iff
theorems.statement:
theorem commute_quarter_iff (D : Finset (Fin 6)) (O : Matrix (Fin 6) (Fin 6) ℂ) :
    O * diagonal (quarter D) = diagonal (quarter D) * O ↔
      O * diagonal (sgn D) = diagonal (sgn D) * O
theorems.description:
**A matrix commutes with the square root of the sign `q_D` exactly when it commutes with the sign `θ_D`:** the generators
that carry the square root of the sign are the generators the division keeps (Definition 15).

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.Jv_smul_c
theorems.statement: theorem Jv_smul_c (c : ℂ) (v : Fin 6 → ℂ) : Jv (c • v) = c • Jv v

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.Jv_single_c
theorems.statement: theorem Jv_single_c (x : Fin 6) : Jv (R := ℂ) (Pi.single x 1) = Jx x

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.diag_single
theorems.statement:
theorem diag_single (D : Finset (Fin 6)) (x : Fin 6) :
    diagonal (quarter D) *ᵥ Pi.single x 1 = quarter D x • (Pi.single x 1 : Fin 6 → ℂ)

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.halfVec_single
theorems.statement:
theorem halfVec_single (D : Finset (Fin 6)) (x : Fin 6) :
    halfVec D (Pi.single x 1) = halfStep D x
theorems.description: The square-root step along a direction of the six is Proposition 34's `f_x`.

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.kept_carries_half
theorems.statement:
theorem kept_carries_half (D : Finset (Fin 6)) (O : Matrix (Fin 6) (Fin 6) ℂ) (hO : Oᵀ * O = 1)
    (hk : O * diagonal (sgn D) = diagonal (sgn D) * O) (a : Fin 6 → ℂ) :
    extMap O * halfVec D a * extMap Oᵀ = halfVec D (O *ᵥ a)
theorems.description:
**A kept generator carries the square-root step:** for an orthogonal `O` that commutes with the sign of the
division, `Λ(O) f^D(a) Λ(O)⁻¹ = f^D(Oa)`, the joint step of Proposition 37 with the square root of the sign.

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.own_clock_moved
theorems.statement:
theorem own_clock_moved (D : Finset (Fin 6)) (t : Fin 6) (h : ¬((0 : Fin 6) ∈ D ↔ t ∈ D)) :
    halfStep D 0 * halfStep D t = stepOne t
theorems.description:
**Where the division moves the own clock** (exactly one of `n, t` divided), the joint step of
the plane `(n t)` is the step of one system along `t` itself: `f_n f_t = γ_t`.

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.own_clock_kept_out
theorems.statement:
theorem own_clock_kept_out (D : Finset (Fin 6)) (t : Fin 6) (h0 : (0 : Fin 6) ∉ D) (ht : t ∉ D) :
    halfStep D 0 * halfStep D t = (-Complex.I) • stepOne t
theorems.description:
**Where the division keeps the own clock with both undivided**, the joint step is the quarter
turn `−iγ_t = e^{−i(π/2)γ_t}` of the clock.

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.own_clock_kept_in
theorems.statement:
theorem own_clock_kept_in (D : Finset (Fin 6)) (t : Fin 6) (h0 : (0 : Fin 6) ∈ D) (ht : t ∈ D) :
    halfStep D 0 * halfStep D t = Complex.I • stepOne t
theorems.description:
**Where the division keeps the own clock with both divided**, the joint step is the quarter turn
`iγ_t = e^{i(π/2)γ_t}` of the clock.

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.stepOne_mul
theorems.statement:
theorem stepOne_mul {s : Fin 6} (t : Fin 6) (hs : s ≠ 0) :
    stepOne s * stepOne t = Jx s * Jx t
theorems.description: Two steps of one system along lines `s, t`: `γ_s γ_t = J_s J_t`.

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.steps_clifford
theorems.statement:
theorem steps_clifford {s t : Fin 6} (hs : s ≠ 0) (ht : t ≠ 0) :
    stepOne s * stepOne t + stepOne t * stepOne s = if s = t then 2 else 0
theorems.description: **The five steps are five lines of one system:** `γ_sγ_t + γ_tγ_s = 2δ_st`.

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.step_at_own
theorems.statement: theorem step_at_own (t : Fin 6) (ht : t ≠ 0) : halfStep {t} 0 * halfStep {t} t = stepOne t
theorems.description: **At the line's own division `{t}`** the joint step of `(n t)` is the step along `t`.

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.step_at_singlet_twin
theorems.statement:
theorem step_at_singlet_twin (t : Fin 6) (ht : t ≠ 0) :
    halfStep {0} 0 * halfStep {0} t = stepOne t
theorems.description:
**At the singlet's counterpart `{n}`** (P3's own division) the joint steps of the five planes `(n t)`
are the five steps of one system.

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.clock_commutes
theorems.statement:
theorem clock_commutes (a b c d : Fin 6) (hac : a ≠ c) (had : a ≠ d) (hbc : b ≠ c) (hbd : b ≠ d) :
    parTurn {a, b} a b * parTurn {a, b} c d = parTurn {a, b} c d * parTurn {a, b} a b
theorems.description:
**At a division of two directions `{a, b}`** the generator of the divided plane commutes with the
generator of every plane outside it, the kept generators of the other side: the clock (Propositions 41, 91).

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.moved_clocks_held
theorems.description:
**The moved own clocks at the six divisions a line holds** (Proposition 27): none at `{}`, all
five at `{n}`, the four other lines at `{h, n}`, `h` at `{h}`, `h, k` at `F`, the colour lines at `C`
(Propositions 173, 192).

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.twin_exchanges
theorems.statement:
theorem twin_exchanges : ∀ D : Finset (Fin 6),
    movedClocks (symmDiff D {0}) = (Finset.univ.filter fun t : Fin 6 => t ≠ 0) \ movedClocks D
theorems.description:
**The counterparts exchange time and mass:** toggling the singlet exchanges the kept and the moved own
clocks at every division of the six.

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.joint_cell
theorems.statement:
theorem joint_cell (D : Finset (Fin 6)) {x y : Fin 6} (hxy : x ≠ y) :
    halfStep D x * halfStep D y =
        (quarter D x * quarter D y) • (Tx x y + εx x * εx y + ιx x * ιx y) ∧
      ∑ k ∈ Finset.range 7, degreeProj k * (halfStep D x * halfStep D y) * degreeProj k =
        parTurn D x y ∧
      (halfStep D x * halfStep D y) * (halfStep D x * halfStep D y) = (-(sgn D x * sgn D y)) • 1 ∧
      parTurn D x y * parTurn D x y * parTurn D x y =
        ((halfStep D x * halfStep D y) * (halfStep D x * halfStep D y)) * parTurn D x y
theorems.description:
**The first pairing's joint cell at every division `D`:** for every plane `(x y)` the joint step
splits into the generator and the two-direction change; its grade-keeping projection is the generator `X`; its
loop is `−θ_D(x)θ_D(y)`; and `X³` is the loop times `X`.

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.two_joint_steps
theorems.statement:
theorem two_joint_steps (a b : Fin n → ℝ) (U V : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ)
    (hU : Uᵀ * U = 1) :
    jointStep a U * jointStep b V =
      Jv a * Jv (U *ᵥ b) * extMap (U * V)
theorems.description: The mixed vertical/parallel term is the transported second direction.

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.three_joint_steps
theorems.statement:
theorem three_joint_steps (a b c : Fin n → ℝ)
    (U V W : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ)
    (hU : Uᵀ * U = 1) (hV : Vᵀ * V = 1) :
    jointStep a U * jointStep b V * jointStep c W =
      Jv a * Jv (U *ᵥ b) * Jv ((U * V) *ᵥ c) * extMap (U * V * W)
theorems.description: A third step remembers both preceding transports.

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.conjugate_product
theorems.statement:
theorem conjugate_product (X : A) (hX : X * X = 1) (a b : A) :
    (X * a * X) * (X * b * X) = X * (a * b) * X
theorems.description: No commuting assumption is needed: carry the entire ordered word.

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.conjugate_word
theorems.statement:
theorem conjugate_word (X : A) (hX : X * X = 1) (w : List A) :
    (w.map (fun a => X * a * X)).prod = X * w.prod * X
theorems.description: Arbitrary finite words, including inserted sources and retained boundaries.

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.traced_word_covariant
theorems.statement:
theorem traced_word_covariant {m : ℕ} (X : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ)
    (hX : X * X = 1) (w : List (Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ)) :
    Matrix.trace (w.map (fun a => X * a * X)).prod = Matrix.trace w.prod
theorems.description: A traced cross-source word has the same value in the two bases.

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.pair_sign_blind
theorems.statement:
theorem pair_sign_blind (S₁ S₂ s g : ℝ) :
    (pairR S₁ S₂ s g).trace = (pairR S₁ S₂ s (-g)).trace ∧
      (pairR S₁ S₂ s g).det = (pairR S₁ S₂ s (-g)).det
theorems.description:
**A pair cannot see the sign of its overlap:** the trace and the determinant of the two-line level operator are
the same for `g` and `−g`.

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.triangle_reads_sign
theorems.statement: theorem triangle_reads_sign (g : ℝ) : (tri g * tri g * tri g).trace = 3 + 18 * g ^ 2 + 6 * g ^ 3
theorems.description: **A triangle reads the sign:** `Tr G³ = 3 + 18g² + 6g³`.

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.triangle_sign_difference
theorems.statement:
theorem triangle_sign_difference (g : ℝ) :
    (tri g * tri g * tri g).trace - (tri (-g) * tri (-g) * tri (-g)).trace = 12 * g ^ 3
theorems.description: The two signs differ in the triangle by `12g³`.

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.gram_minus_det
theorems.statement: theorem gram_minus_det (g : ℝ) : (tri (-g)).det = (1 - 2 * g) * (1 + g) ^ 2

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.gram_minus_not_pos
theorems.statement: theorem gram_minus_not_pos (g : ℝ) (hg : 0 < g) (hc : g ^ 2 = 8 / 15) : (tri (-g)).det < 0
theorems.description:
**At Proposition 194's coupling the negative-overlap meeting matrix is not positive:** for `g > 0` with
`g² = 8/15`, `det(I − g(J − I)) < 0`.

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.gram_plus_det
theorems.statement: theorem gram_plus_det (g : ℝ) : (tri g).det = (1 + 2 * g) * (1 - g) ^ 2
theorems.description:
With every overlap `+c^{1/2}` the meeting matrix is positive: `det(I + g(J − I)) = (1 + 2g)(1 − g)² > 0` for
`0 < g < 1`.

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.gram_plus_pos
theorems.statement: theorem gram_plus_pos (g : ℝ) (hg : 0 < g) (hg1 : g < 1) : 0 < (tri g).det

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.Patterns.jointWalk_channel
theorems.statement:
theorem jointWalk_channel (P : Finset (Fin 5)) (X : Matrix Four Four ℂ) (c : Fin 5 → ℂ)
    (hc : ∀ s, γ s * X * γ s = c s • X) (a : Fin 5 → ℂ) :
    jointWalk P (fun t => a t • X) =
      fun s => ((diagonal (fun s => ((agrZ P s : ℤ) : ℂ) * c s) * offD) *ᵥ a) s • X

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.Patterns.patternK_eq
theorems.statement:
theorem patternK_eq (P : Finset (Fin 5)) :
    patternK (R := ℂ) P = diagonal (fun s => ((agrZ P s : ℤ) : ℂ)) * offD

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.Patterns.one_step_Z
theorems.statement:
theorem one_step_Z : ∀ (P : Finset (Fin 5)) (s : Fin 5),
    γZ s * gammaDZ P * γZ s = ((cycleZ P * agrZ P s : ℤ) : GaussianInt) • gammaDZ P

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.Patterns.one_step
theorems.statement:
theorem one_step (P : Finset (Fin 5)) (s : Fin 5) :
    γ s * gammaD P * γ s = ((cycleZ P * agrZ P s : ℤ) : ℂ) • gammaD P
theorems.description: **The joint formula:** `γ_s γ_P γ_s = z_P² ε_s(P) γ_P` for every pattern `P` and line `s`.

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.Patterns.jointWalk_scalar
theorems.statement:
theorem jointWalk_scalar (P : Finset (Fin 5)) (a : Fin 5 → ℂ) :
    jointWalk P (fun t => a t • (1 : Matrix Four Four ℂ)) =
      fun s => (patternK (R := ℂ) P *ᵥ a) s • (1 : Matrix Four Four ℂ)
theorems.description: **The vertical projection at every pattern:** the scalar channel is the last-step direction's walk `K_P`.

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.Patterns.own_channel
theorems.statement:
theorem own_channel (P : Finset (Fin 5)) (a : Fin 5 → ℂ) :
    jointWalk P (fun t => a t • gammaD P) =
      fun s => (((cycleZ P : ℤ) : ℂ) • (patternK (R := ℂ) ∅ *ᵥ a)) s • gammaD P
theorems.description:
**The own channel at every pattern is the free last-step direction with the full-cycle sign:** on `a ⊗ γ_P` the
joint walk is `z_P² K_∅`: `K_∅` at the meetings, `K_{all five} = −K_∅` at the counterparts.

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.Patterns.own_factor
theorems.description:
The own channel's law: `(1 + u)⁴(1 − 4u)` at the meetings, zero at `u = 1/4`;
`(1 − u)⁴(1 + 4u)` at the counterparts, zero at `u = −1/4`.

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.Patterns.map_toComplex_inj
theorems.statement:
theorem map_toComplex_inj (A B : Matrix Four Four GaussianInt) :
    A.map GaussianInt.toComplex = B.map GaussianInt.toComplex ↔ A = B

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.Patterns.map_star_toComplex
theorems.statement:
theorem map_star_toComplex (A : Matrix Four Four GaussianInt) :
    (A.map star).map GaussianInt.toComplex = (A.map GaussianInt.toComplex).map star

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.Patterns.kept_iff_form_Z
theorems.statement:
theorem kept_iff_form_Z : ∀ (P : Finset (Fin 5)) (x : Fin 5 ⊕ Fin 10),
    Kept (divOf P) x ↔
      (if P.card % 2 = 0 then genZ x * gammaDZ P = gammaDZ P * genZ x
       else genZ x * (gammaDZ P * JZ) = (gammaDZ P * JZ) * (genZ x).map star)

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.Patterns.kept_iff_form
theorems.statement:
theorem kept_iff_form (P : Finset (Fin 5)) (x : Fin 5 ⊕ Fin 10) :
    Kept (divOf P) x ↔
      (if P.card % 2 = 0 then gen x * gammaD P = gammaD P * gen x
       else gen x * (gammaD P * J) = (gammaD P * J) * (gen x).map star)
theorems.description:
**The frame a pattern keeps is the commutant of its own element:** at a meeting (`|P|` even) the
rotations that commute with `γ_P`; at a counterpart (`|P|` odd) those that commute with the antilinear
`C_P = γ_PΘ`, `C_P v = γ_P J v̄` (Proposition 42).

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.Patterns.own_absent
theorems.statement: theorem own_absent : ∀ P : Finset (Fin 5), (P.card = 0 ∨ P.card = 5) → ∀ x, ¬ OwnAt P x
theorems.description: **No own rotation at `0|6` and at its counterpart with `n` added** (the singlet and the singlet's counterpart `{n}`).

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.Patterns.own_unique
theorems.statement:
theorem own_unique : ∀ P : Finset (Fin 5), 1 ≤ P.card → P.card ≤ 4 →
    ∃ x, OwnAt P x ∧ ∀ y, OwnAt P y → y = x
theorems.description: **Exactly one own rotation at every other pattern.**

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.Patterns.own_classes
theorems.statement:
theorem own_classes : ∀ (P : Finset (Fin 5)) (x : Fin 5 ⊕ Fin 10), OwnAt P x →
    (P.card = 1 → Moved (divOf P) x) ∧
    ((P.card = 2 ∨ P.card = 4) → Kept (divOf P) x ∧ CentralIn (divOf P) x) ∧
    (P.card = 3 → Kept (divOf P) x ∧ ¬ CentralIn (divOf P) x)
theorems.description:
**The own rotation by type:** moved at the five `{t}` (`1|5`); kept and central at the fifteen `2|4`
patterns; kept and not central at the ten `3|3` patterns.

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.Patterns.genZ_anticomm_of_overlap
theorems.statement:
theorem genZ_anticomm_of_overlap : ∀ x y : Fin 5 ⊕ Fin 10, x ≠ y → ¬ PlaneDisjoint x y →
    genZ x * genZ y = -(genZ y * genZ x)
theorems.description: Rotations whose planes share one direction anticommute.

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.Patterns.gen_anticomm_of_overlap
theorems.statement:
theorem gen_anticomm_of_overlap (x y : Fin 5 ⊕ Fin 10) (hxy : x ≠ y) (h : ¬ PlaneDisjoint x y) :
    gen x * gen y = -(gen y * gen x)

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.Patterns.centralIn_iff
theorems.statement:
theorem centralIn_iff (D : Finset (Fin 6)) (x : Fin 5 ⊕ Fin 10) :
    CentralIn D x ↔ ∀ y, Kept D y → gen x * gen y = gen y * gen x
theorems.description:
**Central means commuting with the whole kept frame:** where `CentralIn` holds the rotation commutes
with every kept rotation; where it fails some kept rotation anticommutes with it.

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.Patterns.own_noncentral
theorems.statement:
theorem own_noncentral (P : Finset (Fin 5)) (hP : P.card = 3) (x : Fin 5 ⊕ Fin 10)
    (hx : OwnAt P x) : ∃ y, Kept (divOf P) y ∧ gen x * gen y = -(gen y * gen x)
theorems.description: **At the ten `3|3` patterns the own rotation is not central:** some kept rotation anticommutes with it.

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.Patterns.joint_cell
theorems.statement:
theorem joint_cell (P : Finset (Fin 5)) :
    (∀ s, γ s * gammaD P * γ s = ((cycleZ P * agrZ P s : ℤ) : ℂ) • gammaD P) ∧
    (∀ a, jointWalk P (fun t => a t • (1 : Matrix Four Four ℂ)) =
      fun s => (patternK (R := ℂ) P *ᵥ a) s • (1 : Matrix Four Four ℂ)) ∧
    (∀ a, jointWalk P (fun t => a t • gammaD P) =
      fun s => (((cycleZ P : ℤ) : ℂ) • (patternK (R := ℂ) ∅ *ᵥ a)) s • gammaD P) ∧
    (∀ x, Kept (divOf P) x ↔
      (if P.card % 2 = 0 then gen x * gammaD P = gammaD P * gen x
       else gen x * (gammaD P * J) = (gammaD P * J) * (gen x).map star))
theorems.description:
**The joint cell of the second pairing at the pattern `P`:** the formula, its vertical projection
(the scalar channel `K_P`) and its parallel projection (the own channel `z_P² K_∅`, the frame as the
commutant of the own element). Together with `own_absent`, `own_unique`, `own_classes`: the own rotation
is absent at `0|6`, moved at `1|5`, the central clock at `2|4`, kept and not central at `3|3`.

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.Places.jointWalkW_channel
theorems.statement:
theorem jointWalkW_channel (P : Finset (Fin 5)) (w : Fin 5 → ℂ) (X : Matrix Four Four ℂ)
    (c : Fin 5 → ℂ) (hc : ∀ s, γ s * X * γ s = c s • X) (a : Fin 5 → ℂ) :
    jointWalkW P w (fun t => a t • X) =
      fun s => ((diagonal (fun s => agr P s * w s * c s) * offD) *ᵥ a) s • X

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.Places.step_planeTurn
theorems.statement: theorem step_planeTurn (s : Fin 5) : γ s * planeTurn * γ s = agr planeF s • planeTurn
theorems.description: The step carries the plane's rotation with the plane's agreement sign (`γ_conj_relOp` at the plane).

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.Places.agr_sq
theorems.statement: theorem agr_sq (P : Finset (Fin 5)) (s : Fin 5) : agr P s * agr P s = 1

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.Places.vector_channel_F
theorems.statement:
theorem vector_channel_F (w : Fin 5 → ℂ) (a : Fin 5 → ℂ) :
    jointWalkW planeF w (fun t => a t • planeTurn) =
      fun s => ((diagonal w * offD) *ᵥ a) s • planeTurn
theorems.description:
**The vector's channel at the plane meeting:** on the plane's rotation the weighted joint walk at `F` is
`diag(w)(𝐉 − I)`, for every weight on the steps.

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.Places.scalar_channel_singlet
theorems.statement:
theorem scalar_channel_singlet (w : Fin 5 → ℂ) (a : Fin 5 → ℂ) :
    jointWalkW ∅ w (fun t => a t • (1 : Matrix Four Four ℂ)) =
      fun s => ((diagonal w * offD) *ᵥ a) s • (1 : Matrix Four Four ℂ)
theorems.description:
**The pseudoscalar's channel at the singlet:** on the scalar channel the weighted joint walk at the
singlet is `diag(w)(𝐉 − I)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.Places.vector_equals_pseudoscalar
theorems.statement:
theorem vector_equals_pseudoscalar (w : Fin 5 → ℂ) (a : Fin 5 → ℂ) (s : Fin 5) :
    (∃ M : Matrix (Fin 5) (Fin 5) ℂ,
      jointWalkW planeF w (fun t => a t • planeTurn) s = (M *ᵥ a) s • planeTurn ∧
      jointWalkW ∅ w (fun t => a t • (1 : Matrix Four Four ℂ)) s =
        (M *ᵥ a) s • (1 : Matrix Four Four ℂ) ∧ M = diagonal w * offD)
theorems.description:
**One operator for every level:** the vector's channel at `F` and the pseudoscalar's at the singlet carry
the same five-line walk.

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.Places.level_determinant
theorems.statement:
theorem level_determinant (u : ℂ) (w : Fin 5 → ℂ) :
    (1 - u • (diagonal w * offD)).det =
      ∏ t, (1 + u * w t) - u * ∑ t, w t * ∏ s ∈ Finset.univ.erase t, (1 + u * w s)
theorems.description:
**The law on the common channel** (Proposition 135 at `U = ∅`, with the Euler completion):
`det(I − u diag(w)(𝐉 − I)) = ∏_t (1 + uw_t) − u Σ_t w_t ∏_{s≠t} (1 + uw_s)`; with one level `e^{−S}` on
one line and the others one it vanishes where `1 − 3u − 4u²e^{−S} = 0` (Proposition 140), at the
same `u` for the vector's channel and the pseudoscalar's.

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.Places.one_level
theorems.statement:
theorem one_level (u r : ℂ) :
    (1 - u • (diagonal ![r, 1, 1, 1, 1] * offD)).det = (1 + u) ^ 3 * (1 - 3 * u - 4 * u ^ 2 * r)
theorems.description: With one level on the line `0` (`w = (r, 1, 1, 1, 1)`): `det = (1 + u)³(1 − 3u − 4u²r)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.Places.scalar_channel_F
theorems.statement:
theorem scalar_channel_F (w : Fin 5 → ℂ) (a : Fin 5 → ℂ) :
    jointWalkW planeF w (fun t => a t • (1 : Matrix Four Four ℂ)) =
      fun s => ((diagonal (fun s => agr planeF s * w s) * offD) *ᵥ a) s •
        (1 : Matrix Four Four ℂ)
theorems.description: **At `F` the scalar channel is the plane meeting's own walk** `diag(ε(F) w)(𝐉 − I)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.Places.colour_channel_C
theorems.statement:
theorem colour_channel_C (w : Fin 5 → ℂ) (a : Fin 5 → ℂ) :
    jointWalkW colourC w (fun t => a t • planeTurn) =
      fun s => ((diagonal (fun s => -w s) * offD) *ᵥ a) s • planeTurn
theorems.description: At `C` the plane's rotation carries `−diag(w)(𝐉 − I)`: the singlet's counterpart `{n}`'s walk, for every weight.

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.agr_eq
theorems.statement: theorem agr_eq (P : Finset (Fin 5)) (s : Fin 5) : agr P s = if s ∈ P then -1 else 1

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.agr_mul_self
theorems.statement: theorem agr_mul_self (P : Finset (Fin 5)) (s : Fin 5) : agr P s * agr P s = 1

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.agr_colourC
theorems.statement: theorem agr_colourC (s : Fin 5) : agr colourC s = -agr planeF s
theorems.description: The two patterns are counterparts: `ε_s(C) = −ε_s(F)` on every line.

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.gen_inr_zero
theorems.statement: theorem gen_inr_zero : gen (Sum.inr 0) = -planeTurn

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.joint_step_F
theorems.statement: theorem joint_step_F (s : Fin 5) : γ s * planeTurn * γ s = agr planeF s • planeTurn
theorems.description: **The joint step at `F`:** `γ_s (γ_hγ_k) γ_s = ε_s(F) γ_hγ_k` for every line `s`.

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.joint_step_C
theorems.statement: theorem joint_step_C (s : Fin 5) : γ s * planeTurn * γ s = (-agr colourC s) • planeTurn
theorems.description:
**The joint step at `C`:** `γ_s (γ_hγ_k) γ_s = −ε_s(C) γ_hγ_k`: the same transport, the counterpart's
agreement sign reversed (`z_C² = −1`).

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.loop_return
theorems.statement:
theorem loop_return (X : Matrix Four Four ℂ) (c : Fin 5 → ℂ)
    (hc : ∀ s, γ s * X * γ s = c s • X) (s t : Fin 5) :
    γ t * γ s * X * γ s * γ t = (c s * c t) • X
theorems.description: Around a loop `t → s → t` an operator carried with the signs `c` comes back with `c_s c_t`.

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.own_loop_F
theorems.statement:
theorem own_loop_F (s t : Fin 5) :
    γ t * γ s * planeTurn * γ s * γ t = (agr planeF s * agr planeF t) • planeTurn
theorems.description:
**Definition 41 at `F`:** the plane's rotation comes back around every loop with the loop's vertical
return `ε_s(F)ε_t(F)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.own_loop_C
theorems.statement:
theorem own_loop_C (s t : Fin 5) :
    γ t * γ s * planeTurn * γ s * γ t = (agr colourC s * agr colourC t) • planeTurn
theorems.description: **Definition 41 at `C`:** the same rotation comes back with `ε_s(C)ε_t(C)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.step_gen
theorems.statement:
theorem step_gen (s : Fin 5) (x : Fin 5 ⊕ Fin 10) :
    γ s * gen x * γ s = (turnSign s x : ℂ) • gen x
theorems.description: **The step carries every rotation by a sign:** `γ_s X γ_s = ±X` for each of the fifteen rotations.

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.gen_mul_self
theorems.statement: theorem gen_mul_self (x : Fin 5 ⊕ Fin 10) : gen x * gen x = -1
theorems.description: Every one of the fifteen rotations squares to `−1`.

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.gen_ne_zero
theorems.statement: theorem gen_ne_zero (x : Fin 5 ⊕ Fin 10) : gen x ≠ 0

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.planeTurn_mul_self
theorems.statement: theorem planeTurn_mul_self : planeTurn * planeTurn = -1

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.smul_gen_cancel
theorems.statement: theorem smul_gen_cancel (x : Fin 5 ⊕ Fin 10) {a b : ℂ} (h : a • gen x = b • gen x) : a = b
theorems.description: Two complex numbers that scale a nonzero rotation alike are equal.

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.ownAt_iff
theorems.statement:
theorem ownAt_iff (P : Finset (Fin 5)) (x : Fin 5 ⊕ Fin 10) :
    (∀ s t : Fin 5, s ≠ t → γ t * γ s * gen x * γ s * γ t = (agr P s * agr P t) • gen x) ↔
      OwnAt P x

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.ownAt_planeF
theorems.statement: theorem ownAt_planeF : ∀ x : Fin 5 ⊕ Fin 10, OwnAt planeF x ↔ x = Sum.inr 0

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.ownAt_colourC
theorems.statement: theorem ownAt_colourC : ∀ x : Fin 5 ⊕ Fin 10, OwnAt colourC x ↔ x = Sum.inr 0

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.own_plane_unique_F
theorems.statement:
theorem own_plane_unique_F (x : Fin 5 ⊕ Fin 10) :
    (∀ s t : Fin 5, s ≠ t → γ t * γ s * gen x * γ s * γ t = (agr planeF s * agr planeF t) • gen x) ↔
      x = Sum.inr 0
theorems.description:
**The own rotation at `F` is unique:** among the fifteen rotations, `(h k)` alone comes back around every
loop with the loop's vertical return.

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.own_plane_unique_C
theorems.statement:
theorem own_plane_unique_C (x : Fin 5 ⊕ Fin 10) :
    (∀ s t : Fin 5, s ≠ t →
        γ t * γ s * gen x * γ s * γ t = (agr colourC s * agr colourC t) • gen x) ↔
      x = Sum.inr 0
theorems.description: **The own rotation at `C` is the same rotation:** the counterpart's loop character is the plane's.

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.planeTurnZ_map
theorems.statement: theorem planeTurnZ_map : planeTurnZ.map GaussianInt.toComplex = planeTurn

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.map_toComplex_inj
theorems.statement:
theorem map_toComplex_inj (A B : Matrix Four Four GaussianInt) :
    A.map GaussianInt.toComplex = B.map GaussianInt.toComplex ↔ A = B

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.map_star_toComplex
theorems.statement:
theorem map_star_toComplex (A : Matrix Four Four GaussianInt) :
    (A.map star).map GaussianInt.toComplex = (A.map GaussianInt.toComplex).map star

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.kept_F_Z
theorems.statement:
theorem kept_F_Z : ∀ x : Fin 5 ⊕ Fin 10,
    Kept {1, 2} x ↔ genZ x * planeTurnZ = planeTurnZ * genZ x

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.kept_C_Z
theorems.statement:
theorem kept_C_Z : ∀ x : Fin 5 ⊕ Fin 10,
    Kept {3, 4, 5} x ↔ genZ x * (planeTurnZ * JZ) = (planeTurnZ * JZ) * (genZ x).map star

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.kept_F_iff
theorems.statement: theorem kept_F_iff (x : Fin 5 ⊕ Fin 10) : Kept {1, 2} x ↔ gen x * planeTurn = planeTurn * gen x
theorems.description:
**The frame `F` keeps is the commutant of its own rotation:** a rotation is kept by the plane's division
`{h, k}` of the six exactly when it commutes with `γ_hγ_k`.

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.own_central_F
theorems.statement:
theorem own_central_F (x : Fin 5 ⊕ Fin 10) (hx : Kept {1, 2} x) :
    planeTurn * gen x = gen x * planeTurn
theorems.description: **The own rotation is central in the frame `F` keeps: it is the clock** (Propositions 151, 152).

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.kept_C_iff
theorems.statement:
theorem kept_C_iff (x : Fin 5 ⊕ Fin 10) :
    Kept {3, 4, 5} x ↔ gen x * (planeTurn * J) = (planeTurn * J) * (gen x).map star
theorems.description:
**The frame `C` keeps is the commutant of its amplitude form** `C_C = γ_hγ_kΘ` (Proposition 42:
an odd divided set keeps the antilinear `γ_DΘ`, here `γ_{c₁}γ_{c₂}γ_{c₃} = −γ_hγ_k`): a rotation `X` is kept
by `C` exactly when `X (γ_hγ_k J) = (γ_hγ_k J) X̄`, that is `X C_C = C_C X` with `C_C v = γ_hγ_k J v̄`.

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.step_gen_comm
theorems.statement:
theorem step_gen_comm (s : Fin 5) (x : Fin 5 ⊕ Fin 10) :
    γ s * gen x = (turnSign s x : ℂ) • (gen x * γ s)
theorems.description: The step along `s` moved past a rotation: `γ_s X = ±X γ_s`.

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.planeTurn_mul_gen
theorems.statement:
theorem planeTurn_mul_gen (x : Fin 5 ⊕ Fin 10) :
    planeTurn * gen x = ((turnSign 0 x : ℂ) * (turnSign 1 x : ℂ)) • (gen x * planeTurn)
theorems.description:
**The plane's rotation moved past a rotation** gives the rotation's two step signs on the plane:
`γ_hγ_k X = s_h(X) s_k(X) X γ_hγ_k`.

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.gen_planeTurn_ne_zero
theorems.statement: theorem gen_planeTurn_ne_zero (x : Fin 5 ⊕ Fin 10) : gen x * planeTurn ≠ 0
theorems.description: A rotation times the plane's rotation is invertible.

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.own_not_central_C
theorems.statement:
theorem own_not_central_C :
    Kept {3, 4, 5} (Sum.inr 0) ∧ Kept {3, 4, 5} (Sum.inl 0) ∧
      planeTurn * gen (Sum.inl 0) = -(gen (Sum.inl 0) * planeTurn) ∧
      planeTurn * gen (Sum.inl 0) ≠ gen (Sum.inl 0) * planeTurn
theorems.description:
**At `C` the own rotation is kept and not central:** the last-step direction's own clock `iγ_h` is kept by `C` (it
commutes with `C_C`) and anticommutes with `γ_hγ_k` (Propositions 157, 158).

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.kept_counts
theorems.statement:
theorem kept_counts :
    (Finset.univ.filter (Kept {1, 2})).card = 7 ∧ (Finset.univ.filter (Kept {3, 4, 5})).card = 6

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.agr_planeF_vals
theorems.statement: theorem agr_planeF_vals : (fun s => agr planeF s) = ![-1, -1, 1, 1, 1]

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.agr_colourC_vals
theorems.statement: theorem agr_colourC_vals : (fun s => agr colourC s) = ![1, 1, -1, -1, -1]

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.agr_sums
theorems.statement: theorem agr_sums : ∑ s, agr planeF s = 1 ∧ ∑ s, agr colourC s = -1
theorems.description: The agreements less the disagreements, `L − 1`: `1` at `F` (`L = 2`), `−1` at `C`.

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.full_cycles
theorems.statement:
theorem full_cycles :
    (thetaP (R := ℂ) planeF).det = 1 ∧ zS (patternDividedSet planeF) = -1 ∧
      (thetaP (R := ℂ) colourC).det = -1 ∧ zS (patternDividedSet colourC) = -Complex.I
theorems.description:
**The full cycle is `z²`:** `det θ_F = +1 = z_F²` with `z_F = −1` (a count at `u = −1/4`), and
`det θ_C = −1 = z_C²` with `z_C = −i` (an amplitude at `u = −i/4`).

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.factor_F
theorems.statement:
theorem factor_F (u : ℂ) :
    (1 - u • patternK (R := ℂ) planeF).det = (1 + u) ^ 2 * (1 - u) * (1 + 4 * u ^ 2 - u)
theorems.description: **The meeting's factor at `F`:** `det(I − uK_F) = (1 + u)²(1 − u)(1 + 4u² − u)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.factor_C
theorems.statement:
theorem factor_C (u : ℂ) :
    (1 - u • patternK (R := ℂ) colourC).det = (1 + u) * (1 - u) ^ 2 * (1 + 4 * u ^ 2 + u)
theorems.description: **The counterpart's factor at `C`:** `det(I − uK_C) = (1 + u)(1 − u)²(1 + 4u² + u)`, the plane's at `−u`.

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.own_phase_values
theorems.statement:
theorem own_phase_values :
    (1 - (-1 / 4 : ℂ) • patternK (R := ℂ) planeF).det = 135 / 128 ∧
      1 + 4 * (-Complex.I / 4) ^ 2 + (-Complex.I / 4) = (3 - Complex.I) / 4
theorems.description:
At their own phases: `135/128` at `u = −1/4` for `F`; the point factor `(3 − i)/4` at
`u = −i/4` for `C` (Propositions 150, 156).

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.det_four
theorems.description: The walk among four lines with the signs `e`: `I − x diag(e)(𝐉 − I)`, its determinant.

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.sub_walk
theorems.statement:
theorem sub_walk (P : Finset (Fin 5)) (t : Fin 5) :
    (patternK (R := ℂ) P).submatrix t.succAbove t.succAbove =
      diagonal (fun i => agr P (t.succAbove i)) *
        (Matrix.of fun i j : Fin 4 => if i = j then (0 : ℂ) else 1)
theorems.description: The walk among the four lines other than `t` at the pattern `P`.

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.sub_det_F_colour
theorems.statement:
theorem sub_det_F_colour (x : ℂ) :
    (1 - x • (patternK (R := ℂ) planeF).submatrix (Fin.succAbove 2) (Fin.succAbove 2)).det =
      (1 - x ^ 2) * (1 + 3 * x ^ 2)

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.sub_det_C_colour
theorems.statement:
theorem sub_det_C_colour (x : ℂ) :
    (1 - x • (patternK (R := ℂ) colourC).submatrix (Fin.succAbove 2) (Fin.succAbove 2)).det =
      (1 - x ^ 2) * (1 + 3 * x ^ 2)

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.sub_det_F_plane
theorems.statement:
theorem sub_det_F_plane (x : ℂ) :
    (1 - x • (patternK (R := ℂ) planeF).submatrix (Fin.succAbove 0) (Fin.succAbove 0)).det =
      (1 + x) ^ 2 * (1 - 2 * x + 3 * x ^ 2)

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.sub_det_C_plane
theorems.statement:
theorem sub_det_C_plane (x : ℂ) :
    (1 - x • (patternK (R := ℂ) colourC).submatrix (Fin.succAbove 0) (Fin.succAbove 0)).det =
      (1 - x) ^ 2 * (1 + 2 * x + 3 * x ^ 2)

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.lastDirectionReturn_x
theorems.statement:
theorem lastDirectionReturn_x (x : ℂ) (hm : 1 - x ≠ 0) (hp : 1 + x ≠ 0) (h3 : 1 + 3 * x ^ 2 ≠ 0)
    (hF : 1 - 2 * x + 3 * x ^ 2 ≠ 0) (hC : 1 + 2 * x + 3 * x ^ 2 ≠ 0) :
    lastDirectionReturn planeF 2 x = -4 * x ^ 3 / (1 + 3 * x ^ 2) ∧
      lastDirectionReturn colourC 2 x = 4 * x ^ 3 / (1 + 3 * x ^ 2) ∧
      lastDirectionReturn planeF 0 x = -2 * x ^ 2 * (1 - 2 * x) / (1 - 2 * x + 3 * x ^ 2) ∧
      lastDirectionReturn colourC 0 x = -2 * x ^ 2 * (1 + 2 * x) / (1 + 2 * x + 3 * x ^ 2)
theorems.description:
The closed forms in `x`: at `F` the colour last-step direction `−4x³/(1 + 3x²)`, the plane line
`−2x²(1 − 2x)/(1 − 2x + 3x²)`; at `C` the colour last-step direction `4x³/(1 + 3x²)`, the plane line
`−2x²(1 + 2x)/(1 + 2x + 3x²)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.colour_returns
theorems.statement:
theorem colour_returns (z : ℂ) (hz : z ≠ 0) (h16 : 16 + 3 * z ^ 2 ≠ 0) (hm : 4 - z ≠ 0)
    (hp : 4 + z ≠ 0) (hF : 16 - 8 * z + 3 * z ^ 2 ≠ 0) (hC : 16 + 8 * z + 3 * z ^ 2 ≠ 0) :
    lastDirectionReturn planeF 2 (z / 4) = Phi z / z ∧ lastDirectionReturn colourC 2 (z / 4) = -(Phi z / z)
theorems.description:
**At `F` each colour last-step direction returns the signed excursion one step shorter, `Φ(z)/z`** (Proposition 149),
at `x = z/4`; **at `C` it returns `−Φ(z)/z`** (Proposition 155).

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.plane_returns
theorems.statement:
theorem plane_returns (z : ℂ) (h16 : 16 + 3 * z ^ 2 ≠ 0) (hm : 4 - z ≠ 0)
    (hp : 4 + z ≠ 0) (hF : 16 - 8 * z + 3 * z ^ 2 ≠ 0) (hC : 16 + 8 * z + 3 * z ^ 2 ≠ 0) :
    lastDirectionReturn planeF 0 (z / 4) = -(z ^ 2 * (2 - z) / (16 - 8 * z + 3 * z ^ 2)) ∧
      lastDirectionReturn colourC 0 (z / 4) = -z ^ 2 * (2 + z) / (16 + 8 * z + 3 * z ^ 2)
theorems.description:
At `F` the plane line's last-step direction returns `−g₃ = −z²(2 − z)/(16 − 8z + 3z²)` (Proposition 149); at `C`
it returns `g₁ = −z²(2 + z)/(16 + 8z + 3z²)` (Proposition 155).

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.colour_return_values
theorems.statement:
theorem colour_return_values :
    lastDirectionReturn planeF 2 (1 / 4) = -1 / 19 ∧ lastDirectionReturn planeF 2 (-1 / 4) = 1 / 19 ∧
      lastDirectionReturn colourC 2 (1 / 4) = 1 / 19 ∧
      lastDirectionReturn colourC 2 (-Complex.I / 4) = Complex.I / 13
theorems.description:
The colour last-step direction's returns at `z = 1` and at the cells' own phases: `−1/19` and `+1/19` at `F`
(`z = 1, −1`), `+1/19` and `i/13` at `C` (`z = 1, −i`).

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.jointWalk_channel
theorems.statement:
theorem jointWalk_channel (P : Finset (Fin 5)) (X : Matrix Four Four ℂ) (c : Fin 5 → ℂ)
    (hc : ∀ s, γ s * X * γ s = c s • X) (a : Fin 5 → ℂ) :
    jointWalk P (fun t => a t • X) =
      fun s => ((diagonal (fun s => agr P s * c s) * offD) *ᵥ a) s • X
theorems.description:
**A channel of the joint walk:** an operator `X` that every step carries by a sign `c_s` is a
channel on which the joint walk is the five-line matrix `diag(ε(P) c)(𝐉 − I)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.patternK_eq
theorems.statement:
theorem patternK_eq (P : Finset (Fin 5)) :
    patternK (R := ℂ) P = diagonal (fun s => agr P s) * offD
theorems.description: The pattern's walk is the diagonal of its signs times `𝐉 − I`.

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.jointWalk_scalar
theorems.statement:
theorem jointWalk_scalar (P : Finset (Fin 5)) (a : Fin 5 → ℂ) :
    jointWalk P (fun t => a t • (1 : Matrix Four Four ℂ)) =
      fun s => (patternK (R := ℂ) P *ᵥ a) s • (1 : Matrix Four Four ℂ)
theorems.description: **The vertical projection:** on the scalar channel the joint walk is the last-step direction's walk `K_P`.

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.jointWalk_own_F
theorems.statement:
theorem jointWalk_own_F (a : Fin 5 → ℂ) :
    jointWalk planeF (fun t => a t • planeTurn) =
      fun s => (patternK (R := ℂ) ∅ *ᵥ a) s • planeTurn
theorems.description: **The own channel at `F`:** on the plane's rotation the joint walk is the free last-step direction `K_∅`.

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.jointWalk_own_C
theorems.statement:
theorem jointWalk_own_C (a : Fin 5 → ℂ) :
    jointWalk colourC (fun t => a t • planeTurn) =
      fun s => (patternK (R := ℂ) Finset.univ *ᵥ a) s • planeTurn
theorems.description: **The own channel at `C`:** on the plane's rotation the joint walk is `−K_∅ = K_{all five}`.

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.own_factors
theorems.statement:
theorem own_factors (u : ℂ) :
    (1 - u • patternK (R := ℂ) ∅).det = (1 + u) ^ 4 * (1 - 4 * u) ∧
      (1 - u • patternK (R := ℂ) Finset.univ).det = (1 - u) ^ 4 * (1 + 4 * u)
theorems.description:
**The own channel carries the long-range zero:** at `F` its factor is `(1 + u)⁴(1 − 4u)`, zero at
`u = 1/4`; at `C` it is `(1 − u)⁴(1 + 4u)`, zero at `u = −1/4`, the plane's own phase.

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.jointWalk_relOp
theorems.statement:
theorem jointWalk_relOp (P : Finset (Fin 5)) (k : Fin 16) (a : Fin 5 → ℂ) :
    jointWalk P (fun t => a t • relOp k) =
      fun s => (patternK (R := ℂ) (symmDiff P (disagreeSet k)) *ᵥ a) s • relOp k
theorems.description:
The sixteen channels: the step carries every two-spinor state's operator by its agreement sign
(`γ_conj_relOp`), so on the channel `B_k` the joint walk at `P` is `diag(ε(P) ε(T_k))(𝐉 − I)`, the
last-step direction's walk at the pattern `P △ T_k` (the operator form of character shift).

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.joint_cell_F
theorems.statement:
theorem joint_cell_F :
    -- the joint formula
    (∀ s, γ s * planeTurn * γ s = agr planeF s • planeTurn) ∧
    -- vertical: the scalar channel is K_F, its signs, cycle and factor
    (∀ a, jointWalk planeF (fun t => a t • (1 : Matrix Four Four ℂ)) =
      fun s => (patternK (R := ℂ) planeF *ᵥ a) s • (1 : Matrix Four Four ℂ)) ∧
    (fun s => agr planeF s) = ![-1, -1, 1, 1, 1] ∧ (thetaP (R := ℂ) planeF).det = 1 ∧
    (∀ z : ℂ, z ≠ 0 → 16 + 3 * z ^ 2 ≠ 0 → 4 - z ≠ 0 → 4 + z ≠ 0 → 16 - 8 * z + 3 * z ^ 2 ≠ 0 →
      16 + 8 * z + 3 * z ^ 2 ≠ 0 → lastDirectionReturn planeF 2 (z / 4) = Phi z / z) ∧
    (∀ u : ℂ, (1 - u • patternK (R := ℂ) planeF).det = (1 + u) ^ 2 * (1 - u) * (1 + 4 * u ^ 2 - u)) ∧
    -- parallel: the own rotation, the frame, the own channel
    (∀ x, (∀ s t : Fin 5, s ≠ t →
        γ t * γ s * gen x * γ s * γ t = (agr planeF s * agr planeF t) • gen x) ↔ x = Sum.inr 0) ∧
    (∀ x, Kept {1, 2} x ↔ gen x * planeTurn = planeTurn * gen x) ∧
    (∀ a, jointWalk planeF (fun t => a t • planeTurn) =
      fun s => (patternK (R := ℂ) ∅ *ᵥ a) s • planeTurn) ∧
    (∀ u : ℂ, (1 - u • patternK (R := ℂ) ∅).det = (1 + u) ^ 4 * (1 - 4 * u))
theorems.description:
**The joint cell of the second pairing at the plane `F` (2|4).** One formula, the step carrying
the plane's rotation with the plane's agreement sign; its vertical projection (the scalar channel, the
last-step direction's walk `K_F`, its signs, full cycle, colour-last-step direction return and factor) and its parallel projection
(the own rotation selected by the loop character, the frame as its commutant with the own rotation central,
the own channel the free last-step direction with the long-range zero).

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.joint_cell_C
theorems.statement:
theorem joint_cell_C :
    (∀ s, γ s * planeTurn * γ s = (-agr colourC s) • planeTurn) ∧
    (∀ a, jointWalk colourC (fun t => a t • (1 : Matrix Four Four ℂ)) =
      fun s => (patternK (R := ℂ) colourC *ᵥ a) s • (1 : Matrix Four Four ℂ)) ∧
    (fun s => agr colourC s) = ![1, 1, -1, -1, -1] ∧ (thetaP (R := ℂ) colourC).det = -1 ∧
    (∀ z : ℂ, z ≠ 0 → 16 + 3 * z ^ 2 ≠ 0 → 4 - z ≠ 0 → 4 + z ≠ 0 → 16 - 8 * z + 3 * z ^ 2 ≠ 0 →
      16 + 8 * z + 3 * z ^ 2 ≠ 0 → lastDirectionReturn colourC 2 (z / 4) = -(Phi z / z)) ∧
    (∀ u : ℂ, (1 - u • patternK (R := ℂ) colourC).det = (1 + u) * (1 - u) ^ 2 * (1 + 4 * u ^ 2 + u)) ∧
    (∀ x, (∀ s t : Fin 5, s ≠ t →
        γ t * γ s * gen x * γ s * γ t = (agr colourC s * agr colourC t) • gen x) ↔ x = Sum.inr 0) ∧
    (∀ x, Kept {3, 4, 5} x ↔ gen x * (planeTurn * J) = (planeTurn * J) * (gen x).map star) ∧
    (Kept {3, 4, 5} (Sum.inl 0) ∧ planeTurn * gen (Sum.inl 0) ≠ gen (Sum.inl 0) * planeTurn) ∧
    (∀ a, jointWalk colourC (fun t => a t • planeTurn) =
      fun s => (patternK (R := ℂ) Finset.univ *ᵥ a) s • planeTurn) ∧
    (∀ u : ℂ, (1 - u • patternK (R := ℂ) Finset.univ).det = (1 - u) ^ 4 * (1 + 4 * u))
theorems.description:
**The joint cell of the second pairing at the colour counterpart `C` (3|3).** The same transport of the
plane's rotation with the counterpart's agreement sign reversed; vertical: `K_C`, its signs, full cycle `−1`,
colour-last-step direction return `−Φ(z)/z`, factor; parallel: the same own rotation, the frame as the commutant of the
amplitude form `γ_hγ_kΘ` with the own rotation kept and not central, the own channel `K_{all five}`.

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.Third.sum_swap4

source_context.command: variable {R : Type*} [CommRing R] {M : Type*} [Ring M] [Algebra R M]

theorems.statement:
theorem sum_swap4 {N : Type*} [AddCommMonoid N] (h : Fin 5 → Fin 5 → Fin 5 → Fin 5 → N) :
    ∑ u, ∑ v, ∑ s, ∑ t, h u v s t = ∑ s, ∑ t, ∑ u, ∑ v, h u v s t

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.Third.term_anticomm

source_context.command: variable {R : Type*} [CommRing R] {M : Type*} [Ring M] [Algebra R M]

theorems.statement:
theorem term_anticomm (x y z : Fin 5 → M)
    (hx : ∀ s u, x s * x u + x u * x s = (if s = u then (2 : R) else 0) • (1 : M))
    (hxy : ∀ s t, x s * y t = y t * x s) (hxz : ∀ s v, x s * z v = z v * x s)
    (hyz : ∀ t v, y t * z v = z v * y t) (s t u v : Fin 5) :
    x s * y t * (x u * z v) + x u * z v * (x s * y t) =
      (if s = u then (2 : R) else 0) • (y t * z v)
theorems.description: One term: the shared leg anticommutes, the other two legs commute.

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.Third.anticomm_sum

source_context.command: variable {R : Type*} [CommRing R] {M : Type*} [Ring M] [Algebra R M]

theorems.statement:
theorem anticomm_sum (x y z : Fin 5 → M) (A B : Matrix (Fin 5) (Fin 5) R)
    (hx : ∀ s u, x s * x u + x u * x s = (if s = u then (2 : R) else 0) • (1 : M))
    (hxy : ∀ s t, x s * y t = y t * x s) (hxz : ∀ s v, x s * z v = z v * x s)
    (hyz : ∀ t v, y t * z v = z v * y t) :
    (∑ s, ∑ t, A s t • (x s * y t)) * (∑ u, ∑ v, B u v • (x u * z v)) +
      (∑ u, ∑ v, B u v • (x u * z v)) * (∑ s, ∑ t, A s t • (x s * y t)) =
      (2 : R) • ∑ t, ∑ v, (Aᵀ * B) t v • (y t * z v)
theorems.description:
**The anticommutator of the two comparisons contracts the shared leg:**
`{Σ A_st x_s y_t, Σ B_uv x_u z_v} = 2 Σ_{t,v} (AᵀB)_tv y_t z_v`.

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.Third.through_third

source_context.command: variable {R : Type*} [CommRing R] {M : Type*} [Ring M] [Algebra R M]

theorems.statement:
theorem through_third (x y z : Fin 5 → M) (A B : Matrix (Fin 5) (Fin 5) R)
    (hx : ∀ s u, x s * x u + x u * x s = (if s = u then (2 : R) else 0) • (1 : M))
    (hxy : ∀ s t, x s * y t = y t * x s) (hxz : ∀ s v, x s * z v = z v * x s)
    (hyz : ∀ t v, y t * z v = z v * y t) :
    Lf x y A * Lf x z B + Lf x z B * Lf x y A =
      (2 : R) • (Lf x y A + Lf x z B + Lf y z (Aᵀ * B) - 2)
theorems.description:
**Comparisons compose through a third** (Proposition 90), in any algebra:
`{L_ab(A), L_ac(B)} = 2 (L_ab(A) + L_ac(B) + L_bc(AᵀB) − 2)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.Third.commutator_sum

source_context.command: variable {R : Type*} [CommRing R] {M : Type*} [Ring M] [Algebra R M]

theorems.statement:
theorem commutator_sum (x y z : Fin 5 → M) (A B : Matrix (Fin 5) (Fin 5) R)
    (hxy : ∀ s t, x s * y t = y t * x s) (hxz : ∀ s v, x s * z v = z v * x s)
    (hyz : ∀ t v, y t * z v = z v * y t) :
    (∑ s, ∑ t, A s t • (x s * y t)) * (∑ u, ∑ v, B u v • (x u * z v)) -
      (∑ u, ∑ v, B u v • (x u * z v)) * (∑ s, ∑ t, A s t • (x s * y t)) =
      ∑ s, ∑ t, ∑ u, ∑ v, (A s t * B u v) • ((x s * x u - x u * x s) * (y t * z v))
theorems.description:
**The order-dependent part:** `[Σ A_st x_s y_t, Σ B_uv x_u z_v] = Σ (A_st B_uv)(x_s x_u − x_u x_s) y_t z_v`,
using only that operators on different systems commute.

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.Third.commutator_turns

source_context.command: variable {R : Type*} [CommRing R] {M : Type*} [Ring M] [Algebra R M]

theorems.statement:
theorem commutator_turns (x : Fin 5 → M)
    (hx : ∀ s u, x s * x u + x u * x s = (if s = u then (2 : R) else 0) • (1 : M)) (s u : Fin 5) :
    x s * x u - x u * x s = if s = u then 0 else (2 : R) • (x s * x u)
theorems.description:
**The order-dependent part is a rotation of the shared system:** with Proposition 4, `x_s x_u − x_u x_s`
is `0` for `s = u` and `2 x_s x_u` (the rotation of the plane `(s u)`) for `s ≠ u`.

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.Third.ga_clifford
theorems.statement:
theorem ga_clifford (s u : Fin 5) :
    ga s * ga u + ga u * ga s = (if s = u then (2 : ℂ) else 0) • (1 : Matrix Three Three ℂ)

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.Third.ga_gb
theorems.statement: theorem ga_gb (s t : Fin 5) : ga s * gb t = gb t * ga s

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.Third.ga_gc
theorems.statement: theorem ga_gc (s v : Fin 5) : ga s * gc v = gc v * ga s

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.Third.gb_gc
theorems.statement: theorem gb_gc (t v : Fin 5) : gb t * gc v = gc v * gb t

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.Third.prop90
theorems.statement:
theorem prop90 (A B : Matrix (Fin 5) (Fin 5) ℂ) :
    Lab A * Lac B + Lac B * Lab A = (2 : ℂ) • (Lab A + Lac B + Lbc (Aᵀ * B) - 2)
theorems.description:
**Proposition 90 on three systems:** `½{L_ab(A), L_ac(B)} = L_ab(A) + L_ac(B) + L_bc(AᵀB) − 2`, for
all frames `A`, `B`.

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.Third.prop90_order
theorems.statement:
theorem prop90_order (A B : Matrix (Fin 5) (Fin 5) ℂ) :
    Lbc (Aᵀ * B) = (1 / 2 : ℂ) • (Lab A * Lac B + Lac B * Lab A) - Lab A - Lac B + 2
theorems.description:
**The order of the two comparisons does not change the third:** the anticommutator is symmetric,
and the third comparison `L_bc(AᵀB)` is read off it alone.

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.Third.product_through_third
theorems.statement:
theorem product_through_third (A B : Matrix (Fin 5) (Fin 5) ℂ) :
    Lab A * Lac B = Lab A + Lac B + Lbc (Aᵀ * B) - 2 + (1 / 2 : ℂ) • turnPart A B ∧
      Lac B * Lab A = Lab A + Lac B + Lbc (Aᵀ * B) - 2 - (1 / 2 : ℂ) • turnPart A B
theorems.description:
**The product of the two comparisons:** `L_ab(A) L_ac(B) = L_ab(A) + L_ac(B) + L_bc(AᵀB) − 2 + ½T`,
`T` the rotation of the shared system; in the other order `− ½T`. The order-free part is the third
comparison; the order is recorded only in the rotation.

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.Third.turnPart_turns
theorems.statement:
theorem turnPart_turns (A B : Matrix (Fin 5) (Fin 5) ℂ) :
    turnPart A B = ∑ s, ∑ t, ∑ u, ∑ v,
      (A s t * B u v) • ((if s = u then (0 : Matrix Three Three ℂ) else (2 : ℂ) • (ga s * ga u)) *
        (gb t * gc v))
theorems.description:
**The rotation part carries only rotations of the shared system:** its terms with `s = u` vanish and those
with `s ≠ u` are `2 (γ_sγ_u)^{(a)} γ_t^{(b)} γ_v^{(c)}`.

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.Third.Lab_one
theorems.statement: theorem Lab_one : Lab 1 = 1 + ∑ s, ga s * gb s
theorems.description: With the identity frame, `L_ab(1)` is the comparison `1 + Σ_s γ_s^{(a)} γ_s^{(b)}` (Definition 10).

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.Third.triangle_flat
theorems.statement:
theorem triangle_flat {K : Type*} [CommRing K] (A B : Matrix (Fin 5) (Fin 5) K)
    (hA : Aᵀ * A = 1) (hB : Bᵀ * B = 1) : A * (Aᵀ * B) * Bᵀ = 1
theorems.description:
**The triangle closes flat:** for orthogonal frames the frame round `a → b → c → a` is
`A (AᵀB) Bᵀ = 1`.

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.Third.third_orientation
theorems.statement:
theorem third_orientation {K : Type*} [CommRing K] (A B : Matrix (Fin 5) (Fin 5) K) :
    (Aᵀ * B).det = A.det * B.det
theorems.description: The orientation of the third comparison is the product of the other two.

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.Third.comparison_frame_meeting
theorems.statement:
theorem comparison_frame_meeting (k : Fin 16) :
    ((1 : Matrix Two Two ℂ) + ∑ s, (if s ∈ disagreeSet k then -1 else 1 : ℂ) • (γ s ⊗ₖ γ s)) *ᵥ
        rel k = (6 : ℂ) • rel k
theorems.description:
**A pair meeting at `U` is compared in the frame `θ_U`:** `L_ab(θ_U)` is `1 + Σ_s ε_s(U) γ_s ⊗ γ_s`,
which is `6` on the two-spinor state `e_U` (two systems, `agreement`).

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.Third.third_pattern
theorems.statement:
theorem third_pattern {K : Type*} [CommRing K] (U V : Finset (Fin 5)) :
    (thetaP (R := K) U)ᵀ * thetaP V = thetaP (symmDiff U V)
theorems.description: **Two pairs at `U` and `V` put the third pair at `U △ V`:** `θ_Uᵀ θ_V = θ_{U △ V}`.

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.Third.sign_triangle
theorems.statement:
theorem sign_triangle (U V : Finset (Fin 5)) (r : Fin 5) :
    agr U r * agr V r * agr (symmDiff U V) r = 1
theorems.description: **The triangle of signs is `+1`:** for every line `r`, `ε_r(U) ε_r(V) ε_r(U △ V) = 1`.

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.Third.third_sign
theorems.statement:
theorem third_sign (U V : Finset (Fin 5)) (r : Fin 5) :
    agr (symmDiff U V) r = agr U r * agr V r
theorems.description: **The third sign is fixed by the other two:** `ε_r(U △ V) = ε_r(U) ε_r(V)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.Third.no_negative_triangle
theorems.statement:
theorem no_negative_triangle (U V : Finset (Fin 5)) (r : Fin 5) :
    ¬ (agr U r = -1 ∧ agr V r = -1 ∧ agr (symmDiff U V) r = -1)
theorems.description:
**No negative triangle through a third:** three pair signs `−1` on one line cannot occur when the
third pair is composed from the other two.

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.Third.two_at_plane
theorems.statement: theorem two_at_plane : symmDiff ({0, 1} : Finset (Fin 5)) {0, 1} = ∅
theorems.description: **Two pairs at the plane put the third pair at the singlet.**

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.Third.gram_through_third
theorems.statement:
theorem gram_through_third (g σ₁₂ σ₁₃ : ℝ) (h₁₂ : σ₁₂ * σ₁₂ = 1) (h₁₃ : σ₁₃ * σ₁₃ = 1) :
    (!![1, σ₁₂ * g, σ₁₃ * g; σ₁₂ * g, 1, σ₁₂ * σ₁₃ * g; σ₁₃ * g, σ₁₂ * σ₁₃ * g, 1] :
      Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ).det = (1 - g) ^ 2 * (1 + 2 * g)
theorems.description:
**The meeting matrix of three lines composed through a third** is a sign gauge of the flat one:
with signs `σ₁₂, σ₁₃` and `σ₂₃ = σ₁₂σ₁₃`, `det = (1 − g)²(1 + 2g)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.Third.gram_through_third_pos
theorems.statement: theorem gram_through_third_pos (g : ℝ) (h0 : 0 ≤ g) (h1 : g < 1) : 0 < (1 - g) ^ 2 * (1 + 2 * g)
theorems.description: **Positivity follows:** for `0 ≤ g < 1` the determinant is positive; at `g² = 8/15` in particular.

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.Third.c_overlap_lt_one
theorems.statement: theorem c_overlap_lt_one : Real.sqrt (8 / 15) < 1

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.Third.plane_colour_through_third
theorems.statement:
theorem plane_colour_through_third :
    (thetaP (R := ℂ) planeF)ᵀ * thetaP colourC = thetaP Finset.univ ∧
      thetaP (R := ℂ) Finset.univ = -1 ∧ (thetaP (R := ℂ) Finset.univ).det = -1 ∧
      symmDiff planeF colourC = Finset.univ
theorems.description:
**`F` and `C` through a third:** `θ_Fᵀ θ_C = θ_{all five} = −1`, the counterpart `{n}` of the singlet, of
determinant `−1`: a system compared with `b` at `F` and with `c` at `C` compares `b` with `c` at the singlet's counterpart
`{n}`, an orientation-reversing comparison of type `1|5`.

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.Third.plane_colour_comparison
theorems.statement:
theorem plane_colour_comparison :
    Lbc ((thetaP (R := ℂ) planeF)ᵀ * thetaP colourC) = 1 - ∑ s, gb s * gc s
theorems.description:
The comparison at the singlet's counterpart `{n}`: `L_bc(−1) = 1 − Σ_s γ_s^{(b)} γ_s^{(c)}`, through `a` at `F` and
`C`.

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.Third.twin_comparison_on_rel
theorems.statement:
theorem twin_comparison_on_rel (k : Fin 16) :
    ((1 : Matrix Two Two ℂ) - ∑ s, γ s ⊗ₖ γ s) *ᵥ rel k =
      ((2 : ℂ) * (disagreeSet k).card - 4) • rel k
theorems.description:
**On two systems the comparison at the singlet's counterpart `{n}` is `2|T_k| − 4`:** `(1 − Σ_s γ_s ⊗ γ_s) e_k =
(2|T_k| − 4) e_k`, so it is `−4` on the singlet, `0` on the ten symmetric states and `4` on the five vector
states: joined through a third at `F` and `C`, the other two systems' comparison vanishes on the symmetric states.

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.third_frame_unique
theorems.statement: theorem third_frame_unique (a b c : G) (h : a * c = b) : c = a⁻¹ * b
theorems.description: Once the first two comparisons are fixed, the third is their carried product.

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.through_third_flat
theorems.statement: theorem through_third_flat (a b : G) : a * (a⁻¹ * b) * b⁻¹ = 1
theorems.description: The composed comparison triangle has identity holonomy, also noncommutatively.

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.vertex_frames_flat
theorems.statement:
theorem vertex_frames_flat (a b c : G) :
    (a⁻¹ * b) * (b⁻¹ * c) * (c⁻¹ * a) = 1
theorems.description: Three relative comparisons obtained from three frames close.

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.sign_triangle
theorems.statement:
theorem sign_triangle (a b : ℝ) (ha : a ^ 2 = 1) (hb : b ^ 2 = 1) :
    a * (a * b) * b = 1

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.two_negative_force_positive
theorems.statement: theorem two_negative_force_positive (c : ℝ) (h : (-1 : ℝ) * c = -1) : c = 1
theorems.description: Two negative comparisons force a positive third, not three negative edges.

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.three_negative_not_flat
theorems.statement: theorem three_negative_not_flat : (-1 : ℝ) * (-1) * (-1) ≠ 1
theorems.description: A flat normalized triangle cannot have all three overlaps negative.

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.plane_colour_third
theorems.statement: theorem plane_colour_third : planeFrameᵀ * colourFrame = -1
theorems.description: The full comparison through a third joins F and C by the singlet's counterpart `{n}`.

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.plane_colour_triangle
theorems.statement: theorem plane_colour_triangle : planeFrame * (-1) * colourFrameᵀ = 1
theorems.description: The orientation-reversing third two-spinor state is used twice around the triangle.

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.cmpPart_eq
theorems.statement:
theorem cmpPart_eq (A : Matrix (Fin 5) (Fin 5) ℂ) (x y : Fin 5 → R) :
    cmpPart A x y = ∑ s, x s * along A y s

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.along_comm
theorems.statement:
theorem along_comm {x y : Fin 5 → R} (hxy : ∀ s t, x s * y t = y t * x s)
    (A : Matrix (Fin 5) (Fin 5) ℂ) (s u : Fin 5) : x u * along A y s = along A y s * x u

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.along_along_comm
theorems.statement:
theorem along_along_comm {y z : Fin 5 → R} (hyz : ∀ t v, y t * z v = z v * y t)
    (A B : Matrix (Fin 5) (Fin 5) ℂ) (s u : Fin 5) :
    along A y s * along B z u = along B z u * along A y s

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.sum_along_along
theorems.statement:
theorem sum_along_along (A B : Matrix (Fin 5) (Fin 5) ℂ) (y z : Fin 5 → R) :
    ∑ s, along A y s * along B z s = cmpPart (Aᵀ * B) y z

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.swap_left
theorems.statement: theorem swap_left (a b c : R) (h : b * a = a * b) : b * (a * c) = a * (b * c)

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.through_third_core
theorems.statement:
theorem through_third_core (A B : Matrix (Fin 5) (Fin 5) ℂ) (x y z : Fin 5 → R)
    (hx : ∀ s u, x s * x u + x u * x s = (if s = u then (2 : ℂ) else 0) • (1 : R))
    (hxy : ∀ s t, x s * y t = y t * x s) (hxz : ∀ s v, x s * z v = z v * x s)
    (hyz : ∀ t v, y t * z v = z v * y t) :
    cmpPart A x y * cmpPart B x z + cmpPart B x z * cmpPart A x y =
      (2 : ℂ) • cmpPart (Aᵀ * B) y z
theorems.description:
**Comparisons compose through a third, the core:** `XY + YX = 2 Σ_{t,v} (AᵀB)_tv y_t z_v` for
`X = Σ A_st x_s y_t`, `Y = Σ B_uv x_u z_v`.

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.through_third
theorems.statement:
theorem through_third (A B : Matrix (Fin 5) (Fin 5) ℂ) (x y z : Fin 5 → R)
    (hx : ∀ s u, x s * x u + x u * x s = (if s = u then (2 : ℂ) else 0) • (1 : R))
    (hxy : ∀ s t, x s * y t = y t * x s) (hxz : ∀ s v, x s * z v = z v * x s)
    (hyz : ∀ t v, y t * z v = z v * y t) :
    compL A x y * compL B x z + compL B x z * compL A x y =
      (2 : ℂ) • (compL A x y + compL B x z + compL (Aᵀ * B) y z - (2 : ℂ) • 1)
theorems.description:
**Proposition 90, comparisons compose through a third:**
`L_ab(A) L_ac(B) + L_ac(B) L_ab(A) = 2 (L_ab(A) + L_ac(B) + L_bc(AᵀB) − 2)`, the order of the two comparisons free,
the comparison of `b` with `c` in the frame `AᵀB` entering with weight one.

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.three_lines_clifford
theorems.statement:
theorem three_lines_clifford (s u : Fin 5) :
    γa s * γa u + γa u * γa s = (if s = u then (2 : ℂ) else 0) • (1 : Matrix Three Three ℂ)

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.three_ab
theorems.statement: theorem three_ab (s t : Fin 5) : γa s * γb t = γb t * γa s

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.three_ac
theorems.statement: theorem three_ac (s v : Fin 5) : γa s * γc v = γc v * γa s

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.three_bc
theorems.statement: theorem three_bc (t v : Fin 5) : γb t * γc v = γc v * γb t

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.prop90_model
theorems.statement:
theorem prop90_model (A B : Matrix (Fin 5) (Fin 5) ℂ) :
    compL A γa γb * compL B γa γc + compL B γa γc * compL A γa γb =
      (2 : ℂ) • (compL A γa γb + compL B γa γc + compL (Aᵀ * B) γb γc - (2 : ℂ) • 1)
theorems.description:
**Proposition 90 in the model, on three systems:** comparing the first system with the second in the frame `A` and
with the third in the frame `B`, in either order, compares the second with the third in the frame `AᵀB`.

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.frame_transpose
theorems.statement: theorem frame_transpose (U : Finset (Fin 5)) : (frame U)ᵀ = frame U

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.xor_frames
theorems.statement: theorem xor_frames (U V : Finset (Fin 5)) : (frame U)ᵀ * frame V = frame (symmDiff U V)
theorems.description:
**Through a third, two two-spinor states make the third:** `θ_Uᵀ θ_V = θ_{U △ V}`; Proposition 25's composition of the
two-spinor states of three systems is Proposition 90 on the meetings' frames.

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.flat_triangle
theorems.statement: theorem flat_triangle (U V : Finset (Fin 5)) : frame U * frame (symmDiff U V) * frame V = 1
theorems.description:
**The flat triangle:** around the three two-spinor states of three systems the frames multiply to one,
`θ_U θ_{U△V} θ_V = 1`: on every line the three agreement signs multiply to `+1`.

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.triangle_sign_one
theorems.statement:
theorem triangle_sign_one (U V : Finset (Fin 5)) (r : Fin 5) :
    (if r ∈ U then (-1 : ℂ) else 1) * (if r ∈ symmDiff U V then -1 else 1) * (if r ∈ V then -1 else 1) = 1
theorems.description: **No triangle of two-spinor states returns `−1`:** the sign of the three agreements on a line is `+1` at every record.

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.flat_triangle_orth
theorems.statement:
theorem flat_triangle_orth (A B : Matrix (Fin 5) (Fin 5) ℂ) (hA : A * Aᵀ = 1) (hB : B * Bᵀ = 1) :
    A * (Aᵀ * B) * Bᵀ = 1
theorems.description: The same around any three frames composed through a third: `A (AᵀB) Bᵀ = 1` for orthogonal `A, B`.

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.plane_plane_singlet
theorems.statement: theorem plane_plane_singlet : symmDiff ({0, 1} : Finset (Fin 5)) {0, 1} = ∅
theorems.description: Two pairs of three systems at the plane meeting put the third pair at the singlet.

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.frame_univ
theorems.statement: theorem frame_univ : frame Finset.univ = -1
theorems.description: The frame of all five lines reversed, the singlet's counterpart `{n}`, is `−1`.

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.plane_colour_through_third
theorems.statement:
theorem plane_colour_through_third :
    (frame ({0, 1} : Finset (Fin 5)))ᵀ * frame Finset.univ = frame ({2, 3, 4} : Finset (Fin 5))
theorems.description:
**The plane and its colour counterpart are joined through a third:** `θ_Fᵀ θ_{all five} = θ_C` with `F = {h, k}`,
`C = {c₁, c₂, c₃}`, the third compared in the frame `−1` of the singlet's counterpart `{n}`.

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.frame_det_plane
theorems.statement: theorem frame_det_plane : (frame ({0, 1} : Finset (Fin 5))).det = 1

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.frame_det_colour
theorems.statement: theorem frame_det_colour : (frame ({2, 3, 4} : Finset (Fin 5))).det = -1

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.join_needs_improper
theorems.statement:
theorem join_needs_improper (B : Matrix (Fin 5) (Fin 5) ℂ)
    (h : (frame ({0, 1} : Finset (Fin 5)))ᵀ * B = frame ({2, 3, 4} : Finset (Fin 5))) : B.det = -1
theorems.description:
**Only an improper comparison joins them:** every frame `B` with `θ_Fᵀ B = θ_C` has `det B = −1`; turns
(determinant one) alone never join the plane to its colour counterpart.

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.relations_stay_even
theorems.statement: theorem relations_stay_even : ∀ U V : Finset (Fin 5), Even U.card → Even V.card → Even (symmDiff U V).card
theorems.description:
**Two-spinor states stay two-spinor states:** two even sets compose to an even set, so two two-spinor states never compose to the odd
colour counterpart.

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.stepSign_sq
theorems.statement: theorem stepSign_sq (s : Fin 5) (x : Fin 6) : stepSign s x * stepSign s x = 1

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.planeSign_eq
theorems.statement:
theorem planeSign_eq (s : Fin 5) (a b : Fin 6) :
    planeSign s a b = if s ∈ planePattern a b then -1 else 1

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.planePattern_lines
theorems.statement:
theorem planePattern_lines : ∀ (a b : Fin 5), a ≠ b →
    planePattern a.succ b.succ = {a, b}
theorems.description: A rotation of two lines has their two-element pattern.

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.planePattern_clock
theorems.statement:
theorem planePattern_clock : ∀ t : Fin 5,
    planePattern 0 t.succ = ({t} : Finset (Fin 5))ᶜ
theorems.description: An own clock `(n,t)` has the four-vector state pattern.

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.planePattern_even
theorems.statement:
theorem planePattern_even : ∀ a b : Fin 6, a ≠ b →
    (planePattern a b).card = 2 ∨ (planePattern a b).card = 4
theorems.description: Every genuine six-plane gives an even meeting character.

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.J_conj_generator
theorems.statement:
theorem J_conj_generator (a x : Fin 6) :
    Jx (R := ℝ) a * Jx x * Jx a = (if a = x then (1 : ℝ) else -1) • Jx x

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.two_reflections_sign
theorems.statement:
theorem two_reflections_sign : ∀ (s : Fin 5) (x : Fin 6),
    (if s.succ = x then (1 : ℤ) else -1) * (if (0 : Fin 6) = x then 1 else -1) =
      -stepSign s x

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.two_leg_generator
theorems.statement:
theorem two_leg_generator (s : Fin 5) (x : Fin 6) :
    (Jx (R := ℝ) 0 * Jx s.succ) * Jx x * (Jx s.succ * Jx 0) =
      (-(stepSign s x : ℝ)) • Jx x
theorems.description: The two vertical legs act on a six-vector with the negative paired description sign.

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.conj_product
theorems.statement:
theorem conj_product {A : Type*} [Ring A] (L R X Y : A) (hRL : R*L = 1) :
    L*(X*Y)*R = (L*X*R)*(L*Y*R)

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.two_leg_plane
theorems.statement:
theorem two_leg_plane (s : Fin 5) (a b : Fin 6) :
    (Jx (R := ℝ) 0 * Jx s.succ) * (Jx a * Jx b) * (Jx s.succ * Jx 0) =
      (planeSign s a b : ℝ) • (Jx a * Jx b)
theorems.description: The native character is derived from Proposition 37's two vertical legs.

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.mixedK_shift
theorems.statement:
theorem mixedK_shift {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (V W : Finset (Fin 5)) :
    mixedK (R := R) V W = patternK (V ∆ W)
theorems.description: Keeping the parallel character is exactly a shift of the vertical pattern.

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.transported_step
theorems.statement:
theorem transported_step {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (V : Finset (Fin 5))
    (a b : Fin 6) (s t : Fin 5) :
    mixedK (R := R) V (planePattern a b) s t =
      (planeSign s a b : R) * (if s ∈ V then -1 else 1) * (if s = t then 0 else 1)

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.mixed_factor
theorems.statement:
theorem mixed_factor (V W : Finset (Fin 5)) (u : ℂ) :
    (1 - u ^ 2) * (1 - u • mixedK (R := ℂ) V W).det =
      (1 + u) ^ (5 - (V ∆ W).card) * (1 - u) ^ (V ∆ W).card *
        (1 + 4 * u ^ 2 - u * (5 - 2 * (V ∆ W).card))

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.plane_own_shift
theorems.statement: theorem plane_own_shift : mixedK (R := ℂ) plane (planePattern 1 2) = patternK ∅

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.colour_own_shift
theorems.statement: theorem colour_own_shift : mixedK (R := ℂ) colour (planePattern 1 2) = patternK Finset.univ

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.plane_own_factor
theorems.statement:
theorem plane_own_factor (u : ℂ) :
    (1 - u • mixedK (R := ℂ) plane (planePattern 1 2)).det = (1 + u)^4 * (1 - 4*u)

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.colour_own_factor
theorems.statement:
theorem colour_own_factor (u : ℂ) :
    (1 - u • mixedK (R := ℂ) colour (planePattern 1 2)).det = (1 - u)^4 * (1 + 4*u)

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.plane_colour_clock
theorems.statement:
theorem plane_colour_clock :
    mixedK (R := ℂ) plane (planePattern 0 3) = patternK {3, 4}
theorems.description: The clock of a colour line in F's return shifts F to a plane, not to C.

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.colour_colour_clock
theorems.statement:
theorem colour_colour_clock :
    mixedK (R := ℂ) colour (planePattern 0 3) = patternK {0, 1, 2}
theorems.description: The same clock inside C shifts C to the complementary three-line pattern.

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.no_rotation_plane_to_colour
theorems.statement:
theorem no_rotation_plane_to_colour : ∀ a b : Fin 6, a ≠ b →
    plane ∆ planePattern a b ≠ colour
theorems.description: An F-to-C insertion would need the all-five odd pattern, absent from the fifteen rotations.

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.carry_product
theorems.statement:
theorem carry_product {A : Type*} [Ring A] (H X Y : A) (hH : H*H = 1) :
    (H*X*H) * (H*Y*H) = H*(X*Y)*H
theorems.description: Retaining the complete transformed source preserves products.

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.carry_boundary
theorems.statement:
