theorem carry_boundary {A : Type*} [Ring A] (H P X : A) (hH : H*H = 1) :
    (H*P*H)*(H*X*H)*(H*P*H) = H*(P*X*P)*H
theorems.description: Carry both retained boundaries as well as the response, before compressing.

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.carry_inverse
theorems.statement:
theorem carry_inverse {A : Type*} [Ring A] (H X Y : A) (hH : H*H = 1)
    (hXY : X*Y = 1) : (H*X*H)*(H*Y*H) = 1
theorems.description: The inverse travels with the operator; this does not assume a scalar renewal.

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.character_square
theorems.statement: theorem character_square : ∀ x U : Fin 16, charTable x U * charTable x U = 1

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.characterGauge_sq
theorems.statement: theorem characterGauge_sq (U : Fin 16) : characterGauge U * characterGauge U = 1

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.transport_is_gauge
theorems.statement:
theorem transport_is_gauge (U : Fin 16) (c : Fin 5 → Fin 5 → ℂ) :
    characterGauge U * transitionShaped ℂ c * characterGauge U =
      transitionShaped ℂ (fun s t => (charSign s U : ℂ) * c s t)
theorems.description: The carried rotation is a vertex character gauge on the complete eighty states.

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.det_carry
theorems.statement:
theorem det_carry {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (H M : Matrix n n ℂ) (hH : H*H = 1) : (H*M*H).det = M.det
theorems.description: Conjugation does not change a finite determinant.

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.transported_law_det
theorems.statement:
theorem transported_law_det (U : Fin 16) (c : Fin 5 → Fin 5 → ℂ) (u : ℂ) :
    (1 - u • transitionShaped ℂ (fun s t => (charSign s U : ℂ) * c s t)).det =
      (1 - u • transitionShaped ℂ c).det
theorems.description: Hence the whole law with a transported rotation has the original determinant.

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.recordFlags_are_moved_clocks
theorems.statement:
theorem recordFlags_are_moved_clocks : ∀ (r : Fin 5) (p : Fin 16 × Fin 16),
    recordFlags r p =
      (movesTurn (relDiv p.1) 0 r.succ,
       movesTurn (relDiv p.2) 0 r.succ,
       movesTurn (symmDiff (relDiv p.1) (relDiv p.2)) 0 r.succ)
theorems.description: The flags are the actual moved own clocks of the three pair divisions.

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.distinct_record_count
theorems.statement: theorem distinct_record_count : distinctRecords.card = 210

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.xor_triangle_counts
theorems.statement:
theorem xor_triangle_counts : ∀ r : Fin 5,
    flagCount r (false, false, false) = 42 ∧
    flagCount r (false, true, true) = 56 ∧
    flagCount r (true, false, true) = 56 ∧
    flagCount r (true, true, false) = 56 ∧
    flagCount r (true, true, true) = 0

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.no_triple_clock
theorems.statement:
theorem no_triple_clock (r : Fin 5) (p : Fin 16 × Fin 16) :
    recordFlags r p ≠ (true, true, true)

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.triangle_probabilities
theorems.statement:
theorem triangle_probabilities :
    (42 : ℚ) / 210 = 1 / 5 ∧ (56 : ℚ) / 210 = 4 / 15 ∧
      (112 : ℚ) / 210 = 8 / 15

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.two_unit_locks_det
theorems.statement:
theorem two_unit_locks_det :
    Matrix.det (!![(1 : ℚ), 1, 0; 1, 1, 1; 0, 1, 1]) = -1

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.Bases.PhiL_apply
theorems.statement:
theorem PhiL_apply (v : Fin 16 → ℂ) :
    PhiL v = ∑ U, (∑ x, charX ℂ x U * v x) • relOp U

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.Bases.transition_eq_iff
theorems.statement: theorem transition_eq_iff (s : Fin 5) (x y : Fin 16) : x = transition s y ↔ y = transition s x

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.Bases.Phi_transition
theorems.statement:
theorem Phi_transition (t : Fin 5) (v : Fin 16 → ℂ) :
    PhiL (fun x => v (transition t x)) = γ t * PhiL v * γ t
theorems.description: **The vertex transition is the step's conjugation:** `Φ(v ∘ transition_t) = γ_t Φ(v) γ_t`.

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.Bases.transitionK_mulVec
theorems.statement:
theorem transitionK_mulVec (t : Fin 5) (v : Fin 16 → ℂ) :
    transitionK ℂ t *ᵥ v = fun x => v (transition t x)
theorems.description: The vertex transition on the sixteen vertices, `X_t`, as Proposition 130's `transitionK`.

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.Bases.Phi_transitionK
theorems.statement:
theorem Phi_transitionK (t : Fin 5) (v : Fin 16 → ℂ) :
    PhiL (transitionK ℂ t *ᵥ v) = γ t * PhiL v * γ t
theorems.description: **Proposition 130 read through `Φ`:** `Φ(X_t v) = γ_t Φ(v) γ_t`.

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.Bases.relOpZ_gram
theorems.statement:
theorem relOpZ_gram : ∀ j k : Fin 16,
    ((relOpZ j)ᴴ * relOpZ k).trace = if j = k then 4 else 0

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.Bases.toComplex_semiconj
theorems.statement:
theorem toComplex_semiconj :
    Function.Semiconj (GaussianInt.toComplex : GaussianInt → ℂ) star star

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.Bases.relOp_gram
theorems.statement:
theorem relOp_gram (j k : Fin 16) :
    ((relOp j)ᴴ * relOp k).trace = if j = k then 4 else 0
theorems.description: **`tr(B_jᴴ B_k) = 4 δ_jk`.**

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.Bases.trace_PhiL
theorems.statement:
theorem trace_PhiL (j : Fin 16) (v : Fin 16 → ℂ) :
    ((relOp j)ᴴ * PhiL v).trace = 4 * ∑ x, charX ℂ x j * v x

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.Bases.PhiL_injective
theorems.statement: theorem PhiL_injective : Function.Injective PhiL

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.Bases.PhiL_bijective
theorems.statement: theorem PhiL_bijective : Function.Bijective PhiL

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.Bases.contBC_mulVec
theorems.statement:
theorem contBC_mulVec (w : State → ℂ) (x : Fin 16) (s : Fin 5) :
    (contBC *ᵥ w) (x, s) = ∑ t, (if s = t then (0 : ℂ) else 1) * w (transition s x, t)

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.Bases.contBC_eq
theorems.statement: theorem contBC_eq : contBC = stepOp transitionMat
theorems.description: The same operator as the law's `stepOp transitionMat` (Propositions 54, 131).

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.Bases.Phi80_contB
theorems.statement: theorem Phi80_contB (w : State → ℂ) : Phi80 (contBC *ᵥ w) = jointSinglet (Phi80 w)
theorems.description:
**The two pairings are one operator in two bases:** `Φ₈₀(B w) = 𝕁(Φ₈₀ w)`. The line's walk on its
eighty states (first pairing, the vertex moved) is, through `Φ`, the last-step direction's walk carrying one system's
operators by the step (second pairing, the frame transported).

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.Bases.Phi80_bijective
theorems.statement: theorem Phi80_bijective : Function.Bijective Phi80

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.Bases.jointSinglet_channel
theorems.statement:
theorem jointSinglet_channel (k : Fin 16) (a : Fin 5 → ℂ) :
    jointSinglet (fun t => a t • relOp k) =
      fun s => (patternK (R := ℂ) (disagreeSet k) *ᵥ a) s • relOp k
theorems.description:
**A channel of the joint walk:** on `a ⊗ B_k` the joint walk at the singlet is the meeting's last-step direction
walk `K_{T_k} = θ_{T_k}(𝐉 − I)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.Bases.jointTwin_channel
theorems.statement:
theorem jointTwin_channel (k : Fin 16) (a : Fin 5 → ℂ) :
    jointTwin (fun t => a t • relOp k) =
      fun s => (patternK (R := ℂ) (disagreeSet k)ᶜ *ᵥ a) s • relOp k
theorems.description: On `a ⊗ B_k` the joint walk at the singlet's counterpart `{n}` is the counterpart's walk `K_{T_k^c} = −K_{T_k}`.

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.Bases.four_kinds
theorems.statement:
theorem four_kinds :
    (Finset.univ.filter fun k : Fin 16 => (disagreeSet k).card = 0).card = 1 ∧
    (Finset.univ.filter fun k : Fin 16 =>
      (disagreeSet k).card = 2 ∨ (disagreeSet k).card = 4).card = 15 ∧
    (Finset.univ.filter fun k : Fin 16 =>
      (disagreeSet k)ᶜ.card = 1 ∨ (disagreeSet k)ᶜ.card = 5).card = 6 ∧
    (Finset.univ.filter fun k : Fin 16 => (disagreeSet k)ᶜ.card = 3).card = 10
theorems.description:
**The four types on one operator:** the sixteen channels of `𝕁` are the singlet (`0|6`) and the
fifteen meetings of `2|4` (ten symmetric states, five vector states); the sixteen channels of `−𝕁` are the six
counterparts of `1|5` (the five `{t}` and `{n}`) and the ten colour counterparts of `3|3`. Counted by the number of
lines a channel's walk divides: `𝕁` gives `0` once and `2, 4` fifteen times; `−𝕁` gives `5` once,
`1` five times and `3` ten times.

theorems.name: Comparison.JointCells.Bases.law_both
theorems.statement:
theorem law_both (u : ℂ) :
    (1 - u • stepOp transitionMat).det = ∏ k, (1 - u • patternK (R := ℂ) (disagreeSet k)).det ∧
      (1 + u • stepOp transitionMat).det = ∏ k, (1 - u • patternK (R := ℂ) (disagreeSet k)ᶜ).det
theorems.description:
**The law at the four types, both bases at once:** for every `u`, the line's walk, the sixteen
meetings and (at `−u`) the sixteen counterparts give one determinant (Propositions 54, 131; `law_meetings`,
`law_twins`).

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.ihara_bass_weighted

source_context.command: variable {K : Type*} [Field K] {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]

theorems.statement:
theorem ihara_bass_weighted (Γ : Fin 5 → Matrix V V K) (c : Fin 5 → K)
    (hΓ : ∀ t, Γ t * Γ t = c t • 1) (u : K) (hc : ∀ t, 1 - u ^ 2 * c t ≠ 0) :
    (∏ t, (1 - u • Γ t).det) * (1 - u • stepOp Γ).det =
      (∏ t, (1 - u ^ 2 * c t) ^ Fintype.card V) *
        (1 - ∑ t, (u / (1 - u ^ 2 * c t)) • (Γ t - (u * c t) • 1)).det
theorems.description: **Bass's identity for five operators with scalar squares.**

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.bass_line_weights
theorems.statement:
theorem bass_line_weights (w : Fin 5 → ℂ) (u : ℂ) (hc : ∀ t, 1 - u ^ 2 * w t ^ 2 ≠ 0) :
    (1 - u • stepOp (fun t => w t • transitionMat t)).det =
      (∏ t, (1 - u ^ 2 * w t ^ 2) ^ 8) *
        (1 - ∑ t, (u / (1 - u ^ 2 * w t ^ 2) * w t) • transitionMat t +
          (∑ t, u ^ 2 / (1 - u ^ 2 * w t ^ 2) * w t ^ 2) • (1 : Matrix (Fin 16) (Fin 16) ℂ)).det
theorems.description:
**Bass's identity with a weight on the steps along each line** (Proposition 161, the vertex form):
`det(I − uB_w) = ∏_t (1 − u²w_t²)⁸ · det(I − Â + D̂)` on the sixteen vertices,
`Â = Σ_t u(1 − u²w_t²)⁻¹ w_t X_t`, `D̂ = Σ_t u²(1 − u²w_t²)⁻¹ w_t²`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.minor_self
theorems.statement:
theorem minor_self (M : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) R) (S : Finset (Fin m)) :
    minor M S S = (M.submatrix (S.orderEmbOfFin rfl) (S.orderEmbOfFin rfl)).det

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.minor_smul
theorems.statement:
theorem minor_smul (c : R) (M : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) R) (T S : Finset (Fin m)) :
    minor (c • M) T S = c ^ S.card * minor M T S

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.minor_eq_zero_of_card
theorems.statement:
theorem minor_eq_zero_of_card (M : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) R) {T S : Finset (Fin m)}
    (h : S.card ≠ T.card) : minor M T S = 0

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.extPow_smul
theorems.statement:
theorem extPow_smul (c : R) (M : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) R) :
    extPow (c • M) = gradePow c * extPow M

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.extPow_smul'
theorems.statement:
theorem extPow_smul' (c : R) (M : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) R) :
    extPow (c • M) = extPow M * gradePow c
theorems.description: `Λ(cM) = Λ(M) c^N` as well.

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.extPow_one
theorems.statement: theorem extPow_one : extPow (1 : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) R) = 1
theorems.description: `Λ(I) = I`: the minors of the identity.

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.extPow_smul_one
theorems.statement: theorem extPow_smul_one (c : R) : extPow (c • (1 : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) R)) = gradePow c
theorems.description: **`Λ(cI) = c^N`:** the whole described once.

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.sum_orderEmbOfFin
theorems.statement:
theorem sum_orderEmbOfFin {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] (S : Finset (Fin m)) (f : Fin m → M) :
    ∑ i : Fin S.card, f (S.orderEmbOfFin rfl i) = ∑ x ∈ S, f x
theorems.description: The sum over `Fin |S|` read through the increasing enumeration of `S` is the sum over `S`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.minor_rankOne_self
theorems.statement:
theorem minor_rankOne_self {K : Type*} [Field K] (c : K) (v : Fin m → K) (S : Finset (Fin m)) :
    minor (c • vecMulVec v v - 1) S S = (-1) ^ S.card * (1 - c * ∑ x ∈ S, v x * v x)
theorems.description: **The principal minor of `−1 + c·vvᵀ`:** `det(−1 + c v vᵀ)[S, S] = (−1)^{|S|}(1 − c Σ_{x∈S} v_x²)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.carried_apply
theorems.statement:
theorem carried_apply (i j : Fin 6) :
    carried K i j = (if i = 0 ∨ j = 0 then 0 else 2 / 5) - if i = j then 1 else 0

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.carried_zero_zero
theorems.statement: theorem carried_zero_zero : carried K 0 0 = -1

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.carried_zero_succ
theorems.statement: theorem carried_zero_succ (j : Fin 5) : carried K 0 j.succ = 0

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.carried_succ_zero
theorems.statement: theorem carried_succ_zero (i : Fin 5) : carried K i.succ 0 = 0

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.carried_succ_succ
theorems.statement: theorem carried_succ_succ (i j : Fin 5) : carried ℚ i.succ j.succ = coin i j
theorems.description: On the five directions the transported matrix is the coin `σ`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.minor_carried_self
theorems.statement:
theorem minor_carried_self [CharZero K] (S : Finset (Fin 6)) :
    minor (carried K) S S = (-1) ^ S.card * (1 - 2 / 5 * (linesIn S : K))
theorems.description:
**The principal minors of the transported matrix:** `det Σ₆[S, S] = (−1)^{|S|} (1 − (2/5) k)`,
`k` the number of lines in `S`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.five_minor_carried
theorems.statement:
theorem five_minor_carried [CharZero K] (S : Finset (Fin 6)) :
    5 * minor (carried K) S S = (-1) ^ S.card * (5 - 2 * (linesIn S : K))

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.minor_coin_self
theorems.statement:
theorem minor_coin_self (S : Finset (Fin 5)) :
    minor coin S S = (-1) ^ S.card * (5 - 2 * (S.card : ℚ)) / 5
theorems.description:
**The principal minors of the coin:** `det σ[S, S] = (−1)^k (5 − 2k)/5`, `k = |S|`, for every
set `S` of the five directions.

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.minor_coin_relation
theorems.statement:
theorem minor_coin_relation (l : Fin 16) :
    5 * minor coin (disagreeSet l) (disagreeSet l) = (Lvalue l : ℚ) - 1
theorems.description:
On the sixteen two-spinor states, `T_l` the lines on which the two systems disagree,
**`5 det σ[T_l, T_l] = L(e_l) − 1`**: the minor is `(L − 1)/5`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.card_linesOf
theorems.statement: theorem card_linesOf (S : Finset (Fin 6)) : (linesOf S).card = linesIn S

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.minor_carried_lines
theorems.statement:
theorem minor_carried_lines (S : Finset (Fin 6)) :
    minor (carried ℚ) S S =
      (if (0 : Fin 6) ∈ S then -1 else 1) * minor coin (linesOf S) (linesOf S)
theorems.description:
**The minor of `Σ₆` is the coin's on the lines, with the singlet's sign:**
`det Σ₆[S, S] = (−1)^{[n ∈ S]} det σ[S ∩ lines]`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.carried_whole
theorems.statement:
theorem carried_whole :
    extPow (Complex.I • carriedC) = gradePow Complex.I * extPow carriedC ∧
      extPow (Complex.I • carriedC) = extPow (Complex.I • (1 : Matrix (Fin 6) (Fin 6) ℂ)) *
        extPow carriedC
theorems.description: **`Λ(iΣ₆) = i^N Λ(Σ₆) = Λ(iI) Λ(Σ₆)`** on the 64-dimensional exterior algebra of the six.

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.carried_whole_diag
theorems.statement:
theorem carried_whole_diag (S : Finset (Fin 6)) :
    extPow (Complex.I • carriedC) S S =
      Complex.I ^ S.card * ((-1) ^ S.card * (1 - 2 / 5 * (linesIn S : ℂ)))
theorems.description: The diagonal of `Λ(iΣ₆)`: `i^{|S|} det Σ₆[S, S]`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.card_dividedSets
theorems.statement: theorem card_dividedSets : Fintype.card (Finset (Fin 6)) = 64
theorems.description: The exterior algebra of the six has `64` basis sets.

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.prop192_moves
theorems.statement:
theorem prop192_moves :
    ∀ (r : Fin 5) (U : Fin 16), movesTurn (relDiv U) 0 r.succ = decide (r ∈ disagreeSet U)
theorems.description: **The meeting moves a line's clock exactly where the two disagree on that line.**

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.prop192_count
theorems.statement:
theorem prop192_count :
    ∀ r : Fin 5, (Finset.univ.filter fun U : Fin 16 => U ≠ 0 ∧ r ∈ disagreeSet U).card = 8
theorems.description: **At eight of the fifteen two-spinor states other than the singlet**, for every line.

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.time_division_turns
theorems.statement:
theorem time_division_turns : ∀ r : Fin 5,
    (turns6.filter fun p => movesTurn {0, r.succ} p.1 p.2 = true).card = 8 ∧
      (turns6.filter fun p => movesTurn {0, r.succ} p.1 p.2 = false).card = 7
theorems.description: **`r`'s time division `{r, n}` moves 8 and keeps 7 of the 15 rotations.**

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.relTurn_spec
theorems.statement:
theorem relTurn_spec : ∀ U : Fin 16, U ≠ 0 →
    ((disagreeSet U).card = 2 → relDiv U = {(relTurn U).1, (relTurn U).2}) ∧
      ((disagreeSet U).card = 4 → (relTurn U).1 = 0 ∧ (relTurn U).2 ∉ relDiv U)
theorems.description:
The rotation is the two-spinor state's: a plane's two lines, or a vector state's missing line with the
singlet.

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.relTurn_moved
theorems.statement:
theorem relTurn_moved : ∀ (r : Fin 5) (U : Fin 16), U ≠ 0 →
    movesTurn {0, r.succ} (relTurn U).1 (relTurn U).2 = decide (r ∈ disagreeSet U)
theorems.description: **`θ_U` moves `(n r)` ⟺ `r ∈ T_U` ⟺ `r`'s time division moves the two-spinor state's own rotation.**

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.ones_dot_mul_diag
theorems.statement:
theorem ones_dot_mul_diag (B : Matrix State State ℚ) (f : State → ℚ) :
    (1 : State → ℚ) ⬝ᵥ ((B * diagonal f) *ᵥ 1) = ∑ s, ∑ s', B s' s * f s

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.diag_mul_diag
theorems.statement:
theorem diag_mul_diag (f g : State → ℚ) :
    (diagonal f * diagonal g : Matrix State State ℚ) = diagonal fun s => f s * g s

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.count_moved
theorems.statement:
theorem count_moved : ∀ r : Fin 5, ∑ s : State, ∑ s' : State,
    (if Continues s s' ∧ s'.2 = r ∧ r ∈ disagreeSet s.1 ∧ s.1 ≠ 0 then 1 else 0 : ℕ) = 32

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.count_transitions
theorems.statement:
theorem count_transitions : ∀ r : Fin 5, ∑ s : State, ∑ s' : State,
    (if Continues s s' ∧ s'.2 = r ∧ s.1 ≠ 0 then 1 else 0 : ℕ) = 60

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.count_moved_availableTransitions
theorems.statement:
theorem count_moved_availableTransitions : ∀ h : Fin 5, ∑ s : State, ∑ s' : State,
    (if Continues s s' ∧ s'.2 = h ∧ h ∈ disagreeSet s.1 ∧ inExcursion h s = true then 1 else 0 : ℕ) =
      32

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.count_transitions_availableTransitions
theorems.statement:
theorem count_transitions_availableTransitions : ∀ h : Fin 5, ∑ s : State, ∑ s' : State,
    (if Continues s s' ∧ s'.2 = h ∧ inExcursion h s = true then 1 else 0 : ℕ) = 60

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.prop195
theorems.statement:
theorem prop195 (r : Fin 5) :
    (1 : State → ℚ) ⬝ᵥ ((stepsAlong r * lamR r * offSinglet) *ᵥ 1) = 32 ∧
      (1 : State → ℚ) ⬝ᵥ ((stepsAlong r * offSinglet) *ᵥ 1) = 60 ∧
      ((1 : State → ℚ) ⬝ᵥ ((stepsAlong r * lamR r * offSinglet) *ᵥ 1)) /
        ((1 : State → ℚ) ⬝ᵥ ((stepsAlong r * offSinglet) *ᵥ 1)) = 8 / 15
theorems.description: **The coupling as a trace on the eighty states:** `𝟏ᵀB_rΛ_rΠ𝟏 / 𝟏ᵀB_rΠ𝟏 = 32/60 = 8/15`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.prop195_availableTransitions
theorems.statement:
theorem prop195_availableTransitions (h : Fin 5) :
    ((1 : State → ℚ) ⬝ᵥ ((stepsAlong h * lamR h * availableTransitionsProj h) *ᵥ 1)) /
        ((1 : State → ℚ) ⬝ᵥ ((stepsAlong h * availableTransitionsProj h) *ᵥ 1)) = 8 / 15
theorems.description: **The same with the available transitions of `h`, along `h`.**

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.count_kept
theorems.statement:
theorem count_kept : ∀ r : Fin 5,
    (Finset.univ.filter fun U : Fin 16 => U ≠ 0 ∧ r ∉ disagreeSet U).card = 7

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.meeting_matrix_trace
theorems.statement:
theorem meeting_matrix_trace (r : Fin 5) :
    ∑ U ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun U : Fin 16 => U ≠ 0), (4 / 60 : ℚ) • (recordG r U ⊙ recordG r U) =
      1 + (8 / 15 : ℚ) • ((Matrix.of fun _ _ => (1 : ℚ)) - 1)
theorems.description:
**The meeting matrix as a trace over the records:**
`Σ_{U≠∅} (4/60) G(U) ∘ G(U) = I + (8/15)(𝐉 − I)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.det_one_sub_kron_of_eigen
theorems.statement:
theorem det_one_sub_kron_of_eigen {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (A P : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) (l : Fin 2 → ℝ) (hP : IsUnit P.det)
    (hAP : A * P = P * diagonal l) (M : Matrix n n ℝ) :
    (1 - A ⊗ₖ M).det = (1 - l 0 • M).det * (1 - l 1 • M).det
theorems.description:
**The law on the direct sum splits over the modes:** if `AP = P diag(λ)` with `P` invertible, then
`det(I − A ⊗ M) = det(I − λ₁M) det(I − λ₂M)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.levelOp_charpoly
theorems.statement:
theorem levelOp_charpoly (S₁ S₂ g l : ℝ) :
    (l • (1 : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ) - levelOp S₁ S₂ g).det =
      l ^ 2 - (S₁ + S₂) * l + (1 - g ^ 2) * S₁ * S₂
theorems.description:
The level operator's spectrum: `R = D^½GD^½` has the same, and both have the characteristic
polynomial `λ² − (S₁ + S₂)λ + (1 − g²)S₁S₂`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.discR_sq
theorems.statement:
theorem discR_sq (S₁ S₂ c : ℝ) (hd : 0 ≤ (S₁ - S₂) ^ 2 + 4 * c * S₁ * S₂) :
    discR S₁ S₂ c ^ 2 = (S₁ - S₂) ^ 2 + 4 * c * S₁ * S₂

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.eigenPlus_root
theorems.statement:
theorem eigenPlus_root (S₁ S₂ c : ℝ) (hd : 0 ≤ (S₁ - S₂) ^ 2 + 4 * c * S₁ * S₂) :
    eigenPlus S₁ S₂ c ^ 2 - (S₁ + S₂) * eigenPlus S₁ S₂ c + (1 - c) * S₁ * S₂ = 0

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.eigenMinus_root
theorems.statement:
theorem eigenMinus_root (S₁ S₂ c : ℝ) (hd : 0 ≤ (S₁ - S₂) ^ 2 + 4 * c * S₁ * S₂) :
    eigenMinus S₁ S₂ c ^ 2 - (S₁ + S₂) * eigenMinus S₁ S₂ c + (1 - c) * S₁ * S₂ = 0

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.eigen_sum
theorems.statement: theorem eigen_sum (S₁ S₂ c : ℝ) : eigenPlus S₁ S₂ c + eigenMinus S₁ S₂ c = S₁ + S₂
theorems.description: **The first order: `Tr R = λ₊ + λ₋ = S₁ + S₂` at every coupling.**

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.eigen_prod
theorems.statement:
theorem eigen_prod (S₁ S₂ c : ℝ) (hd : 0 ≤ (S₁ - S₂) ^ 2 + 4 * c * S₁ * S₂) :
    eigenPlus S₁ S₂ c * eigenMinus S₁ S₂ c = (1 - c) * S₁ * S₂

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.eigen_sq
theorems.statement:
theorem eigen_sq (S₁ S₂ c : ℝ) (hd : 0 ≤ (S₁ - S₂) ^ 2 + 4 * c * S₁ * S₂) :
    eigenPlus S₁ S₂ c ^ 2 + eigenMinus S₁ S₂ c ^ 2 = S₁ ^ 2 + S₂ ^ 2 + 2 * c * S₁ * S₂
theorems.description: **`Tr R² = S₁² + S₂² + 2cS₁S₂`.**

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.eigen_cube
theorems.statement:
theorem eigen_cube (S₁ S₂ c : ℝ) (hd : 0 ≤ (S₁ - S₂) ^ 2 + 4 * c * S₁ * S₂) :
    eigenPlus S₁ S₂ c ^ 3 + eigenMinus S₁ S₂ c ^ 3 =
      (1 - c) * (S₁ ^ 3 + S₂ ^ 3) + c * (S₁ + S₂) ^ 3
theorems.description: **`Tr R³ = (1 − c)(S₁³ + S₂³) + c(S₁ + S₂)³`:** linear in the coupling.

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.second_order_composite
theorems.statement:
theorem second_order_composite (S₁ S₂ c : ℝ) (hd : 0 ≤ (S₁ - S₂) ^ 2 + 4 * c * S₁ * S₂) :
    (eigenPlus S₁ S₂ c / 5 - 6 / 125 * eigenPlus S₁ S₂ c ^ 2) +
        (eigenMinus S₁ S₂ c / 5 - 6 / 125 * eigenMinus S₁ S₂ c ^ 2) =
      (S₁ + S₂) / 5 - 6 / 125 * (S₁ ^ 2 + S₂ ^ 2) - 12 / 125 * c * S₁ * S₂
theorems.description:
**The second order of the composition:** `Σ_j [λ_j/5 − (6/125)λ_j²] =
(S₁ + S₂)/5 − (6/125)(S₁² + S₂²) − (12/125)c S₁S₂`: the cross spread `c σ²`, `σ² = 12/125`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.prop189_det
theorems.statement:
theorem prop189_det {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] (S₁ S₂ g : ℝ) (hg : g ≠ 0)
    (hS : S₂ ≠ 0) (hd : 0 < (S₁ - S₂) ^ 2 + 4 * g ^ 2 * S₁ * S₂) (M : Matrix n n ℝ) :
    (1 - levelOp S₁ S₂ g ⊗ₖ M).det =
      (1 - eigenPlus S₁ S₂ (g ^ 2) • M).det * (1 - eigenMinus S₁ S₂ (g ^ 2) • M).det
theorems.description:
**Proposition 189: the law on the direct sum is the product over the modes,**
`det(I − (GD) ⊗ M) = det(I − λ₊M) det(I − λ₋M)` (`g ≠ 0`, `S₂ ≠ 0`, distinct modes).

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.line_side_det
theorems.statement:
theorem line_side_det {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] (S₁ S₂ : ℝ) (M : Matrix n n ℝ) :
    (1 - levelOp S₁ S₂ 0 ⊗ₖ M).det = (1 - S₁ • M).det * (1 - S₂ • M).det
theorems.description: **The line side (`G = I`):** `det(I − D ⊗ M) = det(I − S₁M) det(I − S₂M)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.meeting_side_det
theorems.statement:
theorem meeting_side_det {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] (S₁ S₂ : ℝ) (hS : S₂ ≠ 0)
    (hT : S₁ + S₂ ≠ 0) (M : Matrix n n ℝ) :
    (1 - levelOp S₁ S₂ 1 ⊗ₖ M).det = (1 - (S₁ + S₂) • M).det
theorems.description: **The meeting side (`G = 𝟏𝟏ᵀ`):** `det(I − (𝟏𝟏ᵀD) ⊗ M) = det(I − (S₁ + S₂)M)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.deltaLevel_zero
theorems.statement: theorem deltaLevel_zero : deltaLevel 0 = 0

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.composite_ends
theorems.statement:
theorem composite_ends (S₁ S₂ : ℝ) (h₁ : 0 ≤ S₁) (h₂ : 0 ≤ S₂) :
    compositeDelta S₁ S₂ 0 = deltaLevel S₁ + deltaLevel S₂ ∧
      compositeDelta S₁ S₂ 1 = deltaLevel (S₁ + S₂)
theorems.description:
**The two ends:** at `c = 0` the line side `δ₁(S₁) + δ₁(S₂)`; at `c = 1` the meeting side
`δ₁(S₁ + S₂)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.K0_composition
theorems.statement:
theorem K0_composition (Sd mp : ℝ) (hS : 0 ≤ Sd) (hp : 0 ≤ massOp .symmetric sPlaneSinglet) :
    6 * mp ^ 2 * compositeDelta Sd (massOp .symmetric sPlaneSinglet * Sd) 0 =
        6 * mp ^ 2 * (deltaLevel Sd + deltaLevel (massOp .symmetric sPlaneSinglet * Sd)) ∧
      6 * mp ^ 2 * compositeDelta Sd (massOp .symmetric sPlaneSinglet * Sd) 1 =
        6 * mp ^ 2 * deltaLevel (Sd + massOp .symmetric sPlaneSinglet * Sd) ∧
      eigenPlus Sd (massOp .symmetric sPlaneSinglet * Sd) (8 / 15) +
          eigenMinus Sd (massOp .symmetric sPlaneSinglet * Sd) (8 / 15) =
        Sd + massOp .symmetric sPlaneSinglet * Sd ∧
      massOp .symmetric sPlaneSinglet =
        3 ^ (5 : ℝ) * Real.exp (-(5 / 2)) * clockMQ sLastDirectionSinglet (-(9 / 4000)) ^ (1 / 6 : ℝ)
theorems.description:
**K⁰'s composition at its two ends and at first order:** the coupling `8/15` sits between the line
side (`c = 0`) and the meeting side (`c = 1`); the first order `(S_d + S_s)/5` is the same at every
coupling (`eigen_sum`); the strange level is `S_s = pS_d` with `p = 3⁵e^{−5/2}M_Q(−ν)^{1/6}`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.clockMQ_pos
theorems.statement: theorem clockMQ_pos (S : Finset (Fin 6)) (x : ℝ) : 0 < clockMQ S x
theorems.description: The clock is positive.

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.massOp_plane_pos
theorems.statement: theorem massOp_plane_pos (S : Finset (Fin 6)) : 0 < massOp .symmetric S
theorems.description: The strange-to-down ratio `p` is positive.

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.K0_law_on_direct_sum
theorems.statement:
theorem K0_law_on_direct_sum {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] (Sd : ℝ) (hS : 0 < Sd)
    (M : Matrix n n ℝ) :
    (1 - levelOp Sd (massOp .symmetric sPlaneSinglet * Sd) (Real.sqrt (8 / 15)) ⊗ₖ M).det =
      (1 - eigenPlus Sd (massOp .symmetric sPlaneSinglet * Sd) (8 / 15) • M).det *
        (1 - eigenMinus Sd (massOp .symmetric sPlaneSinglet * Sd) (8 / 15) • M).det
theorems.description:
**K⁰'s law on the direct sum of its two lines' words is the product over its two modes,** at the
coupling `G₁₂² = 8/15` of Proposition 195: `det(I − (GD) ⊗ M) = det(I − λ₊M) det(I − λ₋M)`,
`D = diag(S_d, pS_d)`, for every square `M` (Proposition 189 at K⁰).

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.flips_transition
theorems.statement: theorem flips_transition : ∀ (t : Fin 5) (k : Fin 16), flips t (transition t k) = flips t k

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.liftTransition_liftTransition
theorems.statement: theorem liftTransition_liftTransition (t : Fin 5) (p : Bool × Fin 16) : liftTransition t (liftTransition t p) = p

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.liftTransition_central
theorems.statement:
theorem liftTransition_central (t : Fin 5) (p : Bool × Fin 16) :
    liftTransition t (central p) = central (liftTransition t p)
theorems.description: **The central involution commutes with the walk.**

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.liftTransition_inj
theorems.statement: theorem liftTransition_inj (p : Bool × Fin 16) (t t' : Fin 5) : liftTransition t p = liftTransition t' p ↔ t = t'
theorems.description: The five lifted steps from a lifted two-spinor state reach five different lifted two-spinor states.

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.coverAdj_mulVec
theorems.statement:
theorem coverAdj_mulVec (f : Bool × Fin 16 → ℂ) (p : Bool × Fin 16) :
    (coverAdj *ᵥ f) p = ∑ t : Fin 5, f (liftTransition t p)

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.coverAdj_row
theorems.statement: theorem coverAdj_row : coverAdj *ᵥ (fun _ => 1) = fun _ => 5
theorems.description: **Five-regular:** every lifted two-spinor state has five out-steps.

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.card_arcs
theorems.statement: theorem card_arcs : Fintype.card ((Bool × Fin 16) × Fin 5) = 160
theorems.description: **`160` directed arcs.**

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.transitionMat_mulVec
theorems.statement:

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.cover_even
theorems.statement:
theorem cover_even (g : Fin 16 → ℂ) :
    coverAdj *ᵥ (fun p => g p.2) = fun p => (adjC *ᵥ g) p.2
theorems.description: **The even central character:** on functions of the two-spinor state alone the walk is `A`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.sgn_xor

theorems.description: **The odd central character:** on `σ·g(k)` the walk is the signed walk `A₋`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.cover_blocks

theorems.description: **In the basis of the two signs the walk is `[[A₀, A₁], [A₁, A₀]]`.**

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.adj_charpoly
theorems.statement:
theorem adj_charpoly (l : ℂ) :
    (l • (1 : Matrix (Fin 16) (Fin 16) ℂ) - adjC).det =
      (l - 5) * (l - 1) ^ 10 * (l + 3) ^ 5

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.signed_charpoly
theorems.statement:
theorem signed_charpoly (l : ℂ) :
    (l • (1 : Matrix (Fin 16) (Fin 16) ℂ) - adjSigned).det = (l ^ 2 - 5) ^ 8
theorems.description:
**`det(λ − A₋) = (λ² − 5)⁸`:** `A₋` is `(Σ_t γ_t) ⊗ 1` in another basis, and
`det(λ − Σ_tγ_t) = (λ² − 5)²`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.cover_charpoly
theorems.statement:
theorem cover_charpoly (l : ℂ) :
    (l • (1 : Matrix (Bool × Fin 16) (Bool × Fin 16) ℂ) - coverAdj).det =
      (l - 5) * (l - 1) ^ 10 * (l + 3) ^ 5 * (l ^ 2 - 5) ^ 8
theorems.description: **The lifted spectrum:** `det(λ − Ã) = (λ − 5)(λ − 1)¹⁰(λ + 3)⁵(λ² − 5)⁸`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.signed_law_cover
theorems.statement:
theorem signed_law_cover (u : ℂ) :
    (1 - u • stepOp (signTransitionC (-1 : ℂ))).det =
      (1 - u ^ 2) ^ 24 * (1 + 3 * u ^ 2 + 16 * u ^ 4) ^ 8
theorems.description: **Equation (11):** the odd character's law, `det(I − uB₋) = (1 − u²)²⁴(1 + 3u² + 16u⁴)⁸`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.negLaw_eq
theorems.statement: theorem negLaw_eq (n : ℕ) : negLaw n = (excursionLaw n - signedLaw n) / 2

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.lineWalk_isPerron

source_context.command: open Matrix Filter Topology Asymptotics Complex

theorems.statement:
theorem lineWalk_isPerron (w : Fin 5 → ℝ) (hw : ∀ t, 0 < w t) (lam : ℝ) (hl : 0 < lam)
    (hsec : ∑ t, w t / (lam + w t) = 1) : IsPerron (lineWalk w) (lam / 4)
theorems.description:
**The line side's Perron root:** if `λ > 0` solves the singlet meeting's secular equation
`Σ_t w_t/(λ + w_t) = 1`, then `λ/4` is the Perron root of the weighted walk, with the positive
eigenvectors `x_s = w_{t(s)}/(λ + w_{t(s)})` and `y_s = 1/(λ + w_{t(s)})`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.singlet_root_of_secular

source_context.command: open Matrix Filter Topology Asymptotics Complex

theorems.statement:
theorem singlet_root_of_secular (w : Fin 5 → ℝ) (hw : ∀ t, 0 < w t) (lam : ℝ) (hl : 0 < lam)
    (hsec : ∑ t, w t / (lam + w t) = 1) : ∑ t, 1 / (1 + (1 / lam) * w t) - 4 = 0
theorems.description: **The same zero at the singlet meeting:** `u = 1/λ` is the root of `Σ_t 1/(1 + uw_t) − 4`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.singlet_weighted_factor

source_context.command: open Matrix Filter Topology Asymptotics Complex

theorems.statement:
theorem singlet_weighted_factor (u : ℝ) (w : Fin 5 → ℝ) (hw : ∀ t, 1 + u * w t ≠ 0) :
    (1 - u • (diagonal w * (Matrix.of fun i j : Fin 5 => if i = j then (0 : ℝ) else 1))).det =
      (∏ t, (1 + u * w t)) * (∑ t, 1 / (1 + u * w t) - 4)
theorems.description:
**The singlet meeting's weighted factor** (Proposition 135 with the Euler completion):
`det(I − uW(𝐉 − I)) = ∏_t(1 + uw_t) · [Σ_t 1/(1 + uw_t) − 4]` where every `1 + uw_t ≠ 0`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.conj_spectrum

theorems.description: **The spectrum in the two bases:** `det(λ − (𝒳 ⊗ 1)M(𝒳 ⊗ 1)) = det(λ − M)`.

theorem level_factor (h : Fin 5) (S u : ℝ) (h1 : 1 + u ≠ 0) (h2 : 1 + u * Real.exp (-S) ≠ 0) :
    ∑ t, 1 / (1 + u * levelW h S t) - 4 =
      (1 - 3 * u - 4 * u ^ 2 * Real.exp (-S)) / ((1 + u) * (1 + u * Real.exp (-S)))
theorems.description:
With `e^{−S}` on the steps along one line,
`Σ_t 1/(1 + uw_t) − 4 = (1 − 3u − 4u²e^{−S})/((1 + u)(1 + ue^{−S}))`.

**Proposition 140's level and Proposition 167's `δ(S)` to second order:**
`δ(S) = log 4u_c(S) = S/5 − (6/125)S² + O(S³)`, the singlet meeting's root read through the line side's

theorems.description: **A fifth of the steps go along any one line:** the rate of the weight on its steps is `1/5`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.one_line_angle

source_context.command: open Matrix Filter Topology Asymptotics Complex

theorems.statement:
theorem one_line_angle (t : Fin 5) :
    ∃ ψ : ℂ → ℂ, ψ 0 = 1 ∧ (∀ᶠ s in 𝓝 0, charF lawP (alongX t) s (ψ s) = 0) ∧
      HasDerivAt (fun θ : ℝ => Complex.arg (ψ (-I * θ))) (-(1 / 5 : ℝ)) 0
theorems.description:
**A phase `e^{−iθ}` on the steps along one line turns the long-range zero by a fifth of it:**
the eigenvalue `ψ` of the tilted law through `ψ(0) = 1` turns at `−1/5` per unit `θ`, so the zero
`u = 1/(4ψ)` turns at `1/5`, alike for each of the five directions.

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.phase_partial_u

theorems.description: At the singlet meeting: `∂_u[4/(1 + u) + 1/(1 + u) − 4] = −16/5` at `u = 1/4`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.phase_partial_theta

source_context.command: open Matrix Filter Topology Asymptotics Complex

theorems.description: At the singlet meeting: `∂_θ 1/(1 + u e^{−iθ}) = 4i/25` at `(u, θ) = (1/4, 0)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.phase_turn

source_context.command: open Matrix Filter Topology Asymptotics Complex

theorems.statement: theorem phase_turn : -(4 * I / 25) / (-16 / 5) / (1 / 4) = I / 5
theorems.description: **The quotient of the two partials, read at the zero:** `d log 4u_c/dθ_t = i/5`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.level_shift

source_context.command: open Matrix Filter Topology Asymptotics Complex

theorem level_shift (h : Fin 5) :

first order, at the critical step), the zero of the law moves at `1/20` per unit `j`
(`zero_shift_law`): `−l K_j r/(l K_u r) = −(1/5)/(−4)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.residue_values

source_context.command: open Matrix Filter Topology Asymptotics Complex

theorems.statement:
theorem residue_values :
    (Matrix.of fun _ _ => (1 / 16 : ℝ) : Matrix (Fin 16) (Fin 16) ℝ) 0 0 = 1 / 16 ∧
      (∑ U ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun U : Fin 16 => (disagreeSet U).card = 2),
        (Matrix.of fun _ _ => (1 / 16 : ℝ) : Matrix (Fin 16) (Fin 16) ℝ) 0 U) = 10 / 16 ∧

theorems.description:
**The residue at the singlet is `1/16`; the ten symmetric states carry `10/16`, and the plane source

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.critical_sixteen

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.lastDirection_cross_cov

theorems.description:
**`Cov(X^i_0, X^j_k) = (1/5)(Hᵏ)_ij − 1/25 = (1/5)(−1/4)^k(δ_ij − 1/5)`** for the last-step direction's walk
`H = (𝐉 − I)/4`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.cross_spread

source_context.command: open Matrix Filter Topology Asymptotics Complex

theorems.statement:
theorem cross_spread (i j : Fin 5) :
    HasSum (fun k : ℕ => (if k = 0 then (1 : ℝ) else 2) *
        ((1 / 5) * (-1 / 4) ^ k * ((if i = j then 1 else 0) - 1 / 5)))
      ((3 / 25) * ((if i = j then 1 else 0) - 1 / 5))
theorems.description: **The long-run covariance `σ_ij = Σ_{k ∈ ℤ} Cov(X^i_0, X^j_k) = (3/25)(δ_ij − 1/5)`.**

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.cross_values

source_context.command: open Matrix Filter Topology Asymptotics Complex

theorems.description: **`12/125` on one line, `−3/125` across two.**

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.two_limits_first_order

source_context.command: open Matrix Filter Topology Asymptotics Complex

theorems.statement:
theorem two_limits_first_order :
    (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => deltaLevel p.1 + deltaLevel p.2 - (p.1 + p.2) / 5) =O[𝓝 0]
        (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => p.1 ^ 2 + p.2 ^ 2) ∧
      (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => deltaLevel (p.1 + p.2) - (p.1 + p.2) / 5) =O[𝓝 0]
        (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => (p.1 + p.2) ^ 2)
theorems.description:
**The two limits agree at first order** (Proposition 169's first order): for two levels on the
last-step direction, the line side `δ(S₁) + δ(S₂)` and the meeting side `δ(S₁ + S₂)` both carry `(S₁ + S₂)/5`,
each with a remainder `O(S²)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.charTable_transition
theorems.statement:
theorem charTable_transition : ∀ (t : Fin 5) (x U : Fin 16),
    charTable (transition t x) U = charTable x U * charSign t U

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.charTable_symm
theorems.statement: theorem charTable_symm (x U : Fin 16) : charTable x U = charTable U x

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.charX_symm
theorems.statement: theorem charX_symm (x U : Fin 16) : charX K x U = charX K U x

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.charX_transition
theorems.statement:
theorem charX_transition (t : Fin 5) (x U : Fin 16) :
    charX K (transition t x) U = charX K x U * agreeSign K U t

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.charX_mul_self
theorems.statement: theorem charX_mul_self : charX K * charX K = 1

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.charX80_mul_self
theorems.statement: theorem charX80_mul_self : charX80 K * charX80 K = 1

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.det_charX80_sq
theorems.statement: theorem det_charX80_sq : (charX80 K).det ^ 2 = 1

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.transitionShaped_mul_charX80
theorems.statement:
theorem transitionShaped_mul_charX80 (c : Fin 5 → Fin 5 → K) :
    transitionShaped K c * charX80 K =
      charX80 K * meetBlocks K (fun U => thetaM K U * Matrix.of c)
theorems.description: `M 𝒳 = 𝒳 ⊕_U θ_U c` for a transition-shaped `M`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.conj_transitionShaped
theorems.statement:
theorem conj_transitionShaped (c : Fin 5 → Fin 5 → K) :
    charX80 K * transitionShaped K c * charX80 K = meetBlocks K (fun U => thetaM K U * Matrix.of c)
theorems.description:
**The transition-shaped operators become the meetings' blocks:**
`(𝒳 ⊗ 1) M (𝒳 ⊗ 1) = ⊕_U θ_U c`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.charX_transition_charX
theorems.statement:
theorem charX_transition_charX (t : Fin 5) :
    charX K * transitionK K t * charX K = diagonal fun U => agreeSign K U t
theorems.description: **`𝒳 X_t 𝒳 = diag ε_t`.**

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.charX_adjacency_charX
theorems.statement:
theorem charX_adjacency_charX :
    charX K * (∑ t, transitionK K t) * charX K = diagonal fun U => (charValue U : K)
theorems.description:
**`𝒳 A 𝒳 = L − 1`:** the walk on the sixteen vertices is, at the meetings, the agreements less the
disagreements, `a − d = 5, 1, −3`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.sum_agreeSign
theorems.statement: theorem sum_agreeSign (U : Fin 16) : ∑ t, agreeSign K U t = (Lvalue U : K) - 1
theorems.description: The agreements less the disagreements: `Σ_t ε_t(U) = L(e_U) − 1`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.contB_eq_transitionShaped
theorems.statement: theorem contB_eq_transitionShaped : contB = transitionShaped ℚ (fun a b => if a = b then 0 else 1)

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.undoR_eq_transitionShaped
theorems.statement: theorem undoR_eq_transitionShaped : undoR = transitionShaped ℚ (fun a b => if a = b then 1 else 0)

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.stepU_eq_transitionShaped
theorems.statement: theorem stepU_eq_transitionShaped : stepU = transitionShaped ℚ (fun a b => coin a b)

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.of_offDiag
theorems.statement: theorem of_offDiag : (Matrix.of fun a b : Fin 5 => if a = b then (0 : ℚ) else 1) = onesM ℚ - 1

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.of_diag
theorems.statement: theorem of_diag : (Matrix.of fun a b : Fin 5 => if a = b then (1 : ℚ) else 0) = 1

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.prop130_B
theorems.statement: theorem prop130_B : charX80 ℚ * contB * charX80 ℚ = meetBlocks ℚ (lastDirectionK ℚ)
theorems.description:
**Proposition 130, the step:** `(𝒳 ⊗ 1) B (𝒳 ⊗ 1) = ⊕_U K_U`, `K_U = θ_U(𝐉 − I)`: at each
meeting the last-step direction walks the five directions with the meeting's signs.

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.prop130_R
theorems.statement: theorem prop130_R : charX80 ℚ * undoR * charX80 ℚ = meetBlocks ℚ (thetaM ℚ)
theorems.description: **Proposition 130, the undo:** `(𝒳 ⊗ 1) R (𝒳 ⊗ 1) = ⊕_U θ_U`: the meeting's division.

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.prop130_coin
theorems.statement:
theorem prop130_coin :
    charX80 ℚ * ((2 / 5 : ℚ) • contB - (3 / 5 : ℚ) • undoR) * charX80 ℚ =
      meetBlocks ℚ (fun U => thetaM ℚ U * coin)
theorems.description: **Proposition 130, the coin at the meetings:** `(𝒳 ⊗ 1)((2/5)B − (3/5)R)(𝒳 ⊗ 1) = ⊕_U θ_U σ`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.theta_coin_orthogonal
theorems.statement: theorem theta_coin_orthogonal (U : Fin 16) : (thetaM ℚ U * coin)ᵀ * (thetaM ℚ U * coin) = 1
theorems.description: Each meeting's coin `θ_U σ` is orthogonal.

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.thetaP_compl
theorems.statement:
theorem thetaP_compl {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (V : Finset (Fin 5)) :
    thetaP (R := R) Vᶜ = -thetaP V
theorems.description: **The counterpart carries the opposite signs:** `θ_{V^c} = −θ_V`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.thetaM_eq_thetaP
theorems.statement: theorem thetaM_eq_thetaP (U : Fin 16) : thetaM ℚ U = thetaP (disagreeSet U)
theorems.description: The meeting's `θ_U` is the pattern of its disagreement set.

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.prod_erase_ite
theorems.statement:
theorem prod_erase_ite {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (f : Fin 5 → R) (t : Fin 5) :
    ∏ s ∈ Finset.univ.erase t, f s = ∏ s, if s ≠ t then f s else 1

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.euler_completion
theorems.statement:
theorem euler_completion {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (u : R) (c : Fin 5 → R) :
    (1 - u • (diagonal c * (Matrix.of fun i j : Fin 5 => if i = j then (0 : R) else 1))).det =
      ∏ t, (1 + u * c t) - u * ∑ t, c t * ∏ s ∈ Finset.univ.erase t, (1 + u * c s)
theorems.description:
**The Euler completion** (equation (1)), for any five weights `c_t` in any commutative ring:
`det[I − uD(𝐉 − I)] = ∏_t (1 + uc_t) − u Σ_t c_t ∏_{s≠t}(1 + uc_s)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.det_one_add_diag
theorems.statement:
theorem det_one_add_diag {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (u : R) (c : Fin 5 → R) :
    (1 + u • diagonal c).det = ∏ t, (1 + u * c t)
theorems.description: `det(I + uD) = ∏_t (1 + uc_t)`, the exterior character of the meeting.

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.euler_completion_deriv
theorems.statement:
theorem euler_completion_deriv (c : Fin 5 → ℂ) (u : ℂ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun v : ℂ => (1 + v • diagonal c).det)
        (∑ t, c t * ∏ s ∈ Finset.univ.erase t, (1 + u * c s)) u ∧
      (1 - u • (diagonal c * (Matrix.of fun i j : Fin 5 => if i = j then (0 : ℂ) else 1))).det =
        (1 + u • diagonal c).det -
          u * deriv (fun v : ℂ => (1 + v • diagonal c).det) u
theorems.description:
**Equation (1):** over `ℂ`, `det[I − uD(𝐉 − I)] = (1 − u d/du) det(I + uD)` for any complex
weights.

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.meeting_factor
theorems.statement:
theorem meeting_factor {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (u : R) (ε : Fin 5 → R) (hε : ∀ t, ε t ^ 2 = 1) :
    (1 - u ^ 2) *
        (1 - u • (diagonal ε * (Matrix.of fun i j : Fin 5 => if i = j then (0 : R) else 1))).det =
      (∏ t, (1 + u * ε t)) * (1 + 4 * u ^ 2 - u * ∑ t, ε t)
theorems.description:
**The meeting's factor:** for signs `ε_t² = 1`,
`(1 − u²) det(I − uθ(𝐉 − I)) = ∏_t(1 + uε_t)·(1 + 4u² − u Σ_t ε_t)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.prod_pattern
theorems.statement:
theorem prod_pattern {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (u : R) (V : Finset (Fin 5)) :
    ∏ t, (1 + u * (if t ∈ V then -1 else 1 : R)) = (1 + u) ^ (5 - V.card) * (1 - u) ^ V.card
theorems.description: The exterior character of a pattern: `∏_t(1 + uε_t(V)) = (1 + u)^{5−|V|} (1 − u)^{|V|}`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.sum_pattern
theorems.statement:
theorem sum_pattern {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (V : Finset (Fin 5)) :
    ∑ t, (if t ∈ V then -1 else 1 : R) = (5 : R) - 2 * V.card

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.pattern_factor
theorems.statement:
theorem pattern_factor {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (u : R) (V : Finset (Fin 5)) :
    (1 - u ^ 2) * (1 - u • patternK (R := R) V).det =
      (1 + u) ^ (5 - V.card) * (1 - u) ^ V.card * (1 + 4 * u ^ 2 - u * (5 - 2 * V.card))
theorems.description:
**Proposition 131 at every one of the 32 patterns:**
`(1 − u²) det(I − uK_V) = (1 + u)^a (1 − u)^d (1 + 4u² − u(a − d))`, `a = 5 − |V|`, `d = |V|`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.pattern_factor_cancelled
theorems.statement:
theorem pattern_factor_cancelled (V : Finset (Fin 5)) (h1 : 1 ≤ V.card) (h4 : V.card ≤ 4)
    (u : ℂ) :
    (1 - u • patternK (R := ℂ) V).det =
      (1 + u) ^ (4 - V.card) * (1 - u) ^ (V.card - 1) * (1 + 4 * u ^ 2 - u * (5 - 2 * V.card))
theorems.description: The polynomial form of `det(1 − u • M)` over `ℂ` (for the extension from `u² ≠ 1`).

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.singlet_factor
theorems.statement: theorem singlet_factor (u : ℂ) : (1 - u • patternK (R := ℂ) ∅).det = (1 + u) ^ 4 * (1 - 4 * u)
theorems.description: **The singlet meeting:** `det(I − uK_∅) = (1 + u)⁴(1 − 4u)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.all_factor
theorems.statement:
theorem all_factor (u : ℂ) :
    (1 - u • patternK (R := ℂ) Finset.univ).det = (1 - u) ^ 4 * (1 + 4 * u)
theorems.description: **The counterpart of the singlet, all five lines divided:** `det(I − uK_{[5]}) = (1 − u)⁴(1 + 4u)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.sum_agree_minus_one
theorems.statement:
theorem sum_agree_minus_one :
    (∑ U : Fin 16, ((5 - (disagreeSet U).card : ℤ) - 1)) = 24 ∧
      (∑ U : Fin 16, (((disagreeSet U).card : ℤ) - 1)) = 24
theorems.description: **`Σ_U (a_U − 1) = Σ_U (d_U − 1) = 24`** over the sixteen meetings.

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.meetBlocks_eq_submatrix
theorems.statement:
theorem meetBlocks_eq_submatrix (M : Fin 16 → Matrix (Fin 5) (Fin 5) K) :
    meetBlocks K M = (blockDiagonal M).submatrix (Equiv.prodComm (Fin 16) (Fin 5))
      (Equiv.prodComm (Fin 16) (Fin 5))
theorems.description: The meetings' blocks are a block-diagonal matrix with the meeting outside.

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.det_meetBlocks
theorems.statement:
theorem det_meetBlocks (M : Fin 16 → Matrix (Fin 5) (Fin 5) K) :
    (meetBlocks K M).det = ∏ U, (M U).det
theorems.description: **`det ⊕_U M_U = ∏_U det M_U`.**

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.one_sub_meetBlocks
theorems.statement:
theorem one_sub_meetBlocks (u : K) (M : Fin 16 → Matrix (Fin 5) (Fin 5) K) :
    1 - u • meetBlocks K M = meetBlocks K (fun U => 1 - u • M U)

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.det_conj_charX80
theorems.statement:
theorem det_conj_charX80 (M : Matrix State State K) :
    (charX80 K * M * charX80 K).det = M.det

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.stepOp_transitionMat_eq
theorems.statement: theorem stepOp_transitionMat_eq : stepOp transitionMat = transitionShaped ℂ (fun a b => if a = b then 0 else 1)

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.patternK_disagree
theorems.statement:
theorem patternK_disagree (U : Fin 16) :
    thetaM ℂ U * Matrix.of (fun a b : Fin 5 => if a = b then (0 : ℂ) else 1) =
      patternK (disagreeSet U)

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.law_meetings
theorems.statement:
theorem law_meetings (u : ℂ) :
    ∏ U : Fin 16, (1 - u • patternK (R := ℂ) (disagreeSet U)).det =
      (1 - u • stepOp transitionMat).det
theorems.description: **The sixteen meetings multiply to the law:** `∏_U det(I − uK_U) = det(I − uB)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.law_twins
theorems.statement:
theorem law_twins (u : ℂ) :
    ∏ U : Fin 16, (1 - u • patternK (R := ℂ) (disagreeSet U)ᶜ).det =
      (1 + u • stepOp transitionMat).det
theorems.description: **The sixteen counterparts multiply to `det(I + uB)`:** a counterpart's block is `−K_U`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.law_meetings_closed
theorems.statement:
theorem law_meetings_closed (u : ℂ) :
    ∏ U : Fin 16, (1 - u • patternK (R := ℂ) (disagreeSet U)).det =
      (1 - u ^ 2) ^ 24 * ∏ U : Fin 16, (1 + 4 * u ^ 2 - u * (5 - 2 * (disagreeSet U).card))
theorems.description:
**With Proposition 54:** `∏_U det(I − uK_U) = (1 − u²)²⁴ ∏_U (1 + 4u² − uλ_U)`,
`λ_U = 5 − 2|T_U|`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.patternK_apply
theorems.statement:
theorem patternK_apply {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (V : Finset (Fin 5)) (t s : Fin 5) :
    patternK (R := R) V t s = (if t ∈ V then -1 else 1) * (if t = s then 0 else 1)

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.loop_pattern
theorems.statement:
theorem loop_pattern {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (V : Finset (Fin 5)) {t s : Fin 5} (h : t ≠ s) :
    patternK (R := R) V t s * patternK V s t =
      (if t ∈ V then -1 else 1) * (if s ∈ V then -1 else 1)
theorems.description: **The shortest return** `t → s → t` carries `ε_tε_s`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.half_loop
theorems.statement:
theorem half_loop {A : Type*} [Ring A] [Algebra ℂ A] (fx fy : A) (θx θy : ℂ)
    (hanti : fy * fx = -(fx * fy)) (hx : fx * fx = θx • 1) (hy : fy * fy = θy • 1) :
    fx * fy * fx * fy = -((θx * θy) • 1)
theorems.description:
**The vertical loop of the square root of the sign:** if `f_x f_y = −f_y f_x` and `f_x² = θ_x`, `f_y² = θ_y`
(scalars), then `f_x f_y f_x f_y = −θ_xθ_y`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.mem_patternDiv
theorems.statement: theorem mem_patternDiv (V : Finset (Fin 5)) (t : Fin 5) : t.succ ∈ patternDiv V ↔ t ∈ V

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.loop_is_vertical
theorems.statement:
theorem loop_is_vertical {A : Type*} [Ring A] [Algebra ℂ A] (V : Finset (Fin 5)) (f : Fin 6 → A)
    {s t : Fin 5} (hanti : f t.succ * f s.succ = -(f s.succ * f t.succ))
    (hsq : ∀ x, f x * f x = (if x ∈ patternDiv V then -1 else 1 : ℂ) • 1) :
    (((if s ∈ V then -1 else 1 : ℂ) * (if t ∈ V then -1 else 1)) • 1 : A) =
      -(f s.succ * f t.succ * f s.succ * f t.succ)
theorems.description:
**At a pattern the last-step direction's two-step return is the vertical loop of the same division without its
Clifford sign:** for steps `f_x` with `f_sf_t = −f_tf_s` and `f_x² = θ_D(x)`, `D` the pattern's
lines, `ε_s(V)ε_t(V) • 1 = −f_sf_tf_sf_t`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.full_cycle
theorems.statement:
theorem full_cycle {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (V : Finset (Fin 5)) :
    (thetaP (R := R) V).det = (-1) ^ V.card
theorems.description: **The full cycle** through the five directions carries `det θ_V = (−1)^{|V|}`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.signS_patternDividedSet
theorems.statement: theorem signS_patternDividedSet : ∀ V : Finset (Fin 5), signS (patternDividedSet V) = (-1) ^ V.card

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.full_cycle_dividedSet
theorems.statement:
theorem full_cycle_dividedSet (V : Finset (Fin 5)) :
    (thetaP (R := ℂ) V).det = zS (patternDividedSet V) ^ 2
theorems.description: **The full cycle is `z_S²`.**

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.first_return_resolvent
theorems.statement:
theorem first_return_resolvent {K : Type*} [Field K] (x : K) (e : Fin 4 → K)
    (he : ∀ s, 1 + x * e s ≠ 0) (hd : 1 - x * ∑ s, e s / (1 + x * e s) ≠ 0) :
    (1 - x • (diagonal e * (Matrix.of fun i j : Fin 4 => if i = j then (0 : K) else 1))) *ᵥ
        (fun s => (e s / (1 + x * e s)) / (1 - x * ∑ r, e r / (1 + x * e r))) = e
theorems.description:
**Sherman and Morrison on the walk among the other four lines:** with `c_s = ε_s/(1 + xε_s)` and
`y = c/(1 − xΣc)`, `(I − x diag ε (𝐉 − I)) y = ε`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.sum_c_count
theorems.statement:
theorem sum_c_count {K : Type*} [Field K] (x : K) (W : Finset (Fin 4)) :
    ∑ s, (if s ∈ W then (-1 : K) else 1) / (1 + x * (if s ∈ W then -1 else 1)) =
      ((4 - W.card : ℕ) : K) / (1 + x) - (W.card : K) / (1 - x)
theorems.description:
The sum of the four `c_s` counts the agreements: with the disagreements `W` among the other
four lines, `Σc = (4 − |W|)/(1 + x) − |W|/(1 − x)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.firstReturn_closed
theorems.statement:
theorem firstReturn_closed (A : ℕ) (hA : A ≤ 4) (z : ℂ) (h1 : 4 + z ≠ 0) (h2 : 4 - z ≠ 0)
    (hD : 16 + (16 - 8 * (A : ℂ)) * z + 3 * z ^ 2 ≠ 0) :
    firstReturn A z = z ^ 2 * (2 * A - 4 - z) / (16 + (16 - 8 * (A : ℂ)) * z + 3 * z ^ 2)
theorems.description:
**The first return with `A` agreements**, in closed form:
`G_A(z) = z²(2A − 4 − z)/(16 + (16 − 8A)z + 3z²)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.g_closed
theorems.description: **The five first returns** (`z` away from the poles).

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.g_two_phi
theorems.statement:
theorem g_two_phi (z : ℂ) (hz : z ≠ 0) (h16 : 16 + 3 * z ^ 2 ≠ 0) :
    -z ^ 3 / (16 + 3 * z ^ 2) = Phi z / z
theorems.description: `g₂ = Φ(z)/z`: the colour last-step direction's return at the plane is the signed excursion, one step shorter.

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.g_values_one
theorems.statement:
theorem g_values_one :
    firstReturn 4 1 = 1 ∧ firstReturn 3 1 = 1 / 11 ∧ firstReturn 2 1 = -1 / 19 ∧
      firstReturn 1 1 = -1 / 9 ∧ firstReturn 0 1 = -1 / 7

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.g_values_neg_one
theorems.statement:
theorem g_values_neg_one :
    firstReturn 4 (-1) = 1 / 7 ∧ firstReturn 3 (-1) = 1 / 9 ∧ firstReturn 2 (-1) = 1 / 19 ∧
      firstReturn 1 (-1) = -1 / 11 ∧ firstReturn 0 (-1) = -1

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.short_returns
theorems.statement:
theorem short_returns : ∀ V : Finset (Fin 5),
    (patternKZ V * patternKZ V).trace = (5 - 2 * (V.card : ℤ)) ^ 2 - 5 ∧
      (patternKZ V * patternKZ V * patternKZ V).trace =
        (5 - 2 * (V.card : ℤ)) ^ 3 - 13 * (5 - 2 * (V.card : ℤ))
theorems.description:
**The short returns are fixed by the comparison alone:** at every one of the 32 patterns,
`Tr K_V² = λ² − 5` and `Tr K_V³ = λ³ − 13λ`, `λ = 5 − 2|V|`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.short_return_values
theorems.description: The values `(20, 60)`, `(−4, −12)`, `(4, 12)` at the singlet, a plane, a line meeting.

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.characters_sum
theorems.statement: theorem characters_sum : ∀ Δ : Fin 16, ∑ U, charTable U Δ = if Δ = 0 then 16 else 0

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.sum_trace_meet_pow
theorems.statement:
theorem sum_trace_meet_pow :
    ∑ U, (meetKZ U).trace = 0 ∧ ∑ U, (meetKZ U ^ 2).trace = 0 ∧
      ∑ U, (meetKZ U ^ 3).trace = 0 ∧ ∑ U, (meetKZ U ^ 4).trace = 320 ∧
      ∑ U, (meetKZ U ^ 5).trace = 1920 ∧ ∑ U, (meetKZ U ^ 6).trace = 3840

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.trace_singlet_pow
theorems.statement:
theorem trace_singlet_pow :
    (meetKZ 0).trace = 0 ∧ (meetKZ 0 ^ 2).trace = 20 ∧ (meetKZ 0 ^ 3).trace = 60 ∧
      (meetKZ 0 ^ 4).trace = 260 ∧ (meetKZ 0 ^ 5).trace = 1020 ∧
      (meetKZ 0 ^ 6).trace = 4100

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.meetBlocks_mul
theorems.statement:
theorem meetBlocks_mul (M N : Fin 16 → Matrix (Fin 5) (Fin 5) K) :
    meetBlocks K M * meetBlocks K N = meetBlocks K (fun U => M U * N U)

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.meetBlocks_pow
theorems.statement:
theorem meetBlocks_pow (M : Fin 16 → Matrix (Fin 5) (Fin 5) K) (r : ℕ) :
    meetBlocks K M ^ r = meetBlocks K (fun U => M U ^ r)

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.trace_meetBlocks
theorems.statement:
theorem trace_meetBlocks (M : Fin 16 → Matrix (Fin 5) (Fin 5) K) :
    (meetBlocks K M).trace = ∑ U, (M U).trace

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.conj_pow
theorems.statement:

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.trace_law_eq_meetings
theorems.statement:
theorem trace_law_eq_meetings (r : ℕ) :
    (contB ^ r).trace = ∑ U, ((meetKZ U ^ r).trace : ℚ)
theorems.description:
**`Tr B^r = Σ_U Tr K_U^r`:** each meeting weighs every closed walk of the last-step direction by the character of
its displacement, and only the sum over the sixteen meetings keeps the closed comparisons.

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.trace_law_pow

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.signed_law_one_thing

theorems.description:
**The signed law is the last-step direction's walk on one system's four amplitudes, the other's four standing
by:** `det(I − uB₋) = det(I − uB₁)⁴`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.det_one_sub_γ

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.singlet_slope

    HasDerivAt (fun u : ℂ => (1 + u) ^ 4 * (1 - 4 * u)) (-4 * (5 / 4) ^ 4) (1 / 4)
theorems.description: **The slope of the singlet's factor at `1/4` is `−4(5/4)⁴`.**

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.finite_at_quarter
theorems.statement:
theorem finite_at_quarter (V : Finset (Fin 5)) :
    (V.card = 2 → (1 - (1 / 4 : ℂ) • patternK (R := ℂ) V).det = 75 / 64) ∧
    (V.card = 4 → (1 - (1 / 4 : ℂ) • patternK (R := ℂ) V).det = 27 / 32) ∧
    (V.card = 1 → (1 - (1 / 4 : ℂ) • patternK (R := ℂ) V).det = 125 / 128) ∧
    (V.card = 3 → (1 - (1 / 4 : ℂ) • patternK (R := ℂ) V).det = 135 / 128) ∧
    (V.card = 5 → (1 - (1 / 4 : ℂ) • patternK (R := ℂ) V).det = 81 / 128)
theorems.description:
**Every other meeting and counterpart is finite at the critical step:** with `1 − u² = 15/16`,
`(1 − u²) det(I − uK_V) = (1 + u)^a(1 − u)^d(1 + 4u² − u(a − d))` gives `75/64` (symmetric states, `d = 2`),
`27/32` (line meetings, `d = 4`), `125/128` (`{t}`, `d = 1`), `135/128` (3|3, `d = 3`) and
`81/128` (`{n}`, `d = 5`).

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.point_factor_values
theorems.description:
**The point factor at the critical step counts the divided lines:** `1 + 4u² − u(a − d) = d/2` at `u = 1/4`
and `= a/2` at `u = −1/4`, for `a + d = 5`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.piece_h

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.address_volume
theorems.statement:
theorem address_volume (B : Finset (Fin 16)) (a : ℝ) :
    volume B a =
      ((diagonal fun k => a * (sgnL k : ℝ)).submatrix (Subtype.val : B → Fin 16) Subtype.val).det
theorems.description:
**The exterior volume is a principal minor:** `V_B(a) = det diag(a sgn L)[B, B]`, the coefficient
of the several-vertices member on the word `B`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.address_gramTerm
theorems.statement:
theorem address_gramTerm :
    EUS sHere = sourceZ 1 1 ((1 / 5 : ℝ) • (Matrix.of fun _ _ => (1 : ℝ)) : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)
theorems.description:
**The Gram-determinant term's address:** `E_U = 1/t_{} = det(I − J₃/5)⁻¹`, the k-times member on the word of
the three pairings.

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.row_e
theorems.statement:
theorem row_e (h : Fin 5) (a₀ s₀ : State) (h₀ : Continues a₀ s₀) :
    piU ⬝ᵥ (hadPow lawP (oneTransitionX a₀ s₀) 1 *ᵥ 1) = 1 / 320 ∧
      piU ⬝ᵥ (hadPow lawP (availableTransitionsLawX h (transitionX h)) 1 *ᵥ 1) = 1836 / 320
theorems.description:
**The unit:** the bound state that carries one available transition per stationary cycle turns the zero at
`1/320` per unit phase (`one_transition_angle_rate`); the proton's available transitions at `1836/320`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.piece_LOmega
theorems.statement: theorem piece_LOmega : (Lvalue 0 : ℚ) = 6 ∧ 5 * minor coin (disagreeSet 0) (disagreeSet 0) = 5
theorems.description: The comparison at the singlet, `L(Ω) = 6 = 1 + 5 det σ[∅, ∅]`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.piece_opened
theorems.statement: theorem piece_opened : (-(7 * (aS sHere).re ^ 6)) / 16 = -((bS sHere).re * (aS sHere).re ^ 6)
theorems.description: The opened seven-volume over the mean excursion is `−b a⁶`: `|B_h̄|/Eℓ = 7/16 = b({})`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.row_p
theorems.statement: theorem row_p : rowP = protonPole ∧ (1836.152673412 : ℝ) < rowP ∧ rowP < 1836.1526734121
theorems.description: **Row p:** the composition is the book's `6M + C_h + (1/6)log(5/2) − a⁵ − ba⁶`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.petersen_spectrum
theorems.statement:
theorem petersen_spectrum :
    petLap16 * (petLap16 - (2 : ℤ) • 1) * (petLap16 - (5 : ℤ) • 1) = 0 ∧
      petLap16 * petP2num = (2 : ℤ) • petP2num ∧ petLap16 * petP5num = (5 : ℤ) • petP5num ∧
      petP2num.trace = 30 ∧ petP5num.trace = 60 ∧ planeInd16.trace = 10
theorems.description:
**The plane contrasts:** `Δ(Δ − 2)(Δ − 5) = 0`, `Δ·6P₂ = 2·6P₂`, `Δ·15P₅ = 5·15P₅`, with
`Tr 6P₂ = 30` and `Tr 15P₅ = 60`: five contrasts at `2`, four at `5`, over ten symmetric states.

**The quark ratios:** `m_s/m_d = p`, `m_b/m_s = qη`, `m_u/m_d = R_ud = 17/37`,
`κ = (e/t)_{t,n}^{Eℓ/E_P} = (3/2)^{8/5}`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.whole_carried_diag

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.LS_eq_LZ
theorems.statement: theorem LS_eq_LZ (S : Finset (Fin 6)) : LS S = (LZ S : ℂ)

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.linesIn_le
theorems.statement: theorem linesIn_le (S : Finset (Fin 6)) : linesIn S ≤ 5

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.minor_carriedC_self
theorems.statement:
theorem minor_carriedC_self (S : Finset (Fin 6)) :

theorems.description: `det Σ₆[S, S] = P_S (1 − 2k/5)` over `ℂ`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.LS_carried
theorems.statement:
theorem LS_carried (S : Finset (Fin 6)) :
    LS S = 5 - 5 / 2 * (1 - zS S ^ 2) * (1 + minor carriedC S S)
theorems.description: **`L_S` from the transported matrix:** `L_S = 5 − (5/2)(1 − z_S²)(1 + det Σ₆[S, S])`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.LS_odd
theorems.statement: theorem LS_odd {S : Finset (Fin 6)} (h : Odd S.card) : LS S = -5 * minor carriedC S S
theorems.description: **At an odd divided set** `L_S = −5 det Σ₆[S, S]`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.LS_even
theorems.statement: theorem LS_even {S : Finset (Fin 6)} (h : Even S.card) : LS S = 5
theorems.description: **At an even divided set** `L_S = 5`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.LS_odd_coin
theorems.statement:
theorem LS_odd_coin {S : Finset (Fin 6)} (h : Odd S.card) :
    LS S = 5 * (-1) ^ linesIn S * ((minor coin (linesOf S) (linesOf S) : ℚ) : ℂ)
theorems.description: **At an odd divided set** `L_S = 5(−1)^k det σ[S ∩ lines, S ∩ lines]`, the coin's minor.

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.LZ_ne_zero
theorems.statement: theorem LZ_ne_zero (S : Finset (Fin 6)) : LZ S ≠ 0

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.LS_ne_zero
theorems.statement: theorem LS_ne_zero (S : Finset (Fin 6)) : LS S ≠ 0

theorems.description: `Φ = −1/19` on an even divided set, `−1/13` on an odd one.

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.powS_eq
theorems.statement: theorem powS_eq (S : Finset (Fin 6)) : powS S = (3 + (signS S : ℝ)) / 4
theorems.description: **The power is `(3 + P)/4`.**

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.uS_sq
theorems.statement: theorem uS_sq (S : Finset (Fin 6)) : uS S ^ 2 = (signS S : ℂ) / 16

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.wS_sq
theorems.statement: theorem wS_sq (S : Finset (Fin 6)) : wS S ^ 2 = (signS S : ℂ) / LS S ^ 2
theorems.description: `w_S² = P/L_S²`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.LZ_sq_add_ne
theorems.statement: theorem LZ_sq_add_ne (S : Finset (Fin 6)) : LZ S ^ 2 + 3 * signS S ≠ 0

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.psi_int
theorems.statement:
theorem psi_int (S : Finset (Fin 6)) :
    (signS S * (15 + 13 * signS S) = LZ S ^ 2 + 3 * signS S ↔
      (Even S.card ∨ linesIn S = 2 ∨ linesIn S = 3)) ∧
    (Odd S.card → (linesIn S = 0 ∨ linesIn S = 5) → signS S * 22 = -(LZ S ^ 2 + 3 * signS S)) ∧
    (Odd S.card → (linesIn S = 1 ∨ linesIn S = 4) → signS S * 6 = -(LZ S ^ 2 + 3 * signS S))
theorems.description: The integer form of the association's values.

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.PsiS_eq
theorems.statement:
theorem PsiS_eq (S : Finset (Fin 6)) :
    PsiS S = (signS S : ℂ) / (LS S ^ 2 + 3 * (signS S : ℂ))
theorems.description: **`Ψ(w_S²) = P/(L_S² + 3P)`** at every divided set.

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.PsiS_plane
theorems.statement:
theorem PsiS_plane (S : Finset (Fin 6)) :
    (PsiS S = 1 / (15 + 13 * (signS S : ℂ)) ↔
      (Even S.card ∨ linesIn S = 2 ∨ linesIn S = 3)) ∧
    (Odd S.card → (linesIn S = 0 ∨ linesIn S = 5) → PsiS S = -1 / 22) ∧
    (Odd S.card → (linesIn S = 1 ∨ linesIn S = 4) → PsiS S = -1 / 6)
theorems.description:
**`Ψ(w_S²) = 1/(15 + 13P)` exactly at the even divided sets and at the odd divided sets with two or
three lines** (the two signs of a plane); elsewhere the rule gives `−1/22` (`k = 0, 5`) or `−1/6`
(`k = 1, 4`).

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.norm_wS
theorems.statement: theorem norm_wS (S : Finset (Fin 6)) : ‖wS S‖ = 1 / |(LZ S : ℝ)|

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.eS_add_tS
theorems.statement: theorem eS_add_tS (S : Finset (Fin 6)) : eS S + tS S = 1
theorems.description: The reflection and the transmission add to one.

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.eS_four
theorems.statement:
theorem eS_four (S : Finset (Fin 6)) :
    (eS S = 1 - 2 / (4 + (signS S : ℝ)) ↔
      (signS S = 1 ∨ linesIn S = 1 ∨ linesIn S = 4))
theorems.description:
**`e_S = 1 − 2/(4 + P)` exactly when `P = 1` or the divided set holds one line or four**
(`|L_S| = 4 + P`; at an odd divided set with four lines `L_S = −3`).

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.NS_turns
theorems.statement:
theorem NS_turns (S : Finset (Fin 6)) :
    ((Finset.univ.powersetCard 2).filter fun p : Finset (Fin 6) => (p ∩ S).card = 1).card +
      (if Odd S.card then 1 else 0) = NS S
theorems.description: **`N(S) − [|S| odd]` counts the rotations of the six with one end in `S`.**

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.twin_lines
theorems.statement: theorem twin_lines (S : Finset (Fin 6)) : linesIn (twin S) = linesIn S
theorems.description: **Moving the singlet in or out keeps the lines.**

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.twin_sign
theorems.statement: theorem twin_sign (S : Finset (Fin 6)) : signS (twin S) = -signS S
theorems.description: **… and exchanges count and amplitude.**

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.twin_twin
theorems.statement: theorem twin_twin (S : Finset (Fin 6)) : twin (twin S) = S

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.card_lines_dividedSets
theorems.statement:
theorem card_lines_dividedSets :
    (sHere.card, linesIn sHere) = (0, 0) ∧ (sSinglet.card, linesIn sSinglet) = (1, 0) ∧

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.det_one_add_diagonal_mul

theorems.description:
**The address: the several-vertices member expanded on the words,**
`det(I + diag(j) M) = Σ_S (∏_{x∈S} j_x) det M[S, S]`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.address_coeff
theorems.statement:
theorem address_coeff {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (M : Matrix n n R) (S : Finset n) :
    ((1 + diagonal (fun i => (MvPolynomial.X i : MvPolynomial n R)) *
          M.map MvPolynomial.C).det).coeff (∑ i ∈ S, Finsupp.single i 1) =
      (M.submatrix (Subtype.val : S → n) Subtype.val).det
theorems.description:
**The address as a coefficient:** in `det(I + diag(X) M)` over the polynomials in the sources
`X_x`, the coefficient of the word `∏_{x∈S} X_x` is the principal minor `det M[S, S]`.

theorems.name: Comparison.Law.sourceZ_directSum

theorem sourceZ_directSum {m : Type*} [Fintype m] [DecidableEq m] (s g : ℝ) (X : Matrix n n ℝ)

    sourceZ s g (fromBlocks X 0 0 Y) = sourceZ s g X * sourceZ s g Y
theorems.description: **A composite on the direct sum of its lines' words is the product,** in every member.

theorems.name: Comparison.angle_of_zero

source_context.command: open Matrix Filter Topology Asymptotics Complex

theorems.statement:
theorem angle_of_zero (P X : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (π : ι → ℝ)
    (hW : WeightedWalk (tiltR P X) P (hadPow P X 1) (hadPow P X 2) π) :
    ∃ ψ : ℂ → ℂ, ψ 0 = 1 ∧ (∀ᶠ s in 𝓝 0, charF P X s (ψ s) = 0) ∧
      HasDerivAt ψ ((π ⬝ᵥ (hadPow P X 1 *ᵥ 1) : ℝ) : ℂ) 0 ∧
      HasDerivAt (fun θ : ℝ => Complex.arg (ψ (-I * θ))) (-(π ⬝ᵥ (hadPow P X 1 *ᵥ 1))) 0
theorems.description: **The angle of the long-range zero under a phase on the steps.**

theorems.name: Comparison.real_weight_real_root

source_context.command: open Matrix Filter Topology Asymptotics Complex

theorems.statement:
theorem real_weight_real_root (P X : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (π : ι → ℝ)
    (hW : WeightedWalk (tiltR P X) P (hadPow P X 1) (hadPow P X 2) π) :
    ∀ᶠ s in 𝓝 (0 : ℝ), 0 < perronRoot (tiltR P X) s ∧
      Complex.arg ((1 / (4 * perronRoot (tiltR P X) s) : ℝ) : ℂ) = 0
theorems.description:
**A real weight moves the zero only radially:** for real `s` near `0` the largest eigenvalue of
`P ∘ e^{sX}` is real and positive, so the long-range zero `1/(4ρ(s))` lies on the positive real
axis.

theorems.name: Comparison.uniform_phase_zero

source_context.command: open Matrix Filter Topology Asymptotics Complex

theorems.statement:
theorem uniform_phase_zero (μ : ℝ) (u : ℂ) :
    (1 - (u * Complex.exp (-(μ : ℂ) * I)) • stepOp transitionMat).det =
      (1 - (u * Complex.exp (-(μ : ℂ) * I)) ^ 2) ^ 24 * (1 - u * Complex.exp (-(μ : ℂ) * I)) *
        (1 - 4 * (u * Complex.exp (-(μ : ℂ) * I))) *
        (1 - u * Complex.exp (-(μ : ℂ) * I) + 4 * (u * Complex.exp (-(μ : ℂ) * I)) ^ 2) ^ 10 *
        (1 + 3 * (u * Complex.exp (-(μ : ℂ) * I)) + 4 * (u * Complex.exp (-(μ : ℂ) * I)) ^ 2) ^ 5 ∧
    (1 - (Complex.exp ((μ : ℂ) * I) / 4 * Complex.exp (-(μ : ℂ) * I)) • stepOp transitionMat).det = 0
theorems.description:
**A uniform phase turns the zero by its angle:** with the phase `e^{−iμ}` on every step,
`det(1 − u e^{−iμ} B) = D₊(u e^{−iμ})`, which vanishes at `u = e^{iμ}/4`.

theorems.name: Comparison.availableTransitions_angle_rate

source_context.command: open Matrix Filter Topology Asymptotics Complex

theorem availableTransitions_angle_rate :
    piU ⬝ᵥ (hadPow lawP (availableTransitionsLawX h (transitionX h)) 1 *ᵥ 1) = 1836 / 320
theorems.description:
**The available transitions weight `X = L(Ω) + [along h]` turns the zero at `1836/320` per unit `θ` per step**:
the transitions carry `6M + C_h = 1836` (`transition_inventory`) of the `320` steps of a stationary cycle.

theorems.name: Comparison.proton_availableTransitions_ratio

source_context.command: open Matrix Filter Topology Asymptotics Complex

theorems.statement:
theorem proton_availableTransitions_ratio (a₀ s₀ : State) (h₀ : Continues a₀ s₀) :
    (∃ ψ : ℂ → ℂ, ψ 0 = 1 ∧ (∀ᶠ s in 𝓝 0, charF lawP (availableTransitionsLawX h (transitionX h)) s (ψ s) = 0) ∧
      HasDerivAt (fun θ : ℝ => Complex.arg (ψ (-I * θ))) (-(1836 / 320 : ℝ)) 0) ∧
    (∃ ψ : ℂ → ℂ, ψ 0 = 1 ∧ (∀ᶠ s in 𝓝 0, charF lawP (oneTransitionX a₀ s₀) s (ψ s) = 0) ∧
      HasDerivAt (fun θ : ℝ => Complex.arg (ψ (-I * θ))) (-(1 / 320 : ℝ)) 0) ∧
    (1836 / 320 : ℝ) / (1 / 320) = 1836
theorems.description:
**The available transitions part of the proton's row as a ratio of two angles:** with the phase `e^{−iθX}` on
the transitions of the available transitions of `h`, `X = L(Ω) + [along h]`, the long-range zero of the law turns at the
rate `1836/320` per unit `θ`, with the phase `e^{−iθ}` on one transition at `1/320`; the two zeros exist
and turn as stated (`angle_of_zero`), and **the ratio of the rates is `1836 = 6M + C_h`**.

theorems.name: Comparison.adjugate_rank_one

source_context.command: variable {𝕜 : Type*} [Field 𝕜] {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]

theorems.statement:
theorem adjugate_rank_one (K : Matrix ι ι 𝕜) (r ℓ : ι → 𝕜) (hr : r ≠ 0) (hdet : K.det = 0)
    (hkerR : ∀ v, K *ᵥ v = 0 → ∃ c : 𝕜, v = c • r)
    (hkerL : ∀ w, w ᵥ* K = 0 → ∃ c : 𝕜, w = c • ℓ) :
    ∃ κ : 𝕜, K.adjugate = κ • vecMulVec r ℓ
theorems.description: **The adjugate at a zero with one-dimensional kernels is of rank one:** `adj K = κ r ℓᵀ`.

theorems.name: Comparison.trace_smul_vecMulVec_mul

source_context.command: variable {𝕜 : Type*} [Field 𝕜] {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]

    ((κ • vecMulVec r ℓ) * C).trace = κ * (ℓ ⬝ᵥ (C *ᵥ r))
theorems.description: The trace of a rank-one adjugate: `tr(κ r ℓᵀ C) = κ (ℓ · C r)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.norm_le_of_pos_eigen
theorems.statement:
theorem norm_le_of_pos_eigen (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (hA : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ A i j) (x : ι → ℝ)
    (hx : ∀ i, 0 < x i) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : A *ᵥ x = ρ • x) (μ : ℂ) (y : ι → ℂ) (hy : y ≠ 0)
    (hμ : (A.map (fun a : ℝ => (a : ℂ))) *ᵥ y = μ • y) : ‖μ‖ ≤ ρ
theorems.description:
**A positive eigenvector bounds the spectrum:** if `A ≥ 0` entrywise and `A x = ρ x` with
`x > 0`, then every complex eigenvalue `μ` of `A` has `‖μ‖ ≤ ρ`.

theorems.name: Comparison.left_eigen_defect
theorems.statement:
theorem left_eigen_defect (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (y x : ι → ℝ) (ρ lam : ℝ) (hy : y ᵥ* A = ρ • y) :
    (ρ - lam) * (y ⬝ᵥ x) = y ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ x - lam • x)
theorems.description:
**The defect identity:** if `yᵀA = ρ yᵀ`, then for every trial `(λ, x)`,
`(ρ − λ)(y·x) = y·((A − λ)x)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.harmonic_const
theorems.statement:
theorem harmonic_const {ι : Type*} [Finite ι] [Nonempty ι] (N : ι → Finset ι)
    (hconn : ∀ a b, Relation.ReflTransGen (fun a b => b ∈ N a) a b) (v : ι → ℝ)
    (hv : ∀ i, ((N i).card : ℝ) * v i = ∑ j ∈ N i, v j) : ∀ i j, v i = v j
theorems.description:
**The maximum principle:** if every value is the mean of the values on its neighbours and the
neighbour relation connects every point to every point, the function is constant.

theorems.name: Comparison.perron_expansion

source_context.command: variable {P : ℝ → Matrix ι ι ℝ} {P0 P1 P2 : Matrix ι ι ℝ} {π : ι → ℝ}

theorems.statement:
theorem perron_expansion (hW : WeightedWalk P P0 P1 P2 π) (g : ι → ℝ)
    (hg : (1 - P0) *ᵥ g = P1 *ᵥ 1 - (π ⬝ᵥ (P1 *ᵥ 1)) • 1) (hπg : π ⬝ᵥ g = 0) :
    (fun s => perronRoot P s - (1 + s * (π ⬝ᵥ (P1 *ᵥ 1)) +
      s ^ 2 * (π ⬝ᵥ (P1 *ᵥ g) + (π ⬝ᵥ (P2 *ᵥ 1)) / 2))) =O[𝓝 0] (fun s => s ^ 3)
theorems.description:
**The largest eigenvalue to second order:** `ρ(s) = 1 + sv + s²λ₂ + O(s³)` with `v = π P₁ 𝟏`
and `λ₂ = π P₁ g + π P₂ 𝟏 / 2`, `g` the Poisson solution with `π g = 0`.

theorems.name: Comparison.perron_log

source_context.command: variable {P : ℝ → Matrix ι ι ℝ} {P0 P1 P2 : Matrix ι ι ℝ} {π : ι → ℝ}

theorems.statement:
theorem perron_log (hW : WeightedWalk P P0 P1 P2 π) (g : ι → ℝ)
    (hg : (1 - P0) *ᵥ g = P1 *ᵥ 1 - (π ⬝ᵥ (P1 *ᵥ 1)) • 1) (hπg : π ⬝ᵥ g = 0) :
    HasDerivAt (fun s => Real.log (perronRoot P s)) (π ⬝ᵥ (P1 *ᵥ 1)) 0 ∧
    (fun s => Real.log (perronRoot P s) - (s * (π ⬝ᵥ (P1 *ᵥ 1)) + s ^ 2 / 2 *
      (π ⬝ᵥ (P2 *ᵥ 1) + 2 * (π ⬝ᵥ (P1 *ᵥ g)) - (π ⬝ᵥ (P1 *ᵥ 1)) ^ 2))) =O[𝓝 0]
      (fun s => s ^ 3)
theorems.description:
**Proposition 71, in general.** For the weighted walk, the logarithm of the largest eigenvalue
has the derivative `v = π P₁ 𝟏` at `s = 0` (the stationary mean of the weight per step), and
`log ρ(s) = sv + (s²/2)σ² + O(s³)` with `σ² = π P₂ 𝟏 + 2 π P₁ g − v²` (the asymptotic variance of
the weight in its Poisson form, `g` the solution of the Poisson equation with `π g = 0`).

theorems.name: Comparison.residue_general
theorems.statement:
theorem residue_general {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (K : ℝ → Matrix ι ι ℝ)
    (u₀ d : ℝ) (hK : ContinuousAt K u₀) (h0 : (K u₀).det = 0)
    (hd : HasDerivAt (fun u => (K u).det) d u₀) (hd0 : d ≠ 0) :
    Tendsto (fun u => (u - u₀) • (K u)⁻¹) (𝓝[≠] u₀) (𝓝 (d⁻¹ • (K u₀).adjugate))
theorems.description:
**The residue at a simple zero of a determinant:** if `K` is continuous at `u₀`,
`det K(u₀) = 0` and `det K` has the derivative `d ≠ 0` at `u₀`, then
`(u − u₀) K(u)⁻¹ → adj K(u₀)/d`.

theorems.name: Comparison.residue_law
theorems.statement:
theorem residue_law :
    Tendsto (fun u : ℝ => (u - 1 / 4) • (1 - u • stepR)⁻¹) (𝓝[≠] (1 / 4))
      (𝓝 ((-(1 / 320 : ℝ)) • vecMulVec (1 : State → ℝ) (1 : State → ℝ)))
theorems.description:
**Proposition 57 at the law's zero:** `(u − 1/4)(1 − uB)⁻¹ → −𝟏𝟏ᵀ/320` as `u → 1/4`; with
`r = ℓ = 𝟏` and `K' = −B` this is `r ℓᵀ/(ℓ · K' r)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.residue_law_form
theorems.statement:
theorem residue_law_form :
    (-(1 / 320 : ℝ)) • vecMulVec (1 : State → ℝ) (1 : State → ℝ) =
      ((1 : State → ℝ) ⬝ᵥ ((-stepR) *ᵥ (1 : State → ℝ)))⁻¹ •
        vecMulVec (1 : State → ℝ) (1 : State → ℝ)
theorems.description: The residue in the book's form: `rℓᵀ/(ℓ · K' r)` with `r = ℓ = 𝟏`, `K' = −B`.

theorems.name: Comparison.vR_sum
theorems.statement: theorem vR_sum : ∑ t, vR t = 0

theorems.name: Comparison.line_hasDerivAt

theorems.name: Comparison.step_first_order
theorems.statement:
theorem step_first_order (ψ : (Fin 5 → ℝ) → ℝ) (hψ : ContDiff ℝ 3 ψ) (x : Fin 5 → ℝ) :
    ∑ t, deriv (fun e : ℝ => ψ (x + e • vR t)) 0 = 0
theorems.description: **The first-order terms cancel:** `Σ_t Dψ(x)v_t = 0`.

theorems.name: Comparison.line_contDiff
theorems.statement:
theorem line_contDiff (ψ : (Fin 5 → ℝ) → ℝ) (hψ : ContDiff ℝ 3 ψ) (x v : Fin 5 → ℝ) :
    ContDiff ℝ 3 (fun e : ℝ => ψ (x + e • v))

theorems.name: Comparison.line_taylor
theorems.statement:
theorem line_taylor (g : ℝ → ℝ) (hg : ContDiff ℝ 3 g) :
    (fun ε : ℝ => g ε - (g 0 + ε * deriv g 0 + ε ^ 2 / 2 * iteratedDeriv 2 g 0)) =O[𝓝 0]
      (fun ε : ℝ => ε ^ 3)
theorems.description: Taylor along one line: `g(ε) − (g(0) + εg'(0) + (ε²/2)g''(0)) = O(ε³)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.taylor_step
theorems.statement:
theorem taylor_step (ψ : (Fin 5 → ℝ) → ℝ) (hψ : ContDiff ℝ 3 ψ) (x : Fin 5 → ℝ) :
    (fun ε : ℝ => ∑ t, ψ (x + ε • vR t) - (5 * ψ x + ε ^ 2 / 2 * stepLaplacian ψ x)) =O[𝓝 0]
      (fun ε : ℝ => ε ^ 3)
theorems.description: **The Taylor step of Proposition 59:** `Σ_t ψ(x + εv_t) = 5ψ(x) + (ε²/2)Δψ(x) + O(ε³)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.critical_operator
theorems.statement:
theorem critical_operator (ψ : (Fin 5 → ℝ) → ℝ) (hψ : ContDiff ℝ 3 ψ) (x : Fin 5 → ℝ) (m : ℝ) :
    (fun ε : ℝ => (1 + 4 * (1 / 4 - ε ^ 2 * m ^ 2 / 24) ^ 2) * ψ x -
        (1 / 4 - ε ^ 2 * m ^ 2 / 24) * ∑ t, ψ (x + ε • vR t) -
        ε ^ 2 / 8 * (m ^ 2 * ψ x - stepLaplacian ψ x)) =O[𝓝 0] (fun ε : ℝ => ε ^ 3)
theorems.description:
**The law near its critical step (Proposition 59):** at `u = 1/4 − ε²m²/24`,
`(1 + 4u²)ψ(x) − u Σ_t ψ(x + εv_t) = (ε²/8)(m²ψ(x) − Δψ(x)) + O(ε³)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.residual_bound
theorems.description:
The residual of the polynomial part, in the variables `s = a + b`, `Q₂`, `Q₃`:
`|2Q₃ − s(Q₂ − Q₃)/3 + (Q₂ − Q₃)²/3| ≤ s³/8` when `0 ≤ s ≤ 1/2`, `0 ≤ Q₂ ≤ s²/8`, `|Q₃| ≤ s³/100`.

theorems.name: Comparison.dispersion_poly
theorems.description:
The polynomial part: `|2D₀ + D₀²/3 − (a + b − ab/3)| ≤ (a + b)³/8` for `0 ≤ a, b ≤ 1/4`, with
`D₀ = 1 − (1 − a/2 + a²/24)(1 − b/2 + b²/24)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.inverse_step
theorems.description:
The inverse step: if `0 ≤ W ≤ 1`, `|e₃| ≤ (7/4320)W³` and `D = W/2 − W²/24 − e₃`, then
`W ≤ 4D` and `|W − 2D − D²/3| ≤ (11/10)D³`.

theorems.name: Comparison.cos_mul_bound
theorems.statement:
theorem cos_mul_bound (μ k : ℝ) (hμ : |μ| ≤ 1 / 2) (hk : |k| ≤ 1 / 2) :
    |Real.cos μ * Real.cos k - (1 - μ ^ 2 / 2 + μ ^ 4 / 24) * (1 - k ^ 2 / 2 + k ^ 4 / 24)| ≤
      (μ ^ 2 + k ^ 2) ^ 3 / 200
theorems.description:
The product of the two cosines against its polynomial part:
`|cos μ cos k − A B| ≤ (μ² + k²)³/200`, `A = 1 − μ²/2 + μ⁴/24`, `B = 1 − k²/2 + k⁴/24`.

theorems.name: Comparison.dispersion_series
theorems.statement:
theorem dispersion_series (μ k : ℝ) (hμ : |μ| ≤ 1 / 2) (hk : |k| ≤ 1 / 2) :
    |Real.arccos (Real.cos μ * Real.cos k) ^ 2 - (μ ^ 2 + k ^ 2 - μ ^ 2 * k ^ 2 / 3)| ≤
      3 * (μ ^ 2 + k ^ 2) ^ 3
theorems.description:
**Proposition 60, the dispersion series:** for `|μ|, |k| ≤ 1/2` the eigenphase
`ω = arccos(cos μ cos k)` of one step in motion has `|ω² − (μ² + k² − μ²k²/3)| ≤ 3(μ² + k²)³`.

theorems.name: Comparison.stepT_mulVec_real
