theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.comm_skew
theorems.statement:
theorem comm_skew (M N : Matrix Ten Ten ℝ) (hM : Mᵀ = -M) (hN : Nᵀ = -N) :
    (M * N - N * M)ᵀ = -(M * N - N * M)

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.plane_comm_iff
theorems.statement:
theorem plane_comm_iff (M : Matrix Ten Ten ℝ) (hM : Mᵀ = -M) :
    turnOf fockLine M * planeN = planeN * turnOf fockLine M ↔ M * planeJ = planeJ * M
theorems.description: **A rotation keeps `N_F` exactly when its matrix commutes with the plane's structure.**

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.dF_eq_iff
theorems.statement: theorem dF_eq_iff : ∀ s t : Fin 5, dF s = dF t ↔ ¬crossP (s, t)

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.crossP_symm
theorems.statement: theorem crossP_symm {s t : Fin 5} (h : crossP (s, t)) : crossP (t, s)

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.uFive_plane_iff
theorems.statement:
theorem uFive_plane_iff (R : Matrix (Fin 5) (Fin 5) ℝ) :
    uFive R * planeJ = planeJ * uFive R ↔ ∀ s t, crossP (s, t) → R s t = 0
theorems.description: **The rotations of five complex lines that keep `N_F`: the block-diagonal ones.**

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.zc_cross
theorems.statement:
theorem zc_cross {R : Matrix (Fin 5) (Fin 5) ℝ} (hR : ∀ s t, crossP (s, t) → R s t = 0)
    {s t : Fin 5} (hst : crossP (s, t)) : zc R s t = 0

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.lastDirection_term
theorems.statement:
theorem lastDirection_term (R : Matrix (Fin 5) (Fin 5) ℝ) (hR : ∀ s t, crossP (s, t) → R s t = 0)
    (s t : Fin 5) :
    zc R s t • (εx s * ιx t : FockE) lastDirectionRelVec =
      (if s = t ∧ t ≠ 3 then zc R s t • lastDirectionRelVec else 0) +
        (if s = 3 ∧ t = 4 then zc R 3 4 • movedVec else 0)

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.turn_lastDirection
theorems.statement:
theorem turn_lastDirection (R : Matrix (Fin 5) (Fin 5) ℝ) (hR : ∀ s t, crossP (s, t) → R s t = 0) :
    turnOf fockLine (uFive R) lastDirectionRelVec =
      (zc R 0 0 + zc R 1 1 + zc R 2 2 + zc R 4 4 - (1 / 2 : ℂ) * ∑ t, zc R t t) • lastDirectionRelVec +
        zc R 3 4 • movedVec
theorems.description:
**A block-diagonal rotation on `ℓ_h`:**
`ρ(uFive R) ℓ_h = (Z₀₀ + Z₁₁ + Z₂₂ + Z₄₄ − ½ tr Z) ℓ_h + Z₃₄ f_{0123}`.

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.lastDirectionRelVec_at
theorems.statement:
theorem lastDirectionRelVec_at : lastDirectionRelVec {0, 1, 2, 4} = 1 ∧ movedVec {0, 1, 2, 4} = 0 ∧
    lastDirectionRelVec {0, 1, 2, 3} = 0 ∧ movedVec {0, 1, 2, 3} = 1

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.turn_lastDirection_iff
theorems.statement:
theorem turn_lastDirection_iff (R : Matrix (Fin 5) (Fin 5) ℝ) (htr : R.trace = 0)
    (hR : ∀ s t, crossP (s, t) → R s t = 0) :
    turnOf fockLine (uFive R) lastDirectionRelVec = 0 ↔ R 3 3 = 0 ∧ R 3 4 = 0 ∧ R 4 3 = 0
theorems.description:
**Keeping `ℓ_h`:** for a rotation that keeps `Ω` and `N_F`, `ρ(uFive R) ℓ_h = 0` exactly when
`Z₃₃ = 0` and `Z₃₄ = 0`, i.e. `R₃₃ = R₃₄ = R₄₃ = 0`.

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.mem_ker_kerP
theorems.statement:
theorem mem_ker_kerP (P : Fin 5 × Fin 5 → Prop) [DecidablePred P] (R : Matrix (Fin 5) (Fin 5) ℝ) :
    R ∈ LinearMap.ker (kerP P) ↔ R.trace = 0 ∧ ∀ p, P p → R p.1 p.2 = 0

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.kerP_surjective
theorems.statement:
theorem kerP_surjective (P : Fin 5 × Fin 5 → Prop) [DecidablePred P] (h00 : ¬P (0, 0)) :
    Function.Surjective (kerP P)

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.finrank_ker_kerP
theorems.statement:
theorem finrank_ker_kerP (P : Fin 5 × Fin 5 → Prop) [DecidablePred P] (h00 : ¬P (0, 0)) :
    Module.finrank ℝ (LinearMap.ker (kerP P)) + (1 + Fintype.card {p : Fin 5 × Fin 5 // P p}) =
      25

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.card_singletP
theorems.statement: theorem card_singletP : Fintype.card {p : Fin 5 × Fin 5 // singletP p} = 0

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.card_crossP
theorems.statement: theorem card_crossP : Fintype.card {p : Fin 5 × Fin 5 // crossP p} = 12

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.card_lastDirectionP
theorems.statement: theorem card_lastDirectionP : Fintype.card {p : Fin 5 × Fin 5 // lastDirectionP p} = 15

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.finrank_su5
theorems.statement: theorem finrank_su5 : Module.finrank ℝ (LinearMap.ker (kerP singletP)) = 24

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.finrank_plane5
theorems.statement: theorem finrank_plane5 : Module.finrank ℝ (LinearMap.ker (kerP crossP)) = 12

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.finrank_lastDirection5
theorems.statement: theorem finrank_lastDirection5 : Module.finrank ℝ (LinearMap.ker (kerP lastDirectionP)) = 9

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.fockTurn_injective
theorems.statement: theorem fockTurn_injective : Function.Injective ((turnOf fockLine).comp uFive)

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.mem_keepLF
theorems.statement: theorem mem_keepLF (X : FockE) : X ∈ keepLF ↔ ∃ R, turnOf fockLine (uFive R) = X

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.keepVacF_eq
theorems.statement:
theorem keepVacF_eq :
    keepVacF = (LinearMap.ker (kerP singletP)).map ((turnOf fockLine).comp uFive)

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.keepPlaneF_eq
theorems.statement:
theorem keepPlaneF_eq :
    keepPlaneF = (LinearMap.ker (kerP crossP)).map ((turnOf fockLine).comp uFive)

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.keepLastDirectionF_eq
theorems.statement:
theorem keepLastDirectionF_eq :
    keepLastDirectionF = (LinearMap.ker (kerP lastDirectionP)).map ((turnOf fockLine).comp uFive)

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.turns_chain
theorems.statement:
theorem turns_chain :
    Module.finrank ℝ (turnsTen fockLine) = 45 ∧ Module.finrank ℝ keepLF = 25 ∧
      Module.finrank ℝ keepVacF = 24 ∧ Module.finrank ℝ keepPlaneF = 12 ∧
        Module.finrank ℝ keepLastDirectionF = 9
theorems.description:
**Proposition 46, the chain of what the rotations keep, on the spinors of the ten lines:**
`so(10)` 45, keeping `L` 25 (`u(5)`), keeping also `Ω` 24 (`su(5)`), keeping also `N_F` 12
(`s(u(3) ⊕ u(2))`), keeping also `ℓ_h` 9 (`su(3) ⊕ u(1)`).

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.ordProd_empty
theorems.statement: theorem ordProd_empty [Monoid A] (E : Fin n → A) : ordProd E ∅ = 1

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.ordProd_singleton
theorems.statement: theorem ordProd_singleton [Monoid A] (E : Fin n → A) (a : Fin n) : ordProd E {a} = E a

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.ordProd_insert_min
theorems.statement:
theorem ordProd_insert_min [Monoid A] (E : Fin n → A) {a : Fin n} {S : Finset (Fin n)}
    (h : ∀ x ∈ S, a < x) : ordProd E (insert a S) = E a * ordProd E S
theorems.description: Putting a direction below all the others in front.

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.ordProd_congr
theorems.statement:
theorem ordProd_congr [Monoid A] {E E' : Fin n → A} {S : Finset (Fin n)}
    (h : ∀ x ∈ S, E x = E' x) : ordProd E S = ordProd E' S

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.ordProd_intertwine
theorems.statement:
theorem ordProd_intertwine [Monoid A] (E E' : Fin n → A) (X : A) (h : ∀ a, X * E a = E' a * X)
    (S : Finset (Fin n)) : X * ordProd E S = ordProd E' S * X
theorems.description: An element that intertwines each factor intertwines the ordered product.

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.ordProd_mul_left
theorems.statement:
theorem ordProd_mul_left [Ring A] (E z : Fin n → A)
    (hanti : ∀ a b, a ≠ b → E a * E b = -(E b * E a))
    (hsq : ∀ a, E a * E a = z a) (hz : ∀ a b, Commute (z a) (E b))
    (S : Finset (Fin n)) : ∀ a : Fin n, E a * ordProd E S =
      (-1) ^ (S.filter (· < a)).card *
        (if a ∈ S then z a * ordProd E (S.erase a) else ordProd E (insert a S))
theorems.description:
**One factor more in an ordered product.** If the `E_a` anticommute in pairs and each
`E_a² = z_a` is central, then `E_a E_S = (−1)^{#{c ∈ S : c < a}} (z_a E_{S∖{a}})` when `a ∈ S`
and `(−1)^{#{c ∈ S : c < a}} E_{S ∪ {a}}` when `a ∉ S`.

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.neg_one_pow_end_apply
theorems.statement:
theorem neg_one_pow_end_apply {M : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] (k : ℕ) (v : M) :
    ((-1 : Module.End R M) ^ k) v = ((-1 : R) ^ k) • v
theorems.description: `(−1)^k` acts on every vector as the number `(−1)^k`.

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.endo_ext
theorems.statement:
theorem endo_ext {f g : Module.End R (Finset (Fin n) → R)}
    (h : ∀ S, f (Pi.single S 1) = g (Pi.single S 1)) : f = g
theorems.description: Two operators on the sixty-four sets agree when they agree on every `f_S`.

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.extSign_eq
theorems.statement:
theorem extSign_eq (a : Fin n) (S : Finset (Fin n)) :
    extSign (R := R) a S = (-1) ^ (S.filter (· < a)).card

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.extSign_of_min
theorems.statement:
theorem extSign_of_min {a : Fin n} {S : Finset (Fin n)} (h : ∀ x ∈ S, a < x) :
    extSign (R := R) a S = 1

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.εx_single
theorems.description:
**One direction more on a basis set:** `ε_a f_S = 0` for `a ∈ S`, and
`ε_a f_S = (−1)^{#{c ∈ S : c < a}} f_{S ∪ {a}}` for `a ∉ S`.

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.ιx_vac
theorems.statement: theorem ιx_vac (a : Fin n) : ιx (R := R) a (Pi.single ∅ 1) = 0
theorems.description: `ι_a f_∅ = 0`: nothing to remove from the set that divides nothing.

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.ordProd_εx_vac
theorems.statement:
theorem ordProd_εx_vac (S : Finset (Fin n)) :
    ordProd (εx (R := R)) S (Pi.single ∅ 1) = Pi.single S 1
theorems.description: The ordered `ε`-word of `S` on `f_∅` is `f_S`.

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.ordProd_Jx_vac
theorems.statement:
theorem ordProd_Jx_vac (S : Finset (Fin n)) :
    ordProd (Jx (R := R)) S (Pi.single ∅ 1) = Pi.single S 1
theorems.description:
**Proposition 33, the words:** `J_{s₁} J_{s₂} ⋯ J_{s_r} f_∅ = f_{{s₁,…,s_r}}` for
`s₁ < ⋯ < s_r`: the sixty-four sets are the words of the vertical step on the set that divides
nothing.

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.εv_single
theorems.statement: theorem εv_single (a : Fin n) : εv (R := R) (Pi.single a 1) = εx a

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.ιv_single
theorems.statement: theorem ιv_single (a : Fin n) : ιv (R := R) (Pi.single a 1) = ιx a

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.εv_add
theorems.statement: theorem εv_add (v w : Fin n → R) : εv (v + w) = εv v + εv w

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.εv_smul
theorems.statement: theorem εv_smul (c : R) (v : Fin n → R) : εv (c • v) = c • εv v

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.ιv_add
theorems.statement: theorem ιv_add (v w : Fin n → R) : ιv (v + w) = ιv v + ιv w

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.ιv_smul
theorems.statement: theorem ιv_smul (c : R) (v : Fin n → R) : ιv (c • v) = c • ιv v

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.εv_sum
theorems.statement:
theorem εv_sum {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (v : ι → Fin n → R) :
    εv (∑ i ∈ s, v i) = ∑ i ∈ s, εv (v i)

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.ιv_sum
theorems.statement:
theorem ιv_sum {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (v : ι → Fin n → R) :
    ιv (∑ i ∈ s, v i) = ∑ i ∈ s, ιv (v i)

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.vec_eq_sum
theorems.statement: theorem vec_eq_sum (v : Fin n → R) : v = ∑ a, v a • (Pi.single a 1 : Fin n → R)
theorems.description: A vector is the sum of its components along the directions.

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.εv_eq_sum
theorems.statement: theorem εv_eq_sum (v : Fin n → R) : εv v = ∑ a, v a • εv (Pi.single a 1)

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.sum_sym_antisym
theorems.statement:
theorem sum_sym_antisym {M : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] (c : Fin n → Fin n → R)
    (X : Fin n → Fin n → M) (hc : ∀ a b, c a b = c b a) (hX : ∀ a b, X a b + X b a = 0)
    (hX0 : ∀ a, X a a = 0) : ∑ a, ∑ b, c a b • X a b = 0
theorems.description:
A double sum `Σ_{a,b} c_ab M_ab` vanishes when `c` is symmetric, `M` antisymmetric and
`M_aa = 0`.

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.εv_mul_εv
theorems.statement:
theorem εv_mul_εv (v w : Fin n → R) :
    εv v * εv w = ∑ a, ∑ b, (v a * w b) • (εx (R := R) a * εx b)

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.εv_mul_self
theorems.statement: theorem εv_mul_self (v : Fin n → R) : εv v * εv v = 0

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.εv_anticomm
theorems.statement: theorem εv_anticomm (v w : Fin n → R) : εv v * εv w + εv w * εv v = 0

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.ιv_εv_add
theorems.statement:
theorem ιv_εv_add (v w : Fin n → R) :
    ιv v * εv w + εv w * ιv v = (v ⬝ᵥ w) • (1 : Module.End R (Finset (Fin n) → R))

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.ιv_anticomm
theorems.statement: theorem ιv_anticomm (v w : Fin n → R) : ιv v * ιv w + ιv w * ιv v = 0

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.Jv_anticomm
theorems.statement:
theorem Jv_anticomm (v w : Fin n → R) :
    Jv v * Jv w + Jv w * Jv v = (2 * (v ⬝ᵥ w)) • (1 : Module.End R (Finset (Fin n) → R))

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.Jv_mul_self
theorems.statement:
theorem Jv_mul_self (v : Fin n → R) :
    Jv v * Jv v = (v ⬝ᵥ v) • (1 : Module.End R (Finset (Fin n) → R))

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.extMap_single
theorems.statement:
theorem extMap_single (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) R) (S : Finset (Fin n)) :
    extMap O (Pi.single S 1) = ordProd (colStep O) S (Pi.single ∅ 1)

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.extMap_vac
theorems.statement:
theorem extMap_vac (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) R) :
    extMap O (Pi.single ∅ 1) = Pi.single ∅ 1

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.colStep_anti
theorems.statement:
theorem colStep_anti (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) R) (a b : Fin n) :
    colStep O a * colStep O b = -(colStep O b * colStep O a)

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.colStep_sq
theorems.statement:
theorem colStep_sq (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) R) (a : Fin n) :
    colStep O a * colStep O a = 0

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.colStep_mul_ordProd
theorems.statement:
theorem colStep_mul_ordProd (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) R) (S : Finset (Fin n)) (a : Fin n) :
    colStep O a * ordProd (colStep O) S =
      (-1) ^ (S.filter (· < a)).card * (if a ∈ S then 0 else ordProd (colStep O) (insert a S))
theorems.description: The ordered `ε(Oe)`-word of `S`, with one factor more.

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.extMap_εx
theorems.statement:
theorem extMap_εx (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) R) (a : Fin n) :
    extMap O * εx a = colStep O a * extMap O
theorems.description: **`Λ(O) ε_a = ε(Oe_a) Λ(O)`** for every matrix `O`: one direction more is carried by `O`.

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.mulVec_eq_sum_col
theorems.statement:
theorem mulVec_eq_sum_col (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) R) (v : Fin n → R) :
    O *ᵥ v = ∑ a, v a • O.col a
theorems.description: `O v` is the sum of the columns of `O` weighted by `v`.

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.extMap_εv
theorems.statement:
theorem extMap_εv (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) R) (v : Fin n → R) :
    extMap O * εv v = εv (O *ᵥ v) * extMap O
theorems.description: `Λ(O) ε(v) = ε(Ov) Λ(O)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.col_mul
theorems.statement:
theorem col_mul (O P : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) R) (a : Fin n) :
    (O * P).col a = O *ᵥ P.col a

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.extMap_colStep
theorems.statement:
theorem extMap_colStep (O P : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) R) (a : Fin n) :
    extMap O * colStep P a = colStep (O * P) a * extMap O

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.extMap_mul
theorems.statement: theorem extMap_mul (O P : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) R) : extMap (O * P) = extMap O * extMap P

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.col_one
theorems.statement: theorem col_one (a : Fin n) : (1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) R).col a = Pi.single a 1

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.extMap_one
theorems.statement: theorem extMap_one : extMap (1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) R) = 1

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.ιv_vac
theorems.statement: theorem ιv_vac (v : Fin n → R) : ιv v (Pi.single ∅ 1) = 0
theorems.description: `ι(v)` kills the set that divides nothing.

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.extMap_ιx
theorems.statement:
theorem extMap_ιx (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) R) (hO : Oᵀ * O = 1) (a : Fin n) :
    extMap O * ιx a = ιv (O.col a) * extMap O
theorems.description: **`Λ(O) ι_a = ι(Oe_a) Λ(O)`** for every orthogonal `O`: one direction fewer is carried too.

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.extMap_ιv
theorems.statement:
theorem extMap_ιv (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) R) (hO : Oᵀ * O = 1) (v : Fin n → R) :
    extMap O * ιv v = ιv (O *ᵥ v) * extMap O
theorems.description: `Λ(O) ι(v) = ι(Ov) Λ(O)` for orthogonal `O`.

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.extMap_Jv
theorems.statement:
theorem extMap_Jv (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) R) (hO : Oᵀ * O = 1) (v : Fin n → R) :
    extMap O * Jv v = Jv (O *ᵥ v) * extMap O
theorems.description: `Λ(O) J(v) = J(Ov) Λ(O)` for orthogonal `O`.

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.extMap_mul_transpose
theorems.statement:
theorem extMap_mul_transpose (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) R) (hO : Oᵀ * O = 1) :
    extMap O * extMap Oᵀ = 1 ∧ extMap Oᵀ * extMap O = 1
theorems.description: **`Λ(O)⁻¹ = Λ(Oᵀ)`** for orthogonal `O`.

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.extMap_conj_Jv
theorems.statement:
theorem extMap_conj_Jv (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) R) (hO : Oᵀ * O = 1) (v : Fin n → R) :
    extMap O * Jv v * extMap Oᵀ = Jv (O *ᵥ v)
theorems.description:
**Proposition 33, the covariance:** `Λ(O) J(v) Λ(O)⁻¹ = J(Ov)` for every orthogonal `O`, with
`Λ(O)⁻¹ = Λ(Oᵀ)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.extMap_conj_εv
theorems.statement:
theorem extMap_conj_εv (O O' : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) R) (hO : O * O' = 1) (v : Fin n → R) :
    extMap O * εv v * extMap O' = εv (O *ᵥ v)
theorems.description: The same for `ε` alone, for every invertible `O`: `Λ(O) ε(v) Λ(O)⁻¹ = ε(Ov)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.orthogonal_transpose_mul
theorems.statement:
theorem orthogonal_transpose_mul {O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ}
    (hO : O ∈ Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ) : Oᵀ * O = 1

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.extUnits_val
theorems.statement:
theorem extUnits_val (O : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ) :
    ((extUnits O : (Module.End ℝ (Finset (Fin n) → ℝ))ˣ) : Module.End ℝ (Finset (Fin n) → ℝ)) =
      extMap (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ)

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.extUnits_conj_Jv
theorems.statement:
theorem extUnits_conj_Jv (O : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ) (v : Fin n → ℝ) :
    (extUnits O : Module.End ℝ (Finset (Fin n) → ℝ)) * Jv v *
        ((extUnits O)⁻¹ : (Module.End ℝ (Finset (Fin n) → ℝ))ˣ) =
      Jv ((O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) *ᵥ v)
theorems.description: **Proposition 33:** `Λ(O) J(v) Λ(O)⁻¹ = J(Ov)` for every rotation `O`.

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.Q6_apply
theorems.statement: theorem Q6_apply (v : Fin 6 → ℝ) : Q6 v = ∑ a, v a * v a

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.Q6_e6
theorems.statement: theorem Q6_e6 (a : Fin 6) : Q6 (e6 a) = 1

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.polar_e6
theorems.statement: theorem polar_e6 {a b : Fin 6} (hab : a ≠ b) : QuadraticMap.polar Q6 (e6 a) (e6 b) = 0

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.cl_sq
theorems.statement: theorem cl_sq (a : Fin 6) : cl a * cl a = 1

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.cl_anti
theorems.statement: theorem cl_anti {a b : Fin 6} (hab : a ≠ b) : cl a * cl b = -(cl b * cl a)

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.ι_eq_sum_cl
theorems.statement: theorem ι_eq_sum_cl (m : Fin 6 → ℝ) : CliffordAlgebra.ι Q6 m = ∑ a, m a • cl a

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.cl_mul_clWord
theorems.statement:
theorem cl_mul_clWord (a : Fin 6) (S : Finset (Fin 6)) :
    cl a * clWord S = (-1) ^ (S.filter (· < a)).card *
      (if a ∈ S then clWord (S.erase a) else clWord (insert a S))

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.neg_one_pow_mul_eq_smul
theorems.statement:
theorem neg_one_pow_mul_eq_smul {A : Type*} [Ring A] [Algebra ℝ A] (k : ℕ) (x : A) :
    (-1 : A) ^ k * x = ((-1 : ℝ) ^ k) • x

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.clWord_mem_evenOdd
theorems.statement:
theorem clWord_mem_evenOdd (S : Finset (Fin 6)) :
    clWord S ∈ CliffordAlgebra.evenOdd Q6 (S.card : ZMod 2)
theorems.description: The word of `S` lies in the part of parity `|S|`.

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.card_evenSets
theorems.statement: theorem card_evenSets : Fintype.card EvenSets = 32

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.clWord_mem_even
theorems.statement: theorem clWord_mem_even (S : EvenSets) : clWord S.1 ∈ CliffordAlgebra.even Q6

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.cl_mul_mem_odd
theorems.statement:
theorem cl_mul_mem_odd (a : Fin 6) {x : CliffordAlgebra Q6} (hx : x ∈ Peven) :
    cl a * x ∈ Podd

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.cl_mul_mem_even
theorems.statement:
theorem cl_mul_mem_even (a : Fin 6) {x : CliffordAlgebra Q6} (hx : x ∈ Podd) :
    cl a * x ∈ Peven

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.ι_mul_mem_odd
theorems.statement:
theorem ι_mul_mem_odd (m : Fin 6 → ℝ) {x : CliffordAlgebra Q6} (hx : x ∈ Peven) :

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.ι_mul_mem_even
theorems.statement:
theorem ι_mul_mem_even (m : Fin 6 → ℝ) {x : CliffordAlgebra Q6} (hx : x ∈ Podd) :
    CliffordAlgebra.ι Q6 m * x ∈ Peven

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.even_le_span
theorems.statement: theorem even_le_span (x : CliffordAlgebra Q6) (hx : x ∈ CliffordAlgebra.even Q6) : x ∈ Peven
theorems.description: **The even part is spanned by the 32 ordered even words.**

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.lineSum_sq
theorems.statement:
theorem lineSum_sq (v : Fin 6 → ℝ) :
    lineSum v * lineSum v = ((∑ t : Fin 5, v t.succ * v t.succ : ℝ) : ℂ) • 1

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.Q6_split
theorems.statement: theorem Q6_split (v : Fin 6 → ℝ) : Q6 v = v 0 * v 0 + ∑ t : Fin 5, v t.succ * v t.succ

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.rho_sigma
theorems.statement: theorem rho_sigma (v : Fin 6 → ℝ) : rhoL v * sigmaL v = ((Q6 v : ℝ) : ℂ) • 1

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.sigma_rho
theorems.statement: theorem sigma_rho (v : Fin 6 → ℝ) : sigmaL v * rhoL v = ((Q6 v : ℝ) : ℂ) • 1

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.lineSum_add
theorems.statement: theorem lineSum_add (u w : Fin 6 → ℝ) : lineSum (u + w) = lineSum u + lineSum w

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.lineSum_smul
theorems.statement: theorem lineSum_smul (c : ℝ) (u : Fin 6 → ℝ) : lineSum (c • u) = c • lineSum u

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.rhoL_add
theorems.statement: theorem rhoL_add (u w : Fin 6 → ℝ) : rhoL (u + w) = rhoL u + rhoL w

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.sigmaL_add
theorems.statement: theorem sigmaL_add (u w : Fin 6 → ℝ) : sigmaL (u + w) = sigmaL u + sigmaL w

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.rhoL_smul
theorems.statement: theorem rhoL_smul (c : ℝ) (u : Fin 6 → ℝ) : rhoL (c • u) = c • rhoL u

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.sigmaL_smul
theorems.statement: theorem sigmaL_smul (c : ℝ) (u : Fin 6 → ℝ) : sigmaL (c • u) = c • sigmaL u

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.evenBilin_apply
theorems.statement: theorem evenBilin_apply (u v : Fin 6 → ℝ) : evenBilin u v = rhoL u * sigmaL v

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.real_smul_one
theorems.statement: theorem real_smul_one (r : ℝ) : (r • (1 : Matrix Four Four ℂ)) = ((r : ℂ)) • 1

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.evenToFour_ι
theorems.statement:
theorem evenToFour_ι (u v : Fin 6 → ℝ) :
    evenToFour ((CliffordAlgebra.even.ι Q6).bilin u v) = rhoL u * sigmaL v

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.lineSum_singlet
theorems.statement: theorem lineSum_singlet : lineSum (e6 0) = 0

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.lineSum_line
theorems.statement: theorem lineSum_line (s : Fin 5) : lineSum (e6 s.succ) = γ s

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.e6_self
theorems.statement: theorem e6_self (a : Fin 6) : e6 a a = 1

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.e6_line_singlet
theorems.statement: theorem e6_line_singlet (s : Fin 5) : e6 s.succ 0 = 0

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.rhoL_singlet
theorems.statement: theorem rhoL_singlet : rhoL (e6 0) = 1

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.sigmaL_singlet
theorems.statement: theorem sigmaL_singlet : sigmaL (e6 0) = 1

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.rhoL_line
theorems.statement: theorem rhoL_line (s : Fin 5) : rhoL (e6 s.succ) = I • γ s

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.sigmaL_line
theorems.statement: theorem sigmaL_line (s : Fin 5) : sigmaL (e6 s.succ) = -(I • γ s)

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.singletLine_val
theorems.statement: theorem singletLine_val (t : Fin 5) : (singletLine t : CliffordAlgebra Q6) = cl 0 * cl t.succ

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.lineLine_val
theorems.statement: theorem lineLine_val (s t : Fin 5) : (lineLine s t : CliffordAlgebra Q6) = cl s.succ * cl t.succ

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.evenToFour_singlet_line
theorems.statement: theorem evenToFour_singlet_line (t : Fin 5) : evenToFour (singletLine t) = (-I) • γ t

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.evenToFour_line_line
theorems.statement: theorem evenToFour_line_line (s t : Fin 5) : evenToFour (lineLine s t) = γ s * γ t
theorems.description: **`J_s J_t ↦ γ_s γ_t`.**

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.line_eq_i_singlet_line
theorems.statement: theorem line_eq_i_singlet_line (t : Fin 5) : γ t = I • evenToFour (singletLine t)
theorems.description: **A step of one system along a line is two vertical steps:** `γ_t = i · (J_n J_t ↦ ·)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.evenToFour_five
theorems.statement:
theorem evenToFour_five :
    evenToFour (singletLine 0 * singletLine 1 * singletLine 2 * singletLine 3 * singletLine 4) =
      (-I) • (1 : Matrix Four Four ℂ)
theorems.description: `i` is the image of the even word `(J_nJ_0)(J_nJ_1)(J_nJ_2)(J_nJ_3)(J_nJ_4)`, less its sign.

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.mem_range_I_smul
theorems.statement:
theorem mem_range_I_smul {X : Matrix Four Four ℂ} (hX : X ∈ evenToFour.range) :
    I • X ∈ evenToFour.range

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.γ_mem_range
theorems.statement: theorem γ_mem_range (t : Fin 5) : γ t ∈ evenToFour.range

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.γγ_mem_range
theorems.statement: theorem γγ_mem_range (s t : Fin 5) : γ s * γ t ∈ evenToFour.range

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.obs_mem_range
theorems.statement: theorem obs_mem_range (k : Fin 16) : obs k ∈ evenToFour.range

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.complex_smul_eq
theorems.statement:
theorem complex_smul_eq (z : ℂ) (X : Matrix Four Four ℂ) :
    z • X = z.re • X + z.im • (I • X)
theorems.description: A complex multiple is a real combination of the matrix and `i` times it.

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.evenToFour_surjective
theorems.statement: theorem evenToFour_surjective : Function.Surjective evenToFour
theorems.description: **Every operator of the four amplitudes is the image of an even word.**

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.finrank_four
theorems.statement: theorem finrank_four : Module.finrank ℝ (Matrix Four Four ℂ) = 32

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.even_eq_sum
theorems.statement:
theorem even_eq_sum (x : CliffordAlgebra.even Q6) :
    ∃ c : EvenSets → ℝ, x = ∑ S, c S • (⟨clWord S.1, clWord_mem_even S⟩ : CliffordAlgebra.even Q6)

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.evenImage_linearIndependent
theorems.statement: theorem evenImage_linearIndependent : LinearIndependent ℝ evenImage
theorems.description: **The 32 even words go to 32 independent operators.**

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.evenToFour_injective
theorems.statement: theorem evenToFour_injective : Function.Injective evenToFour
theorems.description: **The map from the even words is one to one.**

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.evenToFour_bijective
theorems.statement: theorem evenToFour_bijective : Function.Bijective evenToFour

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.evenEquivFour_apply
theorems.statement: theorem evenEquivFour_apply (x : CliffordAlgebra.even Q6) : evenEquivFour x = evenToFour x

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.stepRep_cl
theorems.statement: theorem stepRep_cl (a : Fin 6) : stepRep (cl a) = Jx a

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.stepRep_clWord
theorems.statement: theorem stepRep_clWord (S : Finset (Fin 6)) : stepRep (clWord S) = ordProd Jx S

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.cl_mul_mem_all
theorems.statement: theorem cl_mul_mem_all (a : Fin 6) {x : CliffordAlgebra Q6} (hx : x ∈ Pall) : cl a * x ∈ Pall

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.all_le_span
theorems.statement: theorem all_le_span (x : CliffordAlgebra Q6) : x ∈ Pall
theorems.description: The Clifford algebra of the six is spanned by its 64 ordered words.

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.stepRep_injective
theorems.statement: theorem stepRep_injective : Function.Injective stepRep
theorems.description: **The vertical steps represent the Clifford algebra of the six faithfully.**

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.extSign_mul_self
theorems.statement:
theorem extSign_mul_self (a : Fin n) (S : Finset (Fin n)) :
    extSign (R := R) a S * extSign a S = 1

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.extSign_insert
theorems.statement:
theorem extSign_insert {a b : Fin n} {S : Finset (Fin n)} (hb : b ∉ S) :
    extSign (R := R) a (insert b S) = (if b < a then -1 else 1) * extSign a S

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.sign_pair
theorems.statement:
theorem sign_pair {a b : Fin n} (hab : a ≠ b) :
    ((if a < b then -1 else 1) * (if b < a then -1 else 1) : R) = -1
theorems.description: Exactly one of `a < b`, `b < a` holds for `a ≠ b`.

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.sign_pair_add
theorems.statement:
theorem sign_pair_add {a b : Fin n} (hab : a ≠ b) :
    ((if a < b then -1 else 1) + (if b < a then -1 else 1) : R) = 0

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.εx_apply
theorems.statement:
theorem εx_apply (a : Fin n) (v : Finset (Fin n) → R) (T : Finset (Fin n)) :
    εx a v T = if a ∈ T then extSign a (T.erase a) * v (T.erase a) else 0

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.ιx_apply
theorems.statement:
theorem ιx_apply (a : Fin n) (v : Finset (Fin n) → R) (T : Finset (Fin n)) :
    ιx a v T = if a ∈ T then 0 else extSign a T * v (insert a T)

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.ιx_adjoint
theorems.statement:
theorem ιx_adjoint (a : Fin n) (v w : Finset (Fin n) → R) :
    ∑ T, w T * εx a v T = ∑ S, ιx a w S * v S
theorems.description: `ι_a` is the transpose of `ε_a`: `Σ_T w(T) (ε_a v)(T) = Σ_S (ι_a w)(S) v(S)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.εx_mul_self
theorems.statement: theorem εx_mul_self (a : Fin n) : εx (R := R) a * εx a = 0

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.ιx_mul_self
theorems.statement: theorem ιx_mul_self (a : Fin n) : ιx (R := R) a * ιx a = 0

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.εx_ιx_self
theorems.statement: theorem εx_ιx_self (a : Fin n) : εx (R := R) a * ιx a + ιx a * εx a = 1
theorems.description: `ε_a ι_a + ι_a ε_a = 1`.

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.εx_ιx_ne
theorems.statement: theorem εx_ιx_ne {a b : Fin n} (hab : a ≠ b) : εx (R := R) a * ιx b + ιx b * εx a = 0
theorems.description: `ε_a ι_b + ι_b ε_a = 0` for `a ≠ b`.

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.εx_ιx_add
theorems.statement:
theorem εx_ιx_add (a b : Fin n) :
    εx (R := R) a * ιx b + ιx b * εx a = if a = b then 1 else 0
theorems.description: **The anticommutation of one more and one fewer:** `ε_a ι_b + ι_b ε_a = δ_ab`.

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.εx_εx_add
theorems.statement: theorem εx_εx_add (a b : Fin n) : εx (R := R) a * εx b + εx b * εx a = 0
theorems.description: `ε_a ε_b + ε_b ε_a = 0`.

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.ιx_ιx_add
theorems.statement: theorem ιx_ιx_add (a b : Fin n) : ιx (R := R) a * ιx b + ιx b * ιx a = 0
theorems.description: `ι_a ι_b + ι_b ι_a = 0`.

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.ιx_εx_ne
theorems.statement:
theorem ιx_εx_ne {a b : Fin n} (hab : a ≠ b) :
    ιx (R := R) b * εx a = -(εx a * ιx b)

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.εx_εx_ne
theorems.statement: theorem εx_εx_ne (a b : Fin n) : εx (R := R) b * εx a = -(εx a * εx b)

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.ιx_ιx_ne
theorems.statement: theorem ιx_ιx_ne (a b : Fin n) : ιx (R := R) b * ιx a = -(ιx a * ιx b)

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.Jx_mul_self
theorems.statement: theorem Jx_mul_self (a : Fin n) : Jx (R := R) a * Jx a = 1

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.Jx_anticomm
theorems.statement:
theorem Jx_anticomm {a b : Fin n} (hab : a ≠ b) :
    Jx (R := R) a * Jx b = -(Jx b * Jx a)
theorems.description: **Two vertical steps along perpendicular directions anticommute.**

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.Jx_anticomm_add
theorems.statement:
theorem Jx_anticomm_add (a b : Fin n) :
    Jx (R := R) a * Jx b + Jx b * Jx a = if a = b then 2 else 0
theorems.description: `J_a J_b + J_b J_a = 2 δ_ab`.

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.shortest_loop
theorems.statement:
theorem shortest_loop {a b : Fin n} (hab : a ≠ b) :
    Jx (R := R) a * Jx b * Jx a * Jx b = -1
theorems.description: **The shortest vertical loop returns `−1`:** `J_a J_b J_a J_b = −1` for `a ≠ b`.

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.Jx_mul_Jx
theorems.statement:
theorem Jx_mul_Jx {a b : Fin n} (hab : a ≠ b) :
    Jx (R := R) a * Jx b = Tx a b + εx a * εx b + ιx a * ιx b
theorems.description: **The two directions joined:** `J_a J_b = T_ab + ε_a ε_b + ι_a ι_b` for `a ≠ b`.

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.Jx_mul_Jx_diag
theorems.statement:
theorem Jx_mul_Jx_diag (a : Fin n) :
    Jx (R := R) a * Jx a = 1 ∧ Tx (R := R) a a + εx a * εx a + ιx a * ιx a = 0
theorems.description: At `a = b` the left side is `1` and the right side is `0`: the hypothesis `a ≠ b` is needed.

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.Jx_mul_Jx'
theorems.statement:
theorem Jx_mul_Jx' (a b : Fin n) :
    Jx (R := R) a * Jx b = Tx' a b + εx a * εx b + ιx a * ιx b
theorems.description: `J_a J_b = T'_ab + ε_a ε_b + ι_a ι_b` for all `a, b`.

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.Tx'_eq
theorems.statement: theorem Tx'_eq (a b : Fin n) : Tx' (R := R) a b = if a = b then 1 else Tx a b
theorems.description: `T'_ab = T_ab` for `a ≠ b` and `T'_aa = 1`.

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.Nx_apply
theorems.statement: theorem Nx_apply (v : Finset (Fin n) → R) (T : Finset (Fin n)) : Nx v T = (T.card : R) * v T

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.εx_ιx_apply
theorems.statement:
theorem εx_ιx_apply (a : Fin n) (v : Finset (Fin n) → R) (T : Finset (Fin n)) :
    ((εx a * ιx a : Module.End R (Finset (Fin n) → R)) v) T = if a ∈ T then v T else 0

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.Nx_eq_sum
theorems.statement: theorem Nx_eq_sum : (Nx : Module.End R (Finset (Fin n) → R)) = ∑ a, εx a * ιx a
theorems.description: `N = Σ_a ε_a ι_a`.

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.Nx_εx
theorems.statement: theorem Nx_εx (a : Fin n) : Nx * εx (R := R) a = εx a * (Nx + 1)
theorems.description: **One direction more raises the number by one:** `N ε_a = ε_a (N + 1)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.Nx_ιx
theorems.statement: theorem Nx_ιx (a : Fin n) : Nx * ιx (R := R) a = ιx a * (Nx - 1)
theorems.description: **One direction fewer lowers the number by one:** `N ι_a = ι_a (N − 1)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.Nx_Tx
theorems.statement: theorem Nx_Tx (a b : Fin n) : Nx * Tx (R := R) a b = Tx a b * Nx
theorems.description: **The parallel rotation keeps the number of directions.**

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.εx_ιx_comm_ne
theorems.statement:
theorem εx_ιx_comm_ne {a b : Fin n} (hab : a ≠ b) :
    εx (R := R) a * ιx b = -(ιx b * εx a)

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.Tx_εx
theorems.statement:
theorem Tx_εx (a b c : Fin n) :
    Tx (R := R) a b * εx c - εx c * Tx a b =
      (if b = c then εx a else 0) - (if a = c then εx b else 0)
theorems.description: **`[T_ab, ε_c] = δ_bc ε_a − δ_ac ε_b`.**

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.Tx_ιx
theorems.statement:
theorem Tx_ιx (a b c : Fin n) :
    Tx (R := R) a b * ιx c - ιx c * Tx a b =
      (if b = c then ιx a else 0) - (if a = c then ιx b else 0)
theorems.description: **`[T_ab, ι_c] = δ_bc ι_a − δ_ac ι_b`.**

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.Tx_Jx
theorems.statement:
theorem Tx_Jx (a b c : Fin n) :
    Tx (R := R) a b * Jx c - Jx c * Tx a b =
      (if b = c then Jx a else 0) - (if a = c then Jx b else 0)
theorems.description: **The parallel rotation turns the vertical step:** `[T_ab, J_c] = δ_bc J_a − δ_ac J_b`.

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.mul_prod_anticomm
theorems.statement:
theorem mul_prod_anticomm {A : Type*} [Ring A] (x : A) (l : List A)
    (h : ∀ y ∈ l, x * y = -(y * x)) : x * l.prod = (-1) ^ l.length * (l.prod * x)
theorems.description: An element that anticommutes with every factor of a product passes it with a sign.

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.prod_sq_anticomm
theorems.statement:
theorem prod_sq_anticomm {A : Type*} [Ring A] (l : List A) (hsq : ∀ y ∈ l, y * y = 1)
    (hpair : l.Pairwise fun y z => y * z = -(z * y)) :
    l.prod * l.prod = (-1) ^ (l.length.choose 2)
theorems.description: **The square of a product of anticommuting involutions** is `(−1)^{C(m,2)}`.

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.finrank_ext_six
theorems.statement:
theorem finrank_ext_six (R : Type*) [Field R] :
    Module.finrank R (Finset (Fin 6) → R) = 64
theorems.description: The exterior algebra of the six has dimension `64`.

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.Jlist_pairwise
theorems.statement: theorem Jlist_pairwise : (Jlist (R := R)).Pairwise fun y z => y * z = -(z * y)

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.volume_sq
theorems.statement: theorem volume_sq : volume (R := R) * volume = -1
theorems.description: **The volume element squares to `−1`:** `(J₀ ⋯ J₅)² = −1`.

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.half_mul_self
theorems.statement:
theorem half_mul_self (D : Finset (Fin 6)) (x : Fin 6) :
    halfStep D x * halfStep D x = (if x ∈ D then -1 else 1 : ℂ) • 1
theorems.description: **The divided steps square to `−1`:** `f_x² = θ_D(x)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.half_anticomm_ne
theorems.statement:
theorem half_anticomm_ne (D : Finset (Fin 6)) {x y : Fin 6} (hxy : x ≠ y) :
    halfStep D x * halfStep D y = -(halfStep D y * halfStep D x)
theorems.description: Steps along different directions still anticommute with the square root of the sign.

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.half_anticomm
theorems.statement:
theorem half_anticomm (D : Finset (Fin 6)) (x y : Fin 6) :
    halfStep D x * halfStep D y + halfStep D y * halfStep D x =
      if x = y then (2 * (if x ∈ D then -1 else 1) : ℂ) • 1 else 0
theorems.description: **`f_x f_y + f_y f_x = 2 θ_D(x) δ_xy`:** the square root of the sign makes the divided steps square to `−1`.

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.filter_finRange_length
theorems.statement:
theorem filter_finRange_length (D : Finset (Fin 6)) :
    ((List.finRange 6).filter fun b => decide (b ∈ D)).length = D.card

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.half_prod
theorems.statement:
theorem half_prod (D : Finset (Fin 6)) :
    (List.ofFn (halfStep D)).prod = Complex.I ^ D.card • volume
theorems.description: **The half on the whole:** `f₀ f₁ ⋯ f₅ = i^{|D|} J₀ J₁ ⋯ J₅`.

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.transpose_orth
theorems.statement: theorem transpose_orth {O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ} (hO : Oᵀ * O = 1) : Oᵀᵀ * Oᵀ = 1

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.Jv_mul_extMap
theorems.statement:
theorem Jv_mul_extMap (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (hO : Oᵀ * O = 1) (a : Fin n → ℝ) :
    Jv a * extMap O = extMap O * Jv (Oᵀ *ᵥ a)
theorems.description:
**Dividing then carrying is carrying then dividing:** `J(a) Λ(O) = Λ(O) J(O⁻¹ a)` for
orthogonal `O` (`O⁻¹ = Oᵀ`).

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.jointStep_rename
theorems.statement:
theorem jointStep_rename (a : Fin n → ℝ) (U gx gy : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (hgx : gxᵀ * gx = 1) :
    extMap gx * jointStep a U * extMap gyᵀ = jointStep (gx *ᵥ a) (gx * U * gyᵀ)
theorems.description:
**The gauge transformation of the joint step:** `Λ(g_x) 𝒯 Λ(g_y)⁻¹ = J(g_x a) Λ(g_x U g_y⁻¹)` for
orthogonal `g_x`, with `Λ(g_y)⁻¹ = Λ(g_yᵀ)` (`extMap_mul_transpose`).

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.dot_orth
theorems.statement:
theorem dot_orth {O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ} (hO : Oᵀ * O = 1) (a : Fin n → ℝ) :
    (O *ᵥ a) ⬝ᵥ (O *ᵥ a) = a ⬝ᵥ a
theorems.description: An orthogonal matrix keeps the length.

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.jointStep_inv
theorems.statement:
theorem jointStep_inv (a : Fin n → ℝ) (ha : a ⬝ᵥ a = 1) (U : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ)
    (hU : Uᵀ * U = 1) :
    jointStep a U * jointStep (Uᵀ *ᵥ a) Uᵀ = 1 ∧ jointStep (Uᵀ *ᵥ a) Uᵀ * jointStep a U = 1
theorems.description:
**The step back:** for a unit direction `a` and orthogonal `U`,
`(J(a)Λ(U)) (J(Uᵀa)Λ(Uᵀ)) = 1` and `(J(Uᵀa)Λ(Uᵀ)) (J(a)Λ(U)) = 1`: `𝒯_xy⁻¹ = J(U_yx a) Λ(U_yx)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.rot_transpose_mul
theorems.statement: theorem rot_transpose_mul (g : Rot n) : (g : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ)ᵀ * g = 1

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.rot_inv_val
theorems.statement:
theorem rot_inv_val (g : Rot n) :
    ((g⁻¹ : Rot n) : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) = (g : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ)ᵀ

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.connStep_rename
theorems.statement:
theorem connStep_rename (c : Connection X (Rot n)) (g : X → Rot n) (a : Fin n → ℝ) (x y : X) :
    extMap (g x : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) * connStep c a x y *
        extMap ((g y)⁻¹ : Rot n) =
      connStep (c.rename g) ((g x : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) *ᵥ a) x y
theorems.description:
**Proposition 37, the gauge transformation:** under a gauge transformation `g`,
`Λ(g_x) 𝒯[U](x, y) Λ(g_y)⁻¹ = 𝒯[g·U](x, y)` with the direction `a ↦ g_x a`.

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.connStep_inv
theorems.statement:
theorem connStep_inv (c : Connection X (Rot n)) (a : Fin n → ℝ) (ha : a ⬝ᵥ a = 1) (x y : X) :
    connStep c a x y * connStep c ((c.U y x : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) *ᵥ a) y x = 1 ∧
      connStep c ((c.U y x : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) *ᵥ a) y x * connStep c a x y = 1
theorems.description:
**Proposition 37, the step back:** `𝒯[U](x, y)⁻¹ = 𝒯[U](y, x)` with the direction carried,
`J(U_yx a)Λ(U_yx)`, for a unit direction.

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.Jx_single
theorems.statement:
theorem Jx_single (a : Fin n) (S : Finset (Fin n)) :
    Jx (R := R) a (Pi.single S (1 : R)) =
      extSign (R := R) a (S.erase a) • (Pi.single (symmDiff S {a}) (1 : R) : Finset (Fin n) → R)

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.comm_mul
theorems.statement:
theorem comm_mul {A : Type*} [Ring A] (T X Y : A) :
    T * (X * Y) - X * Y * T = (T * X - X * T) * Y + X * (T * Y - Y * T)
theorems.description: The commutator obeys the product rule: `[T, XY] = [T, X]Y + X[T, Y]`.

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.Tx_comm_chain
theorems.statement:
theorem Tx_comm_chain {a b c : Fin n} (hab : a ≠ b) (hbc : b ≠ c) (hac : a ≠ c) :
    Tx (R := R) a b * Tx b c - Tx b c * Tx a b = Tx a c
theorems.description:
**The parallel rotations close as the rotations of the six:** `[T_ab, T_bc] = T_ac` for distinct
`a, b, c`.

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.Tx_comm_disjoint
theorems.statement:
theorem Tx_comm_disjoint {a b c d : Fin n} (hac : a ≠ c) (had : a ≠ d) (hbc : b ≠ c)
    (hbd : b ≠ d) : Tx (R := R) a b * Tx c d - Tx c d * Tx a b = 0
theorems.description: **Rotations of disjoint planes commute:** `[T_ab, T_cd] = 0` for `{a, b} ∩ {c, d} = ∅`.

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.rotor_mul
theorems.statement:
theorem rotor_mul {a b : Fin n} (hab : a ≠ b) (θ θ' : ℝ) :
    rotor a b θ * rotor a b θ' = rotor a b (θ + θ')

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.rotor_two_pi
theorems.statement: theorem rotor_two_pi (a b : Fin n) : rotor a b (2 * Real.pi) = -1
theorems.description: **Spin one half:** `R(2π) = −1`, while the rotation of the plane is the identity.

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.rotor_zero
theorems.statement: theorem rotor_zero (a b : Fin n) : rotor a b 0 = 1

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.Jx_JJ
theorems.statement:
theorem Jx_JJ {a b : Fin n} (hab : a ≠ b) :
    Jx (R := ℝ) a * (Jx a * Jx b) = Jx b ∧ (Jx (R := ℝ) a * Jx b) * Jx a = -Jx b ∧
    Jx (R := ℝ) b * (Jx a * Jx b) = -Jx a ∧ (Jx (R := ℝ) a * Jx b) * Jx b = Jx a

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.rotor_conj_a
theorems.statement:
theorem rotor_conj_a {a b : Fin n} (hab : a ≠ b) (θ : ℝ) :
    rotor a b θ * Jx a * rotor a b (-θ) = Real.cos θ • Jx a - Real.sin θ • Jx b
theorems.description: **The step turns its plane:** `R(ϑ) J_a R(−ϑ) = cos ϑ J_a − sin ϑ J_b`.

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.rotor_conj_b
theorems.statement:
theorem rotor_conj_b {a b : Fin n} (hab : a ≠ b) (θ : ℝ) :
    rotor a b θ * Jx b * rotor a b (-θ) = Real.sin θ • Jx a + Real.cos θ • Jx b
theorems.description: `R(ϑ) J_b R(−ϑ) = sin ϑ J_a + cos ϑ J_b`.

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.half_loop_sq
theorems.statement:
theorem half_loop_sq (D : Finset (Fin 6)) {x y : Fin 6} (hxy : x ≠ y) :
    (halfStep D x * halfStep D y) * (halfStep D x * halfStep D y) =
      (-((if x ∈ D then -1 else 1 : ℂ) * (if y ∈ D then -1 else 1))) • 1
theorems.description: **`(f_xf_y)² = −θ_D(x)θ_D(y)`** for `x ≠ y`: `−1` within a side, `+1` across.

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.loop_counts
theorems.statement:
theorem loop_counts : ∀ D : Finset (Fin 6),
    (Finset.univ.filter fun p : Fin 6 × Fin 6 => p.1 < p.2 ∧ (p.1 ∈ D ↔ p.2 ∈ D)).card =
      D.card.choose 2 + (6 - D.card).choose 2 ∧
    (Finset.univ.filter fun p : Fin 6 × Fin 6 => p.1 < p.2 ∧ ¬(p.1 ∈ D ↔ p.2 ∈ D)).card =
      D.card * (6 - D.card)
theorems.description: **Within a side and across:** `C(k,2) + C(6−k,2)` planes keep the sides, `k(6 − k)` cross.

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.phase_compl
theorems.statement:
theorem phase_compl (S : Finset (Fin 6)) :
    Complex.I ^ Sᶜ.card = -star (Complex.I ^ S.card)
theorems.description:
**Calling the other part divided turns the phase into `−` its conjugate:**
`i^{|Sᶜ|} = −\overline{i^{|S|}}`.

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.degreeProj_apply
theorems.statement:
theorem degreeProj_apply (k : ℕ) (v : Finset (Fin n) → R) (T : Finset (Fin n)) :
    degreeProj k v T = if T.card = k then v T else 0

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.εε_degree
theorems.statement:
theorem εε_degree (a b : Fin n) (v : Finset (Fin n) → R) (T : Finset (Fin n)) :
    (εx a * εx b : Module.End R (Finset (Fin n) → R)) (degreeProj T.card v) T = 0
theorems.description: Two directions more change the degree.

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.ιι_degree
theorems.statement:
theorem ιι_degree (a b : Fin n) (v : Finset (Fin n) → R) (T : Finset (Fin n)) :
    (ιx a * ιx b : Module.End R (Finset (Fin n) → R)) (degreeProj T.card v) T = 0
theorems.description: Two directions fewer change the degree.

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.Tx_degree
theorems.statement:
theorem Tx_degree (a b : Fin n) (v : Finset (Fin n) → R) (T : Finset (Fin n)) :
    Tx a b (degreeProj T.card v) T = Tx a b v T
theorems.description: The rotation keeps the degree.

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.Tx_eq_sum_degrees
theorems.statement:
theorem Tx_eq_sum_degrees {a b : Fin n} (hab : a ≠ b) :
    Tx (R := R) a b = ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), degreeProj k * (Jx a * Jx b) * degreeProj k
theorems.description: **Proposition 36:** `T_ab = Σ_k Π_k J_a J_b Π_k` for `a ≠ b`.

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.ιx_single
theorems.statement:
theorem ιx_single (a : Fin n) (S : Finset (Fin n)) :
    ιx (R := R) a (Pi.single S 1) =
      if a ∈ S then extSign (R := R) a (S.erase a) • (Pi.single (S.erase a) 1 : Finset (Fin n) → R)
      else 0
theorems.description:
**One direction fewer on a basis set:** `ι_a f_S = (−1)^{#{c ∈ S : c < a}} f_{S ∖ {a}}` for
`a ∈ S`, zero otherwise.

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.Tx_single_singlet
theorems.statement:
theorem Tx_single_singlet {a b : Fin n} {S : Finset (Fin n)} (ha : a ∉ S) (hb : b ∉ S) :
    Tx (R := R) a b (Pi.single S 1) = 0
theorems.description: The rotation of `(a, b)` kills a set holding neither `a` nor `b`.

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.Tx_single_both
theorems.statement:
theorem Tx_single_both {a b : Fin n} (hab : a ≠ b) {S : Finset (Fin n)} (ha : a ∈ S)
    (hb : b ∈ S) : Tx (R := R) a b (Pi.single S 1) = 0
theorems.description: The rotation of `(a, b)` kills a set holding both.

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.Tx_εx_self_left
theorems.statement:
theorem Tx_εx_self_left {a b : Fin n} (hab : a ≠ b) :
    Tx (R := R) a b * εx a = εx a * Tx a b - εx b

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.Tx_εx_self_right
theorems.statement:
theorem Tx_εx_self_right {a b : Fin n} (hab : a ≠ b) :
    Tx (R := R) a b * εx b = εx b * Tx a b + εx a

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.Tx_εa_singlet
theorems.statement:
theorem Tx_εa_singlet {a b : Fin n} (hab : a ≠ b) {S : Finset (Fin n)} (ha : a ∉ S) (hb : b ∉ S) :
    Tx (R := R) a b (εx a (Pi.single S 1)) = -εx b (Pi.single S 1)
theorems.description: On a set holding neither, `T ε_a f = −ε_b f` and `T ε_b f = ε_a f`.

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.Tx_εb_singlet
theorems.statement:
theorem Tx_εb_singlet {a b : Fin n} (hab : a ≠ b) {S : Finset (Fin n)} (ha : a ∉ S) (hb : b ∉ S) :
    Tx (R := R) a b (εx b (Pi.single S 1)) = εx a (Pi.single S 1)

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.single_eq_εx
theorems.statement:
theorem single_eq_εx {a : Fin n} {S : Finset (Fin n)} (ha : a ∈ S) :
    (Pi.single S 1 : Finset (Fin n) → R) =
      extSign (R := R) a (S.erase a) • εx a (Pi.single (S.erase a) 1)
theorems.description: A set holding `a` is `± ε_a` of the set without it.

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.Tx_cube
theorems.statement: theorem Tx_cube {a b : Fin n} (hab : a ≠ b) : Tx (R := R) a b * Tx a b * Tx a b = -Tx a b
theorems.description: **`T_ab³ = −T_ab`** for `a ≠ b`.

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.exp_smul_of_cube
theorems.statement:
theorem exp_smul_of_cube {𝔸 : Type*} [NormedRing 𝔸] [NormedAlgebra ℝ 𝔸] [CompleteSpace 𝔸]
    (T : 𝔸) (hT : T * T * T = -T) (θ : ℝ) :
    NormedSpace.exp (θ • T) = 1 + Real.sin θ • T + (1 - Real.cos θ) • (T * T)
theorems.description: **In a complete normed real algebra, `T³ = −T` gives `e^{ϑT} = 1 + sin ϑ T + (1 − cos ϑ)T²`.**

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.turnGen_eq_unitTurn
theorems.statement: theorem turnGen_eq_unitTurn (a b : Fin n) : turnGen a b = unitTurn a b

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.turnGen_sq
theorems.statement:
theorem turnGen_sq {a b : Fin n} (hab : a ≠ b) :
    turnGen a b * turnGen a b = -(Matrix.single a a 1 + Matrix.single b b 1)

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.turnGen_cube
theorems.statement:
theorem turnGen_cube {a b : Fin n} (hab : a ≠ b) :
    turnGen a b * turnGen a b * turnGen a b = -turnGen a b

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.planeRot_apply
theorems.statement:
theorem planeRot_apply {a b : Fin n} (hab : a ≠ b) (θ : ℝ) (i j : Fin n) :
    planeRot a b θ i j =
      (if i = j then 1 else 0) + Real.sin θ * ((if a = i ∧ b = j then 1 else 0) -
        (if b = i ∧ a = j then 1 else 0)) -
        (1 - Real.cos θ) *
          ((if a = i ∧ a = j then 1 else 0) + (if b = i ∧ b = j then 1 else 0))

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.planeRot_col_a
theorems.statement:
theorem planeRot_col_a {a b : Fin n} (hab : a ≠ b) (θ : ℝ) :
    (planeRot a b θ).col a = Real.cos θ • Pi.single a 1 - Real.sin θ • Pi.single b 1

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.planeRot_col_b
theorems.statement:
theorem planeRot_col_b {a b : Fin n} (hab : a ≠ b) (θ : ℝ) :
    (planeRot a b θ).col b = Real.sin θ • Pi.single a 1 + Real.cos θ • Pi.single b 1

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.planeRot_col_other
theorems.statement:
theorem planeRot_col_other {a b c : Fin n} (hab : a ≠ b) (hca : c ≠ a) (hcb : c ≠ b) (θ : ℝ) :
    (planeRot a b θ).col c = Pi.single c 1

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.εv_sub
theorems.statement: theorem εv_sub {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (v w : Fin n → R) : εv (v - w) = εv v - εv w

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.colStep_rot_a
theorems.statement:
theorem colStep_rot_a {a b : Fin n} (hab : a ≠ b) (θ : ℝ) :
    colStep (planeRot a b θ) a = Real.cos θ • εx a - Real.sin θ • εx b

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.colStep_rot_b
theorems.statement:
theorem colStep_rot_b {a b : Fin n} (hab : a ≠ b) (θ : ℝ) :
    colStep (planeRot a b θ) b = Real.sin θ • εx a + Real.cos θ • εx b

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.colStep_rot_other
theorems.statement:
theorem colStep_rot_other {a b c : Fin n} (hab : a ≠ b) (hca : c ≠ a) (hcb : c ≠ b) (θ : ℝ) :
    colStep (planeRot a b θ) c = εx c

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.extMap_rot_singlet
theorems.statement:
theorem extMap_rot_singlet {a b : Fin n} (hab : a ≠ b) (θ : ℝ) {S : Finset (Fin n)} (ha : a ∉ S)
    (hb : b ∉ S) : extMap (planeRot a b θ) (Pi.single S 1) = Pi.single S 1
theorems.description: The rotation fixes a set holding neither `a` nor `b`.

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.extMap_rot_εx
theorems.statement:
theorem extMap_rot_εx {a b : Fin n} (hab : a ≠ b) (θ : ℝ) {S : Finset (Fin n)} (ha : a ∉ S)
    (hb : b ∉ S) (c : Fin n) :
    extMap (planeRot a b θ) (εx c (Pi.single S 1)) = colStep (planeRot a b θ) c (Pi.single S 1)
theorems.description: `Λ(R) ε_c f = ε(Re_c) f` on a set held fixed by `R`.

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.extMap_planeRot
theorems.statement:
theorem extMap_planeRot {a b : Fin n} (hab : a ≠ b) (θ : ℝ) :
    extMap (planeRot a b θ) =
      1 + Real.sin θ • Tx a b + (1 - Real.cos θ) • (Tx (R := ℝ) a b * Tx a b)
theorems.description: **`Λ(planeRot a b ϑ) = 1 + sin ϑ T_ab + (1 − cos ϑ)T_ab²`.**

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.matrix_exp_smul_of_cube
theorems.statement:
theorem matrix_exp_smul_of_cube {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (M : Matrix ι ι ℝ)
    (hM : M * M * M = -M) (θ : ℝ) :
    NormedSpace.exp (θ • M) = 1 + Real.sin θ • M + (1 - Real.cos θ) • (M * M)
theorems.description: `e^{ϑM} = 1 + sin ϑ M + (1 − cos ϑ)M²` for a real matrix with `M³ = −M`.

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.exp_unitTurn
theorems.statement:
theorem exp_unitTurn {a b : Fin n} (hab : a ≠ b) (θ : ℝ) :
    NormedSpace.exp (θ • unitTurn a b) = planeRot a b θ
theorems.description: **`e^{ϑ(E_ab − E_ba)}` is the rotation of the plane `(a, b)` by `ϑ`.**

theorems.name: Comparison.SysExt.exp_parallel_turn
theorems.statement:
theorem exp_parallel_turn {a b : Fin n} (hab : a ≠ b) (θ : ℝ) :
    NormedSpace.exp (θ • LinearMap.toMatrixAlgEquiv' (Tx (R := ℝ) a b)) =
      LinearMap.toMatrixAlgEquiv' (extMap (NormedSpace.exp (θ • unitTurn a b)))
theorems.description: **Proposition 36:** `e^{ϑ T_ab} = Λ(e^{ϑ(E_ab − E_ba)})` for `a ≠ b`, as matrices on the sets.

theorem bch_uniform :

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Existence.commZ_eq
theorems.statement: theorem commZ_eq : ∀ (f : Fin 10) (k : Fin 16), commZ f k = (mZ f k : GaussianInt) • relOpZ (planeImg f k)

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Existence.ten_facts
theorems.statement:
theorem ten_facts : (∀ f : Fin 10, ∀ k : Fin 16, planeImg f (planeImg f k) = k) ∧
    (∀ f : Fin 10, ∀ k : Fin 16, mZ f k ≠ 0 → mZ f (planeImg f k) = -mZ f k) ∧
    (∀ f : Fin 10, ∀ k : Fin 16, mZ f k ≠ 0 → (disagreeSet (planeImg f k)).card = (disagreeSet k).card) ∧
    (∀ f : Fin 10, ∀ k : Fin 16, mZ f k = 0 → planeImg f k = k ∨ True)

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Existence.one_kron_planeTurn_Ω
theorems.statement:
theorem one_kron_planeTurn_Ω (f : Fin 10) :
    ((1 : Matrix Four Four ℂ) ⊗ₖ planeTurn f) *ᵥ Ω = -((planeTurn f ⊗ₖ (1 : Matrix Four Four ℂ)) *ᵥ Ω)

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Existence.tenAct_rel
theorems.statement: theorem tenAct_rel (f : Fin 10) (k : Fin 16) : tenAct f *ᵥ rel k = (mZ f k : ℂ) • rel (planeImg f k)

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Existence.tenAct_conjTranspose
theorems.statement: theorem tenAct_conjTranspose (f : Fin 10) : (tenAct f)ᴴ = -tenAct f

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Existence.relCoef_comm
theorems.statement:
theorem relCoef_comm {X : Matrix Two Two ℂ} (hX : ∀ f, X * tenAct f = tenAct f * X) (f : Fin 10)
    (k l : Fin 16) :
    (mZ f l : ℂ) * relCoef X k (planeImg f l) = -((mZ f k : ℂ) * relCoef X (planeImg f k) l)

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Existence.mZ_values
theorems.statement: theorem mZ_values : ∀ (f : Fin 10) (k : Fin 16), mZ f k = 0 ∨ mZ f k = 2 ∨ mZ f k = -2

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Existence.D_rel
theorems.statement:
theorem D_rel (f : Fin 10) (k : Fin 16) :
    (1 + (1 / 2 : ℂ) • (tenAct f * tenAct f)) *ᵥ rel k = (epsZ f k : ℂ) • rel k

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Existence.D_conjTranspose
theorems.statement:
theorem D_conjTranspose (f : Fin 10) :
    (1 + (1 / 2 : ℂ) • (tenAct f * tenAct f))ᴴ = 1 + (1 / 2 : ℂ) • (tenAct f * tenAct f)

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Existence.eps_separates
theorems.statement: theorem eps_separates : ∀ k l : Fin 16, k ≠ l → ∃ f : Fin 10, epsZ f k ≠ epsZ f l

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Existence.irrep_paths
theorems.statement:
theorem irrep_paths : ∀ k l : Fin 16, (disagreeSet k).card = (disagreeSet l).card →
    k = l ∨ (∃ f : Fin 10, mZ f l ≠ 0 ∧ planeImg f l = k) ∨
      (∃ f g : Fin 10, mZ f l ≠ 0 ∧ mZ g (planeImg f l) ≠ 0 ∧ planeImg g (planeImg f l) = k)

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Existence.rel_expand
theorems.statement: theorem rel_expand (v : Two → ℂ) : v = ∑ k, (star (rel k) ⬝ᵥ v) • rel k

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Existence.matrix_ext_rel
theorems.statement: theorem matrix_ext_rel {M N : Matrix Two Two ℂ} (h : ∀ k, M *ᵥ rel k = N *ᵥ rel k) : M = N

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Existence.irrepComb_rel
theorems.statement: theorem irrepComb_rel (c₀ c₁ c₂ : ℂ) (k : Fin 16) : irrepComb c₀ c₁ c₂ *ᵥ rel k = irrepOf c₀ c₁ c₂ k • rel k

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Existence.ten_commutant
theorems.statement:
theorem ten_commutant (X : Matrix Two Two ℂ) :
    (∀ f : Fin 10, X * tenAct f = tenAct f * X) ↔ ∃ c₀ c₁ c₂ : ℂ, X = irrepComb c₀ c₁ c₂
theorems.description: **The operators the ten keep are exactly the combinations of `Π₀`, `Π_F`, `Π_L`.**

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Existence.prop_48_kept
theorems.statement:
theorem prop_48_kept (X : Matrix Two Two ℂ) :
    (∀ f : Fin 10, X * tenAct f = tenAct f * X) ↔
      ∃ c₀ c₁ c₂ : ℂ, X = c₀ • ((1 / 4 : ℂ) • Eop) + c₁ • ((1 / 2 : ℂ) • (1 + swap)) +
        c₂ • ((1 / 2 : ℂ) • (1 - swap) - (1 / 4 : ℂ) • Eop)
theorems.description:
**Proposition 48, the SI's wording:** the projectors onto the singlet, the symmetric and the vector states span the operators the ten keep: an operator on
two systems commutes with the ten rotations `γ_aγ_b ⊗ 1 + 1 ⊗ γ_aγ_b` exactly when it is `c₀Π₀ + c₁Π_F + c₂Π_L`.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Existence.cumQ_values
theorems.statement:
theorem cumQ_values : cumQ 1 = 0 ∧ cumQ 2 = (1 / 2 : ℂ) • (1 + swap) ∧
    cumQ 3 = (1 / 2 : ℂ) • (1 + swap) + ((1 / 2 : ℂ) • (1 - swap) - (1 / 4 : ℂ) • Eop)

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Existence.irreps_sum
theorems.statement:
theorem irreps_sum :
    (1 / 4 : ℂ) • Eop + (1 / 2 : ℂ) • (1 + swap) + ((1 / 2 : ℂ) • (1 - swap) - (1 / 4 : ℂ) • Eop) =
      (1 : Matrix Two Two ℂ)

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Existence.cumQ_rel
theorems.statement:
theorem cumQ_rel (n : ℕ) (k : Fin 16) :
    cumQ n *ᵥ rel k =
      (if 0 < (disagreeSet k).card ∧ (disagreeSet k).card + 2 ≤ 2 * n then 1 else 0 : ℂ) • rel k
theorems.description:
**The cumulative projectors:** `Q_n` is one on the two-spinor states that disagree on `0 < N ≤ 2(n − 1)` lines and zero on
the others.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Existence.prop_48
theorems.statement:
theorem prop_48 :
    ((∀ k : Fin 16, (disagreeSet k).card = 0 ∨ (disagreeSet k).card = 2 ∨ (disagreeSet k).card = 4) ∧
    (Finset.univ.filter fun k : Fin 16 => (disagreeSet k).card = 0).card = 1 ∧
    (Finset.univ.filter fun k : Fin 16 => (disagreeSet k).card = 2).card = 10 ∧
    (Finset.univ.filter fun k : Fin 16 => (disagreeSet k).card = 4).card = 5 ∧
    (∀ k : Fin 16, (disagreeSet k).card ≠ 6) ∧
    (∀ k : Fin 16, L *ᵥ rel k = ((Lvalue k : ℤ) : ℂ) • rel k ∧ Lvalue k = 6 - 2 * (disagreeSet k).card) ∧
    (∀ k : Fin 16,
      ((1 / 4 : ℂ) • Eop) *ᵥ rel k = (if (disagreeSet k).card = 0 then 1 else 0 : ℂ) • rel k ∧
      ((1 / 2 : ℂ) • (1 + swap)) *ᵥ rel k = (if (disagreeSet k).card = 2 then 1 else 0 : ℂ) • rel k ∧
      ((1 / 2 : ℂ) • (1 - swap) - (1 / 4 : ℂ) • Eop) *ᵥ rel k =
        (if (disagreeSet k).card = 4 then 1 else 0 : ℂ) • rel k)) ∧
    (1 / 4 : ℂ) • Eop + (1 / 2 : ℂ) • (1 + swap) + ((1 / 2 : ℂ) • (1 - swap) - (1 / 4 : ℂ) • Eop) =
      (1 : Matrix Two Two ℂ) ∧
    (∀ X : Matrix Two Two ℂ, (∀ f : Fin 10, X * tenAct f = tenAct f * X) ↔
      ∃ c₀ c₁ c₂ : ℂ, X = c₀ • ((1 / 4 : ℂ) • Eop) + c₁ • ((1 / 2 : ℂ) • (1 + swap)) +
        c₂ • ((1 / 2 : ℂ) • (1 - swap) - (1 / 4 : ℂ) • Eop)) ∧
    (cumQ 1 = 0 ∧ cumQ 2 = (1 / 2 : ℂ) • (1 + swap) ∧
      cumQ 3 = (1 / 2 : ℂ) • (1 + swap) + ((1 / 2 : ℂ) • (1 - swap) - (1 / 4 : ℂ) • Eop)) ∧
    (∀ (n : ℕ) (k : Fin 16), cumQ n *ᵥ rel k =
      (if 0 < (disagreeSet k).card ∧ (disagreeSet k).card + 2 ≤ 2 * n then 1 else 0 : ℂ) • rel k)
theorems.description:
**Proposition 48 (singlet, symmetric and vector states).** A two-spinor state disagrees on `N = 0`, `2` or `4` lines, `1 + 10 + 5` two-spinor states,
and none on six (an even set of five lines has at most four); the comparison is `L = 6 − 2N = 6, 2, −2` on them;
`Π₀ = E/4`, `Π_F = (1 + P)/2`, `Π_L = (1 − P)/2 − E/4` are one on the singlet, the symmetric states and the vector states
respectively and zero on the others, `Π₀ + Π_F + Π_L = 1`, and they span the operators the ten keep: an operator on
two systems commutes with the ten rotations `γ_aγ_b ⊗ 1 + 1 ⊗ γ_aγ_b` exactly when it is `c₀Π₀ + c₁Π_F + c₂Π_L`;
cumulatively `Q₁ = 0`, `Q₂ = Π_F`, `Q₃ = Π_F + Π_L`, `Q_n` one on the two-spinor states with `0 < N ≤ 2(n − 1)`.

Recognition: three families and no fourth, the electron at no distinction, the muon reaching the symmetric states, the tau
reaching the vector states. Uses Props. 10, 11, 13.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Existence.prop_47_core
theorems.statement:
theorem prop_47_core :
    (∀ (ι : Type) [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (h : ι → ℝ) (X Y : Matrix ι ι ℝ), h ⬝ᵥ h = 1 → Xᵀ = -X →
      Yᵀ = -Y → massFormLine h X Y = 2 * ((X *ᵥ h) ⬝ᵥ (Y *ᵥ h))) ∧
    (∀ (v : Fin 5 → ℂ) (X : Matrix (Fin 5) (Fin 5) ℂ), star v ⬝ᵥ v = 1 → Xᴴ = -X →
      massFormLine (realVec v) (realify X) (realify X) = 2 * (star (X *ᵥ v) ⬝ᵥ (X *ᵥ v)).re) ∧
    (∀ h k : Fin 5, h ≠ k → ∃ T : Fin 13 → Matrix (Fin 5) (Fin 5) ℂ,
      (∀ j, (T j)ᴴ = -T j) ∧
      (∀ j a b, (a ∈ ({h, k} : Finset (Fin 5)) ↔ b ∉ ({h, k} : Finset (Fin 5))) → T j a b = 0) ∧
      (∀ i j, ((T i)ᴴ * T j).trace.re = if i = j then 1 else 0) ∧
      (∀ i j, (star (T i *ᵥ lastDirectionAt h) ⬝ᵥ (T j *ᵥ lastDirectionAt h)).re = if i = j then w13 i else 0)) ∧
    ((Finset.univ.filter fun j => w13Z j ≠ 0).card = 3 ∧ (∀ j, w13 j = (w13Z j : ℝ) / norm13 j) ∧
      (3 : ℚ) / 13 * (1 - 3 / 13) = 30 / 169) ∧
    (∀ h k : Fin 5, h ≠ k → ∃ T : Fin 12 → Matrix (Fin 5) (Fin 5) ℂ,
      (∀ j, (T j)ᴴ = -T j) ∧ (∀ j, (T j).trace = 0) ∧
      (∀ j a b, (a ∈ ({h, k} : Finset (Fin 5)) ↔ b ∉ ({h, k} : Finset (Fin 5))) → T j a b = 0) ∧
      (∀ i j, ((T i)ᴴ * T j).trace.re = if i = j then 1 else 0) ∧
      (Matrix.of fun i j => (star (T i *ᵥ lastDirectionAt h) ⬝ᵥ (T j *ᵥ lastDirectionAt h)).re).charpoly =
        X ^ 9 * (X - C (1 / 2 : ℝ)) ^ 2 * (X - C (4 / 5 : ℝ))) ∧
    ((1 / 2 : ℝ) / (4 / 5) = 5 / 8 ∧ 1 - (1 / 2 : ℝ) / (4 / 5) = 3 / 8)
theorems.description:
**Proposition 47 (the last-step direction), without the spanning** (`LastDirectionUnit.lean`: `prop_47`). The mass form of the division of the real line `ℝh` is `M_h(X, Y) = 2⟨Xh, Yh⟩`
for rotations of any real space and a unit vector `h`, so on `ℂ⁵ = ℝ¹⁰` `M_h(X, X) = 2|Xh|²` for every anti-Hermitian
`X`; for every plane `{h, k}` there are thirteen rotations that keep the plane and its outside (no entry across), orthonormal
for `Re tr(X†Y)`, on which `½M_h(X_i, X_j) = Re⟨X_ih, X_jh⟩ = diag(1, 0, ½, ½, 0, …, 0)`: three of the thirteen move
the last-step direction, `w_h = 3/13`, `χ_h = w_h(1 − w_h) = 30/169`; and twelve such rotations of trace zero, orthonormal, on which the
form has `det(x − G) = x⁹(x − ½)²(x − 4/5)`: `½M_h = 4/5, ½, ½, 0⁹`; `(½)/(4/5) = 5/8`, `sin²θ = 1 − 5/8 = 3/8`.

Recognition: the last-step direction moves `W⁺`, `W⁻` and `Z` (Gram eigenvalues `½, ½, 4/5`); nine stay massless, the photon and the
eight colour rotations; the last-step direction's length is the Higgs scalar; at the source `M_W²/M_Z² = 5/8`, `sin²θ_W = 3/8`. Uses
Props. 21, 39, 46, Definition 27.

    (∀ h k : Fin 5, h ≠ k → ∃ T : Fin 13 → Matrix (Fin 5) (Fin 5) ℂ,

    ((Finset.univ.filter fun j => w13Z j ≠ 0).card = 3 ∧ (∀ j, w13 j = (w13Z j : ℝ) / norm13 j) ∧
      (3 : ℚ) / 13 * (1 - 3 / 13) = 30 / 169) ∧

theorems.description:

theorems.description: **Conjugation by a unitary keeps the trace form** `tr(X†Y)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Existence.conjU_back

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Existence.span_conj

theorem span_conj {U : Matrix (Fin 5) (Fin 5) ℂ} (hU2 : U * Uᴴ = 1)
    (hB : ∀ a b, (a ∈ ({0, 1} : Finset (Fin 5)) ↔ b ∉ ({0, 1} : Finset (Fin 5))) → U a b = 0)

theorems.description: **Conjugation by a unitary that keeps the plane carries a spanning family of `u(3) ⊕ u(2)` to one.**

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Existence.span_conj0

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Existence.moveTo_mem

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Existence.gram_at_plane
theorems.statement:
theorem gram_at_plane (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 5)) {U : Matrix (Fin 5) (Fin 5) ℂ} (hU : Uᴴ * U = 1)
    (v : Fin 5 → ℂ) (hv : U *ᵥ Pi.single 0 1 = fun a => v (σ a)) (X Y : Matrix (Fin 5) (Fin 5) ℂ) :
    star (moveTo σ (conjU U X) *ᵥ v) ⬝ᵥ (moveTo σ (conjU U Y) *ᵥ v) =
      star (X *ᵥ Pi.single 0 1) ⬝ᵥ (Y *ᵥ Pi.single 0 1)
theorems.description: **The Gram at `v` of the carried rotations is the Gram at `e₀` of the rotations.**

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Existence.col_eq

    (hv : ∀ a, a ≠ h → a ≠ k → v a = 0) : planeU (v h) (v k) *ᵥ Pi.single 0 1 = fun a => v (σ a)

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Existence.unit_plane
