    (Finset.univ.filter fun k : Fin 16 => (disagreeSet k).card = 0).card = 1 ∧
    (Finset.univ.filter fun k : Fin 16 => (disagreeSet k).card = 2).card = 10 ∧
    (Finset.univ.filter fun k : Fin 16 => (disagreeSet k).card = 4).card = 5 ∧
    (∀ k : Fin 16, (disagreeSet k).card ≠ 6) ∧
    (∀ k : Fin 16, L *ᵥ rel k = ((Lvalue k : ℤ) : ℂ) • rel k ∧ Lvalue k = 6 - 2 * (disagreeSet k).card) ∧
    (∀ k : Fin 16,
      ((1 / 4 : ℂ) • Eop) *ᵥ rel k = (if (disagreeSet k).card = 0 then 1 else 0 : ℂ) • rel k ∧
      ((1 / 2 : ℂ) • (1 + swap)) *ᵥ rel k = (if (disagreeSet k).card = 2 then 1 else 0 : ℂ) • rel k ∧
      ((1 / 2 : ℂ) • (1 - swap) - (1 / 4 : ℂ) • Eop) *ᵥ rel k =
        (if (disagreeSet k).card = 4 then 1 else 0 : ℂ) • rel k)) ∧
    (1 / 4 : ℂ) • Eop + (1 / 2 : ℂ) • (1 + swap) + ((1 / 2 : ℂ) • (1 - swap) - (1 / 4 : ℂ) • Eop) =
      (1 : Matrix Two Two ℂ) ∧
    (∀ X : Matrix Two Two ℂ, (∀ f : Fin 10, X * tenAct f = tenAct f * X) ↔
      ∃ c₀ c₁ c₂ : ℂ, X = c₀ • ((1 / 4 : ℂ) • Eop) + c₁ • ((1 / 2 : ℂ) • (1 + swap)) +
        c₂ • ((1 / 2 : ℂ) • (1 - swap) - (1 / 4 : ℂ) • Eop)) ∧
    (cumQ 1 = 0 ∧ cumQ 2 = (1 / 2 : ℂ) • (1 + swap) ∧
      cumQ 3 = (1 / 2 : ℂ) • (1 + swap) + ((1 / 2 : ℂ) • (1 - swap) - (1 / 4 : ℂ) • Eop)) ∧
    (∀ (n : ℕ) (k : Fin 16), cumQ n *ᵥ rel k =
      (if 0 < (disagreeSet k).card ∧ (disagreeSet k).card + 2 ≤ 2 * n then 1 else 0 : ℂ) • rel k)
theorems.description:
**Proposition 48 (singlet, symmetric and vector states).** A two-spinor state disagrees on `N = 0`, `2` or `4` lines, `1 + 10 + 5` two-spinor states,
and none on six (an even set of five lines has at most four); the comparison is `L = 6 − 2N = 6, 2, −2` on them;
`Π₀ = E/4`, `Π_F = (1 + P)/2`, `Π_L = (1 − P)/2 − E/4` are one on the singlet, the symmetric states and the vector states
respectively and zero on the others, `Π₀ + Π_F + Π_L = 1`, and they span the operators the ten keep: an operator on
two systems commutes with the ten rotations `γ_aγ_b ⊗ 1 + 1 ⊗ γ_aγ_b` exactly when it is `c₀Π₀ + c₁Π_F + c₂Π_L`;
cumulatively `Q₁ = 0`, `Q₂ = Π_F`, `Q₃ = Π_F + Π_L`, `Q_n` one on the two-spinor states with `0 < N ≤ 2(n − 1)`.

Recognition: three families and no fourth, the electron at no distinction, the muon reaching the symmetric states, the tau
reaching the vector states. Uses Props. 10, 11, 13.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.prop_99
theorems.statement:
theorem prop_99_full :
    (∀ h : Fin 5, (WholePicture.pairingsBeside h).card = 3) ∧
    (∀ h k : Fin 5, h ≠ k → ∀ c ∈ outLines h k,
      Kc k c * Kc k c = -1 ∧ Kc k c * γ h = γ h * Kc k c ∧ Kc k c * sideQ h = sideQ h * Kc k c) ∧
    (∀ h k : Fin 5, h ≠ k → ∀ c ∈ outLines h k, ∀ d ∈ outLines h k, c ≠ d →
      Kc k c * Kc k d = -(Kc k d * Kc k c)) ∧
    (∀ h k : Fin 5, h ≠ k → ∀ X : Matrix Four Four ℂ, sideQ h * X * sideQ h = X →
      X = (1 / 2 * X.trace) • sideQ h - ∑ c ∈ outLines h k, (1 / 2 * (Kc k c * X).trace) • (Kc k c * sideQ h)) ∧
    (∀ h a b c d : Fin 5, a ≠ b → a ≠ c → a ≠ d → b ≠ c → b ≠ d → c ≠ d → a ≠ h → b ≠ h → c ≠ h → d ≠ h →
      (γ a * γ b) * (γ c * γ d) = γ h ∨ (γ a * γ b) * (γ c * γ d) = -γ h) ∧
    (∀ h k : Fin 5, h ≠ k →
      (∀ x : Fin 5, x ≠ h → ∑ c ∈ outLines h k, pairVec k c x = if x = k then 3 else -1) ∧
      (∀ c ∈ outLines h k, ∀ c' ∈ outLines h k,
        ∑ x ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun x => x ≠ h), pairVec k c x * pairVec k c' x = if c = c' then 4 else 0)) ∧
    Article.gramTheta = !![1, -1 / 4, -1 / 4; -1 / 4, 1, -1 / 4; -1 / 4, -1 / 4, 1] ∧
    (∀ j : Fin 3,
      ![(1 / 4 : ℂ) • Comparison.Eop, (1 / 2 : ℂ) • (1 + Comparison.swap),
        (1 / 2 : ℂ) • (1 - Comparison.swap) - (1 / 4 : ℂ) • Comparison.Eop] j =
        (1 / 4 : ℂ) • ∑ i, Article.B3 i j • Article.XTheta i) ∧
    Article.B3ᵀ * Article.gramTheta * Article.B3 = Matrix.diagonal ![1, 10, 5] ∧ (3 : ℕ) * (1 + 10 + 5) = 48
theorems.description:
**Proposition 99 (the three pairings of the four lines beside the last-step direction).** For every last-step direction `h`: the four lines
beside it pair in exactly three ways; for every plane `{h, k}` and the three lines `c` outside it, with
`K_c = γ_kγ_c` on the last-step direction's side `Q(h)H` (`Q(h) = (1 + γ_h)/2`): `K_c² = −1`, `K_cK_d = −K_dK_c`, each `K_c` keeps
the side (it commutes with `γ_h`), and every operator of the side is `½ tr(X) Q − ½ Σ_c tr(K_cX) K_cQ`, a
combination of `Q` and the three `K_cQ`; for each pairing `{a, b | c, d}` of the four lines,
`(γ_aγ_b)(γ_cγ_d) = ±γ_h`, so on the side `γ_aγ_b = ∓γ_cγ_d`; the pairing vectors, `+1` on the pair of `k` and `−1`
on the other, are orthogonal on the four lines (`Σ_x χ_cχ_{c'} = 4δ`) and sum to `3` at `k` and `−1` at each
outside line, `(3, −1, −1, −1)`; `G_Θ = (5I − 𝖩₃)/4` on `X = (1, −P, −E)`; the singlet, the symmetric and the vector states `Π₀ = E/4`,
`Π_F = (1 + P)/2`, `Π_L = (1 − P)/2 − E/4` are `(1/4) Σ_i (B₃)_{ij} X_i`, so `B₃` changes one basis of the space
into the other and `B₃ᵀG_ΘB₃ = diag(1, 10, 5)` is the Gram matrix of the three projectors; `3(1 + 10 + 5) = 48`.

Recognition: the three families, each one of the three ways the four lines beside the last-step direction split into two symmetric states; on
the last-step direction's doublet the same three are the three rotations of spin. Uses Props. 4, 5, 13, 48.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.prop_49
theorems.statement:
theorem prop_49 (a b : Fin 5) (hab : a ≠ b) :
    zS {a.succ, b.succ} = -1 ∧ Law.LS {a.succ, b.succ} = 5 ∧ Law.wS {a.succ, b.succ} = -1 / 5 ∧
    Law.wS {a.succ, b.succ} ^ 2 = 1 / 25 ∧
    zS (outside a b) = -I ∧ Law.LS (outside a b) = -1 ∧ Law.wS (outside a b) = I ∧
    Law.wS (outside a b) ^ 2 = -1 ∧
    (∀ z : ℂ, Law.Phi z = -z ^ 2 * Law.Psi (z ^ 2 / 16)) ∧ (∀ v : ℂ, Law.Psi v = v / (1 + 3 * v)) ∧
    Law.PsiS {a.succ, b.succ} = 1 / 28 ∧ Law.PsiS (outside a b) = 1 / 2 ∧
    zS {a.succ, b.succ} ^ 2 = 1 ∧ zS (outside a b) ^ 2 = -1 ∧
    (∀ k : Fin 16, k ≠ 0 → |(Lvalue k : ℝ) / 6| = 1 / 3 ∧ Real.sqrt (|(Lvalue k : ℝ) / 6|)⁻¹ = Real.sqrt 3)
theorems.description:
**Proposition 49 (one plane at its two signs).** For every plane `{a, b}`: at the plane itself (even, a count)
`z = −1`, `L = 5`, `w = −1/5`, `w² = 1/25`; at its counterpart `{a, b}'`, the three lines outside it (odd, an amplitude),
`z = −i`, `L = −1`, `w = i`, `w² = −1`; `Φ(z) = −z²Ψ(z²/16)` with `Ψ(v) = v/(1 + 3v)`; `Ψ(w²) = 1/28` at the plane and
`1/2` at its counterpart with `n` added; the sign `z²` each puts on the clock is `+1`, `−1`; on both signs each two-spinor state of the singlet, the symmetric or the vector states weighs
`|L/6|^{−1/2} = √3`.

Recognition: the charged leptons sit at the plane and the quarks at its counterpart with `n` added, one mass operator for both. Uses
Props. 10, 30, 44.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.prop_50
theorems.statement:
theorem prop_50 (a b : Fin 5) (hab : a ≠ b) :
    ((varP / (2 * (varP + varQ)) : ℝ) : ℂ) + Law.wS (outside a b) = 7 / 16 + I ∧
    ((varP / (2 * (varP + varQ)) : ℝ) : ℂ) + Law.wS {0, a.succ, b.succ} = 7 / 16 - I ∧
    Complex.arg (7 / 16 + I) = Complex.arg (7 + 16 * I) ∧
    Complex.arg (7 + 16 * I) = Real.arctan (16 / 7) ∧
    ((1.158385 : ℝ) < Complex.arg (7 + 16 * I) ∧ Complex.arg (7 + 16 * I) < 1.158395) ∧
    Complex.arg (7 / 16 - I) = -Complex.arg (7 + 16 * I)
theorems.description:
**Proposition 50 (the complex weight).** For every plane `{a, b}`: the plane whose one end counts an excursion at `{}`,
`b = Var P/(2(Var P + Var Q)) = 7/16` (Prop. 30), and whose other end carries the three outside lines,
`w_C = i` (Prop. 44), has `b + w_C = 7/16 + i`, of angle `arg(7 + 16i) = arctan(16/7) = 1.15839…`; with the other
orientation of the square root of the sign (`C` named `{n, a, b}`, `w = −i`), `b + w = 7/16 − i`, of angle `−arg(7 + 16i)`.

Recognition: the phase of quark mixing and its sign; the orientation `q` is the one that calls matter matter. Uses
Props. 30, 44.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.prop_51
theorems.statement:
theorem prop_51 :
    Article.lineFactor (1 / 4) = 2 ∧ Article.lineFactor (I / 4) = 3 / 4 * (1 + I) ∧
    Complex.arg (Article.lineFactor (I / 4)) = Real.pi / 4 ∧
    Real.tan (Real.pi / 8) ^ 2 = 3 - 2 * Real.sqrt 2 ∧
    ((0.1715725 : ℝ) < 3 - 2 * Real.sqrt 2 ∧ 3 - 2 * Real.sqrt 2 < 0.1715735) ∧
    (∀ S : Finset (Fin 6), Even S.card →
      (Article.lineFactor (Law.uS S)).im = 0 ∧ 0 < (Article.lineFactor (Law.uS S)).re) ∧
    (∀ t : Fin 5, Law.uS {t.succ} = I / 4) ∧ Law.uS ∅ = 1 / 4
theorems.description:
**Proposition 51 (the line factor at the last-step direction's phase).** The factor of the law on the vector states,
`1 + 3u + 4u²` at `u = z/4`: `2` at `z = 1` (`u_∅ = 1/4`) and `(3/4)(1 + i)` at the last-step direction's phase `z = i`
(`u_{\{t\}} = i/4`), of phase `π/4`, half phase `π/8`; `tan²(π/8) = 3 − 2√2 = 0.171573…`; at every even divided set
the factor is real and positive.

Recognition: the ratio of the two light neutral masses `ρ_ν = tan²(π/8)`. Uses Props. 35, 44.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Existence.prop_46_full
theorems.statement:
theorem prop_46_full :
    ((∀ x y : SysExt.Ten, tenLine x * tenLine y + tenLine y * tenLine x = if x = y then (2 : ℂ) • 1 else 0) ∧
    Module.finrank ℝ (SysExt.turnsTen tenLine) = 45 ∧

    (∀ k : Fin 16, Complex.exp (-(Real.pi / 4 : ℂ) * (Lvalue k : ℂ) * I) • rel k = (-I) • (swap *ᵥ rel k)) ∧
    Module.finrank ℝ keepLP = 25 ∧
    Module.finrank ℝ (SysExt.turnsTen tenLine ⊓ SysExt.commWith (L ⊗ₖ (1 : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ)) :
      Submodule ℝ _) = 25 ∧

    Module.finrank ℝ keepPlaneP = 12 ∧
    lastDirectionP = kronVec (ell 3) (Pi.single 0 1) ∧ Module.finrank ℝ keepLastDirectionP = 9 ∧
    (GroupsContinuumLaw.IsPlaneTurn GroupsContinuumLaw.Yc ∧ (∀ W, GroupsContinuumLaw.IsPlaneTurn W → GroupsContinuumLaw.Yc * W = W * GroupsContinuumLaw.Yc) ∧
      ∀ Z, GroupsContinuumLaw.IsPlaneTurn Z → (∀ W, GroupsContinuumLaw.IsPlaneTurn W → Z * W = W * Z) →
        ∃ a : ℝ, Z = (a : ℂ) • GroupsContinuumLaw.Yc) ∧
    (GroupsContinuumLaw.IsLastDirectionTurn GroupsContinuumLaw.Qc ∧ (∀ W, GroupsContinuumLaw.IsLastDirectionTurn W → GroupsContinuumLaw.Qc * W = W * GroupsContinuumLaw.Qc) ∧
      ∀ Z, GroupsContinuumLaw.IsLastDirectionTurn Z → (∀ W, GroupsContinuumLaw.IsLastDirectionTurn W → Z * W = W * Z) →
        ∃ a : ℝ, Z = (a : ℂ) • GroupsContinuumLaw.Qc) ∧

      ∑ S ∈ GroupsContinuumLaw.relSets, GroupsContinuumLaw.chargeZ GroupsContinuumLaw.y6 S ^ 3 = 0)) ∧
    (∀ h k : Fin 5, h ≠ k →
      crP h * anP h + crP k * anP k =
        (1 / 2 : ℂ) • (1 - (γ h ⊗ₖ γ h) ⊗ₖ σ₃) + (1 / 2 : ℂ) • (1 - (γ k ⊗ₖ γ k) ⊗ₖ σ₃) ∧
      lastDirectionAtP h = kronVec (ell h) (Pi.single 0 1) ∧
      Module.finrank ℝ (keepPlaneP' h k) = 12 ∧ Module.finrank ℝ (keepLastDirectionP' h k) = 9) ∧
    (∀ (a b : Fin 5) (r : Two → ℂ),
      (tenLine (Sum.inl a) * tenLine (Sum.inl b)) *ᵥ kronVec r (Pi.single 0 1) =
        kronVec (((γ a * γ b) ⊗ₖ (1 : Matrix Four Four ℂ)) *ᵥ r) (Pi.single 0 1) ∧
      (tenLine (Sum.inr a) * tenLine (Sum.inr b)) *ᵥ kronVec r (Pi.single 0 1) =
        kronVec (((1 : Matrix Four Four ℂ) ⊗ₖ (γ a * γ b)) *ᵥ r) (Pi.single 0 1) ∧
      (tenLine (Sum.inl a) * tenLine (Sum.inr b)) *ᵥ kronVec r (Pi.single 0 1) =
        kronVec ((I • (γ a ⊗ₖ γ b)) *ᵥ r) (Pi.single 0 1)) ∧
    (∀ X : PairM, X ∈ SysExt.turnsTen tenLine ↔
      ∃ M : Matrix SysExt.Ten SysExt.Ten ℝ, Mᵀ = -M ∧ SysExt.turnOf tenLine M = X) ∧
    (∀ M N : Matrix SysExt.Ten SysExt.Ten ℝ, Mᵀ = -M →

        SysExt.turnOf tenLine (M * N - N * M)) ∧

    (∀ Z W : Matrix (Fin 5) (Fin 5) ℂ,

    (∀ Z W : Matrix (Fin 5) (Fin 5) ℂ, Zᴴ = -Z → Wᴴ = -W →
      SysExt.turnOf tenLine (realForm Z) = SysExt.turnOf tenLine (realForm W) → Z = W) ∧
    (∀ Z : Matrix (Fin 5) (Fin 5) ℂ, Zᴴ = -Z → (SysExt.turnOf tenLine (realForm Z) ∈ keepVacP ↔ Z.trace = 0)) ∧
    (∀ h k : Fin 5, h ≠ k → ∃ π : Equiv.Perm (Fin 5), π 3 = h ∧ π 4 = k) ∧
    (∀ (h k : Fin 5) (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin 5)), π 3 = h → π 4 = k → ∀ Z : Matrix (Fin 5) (Fin 5) ℂ, Zᴴ = -Z →
      (SysExt.turnOf tenLine (realForm Z) ∈ keepPlaneP' h k ↔ GroupsContinuumLaw.IsPlaneTurn (Z.submatrix π π)) ∧
      (SysExt.turnOf tenLine (realForm Z) ∈ keepLastDirectionP' h k ↔ GroupsContinuumLaw.IsLastDirectionTurn (Z.submatrix π π))) ∧
    (∀ X ∈ keepLP, (∀ Y ∈ keepLP, X * Y = Y * X) ↔ ∃ a : ℝ, X = a • (I • ((L - 1) ⊗ₖ σ₃))) ∧
    (∀ h k : Fin 5, h ≠ k → ∀ X ∈ keepPlaneP' h k, (∀ Y ∈ keepPlaneP' h k, X * Y = Y * X) ↔
      ∃ a : ℝ, X = a • SysExt.turnOf tenLine (SysExt.uFive (Matrix.diagonal (yAt h k)))) ∧
    (∀ h k : Fin 5, h ≠ k → ∀ X ∈ keepLastDirectionP' h k, (∀ Y ∈ keepLastDirectionP' h k, X * Y = Y * X) ↔
      ∃ a : ℝ, X = a • SysExt.turnOf tenLine (SysExt.uFive (Matrix.diagonal (qAt h k)))) ∧
    Nonempty (((GroupsContinuumLaw.SU3 × GroupsContinuumLaw.SU2 × GroupsContinuumLaw.U1) ⧸ GroupsContinuumLaw.symHom.ker) ≃* GroupsContinuumLaw.SU32) ∧
    (∀ h k : Fin 5, h ≠ k → ∑ r, hyper h k r = 0 ∧ ∑ r, hyper h k r ^ 3 = 0 ∧
      ∑ r ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun r => nOut h k r = 1 ∨ nOut h k r = 2), hyper h k r = 0 ∧
      ∑ r ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun r => nPlane h k r = 1), hyper h k r = 0)
theorems.description:
**Proposition 46 (the rotations of a pair, and what each keeps).** The ten lines of a pair on `H ⊗ H ⊗ ℂ²`,
`Γ_a = γ_a ⊗ 1 ⊗ σ_x`, `Γ_{5+a} = 1 ⊗ γ_a ⊗ σ_y`, anticommute, `Γ_xΓ_y + Γ_yΓ_x = 2δ_xy`; the two-spinor states are
`σ_z = +1`, on which the rotations `½Γ_xΓ_y` act as `γ_aγ_b ⊗ 1`, `1 ⊗ γ_aγ_b` and `iγ_a ⊗ γ_b` (times `½`); they are
`so(10)`: `M ↦ ρ(M) = ¼ Σ M_xy Γ_xΓ_y` keeps the commutator and is injective on the antisymmetric `M`, dimension
45; `−i Σ_t Γ_tΓ_{5+t} = (L − 1) ⊗ σ_z` and `e^{−iπL/4} = −iP` (as an operator, and on each two-spinor state); the rotations
keeping the comparison are `u(5)`: `Z ↦ ρ([[Re Z, −Im Z], [Im Z, Re Z]])` is an injective real-linear map of Lie
algebras from the anti-Hermitian `5 × 5` matrices onto them, 25 (keeping `L ⊗ 1` likewise), with centre
`ℝ·i(L − 1) ⊗ σ_z`, the rotation `ρ(J) = ½ i(L − 1) ⊗ σ_z` of the complex structure; keeping also the singlet `Ω ⊗ e₊`:
`tr Z = 0`, `su(5)`, 24; keeping also the plane count `N_F = Σ_{t ∈ F}(1 − (γ_t ⊗ γ_t) ⊗ σ_z)/2`: `Z` in
`s(u(3) ⊕ u(2))`, 12, with centre `ℝ·ρ(iY)`; keeping also the last-step direction's two-spinor state `ℓ_h ⊗ e₊`: `Z` in `su(3) ⊕ u(1)`, 9,
with centre `ℝ·ρ(iQ)` — at every plane `F = {h, k}` with the last-step direction `h` (`Z` read after a relabelling `π` with
`π 3 = h`, `π 4 = k`; `Y = ½` on `F`, `−⅓` on `C`; `Q = 0` on `h`, `1` on `k`, `−⅓` on `C`);
`(A, B, z) ↦ (z²A, z̄³B)` maps `SU(3) × SU(2) × U(1)` onto `S(U(3) × U(2))`, with kernel the six images of the sixth
roots of unity, cyclic, and `(SU(3) × SU(2) × U(1))/ℤ₆ ≃ S(U(3) × U(2))`; and on the sixteen, at every plane,
`Tr Y = Tr Y³ = 0` and the colour and the doublet sums of `Y` vanish (`Tr YT_c² = Tr YT₃² = 0`).

Recognition: the gauge group of the standard model, `S(U(2) × U(3)) = (SU(3) × SU(2) × U(1))/ℤ₆`, twelve
generators, held by `SU(5)`; `Y` the hypercharge, `Q` the electric charge. Uses Props. 4, 10, 11, 45.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Existence.prop_46_plane34
theorems.statement:
theorem prop_46_plane34 :
    (∀ x y : SysExt.Ten, tenLine x * tenLine y + tenLine y * tenLine x = if x = y then (2 : ℂ) • 1 else 0) ∧
    Module.finrank ℝ (SysExt.turnsTen tenLine) = 45 ∧
    (-I) • ∑ t, tenLine (Sum.inl t) * tenLine (Sum.inr t) = (L - 1) ⊗ₖ σ₃ ∧
    (∀ k : Fin 16, Complex.exp (-(Real.pi / 4 : ℂ) * (Lvalue k : ℂ) * I) • rel k = (-I) • (swap *ᵥ rel k)) ∧
    Module.finrank ℝ keepLP = 25 ∧
    Module.finrank ℝ (SysExt.turnsTen tenLine ⊓ SysExt.commWith (L ⊗ₖ (1 : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ)) :
      Submodule ℝ _) = 25 ∧
    SysExt.turnOf tenLine SysExt.cxJ = (1 / 2 : ℝ) • (I • ((L - 1) ⊗ₖ σ₃)) ∧
    vacP = kronVec Ω (Pi.single 0 1) ∧ Module.finrank ℝ keepVacP = 24 ∧
    planeNP = (1 / 2 : ℂ) • (1 - (γ 3 ⊗ₖ γ 3) ⊗ₖ σ₃) + (1 / 2 : ℂ) • (1 - (γ 4 ⊗ₖ γ 4) ⊗ₖ σ₃) ∧
    Module.finrank ℝ keepPlaneP = 12 ∧
    lastDirectionP = kronVec (ell 3) (Pi.single 0 1) ∧ Module.finrank ℝ keepLastDirectionP = 9 ∧
    (GroupsContinuumLaw.IsPlaneTurn GroupsContinuumLaw.Yc ∧ (∀ W, GroupsContinuumLaw.IsPlaneTurn W → GroupsContinuumLaw.Yc * W = W * GroupsContinuumLaw.Yc) ∧
      ∀ Z, GroupsContinuumLaw.IsPlaneTurn Z → (∀ W, GroupsContinuumLaw.IsPlaneTurn W → Z * W = W * Z) →
        ∃ a : ℝ, Z = (a : ℂ) • GroupsContinuumLaw.Yc) ∧
    (GroupsContinuumLaw.IsLastDirectionTurn GroupsContinuumLaw.Qc ∧ (∀ W, GroupsContinuumLaw.IsLastDirectionTurn W → GroupsContinuumLaw.Qc * W = W * GroupsContinuumLaw.Qc) ∧
      ∀ Z, GroupsContinuumLaw.IsLastDirectionTurn Z → (∀ W, GroupsContinuumLaw.IsLastDirectionTurn W → Z * W = W * Z) →
        ∃ a : ℝ, Z = (a : ℂ) • GroupsContinuumLaw.Qc) ∧
    Function.Surjective GroupsContinuumLaw.symHom ∧
    (∀ x, GroupsContinuumLaw.symHom x = 1 ↔ ∃ ζ : rootsOfUnity 6 ℂ, x = GroupsContinuumLaw.kerElt ζ) ∧
    Nat.card (rootsOfUnity 6 ℂ) = 6 ∧ IsCyclic (rootsOfUnity 6 ℂ) ∧
    (∑ S ∈ GroupsContinuumLaw.relSets, GroupsContinuumLaw.chargeZ GroupsContinuumLaw.y6 S = 0 ∧
      ∑ S ∈ GroupsContinuumLaw.relSets, GroupsContinuumLaw.chargeZ GroupsContinuumLaw.y6 S ^ 3 = 0)
theorems.description: Proposition 46 at the plane `{3, 4}` with the last-step direction `3`; `PairWhole.lean`: `prop_46`, at every plane and with the centres.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Existence.prop_46_every_plane

    lastDirectionAtP h = kronVec (ell h) (Pi.single 0 1) ∧
    Module.finrank ℝ (keepPlaneP' h k) = 12 ∧ Module.finrank ℝ (keepLastDirectionP' h k) = 9
theorems.description:
**Proposition 46 at every plane:** with `N_F = Σ_{t ∈ F}(1 − (γ_t ⊗ γ_t) ⊗ σ_z)/2` and the last-step direction's two-spinor state
`ℓ_h ⊗ e₊`, the rotations of the pair that keep the comparison, the singlet, `N_F` and `ℓ_h ⊗ e₊` have dimensions 12 and 9
for every plane `F = {h, k}`.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Existence.prop_46_chain
theorems.statement:
theorem prop_46_chain :
    ((∀ x y : SysExt.Ten, tenLine x * tenLine y + tenLine y * tenLine x = if x = y then (2 : ℂ) • 1 else 0) ∧
    Module.finrank ℝ (SysExt.turnsTen tenLine) = 45 ∧
    (-I) • ∑ t, tenLine (Sum.inl t) * tenLine (Sum.inr t) = (L - 1) ⊗ₖ σ₃ ∧
    (∀ k : Fin 16, Complex.exp (-(Real.pi / 4 : ℂ) * (Lvalue k : ℂ) * I) • rel k = (-I) • (swap *ᵥ rel k)) ∧
    Module.finrank ℝ keepLP = 25 ∧
    Module.finrank ℝ (SysExt.turnsTen tenLine ⊓ SysExt.commWith (L ⊗ₖ (1 : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ)) :
      Submodule ℝ _) = 25 ∧
    SysExt.turnOf tenLine SysExt.cxJ = (1 / 2 : ℝ) • (I • ((L - 1) ⊗ₖ σ₃)) ∧
    vacP = kronVec Ω (Pi.single 0 1) ∧ Module.finrank ℝ keepVacP = 24 ∧
    planeNP = (1 / 2 : ℂ) • (1 - (γ 3 ⊗ₖ γ 3) ⊗ₖ σ₃) + (1 / 2 : ℂ) • (1 - (γ 4 ⊗ₖ γ 4) ⊗ₖ σ₃) ∧
    Module.finrank ℝ keepPlaneP = 12 ∧
    lastDirectionP = kronVec (ell 3) (Pi.single 0 1) ∧ Module.finrank ℝ keepLastDirectionP = 9 ∧
    (GroupsContinuumLaw.IsPlaneTurn GroupsContinuumLaw.Yc ∧ (∀ W, GroupsContinuumLaw.IsPlaneTurn W → GroupsContinuumLaw.Yc * W = W * GroupsContinuumLaw.Yc) ∧
      ∀ Z, GroupsContinuumLaw.IsPlaneTurn Z → (∀ W, GroupsContinuumLaw.IsPlaneTurn W → Z * W = W * Z) →
        ∃ a : ℝ, Z = (a : ℂ) • GroupsContinuumLaw.Yc) ∧
    (GroupsContinuumLaw.IsLastDirectionTurn GroupsContinuumLaw.Qc ∧ (∀ W, GroupsContinuumLaw.IsLastDirectionTurn W → GroupsContinuumLaw.Qc * W = W * GroupsContinuumLaw.Qc) ∧
      ∀ Z, GroupsContinuumLaw.IsLastDirectionTurn Z → (∀ W, GroupsContinuumLaw.IsLastDirectionTurn W → Z * W = W * Z) →
        ∃ a : ℝ, Z = (a : ℂ) • GroupsContinuumLaw.Qc) ∧
    Function.Surjective GroupsContinuumLaw.symHom ∧
    (∀ x, GroupsContinuumLaw.symHom x = 1 ↔ ∃ ζ : rootsOfUnity 6 ℂ, x = GroupsContinuumLaw.kerElt ζ) ∧
    Nat.card (rootsOfUnity 6 ℂ) = 6 ∧ IsCyclic (rootsOfUnity 6 ℂ) ∧
    (∑ S ∈ GroupsContinuumLaw.relSets, GroupsContinuumLaw.chargeZ GroupsContinuumLaw.y6 S = 0 ∧
      ∑ S ∈ GroupsContinuumLaw.relSets, GroupsContinuumLaw.chargeZ GroupsContinuumLaw.y6 S ^ 3 = 0)) ∧
    (∀ h k : Fin 5, h ≠ k →
      crP h * anP h + crP k * anP k =
        (1 / 2 : ℂ) • (1 - (γ h ⊗ₖ γ h) ⊗ₖ σ₃) + (1 / 2 : ℂ) • (1 - (γ k ⊗ₖ γ k) ⊗ₖ σ₃) ∧
      lastDirectionAtP h = kronVec (ell h) (Pi.single 0 1) ∧
      Module.finrank ℝ (keepPlaneP' h k) = 12 ∧ Module.finrank ℝ (keepLastDirectionP' h k) = 9)
theorems.description:
Proposition 46, the chain of the rotations of the pair (`PairWhole.lean`: `prop_46`, with the centres). The ten lines of a pair on `H ⊗ H ⊗ ℂ²`,
`Γ_a = γ_a ⊗ 1 ⊗ σ_x`, `Γ_{5+a} = 1 ⊗ γ_a ⊗ σ_y`, anticommute, `Γ_xΓ_y + Γ_yΓ_x = 2δ_xy`; their rotations `½Γ_xΓ_y` span
`so(10)`, dimension 45; `−i Σ_t Γ_tΓ_{5+t} = (L − 1) ⊗ σ_z`, `L − 1` on the two-spinor states (`σ_z = +1`), and
`e^{−iπL/4} = −iP` on each two-spinor state; the rotations keeping the comparison are `u(5)`, 25 (keeping `L ⊗ 1` likewise), with
centre the complex structure `ρ(J) = ½ i(L − 1) ⊗ σ_z`; keeping also the singlet `Ω ⊗ e₊`: `su(5)`, 24; keeping also the
plane count `N_F = Σ_{t ∈ F} (1 − (γ_t ⊗ γ_t) ⊗ σ_z)/2`: `s(u(3) ⊕ u(2))`, 12; keeping also the last-step direction's two-spinor state
`ℓ_h ⊗ e₊`: `su(3) ⊕ u(1)`, 9 — at every plane `F = {h, k}` with the last-step direction `h`; the centres, as `5 × 5` rotations of
`ℂ⁵ = C ⊕ F`, are `ℝ·iY` and `ℝ·iQ`; `(A, B, z) ↦ (z²A, z̄³B)` maps `SU(3) × SU(2) × U(1)` onto `S(U(3) × U(2))` with
kernel the six images of the sixth roots of unity, cyclic of order six; and `Tr Y = Tr Y³ = 0` on the sixteen.

Recognition: the gauge group of the standard model, `S(U(2) × U(3)) = (SU(3) × SU(2) × U(1))/ℤ₆`, twelve
generators, held by `SU(5)`. Uses Props. 4, 10, 11, 21, 45.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Existence.tenLine_products
theorems.statement:
theorem tenLine_products (a b : Fin 5) :
    tenLine (Sum.inl a) * tenLine (Sum.inl b) =
      ((γ a * γ b) ⊗ₖ (1 : Matrix Four Four ℂ)) ⊗ₖ (1 : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) ∧
    tenLine (Sum.inr a) * tenLine (Sum.inr b) =
      ((1 : Matrix Four Four ℂ) ⊗ₖ (γ a * γ b)) ⊗ₖ (1 : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) ∧
    tenLine (Sum.inl a) * tenLine (Sum.inr b) = (γ a ⊗ₖ γ b) ⊗ₖ (I • σ₃)
theorems.description:
**The products of the ten lines:** `Γ_aΓ_b = γ_aγ_b ⊗ 1 ⊗ 1`, `Γ_{5+a}Γ_{5+b} = 1 ⊗ γ_aγ_b ⊗ 1`,
`Γ_aΓ_{5+b} = γ_a ⊗ γ_b ⊗ iσ_z`.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Existence.tenLine_on_relations
theorems.statement:
theorem tenLine_on_relations (a b : Fin 5) (r : Two → ℂ) :
    (tenLine (Sum.inl a) * tenLine (Sum.inl b)) *ᵥ kronVec r (Pi.single 0 1) =
      kronVec (((γ a * γ b) ⊗ₖ (1 : Matrix Four Four ℂ)) *ᵥ r) (Pi.single 0 1) ∧
    (tenLine (Sum.inr a) * tenLine (Sum.inr b)) *ᵥ kronVec r (Pi.single 0 1) =
      kronVec (((1 : Matrix Four Four ℂ) ⊗ₖ (γ a * γ b)) *ᵥ r) (Pi.single 0 1) ∧
    (tenLine (Sum.inl a) * tenLine (Sum.inr b)) *ᵥ kronVec r (Pi.single 0 1) =
      kronVec ((I • (γ a ⊗ₖ γ b)) *ᵥ r) (Pi.single 0 1)
theorems.description:
**The rotations `½Γ_xΓ_y` on the two-spinor states** (`σ_z = +1`): `Γ_aΓ_b`, `Γ_{5+a}Γ_{5+b}` and `Γ_aΓ_{5+b}` act on
`r ⊗ e₊` as `γ_aγ_b ⊗ 1`, `1 ⊗ γ_aγ_b` and `iγ_a ⊗ γ_b` act on `r`.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Existence.tA_antiHerm
theorems.statement: theorem tA_antiHerm (s t : Fin 5) (hst : s ≠ t) : (GroupsContinuumLaw.tA s t)ᴴ = -GroupsContinuumLaw.tA s t

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Existence.tB_antiHerm
theorems.statement: theorem tB_antiHerm (s t : Fin 5) (hst : s ≠ t) : (GroupsContinuumLaw.tB s t)ᴴ = -GroupsContinuumLaw.tB s t

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Existence.u5_centre
theorems.statement:
theorem u5_centre (Z : Matrix (Fin 5) (Fin 5) ℂ) (hZ : Zᴴ = -Z)
    (hc : ∀ W : Matrix (Fin 5) (Fin 5) ℂ, Wᴴ = -W → Z * W = W * Z) :
    ∃ a : ℝ, Z = (a : ℂ) • (I • (1 : Matrix (Fin 5) (Fin 5) ℂ))
theorems.description:
**The centre of `u(5)` is `ℝ·i`:** an anti-Hermitian `5 × 5` matrix that commutes with every anti-Hermitian one
is `a·i` for a real `a`.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Existence.skA_diagonal
theorems.statement: theorem skA_diagonal (d : Fin 5 → ℝ) : SysExt.skA (Matrix.diagonal d) = 0

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Existence.syB_diagonal
theorems.statement: theorem syB_diagonal (d : Fin 5 → ℝ) : SysExt.syB (Matrix.diagonal d) = Matrix.diagonal d

theorems.statement:
theorem uFive_diagonal (d : Fin 5 → ℝ) :
    SysExt.uFive (Matrix.diagonal d) = Matrix.fromBlocks 0 (-Matrix.diagonal d) (Matrix.diagonal d) 0
theorems.description: The rotation of a diagonal `5 × 5` matrix: `uFive (diag d) = [[0, −diag d], [diag d, 0]]`.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Existence.uFive_one
theorems.statement: theorem uFive_one : SysExt.uFive 1 = -SysExt.cxJ

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Existence.turn_comm_iff
theorems.statement:
theorem turn_comm_iff {A : Type*} [Ring A] [Algebra ℝ A] [Nontrivial A] (Γ : SysExt.Ten → A)
    (hΓ : SysExt.IsTen Γ) (M N : Matrix SysExt.Ten SysExt.Ten ℝ) (hM : Mᵀ = -M) (hN : Nᵀ = -N) :
    SysExt.turnOf Γ M * SysExt.turnOf Γ N = SysExt.turnOf Γ N * SysExt.turnOf Γ M ↔ M * N = N * M
theorems.description: **Two rotations commute exactly when their skew matrices do.**

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Existence.pair_L_centre
theorems.statement:
theorem pair_L_centre (X : PairM) (hX : X ∈ keepLP) :
    (∀ Y ∈ keepLP, X * Y = Y * X) ↔ ∃ a : ℝ, X = a • (I • ((L - 1) ⊗ₖ σ₃))
theorems.description:
**The centre of the pair's `u(5)` is `ℝ·i(L − 1) ⊗ σ_z`**, the rotation `ρ(J)` of the complex structure: a rotation
keeping the comparison commutes with all of them exactly when it is a real multiple of `i(L − 1) ⊗ σ_z`.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Existence.central_transfer
theorems.statement:
theorem central_transfer (KP : Submodule ℝ PairM) (KF : Submodule ℝ SysExt.FockE)
    (hP : KP ≤ SysExt.turnsTen tenLine) (hF : KF ≤ SysExt.turnsTen SysExt.fockLine)
    (h : ∀ M : Matrix SysExt.Ten SysExt.Ten ℝ, Mᵀ = -M →
      (SysExt.turnOf tenLine M ∈ KP ↔ SysExt.turnOf SysExt.fockLine M ∈ KF))
    (M : Matrix SysExt.Ten SysExt.Ten ℝ) (hM : Mᵀ = -M) :
    (∀ Y ∈ KP, SysExt.turnOf tenLine M * Y = Y * SysExt.turnOf tenLine M) ↔
      ∀ Y ∈ KF, SysExt.turnOf SysExt.fockLine M * Y = Y * SysExt.turnOf SysExt.fockLine M
theorems.description:
**Centrality is read on the skew matrices:** two subspaces of rotations with the same skew matrices have the same
centre.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Existence.conjE_mul
theorems.statement:
theorem conjE_mul (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin 5)) (X Y : SysExt.FockE) :
    conjE π (X * Y) = conjE π X * conjE π Y
theorems.description: The relabelling is an automorphism: `Λ(P_π)(XY)Λ(P_π)⁻¹ = (Λ(P_π)XΛ(P_π)⁻¹)(Λ(P_π)YΛ(P_π)⁻¹)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Existence.carry_general
theorems.statement:
theorem carry_general (KP : Fin 5 → Fin 5 → Submodule ℝ PairM) (KF : Fin 5 → Fin 5 → Submodule ℝ SysExt.FockE)
    (hP : ∀ a b, KP a b ≤ SysExt.turnsTen tenLine) (hF : ∀ a b, KF a b ≤ SysExt.turnsTen SysExt.fockLine)
    (htr : ∀ (a b : Fin 5) (M : Matrix SysExt.Ten SysExt.Ten ℝ), Mᵀ = -M →
      (SysExt.turnOf tenLine M ∈ KP a b ↔ SysExt.turnOf SysExt.fockLine M ∈ KF a b))
    (hmap : ∀ (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin 5)) (a b : Fin 5), KF (π a) (π b) = (KF a b).map (conjE π).toLinearMap)
    (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin 5)) (a b : Fin 5) (M : Matrix SysExt.Ten SysExt.Ten ℝ) (hM : Mᵀ = -M) :
    (SysExt.turnOf tenLine M ∈ KP (π a) (π b) ↔
        SysExt.turnOf tenLine (M.submatrix (tenPerm π) (tenPerm π)) ∈ KP a b) ∧
    ((∀ Y ∈ KP (π a) (π b), SysExt.turnOf tenLine M * Y = Y * SysExt.turnOf tenLine M) ↔
      ∀ Y ∈ KP a b, SysExt.turnOf tenLine (M.submatrix (tenPerm π) (tenPerm π)) * Y =
        Y * SysExt.turnOf tenLine (M.submatrix (tenPerm π) (tenPerm π)))
theorems.description:
**A relabelling carries what is kept at `{a, b}`, and its centre, to `{πa, πb}`:** for families of kept rotations
of the pair and of `Λℂ⁵` with the same skew matrices, the second carried by the relabellings, a rotation `ρ(M)` is kept at
`{πa, πb}` exactly when `ρ(P_π⁻¹MP_π)` is kept at `{a, b}`, and is central there exactly when `ρ(P_π⁻¹MP_π)` is
central at `{a, b}`.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Existence.uFive_diagonal_perm
theorems.statement:
theorem uFive_diagonal_perm (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin 5)) (d : Fin 5 → ℝ) :

      SysExt.uFive (Matrix.diagonal (d ∘ π.symm))
theorems.description: `P_π` carries the rotation of `diag(d)` to the rotation of `diag(d ∘ π⁻¹)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Existence.yAt_perm

theorem yAt_perm (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin 5)) {h k : Fin 5} (e3 : π 3 = h) (e4 : π 4 = k) :

theorems.statement:

    (e : SysExt.turnOf tenLine N = SysExt.turnOf tenLine N') : N = N'

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Existence.centre_finish
theorems.statement:
theorem centre_finish (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin 5)) (M : Matrix SysExt.Ten SysExt.Ten ℝ) (hM : Mᵀ = -M)
    (R₀ : Matrix (Fin 5) (Fin 5) ℝ) (d : Fin 5 → ℝ)
    (hd : SysExt.uFive (Matrix.diagonal d) = (SysExt.uFive R₀).submatrix (tenPerm π).symm (tenPerm π).symm) :
    (∃ a : ℝ, SysExt.turnOf tenLine (M.submatrix (tenPerm π) (tenPerm π)) =
        a • SysExt.turnOf tenLine (SysExt.uFive R₀)) ↔
      ∃ a : ℝ, SysExt.turnOf tenLine M = a • SysExt.turnOf tenLine (SysExt.uFive (Matrix.diagonal d))
theorems.description: The last step: the centre at `{3, 4}` read at `{πa, πb}`.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Existence.pair_plane_centre_every
theorems.statement:
theorem pair_plane_centre_every (h k : Fin 5) (hk : h ≠ k) (X : PairM) (hX : X ∈ keepPlaneP' h k) :
    (∀ Y ∈ keepPlaneP' h k, X * Y = Y * X) ↔
      ∃ a : ℝ, X = a • SysExt.turnOf tenLine (SysExt.uFive (Matrix.diagonal (yAt h k)))
theorems.description:
**At every plane `{h, k}` the centre of the pair's `s(u(3) ⊕ u(2))` is `ℝ·ρ(iY)`,** `Y = ½` on the plane and
`−⅓` on the three lines outside it.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Existence.pair_lastDirection_centre_every
theorems.statement:
theorem pair_lastDirection_centre_every (h k : Fin 5) (hk : h ≠ k) (X : PairM) (hX : X ∈ keepLastDirectionP' h k) :
    (∀ Y ∈ keepLastDirectionP' h k, X * Y = Y * X) ↔
      ∃ a : ℝ, X = a • SysExt.turnOf tenLine (SysExt.uFive (Matrix.diagonal (qAt h k)))
theorems.description:
**At every plane `{h, k}` with the last-step direction `h`, the centre of the pair's `su(3) ⊕ u(1)` is `ℝ·ρ(iQ)`,** `Q = 0` on
the last-step direction, `1` on `k` and `−⅓` on the three lines outside.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Existence.prop_46
theorems.statement:
theorem prop_46 :
    ((∀ x y : SysExt.Ten, tenLine x * tenLine y + tenLine y * tenLine x = if x = y then (2 : ℂ) • 1 else 0) ∧
    Module.finrank ℝ (SysExt.turnsTen tenLine) = 45 ∧
    (-I) • ∑ t, tenLine (Sum.inl t) * tenLine (Sum.inr t) = (L - 1) ⊗ₖ σ₃ ∧
    (∀ k : Fin 16, Complex.exp (-(Real.pi / 4 : ℂ) * (Lvalue k : ℂ) * I) • rel k = (-I) • (swap *ᵥ rel k)) ∧
    Module.finrank ℝ keepLP = 25 ∧
    Module.finrank ℝ (SysExt.turnsTen tenLine ⊓ SysExt.commWith (L ⊗ₖ (1 : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ)) :
      Submodule ℝ _) = 25 ∧
    SysExt.turnOf tenLine SysExt.cxJ = (1 / 2 : ℝ) • (I • ((L - 1) ⊗ₖ σ₃)) ∧
    vacP = kronVec Ω (Pi.single 0 1) ∧ Module.finrank ℝ keepVacP = 24 ∧
    planeNP = (1 / 2 : ℂ) • (1 - (γ 3 ⊗ₖ γ 3) ⊗ₖ σ₃) + (1 / 2 : ℂ) • (1 - (γ 4 ⊗ₖ γ 4) ⊗ₖ σ₃) ∧
    Module.finrank ℝ keepPlaneP = 12 ∧
    lastDirectionP = kronVec (ell 3) (Pi.single 0 1) ∧ Module.finrank ℝ keepLastDirectionP = 9 ∧
    (GroupsContinuumLaw.IsPlaneTurn GroupsContinuumLaw.Yc ∧ (∀ W, GroupsContinuumLaw.IsPlaneTurn W → GroupsContinuumLaw.Yc * W = W * GroupsContinuumLaw.Yc) ∧
      ∀ Z, GroupsContinuumLaw.IsPlaneTurn Z → (∀ W, GroupsContinuumLaw.IsPlaneTurn W → Z * W = W * Z) →
        ∃ a : ℝ, Z = (a : ℂ) • GroupsContinuumLaw.Yc) ∧
    (GroupsContinuumLaw.IsLastDirectionTurn GroupsContinuumLaw.Qc ∧ (∀ W, GroupsContinuumLaw.IsLastDirectionTurn W → GroupsContinuumLaw.Qc * W = W * GroupsContinuumLaw.Qc) ∧
      ∀ Z, GroupsContinuumLaw.IsLastDirectionTurn Z → (∀ W, GroupsContinuumLaw.IsLastDirectionTurn W → Z * W = W * Z) →
        ∃ a : ℝ, Z = (a : ℂ) • GroupsContinuumLaw.Qc) ∧
    Function.Surjective GroupsContinuumLaw.symHom ∧
    (∀ x, GroupsContinuumLaw.symHom x = 1 ↔ ∃ ζ : rootsOfUnity 6 ℂ, x = GroupsContinuumLaw.kerElt ζ) ∧
    Nat.card (rootsOfUnity 6 ℂ) = 6 ∧ IsCyclic (rootsOfUnity 6 ℂ) ∧
    (∑ S ∈ GroupsContinuumLaw.relSets, GroupsContinuumLaw.chargeZ GroupsContinuumLaw.y6 S = 0 ∧
      ∑ S ∈ GroupsContinuumLaw.relSets, GroupsContinuumLaw.chargeZ GroupsContinuumLaw.y6 S ^ 3 = 0)) ∧
    (∀ h k : Fin 5, h ≠ k →
      crP h * anP h + crP k * anP k =
        (1 / 2 : ℂ) • (1 - (γ h ⊗ₖ γ h) ⊗ₖ σ₃) + (1 / 2 : ℂ) • (1 - (γ k ⊗ₖ γ k) ⊗ₖ σ₃) ∧
      lastDirectionAtP h = kronVec (ell h) (Pi.single 0 1) ∧
      Module.finrank ℝ (keepPlaneP' h k) = 12 ∧ Module.finrank ℝ (keepLastDirectionP' h k) = 9) ∧
    (∀ (a b : Fin 5) (r : Two → ℂ),
      (tenLine (Sum.inl a) * tenLine (Sum.inl b)) *ᵥ kronVec r (Pi.single 0 1) =
        kronVec (((γ a * γ b) ⊗ₖ (1 : Matrix Four Four ℂ)) *ᵥ r) (Pi.single 0 1) ∧
      (tenLine (Sum.inr a) * tenLine (Sum.inr b)) *ᵥ kronVec r (Pi.single 0 1) =
        kronVec (((1 : Matrix Four Four ℂ) ⊗ₖ (γ a * γ b)) *ᵥ r) (Pi.single 0 1) ∧
      (tenLine (Sum.inl a) * tenLine (Sum.inr b)) *ᵥ kronVec r (Pi.single 0 1) =
        kronVec ((I • (γ a ⊗ₖ γ b)) *ᵥ r) (Pi.single 0 1)) ∧
    (∀ X ∈ keepLP, (∀ Y ∈ keepLP, X * Y = Y * X) ↔ ∃ a : ℝ, X = a • (I • ((L - 1) ⊗ₖ σ₃))) ∧
    (∀ h k : Fin 5, h ≠ k → ∀ X ∈ keepPlaneP' h k, (∀ Y ∈ keepPlaneP' h k, X * Y = Y * X) ↔
      ∃ a : ℝ, X = a • SysExt.turnOf tenLine (SysExt.uFive (Matrix.diagonal (yAt h k)))) ∧
    (∀ h k : Fin 5, h ≠ k → ∀ X ∈ keepLastDirectionP' h k, (∀ Y ∈ keepLastDirectionP' h k, X * Y = Y * X) ↔
      ∃ a : ℝ, X = a • SysExt.turnOf tenLine (SysExt.uFive (Matrix.diagonal (qAt h k)))) ∧
    Nonempty (((GroupsContinuumLaw.SU3 × GroupsContinuumLaw.SU2 × GroupsContinuumLaw.U1) ⧸ GroupsContinuumLaw.symHom.ker) ≃* GroupsContinuumLaw.SU32) ∧
    (∀ h k : Fin 5, h ≠ k → ∑ r, hyper h k r = 0 ∧ ∑ r, hyper h k r ^ 3 = 0 ∧
      ∑ r ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun r => nOut h k r = 1 ∨ nOut h k r = 2), hyper h k r = 0 ∧
      ∑ r ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun r => nPlane h k r = 1), hyper h k r = 0)
theorems.description:
**Proposition 46 (the rotations of a pair, and what each keeps).** The ten lines of a pair on `H ⊗ H ⊗ ℂ²`,
`Γ_a = γ_a ⊗ 1 ⊗ σ_x`, `Γ_{5+a} = 1 ⊗ γ_a ⊗ σ_y`, anticommute, `Γ_xΓ_y + Γ_yΓ_x = 2δ_xy`; the two-spinor states are
`σ_z = +1`, on which the rotations `½Γ_xΓ_y` act as `γ_aγ_b ⊗ 1`, `1 ⊗ γ_aγ_b` and `iγ_a ⊗ γ_b` (times `½`); they span
`so(10)`, dimension 45; `−i Σ_t Γ_tΓ_{5+t} = (L − 1) ⊗ σ_z` and `e^{−iπL/4} = −iP` on each two-spinor state; the rotations keeping
the comparison are `u(5)`, 25 (keeping `L ⊗ 1` likewise), with centre `ℝ·i(L − 1) ⊗ σ_z`, the rotation
`ρ(J) = ½ i(L − 1) ⊗ σ_z` of the complex structure; keeping also the singlet `Ω ⊗ e₊`: `su(5)`, 24; keeping also the plane
count `N_F = Σ_{t ∈ F}(1 − (γ_t ⊗ γ_t) ⊗ σ_z)/2`: `s(u(3) ⊕ u(2))`, 12, with centre `ℝ·ρ(iY)`; keeping also the last-step direction's
two-spinor state `ℓ_h ⊗ e₊`: `su(3) ⊕ u(1)`, 9, with centre `ℝ·ρ(iQ)` — at every plane `F = {h, k}` with the last-step direction `h`
(`Y = ½` on `F`, `−⅓` on `C`; `Q = 0` on `h`, `1` on `k`, `−⅓` on `C`); `(A, B, z) ↦ (z²A, z̄³B)` maps
`SU(3) × SU(2) × U(1)` onto `S(U(3) × U(2))`, with kernel the six images of the sixth roots of unity, cyclic, and
`(SU(3) × SU(2) × U(1))/ℤ₆ ≃ S(U(3) × U(2))`; and on the sixteen, at every plane, `Tr Y = Tr Y³ = 0` and the colour
and the doublet sums of `Y` vanish (`Tr YT_c² = Tr YT₃² = 0`).

Recognition: the gauge group of the standard model, `S(U(2) × U(3)) = (SU(3) × SU(2) × U(1))/ℤ₆`, twelve
generators, held by `SU(5)`; `Y` the hypercharge, `Q` the electric charge. Uses Props. 4, 10, 11, 21, 45.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Existence.prop_32
theorems.statement:
theorem prop_32 {X G : Type*} [Group G] :
    (∀ (c : Connection X G) (g : X → G) (x y : X), (c.rename g).U x y = g x * c.U x y * (g y)⁻¹) ∧
    (∀ (c : Connection X G) (g : X → G) (x : X) (rest : List X),
      (x :: rest).getLast (List.cons_ne_nil x rest) = x →
      hol (c.rename g) (x :: rest) = g x * hol c (x :: rest) * (g x)⁻¹) ∧
    (∀ (c : Connection X G) (x : X) (rest : List X),
      (x :: rest).getLast (List.cons_ne_nil x rest) ≠ x →
      ∀ V : G, ∃ g : X → G, hol (c.rename g) (x :: rest) = V) ∧
    (∀ {α : Type*} (φ : G → α) (x : X) (rest : List X),
      (x :: rest).getLast (List.cons_ne_nil x rest) ≠ x →
      IsFact (fun c : Connection X G => φ (hol c (x :: rest))) → ∀ V W : G, φ V = φ W)
theorems.description:
**Proposition 32 (closed facts).** A gauge transformation takes `U_xy ↦ g_xU_xyg_y⁻¹`; the holonomy of a closed walk
at `x₀` turns by the gauge at its own vertex, `hol ↦ g_{x₀} hol g_{x₀}⁻¹`, so its trace is a fact; the transport of an
open walk from `x` to `y ≠ x` can be gauge-transformed into every rotation, and only the constants are facts of it.

Recognition: Einstein's point coincidences and the gauge principle, with Wilson's closed loops. Uses P4,
Definition 24.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Existence.prop_32_trace
theorems.statement:
theorem prop_32_trace {X : Type*} {n R : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] [CommRing R] (x : X)
    (rest : List X) (hclosed : (x :: rest).getLast (List.cons_ne_nil x rest) = x) :
    IsFact (fun c : Connection X (Matrix n n R)ˣ =>
      ((hol c (x :: rest) : (Matrix n n R)ˣ) : Matrix n n R).trace)
theorems.description: The trace of the holonomy of a closed walk, for every group of invertible matrices: a fact (P4).

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Existence.prop_33
theorems.statement:
theorem prop_33 {n : ℕ} {R : Type*} [CommRing R] :
    (∀ v w : Fin n → R, SysExt.ιv v * SysExt.εv w + SysExt.εv w * SysExt.ιv v =
      (v ⬝ᵥ w) • (1 : Module.End R (Finset (Fin n) → R))) ∧
    (∀ v w : Fin n → R, SysExt.εv v * SysExt.εv w + SysExt.εv w * SysExt.εv v = 0) ∧
    (∀ v w : Fin n → R, SysExt.ιv v * SysExt.ιv w + SysExt.ιv w * SysExt.ιv v = 0) ∧
    (∀ v w : Fin n → R, SysExt.Jv v * SysExt.Jv w + SysExt.Jv w * SysExt.Jv v =
      (2 * (v ⬝ᵥ w)) • (1 : Module.End R (Finset (Fin n) → R))) ∧
    (∀ v : Fin n → R, SysExt.Jv v * SysExt.Jv v = (v ⬝ᵥ v) • (1 : Module.End R (Finset (Fin n) → R))) ∧
    (∀ (a : Fin n) (S : Finset (Fin n)), SysExt.Jx (R := R) a (Pi.single S (1 : R)) =
      SysExt.extSign (R := R) a (S.erase a) • (Pi.single (symmDiff S {a}) (1 : R) : Finset (Fin n) → R)) ∧
    (∀ S : Finset (Fin n), SysExt.ordProd (SysExt.Jx (R := R)) S (Pi.single ∅ 1) = Pi.single S 1) ∧
    (∀ (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) R), Oᵀ * O = 1 →
      SysExt.extMap O * SysExt.extMap Oᵀ = 1 ∧ SysExt.extMap Oᵀ * SysExt.extMap O = 1 ∧
      ∀ v : Fin n → R, SysExt.extMap O * SysExt.Jv v * SysExt.extMap Oᵀ = SysExt.Jv (O *ᵥ v)) ∧
    (∀ a : Fin 6, Article.whole (A := Module.End ℂ (Finset (Fin 6) → ℂ)) (fun a => SysExt.εx a)
        (fun a => SysExt.ιx a) * SysExt.εx a =
      -(SysExt.ιx a * Article.whole (A := Module.End ℂ (Finset (Fin 6) → ℂ)) (fun a => SysExt.εx a)
        (fun a => SysExt.ιx a)))
theorems.description:
**Proposition 33 (the vertical step).** On the exterior algebra of `n` directions (the sixty-four sets at `n = 6`):
`ι(v)ε(w) + ε(w)ι(v) = ⟨v, w⟩`, `ε(v)ε(w) + ε(w)ε(v) = 0 = ι(v)ι(w) + ι(w)ι(v)`; `J(v) = ε(v) + ι(v)` has
`J(v)J(w) + J(w)J(v) = 2⟨v, w⟩` and `J(v)² = |v|²`; `J_a f_S = (−1)^{#\{s ∈ S : s < a\}} f_{S △ \{a\}}`;
`J_{s₁} ⋯ J_{s_r} f_∅ = f_{\{s₁,…,s_r\}}` (`s₁ < ⋯ < s_r`); `Λ(O) J(v) Λ(O)⁻¹ = J(Ov)` for every rotation `O`
(`Λ(O)⁻¹ = Λ(Oᵀ)`); and the step of the proof: the whole `w = J₀⋯J₅` turns adding into removing,
`w ε_a = −ι_a w`.

Recognition: dividing a direction and undividing it are one operation. Uses Definitions 13, 26, P3 (b).

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Existence.whole_eq_volume
theorems.statement:
theorem whole_eq_volume :
    Article.whole (A := Module.End ℂ (Finset (Fin 6) → ℂ)) (fun a => SysExt.εx a) (fun a => SysExt.ιx a) =
      SysExt.Jx 0 * SysExt.Jx 1 * SysExt.Jx 2 * SysExt.Jx 3 * SysExt.Jx 4 * SysExt.Jx 5
theorems.description: The whole of the article's theorem is the product of the six vertical steps.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Existence.exp_smul_of_sq_neg

    NormedSpace.exp (θ • X) = Real.cos θ • (1 : 𝔸) + Real.sin θ • X
theorems.description: **In a complete normed real algebra, `X² = −1` gives `e^{θX} = cos θ + sin θ X`.**

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Existence.prop_34
theorems.statement:
theorem prop_34 {n : ℕ} :
    (∀ a b : Fin n, a ≠ b → SysExt.Jx (R := ℝ) a * SysExt.Jx b * SysExt.Jx a * SysExt.Jx b = -1) ∧
    (∀ a b : Fin n, a ≠ b →
      SysExt.Jx (R := ℝ) a (SysExt.Jx b (SysExt.Jx a (SysExt.Jx b (Pi.single (∅ : Finset (Fin n)) 1)))) =
        -Pi.single (∅ : Finset (Fin n)) (1 : ℝ)) ∧
    (∀ a b : Fin n, a ≠ b → ∀ θ : ℝ,
      NormedSpace.exp ((θ / 2) • LinearMap.toMatrixAlgEquiv' (SysExt.Jx (R := ℝ) a * SysExt.Jx b)) =
        LinearMap.toMatrixAlgEquiv' (SysExt.rotor a b θ) ∧
      SysExt.rotor a b θ = Real.cos (θ / 2) • 1 + Real.sin (θ / 2) • (SysExt.Jx a * SysExt.Jx b)) ∧
    (∀ a b : Fin n, a ≠ b → ∀ θ : ℝ, SysExt.rotor a b θ * SysExt.rotor a b (-θ) = 1 ∧
      ∀ v : Fin n → ℝ, SysExt.rotor a b θ * SysExt.Jv v * SysExt.rotor a b (-θ) =
        SysExt.Jv (SysExt.planeRot a b θ *ᵥ v)) ∧
    (∀ a b : Fin n, SysExt.rotor a b (2 * Real.pi) = -1 ∧ SysExt.planeRot a b (2 * Real.pi) = 1) ∧
    (∀ (D : Finset (Fin 6)) (x y : Fin 6),
      SysExt.halfStep D x * SysExt.halfStep D y + SysExt.halfStep D y * SysExt.halfStep D x =
        if x = y then (2 * thetaAt D x) • 1 else 0) ∧
    (∀ (D : Finset (Fin 6)) (x y : Fin 6), x ≠ y →
      (SysExt.halfStep D x * SysExt.halfStep D y) * (SysExt.halfStep D x * SysExt.halfStep D y) =
        (-(thetaAt D x * thetaAt D y)) • 1) ∧
    (∀ D : Finset (Fin 6),
      (Finset.univ.filter fun p : Fin 6 × Fin 6 => p.1 < p.2 ∧ (p.1 ∈ D ↔ p.2 ∈ D)).card =
        D.card.choose 2 + (6 - D.card).choose 2 ∧
      (Finset.univ.filter fun p : Fin 6 × Fin 6 => p.1 < p.2 ∧ ¬(p.1 ∈ D ↔ p.2 ∈ D)).card =
        D.card * (6 - D.card))
theorems.description:
**Proposition 34 (spin one half).** `J_aJ_bJ_aJ_b = −1` (`a ≠ b`): the loop `f_∅ → f_b → f_{ab} → f_a → f_∅`
comes back with `−1`; `R_ab(ϑ) = e^{ϑJ_aJ_b/2} = cos(ϑ/2) + J_aJ_b sin(ϑ/2)`, `R_ab(ϑ) J(v) R_ab(ϑ)⁻¹ = J(O_ϑ v)`
for every `v` (`O_ϑ` the rotation of the plane `(a, b)` by `ϑ`), and `R_ab(2π) = −1` while `O_{2π} = 1`; with the square
root of the sign of a division `D`, `f_x = i^{[x ∈ D]} J_x` has `f_xf_y + f_yf_x = 2θ_D(x)δ_xy` and
`(f_xf_y)² = −θ_D(x)θ_D(y)` (`x ≠ y`): `−1` on the `C(k,2) + C(6−k,2)` planes within a side and `+1` on the
`k(6−k)` planes across (`k = |D|`).

Recognition: spin one half, four quarter turns around a plane come back with `−1`; a loop across the division is a
boost and never closes. Uses Props. 21, 33, Definition 14.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Existence.prop_35
theorems.statement:
theorem prop_35 :
    SysExt.volume (R := ℂ) * SysExt.volume = -1 ∧
    (∀ D : Finset (Fin 6), (List.ofFn (SysExt.halfStep D)).prod = Complex.I ^ D.card • SysExt.volume) ∧
    (∀ D : Finset (Fin 6), SysExt.extMap (half D) (Pi.single Finset.univ 1) =
        (half D).det • Pi.single Finset.univ 1 ∧ (half D).det = Complex.I ^ D.card) ∧
    (∀ S : Finset (Fin 6), SysExt.extMap (Complex.I • (1 : Matrix (Fin 6) (Fin 6) ℂ)) (Pi.single S 1) =
      Complex.I ^ S.card • Pi.single S 1 ∧ zS S = Complex.I ^ S.card) ∧
    (∀ S : Finset (Fin 6), zS S ^ 2 = (theta ℂ S).det ∧ (theta ℂ S).det = (-1) ^ S.card) ∧
    (∀ h k : Fin 5, h ≠ k → zS ∅ = 1 ∧ zS {0} = Complex.I ∧ zS {0, h.succ} = -1 ∧
      zS {h.succ} = Complex.I ∧ zS {h.succ, k.succ} = -1 ∧
      zS ((({h, k} : Finset (Fin 5))ᶜ).map (Fin.succEmb 5)) = -Complex.I) ∧
    (∀ S : Finset (Fin 6), zS (symmDiff S {0}) = Complex.I * zS S ∨
      zS (symmDiff S {0}) = -Complex.I * zS S)
theorems.description:
**Proposition 35 (the phase of the whole).** `w = J₀J₁⋯J₅` has `w² = −1`; with the square root of the sign of `D`,
`f₀f₁⋯f₅ = i^{|D|} w`; `Λ(q_D) f_{\{0,…,5\}} = det(q_D) f_{\{0,…,5\}} = i^{|D|} f_{\{0,…,5\}}`;
`Λ(iI) f_S = i^{|S|} f_S`, `z_S = i^{|S|}`; `z_S² = det θ_S = (−1)^{|S|}`; `z_S = 1, i, −1, i, −1, −i` on the six
divided sets `{}, {n}, {h,n}, {h}, F, C` of a line; and `z_{S △ \{n\}} = ±i z_S`.

Recognition: the four phases `1, i, −1, −i`; counterparts differ by a quarter turn. Uses Props. 19, 27, 33, 34.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Existence.prop_36
theorems.statement:
theorem prop_36 {n : ℕ} {R : Type*} [CommRing R] :
    (∀ a b : Fin n, a ≠ b → SysExt.Tx (R := R) a b =
      ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), SysExt.degreeProj k * (SysExt.Jx a * SysExt.Jx b) * SysExt.degreeProj k) ∧
    (∀ a b : Fin n, SysExt.Nx * SysExt.Tx (R := R) a b = SysExt.Tx a b * SysExt.Nx) ∧
    (∀ a b c : Fin n, a ≠ b → b ≠ c → a ≠ c →
      SysExt.Tx (R := R) a b * SysExt.Tx b c - SysExt.Tx b c * SysExt.Tx a b = SysExt.Tx a c) ∧
    (∀ a b c d : Fin n, a ≠ c → a ≠ d → b ≠ c → b ≠ d →
      SysExt.Tx (R := R) a b * SysExt.Tx c d = SysExt.Tx c d * SysExt.Tx a b) ∧
    (∀ a b : Fin n, a ≠ b →
      SysExt.Jx (R := R) a * SysExt.Jx b = SysExt.Tx a b + SysExt.εx a * SysExt.εx b + SysExt.ιx a * SysExt.ιx b) ∧
    (∀ a b : Fin n, a ≠ b → ∀ θ : ℝ,
      NormedSpace.exp (θ • LinearMap.toMatrixAlgEquiv' (SysExt.Tx (R := ℝ) a b)) =
        LinearMap.toMatrixAlgEquiv' (SysExt.extMap (NormedSpace.exp (θ • unitTurn a b))))

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Existence.prop_37
theorems.statement:
theorem prop_37 {n : ℕ} {X : Type*} :
    (∀ (a : Fin n → ℝ) (U gx gy : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ), gxᵀ * gx = 1 →
      SysExt.extMap gx * SysExt.jointStep a U * SysExt.extMap gyᵀ =
        SysExt.jointStep (gx *ᵥ a) (gx * U * gyᵀ)) ∧
    (∀ (c : Connection X (SysExt.Rot n)) (g : X → SysExt.Rot n) (a : Fin n → ℝ) (x y : X),
      SysExt.extMap (g x : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) * SysExt.connStep c a x y *
          SysExt.extMap ((g y)⁻¹ : SysExt.Rot n) =
        SysExt.connStep (c.rename g) ((g x : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) *ᵥ a) x y) ∧
    (∀ (c : Connection X (SysExt.Rot n)) (a : Fin n → ℝ), a ⬝ᵥ a = 1 → ∀ x y : X,
      SysExt.connStep c a x y * SysExt.connStep c ((c.U y x : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) *ᵥ a) y x = 1 ∧
      SysExt.connStep c ((c.U y x : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) *ᵥ a) y x * SysExt.connStep c a x y = 1) ∧
    Function.Bijective SysExt.evenToFour ∧
    (∀ t : Fin 5, SysExt.evenToFour (SysExt.singletLine t) = (-Complex.I) • γ t) ∧
    (∀ s t : Fin 5, SysExt.evenToFour (SysExt.lineLine s t) = γ s * γ t) ∧
    SysExt.evenToFour wholeEven = (-Complex.I) • (1 : Matrix Four Four ℂ) ∧
    (wholeEven : CliffordAlgebra SysExt.Q6) =
      SysExt.cl 0 * SysExt.cl 1 * SysExt.cl 2 * SysExt.cl 3 * SysExt.cl 4 * SysExt.cl 5 ∧
    (∀ t : Fin 5, γ t = Complex.I • SysExt.evenToFour (SysExt.singletLine t)) ∧
    Function.Injective SysExt.stepRep ∧ (∀ a : Fin 6, SysExt.stepRep (SysExt.cl a) = SysExt.Jx a)
theorems.description:
**Proposition 37 (one step joins the two).** `𝒯 = J(a)Λ(U)` is gauge-transformed like one transport,
`Λ(g_x)𝒯_{xy}Λ(g_y)⁻¹ = J(g_xa)Λ(g_xU_{xy}g_y⁻¹)`, for every connection of P4 with values in the rotations of the six;
`𝒯_{xy}⁻¹ = J(U_{yx}a)Λ(U_{yx})` for a unit direction; on the four amplitudes the even words of the step are all the
operators (an isomorphism of real algebras from the even Clifford algebra of the six), with `J_nJ_t ↦ −iγ_t`,
`J_sJ_t ↦ γ_sγ_t`, `w ↦ −i`; so a step of one system along `t` is `γ_t = i J_nJ_t`, two vertical steps; the vertical
steps on the sixty-four sets are a faithful representation of the Clifford algebra of the six.

Recognition: the four amplitudes are the spinor of the six; the quantum `i` is the whole `w`. Uses Props. 4, 5, 33,
P4, Definitions 24, 26.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Existence.curv_rename
theorems.statement:
theorem curv_rename {n R : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] [CommRing R]
    (c : Connection (Fin 16) (Matrix n n R)ˣ) (g : Fin 16 → (Matrix n n R)ˣ) (x : Fin 16) (s t : Fin 5) :
    curv (c.rename g) x s t =
      (g x : Matrix n n R) * curv c x s t * ((g x)⁻¹ : (Matrix n n R)ˣ)

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Existence.prop_38
theorems.statement:
theorem prop_38 :
    (∀ {n R : Type} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] [CommRing R] (c : Connection (Fin 16) (Matrix n n R)ˣ)
      (g : Fin 16 → (Matrix n n R)ˣ) (x : Fin 16) (s t : Fin 5),
      curv (c.rename g) x s t = (g x : Matrix n n R) * curv c x s t * ((g x)⁻¹ : (Matrix n n R)ˣ)) ∧
    (∀ (x : Fin 16) (a b c d : Fin 5), a ≠ b → b ≠ c → c ≠ d → d ≠ a →
      transition d (transition c (transition b (transition a x))) = x → a = c ∧ b = d) ∧
    (∀ x : Fin 16, (Finset.image (fun p : Fin 5 × Fin 5 => square x p.1 p.2)
      (Finset.univ.filter fun p : Fin 5 × Fin 5 => p.1 < p.2)).card = 10) ∧
    (Finset.image (fun p : Fin 16 × Fin 5 × Fin 5 => square p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2)
      (Finset.univ.filter fun p : Fin 16 × Fin 5 × Fin 5 => p.2.1 < p.2.2)).card = 40 ∧
    (∀ {A : Type} [NormedRing A] [NormedAlgebra ℝ A] [CompleteSpace A] (a₁ a₂ a₃ a₄ : A),
      (fun t : ℝ => NormedSpace.exp (t • a₄) * NormedSpace.exp (t • a₃) * NormedSpace.exp (t • a₂) *
          NormedSpace.exp (t • a₁) -
        NormedSpace.exp (t • (a₁ + a₂ + a₃ + a₄) + (t ^ 2) • ((1 / 2 : ℝ) • Article.squareC a₁ a₂ a₃ a₄)))
        =O[nhds 0] fun t : ℝ => t ^ 3)
theorems.description:
**Proposition 38 (curvature).** The curvature `F_st(x) = hol(x; tsts) − 1` turns under a gauge transformation by
the gauge at its vertex, `F_st(x) ↦ g_xF_st(x)g_x⁻¹`; every closed walk of four steps is a square `tsts`; ten
squares pass through each vertex and there are forty in all; for `U_{xy} = e^{a_{xy}}` near one, with `a₁, …, a₄`
the rotations of the four steps in order, `hol = exp(Σ aᵢ + ½ Σ_{i>j}[aᵢ, aⱼ] + O(a³))`, that is
`log hol = Σ aᵢ + ½ Σ_{i>j}[aᵢ, aⱼ] + O(a³)` (along `a ↦ ta`, with the remainder `O(t³)`).

Recognition: the curvature is the force, `F = dA + A ∧ A` when the vertices are many and the rotations small; the sixteen
vertices and the forty squares build `ℝP⁴`. Uses Props. 25, 32, Definition 25.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Existence.prop_39
theorems.statement:
theorem prop_39 {n : ℕ} :
    (∀ (D : Finset (Fin n)) (X : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ),
      massForm D X X = ∑ i, ∑ j, ((X * projD D - projD D * X) i j) ^ 2 ∧ 0 ≤ massForm D X X ∧
      (massForm D X X = 0 ↔ X * thetaD D = thetaD D * X)) ∧
    (∀ (D : Finset (Fin n)) (a b : Fin n), a ∈ D → b ∉ D → massForm D (unitTurn a b) (unitTurn a b) = 2) ∧
    (∀ U Px Py gx gy : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ, gyᵀ * gy = 1 →
      covDiff (gx * U * gyᵀ) (gx * Px * gxᵀ) (gy * Py * gyᵀ) = gx * covDiff U Px Py * gxᵀ) ∧
    (∀ A Px Py : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ, Aᵀ = -A →
      covDiff (1 + A) Px Py = (Py - Px) + (A * Py - Py * A) - A * Py * A) ∧
    (∀ U Px Py : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ, U * Uᵀ = 1 →
      covDiffC U (qHalf Px) (qHalf Py) = (Complex.I - 1) • toC (covDiff U Px Py)) ∧
    (∀ M : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ, frobSq ((Complex.I - 1) • toC M) = 2 * ∑ i, ∑ j, M i j ^ 2) ∧
    (∀ (D : Finset (Fin n)) (X : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ),
      frobSq ((Complex.I - 1) • toC (X * projD D - projD D * X)) = 2 * massForm D X X)
theorems.description:
**Proposition 39 (kept and moved: the mass form).** `M_D(X, X) = ‖[X, P_D]‖² ≥ 0`, zero exactly when `X` is kept;
`M_D = 2` on every unit moved rotation `E_ab − E_ba` (`a ∈ D`, `b ∉ D`); between neighbouring vertices
`DP_D = U_{xy}P_D(y)U_{xy}⁻¹ − P_D(x) ↦ g_x(DP_D)g_x⁻¹`; near one, with `U = 1 + A`,
`DP_D = (P_D(y) − P_D(x)) + [A, P_D] + O(A²)`; with `q_D = 1 + (i − 1)P_D`, `Dq_D = (i − 1)DP_D` and
`‖Dq_D‖² = 2‖DP_D‖²`; along a rotation `X`, `‖Dq_D‖² = 2M_D(X, X)`.

Recognition: the kept rotations are massless gauge fields and the moved rotations massive (Englert, Brout, Higgs). Uses
Prop. 21, Definitions 15, 27.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Existence.prop_91
theorems.statement:
theorem prop_91 :
    (∀ q : Fin 16 → Fin 16 → Circle, (∀ x y, q y x = (q x y)⁻¹) →
      ((∃ z : Fin 16 → Circle, ∀ x y, clebsch.Adj x y → z x = q x y * z y) ↔
        ∀ (u : Fin 16) (p : clebsch.Walk u u), ArticleStatements.Clock.walkProd (fun x y => q y x) p = 1)) ∧
    clebsch.Preconnected ∧
    (Finset.univ.filter fun p : Fin 16 × Fin 16 => p.1 < p.2 ∧ Adjacent p.1 p.2).card = 40 ∧
    (∀ (a b : Fin 5) (r : Fin 16), transition b (transition a (transition b (transition a r))) = r) ∧ ((-1 : ℂ) ^ 4 = 1) ∧
    (∀ r : Fin 16, transition 4 (transition 3 (transition 2 (transition 1 (transition 0 r)))) = r) ∧ ((-1 : ℂ) ^ 5 = -1) ∧
    (¬ ∃ z : Fin 16 → Circle, ∀ (t : Fin 5) (x : Fin 16), (z (transition t x) : ℂ) = -(z x : ℂ)) ∧
    (∀ D : Finset (Fin 6), Module.finrank ℝ (centreSub D) = if D.card = 2 ∨ D.card = 4 then 1 else 0) ∧
    (∀ a b : Fin 6, a ≠ b → centreSub {a, b} = Submodule.span ℝ {unitTurn a b}) ∧
    (∀ f : Fin 10, plane (Sum.inr f) = ((Comparison.planeLines f).1.succ, (Comparison.planeLines f).2.succ) ∧
      (rotMat (plane (Sum.inr f))).map (Int.cast : ℤ → ℝ) =
        (-2 : ℝ) • unitTurn (Comparison.planeLines f).1.succ (Comparison.planeLines f).2.succ ∧
      gen (Sum.inr f) = -(γ (Comparison.planeLines f).1 * γ (Comparison.planeLines f).2) ∧
      ∀ c : Fin 6, act (gen (Sum.inr f)) (sixP1 c) =
        ∑ d, ((rotMat (plane (Sum.inr f)) d c : ℤ) : ℂ) • sixP1 d)
theorems.description:
**Proposition 91 (the common clock).** Phases `q_{xy} = q_{yx}⁻¹` in `U(1)` on the forty links of the sixteen
vertices have a common phase, `z_x = q_{xy}z_y` on every link, exactly when the product of `q` around every closed walk
is one (the vertices being connected); the flat sign `q ≡ −1` closes every square with `(−1)⁴ = +1` and the closed
walk `12345` with `(−1)⁵ = −1`, so it has no common phase; the centre of the kept rotations has dimension `0, 0, 1, 0`
at the types `0|6, 1|5, 2|4, 3|3` (and their complements), at `2|4` the rotation of the two-direction part, which at the
plane `F = \{h, k\}` is the action of the plane's rotation `γ_hγ_k` on the six.

Recognition: the common time of electromagnetism; the field is the obstruction to it, which the Aharonov–Bohm phase
measures; the flat sign is the loop of `ℝP⁴`. Uses Props. 25, 38, 41, Definition 28.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Existence.prop_32_full

source_context.command: open Asymptotics Filter NormedSpace Topology Matrix

theorems.statement:
theorem prop_32_full {X G : Type*} [Group G] :
    (∀ (c : Connection X G) (g : X → G) (x y : X), (c.rename g).U x y = g x * c.U x y * (g y)⁻¹) ∧
    (∀ (c : Connection X G) (g : X → G) (x : X) (rest : List X),
      (x :: rest).getLast (List.cons_ne_nil x rest) = x →
      hol (c.rename g) (x :: rest) = g x * hol c (x :: rest) * (g x)⁻¹) ∧
    (∀ {n R : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] [CommRing R] (x : X) (rest : List X),
      (x :: rest).getLast (List.cons_ne_nil x rest) = x →
      IsFact (fun c : Connection X (Matrix n n R)ˣ =>
        ((hol c (x :: rest) : (Matrix n n R)ˣ) : Matrix n n R).trace)) ∧
    (∀ (c : Connection X G) (x : X) (rest : List X),
      (x :: rest).getLast (List.cons_ne_nil x rest) ≠ x →
      ∀ V : G, ∃ g : X → G, hol (c.rename g) (x :: rest) = V) ∧
    (∀ {α : Type*} (φ : G → α) (x : X) (rest : List X),
      (x :: rest).getLast (List.cons_ne_nil x rest) ≠ x →
      IsFact (fun c : Connection X G => φ (hol c (x :: rest))) → ∀ V W : G, φ V = φ W)
theorems.description:
**Proposition 32 (closed facts).** A gauge transformation takes `U_xy ↦ g_xU_xyg_y⁻¹`; the holonomy of a closed walk
at `x₀` turns by the gauge at its own vertex, `hol ↦ g_{x₀} hol g_{x₀}⁻¹`, so its trace is a fact (for every group of
invertible matrices over every commutative ring); the transport of an open walk from `x` to `y ≠ x` can be gauge-transformed
into every rotation, and only the constants are facts of it.

Recognition: Einstein's point coincidences and the gauge principle, with Wilson's closed loops. Uses P4,
Definition 24.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Existence.prop_34_full

source_context.command: open Asymptotics Filter NormedSpace Topology Matrix

theorems.statement:
theorem prop_34_full {n : ℕ} :
    (∀ a b : Fin n, a ≠ b → SysExt.Jx (R := ℝ) a * SysExt.Jx b * SysExt.Jx a * SysExt.Jx b = -1) ∧
    (∀ a b : Fin n, a ≠ b →
      SysExt.Jx (R := ℝ) a (SysExt.Jx b (SysExt.Jx a (SysExt.Jx b (Pi.single (∅ : Finset (Fin n)) 1)))) =
        -Pi.single (∅ : Finset (Fin n)) (1 : ℝ)) ∧
    (∀ a b : Fin n, a ≠ b → ∀ θ : ℝ,
      NormedSpace.exp ((θ / 2) • LinearMap.toMatrixAlgEquiv' (SysExt.Jx (R := ℝ) a * SysExt.Jx b)) =
        LinearMap.toMatrixAlgEquiv' (SysExt.rotor a b θ) ∧
      SysExt.rotor a b θ = Real.cos (θ / 2) • 1 + Real.sin (θ / 2) • (SysExt.Jx a * SysExt.Jx b)) ∧
    (∀ a b : Fin n, a ≠ b → ∀ θ : ℝ, SysExt.rotor a b θ * SysExt.rotor a b (-θ) = 1 ∧
      ∀ v : Fin n → ℝ, SysExt.rotor a b θ * SysExt.Jv v * SysExt.rotor a b (-θ) =
        SysExt.Jv (SysExt.planeRot a b θ *ᵥ v)) ∧
    (∀ a b : Fin n, SysExt.rotor a b (2 * Real.pi) = -1 ∧ SysExt.planeRot a b (2 * Real.pi) = 1) ∧
    (∀ (D : Finset (Fin 6)) (x y : Fin 6),
      SysExt.halfStep D x * SysExt.halfStep D y + SysExt.halfStep D y * SysExt.halfStep D x =
        if x = y then (2 * thetaAt D x) • 1 else 0) ∧
    (∀ (D : Finset (Fin 6)) (x y : Fin 6), x ≠ y →
      (SysExt.halfStep D x * SysExt.halfStep D y) * (SysExt.halfStep D x * SysExt.halfStep D y) =
        (-(thetaAt D x * thetaAt D y)) • 1) ∧
    (∀ D : Finset (Fin 6),
      (Finset.univ.filter fun p : Fin 6 × Fin 6 => p.1 < p.2 ∧ (p.1 ∈ D ↔ p.2 ∈ D)).card =
        D.card.choose 2 + (6 - D.card).choose 2 ∧
      (Finset.univ.filter fun p : Fin 6 × Fin 6 => p.1 < p.2 ∧ ¬(p.1 ∈ D ↔ p.2 ∈ D)).card =
        D.card * (6 - D.card)) ∧
    (∀ (D : Finset (Fin 6)) (x : Fin 5 ⊕ Fin 10), Kept D x ↔ ((plane x).1 ∈ D ↔ (plane x).2 ∈ D))
theorems.description:
**Proposition 34 (spin one half).** `J_aJ_bJ_aJ_b = −1` (`a ≠ b`): the loop `f_∅ → f_b → f_{ab} → f_a → f_∅`
comes back with `−1`; `R_ab(ϑ) = e^{ϑJ_aJ_b/2} = cos(ϑ/2) + J_aJ_b sin(ϑ/2)`, `R_ab(ϑ) J(v) R_ab(ϑ)⁻¹ = J(O_ϑ v)`
for every `v` (`O_ϑ` the rotation of the plane `(a, b)` by `ϑ`), and `R_ab(2π) = −1` while `O_{2π} = 1`; with the square
root of the sign of a division `D`, `f_x = i^{[x ∈ D]} J_x` has `f_xf_y + f_yf_x = 2θ_D(x)δ_xy` and
`(f_xf_y)² = −θ_D(x)θ_D(y)` (`x ≠ y`): `−1` on the `C(k,2) + C(6−k,2)` planes within a side and `+1` on the
`k(6−k)` planes across (`k = |D|`); and these are the division's kept and moved rotations: a rotation is kept exactly when its
plane lies within one side.

Recognition: spin one half, four quarter turns around a plane come back with `−1`; a loop across the division is a
boost and never closes. Uses Props. 21, 33, Definition 14.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Existence.prop_38_full

source_context.command: open Asymptotics Filter NormedSpace Topology Matrix

theorems.statement:
theorem prop_38_full :
    (∀ {n R : Type} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] [CommRing R] (c : Connection (Fin 16) (Matrix n n R)ˣ)
      (g : Fin 16 → (Matrix n n R)ˣ) (x : Fin 16) (s t : Fin 5),
      curv (c.rename g) x s t = (g x : Matrix n n R) * curv c x s t * ((g x)⁻¹ : (Matrix n n R)ˣ)) ∧
    (∀ (x : Fin 16) (a b c d : Fin 5), a ≠ b → b ≠ c → c ≠ d → d ≠ a →
      transition d (transition c (transition b (transition a x))) = x → a = c ∧ b = d) ∧
    (∀ x : Fin 16, (Finset.image (fun p : Fin 5 × Fin 5 => square x p.1 p.2)
      (Finset.univ.filter fun p : Fin 5 × Fin 5 => p.1 < p.2)).card = 10) ∧
    (Finset.image (fun p : Fin 16 × Fin 5 × Fin 5 => square p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2)
      (Finset.univ.filter fun p : Fin 16 × Fin 5 × Fin 5 => p.2.1 < p.2.2)).card = 40 ∧
    (∀ {A : Type} [NormedRing A] [NormedAlgebra ℝ A] [CompleteSpace A],
      (fun a : A × A × A × A => NormedSpace.exp a.2.2.2 * NormedSpace.exp a.2.2.1 * NormedSpace.exp a.2.1 *
          NormedSpace.exp a.1 -
        NormedSpace.exp (a.1 + a.2.1 + a.2.2.1 + a.2.2.2 + (1 / 2 : ℝ) • Article.squareC a.1 a.2.1 a.2.2.1 a.2.2.2))
        =O[𝓝 0] fun a => ‖a‖ ^ 3)
theorems.description:
**Proposition 38 (curvature).** The curvature `F_st(x) = hol(x; tsts) − 1` turns under a gauge transformation by
the gauge at its vertex, `F_st(x) ↦ g_xF_st(x)g_x⁻¹`; every closed walk of four steps is a square `tsts`; ten
squares pass through each vertex and there are forty in all, which with the sixteen vertices build the cells of `ℝP⁴`
(SI Prop. 116, `Comparison.System.prop_116`); for `U_{xy} = e^{a_{xy}}` near one, with `a = (a₁, …, a₄)` the rotations
of the four steps in order, `hol = exp(Σ aᵢ + ½ Σ_{i>j}[aᵢ, aⱼ]) + O(‖a‖³)` uniformly for small rotations, that is
`log hol = Σ aᵢ + ½ Σ_{i>j}[aᵢ, aⱼ] + O(a³)`.

Recognition: the curvature is the force, `F = dA + A ∧ A` when the vertices are many and the rotations small. Uses
Props. 25, 32, Definition 25.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Existence.prop_39_full

source_context.command: open Asymptotics Filter NormedSpace Topology Matrix

theorems.statement:
theorem prop_39_full {n : ℕ} :
    (∀ (D : Finset (Fin n)) (X : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ),
      massForm D X X = ∑ i, ∑ j, ((X * projD D - projD D * X) i j) ^ 2 ∧ 0 ≤ massForm D X X ∧
      (massForm D X X = 0 ↔ X * thetaD D = thetaD D * X)) ∧
    (∀ (D : Finset (Fin n)) (a b : Fin n), a ∈ D → b ∉ D → massForm D (unitTurn a b) (unitTurn a b) = 2) ∧
    (∀ U Px Py gx gy : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ, gyᵀ * gy = 1 →
      covDiff (gx * U * gyᵀ) (gx * Px * gxᵀ) (gy * Py * gyᵀ) = gx * covDiff U Px Py * gxᵀ) ∧
    (∀ Px Py : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ,
      (fun A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ => covDiff (NormedSpace.exp A) Px Py - ((Py - Px) + (A * Py + Py * Aᵀ)))
        =O[𝓝 0] fun A => ‖A‖ ^ 2) ∧
    (∀ Px Py : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ,
      (fun A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ => covDiff (NormedSpace.exp A) Px Py - ((Py - Px) + (A * Py - Py * A)))
        =O[𝓝[{A | Aᵀ = -A}] 0] fun A => ‖A‖ ^ 2) ∧
    (∀ A Py : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ, Aᵀ = -A → A * Py + Py * Aᵀ = A * Py - Py * A) ∧
    (∀ A Px Py : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ, Aᵀ = -A →
      covDiff (1 + A) Px Py = (Py - Px) + (A * Py - Py * A) - A * Py * A) ∧
    (∀ U Px Py : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ, U * Uᵀ = 1 →
      covDiffC U (qHalf Px) (qHalf Py) = (Complex.I - 1) • toC (covDiff U Px Py)) ∧
    (∀ M : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ, frobSq ((Complex.I - 1) • toC M) = 2 * ∑ i, ∑ j, M i j ^ 2) ∧
    (∀ (D : Finset (Fin n)) (X : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ),
      frobSq ((Complex.I - 1) • toC (X * projD D - projD D * X)) = 2 * massForm D X X)
theorems.description:
**Proposition 39 (kept and moved: the mass form).** `M_D(X, X) = ‖[X, P_D]‖² ≥ 0`, zero exactly when `X` is kept;
`M_D = 2` on every unit moved rotation `E_ab − E_ba` (`a ∈ D`, `b ∉ D`); between neighbouring vertices
`DP_D = U_{xy}P_D(y)U_{xy}⁻¹ − P_D(x) ↦ g_x(DP_D)g_x⁻¹`; near one, `U = e^A`,
`DP_D = (P_D(y) − P_D(x)) + (AP_D(y) + P_D(y)Aᵀ) + O(‖A‖²)`, which along the rotations `Aᵀ = −A` is
`(P_D(y) − P_D(x)) + [A, P_D(y)] + O(‖A‖²)`, and for `U = 1 + A` exactly `(P_D(y) − P_D(x)) + [A, P_D(y)] − AP_D(y)A`; with `q_D = 1 + (i − 1)P_D`,
`Dq_D = (i − 1)DP_D` and `‖Dq_D‖² = 2‖DP_D‖²`; along a rotation `X`, `‖Dq_D‖² = 2M_D(X, X)`.

Recognition: the kept rotations are massless gauge fields and the moved rotations massive (Englert, Brout, Higgs). Uses
Prop. 21, Definitions 15, 27.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Existence.curvature_split_parts
theorems.statement:
theorem curvature_split_parts {d : ℕ} {θ : Matrix n n ℂ} (hθ : θ * θ = 1) (A : Fin d → Matrix n n ℂ)
    (dA : Fin d → Fin d → Matrix n n ℂ) (μ ν : Fin d) :
    curvAt A dA μ ν = keptPart θ (curvAt A dA μ ν) + movedPart θ (curvAt A dA μ ν) ∧
    Article.IsKept θ (keptPart θ (curvAt A dA μ ν)) ∧ Article.IsMoved θ (movedPart θ (curvAt A dA μ ν)) ∧
    keptPart θ (curvAt A dA μ ν) =
      curvAt (fun μ => keptPart θ (A μ)) (fun μ ν => keptPart θ (dA μ ν)) μ ν +
        Article.brk (movedPart θ (A μ)) (movedPart θ (A ν)) ∧
    Article.IsKept θ (Article.brk (movedPart θ (A μ)) (movedPart θ (A ν))) ∧
    movedPart θ (curvAt A dA μ ν) =
      covDAt (fun μ => keptPart θ (A μ)) (fun μ => movedPart θ (A μ)) (fun μ ν => movedPart θ (dA μ ν)) μ ν
theorems.description:
**The curvature splits by the division.** For every connection `A` (its values and derivatives at a point) and
every division `θ` (`θ² = 1`), with `A_k`, `A_m` the kept and the moved parts (whose derivatives are the kept and the
moved parts of the derivatives, `keptPart_hasFDerivAt`): `F = F_k + F_m`, `F_k` kept, `F_m` moved,
`F_k = F(A_k) + [A_m, A_m]` with `[A_m, A_m]` kept, and `F_m = D_{A_k}A_m`.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Existence.prop_40
theorems.statement:
theorem prop_40 (h k : Fin 5) (hhk : h ≠ k) :
    (sixOf h k).map kind = [0, 1, 2, 1, 2, 3] ∧
    (sixOf h k).map timeLike = [∅, {0}, {0, h.succ}, {h.succ}, {h.succ, k.succ}, ∅] ∧
    (∀ (S : Finset (Fin 6)) (c : Fin 6), thetaAt S c = -1 ↔ c ∈ S) ∧
    (sixOf h k).map (fun S => (loopsWithin S, loopsAcross S)) =
      [(15, 0), (10, 5), (7, 8), (10, 5), (7, 8), (6, 9)] ∧
    (∀ (S : Finset (Fin 6)) (x y : Fin 6), x ≠ y →
      (SysExt.halfStep S x * SysExt.halfStep S y) * (SysExt.halfStep S x * SysExt.halfStep S y) =
        (if (x ∈ S ↔ y ∈ S) then (-1 : ℂ) else 1) • 1) ∧
    (sixOf h k).map zS = [1, I, -1, I, -1, -I] ∧
    (sixOf h k).map (fun S => (keptOf15 S, movedOf15 S)) =
      [(15, 0), (10, 5), (7, 8), (10, 5), (7, 8), (6, 9)] ∧
    (sixOf h k).map (fun S => (keptOf10 S, movedOf10 S)) =
      [(10, 0), (10, 0), (6, 4), (6, 4), (4, 6), (4, 6)] ∧
    (sixOf h k).map (fun S => Module.finrank ℝ (centreSub S)) = [0, 0, 1, 0, 1, 0] ∧
    IsClock {0, h.succ} (unitTurn 0 h.succ) ∧ IsClock {h.succ, k.succ} (unitTurn h.succ k.succ) ∧
    (∀ S ∈ sixOf h k, ∀ a b : Fin 6, a ∈ S → b ∉ S → massForm S (unitTurn a b) (unitTurn a b) = 2) ∧
    (∀ S ∈ sixOf h k, ∀ (d : ℕ) (A : Fin d → Matrix (Fin 6) (Fin 6) ℂ)
        (dA : Fin d → Fin d → Matrix (Fin 6) (Fin 6) ℂ) (μ ν : Fin d),
      curvAt A dA μ ν = keptPart (theta ℂ S) (curvAt A dA μ ν) + movedPart (theta ℂ S) (curvAt A dA μ ν) ∧
      Article.IsKept (theta ℂ S) (keptPart (theta ℂ S) (curvAt A dA μ ν)) ∧
      Article.IsMoved (theta ℂ S) (movedPart (theta ℂ S) (curvAt A dA μ ν)) ∧
      keptPart (theta ℂ S) (curvAt A dA μ ν) =
        curvAt (fun μ => keptPart (theta ℂ S) (A μ)) (fun μ ν => keptPart (theta ℂ S) (dA μ ν)) μ ν +
          Article.brk (movedPart (theta ℂ S) (A μ)) (movedPart (theta ℂ S) (A ν)) ∧
      Article.IsKept (theta ℂ S) (Article.brk (movedPart (theta ℂ S) (A μ)) (movedPart (theta ℂ S) (A ν))) ∧
      movedPart (theta ℂ S) (curvAt A dA μ ν) =
        covDAt (fun μ => keptPart (theta ℂ S) (A μ)) (fun μ => movedPart (theta ℂ S) (A μ))
          (fun μ ν => movedPart (theta ℂ S) (dA μ ν)) μ ν)
theorems.description:
**Proposition 40 (the table of the six).** For every last-step direction `h` and plane `{h, k}`, the six divisions a line holds,
`{}`, `{n}`, `{h, n}`, `{h}`, `F = {h, k}`, `C`, have: the types `0¦6, 1¦5, 2¦4, 1¦5, 2¦4, 3¦3`; the time-like
part (the smaller part, where `θ_S = −1`): none, the singlet, the singlet and `h`, the last-step direction, the plane, none; the loops
`−1/+1`: `15/0, 10/5, 7/8, 10/5, 7/8, 6/9` (a loop `(f_xf_y)²` is `−1` within a side, `+1` across); the phases
`z_S = 1, i, −1, i, −1, −i`; kept/moved of the fifteen `15/0, 10/5, 7/8, 10/5, 7/8, 6/9` and of the ten
`10/0, 10/0, 6/4, 6/4, 4/6, 4/6`; a centre of the kept rotations of dimension `0, 0, 1, 0, 1, 0`, the clocks
`E_{n h} − E_{h n}` at `{h, n}` and `E_{h k} − E_{k h}` at `F` (the rotations of `iγ_h` and `γ_hγ_k`, Prop. 41); every
moved unit rotation has `M_S = 2`; and for every connection the curvature splits as `A = A_k + A_m`,
`F_k = F(A_k) + (A_m ∧ A_m)_k`, `F_m = D_{A_k}A_m` (the derivatives of the parts are the parts of the derivative,
`keptPart_hasFDerivAt`, `movedPart_hasFDerivAt`).

The real forms `SU(4)`, `SU*(4)`, `SU(2,2)`, `SL(4, ℝ)` and the balanced directions `S⁴`, `(S¹ × S³)/ℤ₂`,
`(S² × S²)/ℤ₂` of Table IV are Prop. 21's at the type.

Recognition: `{}` the universality of gravity; `{n}` the sign of time of every pair and the sphere of lines; `{h}`
the ten rotations split at the last-step direction, `6 + 4`, spin connection and co-frame; `{h, n}` the line's own clock; `F` the common
time and light; `C` two times and no clock, colour. Uses Props. 21, 22, 27, 34, 35, 39, Definition 28.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Existence.prop_41
theorems.statement:
theorem prop_41 (h k : Fin 5) (hhk : h ≠ k) :
    gen (Sum.inl h) = I • γ h ∧ plane (Sum.inl h) = (0, h.succ) ∧
    Kept {0, h.succ} (Sum.inl h) ∧
    (∀ x, Kept {0, h.succ} x → gen (Sum.inl h) * gen x = gen x * gen (Sum.inl h)) ∧
    Moved {h.succ} (Sum.inl h) ∧
    (∀ c : Fin 6, act (gen (Sum.inl h)) (sixP1 c) = ∑ d, ((rotMat (0, h.succ) d c : ℤ) : ℂ) • sixP1 d) ∧
    (rotMat (0, h.succ)).map (Int.cast : ℤ → ℝ) = (-2 : ℝ) • unitTurn 0 h.succ ∧
    IsClock {0, h.succ} (unitTurn 0 h.succ) ∧
    centreSub {0, h.succ} = Submodule.span ℝ {unitTurn 0 h.succ} ∧
    (∀ a : ℝ, NormedSpace.exp (a • (I • γ h)) = (Real.cos a : ℂ) • 1 + (I * Real.sin a) • γ h) ∧
    (∀ a : ℝ, (NormedSpace.exp (a • (I • γ h)) ⊗ₖ NormedSpace.exp (a • (I • γ h))) *ᵥ Ω =
      (Real.cos (2 * a) : ℂ) • Ω + (Real.sin (2 * a) : ℂ) • (I • ell h)) ∧
    NormedSpace.exp ((Real.pi / 2) • (I • γ h)) = I • γ h ∧
    (∃ f : Fin 10, (Comparison.planeLines f = (h, k) ∨ Comparison.planeLines f = (k, h)) ∧
      (gen (Sum.inr f) = -(γ h * γ k) ∨ gen (Sum.inr f) = γ h * γ k) ∧
      Kept {h.succ, k.succ} (Sum.inr f) ∧
      (∀ x, Kept {h.succ, k.succ} x → gen (Sum.inr f) * gen x = gen x * gen (Sum.inr f)) ∧
      Moved {h.succ} (Sum.inr f) ∧ Moved {k.succ} (Sum.inr f)) ∧
    IsClock {h.succ, k.succ} (unitTurn h.succ k.succ) ∧
    centreSub {h.succ, k.succ} = Submodule.span ℝ {unitTurn h.succ k.succ}
theorems.description:
**Proposition 41 (the clock of a line, and its mass).** `iγ_h` is the clock of `{h, n}`: it is kept, it
commutes with every rotation `{h, n}` keeps, it turns the plane `(n, h)` of the six (as `−2(E_{n h} − E_{h n})`), whose
unit rotation is a clock and spans the centre of the kept rotations; at `{h}` it is moved;
`e^{iaγ_h} = cos a + i sin a γ_h`, `(e^{iaγ_h} ⊗ e^{iaγ_h})Ω = cos 2a Ω + sin 2a iℓ_h`, `e^{i(π/2)γ_h} = iγ_h`;
`γ_hγ_k` (the plane's rotation, `±γ_hγ_k`) is the clock of `F = {h, k}`: kept, commuting with every rotation `F` keeps, its
unit rotation spans the centre; and it is moved at `{h}` and at `{k}`.

Recognition: the line's own time and its rest mass are one rotation, de Broglie's internal clock, `E = mc²`; the plane's
clock is the common time, the conformal time translation of `SU(2,2)`. Uses Props. 17, 21, 40, Definition 28.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Existence.prop_42
theorems.statement:
theorem prop_42 :
    (∀ S : Finset (Fin 6), (divLines S).card % 2 = S.card % 2) ∧
    (∀ (S : Finset (Fin 6)) (x : Fin 5 ⊕ Fin 10), Kept S x ↔
      (if (divLines S).card % 2 = 0 then gen x * gammaD (divLines S) = gammaD (divLines S) * gen x
       else gen x * (gammaD (divLines S) * Comparison.J) =
         (gammaD (divLines S) * Comparison.J) * (gen x).map star)) ∧
    (∀ S : Finset (Fin 6), Even S.card →
      (hermForm (divLines S))ᴴ = hermForm (divLines S) ∧
      ∀ v : Four → ℂ, (star v ⬝ᵥ (hermForm (divLines S) *ᵥ v)).im = 0) ∧
    (∀ S : Finset (Fin 6), Odd S.card →
      (∀ v : Four → ℂ, Cop (divLines S) v = gammaD (divLines S) *ᵥ Θ v) ∧
      (∀ (c : ℂ) (v w : Four → ℂ), star (Cop (divLines S) (c • v)) ⬝ᵥ w = c * (star (Cop (divLines S) v) ⬝ᵥ w)) ∧
      (∀ v v' w : Four → ℂ, star (Cop (divLines S) (v + v')) ⬝ᵥ w =
        star (Cop (divLines S) v) ⬝ᵥ w + star (Cop (divLines S) v') ⬝ᵥ w) ∧
      (∀ (c : ℂ) (v w : Four → ℂ), star (Cop (divLines S) v) ⬝ᵥ (c • w) = c * (star (Cop (divLines S) v) ⬝ᵥ w)) ∧
      (∀ v w w' : Four → ℂ, star (Cop (divLines S) v) ⬝ᵥ (w + w') =
        star (Cop (divLines S) v) ⬝ᵥ w + star (Cop (divLines S) v) ⬝ᵥ w') ∧
      (∀ v : Four → ℂ, Cop (divLines S) (Cop (divLines S) v) = (countSign (divLines S).card : ℂ) • v) ∧
      (∀ v w : Four → ℂ, star (Cop (divLines S) v) ⬝ᵥ w =
        (countSign (divLines S).card : ℂ) * (star (Cop (divLines S) w) ⬝ᵥ v)) ∧
      (countSign (divLines S).card = -1 ↔ ((divLines S).card = 1 ∨ (divLines S).card = 5)) ∧
      (countSign (divLines S).card = 1 ↔ (divLines S).card = 3) ∧
      (∀ u v : Four → ℂ, star (Cop (divLines S) v) ⬝ᵥ Cop (divLines S) u = star u ⬝ᵥ v)) ∧
    (∀ S : Finset (Fin 6), zS S = (half S).det ∧ zS S ^ 2 = (theta ℂ S).det ∧
      (Even S.card → (theta ℂ S).det = 1) ∧ (Odd S.card → (theta ℂ S).det = -1)) ∧
    (∀ S : Finset (Fin 6), (twin S).card % 2 ≠ S.card % 2)
theorems.description:
**Proposition 42 (count and amplitude).** For every divided set `S` of the six, read with the singlet undivided as the
division of the lines `D = divLines S` (`|D| ≡ |S|` mod 2): the rotations `S` keeps are exactly those that commute with
`γ_D` (`|S|` even) or with the antilinear `C_S = γ_DΘ` (`|S|` odd); for `S` even the kept form
`h_S = i^{r(r−1)/2}γ_D` is Hermitian and `⟨v, h_S v⟩` is real, a count; for `S` odd, `⟨C_S v, w⟩` is linear in `v`
and in `w`, an amplitude, `C_S² = s_r`, `⟨C_S v, w⟩ = s_r ⟨C_S w, v⟩` (antisymmetric where `C² = −1`, `r = 1, 5`;
symmetric where `C² = +1`, `r = 3`), and `⟨C_S v, C_S u⟩ = ⟨u, v⟩`, so `|⟨C_S v, w⟩|²` is a chance between two
states; `z_S = det q_S`, `z_S² = det θ_S`, `+1` for `S` even and `−1` for `S` odd; and a counterpart has the other parity.

Recognition: a count is a probability, an amplitude a transition amplitude; matter is counted, its counterpart with `n` added is a
quantum amplitude. Uses Props. 7, 19, 35, the Lemma of the divisions (the section on divisions), Definition 29.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Existence.prop_43
theorems.statement:
theorem prop_43 :
    (dividedSet 0 = ∅ ∧ twin ∅ = {0}) ∧
    (∀ t : Fin 5, dividedSet (transition t 0) = {0, t.succ} ∧ twin {0, t.succ} = {t.succ}) ∧
    (∀ h k : Fin 5, h ≠ k →
      dividedSet (relOfWord []) = ∅ ∧ dividedSet (relOfWord [h]) = {0, h.succ} ∧ twin {0, h.succ} = {h.succ} ∧
      dividedSet (relOfWord [h, k]) = {h.succ, k.succ} ∧ twin {h.succ, k.succ} = outside h k) ∧
    (∀ a b : Fin 5, a ≠ b → ∀ r : Fin 16, disagreeSet r = {a, b} →
      dividedSet r = {a.succ, b.succ} ∧ twin {a.succ, b.succ} = outside a b) ∧
    (∀ r : Fin 16, Even (dividedSet r).card ∧ Odd (twin (dividedSet r)).card)
theorems.description:
**Proposition 43 (where each piece sits).** An excursion closes the two-spinor state of a line to itself, the singlet, whose
divided set is `{}`, with the counterpart `{n}`; a step along `t` makes `ℓ_t`, divided set `{t, n}`, counterpart `{t}`; for every last-step direction `h`
and plane `{h, k}` of a line (Prop. 27: `r_{k,k} = Ω`, `r_{k,k−1} = ℓ_h`, `r_{k,k−2} = ±e_{hk}`), the three two-spinor states
have the divided sets `{}`, `{h, n}`, `{h, k}` and the counterparts `{n}`, `{h}`, `C` (the three lines outside the plane); every
symmetric state `e_{ab}` has the divided set `{a, b}` and the counterpart `{a, b}'`, the three lines outside it; every divided set is
even (a count, Prop. 42) and its counterpart with `n` added odd (an amplitude).

Recognition: `{}` carries gravity, the proton and the cosmos; `{n}` sizes and moments; `{t, n}` the step; `{t}`
colour per vertex and `α_s`; `{h, n}` the clock and the weak contact; `{h}` the Higgs; `F` the electric plane and
light; `C` the strong force; `{a, b}` the leptons and `{a, b}'` the quarks. Uses Props. 27, 42, Definition 29.
