theorems.name: Comparison.System.Existence.twin_step
theorems.statement:
theorem twin_step {a b : Fin 5} (hab : a ≠ b) :
    Law.LS (outside a b) = -1 ∧ Law.wS (outside a b) = I ∧
    Law.LS {0, a.succ, b.succ} = 1 ∧ Law.wS {0, a.succ, b.succ} = -I ∧
    Law.wS (outside a b) ^ 2 = -1 ∧ Law.wS {0, a.succ, b.succ} ^ 2 = -1
theorems.description:
At the counterpart of a plane: named by its three outside lines `L = −1`, `w = i`; named `{n, a, b}` `L = 1`, `w = −i`;
`w² = −1` either way.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Existence.prop_44
theorems.statement:
theorem prop_44 :
    (∀ S : Finset (Fin 6), (halfLines S)ᴴ * halfLines S = 1) ∧
    (∀ S : Finset (Fin 6),
      (halfLines S)ᵀ * halfLines S = Matrix.diagonal fun t => if t.succ ∈ S then -1 else 1) ∧
    (∀ S : Finset (Fin 6), Even S.card → GS S = 1) ∧
    (∀ S : Finset (Fin 6), Odd S.card → GS S = Matrix.diagonal fun t => if t.succ ∈ S then -1 else 1) ∧
    (∀ S : Finset (Fin 6), ∑ i, ∑ j, GS S i j = Law.LS S) ∧
    (∀ S : Finset (Fin 6), Law.LS S = if Even S.card then 5 else 5 - 2 * (Law.linesIn S : ℂ)) ∧
    (∀ S : Finset (Fin 6), Law.LS S ≠ 0) ∧
    (∀ S : Finset (Fin 6), coinAt (GS S) * coinAt (GS S) = 1) ∧
    coinAt (GS ∅) = coinC ∧
    (∀ S : Finset (Fin 6), Law.eS S = 1 - 2 / |(Law.LZ S : ℝ)|) ∧
    (∀ S : Finset (Fin 6), Law.wS S = zS S / Law.LS S) ∧
    (∀ S : Finset (Fin 6), Even S.card → ‖Law.wS S‖ = 1 / 5 ∧ Law.tS S = 2 / 5 ∧ Law.eS S = 3 / 5) ∧
    (∀ s : State, (disagreeSet s.1).card = 2 →
      (s.2 ∈ disagreeSet s.1 →
        (Finset.univ.filter fun s' => Continues s s' ∧ (disagreeSet s'.1).card = 4).card = 1 ∧
        (Finset.univ.filter fun s' => Continues s s' ∧ (disagreeSet s'.1).card = 2).card = 3) ∧
      (s.2 ∉ disagreeSet s.1 →
        (Finset.univ.filter fun s' => Continues s s' ∧ (disagreeSet s'.1).card = 4).card = 2 ∧
        (Finset.univ.filter fun s' => Continues s s' ∧ (disagreeSet s'.1).card = 2).card = 2)) ∧
    ((Finset.univ ×ˢ Finset.univ).filter fun p : State × State =>
        (disagreeSet p.1.1).card = 2 ∧ Continues p.1 p.2).card = 200 ∧
    ((Finset.univ ×ˢ Finset.univ).filter fun p : State × State =>
        (disagreeSet p.1.1).card = 2 ∧ Continues p.1 p.2 ∧ (disagreeSet p.2.1).card = 4).card = 80 ∧
    ((Finset.univ ×ˢ Finset.univ).filter fun p : State × State =>
        (disagreeSet p.1.1).card = 2 ∧ Continues p.1 p.2 ∧ (disagreeSet p.2.1).card = 2).card = 120 ∧
    (∀ k : Fin 16, (disagreeSet k).card = 2 →
      ((Finset.univ ×ˢ Finset.univ).filter fun p : State × State =>
        (disagreeSet p.1.1).card = 2 ∧ Continues p.1 p.2 ∧ p.2.1 = k).card = 12) ∧
    ((80 : ℚ) / 200 = 2 / 5 ∧ (120 : ℚ) / 200 = 3 / 5 ∧ (12 : ℚ) / 200 = 3 / 50) ∧
    (∀ t : Fin 5, Law.LS {t.succ} = 3 ∧ Law.wS {t.succ} = I / 3 ∧ Law.eS {t.succ} = 1 / 3) ∧
    (Law.LS {0} = 5 ∧ Law.eS {0} = 3 / 5) ∧
    (∀ a b : Fin 5, a ≠ b →
      Law.LS (outside a b) = -1 ∧ Law.wS (outside a b) = I ∧
      Law.LS {0, a.succ, b.succ} = 1 ∧ Law.wS {0, a.succ, b.succ} = -I ∧
      Law.wS (outside a b) ^ 2 = -1 ∧ Law.wS {0, a.succ, b.succ} ^ 2 = -1)
theorems.description:
**Proposition 44 (the step at each divided set).** On the five directions, with `q_S` the square root of the sign of the divided set:
`G_S = q_S†q_S = 1` (`S` even), `G_S = q_Sᵀq_S = θ_S` (`S` odd); `L_S = 𝟏ᵀG_S𝟏 = 5` (`S` even), `5 − 2k` (`S` odd,
`k` lines in `S`), never `0`; the coin at `S`, `σ_S = (2/L_S)𝟏𝟏ᵀG_S − I`, has `σ_S² = I` and `σ_∅ = σ₅`, Prop. 28's
coin; the reflection is `1 − 2/|L_S|` and the weight of a step `w_S = z_S/L_S`; at an even divided set `|w_S| = 1/5`; a symmetric
state continues once to a vector state and three times to symmetric states when its last-step direction is in the plane, twice and twice when
it is not; of the `200` departures from the fifty symmetric states `80` reach a vector state, `120` a plane and `12` each
plane: transmission `2|w_S| = 2/5 = 80/200`, reflection `1 − 2|w_S| = 3/5 = 120/200`, `s = 12/200 = 3/50` per plane; at
`{t}`: `L = 3`, `w = i/3`, reflection `1/3`; at `{n}`: `L = 5`, reflection `3/5`; at the counterpart of a plane named by its three
outside lines `L = −1`, `w = i`, named `{n, a, b}` `L = 1`, `w = −i`; `w² = −1` either way.

Recognition: the reflection `3/5` of the counted step gives `f = (3/5)²/10`, the reflection `1/3` of the coherent one
`α_s² = (1/3)²/8`. Uses Props. 19, 28, 29, 35, 42.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Existence.prop_97
theorems.statement:
theorem prop_97 :
    Real.tanh (Real.log 2) = 3 / 5 ∧ Real.tanh (Real.log 2 / 2) = 1 / 3 ∧
    Real.tanh (Real.log 2 / 4) = 3 - 2 * Real.sqrt 2 ∧ 3 - 2 * Real.sqrt 2 = Real.tan (Real.pi / 8) ^ 2 ∧
    Real.cosh (Real.log 2) = 5 / 4 ∧
    (∀ S : Finset (Fin 6), Even S.card → Law.eS S = Real.tanh (Real.log 2)) ∧
    (∀ t : Fin 5, Law.eS {t.succ} = Real.tanh (Real.log 2 / 2))
theorems.description:
**Proposition 97 (the reflections are radar steps).** `tanh log 2 = 3/5`, `tanh(log 2/2) = 1/3`,
`tanh(log 2/4) = 3 − 2√2 = tan²(π/8)`, `cosh log 2 = 5/4`; the reflection at every even divided set is `tanh log 2` and at a
line alone `tanh(log 2/2)` (Prop. 44); `tan²(π/8)` is the half phase of the line factor at the last-step direction's phase
(Prop. 51).

Recognition: the reflection of a counted step is the speed of one radar step of rapidity `log 2` (`v = 3/5`, `γ = 5/4`);
the reflection of a step carried as an amplitude halves that rapidity, and the half phase of the line factor quarters it.
Uses Props. 44, 51.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Existence.prop_40_full
theorems.statement:
theorem prop_40_full (h k : Fin 5) (hhk : h ≠ k) :
    (sixOf h k).map kind = [0, 1, 2, 1, 2, 3] ∧
    (sixOf h k).map timeLike = [∅, {0}, {0, h.succ}, {h.succ}, {h.succ, k.succ}, ∅] ∧
    (∀ (S : Finset (Fin 6)) (c : Fin 6), thetaAt S c = -1 ↔ c ∈ S) ∧
    (sixOf h k).map (fun S => (loopsWithin S, loopsAcross S)) =
      [(15, 0), (10, 5), (7, 8), (10, 5), (7, 8), (6, 9)] ∧
    (∀ (S : Finset (Fin 6)) (x y : Fin 6), x ≠ y →
      (SysExt.halfStep S x * SysExt.halfStep S y) * (SysExt.halfStep S x * SysExt.halfStep S y) =
        (if (x ∈ S ↔ y ∈ S) then (-1 : ℂ) else 1) • 1) ∧
    (sixOf h k).map zS = [1, I, -1, I, -1, -I] ∧
    (sixOf h k).map (fun S => (keptOf15 S, movedOf15 S)) =
      [(15, 0), (10, 5), (7, 8), (10, 5), (7, 8), (6, 9)] ∧
    (sixOf h k).map (fun S => (keptOf10 S, movedOf10 S)) =
      [(10, 0), (10, 0), (6, 4), (6, 4), (4, 6), (4, 6)] ∧
    (∀ S : Finset (Fin 6), ∀ f : Fin 10, Kept S (Sum.inr f) ↔ Kept (symmDiff S {0}) (Sum.inr f)) ∧
    (sixOf h k).map (fun S => Module.finrank ℝ (centreSub S)) = [0, 0, 1, 0, 1, 0] ∧
    IsClock {0, h.succ} (unitTurn 0 h.succ) ∧ IsClock {h.succ, k.succ} (unitTurn h.succ k.succ) ∧
    (∀ S ∈ sixOf h k, ∀ a b : Fin 6, a ∈ S → b ∉ S → massForm S (unitTurn a b) (unitTurn a b) = 2) ∧
    (∀ S ∈ sixOf h k, ∀ (d : ℕ) (A : Fin d → Matrix (Fin 6) (Fin 6) ℂ)
        (dA : Fin d → Fin d → Matrix (Fin 6) (Fin 6) ℂ) (μ ν : Fin d),
      curvAt A dA μ ν = keptPart (theta ℂ S) (curvAt A dA μ ν) + movedPart (theta ℂ S) (curvAt A dA μ ν) ∧
      Article.IsKept (theta ℂ S) (keptPart (theta ℂ S) (curvAt A dA μ ν)) ∧
      Article.IsMoved (theta ℂ S) (movedPart (theta ℂ S) (curvAt A dA μ ν)) ∧
      keptPart (theta ℂ S) (curvAt A dA μ ν) =
        curvAt (fun μ => keptPart (theta ℂ S) (A μ)) (fun μ ν => keptPart (theta ℂ S) (dA μ ν)) μ ν +
          Article.brk (movedPart (theta ℂ S) (A μ)) (movedPart (theta ℂ S) (A ν)) ∧
      Article.IsKept (theta ℂ S) (Article.brk (movedPart (theta ℂ S) (A μ)) (movedPart (theta ℂ S) (A ν))) ∧
      movedPart (theta ℂ S) (curvAt A dA μ ν) =
        covDAt (fun μ => keptPart (theta ℂ S) (A μ)) (fun μ => movedPart (theta ℂ S) (A μ))
          (fun μ ν => movedPart (theta ℂ S) (dA μ ν)) μ ν) ∧
    (sixOf h k).map divLines = [∅, Finset.univ, Finset.univ.erase h, {h}, {h, k}, Finset.univ \ {h, k}] ∧
    (∀ S ∈ sixOf h k, Geometry.realFormAlg (Geometry.projOf S) =
        (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range (Geometry.realGen6 S)) : Set (Matrix Four Four ℂ)) ∧
      Module.finrank ℝ (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range (Geometry.realGen6 S))) = 15) ∧
    (∀ S ∈ sixOf h k, (divLines S).card % 2 = 0 →
      (∀ X : Matrix Four Four ℂ, X ∈ Geometry.realFormAlg (Geometry.projOf S) ↔
        X.trace = 0 ∧ Xᴴ * hermForm (divLines S) + hermForm (divLines S) * X = 0) ∧
      (hermForm (divLines S))ᴴ = hermForm (divLines S) ∧ hermForm (divLines S) * hermForm (divLines S) = 1 ∧
      ((divLines S).card ≠ 0 → (hermForm (divLines S)).trace = 0)) ∧
    (∀ S ∈ sixOf h k, (divLines S).card % 2 = 1 →
      (∀ X : Matrix Four Four ℂ, X ∈ Geometry.realFormAlg (Geometry.projOf S) ↔
        X.trace = 0 ∧ X * (gammaD (divLines S) * Comparison.J) = (gammaD (divLines S) * Comparison.J) * X.map star) ∧
      ∀ v : Four → ℂ, Cop (divLines S) (Cop (divLines S) v) = (countSign (divLines S).card : ℂ) • v) ∧
    countSign 1 = -1 ∧ countSign 3 = 1 ∧ countSign 5 = -1 ∧
    (∀ S ∈ sixOf h k, ∀ v : Fin 6 → ℝ, Geometry.Balanced (Geometry.projOf S) v ↔
      v ≠ 0 ∧ ∑ a, (if a ∈ S then 0 else v a ^ 2) = ∑ a, (if a ∈ S then v a ^ 2 else 0)) ∧
    (∀ S ∈ sixOf h k, ∀ v w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (6 - S.card)) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin S.card),
      v ≠ 0 → ‖v.1‖ = ‖v.2‖ → w ≠ 0 → ‖w.1‖ = ‖w.2‖ →
        ((∃ c : ℝ, c ≠ 0 ∧ w = c • v) ↔ (GroupsContinuumLaw.nrmPQ w = GroupsContinuumLaw.nrmPQ v ∨ GroupsContinuumLaw.nrmPQ w = -GroupsContinuumLaw.nrmPQ v))) ∧
    (∀ S ∈ sixOf h k, ∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (6 - S.card)) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin S.card),
      v ≠ 0 → ‖v.1‖ = ‖v.2‖ → 0 < ‖v.1‖ ∧ ‖(GroupsContinuumLaw.nrmPQ v).1‖ = 1 ∧ ‖(GroupsContinuumLaw.nrmPQ v).2‖ = 1)
theorems.description:
**Proposition 40 (the table of the six).** For every last-step direction `h` and plane `{h, k}`, the six divisions a line holds,
`{}`, `{n}`, `{h, n}`, `{h}`, `F = {h, k}`, `C`, have: the types `0¦6, 1¦5, 2¦4, 1¦5, 2¦4, 3¦3`; the time-like
part (the smaller part, where `θ_S = −1`): none, the singlet, the singlet and `h`, the last-step direction, the plane, none; the loops
`−1/+1`: `15/0, 10/5, 7/8, 10/5, 7/8, 6/9` (a loop `(f_xf_y)²` is `−1` within a side, `+1` across); the phases
`z_S = 1, i, −1, i, −1, −i`; kept/moved of the fifteen `15/0, 10/5, 7/8, 10/5, 7/8, 6/9` and of the ten
`10/0, 10/0, 6/4, 6/4, 4/6, 4/6`, counterparts keeping the same ten; a centre of the kept rotations of dimension
`0, 0, 1, 0, 1, 0`, the clocks `E_{n h} − E_{h n}` at `{h, n}` and `E_{h k} − E_{k h}` at `F` (the rotations of `iγ_h`
and `γ_hγ_k`, Prop. 41); every moved unit rotation has `M_S = 2`; for every connection the curvature splits as
`A = A_k + A_m`, `F_k = F(A_k) + (A_m ∧ A_m)_k`, `F_m = D_{A_k}A_m` (the derivatives of the parts are the parts of
the derivative, `keptPart_hasFDerivAt`, `movedPart_hasFDerivAt`); the rows divide the lines `∅`, all five, all but
`h`, `{h}`, `{h, k}`, `C`, and the real form of each row (Definition 15) is the real span of fifteen generators,
`{X : tr X = 0, X†h_D + h_DX = 0}` for the even line sets `D` (`h_D` Hermitian, `h_D² = 1`, trace zero for
`|D| = 2, 4`) and `{X : tr X = 0, XC_D = C_DX}` for the odd ones (`C_D² = −1, −1, +1` at `|D| = 1, 5, 3`); the
balanced directions of each row are the `v ≠ 0` with `|v off S| = |v on S|`, and two of them span one line exactly
when their normalized representatives agree up to sign: the balanced lines are `(S^{5−k} × S^{k−1})/ℤ₂`, `k = |S|`.
The real forms as groups (`SU(4)`, `SU*(4)`, `SU(2,2)`, `SL(4, ℝ)`) are in the geometry layer.

Recognition: `{}` the universality of gravity; `{n}` the sign of time of every pair and the sphere of lines; `{h}`
the ten rotations split at the last-step direction, `6 + 4`, spin connection and co-frame; `{h, n}` the line's own clock; `F` the common
time and light; `C` two times and no clock, colour; the real forms `su(4)`, `sl(2, ℍ)`, `su(2,2)`, `sl(4, ℝ)` and the
balanced directions `S⁴`, `(S¹ × S³)/ℤ₂`, `(S² × S²)/ℤ₂`. Uses Props. 21, 22, 27, 34, 35, 39, Definitions 15, 28.

theorem chart_dirac (b : Fin 4 → Fin 5 → ℝ)
    (hb : ∀ μ ν, ∑ t, b μ t * b ν t = if μ = ν then 1 else 0) (h1 : ∀ μ, ∑ t, b μ t = 0)
    (p : Fin 4 → ℝ) (M : ℝ) :
    (∑ μ, (p μ : ℂ) • γv (b μ) + (M : ℂ) • γv (fun _ => 1 / Real.sqrt 5)) *
      (∑ μ, (p μ : ℂ) • γv (b μ) + (M : ℂ) • γv (fun _ => 1 / Real.sqrt 5)) =
      ((∑ μ, p μ ^ 2 + M ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) • (1 : Matrix Four Four ℂ)
theorems.description:

`Γ^μ = γ(b_μ) = Σ_t v_t^μ γ_t` and `γ(m) = Σ_t γ_t/√5` satisfy `(Σ_μ p_μ Γ^μ + Mγ(m))² = p² + M²`.

theorem S3_12 :

        WholePicture.clockW w2 w4 * ((D.card : ℝ) * E.card - 5 * (D ∩ E).card) / 72) ∧

    (∀ z : ℂ, ‖z‖ ≤ 1 → HasSum (fun n => (signedLaw n : ℂ) * z ^ n) (Law.Phi z)) ∧
    HasSum excursionLaw 1 ∧
    HasSum (fun n : ℕ => (n : ℝ) * excursionLaw n) 16 ∧
    (∑' n : ℕ, (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * excursionLaw n) - (∑' n : ℕ, (n : ℝ) * excursionLaw n) ^ 2 = 156 ∧
    Law.Phi 1 = -1 / 19 ∧ Law.Phi (-1) = -1 / 19 ∧
    Law.Phi I = -1 / 13 ∧ Law.Phi (-I) = -1 / 13 ∧
    HasSum signedLaw (-1 / 19) ∧ HasSum (fun n => (signedLaw n : ℂ) * I ^ n) (-1 / 13)
theorems.description:
**SI S3, statement 9: the two first returns.** The plain and the signed first returns from the
singlet back to the singlet, with `z = 4u` (the weights `f_n`, `φ_n` of the excursions of length `n`), have the
generating functions `F(z) = z⁴(1 + z)/(16 − 8z − 3z² − 3z³)` and `Φ(z) = −z⁴/(16 + 3z²)` on
`‖z‖ ≤ 1`; `F(1) = 1`, `F′(1) = Eℓ = 16`, `Var ℓ = 156`, `Φ(±1) = −1/19`, `Φ(±i) = −1/13`.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.S3_10
theorems.statement:
theorem S3_10 :
    ((∀ m, Existence.statLaw Existence.fP m =
        (∑ w ∈ excursions m, (Existence.cP w : ℝ)) / (5 * 4 ^ (m - 1))) ∧
      (∀ m, Existence.statLaw Existence.fQ m =
        (∑ w ∈ excursions m, (Existence.cQ w : ℝ)) / (5 * 4 ^ (m - 1))) ∧
      HasSum (Existence.statLaw Existence.fP) 10 ∧ HasSum (Existence.statLaw Existence.fQ) 5 ∧
      Existence.varP = 84 ∧ Existence.varQ = 12 ∧ Existence.covPQ = 30 ∧
      Existence.varP - Existence.covPQ ^ 2 / Existence.varQ = 9 ∧
      (∀ w : List (Fin 5), IsExcursion w → 1 + Existence.cP w + Existence.cQ w = w.length) ∧
      ∀ x : ℂ, ‖x‖ ≤ 1 → HasSum (fun m => (∑ w ∈ excursions m, x ^ Existence.cP w) / (5 * 4 ^ (m - 1)))
        (x * (1 + x) / (16 - 11 * x - 3 * x ^ 2))) ∧
    (deriv (fun y => excursionF 1 1 y) 1 = Existence.excursionMean Existence.fP ∧
      deriv (fun x => excursionF 1 x 1) 1 = Existence.excursionMean Existence.fQ ∧
      deriv (deriv (fun y => excursionF 1 1 y)) 1 = Existence.excursionMean Existence.fPP ∧
      deriv (deriv (fun x => excursionF 1 x 1)) 1 = Existence.excursionMean Existence.fQQ ∧
      deriv (fun x => deriv (fun y => excursionF 1 x y) 1) 1 = Existence.excursionMean Existence.fPQ) ∧
    deriv (fun y => excursionF 1 1 y) 1 = 10 ∧ deriv (fun x => excursionF 1 x 1) 1 = 5 ∧
    (deriv (deriv (fun y => excursionF 1 1 y)) 1 + deriv (fun y => excursionF 1 1 y) 1 -
        (deriv (fun y => excursionF 1 1 y) 1) ^ 2 = 84 ∧
      deriv (deriv (fun x => excursionF 1 x 1)) 1 + deriv (fun x => excursionF 1 x 1) 1 -
        (deriv (fun x => excursionF 1 x 1) 1) ^ 2 = 12 ∧
      deriv (fun x => deriv (fun y => excursionF 1 x y) 1) 1 -
        deriv (fun y => excursionF 1 1 y) 1 * deriv (fun x => excursionF 1 x 1) 1 = 30 ∧
      (84 : ℝ) - 30 ^ 2 / 12 = 9 ∧ (84 : ℝ) + 12 + 2 * 30 = 156) ∧
    (∀ x : ℝ, GP x = excursionF 1 1 x ∧ GP x = x * (1 + x) / (16 - 11 * x - 3 * x ^ 2)) ∧
    (∀ x : ℝ, 16 - 11 * x - 3 * x ^ 2 = -3 * (x - xc) * (x - xc')) ∧
    xc = (Real.sqrt 313 - 11) / 6 ∧ 1 < xc ∧
    (∀ h : Fin 5, (excursionStates h).card = 74 ∧ ∑ j, alongCount h j = 296 ∧
      alongCount h h = 60 ∧ (∀ j, j ≠ h → alongCount h j = 59) ∧
      ((excursionStates h).filter fun s => h ∉ disagreeSet s.1).card = 34 ∧
      ∑ p ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun p : State × State => inExcursion h p.1 = true ∧ Continues p.1 p.2),
        (6 + if p.2.2 = h then 1 else 0) = 1836 ∧ 6 * 296 + 60 = 1836)
theorems.description:
**SI S3, statement 10: the visits, the visits to the symmetric states and the transitions of one excursion.** An excursion meets
`P` symmetric states and `Q` vector states (`Existence.cP w`, `Existence.cQ w`); an excursion of length
`n` has the weight `1/(5·4ⁿ⁻¹)` (`Existence.statLaw`). Over the excursions: `EP = 10`, `EQ = 5`,
`Var P = 84`, `Var Q = 12`, `Cov(P, Q) = 30`, `Var P − Cov²/Var Q = 9`, and `ℓ = 1 + P + Q` for
every excursion; the visits to the symmetric states over the excursions have the generating function
`G_P(x) = Σ_m Σ_{excursions of length m} x^P/(5·4^{m−1}) = x(1 + x)/(16 − 11x − 3x²)` for `‖x‖ ≤ 1`. With
`F(z, x, y)` the excursion's generating function in the steps, the arrivals at the vector states and the visits to the symmetric states
(`excursionF`, the solution of the first-step equations), these moments are `∂_yF`, `∂_xF`, `∂_y²F`,
`∂_x²F`, `∂_x∂_yF` at `z = x = y = 1`, so `EP = ∂_yF = 10`, `EQ = ∂_xF = 5`; `G_P(x) = F(1, 1, x)`,
with the pole `x_c = (√313 − 11)/6`; an excursion begun after a step along `h` has 74 states, `M = 296`
transitions,
`C_h = 60` along `h`, `C_j = 59` along each other line and 34 states that leave `h` undivided; and
its self-interaction add to `Σ_transitions (6 + [s = h]) = 1836`. Uses Prop. 29 (`prop_29`) and Prop. 31.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.S3_11
theorems.statement:
theorem S3_11 :
    (WholePicture.lapM * WholePicture.greenM * WholePicture.lapM = WholePicture.lapM ∧
      WholePicture.greenM * WholePicture.lapM * WholePicture.greenM = WholePicture.greenM ∧
      (WholePicture.lapM * WholePicture.greenM)ᵀ = WholePicture.lapM * WholePicture.greenM ∧
      (WholePicture.greenM * WholePicture.lapM)ᵀ = WholePicture.greenM * WholePicture.lapM) ∧
    (∀ X : Matrix (Fin 16) (Fin 16) ℝ,
      WholePicture.lapM * X * WholePicture.lapM = WholePicture.lapM →
      X * WholePicture.lapM * X = X → (WholePicture.lapM * X)ᵀ = WholePicture.lapM * X →
      (X * WholePicture.lapM)ᵀ = X * WholePicture.lapM → X = WholePicture.greenM) ∧
    WholePicture.lapM = (5 : ℝ) • (1 : Matrix (Fin 16) (Fin 16) ℝ) - A ℝ ∧
    WholePicture.greenM = (1 / 32 : ℝ) • ((7 : ℝ) • (1 : Matrix (Fin 16) (Fin 16) ℝ) +
      Matrix.of fun x y => (WholePicture.adjZ x y : ℝ)) -
        (3 / 128 : ℝ) • (Matrix.of fun _ _ => (1 : ℝ)) ∧
    (∀ f : Fin 16, (disagreeSet f).card = 2 → RuleAndLaw.res128 0 f = 56) ∧
    (∀ l : Fin 16, (disagreeSet l).card = 4 → RuleAndLaw.res128 0 l = 48) ∧
    (56 : ℚ) / 128 = 7 / 16 ∧
    stepRᵀ * stepR = 1 + (15 : ℝ) • WholePicture.lastDirectionProj ∧
    WholePicture.lastDirectionProj * WholePicture.lastDirectionProj = WholePicture.lastDirectionProj ∧
    WholePicture.absB = 1 + (3 : ℝ) • WholePicture.lastDirectionProj ∧
    WholePicture.absB.IsHermitian ∧
    WholePicture.absB * WholePicture.absB = stepRᵀ * stepR ∧
    WholePicture.absB.charpoly = (X - C (1 : ℝ)) ^ 64 * (X - C (4 : ℝ)) ^ 16 ∧
    (stepRᵀ * stepR).charpoly = (X - C (1 : ℝ)) ^ 64 * (X - C (16 : ℝ)) ^ 16 ∧
    WholePicture.absB = (2 : ℝ) • (Real.exp (Real.log 2) • WholePicture.lastDirectionProj +
      Real.exp (-Real.log 2) • (1 - WholePicture.lastDirectionProj)) ∧
    WholePicture.absB =
      (2 : ℝ) • NormedSpace.exp (Real.log 2 • ((2 : ℝ) • WholePicture.lastDirectionProj - 1)) ∧
    Real.tanh (Real.log 2 / 4) = 3 - 2 * Real.sqrt 2 ∧
    Real.tan (Real.pi / 8) ^ 2 = 3 - 2 * Real.sqrt 2 ∧
    2 * ((∑ s, WholePicture.lineCharge s ^ 2) / 5 - ((∑ s, WholePicture.lineCharge s) / 5) ^ 2) =
      8 / 15 ∧
    (L * L).trace / 4 = 24 ∧
    Module.finrank ℂ (Module.End.eigenspace (Matrix.toLin' L) 6) +
      Module.finrank ℂ (Module.End.eigenspace (Matrix.toLin' L) 2) = 11
theorems.description:
**SI S3, statement 11: the Green function, the polar step, the charge current and 24/11.**
(i) `G = (7 + A)/32 − 3𝐉/128` satisfies the four Penrose equations for `5 − A` and is the only
matrix that does: `(5 − A)⁺ = G`; the resistance from the singlet to every plane is `56/128 = 7/16 = b`
and to every vector state `48/128`. (ii) `BᵀB = 1 + 15Π` with `Π` the projector on the groups of
five targets of one two-spinor state; `|B| = 1 + 3Π` is symmetric with `|B|² = BᵀB` and
`det(X − |B|) = (X − 1)⁶⁴(X − 4)¹⁶`: the singular values of `B` are 1 and 4;
`|B| = 2(e^ξ Π + e^{−ξ}(1 − Π)) = 2e^{ξ(2Π − I)}` with `ξ = log 2`, and `tanh(ξ/4) = 3 − 2√2 =
tan²(π/8)`.
(iii) The line charges have `c = 2 Var Q = 8/15`. (iv) `Tr L²/4 = 24` against the `1 + 10 = 11`
positive vertices of `L`.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.S3.norm_onSinglet
theorems.statement:
theorem norm_onSinglet (X : Matrix Four Four ℂ) (hX : Xᴴ * X = 1) :
    star (onSinglet X) ⬝ᵥ onSinglet X = 1
theorems.description: A two-spinor state `(X ⊗ 1)Ω` with `X` unitary has length one.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.S3.plane_unitary
theorems.statement: theorem plane_unitary (a b : Fin 5) : (γ a * γ b)ᴴ * (γ a * γ b) = 1

theorems.name: Comparison.System.S3.line_unitary
theorems.statement: theorem line_unitary (a : Fin 5) : (γ a)ᴴ * γ a = 1

theorems.name: Comparison.System.S3.charge3_sum
theorems.statement:

      (charge3 h k r : ℚ)

theorems.name: Comparison.System.S3.gram_unitary_invariant
theorems.statement:
theorem gram_unitary_invariant (V : Matrix (Fin 5) (Fin 5) ℂ) (hV : Vᴴ * V = 1)
    (X Y : Matrix (Fin 5) (Fin 5) ℂ) (e : Fin 5 → ℂ) :
    star ((V * X * Vᴴ) *ᵥ (V *ᵥ e)) ⬝ᵥ ((V * Y * Vᴴ) *ᵥ (V *ᵥ e)) = star (X *ᵥ e) ⬝ᵥ (Y *ᵥ e)
theorems.description:
**The Gram of the last-step direction is the same at every last-step direction:** a unitary relabelling `V` of the five
directions carries the generators to `VXV†` and the last-step direction to `Ve`, and leaves every entry.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.S3_1
theorems.statement:
theorem S3_1 :
    (∀ a b : Fin 5,
      γ a * γ b + γ b * γ a = (if a = b then (2 : ℂ) else 0) • (1 : Matrix Four Four ℂ)) ∧
    (∀ a : Fin 5, (γ a)ᴴ = γ a) ∧
    (γ 0 * γ 1 * γ 2 * γ 3 * γ 4 = 1 ∨ γ 0 * γ 1 * γ 2 * γ 3 * γ 4 = -1) ∧
    L = 1 ⊗ₖ 1 + ∑ t, γ t ⊗ₖ γ t ∧
    L = (2 : ℂ) • (swap + Eop) ∧
    Eop = vecMulVec (relOf J) (star (relOf J)) ∧
    Jᵀ = -J ∧
    Eop * Eop = (4 : ℂ) • Eop ∧
    swap * Eop = -Eop ∧ Eop * swap = -Eop ∧
    Module.finrank ℂ (Module.End.eigenspace (Matrix.toLin' L) 6) = 1 ∧
    Module.finrank ℂ (Module.End.eigenspace (Matrix.toLin' L) 2) = 10 ∧
    Module.finrank ℂ (Module.End.eigenspace (Matrix.toLin' L) (-2)) = 5 ∧
    (∀ μ : ℂ, μ ≠ 6 → μ ≠ 2 → μ ≠ -2 → Module.End.eigenspace (Matrix.toLin' L) μ = ⊥) ∧
    (L *ᵥ onSinglet 1 = (6 : ℂ) • onSinglet 1 ∧ star (onSinglet 1) ⬝ᵥ onSinglet 1 = 1) ∧
    (∀ a b : Fin 5, a ≠ b →
      L *ᵥ onSinglet (γ a * γ b) = (2 : ℂ) • onSinglet (γ a * γ b) ∧
        star (onSinglet (γ a * γ b)) ⬝ᵥ onSinglet (γ a * γ b) = 1) ∧
    (∀ a : Fin 5,
      L *ᵥ onSinglet (γ a) = (-2 : ℂ) • onSinglet (γ a) ∧ star (onSinglet (γ a)) ⬝ᵥ onSinglet (γ a) = 1)
theorems.description:
**SI S3, statement 1: five lines and one comparison.** Five Hermitian anticommuting directions
act on `ℂ⁴`, `γ_aγ_b + γ_bγ_a = 2δ_ab`, `γ_a† = γ_a`, `γ₁γ₂γ₃γ₄γ₅ = ±1`; the comparison
`L = I ⊗ I + Σ_t γ_t ⊗ γ_t = 2(P + E)` with `E = |J⟩⟨J|`, `Jᵀ = −J`, `E² = 4E`, `PE = EP = −E`;
`spec L = 6¹ ⊕ 2¹⁰ ⊕ (−2)⁵` with the eigenvectors (of length one) `(I ⊗ 1)Ω`, `(γ_aγ_b ⊗ 1)Ω`,
`(γ_a ⊗ 1)Ω` (the operators `I`, `γ_aγ_b`, `γ_a` under `|J⟩ ↔ I`). About the model; every
candidate system: `System.uniqueness`.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.S3_2
theorems.statement:
theorem S3_2 :
    (∀ D : Finset (Fin 6),
      (Finset.univ.filter (Kept D)).card = D.card.choose 2 + (6 - D.card).choose 2 ∧
      (Finset.univ.filter (Moved D)).card = D.card * (6 - D.card)) ∧
    ((Nat.choose 0 2 + Nat.choose 6 2, Nat.choose 1 2 + Nat.choose 5 2,
        Nat.choose 2 2 + Nat.choose 4 2, Nat.choose 3 2 + Nat.choose 3 2) = (15, 10, 7, 6) ∧
      (0 * 6, 1 * 5, 2 * 4, 3 * 3) = (0, 5, 8, 9)) ∧
    (∀ (n : Type) [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] (P : Matrix n n ℂ), P * P = P → Pᴴ = P →
      (1 - P + I • P) * (1 - P + I • P) = 1 - (2 : ℂ) • P ∧
        (1 - P + I • P)ᴴ * (1 - P + I • P) = 1) ∧
    (∀ (A : Type) [Ring A] [Algebra ℂ A] (e : Finset (Fin 6) → A)
      (c : Finset (Fin 6) → Finset (Fin 6) → ℂ), (∀ S T, e S * e T = c S T • e (symmDiff S T)) →
      ∀ D S T : Finset (Fin 6),
        (I ^ (S ∩ D).card • e S) * (I ^ (T ∩ D).card • e T) =
          ((-1 : ℂ) ^ (S ∩ T ∩ D).card) •
            ((c S T * I ^ ((symmDiff S T) ∩ D).card) • e (symmDiff S T)))
theorems.description:
**SI S3, statement 2: kept and moved rotations, the square root of the sign, and the algebra a description carries.**
(i) A division of the six directions (in the basis of Definition 16, a set `D`) keeps
`C(|D|, 2) + C(6 − |D|, 2)` and moves `|D|(6 − |D|)` of the fifteen rotations: `15, 10, 7, 6` and
`0, 5, 8, 9` at the four types `k|6 − k`. (ii) For every Hermitian projector `P`, the square root of the sign
`q = I − P + iP` has `q² = I − 2P = θ` and `q†q = I`. (iii) In every complex algebra whose words
multiply as `e_Se_T = c(S, T) e_{S△T}` (the 64 words of the six directions), the square root of the sign
`q_D(e_U) = i^{|U∩D|} e_U` satisfies `q_D(e_S) q_D(e_T) = (−1)^{|S∩T∩D|} q_D(e_Se_T)`. About the
model; every candidate system: `System.uniqueness`.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.S3_3
theorems.statement:
theorem S3_3 :
    ∀ h k : Fin 5, h ≠ k →
      (∀ r : Fin 16, charge h k r =
        ∑ s ∈ disagreeSet r, (if s = k then (1 : ℚ) else if s = h then 0 else -1 / 3)) ∧
      (∀ r : Fin 16, charge h k r = isospin h k r + hyper h k r) ∧
      ((Finset.univ.filter fun r => hyper h k r = 0).card = 1 ∧
        (Finset.univ.filter fun r => hyper h k r = 1).card = 1 ∧
        (Finset.univ.filter fun r => hyper h k r = -2 / 3).card = 3 ∧
        (Finset.univ.filter fun r => hyper h k r = 1 / 6).card = 6 ∧
        (Finset.univ.filter fun r => hyper h k r = 1 / 3).card = 3 ∧
        (Finset.univ.filter fun r => hyper h k r = -1 / 2).card = 2) ∧
      ∑ r, hyper h k r = 0 ∧ ∑ r, hyper h k r ^ 3 = 0 ∧
      ∑ r ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun r => nPlane h k r = 1), hyper h k r = 0 ∧
      ∑ r ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun r => nOut h k r = 1 ∨ nOut h k r = 2), hyper h k r = 0 ∧
      ∑ r, hyper h k r ^ 5 = 5 / 9 ∧
      (WholePicture.pairingsBeside h).card = 3
theorems.description:
**SI S3, statement 3: one generation.** For every plane `F = {h, k}` (`h ≠ k`) with the three
outside lines `C`: the hypercharge `Y(S) = |S∩F|/2 − |S∩C|/3`, the isospin
`T₃(S) = (|S∩{k}| − |S∩{h}|)/2` and the charge `Q(S)`, the sum over `S` of the line charges
`0, 1, −⅓, −⅓, −⅓` on `h, k, c₁, c₂, c₃`, satisfy `Q = T₃ + Y` on every even two-spinor state; the sixteen
hypercharges are `0, 1, −⅔, ⅙, ⅓, −½` with multiplicities `1, 1, 3, 6, 3, 2`; `ΣY = ΣY³ = 0`; the
sums of `Y` over the doublets (`|S∩F| = 1`) and over the triplets (`|S∩C| = 1, 2`) vanish;
`ΣY⁵ = 5/9`; the four lines beside the last-step direction pair in exactly three ways. Recognition: one generation
of matter. About the model; every candidate system: `System.uniqueness`.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.S3_4
theorems.statement:
theorem S3_4 :
    (∀ j : Fin 12, (WholePicture.gen12 j)ᴴ = -WholePicture.gen12 j ∧
      (WholePicture.gen12 j).trace = 0 ∧
      ∀ a b : Fin 5, WholePicture.inPlane a ≠ WholePicture.inPlane b →
        WholePicture.gen12 j a b = 0) ∧
    (∀ i j : Fin 12,
      ((WholePicture.gen12 i)ᴴ * WholePicture.gen12 j).trace.re = if i = j then 1 else 0) ∧
    (∀ i j : Fin 12, WholePicture.lastDirectionGram i j =
      (star (WholePicture.gen12 i *ᵥ WholePicture.lastDirectionE) ⬝ᵥ
        (WholePicture.gen12 j *ᵥ WholePicture.lastDirectionE)).re) ∧
    WholePicture.lastDirectionGram.charpoly = X ^ 9 * (X - C (1 / 2 : ℝ)) ^ 2 * (X - C (4 / 5 : ℝ)) ∧
    (∀ V : Matrix (Fin 5) (Fin 5) ℂ, Vᴴ * V = 1 → ∀ i j : Fin 12,
      (star ((V * WholePicture.gen12 i * Vᴴ) *ᵥ (V *ᵥ WholePicture.lastDirectionE)) ⬝ᵥ
        ((V * WholePicture.gen12 j * Vᴴ) *ᵥ (V *ᵥ WholePicture.lastDirectionE))).re =
          WholePicture.lastDirectionGram i j) ∧
    (1 / 2 : ℝ) / (4 / 5) = 5 / 8 ∧ 1 - (1 / 2 : ℝ) / (4 / 5) = 3 / 8
theorems.description:
**SI S3, statement 4: the last-step direction's Gram.** On the twelve generators of `s(u(2) ⊕ u(3))`
(anti-Hermitian, of trace zero, block-diagonal on the plane and the three outside lines), orthonormal
in the trace form, the Gram matrix `G_XY = Re⟨Xφ, Yφ⟩` at the last-step direction `φ = e_h` has the characteristic
polynomial `X⁹(X − ½)²(X − 4/5)`: the nonzero eigenvalues `½, ½, 4/5` and nine zeros; the same
Gram at every last-step direction (a unitary relabelling `V` of the lines leaves every entry); and
`(½)/(4/5) = 5/8`, `1 − 5/8 = 3/8`. Recognition: `W±` at `½`, `Z` at `4/5`, the photon and the
eight colour rotations at zero; `M_W²/M_Z² = 5/8` and `sin²θ = 3/8` at the source.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.S3_5
theorems.statement:
theorem S3_5 :
    (∀ u : ℂ, law u = (1 - u ^ 2) ^ 24 * WholePicture.kN 0 u * WholePicture.kN 2 u ^ 10 *
      WholePicture.kN 4 u ^ 5) ∧
    (∀ u : ℂ, u ≠ 1 → law u =
      ∏ U : Fin 16, (1 + u) ^ ((WholePicture.agreeCount U : ℤ) - 1) *
        (1 - u) ^ ((WholePicture.disagreeCount U : ℤ) - 1) *
        (1 + 4 * u ^ 2 -
          u * ((WholePicture.agreeCount U : ℂ) - (WholePicture.disagreeCount U : ℂ)))) ∧
    (∀ U : Fin 16, WholePicture.agreeCount U = 5 - (disagreeSet U).card ∧
      WholePicture.disagreeCount U = (disagreeSet U).card) ∧
    (∀ u : ℂ, ∏ U : Fin 16, (1 - u • Law.patternK (R := ℂ) (disagreeSet U)).det = law u)
theorems.description:
**SI S3, statement 5: the law and its sixteen meetings.** For every `u`,
`det(I − uB) = (1 − u²)²⁴ k₀(u) k₂(u)¹⁰ k₄(u)⁵` with `k_N(u) = 1 + 4u² − u(5 − 2N)`, and,
wherever the right side is defined (`u ≠ 1`),
`det(I − uB) = ∏_U (1 + u)^{a_U − 1}(1 − u)^{d_U − 1}[1 + 4u² − u(a_U − d_U)]` over the sixteen
meetings `U`, with `a_U = 5 − |U|`, `d_U = |U|`; the sixteen meeting blocks multiply to the law.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.S3_6
theorems.statement:
theorem S3_6 :
    (Finset.univ.filter fun p : Fin 16 × Fin 16 => p.1 < p.2 ∧ Adjacent p.1 p.2).card = 40 ∧
    (∀ l : Fin 40, transition (WholePicture.linkLine l) (linkU l) = linkV l) ∧
    (∀ q : Fin 40, (WholePicture.sqSet q).card = 4) ∧
    (∀ (x : Fin 16) (a b d : Fin 5), a < b → b < d →
      ∃ c : Fin 20, WholePicture.cubeSet c = WholePicture.cubeOf x a b d ∧
        WholePicture.cubeA c = a ∧ WholePicture.cubeB c = b ∧ WholePicture.cubeD c = d) ∧
    (∀ c : Fin 20, (WholePicture.cubeSet c).card = 8) ∧
    (WholePicture.bd1 * WholePicture.bd2 = 0 ∧ WholePicture.bd2 * WholePicture.bd3 = 0 ∧
      WholePicture.bd3 * WholePicture.bd4 = 0) ∧
    (WholePicture.cMat * Law.gradZ' = 0 ∧ Law.cubeBdZ * WholePicture.cMat = 0 ∧
      Law.fourBdZ * Law.cubeBdZ = 0) ∧
    (Module.finrank (ZMod 2) (LinearMap.ker (0 : Matrix (Fin 0) (Fin 16) (ZMod 2)).mulVecLin ⧸
        (LinearMap.range WholePicture.bd1.mulVecLin).comap
          (LinearMap.ker (0 : Matrix (Fin 0) (Fin 16) (ZMod 2)).mulVecLin).subtype) = 1 ∧
      Module.finrank (ZMod 2) (LinearMap.ker WholePicture.bd1.mulVecLin ⧸
        (LinearMap.range WholePicture.bd2.mulVecLin).comap
          (LinearMap.ker WholePicture.bd1.mulVecLin).subtype) = 1 ∧
      Module.finrank (ZMod 2) (LinearMap.ker WholePicture.bd2.mulVecLin ⧸
        (LinearMap.range WholePicture.bd3.mulVecLin).comap
          (LinearMap.ker WholePicture.bd2.mulVecLin).subtype) = 1 ∧
      Module.finrank (ZMod 2) (LinearMap.ker WholePicture.bd3.mulVecLin ⧸
        (LinearMap.range WholePicture.bd4.mulVecLin).comap
          (LinearMap.ker WholePicture.bd3.mulVecLin).subtype) = 1 ∧
      Module.finrank (ZMod 2) (LinearMap.ker WholePicture.bd4.mulVecLin ⧸
        (LinearMap.range (0 : Matrix (Fin 5) (Fin 0) (ZMod 2)).mulVecLin).comap
          (LinearMap.ker WholePicture.bd4.mulVecLin).subtype) = 1) ∧
    ((16 : ℤ) - 40 + 40 - 20 + 5 = 1) ∧
    (∀ (q : Fin 40) (x : Fin 16),
      ∑ l : Fin 40,
        cZ q l * ((if linkV l = x then 1 else 0) - (if linkU l = x then 1 else 0)) = 0) ∧
    WholePicture.cReal.rank = 25 ∧
    (WholePicture.cRealᵀ * WholePicture.cReal).charpoly =
      X ^ 15 * (X - C (4 : ℝ)) ^ 10 * (X - C (8 : ℝ)) ^ 15
theorems.description:
**SI S3, statement 6: the cells of the real projective four-space.** The two-spinor states and their
steps are the cells of `ℝP⁴`: 16 two-spinor states, 40 links (each a pair of neighbours), 40 squares, 20
cubes (every cube of the five-cube with the whole flip appears once) and 5 four-cells; the boundary
of a boundary is nothing (`∂∂ = 0`, over `ℤ/2`, and with orientations over `ℤ` in every degree);
there is one class in each dimension mod 2, `dim(ker ∂_k / im ∂_{k+1}) = 1` for `k = 0, …, 4`; the
Euler number is one; the circulation `C` of link phases around the squares annihilates the gradients
(`C · grad = 0`, over `ℤ`), `rank C = 25` and `det(X − CᵀC) = X¹⁵(X − 4)¹⁰(X − 8)¹⁵`.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.S3_7
theorems.description:
**SI S3, statement 7: the signed step.** `A₋ = A₋ᵀ`, `A₋² = 5I`,
`det(I − uB₋) = (1 − u²)²⁴(1 + 3u² + 16u⁴)⁸` for every `u`, and at the four points `u = i^d/4` `u = i^k/4`,
`1 − 1/R₋(u) = Φ(i^k)` with `R₋(u) = (1 + 3u²)/(1 + 3u² + 16u⁴)` and `Φ(z) = −z⁴/(16 + 3z²)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.S3_8
theorems.statement:
theorem S3_8 {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (c : Connection (Fin 16) (Matrix.unitaryGroup n ℂ)) (u : ℝ) (hu0 : 0 ≤ u) (hu : u < 1 / 4) :
    ((1 + 4 * (u : ℂ) ^ 2) • (1 : Matrix (Fin 16 × n) (Fin 16 × n) ℂ) -
        (u : ℂ) • ∑ t, WholePicture.connStep c t)ᴴ =
      (1 + 4 * (u : ℂ) ^ 2) • (1 : Matrix (Fin 16 × n) (Fin 16 × n) ℂ) -
        (u : ℂ) • ∑ t, WholePicture.connStep c t ∧
    (∀ x : Fin 16 × n → ℂ, (1 - u) * (1 - 4 * u) * (star x ⬝ᵥ x).re ≤
      (star x ⬝ᵥ (((1 + 4 * (u : ℂ) ^ 2) • (1 : Matrix (Fin 16 × n) (Fin 16 × n) ℂ) -
        (u : ℂ) • ∑ t, WholePicture.connStep c t) *ᵥ x)).re) ∧
    0 < (1 - u) * (1 - 4 * u) ∧
    0 < (1 - (u : ℂ) • Bconn c).det
theorems.description:
**SI S3, statement 8: positivity below the critical step.** For every unitary connection `U` on
the links (rotations of any size `n`) the operator `(1 + 4u²) − uA_U`, `A_U = Σ_t Γ_t[U]`, is Hermitian,
and for `0 ≤ u < 1/4` it is bounded below by `(1 − u)(1 − 4u) > 0`:
`Re⟨x, ((1 + 4u²) − uA_U)x⟩ ≥ (1 − u)(1 − 4u)⟨x, x⟩` for every `x`. So the law has no zero there:
`det(I − uB[U]) > 0`.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.quatBasis_eq_geometry
theorems.statement:
theorem quatBasis_eq_geometry (S : CandidateSystem) :
    S.quatBasis = Geometry.quatBasis S.partner
theorems.description: The spine's quaternion basis of a candidate system is the geometry's at its conjugate.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.quatHom_eq_geometry
theorems.statement:
theorem quatHom_eq_geometry (S : CandidateSystem) :
    S.quatHom = Geometry.quatAction S.partner
theorems.description: The spine's action of the quaternions is the geometry's.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.clebsch_adjMatrix_eq
theorems.statement:
theorem clebsch_adjMatrix_eq (R : Type*) [CommRing R] :
    Existence.clebsch.adjMatrix R = A R
theorems.description: The existence layer's Clebsch graph has the spine's adjacency matrix.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.theta_eq_thetaAt
theorems.statement:
theorem theta_eq_thetaAt (D : Finset (Fin 6)) :
    theta ℂ D = Matrix.diagonal (Existence.thetaAt D)
theorems.description: The sign of a division is the diagonal of the existence layer's `thetaAt`.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.num_moments_eq
theorems.statement:
theorem num_moments_eq :
    Completion.Num.EP = Existence.excursionMean Existence.fP ∧
    Completion.Num.EQ = Existence.excursionMean Existence.fQ ∧
    Completion.Num.VarP = Existence.varP ∧ Completion.Num.VarQ = Existence.varQ ∧
    Completion.Num.Cov = Existence.covPQ
theorems.description: The completions' moments of one excursion are the moments over the excursions (Prop. 29).

theorems.name: Comparison.System.P2_iff
theorems.statement:
theorem P2_iff (X : Matrix Two Two ℂ) :
    P2a X ∧ P2b X ↔ ∃ a b : ℂ, X = a • (1 : Matrix Two Two ℂ) + b • L
theorems.description:
**P2 fixes the comparison** (Prop. 13, its last clause). An operator on two systems is
kept by every `U ⊗ U`, `U ∈ Sp(2)`, and by the exchange (P2 (a)), and by the quaternionic structure taken on one
system (P2 (b)), exactly when it is `a + bL`.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.changesEachStep_iff
theorems.statement:
theorem changesEachStep_iff (t : Steps) :
    ChangesEachStep t ↔ ∀ n, IsHistory (Existence.between t 0 n)
theorems.description:
**P5 (b) makes the walks** (Prop. 24): a sequence of steps changes its two-spinor state at
each step exactly when each of its first segments is a walk (a reduced word).

theorems.name: Comparison.System.relAt_eq_relationOf
theorems.statement:
theorem relAt_eq_relationOf (t : Steps) (n : ℕ) :
    relAt t n = relationOf (Existence.between t 0 n)
theorems.description:
**P5 (c) on the words** (Prop. 24): the two-spinor state at the moment `n` is the two-spinor state of
the word of the first `n` steps.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.partner_zero
theorems.statement: theorem partner_zero (T : Partner H) : T.Θ 0 = 0

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.partner_sum
theorems.statement:
theorem partner_sum (T : Partner H) {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → H) :
    T.Θ (∑ i ∈ s, f i) = ∑ i ∈ s, T.Θ (f i)

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.partner_neg
theorems.statement: theorem partner_neg (T : Partner H) (v : H) : T.Θ (-v) = -T.Θ v

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.partner_real_smul
theorems.statement: theorem partner_real_smul (T : Partner H) (r : ℝ) (v : H) : T.Θ (r • v) = r • T.Θ v

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.mem_distinctionsH
theorems.statement:
theorem mem_distinctionsH [FiniteDimensional ℂ H] (T : Partner H) (a : H →ₗ[ℂ] H) :
    a ∈ distinctionsH T ↔ T.IsDistinctionH a

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.candidate_Q_eq
theorems.statement: theorem candidate_Q_eq (S : CandidateSystem) : S.Q = distinctionsH S.partner
theorems.description: The distinctions of a candidate system are `distinctionsH` of its conjugate.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.relOf_relMat
theorems.statement: theorem relOf_relMat (v : Two → ℂ) : relOf (relMat v) = v

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.relMat_relOf
theorems.statement: theorem relMat_relOf (M : Matrix Four Four ℂ) : relMat (relOf M) = M

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.perm_eq_one_of_fix_but
theorems.statement: theorem perm_eq_one_of_fix_but (σ : Equiv.Perm n) (i : n) (h : ∀ j, j ≠ i → σ j = j) : σ = 1
theorems.description: A permutation that fixes every point but one is the identity.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.map_smul_toComplex
theorems.statement:
theorem map_smul_toComplex (c : GaussianInt) (M : Matrix Four Four GaussianInt) :
    (c • M).map GaussianInt.toComplex = (GaussianInt.toComplex c) • M.map GaussianInt.toComplex

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.toComplex_iZ'
theorems.statement: theorem toComplex_iZ' : GaussianInt.toComplex iZ = Complex.I

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.realGenZ_map
theorems.statement:
theorem realGenZ_map (D : Finset (Fin 5)) (x : Fin 5 ⊕ Fin 10) :
    (realGenZ D x).map GaussianInt.toComplex = realGen D x

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.hermFormZ_map
theorems.statement:
theorem hermFormZ_map (D : Finset (Fin 5)) :
    (hermFormZ D).map GaussianInt.toComplex = hermForm D

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.conjTranspose_mapZ
theorems.statement:
theorem conjTranspose_mapZ (M : Matrix Four Four GaussianInt) :
    Mᴴ.map GaussianInt.toComplex = (M.map GaussianInt.toComplex)ᴴ

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.star_mapZ
theorems.statement:
theorem star_mapZ (M : Matrix Four Four GaussianInt) :
    (M.map star).map GaussianInt.toComplex = (M.map GaussianInt.toComplex).map star

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.lemma_evenZ
theorems.statement:
theorem lemma_evenZ : ∀ D : Finset (Fin 5), ∀ x : Fin 5 ⊕ Fin 10, D.card % 2 = 0 →
    (realGenZ D x)ᴴ * hermFormZ D + hermFormZ D * realGenZ D x = 0

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.lemma_oddZ
theorems.statement:
theorem lemma_oddZ : ∀ D : Finset (Fin 5), ∀ x : Fin 5 ⊕ Fin 10, D.card % 2 = 1 →
    realGenZ D x * (gammaDZ D * JZ) = (gammaDZ D * JZ) * (realGenZ D x).map star

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.gen_hermFormZ
theorems.statement:
theorem gen_hermFormZ : ∀ D : Finset (Fin 5), ∀ x : Fin 5 ⊕ Fin 10, D.card % 2 = 0 →
    (KeptLines D x → genZ x * hermFormZ D = hermFormZ D * genZ x) ∧
    (¬ KeptLines D x → genZ x * hermFormZ D = -(hermFormZ D * genZ x))
theorems.description: Each generator commutes or anticommutes with `h_D`: commutes exactly when kept.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.gen_CZ
theorems.statement:
theorem gen_CZ : ∀ D : Finset (Fin 5), ∀ x : Fin 5 ⊕ Fin 10, D.card % 2 = 1 →
    (KeptLines D x → genZ x * (gammaDZ D * JZ) = (gammaDZ D * JZ) * (genZ x).map star) ∧
    (¬ KeptLines D x → genZ x * (gammaDZ D * JZ) = -((gammaDZ D * JZ) * (genZ x).map star))
theorems.description: Each generator commutes or anticommutes with `C_D`: commutes exactly when kept.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.hermFormZ_sq
theorems.statement: theorem hermFormZ_sq : ∀ D : Finset (Fin 5), D.card % 2 = 0 → hermFormZ D * hermFormZ D = 1

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.hermFormZ_trace
theorems.statement:
theorem hermFormZ_trace : ∀ D : Finset (Fin 5), D.card % 2 = 0 → D.card ≠ 0 →
    (hermFormZ D).trace = 0

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.lemma_division_even
theorems.statement:
theorem lemma_division_even (D : Finset (Fin 5)) (hD : D.card % 2 = 0) (x : Fin 5 ⊕ Fin 10) :
    (realGen D x)ᴴ * hermForm D + hermForm D * realGen D x = 0
theorems.description: **The Lemma, even divisions:** every generator of the real form keeps the form `h_D`.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.lemma_division_odd
theorems.statement:
theorem lemma_division_odd (D : Finset (Fin 5)) (hD : D.card % 2 = 1) (x : Fin 5 ⊕ Fin 10)
    (v : Four → ℂ) : realGen D x *ᵥ Cop D v = Cop D (realGen D x *ᵥ v)
theorems.description: **The Lemma, odd divisions:** every generator of the real form commutes with `C_D = γ_DΘ`.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.hermForm_props
theorems.statement:
theorem hermForm_props (D : Finset (Fin 5)) (hD : D.card % 2 = 0) :
    (hermForm D)ᴴ = hermForm D ∧ hermForm D * hermForm D = 1 ∧
    (D.card ≠ 0 → (hermForm D).trace = 0)
theorems.description: `h_D` is Hermitian with `h_D² = 1`; for `r = 2, 4` it has trace zero.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.gamma_on_sixZ
theorems.statement:
theorem gamma_on_sixZ : ∀ S : Finset (Fin 5), S.card % 2 = 0 → ∀ c : Fin 6,
    gammaDZ S * GroupsContinuumLaw.sixZ c * (gammaDZ S)ᵀ =
      (if c ∈ linesDiv S then -1 else 1 : GaussianInt) • GroupsContinuumLaw.sixZ c

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.gamma_on_six
theorems.statement:
theorem gamma_on_six (S : Finset (Fin 5)) (hS : S.card % 2 = 0) (c : Fin 6) :
    (gammaS S ⊗ₖ gammaS S) *ᵥ relOf (sixP1 c) =
      (if c ∈ linesDiv S then -1 else 1 : ℂ) • relOf (sixP1 c)
theorems.description:
**`γ_S ⊗ γ_S = θ_S` on P1's real six for every even set `S` of lines:** `−1` on the divided lines,
`+1` on the singlet and the other lines.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.gammaDZ_univ
theorems.statement: theorem gammaDZ_univ : gammaDZ Finset.univ = 1

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.gammaDZ_erase
theorems.statement:
theorem gammaDZ_erase : ∀ t : Fin 5,
    gammaDZ (Finset.univ.erase t) = γZ t ∨ gammaDZ (Finset.univ.erase t) = -γZ t

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.gammaS_univ
theorems.statement: theorem gammaS_univ : gammaS Finset.univ = 1
theorems.description: **All five lines divided: `γ_D = 1`, so `C_D = Θ`.**

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.gammaS_erase
theorems.statement:
theorem gammaS_erase (t : Fin 5) :
    gammaS (Finset.univ.erase t) = γ t ∨ gammaS (Finset.univ.erase t) = -γ t
theorems.description: **The four lines outside `t`: `γ_D = ±γ_t`.**

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.zero_not_mem_linesDiv
theorems.statement: theorem zero_not_mem_linesDiv (D : Finset (Fin 5)) : (0 : Fin 6) ∉ linesDiv D

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.card_linesDiv
theorems.statement: theorem card_linesDiv (D : Finset (Fin 5)) : (linesDiv D).card = D.card

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.linesDiv_compl
theorems.statement: theorem linesDiv_compl (D : Finset (Fin 5)) : (insert 0 (linesDiv D))ᶜ = linesDiv Dᶜ
theorems.description: Dividing the singlet with the lines `D` is the same division as dividing the lines outside `D`.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.kept_ten_lines
theorems.statement:
theorem kept_ten_lines (D : Finset (Fin 5)) :
    (Finset.univ.filter fun f : Fin 10 => Kept (linesDiv D) (Sum.inr f)).card =
      D.card.choose 2 + (5 - D.card).choose 2 ∧
    (Finset.univ.filter fun f : Fin 10 => Moved (linesDiv D) (Sum.inr f)).card =
      D.card * (5 - D.card)
theorems.description:
**Kept and moved among the ten:** dividing `r` lines with the singlet undivided keeps
`C(r,2) + C(5−r,2)` of the ten rotations that keep the singlet and moves `r(5 − r)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.finrank_division_le
theorems.statement: theorem finrank_division_le (D : Division) : finrank ℝ D ≤ 6

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.finrank_orth
theorems.statement: theorem finrank_orth (D : Division) : finrank ℝ Dᗮ = 6 - finrank ℝ D

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.byTurn_iff_kind
theorems.statement:
theorem byTurn_iff_kind (D D' : Division) :
    Division.ByTurn D D' ↔ Division.kind D = Division.kind D'
theorems.description: **Under the fifteen rotations a division is known by the dimension of its smaller part.**

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.finrank_ofSet
theorems.statement: theorem finrank_ofSet (S : Finset (Fin 6)) : finrank ℝ (Division.ofSet S) = S.card
theorems.description: The coordinate division of a set `S` has dimension `|S|`.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.four_kinds_general
theorems.statement:
theorem four_kinds_general :
    (∀ D : Division, Division.kind D ≤ 3) ∧
    (∀ k ≤ 3, ∃ S : Finset (Fin 6), S.card = k ∧ Division.kind (Division.ofSet S) = k)
theorems.description:
**There are four types:** every division has type `0, 1, 2` or `3`, and each type is the type of
a coordinate division.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.metric_ofSet
theorems.statement:
theorem metric_ofSet (D : Finset (Fin 6)) (v : Fin 6 → ℝ) :
    metricOf (Matrix.diagonal fun a => if a ∈ D then (1 : ℝ) else 0) v =
      ((∑ a, (if a ∈ D then 0 else v a ^ 2) - ∑ a, (if a ∈ D then v a ^ 2 else 0) : ℝ) : ℂ)
theorems.description:
**The metric of a coordinate division:** `g_D(v) = Σ_{a ∉ D} v_a² − Σ_{a ∈ D} v_a²`,
signature `(6 − k, k)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.gen_linearIndependent_complex
theorems.statement: theorem gen_linearIndependent_complex : LinearIndependent ℂ gen

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.gen_trace'
theorems.statement: theorem gen_trace' (x : Fin 5 ⊕ Fin 10) : (gen x).trace = 0

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.realFactor_ne_zero
theorems.statement: theorem realFactor_ne_zero (D : Finset (Fin 5)) (x : Fin 5 ⊕ Fin 10) : realFactor D x ≠ 0

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.realGen_eq
theorems.statement:
theorem realGen_eq (D : Finset (Fin 5)) (x : Fin 5 ⊕ Fin 10) :
    realGen D x = realFactor D x • gen x

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.realGen_linearIndependent
theorems.statement: theorem realGen_linearIndependent (D : Finset (Fin 5)) : LinearIndependent ℂ (realGen D)

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.exists_gen_coeffs
theorems.statement:
theorem exists_gen_coeffs (X : Matrix Four Four ℂ) (htr : X.trace = 0) :
    ∃ c : Fin 5 ⊕ Fin 10 → ℂ, X = ∑ x, c x • gen x
theorems.description: Every operator of trace zero is a complex combination of the fifteen generators.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.realGen_real_comb
theorems.statement:
theorem realGen_real_comb (D : Finset (Fin 5)) (X : Matrix Four Four ℂ) (htr : X.trace = 0) :
    ∃ p q : Fin 5 ⊕ Fin 10 → ℝ, X = ∑ x, (p x : ℂ) • realGen D x +
      Complex.I • ∑ x, (q x : ℂ) • realGen D x
theorems.description: A real combination of the generators of the real form, written with complex coefficients.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.sum_real_conjTranspose
theorems.statement:
theorem sum_real_conjTranspose (D : Finset (Fin 5)) (q : Fin 5 ⊕ Fin 10 → ℝ) :
    (∑ x, (q x : ℂ) • realGen D x)ᴴ = ∑ x, (q x : ℂ) • (realGen D x)ᴴ

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.realGen_span_iff_even
theorems.statement:
theorem realGen_span_iff_even (D : Finset (Fin 5)) (hD : D.card % 2 = 0) (X : Matrix Four Four ℂ) :
    (X.trace = 0 ∧ Xᴴ * hermForm D + hermForm D * X = 0) ↔
      X ∈ Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range (realGen D))
theorems.description:
**The converse of the Lemma, even divisions:** the operators of trace zero that keep the form `h_D`
(`X†h_D + h_DX = 0`) are exactly the real combinations of the fifteen generators of the real form.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.realGen_span_iff_odd
theorems.statement:
theorem realGen_span_iff_odd (D : Finset (Fin 5)) (hD : D.card % 2 = 1) (X : Matrix Four Four ℂ) :
    (X.trace = 0 ∧ X * (gammaD D * J) = (gammaD D * J) * X.map star) ↔
      X ∈ Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range (realGen D))
theorems.description:
**The converse of the Lemma, odd divisions:** the operators of trace zero that commute with the
antilinear `C_D` (`X M = M X̄`, `M = γ_DJ`) are exactly the real combinations of the fifteen
generators of the real form.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.four_kinds_statement
theorems.statement:
theorem Geometry.four_kinds_statement :
    (∀ D D' : Division, Division.ByTurn D D' ↔ Division.kind D = Division.kind D') ∧
    (∀ D : Division, Division.kind D ≤ 3) ∧
    (∀ k ≤ 3, ∃ S : Finset (Fin 6), S.card = k ∧ Division.kind (Division.ofSet S) = k) ∧
    (∀ S : Finset (Fin 6), finrank ℝ (Division.ofSet S) = S.card) ∧
    (∀ D : Finset (Fin 6), (Finset.univ.filter (Kept D)).card =
      D.card.choose 2 + (6 - D.card).choose 2) ∧
    (∀ D : Finset (Fin 6), (Finset.univ.filter (Moved D)).card = D.card * (6 - D.card)) ∧
    (∀ (D : Finset (Fin 6)) (x : Fin 5 ⊕ Fin 10), Kept D x ↔ ¬ Moved D x) ∧
    (∀ (D : Finset (Fin 6)) (v : Fin 6 → ℝ),
      metricOf (Matrix.diagonal fun a => if a ∈ D then (1 : ℝ) else 0) v =
        ((∑ a, (if a ∈ D then 0 else v a ^ 2) - ∑ a, (if a ∈ D then v a ^ 2 else 0) : ℝ) : ℂ)) ∧
    (∀ D : Finset (Fin 5), D.card % 2 = 0 → ∀ x : Fin 5 ⊕ Fin 10,
      (realGen D x)ᴴ * hermForm D + hermForm D * realGen D x = 0) ∧
    (∀ D : Finset (Fin 5), D.card % 2 = 0 →
      (hermForm D)ᴴ = hermForm D ∧ hermForm D * hermForm D = 1 ∧
      (D.card ≠ 0 → (hermForm D).trace = 0)) ∧
    (∀ D : Finset (Fin 5), D.card % 2 = 1 → ∀ (x : Fin 5 ⊕ Fin 10) (v : Four → ℂ),
      realGen D x *ᵥ Cop D v = Cop D (realGen D x *ᵥ v)) ∧
    (∀ (D : Finset (Fin 5)) (v : Four → ℂ), Cop D (Cop D v) = (countSign D.card : ℂ) • v) ∧
    countSign 1 = -1 ∧ countSign 3 = 1 ∧ countSign 5 = -1 ∧
    (∀ v : Fin 6 → ℝ, GroupsContinuumLaw.OnCone v → GroupsContinuumLaw.r2 v = 1 →
      ∀ i j, GroupsContinuumLaw.g6 (GroupsContinuumLaw.frame v i) (GroupsContinuumLaw.frame v j) =
        if i = j then (if i = 0 then 1 else -1) else 0) ∧
    (∀ D : Finset (Fin 5), LinearIndependent ℂ (realGen D)) ∧
    (∀ D : Finset (Fin 5), D.card % 2 = 0 → ∀ X : Matrix Four Four ℂ,
      (X.trace = 0 ∧ Xᴴ * hermForm D + hermForm D * X = 0) ↔
        X ∈ Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range (realGen D))) ∧
    (∀ D : Finset (Fin 5), D.card % 2 = 1 → ∀ X : Matrix Four Four ℂ,
      (X.trace = 0 ∧ X * (gammaD D * J) = (gammaD D * J) * X.map star) ↔
        X ∈ Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range (realGen D))) ∧
    (∀ ε : Fin 6 → ℝ, (∀ i, ε i = 1 ∨ ε i = -1) → ∀ X : Matrix (Fin 6) (Fin 6) ℝ, Xᵀ = -X →
      (GroupsContinuumLaw.realFormMap ε X)ᵀ * Matrix.diagonal ε +
        Matrix.diagonal ε * GroupsContinuumLaw.realFormMap ε X = 0) ∧
    (∀ ε : Fin 6 → ℝ, (∀ i, ε i = 1 ∨ ε i = -1) → ∀ Y : Matrix (Fin 6) (Fin 6) ℝ,
      Yᵀ * Matrix.diagonal ε + Matrix.diagonal ε * Y = 0 →
        (GroupsContinuumLaw.realFormMap ε Y)ᵀ = -GroupsContinuumLaw.realFormMap ε Y ∧
          GroupsContinuumLaw.realFormMap ε (GroupsContinuumLaw.realFormMap ε Y) = Y) ∧
    (∀ (p q : ℕ) (v w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin p) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin q)), v ≠ 0 →
      ‖v.1‖ = ‖v.2‖ → w ≠ 0 → ‖w.1‖ = ‖w.2‖ →
        ((∃ c : ℝ, c ≠ 0 ∧ w = c • v) ↔
          (GroupsContinuumLaw.nrmPQ w = GroupsContinuumLaw.nrmPQ v ∨ GroupsContinuumLaw.nrmPQ w = -GroupsContinuumLaw.nrmPQ v))) ∧
    (∀ (p q : ℕ) (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin p) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin q)), v ≠ 0 →
      ‖v.1‖ = ‖v.2‖ → 0 < ‖v.1‖ ∧ ‖(GroupsContinuumLaw.nrmPQ v).1‖ = 1 ∧ ‖(GroupsContinuumLaw.nrmPQ v).2‖ = 1)
theorems.description:
**Proposition 21 (four types of division).** Under the fifteen rotations a division (a subspace `D`
of P1's real six) is known by the dimension `k` of its smaller part: two divisions are carried one to
the other by a rotation of `SU(4)` exactly when they have the same type, there are four types,
`k = 0, 1, 2, 3`, each that of a coordinate division; in a basis, a division `D ⊆ {0, …, 5}` keeps
`C(k,2) + C(6−k,2) = 15, 10, 7, 6` and moves `k(6 − k) = 0, 5, 8, 9` of the fifteen generators,
each generator kept or moved and not both; its metric is `Σ_{a∉D} v_a² − Σ_{a∈D} v_a²`
(signature `(6−k, k)`); for the divisions of the lines with the singlet undivided (the Lemma), the
generators of the real form — the kept rotations and `i` times the moved ones — keep the form
`h_D = i^{r(r−1)/2}γ_D` (Hermitian, `h_D² = 1`, trace zero for `r = 2, 4`) when `r` is even and
commute with the antilinear `C_D = γ_DΘ`, `C_D² = −1` for `r = 1, 5` and `+1` for `r = 3`, when `r` is
odd; and on the balanced directions of the type `2|4` the metric has the signs `(+, −, −, −)` on
`v^⊥/ℝv`. Recognition: the four types are those of gravity, the weak force, electromagnetism and the
strong force; the real forms `su(4)`, `sl(2,ℍ)`, `su(2,2)`, `sl(4,ℝ)` of the twistor group; the balance
of `2|4` is spacetime `(1, 3)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.prop_22
theorems.statement:
theorem prop_22 :
    Fintype.card (Finset (Fin 5)) = 32 ∧
    ((∀ k : Fin 16, Even (disagreeSet k).card) ∧ Function.Injective disagreeSet ∧
      ∀ S : Finset (Fin 5), Even S.card → ∃ k, disagreeSet k = S) ∧
    (∀ S : Finset (Fin 5), S.card % 2 = 0 → ∀ c : Fin 6,
      (gammaS S ⊗ₖ gammaS S) *ᵥ relOf (sixP1 c) =
        (if c ∈ linesDiv S then -1 else 1 : ℂ) • relOf (sixP1 c)) ∧
    (∀ D : Finset (Fin 5), (insert 0 (linesDiv D))ᶜ = linesDiv Dᶜ) ∧
    (∀ (D : Finset (Fin 6)) (x : Fin 5 ⊕ Fin 10), Kept Dᶜ x ↔ Kept D x) ∧
    (∀ D : Finset (Fin 5),
      (Finset.univ.filter fun f : Fin 10 => Kept (linesDiv D) (Sum.inr f)).card =
        D.card.choose 2 + (5 - D.card).choose 2 ∧
      (Finset.univ.filter fun f : Fin 10 => Moved (linesDiv D) (Sum.inr f)).card =
        D.card * (5 - D.card)) ∧
    (∀ D : Finset (Fin 5), D.card % 2 = 0 → ∀ x : Fin 5 ⊕ Fin 10,
      (realGen D x)ᴴ * hermForm D + hermForm D * realGen D x = 0) ∧
    (∀ D : Finset (Fin 5), D.card % 2 = 1 → ∀ (x : Fin 5 ⊕ Fin 10) (v : Four → ℂ),
      realGen D x *ᵥ Cop D v = Cop D (realGen D x *ᵥ v)) ∧
    (∀ D : Finset (Fin 5), Division.kind (Division.ofSet (linesDiv D)) = min D.card (6 - D.card)) ∧
    gammaS Finset.univ = 1 ∧
    (∀ t : Fin 5, gammaS (Finset.univ.erase t) = γ t ∨ gammaS (Finset.univ.erase t) = -γ t) ∧
    (∀ x : Fin 5 ⊕ Fin 10, Kept {1, 2, 3, 4, 5} x ↔ x.isRight) ∧
    [(∅ : Finset (Fin 6)), {0}, {1}, {0, 1}, {1, 2}, {0, 1, 2}].map
      (fun D => ((Finset.univ.filter (Kept D)).card, (Finset.univ.filter (Moved D)).card,
        (Finset.univ.filter fun f : Fin 10 => Kept D (Sum.inr f)).card,
        (Finset.univ.filter fun f : Fin 10 => Moved D (Sum.inr f)).card)) =
    [(15, 0, 10, 0), (10, 5, 10, 0), (10, 5, 6, 4), (7, 8, 6, 4), (7, 8, 4, 6), (6, 9, 4, 6)]
theorems.description:
**Proposition 22 (six divisions with the singlet fixed).** In a basis the divisions with the singlet
fixed are the 32 sets `S` of lines; the sixteen even ones are the sets of the two-spinor states `e_S`; on
P1's real six `γ_S ⊗ γ_S = θ_S` for every even `S`; dividing the singlet with the lines `D` is the same
division as dividing the lines outside `D`, so with the singlet fixed a division is known by the number
`r` of lines it divides; among the ten rotations that keep the singlet it keeps `C(r,2) + C(5−r,2)` and moves
`r(5 − r)` (`10/0, 6/4, 4/6, 4/6, 6/4, 10/0` for `r = 0, …, 5`); each keeps on `H` the product
`γ_D` of its divided lines, as a form when `r` is even and multiplied by the quaternionic structure when `r` is odd
(the Lemma); P3's own division is the point with the singlet: it keeps the ten and moves the five.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.kronN_apply

theorem kronN_apply {N : ℕ} (A : Fin N → Matrix Four Four ℂ) (w v : Fin N → Four) :

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.kronN_conjTranspose

theorem kronN_conjTranspose {N : ℕ} (A : Fin N → Matrix Four Four ℂ) :

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.kronN_one
theorems.statement: theorem kronN_one {N : ℕ} : kronN (fun _ : Fin N => (1 : Matrix Four Four ℂ)) = 1

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.tpow_mul
theorems.statement: theorem tpow_mul (N : ℕ) (U V : Matrix Four Four ℂ) : tpow N U * tpow N V = tpow N (U * V)

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.tpow_conjTranspose
theorems.statement: theorem tpow_conjTranspose (N : ℕ) (U : Matrix Four Four ℂ) : (tpow N U)ᴴ = tpow N Uᴴ

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.pstr_conjTranspose
theorems.statement: theorem pstr_conjTranspose {N : ℕ} (σ : Fin N → Fin 16) : (pstr σ)ᴴ = pstr σ

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.trace_pstr_mul
theorems.statement:
theorem trace_pstr_mul {N : ℕ} (σ τ : Fin N → Fin 16) :
    (pstr σ * pstr τ).trace = if σ = τ then 4 ^ N else 0
theorems.description: **The strings are orthogonal:** `Tr(P_σ P_τ) = 4^N δ_στ`.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.pstr_linearIndependent
theorems.statement: theorem pstr_linearIndependent (N : ℕ) : LinearIndependent ℂ (pstr (N := N))

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.pstr_span
theorems.statement: theorem pstr_span (N : ℕ) : Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range (pstr (N := N))) = ⊤

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.expand_pstr
theorems.statement: theorem expand_pstr {N : ℕ} (X : Op N) : X = ∑ σ, coef σ X • pstr σ
theorems.description: **Every operator on `N` systems is `Σ_σ c_σ(X) P_σ`.**

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.eq_zero_of_coef
theorems.statement: theorem eq_zero_of_coef {N : ℕ} (X : Op N) (h : ∀ σ, coef σ X = 0) : X = 0
theorems.description: An operator all of whose coefficients vanish is zero.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.tpow_conj_pstr
theorems.statement:
theorem tpow_conj_pstr {N : ℕ} (U : Matrix Four Four ℂ) (s : Fin 16 → ℂ) (π : Fin 16 → Fin 16)
    (hU : ∀ k, Uᴴ * obs k * U = s k • obs (π k)) (σ : Fin N → Fin 16) :
    (tpow N U)ᴴ * pstr σ * tpow N U = (∏ i, s (σ i)) • pstr (π ∘ σ)
theorems.description: **Conjugating a string by `U^{⊗N}`**, when `U†X_kU = s_k X_{π k}` on the sixteen.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.coef_of_commute
theorems.statement:
theorem coef_of_commute {N : ℕ} (U : Matrix Four Four ℂ) (hu : U * Uᴴ = 1) (s : Fin 16 → ℂ)
    (π : Fin 16 → Fin 16) (hU : ∀ k, Uᴴ * obs k * U = s k • obs (π k)) (X : Op N)
    (hX : X * tpow N U = tpow N U * X) (σ : Fin N → Fin 16) :
    coef σ X = (∏ i, s (σ i)) * coef (π ∘ σ) X
theorems.description:
**The coefficients of a kept operator:** if `X` commutes with `U^{⊗N}` for a unitary `U` with
`U†X_kU = s_k X_{π k}`, then `c_σ(X) = (∏ s_{σ_i}) c_{π∘σ}(X)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.mem_keptAlg
theorems.statement: theorem mem_keptAlg {N : ℕ} (X : Op N) : X ∈ keptAlg N ↔ KeptN N X

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.permOp_mul_apply

theorems.description: **Every swap of the systems is kept by every `U^{⊗N}`.**

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.upd2_a
theorems.statement:
theorem upd2_a {N : ℕ} (w : Fin N → Four) {a b : Fin N} (hab : a ≠ b) (x y : Four) :

theorems.statement: theorem upd2_b {N : ℕ} (w : Fin N → Four) (a b : Fin N) (x y : Four) : upd2 w a b x y b = y

theorems.statement:

    (hcb : c ≠ b) : upd2 w a b x y c = w c

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.sum_agree
theorems.statement:
theorem sum_agree {N : ℕ} {a b : Fin N} (hab : a ≠ b) (w : Fin N → Four)
    (f : (Fin N → Four) → ℂ) :
    ∑ u, (if (∀ c, c ≠ a → c ≠ b → w c = u c) then f u else 0) =
      ∑ p : Four × Four, f (upd2 w a b p.1 p.2)
theorems.description: **The sum over the states that agree with `w` off `a` and `b`.**

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.sum_agree'
theorems.statement:
theorem sum_agree' {N : ℕ} {a b : Fin N} (hab : a ≠ b) (v : Fin N → Four)
    (f : (Fin N → Four) → ℂ) :
    ∑ u, (if (∀ c, c ≠ a → c ≠ b → u c = v c) then f u else 0) =
      ∑ p : Four × Four, f (upd2 v a b p.1 p.2)
theorems.description: The same sum, with the fixed state on the right.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.prod_upd2
theorems.statement:
theorem prod_upd2 {N : ℕ} {a b : Fin N} (hab : a ≠ b) (w : Fin N → Four) (x y : Four)
    (g : Fin N → Four → ℂ) :
    ∏ i, g i (upd2 w a b x y i) =
      g a x * (g b y * ∏ i ∈ (Finset.univ.erase a).erase b, g i (w i))
theorems.description: **The product over the systems, with `a`, `b` set to `x`, `y`.**

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.Eab_mul_tpow
theorems.statement:
theorem Eab_mul_tpow {N : ℕ} {a b : Fin N} (hab : a ≠ b) (U : Matrix Four Four ℂ)
    (w v : Fin N → Four) :
    (Eab a b * tpow N U) w v =
      J (w a) (w b) * ((Uᵀ * J * U) (v a) (v b) * restProd a b U w v)

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.tpow_mul_Eab
theorems.statement:
theorem tpow_mul_Eab {N : ℕ} {a b : Fin N} (hab : a ≠ b) (U : Matrix Four Four ℂ)
    (w v : Fin N → Four) :
    (tpow N U * Eab a b) w v =
      J (v a) (v b) * ((U * J * Uᵀ) (w a) (w b) * restProd a b U w v)

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.transpose_keeps_J
theorems.statement: theorem transpose_keeps_J (U : Matrix Four Four ℂ) (hJ : U * J * Uᵀ = J) : Uᵀ * J * U = J
theorems.description: `Uᵀ J U = J` for every unitary `U` with `U J Uᵀ = J`.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.Eab_commute
theorems.statement:
theorem Eab_commute {N : ℕ} {a b : Fin N} (hab : a ≠ b) (U : Matrix Four Four ℂ)
    (hJ : U * J * Uᵀ = J) : Eab a b * tpow N U = tpow N U * Eab a b
theorems.description: **The pairing `E` of two of `N` systems is kept by every rotation of `Sp(2)`.**

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.brauer_kept
theorems.statement: theorem brauer_kept (N : ℕ) : brauerAlg N ≤ keptAlg N
theorems.description:
**The easy half of Proposition 15, for every `N`:** every sum of products of swaps and pairings is
kept by every rotation of `Sp(2)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.keptOne_eq
theorems.statement: theorem keptOne_eq : keptOne = Submodule.span ℂ {(1 : Matrix Four Four ℂ)}

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.finrank_keptOne
theorems.statement: theorem finrank_keptOne : finrank ℂ keptOne = 1

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.one_swap_E_linearIndependent
theorems.statement:
theorem one_swap_E_linearIndependent :
    LinearIndependent ℂ ![(1 : Matrix Two Two ℂ), swap, Eop]

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.keptTwo_eq
theorems.statement: theorem keptTwo_eq : keptTwo = Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range ![(1 : Matrix Two Two ℂ), swap, Eop])

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.finrank_keptTwo
theorems.statement: theorem finrank_keptTwo : finrank ℂ keptTwo = 3

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.kept_up_to_two
theorems.statement:
theorem Geometry.kept_up_to_two :
    (∀ N : ℕ, ∀ X ∈ brauerAlg N, KeptN N X) ∧
    (∀ (N : ℕ) (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin N)), KeptN N (permOp π)) ∧
    (∀ (N : ℕ) (a b : Fin N), a ≠ b → KeptN N (Eab a b)) ∧
    keptOne = Submodule.span ℂ {(1 : Matrix Four Four ℂ)} ∧ finrank ℂ keptOne = 1 ∧
    keptTwo = Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range ![(1 : Matrix Two Two ℂ), swap, Eop]) ∧
    LinearIndependent ℂ ![(1 : Matrix Two Two ℂ), swap, Eop] ∧ finrank ℂ keptTwo = 3
theorems.description:
**Proposition 15 (swaps and the singlet make every kept operator), the parts proved.** For every
number `N` of systems, every swap `P_π` and every pairing `E_ab` (`|J⟩⟨J|` on the systems `a ≠ b`, the
singlet between them), and so every sum of products of them, commutes with every `U^{⊗N}`,
`U ∈ Sp(2)`; on one system the kept operators are the multiples of `1`, dimension 1; on two systems they
are `a + bP + cE`, with `1, P, E` independent, dimension 3. The converse on three and four systems, with the
dimensions 14 and 84, is `prop_15` (`System/Geometry/KeptAll.lean`); every `N ≥ 5`, the first fundamental theorem of
invariant theory for `Sp(2)`, is the statement that completes Prop. 15. Recognition: none.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.prop_15
theorems.statement:
theorem prop_15 :
    ((∀ N : ℕ, ∀ X ∈ brauerAlg N, KeptN N X) ∧
      (∀ (N : ℕ) (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin N)), KeptN N (permOp π)) ∧
      (∀ (N : ℕ) (a b : Fin N), a ≠ b → KeptN N (Eab a b)) ∧
      keptOne = Submodule.span ℂ {(1 : Matrix Four Four ℂ)} ∧ finrank ℂ keptOne = 1 ∧
      keptTwo = Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range ![(1 : Matrix Two Two ℂ), swap, Eop]) ∧
      LinearIndependent ℂ ![(1 : Matrix Two Two ℂ), swap, Eop] ∧ finrank ℂ keptTwo = 3) ∧
    ((∀ X : Op 3, KeptN 3 X ↔ X ∈ brauerAlg 3) ∧ finrank ℂ (keptN 3) = 14 ∧
      keptN 3 = Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range B3) ∧ LinearIndependent ℂ B3) ∧
    ((∀ X : Op 4, KeptN 4 X ↔ X ∈ brauerAlg 4) ∧ finrank ℂ (keptN 4) = 84 ∧
      keptN 4 = Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range B4) ∧ LinearIndependent ℂ B4)
theorems.description:
**Proposition 15 (swaps and the singlet make every kept operator).** For every number `N` of systems,
every element of the algebra of swaps and pairings (`brauerAlg N`), every swap and every pairing is kept
by every `U^{⊗N}`, `U ∈ Sp(2)`; the kept operators are `ℂ1` on one system (dimension 1), `span{1, P, E}`
on two (independent, dimension 3), and on three and on four systems exactly the sums of products of swaps
and pairings, of dimensions 14 and 84, spanned by independent products. Status: partial; every `N ≥ 5` is
missing (the first fundamental theorem of invariant theory for `Sp(2)`). Recognition: none.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.pauliSignT_cases

    (hz : z = 1 ∨ z = -1) (hw : w = 1 ∨ w = -1) :
    (x * y * z * w = 1 ∨ x * y * z * w = -1) ∧ (x * y * z * w = 1 → w = x * y * z)

theorems.statement: theorem cert4_unique (a b c d : Fin 16) (h : CharTriv4 a b c d) : d = third4T a b c

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.cert4_step
theorems.statement:
theorem cert4_step : ∀ a b c : Fin 16, dep4T a b c = 0 ∨
    (dep4T (cliffPermT (gen4T a b c) a) (cliffPermT (gen4T a b c) b) (cliffPermT (gen4T a b c) c) <
        dep4T a b c ∧
      cliffPermT (gen4T a b c) (third4T a b c) =
        third4T (cliffPermT (gen4T a b c) a) (cliffPermT (gen4T a b c) b)
          (cliffPermT (gen4T a b c) c) ∧
      root4T (cliffPermT (gen4T a b c) a) (cliffPermT (gen4T a b c) b)
          (cliffPermT (gen4T a b c) c) = root4T a b c ∧
      sgn4T a b c = cliffSignT (gen4T a b c) a * cliffSignT (gen4T a b c) b *
        cliffSignT (gen4T a b c) c * cliffSignT (gen4T a b c) (third4T a b c) *
          sgn4T (cliffPermT (gen4T a b c) a) (cliffPermT (gen4T a b c) b)
            (cliffPermT (gen4T a b c) c))

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.cert4_rep
theorems.statement:
theorem cert4_rep : ∀ a b c : Fin 16, dep4T a b c = 0 →
    rep4A (root4T a b c) = a ∧ rep4B (root4T a b c) = b ∧ rep4C (root4T a b c) = c ∧

theorems.statement:
theorem coef4_root (X : Op 4) (hX : KeptN 4 X) (a b c : Fin 16) :

theorems.description:
**The coefficients of a kept operator on four systems along the trivial-character strings are
`±` those of the 99 roots.**

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.coef4_eq
theorems.statement:
theorem coef4_eq (X : Op 4) (hX : KeptN 4 X) (σ : Fin 4 → Fin 16) :

      ((sgn4T (σ 0) (σ 1) (σ 2) : ℤ) : ℂ) * coef (repStr4 (root4T (σ 0) (σ 1) (σ 2))) X else 0
theorems.description: **Every coefficient of a kept operator on four systems is `±` a root coefficient or zero.**

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.kronN_update_apply

    kronN (Function.update A i B) w v = B (w i) (v i) * ∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, A j (w j) (v j)

theorem commFZ : ∀ k : Fin 16,

`Σ_i μ(ρ_i) c_{ρ[i ↦ κ(ρ_i)]}(X) = 0`.

are exactly the sums of products of swaps and pairings; they form a space of dimension 84, spanned by
84 products (permutations, `P_πE₀₁P_ρ`, `P_πE₀₁E₂₃P_ρ`), which are independent. Recognition: none.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.cliff_conjZ

      ((2 * cliffSignT f k : ℤ) : GaussianInt) • obsZ (cliffPermT f k)
theorems.description: **The quarter turns on the sixteen:** `(1 − F)X_k(1 + F) = 2s_kX_{π k}`, `F = γ_aγ_b`.

the six permutations and eight products `P_πE₀₁P_ρ`, which are independent. Recognition: none.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.anticomm_of_P3H
theorems.statement:
theorem anticomm_of_P3H {H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H]
    [FiniteDimensional ℂ H] (T : Partner H) (hT : T.P3H) {a b : H →ₗ[ℂ] H}
    (ha : T.IsDistinctionH a) (hb : T.IsDistinctionH b) :
    a * b + b * a = (2 * τH (a * b)) • (1 : H →ₗ[ℂ] H)
theorems.description:
**Polarization of P3 (b):** on every system whose distinctions square to numbers,
`ab + ba = 2τ(ab)·1` for all distinctions `a, b`.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.τ_gamma_mul
theorems.statement: theorem τ_gamma_mul (n m : Fin 5 → ℝ) : τ (gamma n * gamma m) = ((∑ s, n s * m s : ℝ) : ℂ)
theorems.description: On the model, `τ(γ(n)γ(m)) = n·m`.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.anticomm_distinction

theorem anticomm_distinction {a b : Matrix Four Four ℂ} (ha : IsDistinction a)

theorems.description: **On the model, `ab + ba = 2τ(ab)·1` for all distinctions.**
