theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.gamma_frameVec_conj
theorems.statement:
theorem gamma_frameVec_conj (U : GroupsContinuumLaw.Sp2) (x : GroupsContinuumLaw.E5) :
    GroupsContinuumLaw.gE (GroupsContinuumLaw.rotV U x) =
      GroupsContinuumLaw.mat U * GroupsContinuumLaw.gE x * star (GroupsContinuumLaw.mat U)

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.prod_conj
theorems.statement:
theorem prod_conj (A : Matrix Four Four ℂ) (hA : star A * A = 1) (g : Fin 5 → Matrix Four Four ℂ) :
    (A * g 0 * star A) * (A * g 1 * star A) * (A * g 2 * star A) * (A * g 3 * star A) *
        (A * g 4 * star A) = A * (g 0 * g 1 * g 2 * g 3 * g 4) * star A

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.gamma_frame_prod
theorems.statement:
theorem gamma_frame_prod (m : Fin 5 → Fin 5 → ℝ)
    (hm : ∀ i j, ∑ s, m i s * m j s = if i = j then 1 else 0) :
    gamma (m 0) * gamma (m 1) * gamma (m 2) * gamma (m 3) * gamma (m 4) =
      (((Matrix.of m).det : ℝ) : ℂ) • (1 : Matrix Four Four ℂ) ∧
    ((Matrix.of m).det = 1 ∨ (Matrix.of m).det = -1)
theorems.description:
**Five orthonormal lines multiply to `det(m)·1`:** for every orthonormal basis `m₁, …, m₅` of
`Q = ℝ⁵`, `γ(m₁)⋯γ(m₅) = det(m)·1`, which is `+1` for one orientation of the five and `−1` for
the other.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.rank_side
theorems.statement: theorem rank_side (n : Fin 5 → ℝ) (hn : ∑ s, n s ^ 2 = 1) : (side n).rank = 2
theorems.description: **Each side of a line has two dimensions:** `rank Q_n = 2`.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.prop_4
theorems.statement:
theorem prop_4 :
    (∀ S : CandidateSystem, ∀ a ∈ S.Q, ∀ b ∈ S.Q,
      a * b + b * a = (2 * τH (a * b)) • (1 : S.H →ₗ[ℂ] S.H)) ∧
    (∀ a b : Matrix Four Four ℂ, IsDistinction a → IsDistinction b →
      a * b + b * a = (2 * τ (a * b)) • (1 : Matrix Four Four ℂ)) ∧
    (∀ s t : Fin 5, γ s * γ t + γ t * γ s = (if s = t then (2 : ℂ) else 0) • (1 : Matrix Four Four ℂ)) ∧
    γ 0 * γ 1 * γ 2 * γ 3 * γ 4 = 1 ∧
    (∀ m : Fin 5 → Fin 5 → ℝ, (∀ i j, ∑ s, m i s * m j s = if i = j then 1 else 0) →
      gamma (m 0) * gamma (m 1) * gamma (m 2) * gamma (m 3) * gamma (m 4) =
        (((Matrix.of m).det : ℝ) : ℂ) • (1 : Matrix Four Four ℂ) ∧
      ((Matrix.of m).det = 1 ∨ (Matrix.of m).det = -1))
theorems.description:
**Proposition 4 (perpendicular lines anticommute).** For every candidate system, `ab + ba =
2τ(ab)·1` for all distinctions `a, b`; on the model the five directions satisfy
`γ_sγ_t + γ_tγ_s = 2δ_st` and `γ₀γ₁γ₂γ₃γ₄ = 1`, and for **every** orthonormal basis `m₁, …, m₅` of
`Q` the product `γ(m₁)⋯γ(m₅)` is `det(m)·1`, `1` for one orientation and `−1` for the other. Every
candidate system: `System.uniqueness`. Recognition: none.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.prop_5
theorems.statement:
theorem prop_5 :
    (∀ n : Fin 5 → ℝ, ∑ s, n s ^ 2 = 1 →
      side n * side n = side n ∧ side (-n) * side (-n) = side (-n) ∧ side n * side (-n) = 0 ∧
      side n + side (-n) = 1 ∧ (side n).rank = 2 ∧ (side (-n)).rank = 2 ∧
      ∀ v, side n *ᵥ Θ v = Θ (side n *ᵥ v)) ∧
    (∀ k, (obs k)ᴴ = obs k) ∧
    (∀ k l, (obs k * obs l).trace = if k = l then 4 else 0) ∧
    Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range obs) = hermitian ∧ finrank ℝ hermitian = 16
theorems.description:
**Proposition 5 (two equal sides and sixteen observables).** For every unit `n`: `Q_{±n}` are
projectors, `Q_nQ_{−n} = 0`, `Q_n + Q_{−n} = 1`, each of rank two, kept by the quaternionic structure; the one, the
five directions and the ten `iγ_sγ_t` are Hermitian, orthonormal for `τ`, and span the Hermitian
operators: `16 = 1 + 5 + 10`. Every candidate system: `System.uniqueness`. Recognition: none.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.prop_6
theorems.statement:
theorem prop_6 :
    (∀ U : Matrix.unitaryGroup Four ℂ, U ∈ Sp2 ↔
      ∀ v, (U : Matrix Four Four ℂ) *ᵥ Θ v = Θ ((U : Matrix Four Four ℂ) *ᵥ v)) ∧
    (∀ U : Matrix.unitaryGroup Four ℂ,
      U ∈ Sp2 ↔ (U : Matrix Four Four ℂ) * J * (U : Matrix Four Four ℂ)ᵀ = J) ∧
    (∀ U ∈ Sp2, (U : Matrix Four Four ℂ) * J * (U : Matrix Four Four ℂ)ᵀ = J ∧
      (U : Matrix Four Four ℂ).det = 1) ∧
    (∀ (U : Sp2) (x : GroupsContinuumLaw.E5), gamma (WithLp.ofLp (GroupsContinuumLaw.rotHom U x)) =
      GroupsContinuumLaw.mat U * gamma (WithLp.ofLp x) * star (GroupsContinuumLaw.mat U)) ∧
    (∀ U : Sp2, LinearMap.det (GroupsContinuumLaw.rotHom U).toLinearMap = 1) ∧
    (∀ φ : GroupsContinuumLaw.E5 ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] GroupsContinuumLaw.E5, LinearMap.det φ.toLinearMap = 1 →
      ∃ U : Sp2, GroupsContinuumLaw.rotHom U = φ) ∧
    (∀ U : Sp2, GroupsContinuumLaw.rotHom U = 1 ↔ GroupsContinuumLaw.mat U = 1 ∨ GroupsContinuumLaw.mat U = -1) ∧
    sp2 = Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range fun f : Fin 10 => gen (Sum.inr f)) ∧ finrank ℝ sp2 = 10
theorems.description:
**Proposition 6 (the ten rotations).** `Sp(2)`, the unitary rotations with `UJUᵀ = J`, are exactly the
unitary rotations that keep the quaternionic structure; they have determinant one, act on the lines by
`Uγ(x)U† = γ(R_U x)` with `R_U ∈ SO(5)`, every rotation of `SO(5)` is some `R_U`, and `R_U = 1`
exactly when `U = ±1`: `Sp(2)/{±1} = SO(5)`; the generators are the ten `γ_sγ_t`. Recognition: by
P2 (a) no number the geometry reports tells one line from another.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.prop_7
theorems.statement:
theorem prop_7 :
    (∀ n m : Fin 5 → ℝ, ∑ s, n s ^ 2 = 1 →
      side n * side m * side n = (((1 + ∑ s, n s * m s) / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) • side n) ∧
    (∀ n m : GroupsContinuumLaw.E5, ‖n‖ = 1 → ‖m‖ = 1 →
      (1 + inner ℝ n m) / 2 = Real.cos (InnerProductGeometry.angle n m / 2) ^ 2 ∧
      inner ℝ n m = inner ℝ m n) ∧
    (∀ (n m : Fin 5 → ℝ) (ψ : Four → ℂ), ∑ s, n s ^ 2 = 1 → normSq ψ = 1 →
      side n *ᵥ ψ = ψ → star ψ ⬝ᵥ (side m *ᵥ ψ) = (((1 + ∑ s, n s * m s) / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ))
theorems.description:
**Proposition 7 (the overlap of two sides).** For unit `n` and every `m`,
`Q_nQ_mQ_n = ((1 + n·m)/2)Q_n`; for unit `n`, `m` the number is `cos²(∠(n, m)/2)` and is the same
with `n` and `m` exchanged; for every state `ψ` on the plus side of `n` the chance
`⟨ψ, Q_mψ⟩` is `(1 + n·m)/2`. Recognition: Born's rule; the chance needs no order of the two lines.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.prop_8
theorems.statement:
theorem prop_8 :
    (∀ n : Fin 5 → ℝ, gamma n * gamma n = 1 ↔ ∑ s, n s ^ 2 = 1) ∧
    (∀ n : Fin 5 → ℝ, ∑ s, n s ^ 2 = 1 → GroupsContinuumLaw.IsQProj (side n)) ∧
    (∀ P, GroupsContinuumLaw.IsQProj P → ∃ n : Fin 5 → ℝ, ∑ s, n s ^ 2 = 1 ∧ P = side n) ∧
    Function.Injective side ∧
    Nonempty ({n : Fin 5 → ℝ // ∑ s, n s ^ 2 = 1} ≃ {P : Matrix Four Four ℂ // GroupsContinuumLaw.IsQProj P}) ∧
    (∀ ψ : Four → ℂ, normSq ψ = 1 → ∑ s, lineOf ψ s ^ 2 = 1 ∧
      side (lineOf ψ) = vecMulVec ψ (star ψ) + vecMulVec (Θ ψ) (star (Θ ψ))) ∧
    (∀ (c : ℂ) (ψ : Four → ℂ) (s : Fin 5), lineOf (c • ψ) s = Complex.normSq c * lineOf ψ s) ∧
    (∀ ψ φ : Four → ℂ, normSq ψ = 1 → normSq φ = 1 →
      (lineOf φ = lineOf ψ ↔ ∃ a b : ℂ, φ = a • ψ + b • Θ ψ))
theorems.description:
**Proposition 8 (the sphere of lines).** `γ(n)` is a line exactly when `|n| = 1`: the lines are
the unit sphere `S⁴` of `Q`; `n ↦ Q_n` is a bijection of `S⁴` onto the two-dimensional subspaces kept
by the quaternionic structure (`S⁴ = ℍP¹`); for every state `ψ`, `n(ψ) = (⟨ψ, γ_sψ⟩)_s` is a unit vector with
`Q_{n(ψ)} = |ψ⟩⟨ψ| + |Θψ⟩⟨Θψ|`, it depends on `ψ` only up to a factor, and two states have the same
line exactly when one lies in `span{ψ, Θψ}`: the fibre is `ℂP¹`. Recognition: Penrose's twistor
fibration, with the matrix `J` of the quaternionic structure a nondegenerate infinity twistor.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.J_eq_one_kron_iσy
theorems.statement: theorem J_eq_one_kron_iσy : J = (1 : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) ⊗ₖ (Complex.I • σ₂)
theorems.description: `J₀ = 1 ⊗ iσ_y`.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.prop_23
theorems.statement:
theorem prop_23 :
    J = (1 : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) ⊗ₖ (Complex.I • σ₂) ∧
    γ = ![σ₁ ⊗ₖ 1, σ₃ ⊗ₖ 1, σ₂ ⊗ₖ σ₁, σ₂ ⊗ₖ σ₂, σ₂ ⊗ₖ σ₃] ∧
    γ 0 * γ 1 * γ 2 * γ 3 * γ 4 = 1 ∧
    (∀ S : CandidateSystem, finrank ℂ S.H = 4 ∧ Nonempty S.Frame ∧
      ∀ f : S.Frame, (∀ k : Fin 2, f.b (k, 1) = -S.partner.Θ (f.b (k, 0))) ∧
        (∀ v : S.H, f.e (S.partner.Θ v) = modelΘ (f.e v)) ∧
        (∀ s, f.lines s ∈ S.Q) ∧ (∀ s, f.conj (f.lines s) = γ s) ∧
        (∀ s t, f.lines s * f.lines t + f.lines t * f.lines s =
          (if s = t then (2 : ℂ) else 0) • (1 : S.H →ₗ[ℂ] S.H)) ∧
        f.lines 0 * f.lines 1 * f.lines 2 * f.lines 3 * f.lines 4 = 1 ∧
        (∀ a ∈ S.Q, ∃! t : Fin 5 → ℝ, a = ∑ s, (t s : ℂ) • f.lines s)) ∧
    (∀ S : CandidateSystem, ∀ f f' : S.Frame, ∃ U ∈ Sp2, ∀ w : ModelH,
      f'.e (f.e.symm w) = WithLp.toLp 2 ((U : Matrix Four Four ℂ) *ᵥ WithLp.ofLp w)) ∧
    (∀ S S' : CandidateSystem,
      ∃ e : S.H ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] S'.H, ∀ v, e (S.partner.Θ v) = S'.partner.Θ (e v))
theorems.description:
**Proposition 23 (one model).** The model: `J₀ = 1 ⊗ iσ_y`, the five directions `σ_x ⊗ 1, σ_z ⊗ 1,
σ_y ⊗ σ_x, σ_y ⊗ σ_y, σ_y ⊗ σ_z` with `γ₁γ₂γ₃γ₄γ₅ = 1`. Every candidate system `S` (P1 to P3 in
mathematical form) has four complex dimensions and a basis `u₁, −Θu₁, u₂, −Θu₂` (a gauge); in every
gauge `Θv = J₀v̄` in coordinates, the five directions pulled back from the model are distinctions of `S`
with matrix `γ_s`, anticommuting and of product one, and every distinction is a unique real
combination of them; two gauges differ by one rotation of `Sp(2)`; and any two candidate systems are
isometric with quaternionic structure carried to quaternionic structure. Every candidate system: `System.uniqueness`.
Recognition: none.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.partnerMatrix_coord
theorems.statement:
theorem partnerMatrix_coord (T : Partner H) {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (b : OrthonormalBasis ι ℂ H)
    (v : H) (i : ι) :
    ⟪b i, T.Θ v⟫_ℂ = (partnerMatrix T b *ᵥ star (fun j => ⟪b j, v⟫_ℂ)) i
theorems.description: **`Θ v = J_b v̄` in every orthonormal basis.**

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.partnerMatrix_transpose
theorems.statement:
theorem partnerMatrix_transpose (T : Partner H) {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (b : OrthonormalBasis ι ℂ H) : (partnerMatrix T b)ᵀ = -partnerMatrix T b
theorems.description: **The matrix of the quaternionic structure is antisymmetric in every orthonormal basis:** `J_bᵀ = −J_b`.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.partnerMatrix_unitary
theorems.statement:
theorem partnerMatrix_unitary (T : Partner H) {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (b : OrthonormalBasis ι ℂ H) : (partnerMatrix T b)ᴴ * partnerMatrix T b = 1
theorems.description: **The matrix of the quaternionic structure is unitary in every orthonormal basis.**

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.partnerMatrix_normal
theorems.statement:
theorem partnerMatrix_normal (T : Partner H) {n : ℕ} (b : OrthonormalBasis (Fin n × Fin 2) ℂ H)
    (hb : ∀ k, b (k, 1) = -T.Θ (b (k, 0))) : partnerMatrix T b = Jn n
theorems.description: **In a normal basis the matrix of the quaternionic structure is `J_n = diag(ε, …, ε)`.**

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.imulR_apply
theorems.statement: theorem imulR_apply (v : H) : (imulR : Module.End ℝ H) v = Complex.I • v

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.partnerR_apply
theorems.statement: theorem partnerR_apply (T : Partner H) (v : H) : partnerR T v = T.Θ v

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.quatAction_apply
theorems.statement:
theorem quatAction_apply (T : Partner H) (q : ℍ[ℝ]) (v : H) :
    quatAction T q v = q.re • v + q.imI • (Complex.I • v) + q.imJ • T.Θ v +
      q.imK • (Complex.I • T.Θ v)

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.smul_eq_complex
theorems.statement: theorem smul_eq_complex (r : ℝ) (v : H) : r • v = (r : ℂ) • v

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.quatAction_eq
theorems.statement:
theorem quatAction_eq (T : Partner H) (q : ℍ[ℝ]) (v : H) :
    quatAction T q v = (⟨q.re, q.imI⟩ : ℂ) • v + (⟨q.imJ, q.imK⟩ : ℂ) • T.Θ v
theorems.description: The quaternion `q` acts as `α v + β Θv`, `α = re + imI i`, `β = imJ + imK i`.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.quatCoords_normal
theorems.statement:
theorem quatCoords_normal (T : Partner H) {n : ℕ} (b : OrthonormalBasis (Fin n × Fin 2) ℂ H)
    (hb : ∀ k, b (k, 1) = -T.Θ (b (k, 0))) (q : Fin n → ℍ[ℝ]) :
    quatCoords T (fun k => b (k, 0)) q =
      ∑ k, ((⟨(q k).re, (q k).imI⟩ : ℂ) • b (k, 0) - (⟨(q k).imJ, (q k).imK⟩ : ℂ) • b (k, 1))

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.quatCoords_bijective
theorems.statement:
theorem quatCoords_bijective (T : Partner H) {n : ℕ} (b : OrthonormalBasis (Fin n × Fin 2) ℂ H)
    (hb : ∀ k, b (k, 1) = -T.Θ (b (k, 0))) :
    Function.Bijective (quatCoords T (fun k => b (k, 0)))
theorems.description: **`H = ℍⁿ`:** in a normal basis the quaternionic coordinates are a bijection `ℍⁿ → H`.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.quatCoords_mul
theorems.statement:
theorem quatCoords_mul (T : Partner H) {n : ℕ} (u : Fin n → H) (p : ℍ[ℝ]) (q : Fin n → ℍ[ℝ]) :
    quatCoords T u (fun k => p * q k) = quatAction T p (quatCoords T u q)
theorems.description: **`H` is a left `ℍ`-module through the coordinates.**

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.matR_apply
theorems.statement:
theorem matR_apply {n : ℕ} (b : OrthonormalBasis (Fin n × Fin 2) ℂ H) (a : H →ₗ[ℂ] H) :
    matR b a = LinearMap.toMatrixOrthonormal b a

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.map_distinctionsH
theorems.statement:
theorem map_distinctionsH (T : Partner H) {n : ℕ} (b : OrthonormalBasis (Fin n × Fin 2) ℂ H)
    (hb : ∀ k, b (k, 1) = -T.Θ (b (k, 0))) :
    (distinctionsH T).map (matR b).toLinearMap = Comparison.Article.distinctions n
theorems.description: In a normal basis the distinctions of `(H, Θ)` are carried onto the model's.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.finrank_distinctionsH
theorems.statement:
theorem finrank_distinctionsH (T : Partner H) {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n)
    (hdim : finrank ℂ H = 2 * n) : finrank ℝ (distinctionsH T) = 2 * n ^ 2 - n - 1
theorems.description: **`dim Q = 2n² − n − 1`** for every system with `dim H = 2n`, `n ≥ 1`.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.qstar_smul
theorems.statement: theorem qstar_smul (r : ℝ) (q : ℍ[ℝ]) : star (r • q) = r • star q

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.qblockMat_add
theorems.statement:
theorem qblockMat_add {n : ℕ} (M N : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℍ[ℝ]) :
    qblockMat (M + N) = qblockMat M + qblockMat N

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.qblockMat_smul
theorems.statement:
theorem qblockMat_smul {n : ℕ} (r : ℝ) (M : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℍ[ℝ]) :
    qblockMat (r • M) = r • qblockMat M

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.qblockMat_injective
theorems.statement: theorem qblockMat_injective {n : ℕ} : Function.Injective (qblockMat (n := n))

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.trace_qblockMat
theorems.statement:
theorem trace_qblockMat {n : ℕ} (M : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℍ[ℝ]) :
    (qblockMat M).trace = ((2 * (M.trace).re : ℝ) : ℂ)

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.qblockMat_conjTranspose
theorems.statement:
theorem qblockMat_conjTranspose {n : ℕ} (M : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℍ[ℝ]) :
    (qblockMat M)ᴴ = qblockMat Mᴴ

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.qblockMat_commutes
theorems.statement:
theorem qblockMat_commutes {n : ℕ} (M : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℍ[ℝ]) :
    qblockMat M * Jn n = Jn n * (qblockMat M).map star

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.qblockMat_mem_iff
theorems.statement:
theorem qblockMat_mem_iff {n : ℕ} (M : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℍ[ℝ]) :
    IsDistinctionN n (qblockMat M) ↔ M ∈ hermZeroQ n
theorems.description: **The distinctions of the model `ℂ^{2n}` are the blocks of `Herm₀(ℍⁿ)`.**

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.exists_qblockMat
theorems.statement:
theorem exists_qblockMat {n : ℕ} (a : Matrix (Fin n × Fin 2) (Fin n × Fin 2) ℂ)
    (ha : IsDistinctionN n a) : ∃ M, qblockMat M = a
theorems.description: Every distinction of the model `ℂ^{2n}` is a quaternionic block matrix.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.toDistinctions_apply
theorems.statement:
theorem toDistinctions_apply (n : ℕ) (M : hermZeroQ n) :
    (toDistinctions n M : Matrix (Fin n × Fin 2) (Fin n × Fin 2) ℂ) = qblockMat M.1

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.τH_smul_one

source_context.command: variable {H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [FiniteDimensional ℂ H]

theorems.statement: theorem τH_smul_one (c : ℂ) (h : finrank ℂ H ≠ 0) : τH (c • (1 : H →ₗ[ℂ] H)) = c

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.finrank_ne_zero_of_exists

source_context.command: variable {H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [FiniteDimensional ℂ H]

theorems.statement:
theorem finrank_ne_zero_of_exists (T : Partner H) (h : ∃ a, T.IsDistinctionH a ∧ a ≠ 0) :
    finrank ℂ H ≠ 0

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.P3H_iff_tau

source_context.command: variable {H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [FiniteDimensional ℂ H]

theorems.statement:
theorem P3H_iff_tau (T : Partner H) :
    T.P3H ↔ ((∃ a, T.IsDistinctionH a ∧ a ≠ 0) ∧
      ∀ a, T.IsDistinctionH a → a * a = τH (a * a) • (1 : H →ₗ[ℂ] H))
theorems.description: P3 (b) with `a² = c·1`, `c` real, is P3 (b) with `a² = τ(a²)·1`.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.prop_1
theorems.statement:
theorem prop_1 {H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [FiniteDimensional ℂ H]
    (T : Partner H) :
    (∀ v : H, ⟪v, T.Θ v⟫_ℂ = 0 ∧ ‖T.Θ v‖ = ‖v‖) ∧
    (∀ {ι : Type} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (b : OrthonormalBasis ι ℂ H),
      (∀ v i, ⟪b i, T.Θ v⟫_ℂ = (partnerMatrix T b *ᵥ star (fun j => ⟪b j, v⟫_ℂ)) i) ∧
      (partnerMatrix T b)ᴴ * partnerMatrix T b = 1 ∧
      (partnerMatrix T b)ᵀ = -partnerMatrix T b) ∧
    (∀ v : H, T.Θ (Complex.I • v) = -(Complex.I • T.Θ v)) ∧
    (∀ v : H, quatAction T ⟨0, 1, 0, 0⟩ v = Complex.I • v ∧ quatAction T ⟨0, 0, 1, 0⟩ v = T.Θ v ∧
      quatAction T ⟨0, 0, 0, 1⟩ v = Complex.I • T.Θ v) ∧
    ∃ n : ℕ, ∃ b : OrthonormalBasis (Fin n × Fin 2) ℂ H,
      (∀ k, b (k, 1) = -T.Θ (b (k, 0))) ∧ finrank ℂ H = 2 * n ∧ partnerMatrix T b = Jn n ∧
      Function.Bijective (quatCoords T (fun k => b (k, 0))) ∧
      ∀ (p : ℍ[ℝ]) (q : Fin n → ℍ[ℝ]), quatCoords T (fun k => b (k, 0)) (fun k => p * q k) =
        quatAction T p (quatCoords T (fun k => b (k, 0)) q)
theorems.description:
**Proposition 1 (the quaternionic structure).** For every system `H` with a quaternionic structure `Θ` (P1, P3 (a)): every
state is perpendicular to its conjugate and as long, `⟨v, Θv⟩ = 0`, `‖Θv‖ = ‖v‖`; in **every**
orthonormal basis `b` the quaternionic structure reads `Θv = J_b v̄` with `J_b` unitary and `J_bᵀ = −J_b`;
`Θ(iv) = −iΘv`; and there is a basis `u₁, −Θu₁, …, u_n, −Θu_n` in which the matrix of the quaternionic structure
is `J_n = diag(ε, …, ε)`, so `dim H = 2n`; in it the quaternions act (`i ↦ i·`, `j ↦ Θ`,
`k ↦ iΘ`, an algebra map) and the coordinates `ℍⁿ → H` are a bijection of `ℍ`-modules: `H = ℍⁿ`.
Recognition: none.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.prop_2
theorems.statement:
theorem prop_2 {H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [FiniteDimensional ℂ H]
    (T : Partner H) {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (hdim : finrank ℂ H = 2 * n) :
    finrank ℝ (distinctionsH T) = 2 * n ^ 2 - n - 1 ∧
      Nonempty (distinctionsH T ≃ₗ[ℝ] hermZeroQ n)
theorems.description:
**Proposition 2 (the distinctions).** For every system `(H, Θ)` with `dim H = 2n`, `n ≥ 1`, the
distinctions form a real space of dimension `2n² − n − 1`, isomorphic to `Herm₀(ℍⁿ)`, the Hermitian
`n × n` matrices of quaternions with trace zero. Recognition: none.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.prop_3
theorems.statement:
theorem prop_3 {H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [FiniteDimensional ℂ H]
    (T : Partner H) :
    (((∃ a ∈ distinctionsH T, a ≠ 0) ∧
        ∀ a ∈ distinctionsH T, a * a = τH (a * a) • (1 : H →ₗ[ℂ] H)) ↔ finrank ℂ H = 4) ∧
      (finrank ℂ H = 4 → finrank ℝ (distinctionsH T) = 5)
theorems.description:
**Proposition 3 (four amplitudes and five lines).** For every system `(H, Θ)`: some distinction is
not zero and every distinction squares to `τ(a²)·1` exactly when `dim H = 4`; then `dim Q = 5`. For a
candidate system this is the first two items of `System.uniqueness`. Recognition: none.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.rotMat_sum

    ∑ c, ((rotMat p d c : ℤ) : ℂ) * w c =
      if d = p.2 then 2 * w p.1 else if d = p.1 then -2 * w p.2 else 0
theorems.description:
The rotation of the plane `p` on coordinates: `w_{p.1}` goes to `2w_{p.1}` at `p.2`, `w_{p.2}`
to `−2w_{p.2}` at `p.1`.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.realFormAlg_subset_span

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.realFormAlg_ofSet
theorems.statement:
theorem realFormAlg_ofSet (S : Finset (Fin 6)) :
    realFormAlg (projOf S) = (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range (realGen6 S)) : Set (Matrix Four Four ℂ))
theorems.description:
**Definition 15's real form in a basis:** for every set `S` of directions of P1's real six, the
generators of the real form of the division `S` (trace zero, `X ⊗ 1 + 1 ⊗ X` keeps `q_S(ℝ⁶)`) are
exactly the real combinations of the kept rotations and `i` times the moved rotations.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.realGen6_linearIndependent
theorems.statement: theorem realGen6_linearIndependent (S : Finset (Fin 6)) : LinearIndependent ℂ (realGen6 S)

theorem finrank_realFormSpan (S : Finset (Fin 6)) :

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.realFormAlg_compl
theorems.statement:
theorem realFormAlg_compl (S : Finset (Fin 6)) :
    realFormAlg (projOf Sᶜ) = realFormAlg (projOf S)
theorems.description: Calling the other part divided gives the same real form: `realFormAlg (P_{Sᶜ}) = realFormAlg (P_S)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.realFormAlg_lines
theorems.statement:
theorem realFormAlg_lines (D : Finset (Fin 5)) :
    realFormAlg (projOf (linesDiv D)) =
      (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range (realGen D)) : Set (Matrix Four Four ℂ))
theorems.description: **The real form of the division of the lines `D` is the real span of the Lemma's fifteen.**

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.realFormAlg_lines_even
theorems.statement:
theorem realFormAlg_lines_even (D : Finset (Fin 5)) (hD : D.card % 2 = 0) (X : Matrix Four Four ℂ) :
    X ∈ realFormAlg (projOf (linesDiv D)) ↔
      X.trace = 0 ∧ Xᴴ * hermForm D + hermForm D * X = 0
theorems.description: **Even divisions of the lines:** Definition 15's real form is `{X : tr X = 0, X†h_D + h_DX = 0}`.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.realFormAlg_lines_odd
theorems.statement:
theorem realFormAlg_lines_odd (D : Finset (Fin 5)) (hD : D.card % 2 = 1) (X : Matrix Four Four ℂ) :
    X ∈ realFormAlg (projOf (linesDiv D)) ↔
      X.trace = 0 ∧ X * (gammaD D * J) = (gammaD D * J) * X.map star
theorems.description:
**Odd divisions of the lines:** Definition 15's real form is `{X : tr X = 0, XC_D = C_DX}`, with
`C_Dv = γ_DJv̄`.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.kept_add_moved
theorems.statement:
theorem kept_add_moved (P : Matrix (Fin 6) (Fin 6) ℝ) (hP : P * P = P)
    (X : Matrix (Fin 6) (Fin 6) ℝ) :
    X = (1 / 2 : ℝ) • (X + signOf P * X * signOf P) + (1 / 2 : ℝ) • (X - signOf P * X * signOf P) ∧
    KeptBy P ((1 / 2 : ℝ) • (X + signOf P * X * signOf P)) ∧
    MovedBy P ((1 / 2 : ℝ) • (X - signOf P * X * signOf P)) ∧
    (Pᵀ = P → Xᵀ = -X →
      ((1 / 2 : ℝ) • (X + signOf P * X * signOf P))ᵀ =
        -((1 / 2 : ℝ) • (X + signOf P * X * signOf P)) ∧
      ((1 / 2 : ℝ) • (X - signOf P * X * signOf P))ᵀ =
        -((1 / 2 : ℝ) • (X - signOf P * X * signOf P)))
theorems.description:
**Every generator is one kept plus one moved.** For every projector `P` (`P² = P`) and every
`X`, with `θ = 1 − 2P`: `X = ½(X + θXθ) + ½(X − θXθ)`, the first part kept (it commutes with `θ`) and
the second moved (it anticommutes with `θ`); for a symmetric `P` both parts of an antisymmetric `X`
are antisymmetric.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.realForm_statement
theorems.statement:
theorem Geometry.realForm_statement :
    (∀ S : Finset (Fin 6), realFormAlg (projOf S) =
      (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range (realGen6 S)) : Set (Matrix Four Four ℂ))) ∧
    (∀ S : Finset (Fin 6), LinearIndependent ℂ (realGen6 S) ∧
      finrank ℝ (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range (realGen6 S))) = 15) ∧
    (∀ S : Finset (Fin 6), realFormAlg (projOf Sᶜ) = realFormAlg (projOf S)) ∧
    (∀ D : Finset (Fin 5), D.card % 2 = 0 → ∀ X : Matrix Four Four ℂ,
      X ∈ realFormAlg (projOf (linesDiv D)) ↔
        X.trace = 0 ∧ Xᴴ * hermForm D + hermForm D * X = 0) ∧
    (∀ D : Finset (Fin 5), D.card % 2 = 1 → ∀ X : Matrix Four Four ℂ,
      X ∈ realFormAlg (projOf (linesDiv D)) ↔
        X.trace = 0 ∧ X * (gammaD D * J) = (gammaD D * J) * X.map star) ∧
    (∀ P : Matrix (Fin 6) (Fin 6) ℝ, P * P = P → ∀ X : Matrix (Fin 6) (Fin 6) ℝ,
      X = (1 / 2 : ℝ) • (X + signOf P * X * signOf P) + (1 / 2 : ℝ) • (X - signOf P * X * signOf P) ∧
      KeptBy P ((1 / 2 : ℝ) • (X + signOf P * X * signOf P)) ∧
      MovedBy P ((1 / 2 : ℝ) • (X - signOf P * X * signOf P)))
theorems.description:
**Proposition 21, the real form of a division in a basis (Definition 15, the Lemma and its
converse).** For every set `S` of directions of P1's real six, the generators of Definition 15's real
form (trace zero, `X ⊗ 1 + 1 ⊗ X` keeps `q_S(P1's real six)`) are exactly the real combinations of
the fifteen generators of the real form, the kept rotations and `i` times the moved ones, which are
independent; calling the other part divided gives the same real form; for the division of the lines
`D` with the singlet undivided it is `{X : tr X = 0, X†h_D + h_DX = 0}` (`|D|` even) or
`{X : tr X = 0, XC_D = C_DX}` (`|D|` odd); every generator of the six is one kept plus one moved.
Recognition: `su(4)`, `sl(2,ℍ)`, `su(2,2)`, `sl(4,ℝ)`, the real forms of the twistor group.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.projOf_transpose
theorems.statement: theorem projOf_transpose (S : Finset (Fin 6)) : (projOf S)ᵀ = projOf S

theorems.statement: theorem flip0_transpose : flip0ᵀ = flip0

theorems.statement: theorem flip0_projOf (S : Finset (Fin 6)) : flip0 * projOf S * flip0 = projOf S

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.exists_rot_projOf
theorems.statement:
theorem exists_rot_projOf (P : Matrix (Fin 6) (Fin 6) ℝ) (hS : Pᵀ = P) (hP : P * P = P) :
    ∃ (R : Matrix (Fin 6) (Fin 6) ℝ) (S : Finset (Fin 6)), Rᵀ * R = 1 ∧ R.det = 1 ∧
      P = R * projOf S * Rᵀ

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.matLM_apply
theorems.statement:
theorem matLM_apply (R : Matrix (Fin 6) (Fin 6) ℝ) (t : GroupsContinuumLaw.E6) :
    matLM R t = WithLp.toLp 2 (R *ᵥ WithLp.ofLp t)

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.matLI_apply
theorems.statement:
theorem matLI_apply (R : Matrix (Fin 6) (Fin 6) ℝ) (hR : Rᵀ * R = 1) (t : GroupsContinuumLaw.E6) :
    matLI R hR t = WithLp.toLp 2 (R *ᵥ WithLp.ofLp t)

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.det_matLI
theorems.statement:
theorem det_matLI (R : Matrix (Fin 6) (Fin 6) ℝ) (hR : Rᵀ * R = 1) :
    LinearMap.det (matLI R hR).toLinearMap = R.det

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.lift_rot
theorems.statement:
theorem lift_rot (R : Matrix (Fin 6) (Fin 6) ℝ) (hR : Rᵀ * R = 1) (hdet : R.det = 1) :
    ∃ U : GroupsContinuumLaw.SU4, ∀ z : Fin 6 → ℂ,
      (U : Matrix Four Four ℂ) * GroupsContinuumLaw.ιC z * (U : Matrix Four Four ℂ)ᵀ =
        GroupsContinuumLaw.ιC (R.map ((↑) : ℝ → ℂ) *ᵥ z)
theorems.description:
**Every rotation of the six lifts to an element of `SU(4)`:** for `RᵀR = 1`, `det R = 1` there is `U ∈ SU(4)`
with `U ι(z) Uᵀ = ι(Rz)` for every point `z` of the six (complex coordinates).

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.halfOf_conj
theorems.statement:
theorem halfOf_conj (P R : Matrix (Fin 6) (Fin 6) ℝ) (hR : Rᵀ * R = 1) :
    halfOf (R * P * Rᵀ) = R.map ((↑) : ℝ → ℂ) * halfOf P * Rᵀ.map ((↑) : ℝ → ℂ)

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.act_conj
theorems.statement:
theorem act_conj (U : GroupsContinuumLaw.SU4) (X A : Matrix Four Four ℂ) :
    act ((U : Matrix Four Four ℂ) * X * (U : Matrix Four Four ℂ)⁻¹)
        ((U : Matrix Four Four ℂ) * A * (U : Matrix Four Four ℂ)ᵀ) =
      (U : Matrix Four Four ℂ) * act X A * (U : Matrix Four Four ℂ)ᵀ

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.halfSix_conj
theorems.statement:
theorem halfSix_conj (P R : Matrix (Fin 6) (Fin 6) ℝ) (hR : Rᵀ * R = 1) (U : GroupsContinuumLaw.SU4)
    (hU : ∀ z : Fin 6 → ℂ, (U : Matrix Four Four ℂ) * GroupsContinuumLaw.ιC z * (U : Matrix Four Four ℂ)ᵀ =
      GroupsContinuumLaw.ιC (R.map ((↑) : ℝ → ℂ) *ᵥ z)) (A : Matrix Four Four ℂ) :
    A ∈ halfSix (R * P * Rᵀ) ↔ ∃ B ∈ halfSix P,
      A = (U : Matrix Four Four ℂ) * B * (U : Matrix Four Four ℂ)ᵀ
theorems.description: `q_{RPRᵀ}(ℝ⁶)` is the turned `q_P(ℝ⁶)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.realFormAlg_conj
theorems.statement:
theorem realFormAlg_conj (P R : Matrix (Fin 6) (Fin 6) ℝ) (hR : Rᵀ * R = 1) (U : GroupsContinuumLaw.SU4)
    (hU : ∀ z : Fin 6 → ℂ, (U : Matrix Four Four ℂ) * GroupsContinuumLaw.ιC z * (U : Matrix Four Four ℂ)ᵀ =
      GroupsContinuumLaw.ιC (R.map ((↑) : ℝ → ℂ) *ᵥ z)) (X : Matrix Four Four ℂ) :
    (U : Matrix Four Four ℂ) * X * (U : Matrix Four Four ℂ)⁻¹ ∈ realFormAlg (R * P * Rᵀ) ↔
      X ∈ realFormAlg P
theorems.description:
**Definition 15 under a rotation:** `X` is a generator of the real form of `P` exactly when `UXU⁻¹`
is one of `RPRᵀ`.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.signOf_conj
theorems.statement:
theorem signOf_conj (P R : Matrix (Fin 6) (Fin 6) ℝ) (hR : Rᵀ * R = 1) :
    signOf (R * P * Rᵀ) = R * signOf P * Rᵀ
theorems.description: Kept and moved under the rotation: `θ_{RPRᵀ} = Rθ_PRᵀ`.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.rconj_mul
theorems.statement:
theorem rconj_mul (R A B : Matrix (Fin 6) (Fin 6) ℝ) (hR : Rᵀ * R = 1) :
    (R * A * Rᵀ) * (R * B * Rᵀ) = R * (A * B) * Rᵀ

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.rconj_cancel
theorems.statement:
theorem rconj_cancel (R A B : Matrix (Fin 6) (Fin 6) ℝ) (hR : Rᵀ * R = 1)
    (h : R * A * Rᵀ = R * B * Rᵀ) : A = B

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.keptBy_conj
theorems.statement:
theorem keptBy_conj (P R X : Matrix (Fin 6) (Fin 6) ℝ) (hR : Rᵀ * R = 1) :
    KeptBy (R * P * Rᵀ) (R * X * Rᵀ) ↔ KeptBy P X

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.movedBy_conj
theorems.statement:
theorem movedBy_conj (P R X : Matrix (Fin 6) (Fin 6) ℝ) (hR : Rᵀ * R = 1) :
    MovedBy (R * P * Rᵀ) (R * X * Rᵀ) ↔ MovedBy P X

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.realFormAlg_every_division
theorems.statement:
theorem realFormAlg_every_division (P : Matrix (Fin 6) (Fin 6) ℝ) (hS : Pᵀ = P) (hP : P * P = P) :
    ∃ (S : Finset (Fin 6)) (U : GroupsContinuumLaw.SU4), ∀ X : Matrix Four Four ℂ,
      X ∈ realFormAlg P ↔
        (U : Matrix Four Four ℂ)⁻¹ * X * (U : Matrix Four Four ℂ) ∈
          (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range (realGen6 S)) : Set (Matrix Four Four ℂ))
theorems.description:
**The real form of every division** is the turned real form of a coordinate division: for every
symmetric projector `P` of the six there are a set `S` and a rotation `U ∈ SU(4)` with
`X ∈ realFormAlg P ↔ U⁻¹XU ∈ realFormAlg (P_S)`, and `realFormAlg (P_S)` is the real span of the
fifteen `realGen6 S`.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.map_star_mul
theorems.statement: theorem map_star_mul (A B : Matrix Four Four ℂ) : (A * B).map star = A.map star * B.map star

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.map_star_one
theorems.statement: theorem map_star_one : (1 : Matrix Four Four ℂ).map star = 1

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.exp_mem_formGroup
theorems.statement:
theorem exp_mem_formGroup (h X : Matrix Four Four ℂ) (hh : h * h = 1)
    (hX : Xᴴ * h + h * X = 0) (htr : X.trace = 0) :
    (NormedSpace.exp X).det = 1 ∧ (NormedSpace.exp X)ᴴ * h * NormedSpace.exp X = h
theorems.description: If `X†h + hX = 0`, `h² = 1` and `tr X = 0`, then `e^X` has determinant one and keeps `h`.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.prop_21
theorems.statement:
theorem prop_21 :
    (
      (∀ D D' : Division, Division.ByTurn D D' ↔ Division.kind D = Division.kind D') ∧
      (∀ D : Division, Division.kind D ≤ 3) ∧
      (∀ k ≤ 3, ∃ S : Finset (Fin 6), S.card = k ∧ Division.kind (Division.ofSet S) = k) ∧
      (∀ S : Finset (Fin 6), finrank ℝ (Division.ofSet S) = S.card) ∧
      (∀ D : Finset (Fin 6), (Finset.univ.filter (Kept D)).card =
        D.card.choose 2 + (6 - D.card).choose 2) ∧
      (∀ D : Finset (Fin 6), (Finset.univ.filter (Moved D)).card = D.card * (6 - D.card)) ∧
      (∀ (D : Finset (Fin 6)) (x : Fin 5 ⊕ Fin 10), Kept D x ↔ ¬ Moved D x) ∧
      (∀ (D : Finset (Fin 6)) (v : Fin 6 → ℝ),
        metricOf (Matrix.diagonal fun a => if a ∈ D then (1 : ℝ) else 0) v =
          ((∑ a, (if a ∈ D then 0 else v a ^ 2) - ∑ a, (if a ∈ D then v a ^ 2 else 0) : ℝ) : ℂ)) ∧
      (∀ D : Finset (Fin 5), D.card % 2 = 0 → ∀ x : Fin 5 ⊕ Fin 10,
        (realGen D x)ᴴ * hermForm D + hermForm D * realGen D x = 0) ∧
      (∀ D : Finset (Fin 5), D.card % 2 = 0 →
        (hermForm D)ᴴ = hermForm D ∧ hermForm D * hermForm D = 1 ∧
        (D.card ≠ 0 → (hermForm D).trace = 0)) ∧
      (∀ D : Finset (Fin 5), D.card % 2 = 1 → ∀ (x : Fin 5 ⊕ Fin 10) (v : Four → ℂ),
        realGen D x *ᵥ Cop D v = Cop D (realGen D x *ᵥ v)) ∧
      (∀ (D : Finset (Fin 5)) (v : Four → ℂ), Cop D (Cop D v) = (countSign D.card : ℂ) • v) ∧
      countSign 1 = -1 ∧ countSign 3 = 1 ∧ countSign 5 = -1 ∧
      (∀ v : Fin 6 → ℝ, GroupsContinuumLaw.OnCone v → GroupsContinuumLaw.r2 v = 1 →
        ∀ i j, GroupsContinuumLaw.g6 (GroupsContinuumLaw.frame v i) (GroupsContinuumLaw.frame v j) =
          if i = j then (if i = 0 then 1 else -1) else 0) ∧
      (∀ D : Finset (Fin 5), LinearIndependent ℂ (realGen D)) ∧
      (∀ D : Finset (Fin 5), D.card % 2 = 0 → ∀ X : Matrix Four Four ℂ,
        (X.trace = 0 ∧ Xᴴ * hermForm D + hermForm D * X = 0) ↔
          X ∈ Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range (realGen D))) ∧
      (∀ D : Finset (Fin 5), D.card % 2 = 1 → ∀ X : Matrix Four Four ℂ,
        (X.trace = 0 ∧ X * (gammaD D * J) = (gammaD D * J) * X.map star) ↔
          X ∈ Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range (realGen D))) ∧
      (∀ ε : Fin 6 → ℝ, (∀ i, ε i = 1 ∨ ε i = -1) → ∀ X : Matrix (Fin 6) (Fin 6) ℝ, Xᵀ = -X →
        (GroupsContinuumLaw.realFormMap ε X)ᵀ * Matrix.diagonal ε +
          Matrix.diagonal ε * GroupsContinuumLaw.realFormMap ε X = 0) ∧
      (∀ ε : Fin 6 → ℝ, (∀ i, ε i = 1 ∨ ε i = -1) → ∀ Y : Matrix (Fin 6) (Fin 6) ℝ,
        Yᵀ * Matrix.diagonal ε + Matrix.diagonal ε * Y = 0 →
          (GroupsContinuumLaw.realFormMap ε Y)ᵀ = -GroupsContinuumLaw.realFormMap ε Y ∧
            GroupsContinuumLaw.realFormMap ε (GroupsContinuumLaw.realFormMap ε Y) = Y) ∧
      (∀ (p q : ℕ) (v w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin p) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin q)), v ≠ 0 →
        ‖v.1‖ = ‖v.2‖ → w ≠ 0 → ‖w.1‖ = ‖w.2‖ →
          ((∃ c : ℝ, c ≠ 0 ∧ w = c • v) ↔
            (GroupsContinuumLaw.nrmPQ w = GroupsContinuumLaw.nrmPQ v ∨ GroupsContinuumLaw.nrmPQ w = -GroupsContinuumLaw.nrmPQ v))) ∧
      (∀ (p q : ℕ) (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin p) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin q)), v ≠ 0 →
        ‖v.1‖ = ‖v.2‖ → 0 < ‖v.1‖ ∧ ‖(GroupsContinuumLaw.nrmPQ v).1‖ = 1 ∧ ‖(GroupsContinuumLaw.nrmPQ v).2‖ = 1)
    ) ∧
    (
      (∀ S : Finset (Fin 6), realFormAlg (projOf S) =
        (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range (realGen6 S)) : Set (Matrix Four Four ℂ))) ∧
      (∀ S : Finset (Fin 6), LinearIndependent ℂ (realGen6 S) ∧
        finrank ℝ (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range (realGen6 S))) = 15) ∧
      (∀ S : Finset (Fin 6), realFormAlg (projOf Sᶜ) = realFormAlg (projOf S)) ∧
      (∀ D : Finset (Fin 5), D.card % 2 = 0 → ∀ X : Matrix Four Four ℂ,
        X ∈ realFormAlg (projOf (linesDiv D)) ↔
          X.trace = 0 ∧ Xᴴ * hermForm D + hermForm D * X = 0) ∧
      (∀ D : Finset (Fin 5), D.card % 2 = 1 → ∀ X : Matrix Four Four ℂ,
        X ∈ realFormAlg (projOf (linesDiv D)) ↔
          X.trace = 0 ∧ X * (gammaD D * J) = (gammaD D * J) * X.map star) ∧
      (∀ P : Matrix (Fin 6) (Fin 6) ℝ, P * P = P → ∀ X : Matrix (Fin 6) (Fin 6) ℝ,
        X = (1 / 2 : ℝ) • (X + signOf P * X * signOf P) + (1 / 2 : ℝ) • (X - signOf P * X * signOf P) ∧
        KeptBy P ((1 / 2 : ℝ) • (X + signOf P * X * signOf P)) ∧
        MovedBy P ((1 / 2 : ℝ) • (X - signOf P * X * signOf P)))
    ) ∧
    ((∀ D : Finset (Fin 5), D.card % 2 = 0 →
        realForm (projOf (linesDiv D)) ≤ formGroup (hermForm D)) ∧
      (∀ D : Finset (Fin 5), D.card % 2 = 1 →
        realForm (projOf (linesDiv D)) ≤ antiGroup (gammaD D * J))) ∧
    (∀ P : Matrix (Fin 6) (Fin 6) ℝ, Pᵀ = P → P * P = P →
      ∃ (R : Matrix (Fin 6) (Fin 6) ℝ) (S : Finset (Fin 6)), Rᵀ * R = 1 ∧ R.det = 1 ∧
        P = R * projOf S * Rᵀ) ∧
    (∀ P : Matrix (Fin 6) (Fin 6) ℝ, Pᵀ = P → P * P = P →
      ∃ (S : Finset (Fin 6)) (U : GroupsContinuumLaw.SU4), ∀ X : Matrix Four Four ℂ,
        X ∈ realFormAlg P ↔
          (U : Matrix Four Four ℂ)⁻¹ * X * (U : Matrix Four Four ℂ) ∈
            (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range (realGen6 S)) : Set (Matrix Four Four ℂ))) ∧
    (∀ P R X : Matrix (Fin 6) (Fin 6) ℝ, Rᵀ * R = 1 →
      (KeptBy (R * P * Rᵀ) (R * X * Rᵀ) ↔ KeptBy P X) ∧
        (MovedBy (R * P * Rᵀ) (R * X * Rᵀ) ↔ MovedBy P X)) ∧
    (∀ U : (Matrix Four Four ℂ)ˣ, U ∈ realForm (projOf (linesDiv ∅)) ↔
      (U : Matrix Four Four ℂ).det = 1 ∧ (U : Matrix Four Four ℂ)ᴴ * U = 1)
theorems.description:
**Proposition 21 (four types of division).** Under the fifteen rotations a division (a subspace `D`
of P1's real six) is known by the dimension `k` of its smaller part: two divisions are carried one to
the other by a rotation of `SU(4)` exactly when they have the same type, there are four types,
`k = 0, 1, 2, 3`, each that of a coordinate division; in a basis, a division `D ⊆ {0, …, 5}` keeps
`C(k,2) + C(6−k,2) = 15, 10, 7, 6` and moves `k(6 − k) = 0, 5, 8, 9` of the fifteen generators,
each generator kept or moved and not both; its metric is `Σ_{a∉D} v_a² − Σ_{a∈D} v_a²`
(signature `(6−k, k)`); for the divisions of the lines with the singlet undivided (the Lemma and its
converse), the real form's Lie algebra is `{X : tr X = 0, X†h_D + h_DX = 0}` (`r` even, `h_D`
Hermitian, `h_D² = 1`, trace zero for `r = 2, 4`) or `{X : tr X = 0, XC_D = C_DX}` (`r` odd,
`C_D² = −1` for `r = 1, 5`, `+1` for `r = 3`), of real dimension 15; on the six these real forms are
`so(6 − k, k)`; the balanced lines are `(S^{5−k} × S^{k−1})/ℤ₂`, and at `2|4` the metric has the signs
`(+, −, −, −)` on `v^⊥/ℝv`. Definition 15's real form in a basis: for every set `S` of directions,
`realFormAlg` is the real span of the kept rotations and `i` times the moved ones, the same for `S` and its
complement, and every generator is one kept plus one moved; the group it generates lies in
`{U : det U = 1, U†h_DU = h_D}` (`r` even) or `{U : det U = 1, UC_D = C_DU}` (`r` odd).
Every division is a coordinate division in a rotated basis, `P = R·P_S·Rᵀ`, its real form is the
real form of `S` turned by the lift `U` of `R`, and its kept and moved generators are those of `S` turned
by `R`. The real form of the point is all of `SU(4)`. Status: partial; missing (b): that the group generated
is all of `SU(2,2)`, `SU*(4)`, `SL(4,ℝ)` (every element a product of exponentials of the real form).
Recognition: the four types are those of gravity, the weak force, electromagnetism and
the strong force; the real forms `su(4)`, `sl(2,ℍ)`, `su(2,2)`, `sl(4,ℝ)` of the twistor group; the
balance `(1, 3)` of `2|4` is spacetime.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.prop_20
theorems.statement:
theorem prop_20 :
    (∀ {H : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℝ H] [FiniteDimensional ℝ H]
        (T : RealPartner H),
      (∀ v w, ⟪T.Θ v, w⟫_ℝ = -⟪v, T.Θ w⟫_ℝ) ∧ (∀ v, T.Θ (T.Θ v) = -v) ∧
      (T.P3R ↔ finrank ℝ H = 4) ∧ (finrank ℝ H = 4 → finrank ℝ T.distinctionsR = 3) ∧
      (finrank ℝ H = 4 → Nonempty (T.distinctionsR ≃ₗ[ℝ] hermZero2))) ∧
    Comparison.Article.realQ = Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range Comparison.Article.realLines) ∧
    (∀ i j : Fin 3, Comparison.Article.realLines i * Comparison.Article.realLines j +
      Comparison.Article.realLines j * Comparison.Article.realLines i =
        (if i = j then 2 else 0 : ℝ) • 1) ∧
    finrank ℝ Comparison.Article.realQ = 3 ∧
    (∀ {H : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [FiniteDimensional ℂ H]
        (T : Partner H),
      (∀ v : H, T.Θ (T.Θ v) = -v) ∧ (∀ v : H, T.Θ (Complex.I • v) = -(Complex.I • T.Θ v)) ∧
      (finrank ℂ H = 4 → finrank ℝ (distinctionsH T) = 5)) ∧
    (∀ {n : Type} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] (q : Matrix n n ℝ) (D : Finset n),
      q * q = Matrix.diagonal (fun i => if i ∈ D then -1 else 1) →
        q.det ^ 2 = (-1) ^ D.card ∧ Even D.card) ∧
    (finrank ℝ (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range Comparison.Article.realProducts)) = 9 ∧
      (Comparison.Article.epsR ⊗ₖ Comparison.Article.epsR)ᵀ =
        Comparison.Article.epsR ⊗ₖ Comparison.Article.epsR ∧
      (∀ p, ((Comparison.Article.epsR ⊗ₖ Comparison.Article.epsR) *
        Comparison.Article.realProducts p).trace = 0) ∧
      Comparison.Article.epsR ⊗ₖ Comparison.Article.epsR ∉
        Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range Comparison.Article.realProducts)) ∧
    Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range fun p : Fin 4 × Fin 4 => pauli p.1 ⊗ₖ pauli p.2) = hermitian ∧
    (∀ i j : Fin 3, pauli3 i * pauli3 j + pauli3 j * pauli3 i = (if i = j then (2 : ℂ) else 0) • 1) ∧
    hermZero2 = Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range pauli3) ∧ LinearIndependent ℝ pauli3 ∧
    (∀ i : Fin 3, (realQEquivHerm ⟨Comparison.Article.realLines i,
      Comparison.Article.realLines_mem i⟩ : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) = pauli3 i) ∧
    finrank ℝ symFour = 10 ∧
    Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range Comparison.Article.realProducts) ≤ symFour
theorems.description:
**Proposition 20 (the square root of the sign uses P1's `i`).** With real numbers in P1 — a real Hilbert space `H`
with an orthogonal quaternionic structure, `Θ² = −1` — for **every** such `(H, Θ)`: `Θᵀ = −Θ`, P3 (b) holds exactly
when `dim H = 4`, and then `dim Q = 3`: on the real model `Q` is spanned by three lines that
anticommute and square to one, the two-spinor states of the three Pauli matrices (`Herm₀(ℂ²)`); with complex
P1, `i`, `Θ`, `iΘ` multiply as the quaternion units and `dim Q = 5`; a real `q` with `q² = −1` on
`k` directions and `+1` on the rest has `(det q)² = (−1)^k`, so `k` is even; the products of
symmetric operators on `ℝ² ⊗ ℝ²` span 9 dimensions and miss the symmetric `ε ⊗ ε`, while on
`ℂ² ⊗ ℂ²` they span all 16 Hermitian operators. Recognition: the complex numbers stay in P1, and the square
root of the sign of a division uses P1's `i`.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.half_general_props
theorems.statement:
theorem half_general_props {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] (P : Matrix n n ℝ)
    (hS : Pᵀ = P) (hP : P * P = P) :
    halfOf P * halfOf P = (1 - (2 : ℝ) • P).map (↑) ∧
    (halfOf P)ᵀ * halfOf P = (1 - (2 : ℝ) • P).map (↑) ∧
    (halfOf P)ᴴ * halfOf P = 1 ∧ halfOf P ^ 4 = 1 ∧
    halfOf P * halfOf (1 - P) = Complex.I • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ)
theorems.description:
**The half of every division:** for every orthogonal projector `P` (real, symmetric,
idempotent) onto the divided part, `q = 1 − P + iP` has `q² = θ`, `qᵀq = θ`, `q†q = 1`, `q⁴ = 1`,
and the square roots of the two parts make `i`.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.metricOf_eq
theorems.statement:
theorem metricOf_eq (P : Matrix (Fin 6) (Fin 6) ℝ) (hS : Pᵀ = P) (hP : P * P = P)
    (v : Fin 6 → ℝ) :
    metricOf P v = ((∑ a, ((1 - P) *ᵥ v) a ^ 2 - ∑ a, (P *ᵥ v) a ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)
theorems.description: **The metric of every division:** `g_D(v) = p(q v) = |(1 − P)v|² − |Pv|²`.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.theta_map_eq
theorems.statement:
theorem theta_map_eq {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] (P : Matrix n n ℝ) :
    (1 - (2 : ℝ) • P).map ((↑) : ℝ → ℂ) = 1 - (2 : ℂ) • P.map (↑)
theorems.description: `θ = 1 − 2P` with complex entries.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.halfOf_eq_combo
theorems.statement:
theorem halfOf_eq_combo {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] (P : Matrix n n ℝ) :
    halfOf P = ((1 + Complex.I) / 2) • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) +
      ((1 - Complex.I) / 2) • (1 - (2 : ℝ) • P).map (↑)
theorems.description: **The half is made from the sign:** `q = (1+i)/2 + ((1−i)/2)θ`.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.halfOf_map_star
theorems.statement:
theorem halfOf_map_star {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] (P : Matrix n n ℝ) :
    (halfOf P).map star = ((1 - Complex.I) / 2) • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) +
      ((1 + Complex.I) / 2) • (1 - (2 : ℝ) • P).map (↑)
theorems.description: **The conjugate half:** `q̄ = (1 − P) − iP = (1−i)/2 + ((1+i)/2)θ`.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.halves_iff_general
theorems.statement:
theorem halves_iff_general {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] (P : Matrix n n ℝ)
    (hP : P * P = P) (h0 : P ≠ 0) (h1 : P ≠ 1) (α β : ℂ) :
    (α • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) + β • (1 - (2 : ℝ) • P).map (↑)) ^ 2 = (1 - (2 : ℝ) • P).map (↑) ↔
      α ^ 2 + β ^ 2 = 0 ∧ 2 * α * β = 1
theorems.description:
**The square roots of every division but the point:** with `θ = 1 − 2P`, `P ≠ 0`, `P ≠ 1`,
`(α + βθ)² = θ` exactly when `α² + β² = 0` and `2αβ = 1`.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.halves_general
theorems.statement:
theorem halves_general {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] (P : Matrix n n ℝ)
    (hP : P * P = P) (h0 : P ≠ 0) (h1 : P ≠ 1) (α β : ℂ) :
    ((α • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) + β • (1 - (2 : ℝ) • P).map (↑)) ^ 2 = (1 - (2 : ℝ) • P).map (↑) ↔
      α • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) + β • (1 - (2 : ℝ) • P).map (↑) ∈
        ({halfOf P, -halfOf P, (halfOf P).map star, -(halfOf P).map star} :
          Set (Matrix n n ℂ)))
theorems.description:
**The four square roots:** for every division but the point, `(α + βθ)² = θ` exactly when `α + βθ`
is one of `±q`, `±q̄`.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.no_real_half_general
theorems.statement:
theorem no_real_half_general {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] (P : Matrix n n ℝ)
    (hP : P * P = P) (h0 : P ≠ 0) (h1 : P ≠ 1) (α β : ℝ) :
    ((α : ℂ) • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) + (β : ℂ) • (1 - (2 : ℝ) • P).map (↑)) ^ 2 ≠
      (1 - (2 : ℝ) • P).map (↑)
theorems.description: **No real half:** for every division but the point no real `α, β` have `(α + βθ)² = θ`.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.halfOf_diag

theorems.description:
In the basis `f_a` a division is a set `D`, its projector the diagonal of `D`, and its half is
the coordinate half `half D`.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.half_fS

theorems.description: **The half on the sixty-four sets:** `q_D f_S = i^{|S ∩ D|} f_S`.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Geometry.P3six_eq_half_P1six
theorems.description: **P3's real six is the square root of the sign of P1's:** `P3's real six = q(P1's real six)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.prop_16
theorems.statement:
theorem prop_16 :
    (∀ a b : Fin 6, star (rel (Article.six a)) ⬝ᵥ rel (Article.six b) = if a = b then 1 else 0) ∧
    rel (Article.six 0) = Ω ∧
    (∀ s : Fin 5, rel (Article.six s.succ) = (γ s ⊗ₖ (1 : Matrix Four Four ℂ)) *ᵥ Ω) ∧
    (∀ v : Two → ℂ, v ∈ sixDirections ↔ ∃ t : Fin 6 → ℂ, v = ∑ a, t a • rel (Article.six a)) ∧
    (∀ t : Fin 6 → ℂ, pfRel (∑ a, t a • rel (Article.six a)) = t 0 ^ 2 - ∑ s : Fin 5, t s.succ ^ 2) ∧
    (∀ t : Fin 6 → ℂ, star (∑ a, t a • rel (Article.six a)) ⬝ᵥ (∑ a, t a • rel (Article.six a)) =

    (∀ t : Fin 6 → ℂ, (∑ a, t a • rel (Article.six a)) ∈ P3six ↔ ∀ a, (t a).im = 0)
theorems.description:
**Proposition 16 (the six directions).** The singlet and the five vector states `Ω, ℓ₁, …, ℓ₅`
(`ℓ_s = (γ_s ⊗ 1)Ω`) are orthonormal and are the six directions (the antisymmetric two-spinor states); for
`v = t₀Ω + Σ t_sℓ_s`: `p(v) = t₀² − Σ t_s²` and `‖v‖² = |t₀|² + Σ|t_s|²`; P1's real six
(`p(v) = ‖v‖²`) are the `v` with `t₀` real and every `t_s` imaginary; P3's real six
(`(Θ ⊗ Θ)v = v`) are the `v` with every `t` real. Recognition: none.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.prop_17
theorems.statement:
theorem prop_17 :
    (su4 = sp2 ⊔ Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range fun s : Fin 5 => gen (Sum.inl s)) ∧
      Disjoint sp2 (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range fun s : Fin 5 => gen (Sum.inl s)))) ∧

        relOf (GroupsContinuumLaw.ι6 (GroupsContinuumLaw.rot6Hom U t))) ∧

    (∀ φ : GroupsContinuumLaw.E6 ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] GroupsContinuumLaw.E6, LinearMap.det φ.toLinearMap = 1 →

    (∀ n : GroupsContinuumLaw.E6, ∑ a, n a ^ 2 = 1 →

    (∀ (a : ℝ) (s : Fin 5),

        (Real.cos a : ℂ) • (1 : Matrix Four Four ℂ) + (Real.sin a : ℂ) • (Complex.I • γ s) ∧
      (NormedSpace.exp ((a : ℂ) • (Complex.I • γ s)) ⊗ₖ
          NormedSpace.exp ((a : ℂ) • (Complex.I • γ s))) *ᵥ Ω =
        (Real.cos (2 * a) : ℂ) • Ω + (Real.sin (2 * a) : ℂ) • (Complex.I • ((γ s ⊗ₖ 1) *ᵥ Ω))) ∧
    (∀ U : Matrix Four Four ℂ, (U ⊗ₖ U) *ᵥ Ω = Ω ↔ U * J * Uᵀ = J) ∧
    (∀ U : Matrix Four Four ℂ, U * Uᴴ = 1 → U.det = 1 →

        U * J * Uᵀ = J ∨ (Complex.I • U) * J * (Complex.I • U)ᵀ = J)) ∧
    (∀ x : Fin 5 ⊕ Fin 10, Kept {1, 2, 3, 4, 5} x ↔ x.isRight)
theorems.description:
**Proposition 17 (the fifteen rotations and the ten).** `su(4) = sp(2) ⊕ iQ` (the fifteen generators:
the ten of `sp(2)` and the five `iγ_s`); `U ↦ U ⊗ U` acts on P1's real six as a rotation
(`(U ⊗ U)ι(t) = ι(R_U t)`), of determinant one, every rotation of `SO(6)` is some `R_U`, and `R_U = 1`

`e^{iaγ_s} = cos a + i sin a γ_s` and `(e^{iaγ_s} ⊗ e^{iaγ_s})Ω = cos 2a Ω + sin 2a iℓ_s`; the rotations
keeping `Ω` are `Sp(2)`, those keeping `L` are `Sp(2) ∪ i Sp(2)`; P3's own division (the five directions

theorems.name: Comparison.System.prop_18

theorem prop_18 :

theorems.description:
**Proposition 18 (the sign of time).** For `X = t₀ + Σ t_sγ_s`: `det X = (t₀² − Σ t_s²)²`;
for real `t`, `X ≥ 0` exactly when `t₀ ≥ |t|`, and for `t ≠ 0`, `t₀ = |t|` exactly when

and `i` on the five directions. Recognition: the singlet is time-like and the five directions space-like; the singlet

theorems.name: Comparison.System.prop_19
theorems.statement:
theorem prop_19 :
    (∀ {n : Type} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] (P : Matrix n n ℝ), Pᵀ = P → P * P = P →
      halfOf P * halfOf P = (1 - (2 : ℝ) • P).map (↑) ∧
      (halfOf P)ᵀ * halfOf P = (1 - (2 : ℝ) • P).map (↑) ∧
      (halfOf P)ᴴ * halfOf P = 1 ∧ halfOf P ^ 4 = 1 ∧
      halfOf P * halfOf (1 - P) = Complex.I • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ)) ∧
    (∀ {n : Type} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] (P : Matrix n n ℂ), P * P = P →
      (1 - P + Complex.I • P) * (1 - P + Complex.I • P) = 1 - (2 : ℂ) • P ∧
      (Pᴴ = P → (1 - P + Complex.I • P)ᴴ * (1 - P + Complex.I • P) = 1)) ∧
    (∀ {n : Type} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] (P : Matrix n n ℝ), P * P = P → P ≠ 0 → P ≠ 1 →
      ∀ α β : ℂ, ((α • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) + β • (1 - (2 : ℝ) • P).map (↑)) ^ 2 =
          (1 - (2 : ℝ) • P).map (↑) ↔
        α • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) + β • (1 - (2 : ℝ) • P).map (↑) ∈
          ({halfOf P, -halfOf P, (halfOf P).map star, -(halfOf P).map star} :
            Set (Matrix n n ℂ)))) ∧
    (∀ {n : Type} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] (P : Matrix n n ℝ), P * P = P → P ≠ 0 → P ≠ 1 →
      ∀ α β : ℝ, ((α : ℂ) • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) + (β : ℂ) • (1 - (2 : ℝ) • P).map (↑)) ^ 2 ≠
        (1 - (2 : ℝ) • P).map (↑)) ∧
    (∀ P : Matrix (Fin 6) (Fin 6) ℝ, Pᵀ = P → P * P = P → ∀ v : Fin 6 → ℝ,
      metricOf P v = ((∑ a, ((1 - P) *ᵥ v) a ^ 2 - ∑ a, (P *ᵥ v) a ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)) ∧
    (∀ D : Finset (Fin 6), halfOf (Matrix.diagonal fun a => if a ∈ D then (1 : ℝ) else 0) = half D) ∧
    (∀ D S : Finset (Fin 6),
      ExteriorAlgebra.map (Matrix.toLin' (half D)) (fS S) = Complex.I ^ (S ∩ D).card • fS S) ∧
    ((Finset.univ.filter fun S : Finset (Fin 6) => S.card % 4 = 0).card = 16 ∧
      (Finset.univ.filter fun S : Finset (Fin 6) => S.card % 4 = 1).card = 12 ∧
      (Finset.univ.filter fun S : Finset (Fin 6) => S.card % 4 = 2).card = 16 ∧
      (Finset.univ.filter fun S : Finset (Fin 6) => S.card % 4 = 3).card = 20)
theorems.description:
**Proposition 19 (the square root of the sign).** For every division, given by the orthogonal projector `P` onto its
divided part, the square root of the sign `q = 1 − P + iP` has `q² = qᵀq = θ = 1 − 2P`, `q†q = 1`, `q⁴ = 1` and
`q_Dq_{D′} = i`; for every Hermitian projector `P` (complex) the same `q = 1 − P + iP` has `q² = 1 − 2P`
and `q†q = 1`; for every division but the point, `(α + βθ)² = θ` exactly when `α + βθ` is `±q` or
`±q̄`, and no real `α, β` do it; the metric is `g_D(v) = p(qv) = |v_{D′}|² − |v_D|²`; in the basis
`f_a` the square root of the sign of the set `D` is the coordinate half, `q_Df_S = i^{|S∩D|}f_S`, and `i^{|S|}` is
`1, i, −1, −i` on `16, 12, 16, 20` of the sixty-four sets. Recognition: the `i` of quantum theory and
the metric of gravity are the square root of the sign and its square.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.prop_9
theorems.statement:
theorem prop_9 :
    (∀ U : Matrix Four Four ℂ, U * Uᴴ = 1 →
      (1 / 2 : ℂ) • ∑ j : Four, (fun p : Two => U p.1 j * Θ (fun i => U i j) p.2) = Ω) ∧
    (∀ U : Matrix Four Four ℂ, U * Uᴴ = 1 →
      (∀ v, Θ (U *ᵥ v) = U *ᵥ (partnerMatrixOf U *ᵥ star v)) ∧
      relOf (U * ((-(1 / 2) : ℂ) • partnerMatrixOf U) * Uᵀ) = Ω) ∧
    MΩ = (-(1 / 2) : ℂ) • J ∧
    star Ω ⬝ᵥ Ω = 1 ∧ swap *ᵥ Ω = -Ω ∧
    (∀ X : Matrix Four Four ℂ, ((1 : Matrix Four Four ℂ) ⊗ₖ X) *ᵥ Ω =
      (partnerOp X ⊗ₖ (1 : Matrix Four Four ℂ)) *ᵥ Ω) ∧
    (∀ a, InR1Q a → (a ⊗ₖ (1 : Matrix Four Four ℂ)) *ᵥ Ω = ((1 : Matrix Four Four ℂ) ⊗ₖ a) *ᵥ Ω) ∧
    (∀ v : Two → ℂ, (∀ U : Matrix Four Four ℂ, U * Uᴴ = 1 → U * J * Uᵀ = J → (U ⊗ₖ U) *ᵥ v = v) ↔
      ∃ c : ℂ, v = c • Ω) ∧
    (∀ i j : Four, ∑ k : Four, Ω (i, k) * star (Ω (j, k)) = (1 / 4 : ℂ) * (if i = j then 1 else 0))
theorems.description:
**Proposition 9 (the singlet).** The singlet `Ω = ½Σ_j u_j ⊗ Θu_j` is the same in every orthonormal
basis, its matrix in every orthonormal basis is `−½` the matrix of the quaternionic structure there (in the standard
basis `M_Ω = −½J`), `‖Ω‖ = 1`, `PΩ = −Ω`; `(1 ⊗ X)Ω = (X♯ ⊗ 1)Ω` for every operator `X`, so
`(a ⊗ 1)Ω = (1 ⊗ a)Ω` for every `a ∈ ℝ1 ⊕ Q`; the two-spinor states kept by every rotation of `Sp(2)` are exactly
`ℂΩ`; and `Tr₂|Ω⟩⟨Ω| = ¼·1`. Recognition: none.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.prop_10
theorems.statement:
theorem prop_10 :
    ((∀ k : Fin 16, Even (disagreeSet k).card) ∧ Function.Injective disagreeSet ∧
      ∀ S : Finset (Fin 5), Even S.card → ∃ k, disagreeSet k = S) ∧
    (∀ k : Fin 16, (rel k = (gammaS (disagreeSet k) ⊗ₖ (1 : Matrix Four Four ℂ)) *ᵥ Ω ∨
        rel k = -((gammaS (disagreeSet k) ⊗ₖ (1 : Matrix Four Four ℂ)) *ᵥ Ω)) ∧
      ((disagreeSet k).card ≠ 4 →
        rel k = (gammaS (disagreeSet k) ⊗ₖ (1 : Matrix Four Four ℂ)) *ᵥ Ω)) ∧
    (∀ k l : Fin 16, star (rel k) ⬝ᵥ rel l = if k = l then 1 else 0) ∧
    (∀ (u : Fin 5) (k : Fin 16), count u *ᵥ rel k = (if u ∈ disagreeSet k then 1 else 0 : ℂ) • rel k) ∧
    (∀ k : Fin 16, L *ᵥ rel k = ((6 : ℂ) - 2 * (disagreeSet k).card) • rel k) ∧
    finrank ℂ (Module.End.eigenspace (Matrix.toLin' L) 6) = 1 ∧
    finrank ℂ (Module.End.eigenspace (Matrix.toLin' L) 2) = 10 ∧
    finrank ℂ (Module.End.eigenspace (Matrix.toLin' L) (-2)) = 5 ∧
    (∀ μ : ℂ, μ ≠ 6 → μ ≠ 2 → μ ≠ -2 → Module.End.eigenspace (Matrix.toLin' L) μ = ⊥)
theorems.description:
**Proposition 10 (the sixteen two-spinor states and the comparison).** The sixteen two-spinor states
`e_S = (γ_S ⊗ 1)Ω`, labelled by the sixteen even sets `S` of lines (up to the sign on the five vector
states `ℓ_t = (γ_t ⊗ 1)Ω = ±e_{T_t}`), are orthonormal; `n_t e_S = [t ∈ S]e_S`; `L e_S =
(6 − 2|S|)e_S`; so `L` has the values `6, 2, −2` with multiplicities `1, 10, 5` and no other.
Recognition: the sixteen states of one generation of matter; the grade `N = |S|`.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.prop_11
theorems.statement:
theorem prop_11 :
    L = (1 : Matrix Four Four ℂ) ⊗ₖ 1 + ∑ s, γ s ⊗ₖ γ s ∧ L = (2 : ℂ) • (swap + Eop) ∧
    (∀ k : Fin 16, swap *ᵥ rel k = (if (disagreeSet k).card = 2 then 1 else -1 : ℂ) • rel k) ∧
    (∀ O : Matrix (Fin 6) (Fin 6) ℝ, (∀ a c : Fin 6, (1 / 4 : ℂ) *
        ((∑ b, (O a b : ℂ) • Article.Ybasis b) * (∑ d, (O c d : ℂ) • Article.Ybasis d)).trace =
          if a = c then 1 else 0) →
      L = ∑ a, (∑ b, (O a b : ℂ) • Article.Ybasis b) ⊗ₖ (∑ d, (O a d : ℂ) • Article.Ybasis d)) ∧
    Eop = vecMulVec (relOf J) (star (relOf J)) ∧ Eop * Eop = (4 : ℂ) • Eop ∧
    swap * Eop = -Eop ∧ Eop * swap = -Eop ∧ swap * swap = 1 ∧
    WholePicture.compOp 1 = (6 : ℂ) • (1 : Matrix Four Four ℂ) ∧
    (∀ a, WholePicture.compOp (γ a) = (-2 : ℂ) • γ a) ∧
    (∀ a b : Fin 5, a ≠ b → WholePicture.compOp (γ a * γ b) = (2 : ℂ) • (γ a * γ b))
theorems.description:
**Proposition 11 (the comparison is the swap and the singlet).** `L = 1 ⊗ 1 + Σ_s γ_s ⊗ γ_s =
2(P + E)`; `P` is `+1` on the ten symmetric states and `−1` on the singlet and the five directions; `L = Σ_α X_α ⊗ X_α`
for every orthonormal basis `X_α = Σ_β O_{αβ}Y_β` of `ℝ1 ⊕ Q`; `E = |J⟩⟨J|`, `E² = 4E`,
`PE = EP = −E`, `P² = 1`; on one system's operators the comparison has the eigenvectors `1` (value 6),
`γ_aγ_b` (2) and `γ_a` (−2). Recognition: one comparison tells one of three facts.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.prop_12
theorems.statement:
theorem prop_12 :
    disagreement = (1 / 2 : ℂ) • ∑ s, (γ s ⊗ₖ 1 - 1 ⊗ₖ γ s) * (γ s ⊗ₖ 1 - 1 ⊗ₖ γ s) ∧
    disagreement = (2 : ℂ) • Ncount ∧
    (∀ k : Fin 16, disagreement *ᵥ rel k = ((2 * (disagreeSet k).card : ℕ) : ℂ) • rel k) ∧
    disagreement.PosSemidef ∧
    (∀ v : Two → ℂ, disagreement *ᵥ v = 0 ↔ ∃ c : ℂ, v = c • Ω) ∧
    (∀ a b : Four → ℂ, normSq a = 1 → normSq b = 1 →
      4 ≤ (star (prodRel a b) ⬝ᵥ (disagreement *ᵥ prodRel a b)).re) ∧
    (∀ ρ : Matrix Four Four ℂ, ρ.PosSemidef → ρ.trace = 1 → ∑ s, mixedLine ρ s ^ 2 ≤ 1) ∧
    (∀ ρ σ : Matrix Four Four ℂ, ρᴴ = ρ → σᴴ = σ → ρ.trace = 1 → σ.trace = 1 →
      ((ρ ⊗ₖ σ) * disagreement).trace = ((5 - ∑ s, mixedLine ρ s * mixedLine σ s : ℝ) : ℂ)) ∧
    (∀ ρ σ : Matrix Four Four ℂ, ρ.PosSemidef → σ.PosSemidef → ρ.trace = 1 → σ.trace = 1 →
      4 ≤ ((ρ ⊗ₖ σ) * disagreement).trace.re) ∧
    (∀ {ι : Type} [Fintype ι] (p : ι → ℝ), (∀ i, 0 ≤ p i) → ∑ i, p i = 1 →
      ∀ ρ σ : ι → Matrix Four Four ℂ, (∀ i, (ρ i).PosSemidef) → (∀ i, (σ i).PosSemidef) →
      (∀ i, (ρ i).trace = 1) → (∀ i, (σ i).trace = 1) →
      4 ≤ ((∑ i, (p i : ℂ) • (ρ i ⊗ₖ σ i)) * disagreement).trace.re)
theorems.description:
**Proposition 12 (disagreement).** `6 − L = ½Σ_s(γ_s ⊗ 1 − 1 ⊗ γ_s)² = 2N ≥ 0`, which is `0, 4, 8`
on the singlet, the symmetric states and the vector states (`(6 − L)e_S = 2|S|e_S`); it is zero exactly
on `ℂΩ`; two unit states taken apart, and two mixed states taken separately or any mixture of such
pairs, disagree by at least four, with `Tr[(ρ ⊗ σ)(6 − L)] = 5 − m_ρ·m_σ` and `|m_ρ| ≤ 1`.
Recognition: the singlet cannot be made from two systems apart; it is entangled.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.prop_13
theorems.statement:
theorem prop_13 :
    (∀ X : Matrix Four Four ℂ, (Xᴴ = X ∧ partnerOp X = X) ↔ InR1Q X) ∧
    (∀ X : Matrix Two Two ℂ,
      (∀ U : Matrix Four Four ℂ, U * Uᴴ = 1 → U * J * Uᵀ = J → X * (U ⊗ₖ U) = (U ⊗ₖ U) * X) ↔
      ∃ a b c : ℂ, X = a • (1 : Matrix Two Two ℂ) + b • swap + c • Eop) ∧
    (∀ a b c : ℂ, a • (1 : Matrix Two Two ℂ) + b • swap + c • Eop = 0 → a = 0 ∧ b = 0 ∧ c = 0) ∧
    (∀ X Y : Matrix Four Four ℂ, partnerTwo (X ⊗ₖ Y) = X ⊗ₖ partnerOp Y) ∧
    partnerTwo 1 = 1 ∧ partnerTwo swap = Eop ∧ partnerTwo Eop = swap ∧ partnerTwo L = L ∧
    (∀ X : Matrix Two Two ℂ,
      ((∀ U : Matrix Four Four ℂ, U * Uᴴ = 1 → U * J * Uᵀ = J → X * (U ⊗ₖ U) = (U ⊗ₖ U) * X) ∧
        partnerTwo X = X) ↔ ∃ a b : ℂ, X = a • (1 : Matrix Two Two ℂ) + b • (swap + Eop)) ∧
    (∀ X : Matrix Two Two ℂ, P2a X ∧ P2b X ↔ ∃ a b : ℂ, X = a • (1 : Matrix Two Two ℂ) + b • L)
theorems.description:
**Proposition 13 (one's own past and a neighbour).** `X = X† = X♯ ⟺ X ∈ ℝ1 ⊕ Q`; the operators on
two systems kept by every `U ⊗ U`, `U ∈ Sp(2)`, are exactly the `a + bP + cE`, with `1, P, E` independent; the
quaternionic structure on one system, `X ⊗ Y ↦ X ⊗ Y♯`, takes `1 ↦ 1`, `P ↦ E`, `E ↦ P`, `L ↦ L`; the operators kept
by both are `a + b(P + E)`, and those that satisfy P2 (kept by every `U ⊗ U` and the exchange, and by the
quaternionic structure on one system) are exactly `a + bL`. Recognition: meeting a neighbour is a crossing and meeting one's own past
a join; inertia is gravity.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.prop_14
theorems.statement:
theorem prop_14 :
    (∀ (t : Fin 5) (k : Fin 16), disagreeSet (transition t k) = symmDiff (disagreeSet k) (Finset.univ.erase t)) ∧
    (∀ (t : Fin 5) (k : Fin 16),
      (γ t ⊗ₖ (1 : Matrix Four Four ℂ)) *ᵥ rel k = (transitionSign t k : ℂ) • rel (transition t k)) ∧
    (∀ t k, transition t (transition t k) = k) ∧ (∀ t k, transition t k ≠ k) ∧
    (∀ t t' k, transition t k = transition t' k ↔ t = t') ∧
    (∀ t : Fin 5, disagreeSet (transition t 0) = Finset.univ.erase t) ∧
    (∀ t s : Fin 5, disagreeSet (transition s (transition t 0)) = if s = t then ∅ else {s, t}) ∧
    (∀ (k : Fin 16) (a b : Fin 5), a ≠ b → disagreeSet k = {a, b} → ∀ u : Fin 5,
      disagreeSet (transition u k) = if u = a then Finset.univ.erase b else if u = b then Finset.univ.erase a
        else Finset.univ \ {a, b, u}) ∧
    (∀ k : Fin 16, (Finset.univ.filter (Adjacent k)).card = 5) ∧
    (∀ k l : Fin 16, k ≠ l → (Finset.univ.filter fun m => Adjacent k m ∧ Adjacent l m).card =
      if Adjacent k l then 0 else 2) ∧
    (Finset.univ.filter fun p : Fin 16 × Fin 16 => p.1 < p.2 ∧ Adjacent p.1 p.2).card = 40
theorems.description:
**Proposition 14 (one line on one system).** Applying the line `t` to one system moves each two-spinor state
to a two-spinor state, `(γ_t ⊗ 1)e_S = ±e_{S △ T_t}`; each transition is an involution without fixed two-spinor state; from
every two-spinor state the five directions lead to five different two-spinor states; the singlet goes to the five vector
states, a vector state `ℓ_t` to the singlet and the four symmetric states through `t`, a plane `{a, b}` to `ℓ_a`,
`ℓ_b` and the three symmetric states of the lines outside it; the sixteen two-spinor states with these transitions are the
strongly regular graph (16, 5, 0, 2): five
neighbours, none in common for neighbours, two in common otherwise, forty pairs. Recognition: the
Clebsch graph, what a world line steps through.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Law.four_cells_cubes
theorems.statement:
theorem four_cells_cubes :
    (∀ (j : Fin 5) (c : Fin 20), fourBdZ j c ≠ 0 ↔ cubeLines c ⊆ Finset.univ.erase j) ∧
    (∀ j : Fin 5, (Finset.univ.filter fun c : Fin 20 => fourBdZ j c ≠ 0).card = 8) ∧
    (∀ c : Fin 20, (Finset.univ.filter fun j : Fin 5 => fourBdZ j c ≠ 0).card = 2)
theorems.description:
**The cubes of the four-cell `j` are those whose three lines avoid `j`:** eight of them, and every cube lies on
two four-cells.

theorem step_on_cube : ∀ (t : Fin 5) (k : Fin 16),
    disagreeSet (transition t k) = symmDiff (symmDiff (disagreeSet k) {t}) Finset.univ
theorems.description: **A step changes one line and then flips them all:** `T_{transition t k} = (T_k △ {t}) △ [5]`.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.prop_116
theorems.statement:
theorem prop_116 :
    (∀ (t : Fin 5) (k : Fin 16),
      disagreeSet (transition t k) = symmDiff (symmDiff (disagreeSet k) {t}) Finset.univ) ∧
    (∀ x y : Fin 16, x < y → sadjF x y ≠ 0 → ∃ l : Fin 40, linkU l = x ∧ linkV l = y) ∧
    (∀ l m : Fin 40, linkU l = linkU m → linkV l = linkV m → l = m) ∧
    (∀ (x : Fin 16) (s t : Fin 5), s ≠ t →
      ∃ q : Fin 40, square x s t = square (sqX q) (sqS q) (sqT q)) ∧
    (∀ q q' : Fin 40, square (sqX q) (sqS q) (sqT q) = square (sqX q') (sqS q') (sqT q') → q = q') ∧
    (∀ (x : Fin 16) (a b d : Fin 5), a < b → b < d →
      ∃ c : Fin 20, cubeSet c = cubeOf x a b d ∧ cubeA c = a ∧ cubeB c = b ∧ cubeD c = d) ∧
    (∀ c c' : Fin 20, cubeSet c = cubeSet c' → cubeA c = cubeA c' → cubeB c = cubeB c' →
      cubeD c = cubeD c' → c = c') ∧
    (∀ (x : Fin 16) (j : Fin 5), Law.fourOf x j = Finset.univ) ∧
    (∀ (j : Fin 5) (c : Fin 20), fourBdZ j c ≠ 0 ↔ cubeLines c ⊆ Finset.univ.erase j) ∧
    (∀ j : Fin 5, (Finset.univ.filter fun c : Fin 20 => fourBdZ j c ≠ 0).card = 8) ∧
    (∀ c : Fin 20, (Finset.univ.filter fun j : Fin 5 => fourBdZ j c ≠ 0).card = 2) ∧
    (cMat * gradZ' = 0 ∧ cubeBdZ * cMat = 0 ∧ fourBdZ * cubeBdZ = 0) ∧
    (bd1 * bd2 = 0 ∧ bd2 * bd3 = 0 ∧ bd3 * bd4 = 0) ∧
    (Module.finrank (ZMod 2) (LinearMap.ker (0 : Matrix (Fin 0) (Fin 16) (ZMod 2)).mulVecLin ⧸
      (LinearMap.range bd1.mulVecLin).comap
        (LinearMap.ker (0 : Matrix (Fin 0) (Fin 16) (ZMod 2)).mulVecLin).subtype) = 1 ∧
    Module.finrank (ZMod 2) (LinearMap.ker bd1.mulVecLin ⧸
      (LinearMap.range bd2.mulVecLin).comap (LinearMap.ker bd1.mulVecLin).subtype) = 1 ∧
    Module.finrank (ZMod 2) (LinearMap.ker bd2.mulVecLin ⧸
      (LinearMap.range bd3.mulVecLin).comap (LinearMap.ker bd2.mulVecLin).subtype) = 1 ∧
    Module.finrank (ZMod 2) (LinearMap.ker bd3.mulVecLin ⧸
      (LinearMap.range bd4.mulVecLin).comap (LinearMap.ker bd3.mulVecLin).subtype) = 1 ∧
    Module.finrank (ZMod 2) (LinearMap.ker bd4.mulVecLin ⧸
      (LinearMap.range (0 : Matrix (Fin 5) (Fin 0) (ZMod 2)).mulVecLin).comap
        (LinearMap.ker bd4.mulVecLin).subtype) = 1) ∧
    ((Fintype.card (Fin 16) : ℤ) - Fintype.card (Fin 40) + Fintype.card (Fin 40) -
      Fintype.card (Fin 20) + Fintype.card (Fin 5) = 1) ∧
    cReal.rank = 25 ∧
    (cRealᵀ * cReal).charpoly =
      Polynomial.X ^ 15 * (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C (4 : ℝ)) ^ 10 *
        (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C (8 : ℝ)) ^ 15 ∧
    (∀ (w : ℂ), 1 - 5 * w ^ 2 ≠ 0 → ∀ j k : Fin 40,
      hessLaw w j k = -(2 * w ^ 4 / (1 - 5 * w ^ 2) ^ 2) * (GZ j k : ℂ)) ∧
    (∀ (w : ℂ), 1 - 5 * w ^ 2 ≠ 0 → ∀ θ : Fin 40 → ℝ,
      HasDerivAt (fun s => (Kph w θ s).det) 0 0 ∧
      HasDerivAt (deriv (fun s => (Kph w θ s).det))
        (-(2 * w ^ 4 / (1 - 5 * w ^ 2) ^ 2) * (plaqSq θ : ℂ) * (Kph w θ 0).det) 0) ∧
    (2 * (1 / 5 : ℂ) ^ 4 / (1 - 5 * (1 / 5) ^ 2) ^ 2 = 1 / 200 ∧
      2 * (-1 / 5 : ℂ) ^ 4 / (1 - 5 * (-1 / 5) ^ 2) ^ 2 = 1 / 200 ∧
      2 * (Complex.I / 3) ^ 4 / (1 - 5 * (Complex.I / 3) ^ 2) ^ 2 = 1 / 98 ∧
      2 * (-Complex.I / 3) ^ 4 / (1 - 5 * (-Complex.I / 3) ^ 2) ^ 2 = 1 / 98)
theorems.description:
**Proposition 116, the plane flux closes on the cells.** The cells of `RP⁴` (a step changes one line and
then flips them all): sixteen vertices, forty links, forty squares, twenty cubes, five four-cells, every link,
square and cube of the five-cube with the flip listed once, and the five four-cells the four-symmetric states left out by one
line `j` (each reaches all sixteen vertices; its boundary is the eight cubes whose three lines avoid `j`, and every
cube lies on two four-cells); the boundary of a boundary is nothing, with
orientations over `ℤ` (`C·grad = 0`, `D·C = 0`, `E·D = 0`) and mod 2; the Euler number is `1`; mod 2 there
is one class in each dimension (`dim H_k(RP⁴; ℤ/2) = 1`, `k = 0, …, 4`); `rank C = 25` and
`spec CᵀC = 0¹⁵ ⊕ 4¹⁰ ⊕ 8¹⁵`; the second variation of `log det(I − wA₋[θ])` is `−κ(w)CᵀC`,
`κ(w) = 2w⁴/(1 − 5w²)²` (the Hessian matrix entry by entry, and the second derivative of `det(I − wA₋[e^{itθ}])`
at `t = 0` along every direction `θ`, `Law/Phases.lean`), which is `1/200` at `w = ±1/5` and `1/98` at
`w = ±i/3`.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Law.residue_general_field

source_context.command: variable {𝕜 : Type*} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]

theorems.statement:
theorem residue_general_field (K : 𝕜 → Matrix ι ι 𝕜) (u₀ d : 𝕜) (hK : ContinuousAt K u₀)
    (h0 : (K u₀).det = 0) (hd : HasDerivAt (fun u => (K u).det) d u₀) (hd0 : d ≠ 0) :
    Tendsto (fun u => (u - u₀) • (K u)⁻¹) (𝓝[≠] u₀) (𝓝 (d⁻¹ • (K u₀).adjugate))
theorems.description:
The residue at a simple zero of a determinant, over any nontrivially normed field: if `K` is continuous
at `u₀`, `det K(u₀) = 0` and `det K` has the derivative `d ≠ 0` at `u₀`, then `(u − u₀)K(u)⁻¹ → adj K(u₀)/d`.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Law.residue_at_simple_zero

source_context.command: variable {𝕜 : Type*} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]

theorems.statement:
theorem residue_at_simple_zero (S : 𝕜 → Matrix ι ι 𝕜) (ζ₀ : 𝕜) (Sζ : Matrix ι ι 𝕜)
    (hS : ∀ i j, HasDerivAt (fun ζ => S ζ i j) (Sζ i j) ζ₀) (hdet : (S ζ₀).det = 0)
    (r ℓ : ι → 𝕜) (hr : r ≠ 0) (hkerR : ∀ v, S ζ₀ *ᵥ v = 0 → ∃ c : 𝕜, v = c • r)
    (hkerL : ∀ w, w ᵥ* S ζ₀ = 0 → ∃ c : 𝕜, w = c • ℓ)
    (hsimple : deriv (fun ζ => (S ζ).det) ζ₀ ≠ 0) :
    ℓ ⬝ᵥ (Sζ *ᵥ r) ≠ 0 ∧
      Tendsto (fun ζ => (ζ - ζ₀) • (S ζ)⁻¹) (𝓝[≠] ζ₀) (𝓝 ((ℓ ⬝ᵥ (Sζ *ᵥ r))⁻¹ • vecMulVec r ℓ))
theorems.description:
**The residue at a simple zero** `ζ₀` of `det S`, with the kernels spanned by `r` and `ℓ`:
`ℓ S_ζ r ≠ 0` and `(ζ − ζ₀) S(ζ)⁻¹ → r ℓᵀ/(ℓ S_ζ r)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Law.zero_shift_pencil

source_context.command: variable {𝕜 : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜] {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]

theorems.statement:
theorem zero_shift_pencil (S₀ Sζ Sa : Matrix ι ι 𝕜) (ζ₀ : 𝕜) (r ℓ : ι → 𝕜) (hr : r ≠ 0)
    (hdet : S₀.det = 0) (hkerR : ∀ v, S₀ *ᵥ v = 0 → ∃ c : 𝕜, v = c • r)
    (hkerL : ∀ w, w ᵥ* S₀ = 0 → ∃ c : 𝕜, w = c • ℓ) (hsimple : (S₀.adjugate * Sζ).trace ≠ 0) :
    ℓ ⬝ᵥ (Sζ *ᵥ r) ≠ 0 ∧
    ∃ ζ : 𝕜 → 𝕜, ζ 0 = ζ₀ ∧ (∀ᶠ J in 𝓝 0, pencilDet S₀ Sζ Sa ζ₀ J (ζ J) = 0) ∧
      HasDerivAt ζ (-(ℓ ⬝ᵥ (Sa *ᵥ r)) / (ℓ ⬝ᵥ (Sζ *ᵥ r))) 0
theorems.description:
**The shift of a simple zero under a source:** for the pencil `S(ζ, J) = S₀ + (ζ − ζ₀)S_ζ + J S_a`, with
`det S₀ = 0`, the kernels of `S₀` spanned by `r` and `ℓ`, and `ζ₀` a simple zero (`∂_ζ det S = tr(adj S₀ S_ζ) ≠ 0`),
the zero `ζ(J)` of `det S(·, J)` through `ζ(0) = ζ₀` exists near `J = 0` and `dζ/dJ = −ℓ S_a r/(ℓ S_ζ r)`, over
`ℝ` and over `ℂ` (every `RCLike` field: the implicit function theorem holds there).

theorems.name: Comparison.System.prop_57
theorems.statement:
theorem prop_57 :
    (∀ (m n : Type) [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n]
        (A : Matrix m m ℂ) (B : Matrix m n ℂ) (C : Matrix n m ℂ) (D : Matrix n n ℂ) [Invertible D],
      (fromBlocks A B C D).det = D.det * (schurS A B C D).det ∧
      ∀ [Invertible (schurS A B C D)],
        (fromBlocks A B C D)⁻¹ = schurR C D * ⅟(schurS A B C D) * schurL B D + schurQ D) ∧
    (∀ (m n : Type) [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n]
        (A Aa : Matrix m m ℂ) (B Ba : Matrix m n ℂ) (C Ca : Matrix n m ℂ) (D Da : Matrix n n ℂ),
      D.det ≠ 0 → ∀ i j : m,
      HasDerivAt (fun s : ℂ => schurN (A + s • Aa) (B + s • Ba) (C + s • Ca) (D + s • Da) i j)
        ((schurLN B D * fromBlocks Aa Ba Ca Da * schurRN C D) i j) 0) ∧
    (∀ (m n : Type) [Fintype m] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq m] [DecidableEq n]
        (A Aa Ab Aab : Matrix m m ℂ) (B Ba Bb Bab : Matrix m n ℂ) (C Ca Cb Cab : Matrix n m ℂ)
        (D Da Db Dab : Matrix n n ℂ), D.det ≠ 0 → ∀ i j : m,
      HasDerivAt (fun s : ℂ => deriv (fun t : ℂ =>
          schurN (A + s • Aa + t • (Ab + s • Aab)) (B + s • Ba + t • (Bb + s • Bab))
            (C + s • Ca + t • (Cb + s • Cab)) (D + s • Da + t • (Db + s • Dab)) i j) 0)
        ((schurLN B D * (fromBlocks Aab Bab Cab Dab -
            fromBlocks Aa Ba Ca Da * schurQN (m := m) D * fromBlocks Ab Bb Cb Db -
            fromBlocks Ab Bb Cb Db * schurQN (m := m) D * fromBlocks Aa Ba Ca Da) * schurRN C D) i j) 0) ∧
    (∀ (ι : Type) [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (S : ℂ → Matrix ι ι ℂ) (ζ₀ : ℂ) (Sζ : Matrix ι ι ℂ),
      (∀ i j, HasDerivAt (fun ζ => S ζ i j) (Sζ i j) ζ₀) → (S ζ₀).det = 0 →
      ∀ (r ℓ : ι → ℂ), r ≠ 0 → (∀ v, S ζ₀ *ᵥ v = 0 → ∃ c : ℂ, v = c • r) →
      (∀ w, w ᵥ* S ζ₀ = 0 → ∃ c : ℂ, w = c • ℓ) → deriv (fun ζ => (S ζ).det) ζ₀ ≠ 0 →
      ℓ ⬝ᵥ (Sζ *ᵥ r) ≠ 0 ∧
        Tendsto (fun ζ => (ζ - ζ₀) • (S ζ)⁻¹) (𝓝[≠] ζ₀)
          (𝓝 ((ℓ ⬝ᵥ (Sζ *ᵥ r))⁻¹ • vecMulVec r ℓ))) ∧
    (∀ (𝕜 : Type) [RCLike 𝕜] (ι : Type) [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (S₀ Sζ Sa : Matrix ι ι 𝕜) (ζ₀ : 𝕜)
      (r ℓ : ι → 𝕜),
      r ≠ 0 → S₀.det = 0 → (∀ v, S₀ *ᵥ v = 0 → ∃ c : 𝕜, v = c • r) →
      (∀ w, w ᵥ* S₀ = 0 → ∃ c : 𝕜, w = c • ℓ) → (S₀.adjugate * Sζ).trace ≠ 0 →
      ℓ ⬝ᵥ (Sζ *ᵥ r) ≠ 0 ∧
      ∃ ζ : 𝕜 → 𝕜, ζ 0 = ζ₀ ∧ (∀ᶠ J in 𝓝 0, (S₀ + (ζ J - ζ₀) • Sζ + J • Sa).det = 0) ∧
        HasDerivAt ζ (-(ℓ ⬝ᵥ (Sa *ᵥ r)) / (ℓ ⬝ᵥ (Sζ *ᵥ r))) 0)
theorems.description:
**Proposition 57, closing a level.** For `K = [[A, B], [C, D]]` with `D` invertible and
`S = A − BD⁻¹C`: `det K = det D · det S` and `K⁻¹ = RS⁻¹L + Q`; with a source `K + sK_a`, `∂_sS = LK_aR`;
with two sources `K + sK_a + t(K_b + sK_ab)`, `∂_s∂_tS = L(K_ab − K_aQK_b − K_bQK_a)R`; at a simple zero
`ζ₀` of `det S` with `Sr = 0 = ℓS` (kernels spanned by `r`, `ℓ`): `ℓS_ζr ≠ 0` and
`Res S⁻¹ = lim (ζ − ζ₀)S(ζ)⁻¹ = rℓᵀ/(ℓS_ζr)`; and for the pencil `S₀ + (ζ − ζ₀)S_ζ + JS_a`,
`dζ₀/dJ = −ℓS_ar/(ℓS_ζr)` over `ℝ` and over `ℂ` (every `RCLike` field), the law's reduced operators being
complex.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Law.stepLaplacian_eq_frame

theorems.statement:
theorem stepLaplacian_eq_frame (ψ : (Fin 5 → ℝ) → ℝ) (hψ : ContDiff ℝ 2 ψ) (x : Fin 5 → ℝ)
    (f : Fin 4 → Fin 5 → ℝ) (hon : ∀ i j, f i ⬝ᵥ f j = if i = j then 1 else 0)
    (hperp : ∀ i, ∑ a, f i a = 0) :
    stepLaplacian ψ x = ∑ i, fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ ψ) x (f i) (f i)
theorems.description:
**The step Laplacian is the Laplacian of `𝟏^⊥ = ℝ⁴`:** for `ψ ∈ C²` and every orthonormal basis
`f₁, …, f₄` of `𝟏^⊥`, `Σ_t (v_t·∇)²ψ(x) = Σ_i D²ψ(x)(f_i, f_i)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.prop_59

source_context.command: open Matrix Filter Topology Asymptotics Comparison

theorems.statement:
theorem prop_59 :
    ∑ t, vR t = 0 ∧
    (∀ a b, vR a ⬝ᵥ vR b = (if a = b then 1 else 0) - 1 / 5) ∧
    ∑ t, vecMulVec (vR t) (vR t) = (1 : Matrix (Fin 5) (Fin 5) ℝ) - (1 / 5 : ℝ) • (Matrix.of fun _ _ => 1) ∧
    (∀ v : Fin 5 → ℝ, ∑ i, v i = 0 → (∑ t, vecMulVec (vR t) (vR t)) *ᵥ v = v) ∧
    (∀ (ψ : (Fin 5 → ℝ) → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ 3 ψ → ∀ (x : Fin 5 → ℝ) (m : ℝ),
      (fun ε : ℝ => (1 + 4 * (1 / 4 - ε ^ 2 * m ^ 2 / 24) ^ 2) * ψ x -
        (1 / 4 - ε ^ 2 * m ^ 2 / 24) * ∑ t, ψ (x + ε • vR t) -
        ε ^ 2 / 8 * (m ^ 2 * ψ x - stepLaplacian ψ x)) =O[𝓝 0] (fun ε : ℝ => ε ^ 3)) ∧
    (∀ (ψ : (Fin 5 → ℝ) → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ 2 ψ → ∀ (x : Fin 5 → ℝ) (f : Fin 4 → Fin 5 → ℝ),
      (∀ i j, f i ⬝ᵥ f j = if i = j then 1 else 0) → (∀ i, ∑ a, f i a = 0) →
      stepLaplacian ψ x = ∑ i, fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ ψ) x (f i) (f i)) ∧
    ∃ f : Fin 4 → Fin 5 → ℝ, (∀ i j, f i ⬝ᵥ f j = if i = j then 1 else 0) ∧ ∀ i, ∑ a, f i a = 0
theorems.description:
**Proposition 59, the law near its critical step.** `v_t = e_t − 𝟏/5`: `Σ_t v_t = 0`,
`v_a·v_b = δ_ab − 1/5`, `Σ_t v_t ⊗ v_t = 1 − 𝟏𝟏ᵀ/5`, the identity on `𝟏^⊥ = ℝ⁴`; for every `ψ ∈ C³` and
every `x`, at `u = 1/4 − ε²m²/24`, `(1 + 4u²)ψ(x) − u Σ_t ψ(x + εv_t) = (ε²/8)(m²ψ(x) − Δψ(x)) + O(ε³)`;
and `Δψ(x) = Σ_t (v_t·∇)²ψ(x)` is the Laplacian of `𝟏^⊥ = ℝ⁴`: `Σ_i D²ψ(x)(f_i, f_i)` for every orthonormal
basis `f` of `𝟏^⊥` (one exists).

theorem det_one_sub_connStepSigned {σ : Fin 5 → Fin 16 → ℂ} (hσ : IsLinkSign σ)
    (c : Connection (Fin 16) (Matrix.unitaryGroup n ℂ)) (t : Fin 5) (u : ℂ) :

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Law.bass_connection
theorems.statement:
theorem bass_connection {σ : Fin 5 → Fin 16 → ℂ} (hσ : IsLinkSign σ)
    (c : Connection (Fin 16) (Matrix.unitaryGroup n ℂ)) (u : ℂ) :
    (1 - u • stepOp (connStepSigned σ c)).det =
      (1 - u ^ 2) ^ (24 * Fintype.card n) *
        ((1 + 4 * u ^ 2) • (1 : Matrix (Fin 16 × n) (Fin 16 × n) ℂ) -
          u • ∑ t, connStepSigned σ c t).det
theorems.description:
**Proposition 54, the first line, for every unitary connection and either sign:**
`det(I − uB^σ[U]) = (1 − u²)^{24 dim U} det((1 + 4u²) − uA^σ[U])` for every `u`.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Law.quad_lower_connection
theorems.statement:
theorem quad_lower_connection {σ : Fin 5 → Fin 16 → ℂ} (hσ : IsLinkSign σ)
    (c : Connection (Fin 16) (Matrix.unitaryGroup n ℂ)) (u : ℝ) (hu : 0 ≤ u)
    (x : Fin 16 × n → ℂ) :
    (1 - u) * (1 - 4 * u) * (star x ⬝ᵥ x).re ≤
      (star x ⬝ᵥ (((1 + 4 * (u : ℂ) ^ 2) • (1 : Matrix (Fin 16 × n) (Fin 16 × n) ℂ) -
        (u : ℂ) • ∑ t, connStepSigned σ c t) *ᵥ x)).re
theorems.description:
**Below the critical step the law's operator is bounded below by `(1 − u)(1 − 4u)`**, for every unitary
connection and either sign.

      24 * (15 / 16) ^ 24 * (1 - 4 * u) + (1 - 4 * u) ^ 2 * h.eval u
theorems.description: **At the critical step:** `D₊(u) = 24(15/16)²⁴(1 − 4u) + (1 − 4u)² h(u)` with `h` a polynomial.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.prop_54
theorems.statement:
theorem prop_54 :
    (∀ (n : Type) [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] (c : Connection (Fin 16) (Matrix.unitaryGroup n ℂ))
        (u : ℂ),
      (1 - u • stepOp (Law.connStepSigned Law.countSign c)).det =
          (1 - u ^ 2) ^ (24 * Fintype.card n) *
            ((1 + 4 * u ^ 2) • (1 : Matrix (Fin 16 × n) (Fin 16 × n) ℂ) -
              u • ∑ t, Law.connStepSigned Law.countSign c t).det ∧
        (1 - u • stepOp (Law.connStepSigned Law.cliffordSign c)).det =
          (1 - u ^ 2) ^ (24 * Fintype.card n) *
            ((1 + 4 * u ^ 2) • (1 : Matrix (Fin 16 × n) (Fin 16 × n) ℂ) -
              u • ∑ t, Law.connStepSigned Law.cliffordSign c t).det) ∧
    (∀ u : ℂ, (1 - u • B ℂ).det =
      (1 - u ^ 2) ^ 24 * (1 - u) * (1 - 4 * u) * (1 - u + 4 * u ^ 2) ^ 10 *
        (1 + 3 * u + 4 * u ^ 2) ^ 5) ∧
    (∀ u : ℂ, (1 - u • stepOp (signTransitionC (-1 : ℂ))).det =
      (1 - u ^ 2) ^ 24 * (1 + 3 * u ^ 2 + 16 * u ^ 4) ^ 8) ∧
    ((1 - (1 / 4 : ℂ) • B ℂ).det = 0 ∧
      (1 - (1 / 4 : ℂ) ^ 2) ^ 24 * (1 - 1 / 4) * (1 - 1 / 4 + 4 * (1 / 4) ^ 2) ^ 10 *
        (1 + 3 * (1 / 4) + 4 * (1 / 4 : ℂ) ^ 2) ^ 5 ≠ 0) ∧
    (∃ h : ℂ[X], ∀ u : ℂ, (1 - u • B ℂ).det =
      24 * (15 / 16) ^ 24 * (1 - 4 * u) + (1 - 4 * u) ^ 2 * h.eval u) ∧
    (1 - (1 / 4 : ℂ) • stepOp (signTransitionC (-1 : ℂ))).det = (15 / 16) ^ 24 * (5 / 4) ^ 8 ∧
    (∀ (n : Type) [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] (c : Connection (Fin 16) (Matrix.unitaryGroup n ℂ))
        (u : ℝ), 0 ≤ u → u < 1 / 4 → 0 < (1 - u) * (1 - 4 * u) ∧
      ∀ x : Fin 16 × n → ℂ,
        (1 - u) * (1 - 4 * u) * (star x ⬝ᵥ x).re ≤
          (star x ⬝ᵥ (((1 + 4 * (u : ℂ) ^ 2) • (1 : Matrix (Fin 16 × n) (Fin 16 × n) ℂ) -
            (u : ℂ) • ∑ t, Law.connStepSigned Law.countSign c t) *ᵥ x)).re ∧
        (1 - u) * (1 - 4 * u) * (star x ⬝ᵥ x).re ≤
          (star x ⬝ᵥ (((1 + 4 * (u : ℂ) ^ 2) • (1 : Matrix (Fin 16 × n) (Fin 16 × n) ℂ) -
            (u : ℂ) • ∑ t, Law.connStepSigned Law.cliffordSign c t) *ᵥ x)).re)
theorems.description:
**Proposition 54, the determinant.** For every unitary connection `U` (of every rank `dim U`) and either
sign (the count `B₊[U]`, the Clifford sign `B₋[U]`), `det(I − uB±[U]) = (1 − u²)^{24 dim U} det((1 + 4u²) −
uA±[U])`; without a connection `D₊(u) = (1 − u²)²⁴(1 − u)(1 − 4u)(1 − u + 4u²)¹⁰(1 + 3u + 4u²)⁵` and
`D₋(u) = (1 − u²)²⁴(1 + 3u² + 16u⁴)⁸` (`D₊` with the canonical step `B ℂ`, `stepOp_transitionMat_eq`); at `u = 1/4` only the factor `1 − 4u` vanishes,
`D₊(u) = 24(15/16)²⁴(1 − 4u) + O((1 − 4u)²)` and `D₋(1/4) = (15/16)²⁴(5/4)⁸`; for `0 ≤ u < 1/4` and every
unitary connection, `(1 + 4u²) − uA±[U] ≥ (1 − u)(1 − 4u) > 0`.
