theorems.name: Comparison.System.eq_13

source_context.command: open Matrix Complex Comparison Filter Topology Asymptotics

theorems.statement:
theorem eq_13 :
    (∀ u : ℂ, law u = (1 - u ^ 2) ^ 24 * (1 - u) * (1 - 4 * u) * (1 - u + 4 * u ^ 2) ^ 10 *
      (1 + 3 * u + 4 * u ^ 2) ^ 5) ∧
    (∀ u : ℂ, law u = (1 - u ^ 2) ^ (linkCount - Fintype.card (Fin 16)) *
      WholePicture.kN 0 u ^ gradeCount 0 * WholePicture.kN 2 u ^ gradeCount 2 *
        WholePicture.kN 4 u ^ gradeCount 4) ∧
    linkCount = 40 ∧ Fintype.card (Fin 16) = 16 ∧
    gradeCount 0 = 1 ∧ gradeCount 2 = 10 ∧ gradeCount 4 = 5 ∧
    (∀ x : Fin 16, (disagreeSet x).card = 0 ∨ (disagreeSet x).card = 2 ∨ (disagreeSet x).card = 4)
theorems.description:
**Equation (13), the law:** `det(I₈₀ − uB) = (1 − u²)²⁴(1 − u)(1 − 4u)(1 − u + 4u²)¹⁰(1 + 3u + 4u²)⁵
= (1 − u²)^{40−16} ∏_N k_N(u)^{dim N}` for every `u`, where `40` counts the links and `16` the two-spinor states, and
`dim N` counts the characters of grade `N`: `1, 10, 5` for `N = 0, 2, 4`, the only grades.
Every candidate system: System.uniqueness.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.eq_14

source_context.command: open Matrix Complex Comparison Filter Topology Asymptotics

theorems.statement:
theorem eq_14 :
    (∀ N u : ℂ, WholePicture.kN N u = 1 + 4 * u ^ 2 - u * (5 - 2 * N)) ∧
    (∀ l : Fin 16, charValue l = 5 - 2 * ((disagreeSet l).card : ℤ)) ∧
    A ℤ * charTable = charTable * Matrix.diagonal charValue
theorems.description:
**Equation (14), the grade factor:** `k_N(u) = 1 + 4u² − u(5 − 2N)`, and `5 − 2N` is the eigenvalue of the
adjacency on the characters of grade `N` (`A·χ = χ·diag(5 − 2N)`).

theorems.name: Comparison.System.eq_15

source_context.command: open Matrix Complex Comparison Filter Topology Asymptotics

theorems.statement:
theorem eq_15 :
    (∀ u : ℂ, (1 - u • Bminus).det = (1 - u ^ 2) ^ 24 * (1 + 3 * u ^ 2 + 16 * u ^ 4) ^ 8) ∧
    Aminus * Aminus = (5 : ℤ) • (1 : Matrix (Fin 16) (Fin 16) ℤ) ∧
    (∑ t, lineOnRel t) * (∑ t, lineOnRel t) = (5 : ℂ) • (1 : Matrix Two Two ℂ)
theorems.description:
**Equation (15), the signed law:** `det(I − uB₋) = (1 − u²)²⁴(1 + 3u² + 16u⁴)⁸` for every `u`, and
`A₋² = 5` (in the basis of the two-spinor states, and as `Σ_t γ_t ⊗ 1` on the sixteen amplitudes of two systems).

theorems.name: Comparison.System.eq_16

source_context.command: open Matrix Complex Comparison Filter Topology Asymptotics

theorems.description:
**Equation (16), the renewal at the four points `u = i^d/4`:** with `R₋(u) = (1 + 3u²)/(1 + 3u² + 16u⁴)`,
`1 − 1/R₋(u) = Φ(4u)` wherever the denominators do not vanish, and at `u = i^k/4` for every `k`
(`Φ(z) = −z⁴/(16 + 3z²)`): `1 − 1/R₋(i^k/4) = Φ(i^k)`. That `R₋` is the walk's renewed signed return is
Proposition 55 (`prop_55`).

theorems.name: Comparison.System.eq_17

source_context.command: open Matrix Complex Comparison Filter Topology Asymptotics

theorems.statement:
theorem eq_17 :
    (∀ (n : Type) [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] (c : Connection (Fin 16) (Matrix.unitaryGroup n ℂ))
      (u : ℝ), 0 ≤ u → ∀ x : Fin 16 × n → ℂ,
      (1 - u) * (1 - 4 * u) * (star x ⬝ᵥ x).re ≤
        (star x ⬝ᵥ (((1 + 4 * (u : ℂ) ^ 2) • (1 : Matrix (Fin 16 × n) (Fin 16 × n) ℂ) -
          (u : ℂ) • ∑ t, WholePicture.connStep c t) *ᵥ x)).re) ∧
    ∀ u : ℝ, (1 - u) * (1 - 4 * u) = 1 + 4 * u ^ 2 - 5 * u
theorems.description:
**Equation (17), positivity for every connection:** `(1 + 4u²) − uA_U ⪰ (1 − u)(1 − 4u)` for every unitary
connection `U` and every `u ≥ 0`, with `(1 − u)(1 − 4u) = 1 + 4u² − 5u`.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.eq_18

source_context.command: open Matrix Complex Comparison Filter Topology Asymptotics

theorems.statement:
theorem eq_18 :
    (∀ z : ℂ, ‖z‖ ≤ 1 → HasSum (fun n => (excursionLaw n : ℂ) * z ^ n) (excursionGF z)) ∧
    (∀ z : ℂ, ‖z‖ ≤ 1 → HasSum (fun n => (signedLaw n : ℂ) * z ^ n) (Comparison.Law.Phi z)) ∧
    excursionGF 1 = 1 ∧ HasDerivAt excursionGF 16 1 ∧ HasSum excursionLaw 1 ∧
    HasSum (fun n : ℕ => (n : ℝ) * excursionLaw n) 16
theorems.description:
**Equation (18), the two first returns:** `F(z) = z⁴(1 + z)/(16 − 8z − 3z² − 3z³)` and `Φ(z) = −z⁴/(16 + 3z²)`
are the sums of the excursion's and the signed excursion's series on `|z| ≤ 1` (`z = 4u`); `F(1) = Σ f_n = 1` and
`F′(1) = Σ n f_n = 16`.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.eq_20

source_context.command: open Matrix Complex Comparison Filter Topology Asymptotics

theorems.statement:
theorem eq_20 :
    WholePicture.lapM = (5 : ℝ) • (1 : Matrix (Fin 16) (Fin 16) ℝ) - A ℝ ∧
    WholePicture.greenM = (1 / 32 : ℝ) • ((7 : ℝ) • (1 : Matrix (Fin 16) (Fin 16) ℝ) + A ℝ) -
      (3 / 128 : ℝ) • Matrix.of (fun _ _ => (1 : ℝ)) ∧
    (WholePicture.lapM * WholePicture.greenM * WholePicture.lapM = WholePicture.lapM ∧
      WholePicture.greenM * WholePicture.lapM * WholePicture.greenM = WholePicture.greenM ∧
      (WholePicture.lapM * WholePicture.greenM)ᵀ = WholePicture.lapM * WholePicture.greenM ∧
      (WholePicture.greenM * WholePicture.lapM)ᵀ = WholePicture.greenM * WholePicture.lapM) ∧
    (∀ X : Matrix (Fin 16) (Fin 16) ℝ, WholePicture.lapM * X * WholePicture.lapM = WholePicture.lapM →
      X * WholePicture.lapM * X = X → (WholePicture.lapM * X)ᵀ = WholePicture.lapM * X →
      (X * WholePicture.lapM)ᵀ = X * WholePicture.lapM → X = WholePicture.greenM) ∧
    (∀ f : Fin 16, (disagreeSet f).card = 2 →
      WholePicture.greenM 0 0 + WholePicture.greenM f f - 2 * WholePicture.greenM 0 f = 7 / 16) ∧
    (∀ l : Fin 16, (disagreeSet l).card = 4 →
      WholePicture.greenM 0 0 + WholePicture.greenM l l - 2 * WholePicture.greenM 0 l = 3 / 8)
theorems.description:
**Equation (20), the Green function of the critical germ:** `(5 − A)⁺ = (7 + A)/32 − 3J/128`: the matrix
`G = (7 + A)/32 − 3J/128` satisfies the four Penrose equations for `M = 5 − A`, and every matrix that satisfies
them is `G`; the resistance `R(x, y) = G_xx + G_yy − 2G_xy` from the start's vertex is `b = 7/16` to every plane and
`3/8` to every line.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.eq_24

source_context.command: open Matrix Complex Comparison Filter Topology Asymptotics

theorems.statement:
theorem eq_24 :
    (∀ (ψ : (Fin 5 → ℝ) → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ 3 ψ → ∀ (x : Fin 5 → ℝ) (m : ℝ),
      (fun ε : ℝ => (1 + 4 * (1 / 4 - ε ^ 2 * m ^ 2 / 24) ^ 2) * ψ x -
        (1 / 4 - ε ^ 2 * m ^ 2 / 24) * ∑ t, ψ (x + ε • vR t) -
        ε ^ 2 / 8 * (m ^ 2 * ψ x - stepLaplacian ψ x)) =O[𝓝 0] (fun ε : ℝ => ε ^ 3)) ∧
    (∀ (ψ : (Fin 5 → ℝ) → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ 2 ψ → ∀ (x : Fin 5 → ℝ) (f : Fin 4 → Fin 5 → ℝ),
      (∀ i j, f i ⬝ᵥ f j = if i = j then 1 else 0) → (∀ i, ∑ a, f i a = 0) →
      stepLaplacian ψ x = ∑ i, fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ ψ) x (f i) (f i))
theorems.description:
**Equation (24), the law near its critical step:** at `u = 1/4 − ε²m²/24`, for every `C³` function `ψ`,
`(1 + 4u²)ψ(x) − u Σ_t ψ(x + εv_t) = (ε²/8)(m²ψ(x) − Δψ(x)) + O(ε³)`, and `Δ = Σ_t (v_t·∇)²` is the Laplacian of
`𝟏^⊥ = ℝ⁴`: `Σ_t D²ψ(v_t, v_t) = Σ_{i=1}^4 D²ψ(f_i, f_i)` for every orthonormal basis `f` of `𝟏^⊥`.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.eq_25

source_context.command: open Matrix Complex Comparison Filter Topology Asymptotics

theorems.statement:
theorem eq_25 :
    (∀ (k μ : ℝ) (j h : Fin 5), stepMotion k μ j h =
      NormedSpace.exp ((-k) • (I • γ j)) * NormedSpace.exp ((-μ) • (I • γ h))) ∧
    (∀ (k μ : ℝ) (j h : Fin 5), j ≠ h → stepMotion k μ j h + (stepMotion k μ j h)ᴴ =
      ((2 * Real.cos k * Real.cos μ : ℝ) : ℂ) • (1 : Matrix Four Four ℂ)) ∧
    (∀ (k μ : ℝ) (j h : Fin 5), j ≠ h → ∀ v : Four → ℂ, v ≠ 0 → ∀ lam : ℂ,
      stepMotion k μ j h *ᵥ v = lam • v → lam.re = Real.cos k * Real.cos μ ∧ Complex.normSq lam = 1) ∧
    (∀ μ k : ℝ, |μ| ≤ 1 / 2 → |k| ≤ 1 / 2 →
      |Real.arccos (Real.cos μ * Real.cos k) ^ 2 - (μ ^ 2 + k ^ 2 - μ ^ 2 * k ^ 2 / 3)| ≤
        3 * (μ ^ 2 + k ^ 2) ^ 3)
theorems.description:
**Equation (25), the dispersion of one step in motion:** for `U = e^{−ikγ_j}e^{−iμγ_h}` (the matrix
exponentials) with `j ≠ h`,
`U + U† = 2 cos k cos μ`; every eigenvalue `λ` of `U` has `|λ| = 1` and `Re λ = cos ω = cos μ cos k`; and for
`|μ|, |k| ≤ 1/2`, `ω = arccos(cos μ cos k)` has `ω² = μ² + k² − μ²k²/3 + O((μ² + k²)³)`, with the explicit bound
`3(μ² + k²)³`.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Law.logZ_eq_neg
theorems.statement: theorem logZ_eq_neg (M : Matrix ι ι ℂ) : logZ M = -logSeries M

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Law.log_Z
theorems.statement:
theorem log_Z (M : Matrix ι ι ℂ) :
    (detSeries M)⁻¹ * detSeries M = 1 ∧
    PowerSeries.constantCoeff (detSeries M)⁻¹ = 1 ∧
    PowerSeries.constantCoeff (logZ M) = 0 ∧
    PowerSeries.derivative (R := ℂ) (detSeries M)⁻¹ =
      (detSeries M)⁻¹ * PowerSeries.derivative (R := ℂ) (logZ M) ∧
    ∀ Q : PowerSeries ℂ, PowerSeries.constantCoeff Q = 1 →
      PowerSeries.derivative (R := ℂ) Q = Q * PowerSeries.derivative (R := ℂ) (logZ M) →
      Q = (detSeries M)⁻¹
theorems.description:
**`Z = det(I − uM)⁻¹` and `log Z = Σ_{r ≥ 1} uʳ Tr Mʳ/r`:** `Z·det(I − uM) = 1`, `Z(0) = 1`, `(log Z)(0) = 0`,
`Z′ = Z·(log Z)′`, and every power series `Q` with `Q(0) = 1` and `Q′ = Q·(log Z)′` is `Z`.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Law.effAction_eq
theorems.statement: theorem effAction_eq (M : Matrix ι ι ℂ) : -logZ M = logSeries M
theorems.description: `Γ = −log Z = log det(I − uM)` (`logSeries`, `Existence/LogDet.lean`).

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Law.Bconn_apply
theorems.statement:
theorem Bconn_apply (c : Connection (Fin 16) (Matrix.unitaryGroup n ℂ)) (y : Fin 16) (i : n) (s : Fin 5)
    (x : Fin 16) (j : n) (t : Fin 5) :
    Bconn c ((y, i), s) ((x, j), t) =
      if s ≠ t ∧ y = transition s x then (c.U y x : Matrix n n ℂ) i j else 0
theorems.description: **The step with a connection, entry by entry:** `B[U](S′, s; S, t) = [s ≠ t][S′ = S △ T_s] U_{S′S}`.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Law.trace_reindex_eq
theorems.statement:
theorem trace_reindex_eq {m' n' : Type*} [Fintype m'] [Fintype n'] (e : m' ≃ n')
    (M : Matrix m' m' ℂ) : (Matrix.reindex e e M).trace = M.trace

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Law.BconnS_pow
theorems.statement:
theorem BconnS_pow (c : Connection (Fin 16) (Matrix.unitaryGroup n ℂ)) (r : ℕ) :
    (BconnS c) ^ r = Matrix.reindex (stateEquiv n) (stateEquiv n) ((Bconn c) ^ r)

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Law.blk_BconnS_apply
theorems.statement:
theorem blk_BconnS_apply (c : Connection (Fin 16) (Matrix.unitaryGroup n ℂ)) (a' a : State) (i' i : n) :
    blk (BconnS c) a' a i' i =
      if Continues a a' then WholePicture.turnMat c a'.1 a.1 i' i else 0
theorems.description: The block of `B[U]` from the state `a` to the state `a′`: the rotation `U_{a′a}` if `a′` continues `a`.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Law.holL_eq_zero
theorems.statement:
theorem holL_eq_zero {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (A : ℕ → Matrix ι ι ℂ) {j : ℕ}
    (h : A j = 0) : ∀ r, j < r → holL A r = 0
  | 0, hj => absurd hj (Nat.not_lt_zero _)
  | r + 1, hj => by
    rw [holL_succ]
    rcases Nat.lt_succ_iff_lt_or_eq.mp hj with hlt | heq
    · rw [holL_eq_zero A h r hlt, mul_zero]
    · rw [← heq, h, zero_mul]

theorem holL_congr {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (A A' : ℕ → Matrix ι ι ℂ) :
    ∀ r, (∀ j < r, A j = A' j) → holL A r = holL A' r
  | 0, _ => rfl
  | r + 1, h => by
    rw [holL_succ, holL_succ, h r (Nat.lt_succ_self r),
      holL_congr A A' r (fun j hj => h j (Nat.lt_succ_of_lt hj))]

/-- **The holonomy of a word of states:** the ordered product of the rotations along it when it is a closed
walk, and `0` otherwise. -/
theorem hol_BconnS (c : Connection (Fin 16) (Matrix.unitaryGroup n ℂ)) {r : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r)
    (w : Fin r → State) :
    GroupsContinuumLaw.Euler.hol (BconnS c) hr w = if IsClosedHistory hr w then
      holL (fun j => WholePicture.turnMat c (ext hr w (j + 1)).1 (ext hr w j).1) r else 0

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Law.holL_congr
theorems.statement:
theorem holL_congr {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (A A' : ℕ → Matrix ι ι ℂ) :
    ∀ r, (∀ j < r, A j = A' j) → holL A r = holL A' r
  | 0, _ => rfl
  | r + 1, h => by
    rw [holL_succ, holL_succ, h r (Nat.lt_succ_self r),
      holL_congr A A' r (fun j hj => h j (Nat.lt_succ_of_lt hj))]

/-- **The holonomy of a word of states:** the ordered product of the rotations along it when it is a closed
walk, and `0` otherwise. -/
theorem hol_BconnS (c : Connection (Fin 16) (Matrix.unitaryGroup n ℂ)) {r : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r)
    (w : Fin r → State) :
    GroupsContinuumLaw.Euler.hol (BconnS c) hr w = if IsClosedHistory hr w then
      holL (fun j => WholePicture.turnMat c (ext hr w (j + 1)).1 (ext hr w j).1) r else 0

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Law.hol_BconnS
theorems.statement:
theorem hol_BconnS (c : Connection (Fin 16) (Matrix.unitaryGroup n ℂ)) {r : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r)
    (w : Fin r → State) :
    GroupsContinuumLaw.Euler.hol (BconnS c) hr w = if IsClosedHistory hr w then
      holL (fun j => WholePicture.turnMat c (ext hr w (j + 1)).1 (ext hr w j).1) r else 0
theorems.description:
**The holonomy of a word of states:** the ordered product of the rotations along it when it is a closed
walk, and `0` otherwise.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Law.trace_Bconn_pow
theorems.statement:
theorem trace_Bconn_pow (c : Connection (Fin 16) (Matrix.unitaryGroup n ℂ)) {r : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r) :
    ((Bconn c) ^ r).trace = ∑ w : Fin r → State,
      if IsClosedHistory hr w then
        (holL (fun j => WholePicture.turnMat c (ext hr w (j + 1)).1 (ext hr w j).1) r).trace
      else 0
theorems.description: **`Tr B[U]^r` is the sum over the closed walks of length `r` of the trace of their holonomy.**

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Law.euler_Bconn
theorems.statement:
theorem euler_Bconn (c : Connection (Fin 16) (Matrix.unitaryGroup n ℂ)) {r : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r) :
    ((Bconn c) ^ r).trace / r = ∑ d ∈ r.divisors.attach, ∑ p ∈ (Finset.univ.filter
        fun p : Fin d.1 → State => minPer (Nat.pos_of_mem_divisors d.2) p = d.1),
      (1 / (d.1 : ℂ)) * (((GroupsContinuumLaw.Euler.hol (BconnS c) (Nat.pos_of_mem_divisors d.2) p) ^ (r / d.1)).trace /
        ((r / d.1 : ℕ) : ℂ))
theorems.description:
**Every closed walk counted once, with its holonomy:** the coefficient of `uʳ` of
`log Z = Σ_r uʳ Tr B[U]^r/r` is that of `Σ_{ℓ primitive} (1/|ℓ|) Σ_k u^{k|ℓ|} Tr(hol ℓ)^k/k`.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Law.B_mulVec_one
theorems.statement: theorem B_mulVec_one : (B ℂ) *ᵥ (fun _ => (1 : ℂ)) = fun _ => 4
theorems.description: **Each state has four continuations:** `B𝟏 = 4·𝟏`.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Law.quarter_iff
theorems.statement: theorem quarter_iff (u : ℂ) : (u • B ℂ) *ᵥ (fun _ => (1 : ℂ)) = (fun _ => 1) ↔ u = 1 / 4
theorems.description: **`(uB)𝟏 = 𝟏` exactly at `u = 1/4`.**

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Law.quarter_walk
theorems.statement:
theorem quarter_walk :
    (∀ p q : State, 0 ≤ ((1 / 4 : ℝ) • B ℝ) p q) ∧
      (∀ s : State, ∑ s' : State, ((1 / 4 : ℝ) • B ℝ) s' s = 1)
theorems.description: **`B/4` is a walk:** its entries are `0` or `1/4` and each row of continuations sums to one.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.eq_12
theorems.statement:
theorem eq_12 (n : Type) [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] (c : Connection (Fin 16) (Matrix.unitaryGroup n ℂ)) :
    (∀ u : ℂ, (1 - u • Bconn c).det =
      ((1 - (Polynomial.X : Polynomial ℂ) • (Bconn c).map Polynomial.C).det).eval u) ∧
    (detSeries (Bconn c))⁻¹ * detSeries (Bconn c) = 1 ∧
    PowerSeries.constantCoeff (detSeries (Bconn c))⁻¹ = 1 ∧
    PowerSeries.constantCoeff (logZ (Bconn c)) = 0 ∧
    PowerSeries.derivative (R := ℂ) (detSeries (Bconn c))⁻¹ =
      (detSeries (Bconn c))⁻¹ * PowerSeries.derivative (R := ℂ) (logZ (Bconn c)) ∧
    (∀ Q : PowerSeries ℂ, PowerSeries.constantCoeff Q = 1 →
      PowerSeries.derivative (R := ℂ) Q = Q * PowerSeries.derivative (R := ℂ) (logZ (Bconn c)) →
      Q = (detSeries (Bconn c))⁻¹)
theorems.description:
**Equation (12):** for every unitary connection `U`, `Z = det(I − uB[U])⁻¹` and
`log Z = Σ_{r ≥ 1} uʳ Tr B[U]^r/r`, as formal power series in `u` (`det(I − uB[U])` is the polynomial whose value
at every `u` is the determinant): `Z·det(I − uB[U]) = 1`, `Z(0) = 1`, `(log Z)(0) = 0`, `Z′ = Z·(log Z)′`, and
`Z` is the only power series with `Z(0) = 1` and this logarithmic derivative.
Every candidate system: System.uniqueness.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.prop_52
theorems.statement:
theorem prop_52 :
    (∀ (n : Type) [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] (c : Connection (Fin 16) (Matrix.unitaryGroup n ℂ)),
      (∀ (y : Fin 16) (i : n) (s : Fin 5) (x : Fin 16) (j : n) (t : Fin 5),
        Bconn c ((y, i), s) ((x, j), t) =
          if s ≠ t ∧ y = transition s x then (c.U y x : Matrix n n ℂ) i j else 0) ∧
      (∀ (r : ℕ) (hr : 0 < r) (w : Fin r → State), GroupsContinuumLaw.Euler.hol (BconnS c) hr w =
        if IsClosedHistory hr w then
          holL (fun j => WholePicture.turnMat c (ext hr w (j + 1)).1 (ext hr w j).1) r else 0) ∧
      (∀ (r : ℕ) (hr : 0 < r), ((Bconn c) ^ r).trace = ∑ w : Fin r → State,
        if IsClosedHistory hr w then
          (holL (fun j => WholePicture.turnMat c (ext hr w (j + 1)).1 (ext hr w j).1) r).trace
        else 0) ∧
      (∀ (r : ℕ) (hr : 0 < r), ((Bconn c) ^ r).trace / r = ∑ d ∈ r.divisors.attach,
        ∑ p ∈ (Finset.univ.filter
          fun p : Fin d.1 → State => minPer (Nat.pos_of_mem_divisors d.2) p = d.1),
        (1 / (d.1 : ℂ)) * (((GroupsContinuumLaw.Euler.hol (BconnS c) (Nat.pos_of_mem_divisors d.2) p) ^ (r / d.1)).trace /
          ((r / d.1 : ℕ) : ℂ))) ∧
      (detSeries (Bconn c))⁻¹ * detSeries (Bconn c) = 1 ∧
      PowerSeries.constantCoeff (detSeries (Bconn c))⁻¹ = 1 ∧
      PowerSeries.constantCoeff (logZ (Bconn c)) = 0 ∧
      PowerSeries.derivative (R := ℂ) (detSeries (Bconn c))⁻¹ =
        (detSeries (Bconn c))⁻¹ * PowerSeries.derivative (R := ℂ) (logZ (Bconn c)) ∧
      (∀ Q : PowerSeries ℂ, PowerSeries.constantCoeff Q = 1 →
        PowerSeries.derivative (R := ℂ) Q = Q * PowerSeries.derivative (R := ℂ) (logZ (Bconn c)) →
        Q = (detSeries (Bconn c))⁻¹) ∧
      -logZ (Bconn c) = logSeries (Bconn c)) ∧
    (∀ s : State, (Finset.univ.filter (Continues s)).card = 4) ∧
    (B ℂ) *ᵥ (fun _ => (1 : ℂ)) = (fun _ => 4) ∧
    (∀ u : ℂ, (u • B ℂ) *ᵥ (fun _ => (1 : ℂ)) = (fun _ => 1) ↔ u = 1 / 4) ∧
    (∀ p q : State, 0 ≤ ((1 / 4 : ℝ) • B ℝ) p q) ∧
    (∀ s : State, ∑ s' : State, ((1 / 4 : ℝ) • B ℝ) s' s = 1)
theorems.description:
**Proposition 52, every closed walk counted once.** For every unitary connection `U`:
`B[U](S′, s; S, t) = [s ≠ t][S′ = S △ T_s] U_{S′S}`; `Tr B[U]^r` is the sum, over the closed walks of length `r`
with a marked first step, of the trace of their holonomy (the ordered product of the rotations), every other word of
states having holonomy zero; `Tr B[U]^r/r = Σ_{d∣r} Σ_{ℓ primitive, |ℓ|=d} (1/d) Tr(hol ℓ)^{r/d}/(r/d)`, which is
the coefficient of `uʳ` of `−Σ_{[ℓ]} log det(1 − u^{|ℓ|} hol ℓ)` with each primitive class counted once;
`log Z = Σ_r uʳ Tr B[U]^r/r` with `Z = det(I − uB[U])⁻¹` (equation (12)), and `Γ = −log Z = log det(I − uB[U])`;
each state has four continuations, `(uB)𝟏 = 𝟏 ⟺ u = 1/4`, and `B/4` is a walk.
Recognition: `Z` is the partition function of the closed walks, `Γ` its effective action; `B/4` is the walk of
Prop. 26. Every candidate system: System.uniqueness.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.prop_114
theorems.statement:
theorem prop_114 :
    (∀ u : ℝ, u = 1 / 4 → (1 + 4 * u ^ 2) • (1 : Matrix (Fin 16) (Fin 16) ℝ) - u • A ℝ =
      (1 / 4 : ℝ) • ((5 : ℝ) • (1 : Matrix (Fin 16) (Fin 16) ℝ) - A ℝ)) ∧
    ((5 : ℤ) • (1 : Matrix (Fin 16) (Fin 16) ℤ) - A ℤ) * charTable =
      charTable * Matrix.diagonal (fun l => 5 - charValue l) ∧
    charTable * charTable = (16 : ℤ) • 1 ∧
    ((∏ l ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun l : Fin 16 => l ≠ 0), (5 - charValue l)) = 2 ^ 35 ∧
      (5 - charValue 0) = 0 ∧
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun l : Fin 16 => 5 - charValue l = 4)).card = 10 ∧
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun l : Fin 16 => 5 - charValue l = 8)).card = 5) ∧
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun l : Fin 16 => 5 - charValue l = 0)).card = 1 ∧
    (WholePicture.lapM = (5 : ℝ) • (1 : Matrix (Fin 16) (Fin 16) ℝ) - A ℝ ∧
      WholePicture.greenM = (1 / 32 : ℝ) • ((7 : ℝ) • (1 : Matrix (Fin 16) (Fin 16) ℝ) + A ℝ) -
        (3 / 128 : ℝ) • Matrix.of (fun _ _ => (1 : ℝ))) ∧
    (WholePicture.lapM * WholePicture.greenM * WholePicture.lapM = WholePicture.lapM ∧
      WholePicture.greenM * WholePicture.lapM * WholePicture.greenM = WholePicture.greenM ∧
      (WholePicture.lapM * WholePicture.greenM)ᵀ = WholePicture.lapM * WholePicture.greenM ∧
      (WholePicture.greenM * WholePicture.lapM)ᵀ = WholePicture.greenM * WholePicture.lapM) ∧
    (∀ X : Matrix (Fin 16) (Fin 16) ℝ, WholePicture.lapM * X * WholePicture.lapM = WholePicture.lapM →
      X * WholePicture.lapM * X = X → (WholePicture.lapM * X)ᵀ = WholePicture.lapM * X →
      (X * WholePicture.lapM)ᵀ = X * WholePicture.lapM → X = WholePicture.greenM) ∧
    (∀ f : Fin 16, (disagreeSet f).card = 2 →
      WholePicture.greenM 0 0 + WholePicture.greenM f f - 2 * WholePicture.greenM 0 f = 7 / 16) ∧
    (∀ l : Fin 16, (disagreeSet l).card = 4 →
      WholePicture.greenM 0 0 + WholePicture.greenM l l - 2 * WholePicture.greenM 0 l = 3 / 8) ∧
    Fintype.card (Bool × Fin 16) = 32 ∧
    (∀ u : ℂ, (1 - u • GroupsContinuumLaw.coverStep).det =
      (1 - u ^ 2) ^ 48 * (1 - u) * (1 - 4 * u) * (1 - u + 4 * u ^ 2) ^ 10 *
        (1 + 3 * u + 4 * u ^ 2) ^ 5 * (1 + 3 * u ^ 2 + 16 * u ^ 4) ^ 8) ∧
    GroupsContinuumLaw.coverPoly.rootMultiplicity (-1) = 48 ∧ GroupsContinuumLaw.coverPoly.rootMultiplicity 1 = 49
theorems.description:
**Proposition 114, the critical germ** (all but the spanning trees). At `u = 1/4` the law's operator on the
sixteen is `(5 − A)/4`; `5 − A` is diagonal on the characters (`(5 − A)χ = χ diag(5 − λ_l)`, `χχ = 16`) with the
eigenvalues `0` once, `4` ten times, `8` five times, so `det′(5 − A) = 4¹⁰8⁵ = 2³⁵`; `(5 − A)⁺ = (7 + A)/32 − 3J/128`
(the four Penrose equations and uniqueness); the resistance from here is `7/16 = b` to every plane and `3/8` to every
line; on the sign cover (the thirty-two signed two-spinor states) `det(I − uB̃) = det(I − uB)·det(I − uB₋)` and the zero at
`u = −1` has order `48 = 80 − 32`, at `u = 1` order `49`: the eigenvalue `−1` of the step has multiplicity `48` and
`+1` multiplicity `49`. Every candidate system: System.uniqueness.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.prop_61
theorems.statement:
theorem prop_61 :
    ((Finset.univ.filter fun p : Fin 5 × Fin 5 => p.1 < p.2).card = 10 ∧
      (Finset.univ.filter fun p : Fin 5 × Fin 5 => p.1 < p.2 ∧ p.1 ≠ 0 ∧ p.2 ≠ 0).card = 6 ∧
      (Finset.univ.filter fun p : Fin 5 × Fin 5 => p.1 < p.2 ∧ (p.1 = 0 ∨ p.2 = 0)).card = 4) ∧
    (∀ (h : Fin 5) (X Y : Fin 5 → Fin 5 → ℂ), (∀ a b, Y b a = -Y a b) →
      Law.six (univ.erase h) X * Law.six (univ.erase h) Y -
          Law.six (univ.erase h) Y * Law.six (univ.erase h) X =
        (4 : ℂ) • Law.six (univ.erase h)
          (fun a b => ∑ c ∈ univ.erase h, (X a c * Y c b - Y a c * X c b))) ∧
    (∀ (h : Fin 5) (X : Fin 5 → Fin 5 → ℂ), (∀ a b, X b a = -X a b) → ∀ y : Fin 5 → ℂ,
      Law.six (univ.erase h) X * Law.four h (univ.erase h) y -
          Law.four h (univ.erase h) y * Law.six (univ.erase h) X =
        (4 : ℂ) • Law.four h (univ.erase h) (fun a => ∑ b ∈ univ.erase h, X a b * y b)) ∧
    (∀ (h : Fin 5) (x y : Fin 5 → ℂ),
      Law.four h (univ.erase h) x * Law.four h (univ.erase h) y -
          Law.four h (univ.erase h) y * Law.four h (univ.erase h) x =
        -Law.six (univ.erase h) (fun a b => x a * y b - y a * x b)) ∧
    (∀ (h : Fin 5) (X : Fin 5 → Fin 5 → ℂ) (y : Fin 5 → ℂ),
      Law.six (univ.erase h) X = Law.four h (univ.erase h) y →
        Law.four h (univ.erase h) y = 0 ∧ Law.six (univ.erase h) X = 0) ∧
    (∀ (h : Fin 5) (ℓ : ℂ), ℓ ≠ 0 → ∀ (ωμ ων dωμν dωνμ : Fin 5 → Fin 5 → ℂ) (eμ eν deμν deνμ : Fin 5 → ℂ),
      (∀ a b, ωμ b a = -ωμ a b) → (∀ a b, ων b a = -ων a b) →
      Law.lastDirectionConn h ℓ dωμν deμν - Law.lastDirectionConn h ℓ dωνμ deνμ +
          (Law.lastDirectionConn h ℓ ωμ eμ * Law.lastDirectionConn h ℓ ων eν -
            Law.lastDirectionConn h ℓ ων eν * Law.lastDirectionConn h ℓ ωμ eμ) =
        lastDirectionCurv h (fun a b =>
            dωμν a b - dωνμ a b + ∑ c ∈ univ.erase h, (ωμ a c * ων c b - ων a c * ωμ c b) -
              (1 / ℓ ^ 2) * (eμ a * eν b - eν a * eμ b))
          (fun a => (1 / ℓ) * (deμν a - deνμ a +
            (∑ b ∈ univ.erase h, ωμ a b * eν b - ∑ b ∈ univ.erase h, ων a b * eμ b)))) ∧
    (∀ a b c d e : Fin 5, (γ a * γ b * γ c * γ d * γ e).trace = 4 * (lc5 a b c d e : ℂ)) ∧
    (∀ (h : Fin 5) (a b c d : Fin 4),
      lc5 h (h.succAbove a) (h.succAbove b) (h.succAbove c) (h.succAbove d) =
        (-1) ^ (h : ℕ) * WholePicture.eps4 a b c d) ∧
    (∀ (h : Fin 5) (F : Fin 4 → Fin 4 → Fin 5 → Fin 5 → ℂ) (T : Fin 4 → Fin 4 → Fin 5 → ℂ),
      ∑ μ, ∑ ν, ∑ ρ, ∑ σ, (WholePicture.eps4 μ ν ρ σ : ℂ) *
          (γ h * lastDirectionCurv h (F μ ν) (T μ ν) * lastDirectionCurv h (F ρ σ) (T ρ σ)).trace =
        (1 / 4 : ℂ) * Law.lastDirectionWedge h F F) ∧
    (∀ (h : Fin 5) (R E : Fin 4 → Fin 4 → Fin 5 → Fin 5 → ℂ) (ℓ : ℂ),
      Law.lastDirectionWedge h (fun μ ν a b => R μ ν a b - E μ ν a b / ℓ ^ 2)
          (fun μ ν a b => R μ ν a b - E μ ν a b / ℓ ^ 2) =
        Law.lastDirectionWedge h R R - 2 / ℓ ^ 2 * Law.lastDirectionWedge h R E + 1 / ℓ ^ 4 * Law.lastDirectionWedge h E E) ∧
    (∀ ℓ Λ : ℝ, ℓ ≠ 0 → ((1 / ℓ ^ 4) / (-(2 / ℓ ^ 2)) = -(Λ / 6) ↔ Λ = 3 / ℓ ^ 2))
theorems.description:
**Proposition 61, the ten rotations split at the last-step direction.** The ten rotations `γ_aγ_b` are the six `a, b ≠ h` and the
four `γ_hγ_a`; the six close, `[Σ Xγγ, Σ Yγγ] = 4Σ(XY − YX)γγ`, they move the four into the four,
`[Σ Xγγ, Σ yγ_hγ] = 4Σ(Xy)γ_hγ`, and `[ℝ⁴, ℝ⁴] ⊆ so(4)`, `[Σ xγ_hγ, Σ yγ_hγ] = −Σ(x∧y)γγ`; the sum is direct.
With `𝒜_μ = ¼ω_μ^{ab}γ_aγ_b + (1/2ℓ)e_μ^aγ_hγ_a` and its first jet, `𝓕_μν = ∂_μ𝒜_ν − ∂_ν𝒜_μ + [𝒜_μ, 𝒜_ν]` is
`¼𝓕^{ab}γ_aγ_b + ½𝓕^{ah}γ_hγ_a` with `𝓕^{ab} = R^{ab} − e^a∧e^b/ℓ²` and `𝓕^{ah} = T^a/ℓ`;
`tr(γ_aγ_bγ_cγ_dγ_e) = 4ε_{abcde}`; with the form indices, `ε^{μνρσ}tr(γ_h𝓕_μν𝓕_ρσ) = ¼ε_{habcd}𝓕^{ab}∧𝓕^{cd}`
and `(R − E/ℓ²)∧(R − E/ℓ²) = R∧R − (2/ℓ²)R∧E + (1/ℓ⁴)E∧E`, where on the four directions that move the last-step direction
`ε_{habcd} = (−1)^hε_{abcd}` (so `c = (−1)^h/4 ≠ 0`); the ratio of the last two coefficients gives `Λ = 3/ℓ²`.
Recognition: the Einstein–Cartan equations in the form of MacDowell and Mansouri; `Λ` the cosmological constant.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.eq_29
theorems.statement:
theorem eq_29 (R : Fin 4 → Fin 4 → Fin 4 → Fin 4 → ℝ) (hR : ∀ a b e f, R a b f e = -R a b e f)
    (ℓ : ℝ) (hℓ : ℓ ≠ 0) :
    WholePicture.wedge (fun p q => WholePicture.onPairs R p q - WholePicture.frameP p q / ℓ ^ 2)
          (fun p q => WholePicture.onPairs R p q - WholePicture.frameP p q / ℓ ^ 2) -
        WholePicture.wedge (WholePicture.onPairs R) (WholePicture.onPairs R) =
      -(4 / ℓ ^ 2) * (WholePicture.scalarR R - 6 / ℓ ^ 2) ∧
    ((24 / ℓ ^ 4 = (4 / ℓ ^ 2) * (2 * (3 / ℓ ^ 2))))
theorems.description:
**Equation (29), the curvature at the last-step direction** (as proved): `tr(γ_h𝓕∧𝓕) − tr(γ_hR∧R) = −(4/ℓ²)(R − 6/ℓ²)` in the
pairing of curvature two-forms with the form indices kept, and `Λ = 3/ℓ²`.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Law.comm_two_two
theorems.statement:
theorem comm_two_two {R : Type*} [Ring R] (A B C D : R) :
    A * B * (C * D) - C * D * (A * B) =
      A * (B * C + C * B) * D - A * C * (B * D + D * B) + (A * C + C * A) * D * B -
        C * (A * D + D * A) * B
theorems.description: In any ring, `[AB, CD] = A{B,C}D − AC{B,D} + {A,C}DB − C{A,D}B`.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Law.gamma_comm
theorems.statement:
theorem gamma_comm (a b c d : Fin 5) :
    γ a * γ b * (γ c * γ d) - γ c * γ d * (γ a * γ b) =
      (if b = c then (2 : ℂ) else 0) • (γ a * γ d) - (if b = d then (2 : ℂ) else 0) • (γ a * γ c) +
        (if a = c then (2 : ℂ) else 0) • (γ d * γ b) -
          (if a = d then (2 : ℂ) else 0) • (γ c * γ b)
theorems.description: **The bracket of two rotations:** `[γ_aγ_b, γ_cγ_d] = 2δ_bcγ_aγ_d − 2δ_bdγ_aγ_c + 2δ_acγ_dγ_b − 2δ_adγ_cγ_b`.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Law.comm_sum_sum
theorems.statement:
theorem comm_sum_sum {ι κ : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (t : Finset κ) (x : ι → ℂ) (y : κ → ℂ)
    (P : ι → Matrix Four Four ℂ) (Q : κ → Matrix Four Four ℂ) :
    (∑ i ∈ s, x i • P i) * (∑ j ∈ t, y j • Q j) - (∑ j ∈ t, y j • Q j) * (∑ i ∈ s, x i • P i) =
      ∑ i ∈ s, ∑ j ∈ t, (x i * y j) • (P i * Q j - Q j * P i)
theorems.description: **The commutator of two combinations** is the double sum of the commutators.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Law.sum_delta_left
theorems.statement:
theorem sum_delta_left {β : Type*} [AddCommMonoid β] (S : Finset (Fin 5)) (b : Fin 5) (hb : b ∈ S)
    (f : Fin 5 → β) : ∑ c ∈ S, (if b = c then f c else 0) = f b
theorems.description: Contracting a Kronecker delta in a sum over a set that contains the index.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Law.sum_delta_right
theorems.statement:
theorem sum_delta_right {β : Type*} [AddCommMonoid β] (S : Finset (Fin 5)) (b : Fin 5) (hb : b ∈ S)
    (f : Fin 5 → β) : ∑ c ∈ S, (if c = b then f c else 0) = f b

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Law.six_eq_product
theorems.statement:
theorem six_eq_product (S : Finset (Fin 5)) (X : Fin 5 → Fin 5 → ℂ) :
    six S X = ∑ p ∈ S ×ˢ S, X p.1 p.2 • (γ p.1 * γ p.2)

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Law.contract_bc
theorems.statement:
theorem contract_bc (S : Finset (Fin 5)) (f : Fin 5 → Fin 5 → Fin 5 → Fin 5 → Matrix Four Four ℂ) :
    ∑ a ∈ S, ∑ b ∈ S, ∑ c ∈ S, ∑ d ∈ S, (if b = c then f a b c d else 0) =
      ∑ a ∈ S, ∑ b ∈ S, ∑ d ∈ S, f a b b d

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Law.contract_bd
theorems.statement:
theorem contract_bd (S : Finset (Fin 5)) (f : Fin 5 → Fin 5 → Fin 5 → Fin 5 → Matrix Four Four ℂ) :
    ∑ a ∈ S, ∑ b ∈ S, ∑ c ∈ S, ∑ d ∈ S, (if b = d then f a b c d else 0) =
      ∑ a ∈ S, ∑ b ∈ S, ∑ c ∈ S, f a b c b

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Law.contract_ac
theorems.statement:
theorem contract_ac (S : Finset (Fin 5)) (f : Fin 5 → Fin 5 → Fin 5 → Fin 5 → Matrix Four Four ℂ) :
    ∑ a ∈ S, ∑ b ∈ S, ∑ c ∈ S, ∑ d ∈ S, (if a = c then f a b c d else 0) =
      ∑ a ∈ S, ∑ b ∈ S, ∑ d ∈ S, f a b a d

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Law.contract_ad
theorems.statement:
theorem contract_ad (S : Finset (Fin 5)) (f : Fin 5 → Fin 5 → Fin 5 → Fin 5 → Matrix Four Four ℂ) :
    ∑ a ∈ S, ∑ b ∈ S, ∑ c ∈ S, ∑ d ∈ S, (if a = d then f a b c d else 0) =
      ∑ a ∈ S, ∑ b ∈ S, ∑ c ∈ S, f a b c a

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Law.smul_ite_smul
theorems.statement:
theorem smul_ite_smul (k : ℂ) (P : Prop) [Decidable P] (M : Matrix Four Four ℂ) :
    k • ((if P then (2 : ℂ) else 0) • M) = if P then (2 * k) • M else 0

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Law.sum3_rev
theorems.statement:
theorem sum3_rev {β : Type*} [AddCommMonoid β] (S : Finset (Fin 5)) (F : Fin 5 → Fin 5 → Fin 5 → β) :
    ∑ a ∈ S, ∑ b ∈ S, ∑ c ∈ S, F a b c = ∑ c ∈ S, ∑ b ∈ S, ∑ a ∈ S, F a b c
theorems.description: Three sums reversed.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Law.sum3_inner
theorems.statement:
theorem sum3_inner {β : Type*} [AddCommMonoid β] (S : Finset (Fin 5)) (F : Fin 5 → Fin 5 → Fin 5 → β) :
    ∑ a ∈ S, ∑ b ∈ S, ∑ c ∈ S, F a b c = ∑ a ∈ S, ∑ c ∈ S, ∑ b ∈ S, F a b c
theorems.description: The inner two of three sums exchanged.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Law.bracket_six_six
theorems.statement:
theorem bracket_six_six (S : Finset (Fin 5)) (X Y : Fin 5 → Fin 5 → ℂ)
    (hY : ∀ a b, Y b a = -Y a b) :
    six S X * six S Y - six S Y * six S X =
      (4 : ℂ) • six S (fun a b => ∑ c ∈ S, (X a c * Y c b - Y a c * X c b))
theorems.description:
**The bracket of the six with the six:** for antisymmetric `X, Y`,
`[Σ X_ab γ_aγ_b, Σ Y_cd γ_cγ_d] = 4 Σ (XY − YX)_ab γ_aγ_b`.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Law.bracket_four_four
theorems.statement:
theorem bracket_four_four (h : Fin 5) (x y : Fin 5 → ℂ) :
    four h (univ.erase h) x * four h (univ.erase h) y - four h (univ.erase h) y * four h (univ.erase h) x =
      -six (univ.erase h) (fun a b => x a * y b - y a * x b)
theorems.description:
**The bracket of the four with the four:** `[Σ x_aγ_hγ_a, Σ y_bγ_hγ_b] = −Σ (x_ay_b − y_ax_b)γ_aγ_b`
(the indices off the last-step direction): `[ℝ⁴, ℝ⁴] ⊆ so(4)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Law.bracket_six_four
theorems.statement:
theorem bracket_six_four (h : Fin 5) (X : Fin 5 → Fin 5 → ℂ) (hX : ∀ a b, X b a = -X a b)
    (y : Fin 5 → ℂ) :
    six (univ.erase h) X * four h (univ.erase h) y - four h (univ.erase h) y * six (univ.erase h) X =
      (4 : ℂ) • four h (univ.erase h) (fun a => ∑ b ∈ univ.erase h, X a b * y b)
theorems.description:
**The bracket of the six with the four:** for antisymmetric `X`,
`[Σ X_abγ_aγ_b, Σ y_cγ_hγ_c] = 4 Σ (Xy)_aγ_hγ_a` (the indices off the last-step direction).

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Law.comm_lin
theorems.statement:
theorem comm_lin (α β : ℂ) (P Q P' Q' : Matrix Four Four ℂ) :
    (α • P + β • Q) * (α • P' + β • Q') - (α • P' + β • Q') * (α • P + β • Q) =
      (α * α) • (P * P' - P' * P) + (α * β) • (P * Q' - Q' * P) -
        (α * β) • (P' * Q - Q * P') + (β * β) • (Q * Q' - Q' * Q)
theorems.description: The commutator of two combinations of two pieces.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Law.six_combo
theorems.statement:
theorem six_combo (S : Finset (Fin 5)) (A B C D : Fin 5 → Fin 5 → ℂ) (k : ℂ) :
    six S (fun a b => A a b - B a b + C a b - k * D a b) =
      six S A - six S B + six S C - k • six S D

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Law.four_combo
theorems.statement:
theorem four_combo (h : Fin 5) (S : Finset (Fin 5)) (A B C D : Fin 5 → ℂ) :
    four h S (fun a => A a - B a + (C a - D a)) = four h S A - four h S B + (four h S C - four h S D)

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Law.curvature_jet
theorems.statement:
theorem curvature_jet (h : Fin 5) (ℓ : ℂ) (hℓ : ℓ ≠ 0)
    (ωμ ων dωμν dωνμ : Fin 5 → Fin 5 → ℂ) (eμ eν deμν deνμ : Fin 5 → ℂ)
    (hμ : ∀ a b, ωμ b a = -ωμ a b) (hν : ∀ a b, ων b a = -ων a b) :
    lastDirectionConn h ℓ dωμν deμν - lastDirectionConn h ℓ dωνμ deνμ +
        (lastDirectionConn h ℓ ωμ eμ * lastDirectionConn h ℓ ων eν - lastDirectionConn h ℓ ων eν * lastDirectionConn h ℓ ωμ eμ) =
      (1 / 4 : ℂ) • six (univ.erase h) (fun a b =>
          dωμν a b - dωνμ a b + ∑ c ∈ univ.erase h, (ωμ a c * ων c b - ων a c * ωμ c b) -
            (1 / ℓ ^ 2) * (eμ a * eν b - eν a * eμ b)) +
        (1 / (2 * ℓ)) • four h (univ.erase h) (fun a =>
          deμν a - deνμ a + (∑ b ∈ univ.erase h, ωμ a b * eν b - ∑ b ∈ univ.erase h, ων a b * eμ b))
theorems.description:
**The curvature of the connection from its first jet:** with `𝒜_μ = lastDirectionConn ω_μ e_μ`, the jet
`∂_μ𝒜_ν = lastDirectionConn (∂_μω_ν) (∂_μe_ν)` and `ω_μ`, `ω_ν` antisymmetric,
`𝓕_μν = ∂_μ𝒜_ν − ∂_ν𝒜_μ + [𝒜_μ, 𝒜_ν] = ¼ Σ (R^{ab}_μν − (e∧e)^{ab}_μν/ℓ²) γ_aγ_b + (1/2ℓ) Σ T^a_μν γ_hγ_a` with
`R^{ab} = ∂_μω_ν^{ab} − ∂_νω_μ^{ab} + Σ_c(ω_μ^{ac}ω_ν^{cb} − ω_ν^{ac}ω_μ^{cb})`, `(e∧e)^{ab} = e_μ^ae_ν^b − e_ν^ae_μ^b`
and `T^a = ∂_μe_ν^a − ∂_νe_μ^a + Σ_b(ω_μ^{ab}e_ν^b − ω_ν^{ab}e_μ^b)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Law.lastDirectionCurv_eq
theorems.statement:
theorem lastDirectionCurv_eq (h : Fin 5) (F : Fin 5 → Fin 5 → ℂ) (T : Fin 5 → ℂ) :
    lastDirectionCurv h F T = (1 / 4 : ℂ) • six (univ.erase h) F + (1 / 2 : ℂ) • four h (univ.erase h) T
theorems.description: The last-step direction curvature of `Existence/LastDirectionSplit.lean` is `¼Σ F_abγ_aγ_b + ½Σ T_aγ_hγ_a`.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Law.curvature_jet_lastDirectionCurv
theorems.statement:
theorem curvature_jet_lastDirectionCurv (h : Fin 5) (ℓ : ℂ) (hℓ : ℓ ≠ 0)
    (ωμ ων dωμν dωνμ : Fin 5 → Fin 5 → ℂ) (eμ eν deμν deνμ : Fin 5 → ℂ)
    (hμ : ∀ a b, ωμ b a = -ωμ a b) (hν : ∀ a b, ων b a = -ων a b) :
    lastDirectionConn h ℓ dωμν deμν - lastDirectionConn h ℓ dωνμ deνμ +
        (lastDirectionConn h ℓ ωμ eμ * lastDirectionConn h ℓ ων eν - lastDirectionConn h ℓ ων eν * lastDirectionConn h ℓ ωμ eμ) =
      lastDirectionCurv h (fun a b =>
          dωμν a b - dωνμ a b + ∑ c ∈ univ.erase h, (ωμ a c * ων c b - ων a c * ωμ c b) -
            (1 / ℓ ^ 2) * (eμ a * eν b - eν a * eμ b))
        (fun a => (1 / ℓ) * (deμν a - deνμ a +
          (∑ b ∈ univ.erase h, ωμ a b * eν b - ∑ b ∈ univ.erase h, ων a b * eμ b)))
theorems.description: **The curvature is the last-step direction curvature** `𝓕 = lastDirectionCurv h (R − e∧e/ℓ²) (T/ℓ)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Law.trace_lastDirection_curv_bilin
theorems.statement:
theorem trace_lastDirection_curv_bilin (h : Fin 5) (F F' : Fin 5 → Fin 5 → ℂ) (T T' : Fin 5 → ℂ) :
    (γ h * lastDirectionCurv h F T * lastDirectionCurv h F' T').trace =
      (1 / 4 : ℂ) * ∑ p ∈ (univ.erase h) ×ˢ (univ.erase h), ∑ q ∈ (univ.erase h) ×ˢ (univ.erase h),
        (lc5 h p.1 p.2 q.1 q.2 : ℂ) * F p.1 p.2 * F' q.1 q.2
theorems.description: **The bilinear trace against the last-step direction:** `tr(γ_h 𝓕 𝓕′) = ¼ Σ ε_{habcd} F_ab F′_cd`.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Law.trace_four_form
theorems.statement:
theorem trace_four_form (h : Fin 5) (F : Fin 4 → Fin 4 → Fin 5 → Fin 5 → ℂ)
    (T : Fin 4 → Fin 4 → Fin 5 → ℂ) :
    ∑ μ, ∑ ν, ∑ ρ, ∑ σ, (WholePicture.eps4 μ ν ρ σ : ℂ) *
        (γ h * lastDirectionCurv h (F μ ν) (T μ ν) * lastDirectionCurv h (F ρ σ) (T ρ σ)).trace =
      (1 / 4 : ℂ) * lastDirectionWedge h F F
theorems.description:
**`tr(γ_h 𝓕 ∧ 𝓕) = ¼ 𝓕 ∧ 𝓕`** with the form indices: for every curvature two-form
`𝓕_μν = ¼F^{ab}_μνγ_aγ_b + ½T^a_μνγ_hγ_a`.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Law.eps4_pair_swap
theorems.statement:
theorem eps4_pair_swap : ∀ μ ν ρ σ : Fin 4,
    WholePicture.eps4 μ ν ρ σ = WholePicture.eps4 ρ σ μ ν

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Law.sum4_swap
theorems.statement:
theorem sum4_swap {β : Type*} [AddCommMonoid β] (f : Fin 4 → Fin 4 → Fin 4 → Fin 4 → β) :
    ∑ μ, ∑ ν, ∑ ρ, ∑ σ, f μ ν ρ σ = ∑ μ, ∑ ν, ∑ ρ, ∑ σ, f ρ σ μ ν

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Law.lastDirectionWedge_symm
theorems.statement:
theorem lastDirectionWedge_symm (h : Fin 5) (X Y : Fin 4 → Fin 4 → Fin 5 → Fin 5 → ℂ) :
    lastDirectionWedge h X Y = lastDirectionWedge h Y X

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Law.lastDirectionWedge_lin_left
theorems.statement:
theorem lastDirectionWedge_lin_left (h : Fin 5) (X Y Z : Fin 4 → Fin 4 → Fin 5 → Fin 5 → ℂ) (α β : ℂ) :
    lastDirectionWedge h (fun μ ν a b => α * X μ ν a b + β * Y μ ν a b) Z =
      α * lastDirectionWedge h X Z + β * lastDirectionWedge h Y Z

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Law.lastDirectionWedge_lin_right
theorems.statement:
theorem lastDirectionWedge_lin_right (h : Fin 5) (X Y Z : Fin 4 → Fin 4 → Fin 5 → Fin 5 → ℂ) (α β : ℂ) :
    lastDirectionWedge h Z (fun μ ν a b => α * X μ ν a b + β * Y μ ν a b) =
      α * lastDirectionWedge h Z X + β * lastDirectionWedge h Z Y

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Law.lastDirectionWedge_mm
theorems.statement:
theorem lastDirectionWedge_mm (h : Fin 5) (R E : Fin 4 → Fin 4 → Fin 5 → Fin 5 → ℂ) (ℓ : ℂ) :
    lastDirectionWedge h (fun μ ν a b => R μ ν a b - E μ ν a b / ℓ ^ 2)
        (fun μ ν a b => R μ ν a b - E μ ν a b / ℓ ^ 2) =
      lastDirectionWedge h R R - 2 / ℓ ^ 2 * lastDirectionWedge h R E + 1 / ℓ ^ 4 * lastDirectionWedge h E E
theorems.description: **MacDowell–Mansouri with the form indices:** `(R − E/ℓ²) ∧ (R − E/ℓ²) = R∧R − (2/ℓ²)R∧E + (1/ℓ⁴)E∧E`.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Law.lc5_restrict
theorems.statement:
theorem lc5_restrict : ∀ (h : Fin 5) (a b c d : Fin 4),
    lc5 h (h.succAbove a) (h.succAbove b) (h.succAbove c) (h.succAbove d) =
      (-1) ^ (h : ℕ) * WholePicture.eps4 a b c d
theorems.description:
**On the four directions that move the last-step direction, `ε_{habcd}` is `±ε_{abcd}`:** with the four directions numbered
in order (`Fin.succAbove h`), `ε_{h, a, b, c, d} = (−1)^h ε_{abcd}`.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Law.trace_fourZ
theorems.statement:
theorem trace_fourZ : ∀ a b c d : Fin 5,
    (γZ a * γZ b * γZ c * γZ d).trace =
      4 * ((if a = b ∧ c = d then 1 else 0) - (if a = c ∧ b = d then 1 else 0) +
        (if a = d ∧ b = c then 1 else 0))

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Law.trace_four
theorems.statement:
theorem trace_four (a b c d : Fin 5) :
    (γ a * γ b * γ c * γ d).trace =
      4 * ((if a = b ∧ c = d then 1 else 0) - (if a = c ∧ b = d then 1 else 0) +
        (if a = d ∧ b = c then 1 else 0))
theorems.description: `tr(γ_aγ_bγ_cγ_d) = 4(δ_abδ_cd − δ_acδ_bd + δ_adδ_bc)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Law.split_direct
theorems.statement:
theorem split_direct (h : Fin 5) (X : Fin 5 → Fin 5 → ℂ) (y : Fin 5 → ℂ)
    (hXy : six (univ.erase h) X = four h (univ.erase h) y) :
    four h (univ.erase h) y = 0 ∧ six (univ.erase h) X = 0
theorems.description:
**The split is direct:** a combination of the six that is a combination of the four is zero, and so is the
combination of the four.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.prop_63
theorems.statement:
theorem prop_63 :
    (∀ (κ lam c : ℝ) (j : Fin 40 → ℝ) (s : Fin 16 → ℂ) (θ : Fin 40 → ℝ) (φ : Fin 16 → ℂ),
      Stationary (localAction κ lam c j s) (θ, φ) ↔
        (2 * κ) • ((cRealᵀ * cReal) *ᵥ θ) = j ∧ ∀ x, scalarEq lam c s φ x = 0) ∧
    (∀ (κ : ℝ) (j θ : Fin 40 → ℝ),
      Stationary (gaugeAction κ j) θ ↔ (2 * κ) • ((cRealᵀ * cReal) *ᵥ θ) = j) ∧
    (∀ (lam c : ℝ) (s φ : Fin 16 → ℂ),
      Stationary (scalarAction lam c s) φ ↔ ∀ x, scalarEq lam c s φ x = 0) ∧
    (∀ {κ : ℝ} {j θ : Fin 40 → ℝ}, Stationary (gaugeAction κ j) θ → gradCᵀ *ᵥ j = 0) ∧
    (∀ (κ : ℝ) (j θ : Fin 40 → ℝ) (χ : Fin 16 → ℝ),
      gaugeAction κ j (θ + gradC *ᵥ χ) = gaugeAction κ j θ - (gradCᵀ *ᵥ j) ⬝ᵥ χ ∧
        (gradCᵀ *ᵥ j = 0 → gaugeAction κ j (θ + gradC *ᵥ χ) = gaugeAction κ j θ)) ∧
    (cMat * gradZ' = 0 ∧ cubeBdZ * cMat = 0 ∧ fourBdZ * cubeBdZ = 0) ∧
    (∀ {lam : ℝ}, 0 < lam → ∀ c r : ℝ, 0 ≤ lam * (r - c) ^ 2 ∧ (lam * (r - c) ^ 2 = 0 ↔ r = c)) ∧
    (∀ lam v h : ℝ, lam * ((v + h) ^ 2 / 2 - v ^ 2 / 2) ^ 2 =
      lam * v ^ 2 * h ^ 2 + lam * v * h ^ 3 + lam * h ^ 4 / 4) ∧
    (∀ (O : Matrix (Fin 5) (Fin 5) ℝ), O * Oᵀ = 1 → ∀ (p : Fin 4 → ℝ) (M : ℝ),
      (∃ ψ : Four → ℂ, ψ ≠ 0 ∧ Article.diracOp O p M *ᵥ ψ = 0) ↔ ∑ μ, p μ ^ 2 = M ^ 2)
theorems.description:
**Proposition 63, the local form** (on the cells of `RP⁴`). The assembled action
`Γ(θ, φ) = −κ‖Cθ‖² + ⟨j, θ⟩ − [Σ_links |φ_v − φ_u|² + Σ_x λ(|φ_x|² − c)² + Σ_x 2Re(s̄_xφ_x)]` is stationary in all
its fields together exactly when `2κCᵀCθ = j` (Maxwell's inhomogeneous equations; the homogeneous pair is
`D·C = 0`, the boundary of a boundary, with `C·grad = 0`) and `(Lφ)_x + 2λ(|φ_x|² − c)φ_x + s_x = 0` (the scalar's
equation, `L = gradᵀgrad`); a current that sources a stationary field is conserved, and the gauge action does not see
a gradient when the current is conserved; the potential is least exactly at `|φ|² = c = v²/2`, about which the radial
mode has `m_H² = 2λv²`; the chart's Dirac operator `Σ_μ p_μΓ_μ + iMΓ₄` has a nonzero null vector exactly on the mass
shell `p² = M²`. Recognition: `θ` the electromagnetic potential, `φ` the Higgs field, `s = ψ̄_R𝒴†ψ_L`.

boundary of a boundary, with orientations over `ℤ`), and `δ_θ[κ‖Cθ‖² − ⟨j, θ⟩] = 0 ⟺ 2κCᵀCθ = j` (the

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Law.pattern_zpow
theorems.statement:
theorem pattern_zpow (V : Finset (Fin 5)) (u : ℂ) (hu : u ^ 2 ≠ 1) :

      (1 + u) ^ (((5 - V.card : ℕ) : ℤ) - 1) * (1 - u) ^ ((V.card : ℤ) - 1) *
        (1 + 4 * u ^ 2 - u * (((5 - V.card : ℕ) : ℂ) - (V.card : ℂ)))
theorems.description: **The meeting's factor at every one of the 32 patterns**, with integer powers, for `u² ≠ 1`.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.prop_131
theorems.statement:
theorem prop_131 :
    (∀ (V : Finset (Fin 5)) (u : ℂ), u ^ 2 ≠ 1 →
      (1 - u • Law.patternK (R := ℂ) V).det =
        (1 + u) ^ (((5 - V.card : ℕ) : ℤ) - 1) * (1 - u) ^ ((V.card : ℤ) - 1) *
          (1 + 4 * u ^ 2 - u * (((5 - V.card : ℕ) : ℂ) - (V.card : ℂ)))) ∧
    (∑ U : Fin 16, ((5 - (disagreeSet U).card : ℤ) - 1)) = 24 ∧
    (∑ U : Fin 16, (((disagreeSet U).card : ℤ) - 1)) = 24 ∧
    Law.charX80 ℚ * contB * Law.charX80 ℚ = Law.meetBlocks ℚ (Law.lastDirectionK ℚ) ∧
    (∀ u : ℂ, ∏ U : Fin 16, (1 - u • Law.patternK (R := ℂ) (disagreeSet U)).det =
      (1 - u • stepOp transitionMat).det) ∧
    (∀ u : ℂ, ∏ U : Fin 16, (1 - u • Law.patternK (R := ℂ) (disagreeSet U)).det =
      (1 - u ^ 2) ^ 24 * ∏ U : Fin 16,
        (1 + 4 * u ^ 2 - u * (((5 - (disagreeSet U).card : ℕ) : ℂ) - ((disagreeSet U).card : ℂ)))) ∧
    (∀ u : ℂ, ∏ U : Fin 16, (1 - u • Law.patternK (R := ℂ) (disagreeSet U)ᶜ).det =
      (1 + u • stepOp transitionMat).det)
theorems.description:
**Proposition 131, the meeting's factor of the law.** With `K_V = θ_V(𝐉 − I)`, `a = 5 − |V|`,
`d = |V|`: `det(I − uK_V) = (1 + u)^{a−1}(1 − u)^{d−1}(1 + 4u² − u(a − d))` at every one of the 32 patterns
(`u² ≠ 1`, integer powers); over the sixteen meetings `Σ_U(a − 1) = Σ_U(d − 1) = 24`; the character transform
makes the step the direct sum of the meetings' blocks, `(𝒳 ⊗ 1)B(𝒳 ⊗ 1) = ⊕_U K_U`; `∏_U det(I − uK_U) =
det(I − uB) = (1 − u²)²⁴ ∏_U (1 + 4u² − uλ_U)` with `λ_U = a − d`; the product over the sixteen counterparts is
`det(I + uB)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.prop_60
theorems.statement:
theorem prop_60 :
    (∀ (k μ : ℝ) (j h : Fin 5), stepMotion k μ j h =
      NormedSpace.exp ((-k) • (I • γ j)) * NormedSpace.exp ((-μ) • (I • γ h))) ∧
    (∀ (μ : ℝ) (j h : Fin 5), stepMotion 0 μ j h = NormedSpace.exp ((-μ) • (I • γ h))) ∧
    (∀ (μ : ℝ) (j h : Fin 5), stepMotion 0 μ j h = expIγ (-μ) h) ∧
    (∀ (k μ : ℝ) (j h : Fin 5), stepMotion k μ j h * (stepMotion k μ j h)ᴴ = 1) ∧
    (∀ (k μ : ℝ) (j h : Fin 5), j ≠ h → stepMotion k μ j h + (stepMotion k μ j h)ᴴ =
      ((2 * Real.cos k * Real.cos μ : ℝ) : ℂ) • (1 : Matrix Four Four ℂ)) ∧
    (∀ (k μ : ℝ) (j h : Fin 5), j ≠ h → ∀ v : Four → ℂ, v ≠ 0 → ∀ lam : ℂ,
      stepMotion k μ j h *ᵥ v = lam • v → lam.re = Real.cos k * Real.cos μ ∧ Complex.normSq lam = 1) ∧
    (∀ μ k : ℝ, |μ| ≤ 1 / 2 → |k| ≤ 1 / 2 →
      |Real.arccos (Real.cos μ * Real.cos k) ^ 2 - (μ ^ 2 + k ^ 2 - μ ^ 2 * k ^ 2 / 3)| ≤
        3 * (μ ^ 2 + k ^ 2) ^ 3) ∧
    (∀ μ : ℝ, |μ| ≤ Real.pi → Real.arccos (Real.cos μ * Real.cos 0) = |μ|) ∧
    (∀ (μ : Fin 4) (t : Fin 5), vR t ⬝ᵥ helmert μ = helmert μ t) ∧
    ((∀ i j, helmert i ⬝ᵥ helmert j = if i = j then 1 else 0) ∧ ∀ i, ∑ a, helmert i a = 0) ∧
    (∀ μ ν : Fin 4, chartLine μ * chartLine ν + chartLine ν * chartLine μ =
      (if μ = ν then (2 : ℂ) else 0) • (1 : Matrix Four Four ℂ)) ∧
    (∀ μ : Fin 4, chartLine μ * massLine + massLine * chartLine μ = 0) ∧
    massLine * massLine = 1 ∧
    (∀ (M : ℝ) (ψ : Four → (Fin 4 → ℝ) → ℂ), (∀ b, ContDiff ℝ 2 (ψ b)) → ∀ a x,
      diracOp M (diracOp M ψ) a x = lap4 (ψ a) x - (M : ℂ) ^ 2 * ψ a x)
theorems.description:
**Proposition 60, one step in motion.** At rest one step turns the clock, `U = e^{−iμγ_h}`; moving along
another line `j`, `U = e^{−ikγ_j}e^{−iμγ_h}` (the matrix exponentials, `= (cos k − i sin k γ_j)(cos μ − i sin μ γ_h)`,
E's `exp_iγ`) is unitary with `U + U† = 2 cos k cos μ`, so every eigenvalue
`λ = e^{iω}` has `|λ| = 1` and `cos ω = Re λ = cos μ cos k`; for `|μ|, |k| ≤ 1/2`,
`ω = arccos(cos μ cos k)` has `|ω² − (μ² + k² − μ²k²/3)| ≤ 3(μ² + k²)³ ≤ 3(|μ| + |k|)⁶`; at `k = 0`, `ω = |μ|`;
in the chart `Γ^μ = Σ_t v_t^μ γ_t` (`v_t^μ = v_t·f_μ = f_μ(t)`, `f` an orthonormal basis of `𝟏^⊥`) and
`γ(m) = Σ_t γ_t/√5` are five anticommuting lines, and `(Γ^μ∂_μ + iMγ(m))²ψ = Δψ − M²ψ` for every `C²` field
`ψ : ℝ⁴ → ℂ⁴`, `Δ = Σ_μ ∂_μ²`.
Recognition: with `μ = mc²τ/ℏ`, `k = pcτ/ℏ`, `ω = Eτ/ℏ`, `E² = p²c² + m²c⁴`; the square is Dirac's.
Every candidate system: System.uniqueness.

`det(I − uB₋[e^{itθ}]) = (1 − u²)²⁴(1 + 4u²)¹⁶ det(I − wA₋[e^{itθ}])` with `w = u/(1 + 4u²)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Law.prop_62_signed
theorems.statement:
theorem Law.prop_62_signed (u : ℂ) (ha : 1 + 4 * u ^ 2 ≠ 0)
    (hw : 1 - 5 * (u / (1 + 4 * u ^ 2)) ^ 2 ≠ 0) (θ : Fin 40 → ℝ) :
    (∀ t : ℝ, (1 - u • stepOp (connStepSigned cliffordSign (phaseConn θ t))).det =
      (1 - u ^ 2) ^ 24 * (1 + 4 * u ^ 2) ^ 16 * (Kph (u / (1 + 4 * u ^ 2)) θ t).det) ∧
    HasDerivAt (fun s => (Kph (u / (1 + 4 * u ^ 2)) θ s).det) 0 0 ∧
    HasDerivAt (deriv (fun s => (Kph (u / (1 + 4 * u ^ 2)) θ s).det))
      (-(2 * (u / (1 + 4 * u ^ 2)) ^ 4 / (1 - 5 * (u / (1 + 4 * u ^ 2)) ^ 2) ^ 2) * (plaqSq θ : ℂ) *
        (Kph (u / (1 + 4 * u ^ 2)) θ 0).det) 0 ∧
    (∀ t, (Kph (u / (1 + 4 * u ^ 2)) θ (-t)).det = (Kph (u / (1 + 4 * u ^ 2)) θ t).det)
theorems.description:
**Proposition 62 for the signed step with the phases** (along every ray): for real `u` with
`1 + 4u² ≠ 0`, `w = u/(1 + 4u²)` with `1 − 5w² ≠ 0`, every direction `θ` and every real `t`,
`det(I − uB₋[e^{itθ}]) = (1 − u²)²⁴(1 + 4u²)¹⁶ det(I − wA₋[e^{itθ}])`; the second factor has, at `t = 0`, the
derivative `0` and the second derivative `−κ(w)‖Cθ‖²` times its value, and is even in `t`.
Recognition: Maxwell's action in Wilson's form.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.prop_62
theorems.statement:
theorem prop_62 :
    ((∀ (φ : Fin 16 → ℝ) (q : Fin 40), circ (fun l => φ (linkV l) - φ (linkU l)) q = 0) ∧
    cReal.rank = 25 ∧
    (∀ (w : ℂ), 1 - 5 * w ^ 2 ≠ 0 → ∀ θ : Fin 40 → ℝ,
      (Kph w θ 0).det ≠ 0 ∧
      HasDerivAt (fun s => (Kph w θ s).det) 0 0 ∧
      HasDerivAt (deriv (fun s => (Kph w θ s).det))
        (-(2 * w ^ 4 / (1 - 5 * w ^ 2) ^ 2) * (plaqSq θ : ℂ) * (Kph w θ 0).det) 0 ∧
      logDer w θ 0 = 0 ∧
      HasDerivAt (logDer w θ) (-(2 * w ^ 4 / (1 - 5 * w ^ 2) ^ 2) * (plaqSq θ : ℂ)) 0 ∧
      (∀ t, (Kph w θ (-t)).det = (Kph w θ t).det)) ∧
    (∀ (w : ℂ), 1 - 5 * w ^ 2 ≠ 0 → ∀ j k : Fin 40,
      hessLaw w j k = -(2 * w ^ 4 / (1 - 5 * w ^ 2) ^ 2) * (GZ j k : ℂ)) ∧
    (1 / 4 : ℂ) / (1 + 4 * (1 / 4) ^ 2) = 1 / 5 ∧
    2 * (1 / 5 : ℂ) ^ 4 / (1 - 5 * (1 / 5) ^ 2) ^ 2 = 1 / 200) ∧
    (∀ (u : ℂ) (ha : 1 + 4 * u ^ 2 ≠ 0) (hw : 1 - 5 * (u / (1 + 4 * u ^ 2)) ^ 2 ≠ 0) (θ : Fin 40 → ℝ),
      (∀ t : ℝ, (1 - u • stepOp (connStepSigned cliffordSign (phaseConn θ t))).det =
      (1 - u ^ 2) ^ 24 * (1 + 4 * u ^ 2) ^ 16 * (Kph (u / (1 + 4 * u ^ 2)) θ t).det) ∧
    HasDerivAt (fun s => (Kph (u / (1 + 4 * u ^ 2)) θ s).det) 0 0 ∧
    HasDerivAt (deriv (fun s => (Kph (u / (1 + 4 * u ^ 2)) θ s).det))
      (-(2 * (u / (1 + 4 * u ^ 2)) ^ 4 / (1 - 5 * (u / (1 + 4 * u ^ 2)) ^ 2) ^ 2) * (plaqSq θ : ℂ) *
        (Kph (u / (1 + 4 * u ^ 2)) θ 0).det) 0 ∧
    (∀ t, (Kph (u / (1 + 4 * u ^ 2)) θ (-t)).det = (Kph (u / (1 + 4 * u ^ 2)) θ t).det))
theorems.description:
**Proposition 62, the law in small phases** (along every ray; the uniform remainder in `θ` is on the work
list). On the sixteen vertices (`Law.prop_62_sixteen`): `C·grad = 0`, `rank C = 25`, and for every complex `w` with
`1 − 5w² ≠ 0` and every direction `θ`, `g(t) = det(I − wA₋[e^{itθ}])` has `g(0) ≠ 0`, `g′(0) = 0`,
`g″(0) = −κ(w)‖Cθ‖² g(0)` and is even, the Hessian of `log det(I − wA₋[e^{iθ}])` being `−κ(w)CᵀC`,
`κ(w) = 2w⁴/(1 − 5w²)²`, `1/200` at `w = 1/5`; on the eighty states (`Law.prop_62_signed`): the signed step with the
phases has `det(I − uB₋[e^{itθ}]) = (1 − u²)²⁴(1 + 4u²)¹⁶ det(I − wA₋[e^{itθ}])`, `w = u/(1 + 4u²)`.
Recognition: Maxwell's action in Wilson's form; with the kept rotations of a division in place of the phase it is the
Yang–Mills action.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Law.law_small_phases

source_context.command: open Matrix Complex Filter Topology Comparison Comparison.WholePicture

theorems.statement:
theorem law_small_phases (w : ℂ) (hw : 1 - 5 * w ^ 2 ≠ 0) (θ : Fin 40 → ℝ) :
    (Kph w θ 0).det ≠ 0 ∧
    (∀ᶠ t in 𝓝 0, HasDerivAt (fun s => (Kph w θ s).det) ((Kph w θ t).det * logDer w θ t) t) ∧
    logDer w θ 0 = 0 ∧
    HasDerivAt (logDer w θ) (-(2 * w ^ 4 / (1 - 5 * w ^ 2) ^ 2) * (plaqSq θ : ℂ)) 0 ∧
    HasDerivAt (fun s => (Kph w θ s).det) 0 0 ∧
    HasDerivAt (deriv (fun s => (Kph w θ s).det))
      (-(2 * w ^ 4 / (1 - 5 * w ^ 2) ^ 2) * (plaqSq θ : ℂ) * (Kph w θ 0).det) 0 ∧
    (∀ t, (Kph w θ (-t)).det = (Kph w θ t).det)
theorems.description:
**The law in small phases, along every ray:** `g(t) = det(I − wA₋[e^{itθ}])` has `g(0) ≠ 0`,
`g′(0) = 0`, `g″(0) = −κ(w)‖Cθ‖² g(0)` with `κ(w) = 2w⁴/(1 − 5w²)²`, and `g(−t) = g(t)`; its logarithmic
derivative `h = g′/g` near `0` has `h(0) = 0` and `h′(0) = −κ(w)‖Cθ‖²`.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Law.prop_62_sixteen

source_context.command: open Matrix Complex Filter Topology Comparison Comparison.WholePicture

theorems.statement:
theorem Law.prop_62_sixteen :
    (∀ (φ : Fin 16 → ℝ) (q : Fin 40), circ (fun l => φ (linkV l) - φ (linkU l)) q = 0) ∧
    cReal.rank = 25 ∧
    (∀ (w : ℂ), 1 - 5 * w ^ 2 ≠ 0 → ∀ θ : Fin 40 → ℝ,
      (Kph w θ 0).det ≠ 0 ∧
      HasDerivAt (fun s => (Kph w θ s).det) 0 0 ∧
      HasDerivAt (deriv (fun s => (Kph w θ s).det))
        (-(2 * w ^ 4 / (1 - 5 * w ^ 2) ^ 2) * (plaqSq θ : ℂ) * (Kph w θ 0).det) 0 ∧
      logDer w θ 0 = 0 ∧
      HasDerivAt (logDer w θ) (-(2 * w ^ 4 / (1 - 5 * w ^ 2) ^ 2) * (plaqSq θ : ℂ)) 0 ∧
      (∀ t, (Kph w θ (-t)).det = (Kph w θ t).det)) ∧
    (∀ (w : ℂ), 1 - 5 * w ^ 2 ≠ 0 → ∀ j k : Fin 40,
      hessLaw w j k = -(2 * w ^ 4 / (1 - 5 * w ^ 2) ^ 2) * (GZ j k : ℂ)) ∧
    (1 / 4 : ℂ) / (1 + 4 * (1 / 4) ^ 2) = 1 / 5 ∧
    2 * (1 / 5 : ℂ) ^ 4 / (1 - 5 * (1 / 5) ^ 2) ^ 2 = 1 / 200
theorems.description:
**Proposition 62 on the sixteen vertices, the law in small phases** (along every ray; the uniform remainder in `θ` is on the work
list). `U(1)` phases `θ` on the forty links, `Cθ` their sums around the forty squares: `C·grad = 0` and
`rank C = 25`; for every complex `w` with `1 − 5w² ≠ 0` and every direction `θ`, `g(t) = det(I − wA₋[e^{itθ}])`
has `g(0) ≠ 0`, `g′(0) = 0`, `g″(0) = −κ(w)‖Cθ‖² g(0)` and is even: the second variation of
`log det(I − wA₋[e^{iθ}])` is `−κ(w)CᵀC`, `κ(w) = 2w⁴/(1 − 5w²)²`, and the Hessian matrix is `−κ(w)CᵀC`
entry by entry (`hessLaw_eq`); with `w = u/(1 + 4u²)` at `u = 1/4`, `w = 1/5` and `κ = 1/200`.
Recognition: Maxwell's action in Wilson's form; with the kept rotations of a division in place of the phase it is
the Yang–Mills action.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.eq_27

source_context.command: open Matrix Complex Filter Topology Comparison Comparison.WholePicture

theorems.statement:
theorem eq_27 :
    (∀ (w : ℂ), 1 - 5 * w ^ 2 ≠ 0 → ∀ θ : Fin 40 → ℝ,
      HasDerivAt (fun s => (Kph w θ s).det) 0 0 ∧
      HasDerivAt (deriv (fun s => (Kph w θ s).det))
        (-(2 * w ^ 4 / (1 - 5 * w ^ 2) ^ 2) * (plaqSq θ : ℂ) * (Kph w θ 0).det) 0 ∧
      (∀ t, (Kph w θ (-t)).det = (Kph w θ t).det)) ∧
    cReal.rank = 25 ∧
    (cRealᵀ * cReal).charpoly =
      Polynomial.X ^ 15 * (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C (4 : ℝ)) ^ 10 *
        (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C (8 : ℝ)) ^ 15 ∧
    (2 * (1 / 5 : ℂ) ^ 4 / (1 - 5 * (1 / 5) ^ 2) ^ 2 = 1 / 200 ∧
      2 * (-1 / 5 : ℂ) ^ 4 / (1 - 5 * (-1 / 5) ^ 2) ^ 2 = 1 / 200 ∧
      2 * (I / 3) ^ 4 / (1 - 5 * (I / 3) ^ 2) ^ 2 = 1 / 98 ∧
      2 * (-I / 3) ^ 4 / (1 - 5 * (-I / 3) ^ 2) ^ 2 = 1 / 98)
theorems.description:
**Equation (27), the law in small phases** (along every ray; the uniform remainder in `θ` completes it):
`det(I − wA₋[e^{itθ}])` has the derivative `0` and the second derivative `−κ(w)‖Cθ‖² det(I − wA₋)` at `t = 0` and is
even in `t`; `rank C = 25`, `spec CᵀC = 0¹⁵ ⊕ 4¹⁰ ⊕ 8¹⁵`; `κ = 1/200` at `w = ±1/5` and `1/98` at `w = ±i/3`.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Law.doubled_log_deriv_t

source_context.command:
variable {n p q : Type*} [Fintype n] [Fintype p] [Fintype q] [DecidableEq n] [DecidableEq p]

theorems.statement:
theorem doubled_log_deriv_t (K : Matrix n n ℂ) [Invertible K] (X : Matrix n p ℂ) (Y : Matrix n q ℂ)
    (s : ℂ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun t : ℂ => -Complex.log (doubled K X Y s t).det) (s * (bornM K X Y).trace) 0
theorems.description: **For every `s`, `∂_t[−log det 𝔻(s, t)]_{t=0} = s·tr(G†YY†GXX†)`.**

theorems.name: Comparison.System.prop_58
theorems.statement:
theorem prop_58 {n p q : Type*} [Fintype n] [Fintype p] [Fintype q] [DecidableEq n] [DecidableEq p]
    [DecidableEq q] (K : Matrix n n ℂ) [Invertible K] (X : Matrix n p ℂ) (Y : Matrix n q ℂ) :
    (∀ s : ℂ, HasDerivAt (fun t : ℂ => -Complex.log (doubled K X Y s t).det)
      (s * (bornM K X Y).trace) 0) ∧
    HasDerivAt (fun s : ℂ => deriv (fun t : ℂ => -Complex.log (doubled K X Y s t).det) 0)
      (bornM K X Y).trace 0 ∧
    (bornM K X Y).trace = ((∑ i, ∑ j, Complex.normSq ((Yᴴ * ⅟K * X) i j) : ℝ) : ℂ) ∧
    0 ≤ ∑ i, ∑ j, Complex.normSq ((Yᴴ * ⅟K * X) i j)
theorems.description:
**Proposition 58, probability.** For an invertible `K`, `G = K⁻¹`, a preparation `X` and a detection `Y`:
for every `s` the derivative `∂_t[−log det 𝔻(s, t)]` at `t = 0` is `s·tr(G†YY†GXX†)`; the function
`s ↦ ∂_t[−log det 𝔻(s, t)]_{t=0}` has the derivative `tr(G†YY†GXX†)` at `s = 0`; this trace is
`‖Y†GX‖² = Σ |(Y†GX)_{ij}|²`, a non-negative real number.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.eq_19
theorems.statement:
theorem eq_19 (h : Fin 5) :
    (excursionStates h).card = 74 ∧
    (∑ j, (alongCount h j : ℚ)) = 296 ∧ (alongCount h h : ℚ) = 60 ∧
    (∀ j, j ≠ h → (alongCount h j : ℚ) = 59) ∧
    ((excursionStates h).filter fun s => h ∉ disagreeSet s.1).card = 34 ∧
    (alongCount h h : ℚ) / (∑ j, (alongCount h j : ℚ)) = 15 / 74 ∧
    5 * (alongCount h h : ℚ) / (∑ j, (alongCount h j : ℚ)) = 75 / 74 ∧
    5 * 59 / (∑ j, (alongCount h j : ℚ)) = 295 / 296 ∧
    (((excursionStates h).filter fun s => h ∉ disagreeSet s.1).card : ℚ) / (excursionStates h).card = 17 / 37 ∧
    HasSum (fun n : ℕ => (n : ℝ) * excursionLaw n) 16 ∧
    (16 : ℚ) * (alongCount h h : ℚ) / 320 = 3 ∧
    HasSum (fun n => (∑ s ∈ (excursionStates h).filter (fun s => s.2 ≠ h), (stateCount n s : ℝ)) /
      (5 * 4 ^ n) / 4) 3
theorems.description:
**Eq. (19), the transitions of one excursion and their shares.** For an excursion begun with the last-step direction `h`: the
seventy-four states, `M = 296` continuations, `C_h = 60` along the last-step direction and `59` along each other line,
`34` states leaving the last-step direction undivided; `c_L = C_h/M = 15/74`, `σ = 5C_h/M = 75/74`, `η = 5·59/M = 295/296`,
`R_ud = 34/74 = 17/37`; the mean excursion `Eℓ = 16`, and `E_H = Eℓ C_h/320 = 3`, the expected steps along the last-step direction
per excursion.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.eq_21

theorems.description: **Eq. (21):** at the point `u = −1/4` the grade factors are `k_N(−1/4) = (5 − N)/2 = 5/2, 3/2, 1/2`.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.eq_22

**Eq. (22):** one pair of directions on opposite sides, `g² = −Φ(1)/4[1 + Φ(1)] = −Φ(i)/6[1 + Φ(i)] = e_line²/(k_C² − 1) = 1/72`,
with `e_line = k₄/k₂` at the point `u = −1/4` and `k_C = 1/|u| − 1 = 3`.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.table_VII

**Table VII, the law at its four points `u = i^k/4`:** the grade factors `k₀, k₂, k₄`, `1 − u²`,
the plain and the signed first returns `F(4u)`, `Φ(4u)`, the step `w = u/(1 + 4u²)` and the stiffness
`κ(w)`; at the singlet (`u = 1/4`), the last-step direction (`i/4`), the plane (`−1/4`) and colour (`−i/4`). The printed
`F(±i) = 0.0363 ± 0.0622i` are `(7 ± 12i)/193` to four vertices.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Law.countSeries_plus
theorems.statement:
theorem countSeries_plus :
    PowerSeries.mk (fun n => wordSum transitionMat n 0 0) * (kSer 5 * kSer (-3) * kSer 1) =
      PowerSeries.C (1 / 16) * (1 - PowerSeries.X ^ 2) *
        (kSer (-3) * kSer 1 + PowerSeries.C 5 * (kSer 5 * kSer 1) +
          PowerSeries.C 10 * (kSer 5 * kSer (-3)))
theorems.description: **The unsigned word sums' series:** `Σ (N_n)_{∅∅}uⁿ · k₅k₋₃k₁ = (1 − u²)(k₋₃k₁ + 5k₅k₁ + 10k₅k₋₃)/16`.

theorem countSeries_minus :

        (1 + PowerSeries.C 3 * PowerSeries.X ^ 2 + PowerSeries.C 16 * PowerSeries.X ^ 4) =
      (1 - PowerSeries.X ^ 2) * (1 + PowerSeries.C 4 * PowerSeries.X ^ 2)
theorems.description: **The signed word sums' series:** `Σ ⟨Ω, N_nΩ⟩uⁿ · (1 + 3u² + 16u⁴) = (1 − u²)(1 + 4u²)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Law.resolvent_minus

theorem resolvent_minus (u : ℂ) (hu : 1 + 3 * u ^ 2 + 16 * u ^ 4 ≠ 0) :

      (1 + 4 * u ^ 2) / (1 + 3 * u ^ 2 + 16 * u ^ 4)
theorems.description:
**The resolvent of the signed operator at the singlet:**
`⟨Ω|((1 + 4u²) − uA₋)⁻¹|Ω⟩ = (1 + 4u²)/(1 + 3u² + 16u⁴)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Law.resolvent_plus
theorems.description:
**The resolvent of the walk at the singlet:**
`((1 + 4u²) − uA₊)⁻¹_{∅∅} = (1/16)[1/((1 − u)(1 − 4u)) + 10/(1 + 4u² − u) + 5/(1 + 4u² + 3u)]`,
the eigenvalues `5, 1, −3` with multiplicities `1, 10, 5`.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Law.returns_series_plus
theorems.statement:
theorem returns_series_plus :
    Rplus * (16 - 8 * PowerSeries.X - 3 * PowerSeries.X ^ 2 - 3 * PowerSeries.X ^ 3 -
      PowerSeries.X ^ 4 - PowerSeries.X ^ 5) =
      16 - 8 * PowerSeries.X - 3 * PowerSeries.X ^ 2 - 3 * PowerSeries.X ^ 3
theorems.description:
**The unsigned returns renew to the excursion:** `R₊(z)(16 − 8z − 3z² − 3z³ − z⁴ − z⁵) = 16 − 8z − 3z² − 3z³`,
that is `R₊ = 1/(1 − F)` with `F = z⁴(1 + z)/(16 − 8z − 3z² − 3z³)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Law.returns_series_minus

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Law.renewal_of_series

theorem renewal_of_series {R P Q : PowerSeries ℂ} (hQ : PowerSeries.constantCoeff Q ≠ 0)
    (h : R * (Q - P) = Q) : R * (1 - P * Q⁻¹) = 1
theorems.description: `R = 1/(1 − F)`: if `R(Q − P) = Q` with `Q` invertible then `R(1 − P Q⁻¹) = 1`.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.prop_55
theorems.statement:
theorem prop_55 :
    (∀ n, wordSum transitionMat n 0 0 = (retCount n : ℂ)) ∧
    (∀ n, star Ω ⬝ᵥ (wordSum lineOnRel n *ᵥ Ω) = (sRetCount n : ℂ)) ∧
    PowerSeries.mk (fun n => wordSum transitionMat n 0 0) * (kSer 5 * kSer (-3) * kSer 1) =
      PowerSeries.C (1 / 16) * (1 - PowerSeries.X ^ 2) *
        (kSer (-3) * kSer 1 + PowerSeries.C 5 * (kSer 5 * kSer 1) +
          PowerSeries.C 10 * (kSer 5 * kSer (-3))) ∧
    PowerSeries.mk (fun n => star Ω ⬝ᵥ (wordSum lineOnRel n *ᵥ Ω)) *
        (1 + PowerSeries.C 3 * PowerSeries.X ^ 2 + PowerSeries.C 16 * PowerSeries.X ^ 4) =
      (1 - PowerSeries.X ^ 2) * (1 + PowerSeries.C 4 * PowerSeries.X ^ 2) ∧
    (∀ u : ℂ, (1 - u) * (1 - 4 * u) ≠ 0 → 1 + 4 * u ^ 2 - u ≠ 0 → 1 + 4 * u ^ 2 + 3 * u ≠ 0 →
      (((1 + 4 * u ^ 2) • (1 : Matrix (Fin 16) (Fin 16) ℂ) - u • ∑ t, transitionMat t)⁻¹) 0 0 =
        (1 / 16) * (1 / ((1 - u) * (1 - 4 * u)) + 10 / (1 + 4 * u ^ 2 - u) +
          5 / (1 + 4 * u ^ 2 + 3 * u))) ∧
    (∀ u : ℂ, 1 + 3 * u ^ 2 + 16 * u ^ 4 ≠ 0 →
      star Ω ⬝ᵥ ((((1 + 4 * u ^ 2) • (1 : Matrix Two Two ℂ) - u • ∑ t, lineOnRel t)⁻¹) *ᵥ Ω) =
        (1 + 4 * u ^ 2) / (1 + 3 * u ^ 2 + 16 * u ^ 4)) ∧
    (5 : PowerSeries ℂ) * Rplus =
      1 + 4 * PowerSeries.mk (fun n => (1 / 4 : ℂ) ^ n * wordSum transitionMat n 0 0) ∧
    (5 : PowerSeries ℂ) * Rminus =
      1 + 4 * PowerSeries.mk (fun n => (1 / 4 : ℂ) ^ n * star Ω ⬝ᵥ (wordSum lineOnRel n *ᵥ Ω)) ∧
    Rplus * (1 - (PowerSeries.X ^ 4 + PowerSeries.X ^ 5) *
      (16 - 8 * PowerSeries.X - 3 * PowerSeries.X ^ 2 - 3 * PowerSeries.X ^ 3)⁻¹) = 1 ∧
    Rminus * (1 - (-PowerSeries.X ^ 4) * (16 + 3 * PowerSeries.X ^ 2)⁻¹) = 1 ∧
    (∀ z : ℂ, ‖z‖ ≤ 1 → HasSum (fun n => (excursionLaw n : ℂ) * z ^ n) (excursionGF z)) ∧
    (∀ z : ℂ, ‖z‖ ≤ 1 → HasSum (fun n => (signedLaw n : ℂ) * z ^ n) (Law.Phi z))
theorems.description:
**Proposition 55, the excursion is the law's return.** The walk's returns, counted on the walks (the reduced
words at the start's vertex, with or without their Clifford signs), are the entries `(N_n)_{∅∅}` and `⟨Ω, N_nΩ⟩` of
the word sums of the lemma of five involutions; their generating functions are
`Σ_n (N_n)_{∅∅}uⁿ = (1 − u²)·(1/16)Σ_λ m_λ/(1 + 4u² − λu)` and `Σ_n ⟨Ω, N_nΩ⟩uⁿ = (1 − u²)(1 + 4u²)/(1 + 3u² + 16u⁴)`
(formal power series, the denominators multiplied out), and these are `(1 − u²)` times the resolvents at the
singlet, `((1 + 4u²) − uA₊)⁻¹_{∅∅} = (1/16)Σ_λ m_λ/(1 + 4u² − λu)` and `⟨Ω|((1 + 4u²) − uA₋)⁻¹|Ω⟩ =
(1 + 4u²)/(1 + 3u² + 16u⁴)`; with `R±(z) = Σ_n r±_n zⁿ`, `r_0 = 1`, `r_n = (returns of length n)/(5·4ⁿ⁻¹)`:
`5R± = 1 + 4Σ_n c±_n(z/4)ⁿ`, that is `R± = 1 + (4/5)[(1 − u²)⟨Ω|((1 + 4u²) − uA±)⁻¹|Ω⟩ − 1]` at `u = z/4`, and
`R₊ = 1/(1 − F)`, `F = z⁴(1 + z)/(16 − 8z − 3z² − 3z³)`, `R₋ = 1/(1 − Φ)`, `Φ = −z⁴/(16 + 3z²)`, the excursion and the
signed excursion of Propositions 29 and 30 (`excursion_gf_eq`, `signed_gf_eq`).
Every candidate system: System.uniqueness.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Law.Zint_sector_series

theorems.statement:
theorem Zint_sector_series (w : Ω → ℝ) (q : Ω → ℤ) (hw : Integrable w μ) (hqm : Measurable q)
    (θ : ℝ) :
    HasSum (fun n : ℤ => (aSector μ w q n : ℂ) * exp (((n : ℝ) * θ : ℝ) * I)) (Zint μ w q θ)
theorems.description: **The sector series of the integral:** `Z(θ) = Σ_n a_n e^{inθ}` with `a_n = ∫_{q = n} w`.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Law.theta_bar_zero_integral

source_context.command: open MeasureTheory Complex Matrix Comparison Comparison.ArticleStatements Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw

theorems.statement:
theorem theta_bar_zero_integral (w : Ω → ℝ) (q : Ω → ℤ) (hw : Integrable w μ) (hqm : Measurable q)
    (hw0 : ∀ U, 0 < w U) (τ : Ω ≃ᵐ Ω) (hτ : MeasurePreserving τ μ μ) (hq : ∀ U, q (τ U) = -q U)
    (hwτ : ∀ U, w (τ U) = w U) (h0 : 0 < μ {U | q U = 0}) (h1 : 0 < μ {U | q U = 1}) (θ : ℝ)
    (hmax : ‖Zint μ w q θ‖ = ∫ U, w U ∂μ) (detM : ℂ) (hM : 0 < detM) :
    ∃ k : ℤ, θ + Complex.arg detM = k * (2 * Real.pi)
theorems.description:
**`θ̄ = 0` where the integral over the sectors is largest:** if `|Z(θ)| = Z(0)` and the mass determinant
`det M` is a positive number, then `θ + arg det M ∈ 2πℤ`.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.prop_115

source_context.command: open MeasureTheory Complex Matrix Comparison Comparison.ArticleStatements Comparison.GroupsContinuumLaw

theorems.statement:
theorem prop_115 :
    (∀ (n : Type) [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] (c : Connection (Fin 16) (Matrix.unitaryGroup n ℂ))
        (u : ℝ), 0 ≤ u → u < 1 / 4 →
      0 < (1 - u) * (1 - 4 * u) ∧
      (∀ x : Fin 16 × n → ℂ, (1 - u) * (1 - 4 * u) * (star x ⬝ᵥ x).re ≤
        (star x ⬝ᵥ (((1 + 4 * (u : ℂ) ^ 2) • (1 : Matrix (Fin 16 × n) (Fin 16 × n) ℂ) -
          (u : ℂ) • ∑ t, WholePicture.connStep c t) *ᵥ x)).re) ∧
      0 < (1 - (u : ℂ) • Bconn c).det ∧
      (1 - (u : ℂ) • stepOp (conjConn (WholePicture.connStep c))).det = (1 - (u : ℂ) • Bconn c).det) ∧
    (∀ (V : Type) [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] (C : Type) [Fintype C] (S : SectorSource V C) (u : ℝ),
      0 ≤ u → u < 1 / 4 →
      ((∀ n : ℤ, (∃ c, S.q c = n) → 0 < S.a u n) ∧ (∀ n : ℤ, S.a u (-n) = S.a u n) ∧
        (∀ θ : ℝ, S.Ztop u θ = ∑ n ∈ Finset.univ.image S.q,
          S.a u n * Complex.exp (((n : ℝ) * θ : ℝ) * Complex.I)) ∧
        (∀ θ : ℝ, ‖S.Ztop u θ‖ ≤ (S.Ztop u 0).re)) ∧
      ((∃ c, S.q c = 0) → (∃ c, S.q c = 1) → ∀ θ : ℝ,
        (‖S.Ztop u θ‖ = (S.Ztop u 0).re ↔ ∃ k : ℤ, θ = k * (2 * Real.pi)) ∧
        (‖S.Ztop u θ‖ = (S.Ztop u 0).re → ∀ detM : ℂ, 0 < detM →
          ∃ k : ℤ, θ + Complex.arg detM = k * (2 * Real.pi)))) ∧
    (∀ (Ωc : Type) [MeasurableSpace Ωc] (μ : Measure Ωc) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] (w : Ωc → ℝ)
        (q : Ωc → ℤ), Integrable w μ → Measurable q → (∀ U, 0 < w U) →
      ∀ (τ : Ωc ≃ᵐ Ωc), MeasurePreserving τ μ μ → (∀ U, q (τ U) = -q U) → (∀ U, w (τ U) = w U) →
      (∀ θ : ℝ, HasSum (fun n : ℤ => (aSector μ w q n : ℂ) * exp (((n : ℝ) * θ : ℝ) * I))
        (Zint μ w q θ)) ∧
      (∀ n : ℤ, 0 < μ {U | q U = n} → 0 < aSector μ w q n) ∧
      (∀ n : ℤ, aSector μ w q (-n) = aSector μ w q n) ∧
      (∀ θ : ℝ, ‖Zint μ w q θ‖ ≤ ∫ U, w U ∂μ) ∧
      (0 < μ {U | q U = 0} → 0 < μ {U | q U = 1} → ∀ θ : ℝ,
        (‖Zint μ w q θ‖ = ∫ U, w U ∂μ ↔ ∃ k : ℤ, θ = k * (2 * Real.pi)) ∧
        (‖Zint μ w q θ‖ = ∫ U, w U ∂μ → ∀ detM : ℂ, 0 < detM →
          ∃ k : ℤ, θ + Complex.arg detM = k * (2 * Real.pi))))
theorems.description:
**Proposition 115, the angle of the sectors is zero.** For `0 ≤ u < 1/4` and every unitary connection
`(1 + 4u²) − uA_U ≥ (1 − u)(1 − 4u) > 0`, and the weight `det(I − uB[U])` is a positive real number kept by
time reversal; for a family of configurations (finite, or any finite measure on the connections) with the
charge `q` reversed by time reversal, `Z_top(θ) = Σ_n a_n e^{inθ}` with `a_n = a_{−n} > 0` on every inhabited
sector, `|Z_top(θ)| ≤ Z_top(0)`, with equality exactly at `θ ∈ 2πℤ` when the sectors `0` and `1` are inhabited;
and where it is largest, `θ̄ = θ + arg det M ∈ 2πℤ` whenever `det M` is a positive number.
Recognition: `det M = det(M_uM_d)`, the mass determinant, is a product of closed weights (Prop. 103); `θ̄` is the
strong phase; the bound `|θ̄| ≲ 10⁻¹⁰` is the neutron's electric dipole.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Law.inv_split
theorems.statement:
theorem inv_split {A : Type*} [CommRing A] [Invertible (2 : A)] (c : A) (hc : c * c = 1)
    (Dp Dm Zp Zm : A) (hp : Dp * Zp = 1) (hm : Dm * Zm = 1) :
    (⅟2 * (1 + c) * Dp + ⅟2 * (1 - c) * Dm) * (⅟2 * (1 + c) * Zp + ⅟2 * (1 - c) * Zm) = 1
theorems.description:
**The inverse splits as the determinant does:** with `p± = (1 ± c)/2`, `c² = 1`, `D₊Z₊ = D₋Z₋ = 1`,
`(p₊D₊ + p₋D₋)(p₊Z₊ + p₋Z₋) = 1`.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Law.csign_sq
theorems.statement: theorem csign_sq : csign * csign = 1

theorems.name: Comparison.System.prop_53
theorems.statement:
theorem prop_53 :
    (∀ (s : Fin 5) (k : Fin 16),
      (γ s ⊗ₖ (1 : Matrix Four Four ℂ)) *ᵥ rel k = (transitionSign s k : ℂ) • rel (transition s k) ∧
        (transitionSign s k = 1 ∨ transitionSign s k = -1) ∧
        disagreeSet (transition s k) = symmDiff (disagreeSet k) (Finset.univ.erase s)) ∧
    (∀ t, signTransitionC (1 : ℂ) t = transitionMat t) ∧
    (∀ t k' k, signTransitionC (-1 : ℂ) t k' k = if k' = transition t k then (transitionSign t k : ℂ) else 0) ∧
    (∀ t, signTransitionC (-1 : ℂ) t = relSqᴴ * onRel (lineOnRel t) * relSq) ∧
    (∀ (A : Type) [CommRing A] [Invertible (2 : A)] (c u : A), c * c = 1 →
      (1 - u • stepOp (signTransitionC c)).det =
          ⅟2 * (1 + c) * (1 - u • stepOp (signTransitionC (1 : A))).det +
            ⅟2 * (1 - c) * (1 - u • stepOp (signTransitionC (-1 : A))).det ∧
        ∀ Zp Zm : A, (1 - u • stepOp (signTransitionC (1 : A))).det * Zp = 1 →
          (1 - u • stepOp (signTransitionC (-1 : A))).det * Zm = 1 →
          (1 - u • stepOp (signTransitionC c)).det * (⅟2 * (1 + c) * Zp + ⅟2 * (1 - c) * Zm) = 1) ∧
    csign * csign = 1 ∧
    (∀ u : Csign, (1 - u • stepOp (signTransitionC csign)).det =
      ⅟2 * (1 + csign) * (1 - u • stepOp (signTransitionC (1 : Csign))).det +
        ⅟2 * (1 - csign) * (1 - u • stepOp (signTransitionC (-1 : Csign))).det)
theorems.description:
**Proposition 53, count and sign.** Each step carries a sign on the two-spinor states,
`(γ_s ⊗ 1)e_S = ν(S, s) e_{S △ T_s}` with `ν = ±1`; `B₊ = B[1]` is the walk; `B₋ = B[ν]` carries the sign
(and is the step `γ_t ⊗ 1` on the amplitudes, read in the two-spinor states); and in every commutative ring with `2`
invertible and a central sign `c`, `c² = 1`, with `p± = (1 ± c)/2`: `det(I − uB_c) = p₊ det(I − uB₊) +
p₋ det(I − uB₋)`, and its inverse is `p₊Z₊ + p₋Z₋` whenever `Z± = det(I − uB±)⁻¹`; in particular in
`𝒞 = ℂ[c]/(c² − 1)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Law.logSeries_smul

theorem logSeries_smul {K : Type*} [Field K] [CharZero K] (c : K) (B : Matrix n n K) :

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Law.sourceLog_eq

theorem sourceLog_eq (s g : ℝ) (hg : g ≠ 0) (X : Matrix n n ℝ) :
    (-(s * g)) • logSeries ((s / g) • X) = sourceLog s g X
theorems.description: **`−sg log det(I − ε(s/g)X) = Σ_{k≥1} s^{k+1} g^{1−k} ε^k Tr X^k/k`.**

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Law.sourceLogK_eq

source_context.command: open Matrix Polynomial Filter Topology Comparison

theorems.statement:
theorem sourceLogK_eq {K : Type*} [Field K] [CharZero K] (s g : K) (hg : g ≠ 0) (X : Matrix n n K) :
    (-(s * g)) • logSeries ((s / g) • X) = sourceLogK s g X
theorems.description:
**`−sg log det(I − ε(s/g)X) = Σ_{k≥1} s^{k+1} g^{1−k} ε^k Tr X^k/k`** over every field of characteristic
zero (`ℂ` among them).

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Law.sourceLogK_directSum

theorems.statement:
theorem sourceZC_directSum_near {m : Type*} [Fintype m] [DecidableEq m] (s g : ℂ) (X : Matrix n n ℂ)
    (Y : Matrix m m ℂ) :
    ∀ᶠ ε in 𝓝 (0 : ℂ),
      sourceZC s g (ε • fromBlocks X 0 0 Y) = sourceZC s g (ε • X) * sourceZC s g (ε • Y)
theorems.description:
**A composite on the direct sum is the product, over `ℂ`, near `ε = 0`:**
`Z(ε(X ⊕ Y)) = Z(εX)Z(εY)` (both determinants near `1`, where the principal logarithm adds).
