    sourceZC 1 1 (fromBlocks X 0 0 Y) = sourceZC 1 1 X * sourceZC 1 1 Y
theorems.description:
**The integer members on the direct sum, exactly:** `det(I + X ⊕ Y) = det(I + X)det(I + Y)` and
`det(I − X ⊕ Y)⁻¹ = det(I − X)⁻¹det(I − Y)⁻¹`.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.Law.source_family_real

source_context.command: open Matrix Polynomial Filter Topology Comparison

theorems.statement:
theorem Law.source_family_real :
    (∀ (n : Type) [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] (s g : ℝ) (X : Matrix n n ℝ),
      Law.sourceZ s g X = (det (1 - (s / g) • X)) ^ (-(s * g))) ∧
    (∀ (n : Type) [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] (s g : ℝ) (X : Matrix n n ℝ), g ≠ 0 →
      (PowerSeries.derivative (R := ℝ)
          ((1 - (Polynomial.X : ℝ[X]) • ((s / g) • X).map Polynomial.C).det : PowerSeries ℝ) =
        ((1 - (Polynomial.X : ℝ[X]) • ((s / g) • X).map Polynomial.C).det : PowerSeries ℝ) *
          PowerSeries.derivative (R := ℝ) (logSeries ((s / g) • X)) ∧
        PowerSeries.constantCoeff (logSeries ((s / g) • X)) = 0) ∧
      (-(s * g)) • logSeries ((s / g) • X) = sourceLog s g X) ∧
    (∀ (n : Type) [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] (X : Matrix n n ℝ),
      Tendsto (fun g : ℝ => Law.sourceZ 1 g X) atTop (𝓝 (Real.exp (trace X))) ∧
      Law.sourceZ (-1) 1 X = det (1 + X) ∧ Law.sourceZ 1 1 X = (det (1 - X))⁻¹) ∧
    (∀ (n : Type) [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] (s g : ℝ) (X : Matrix n n ℝ), g ≠ 0 →
      HasDerivAt (fun ε : ℝ => -(s * g) * Real.log (det (1 - (ε * (s / g)) • X)))
        (s ^ 2 * trace X) 0) ∧
    (∀ (n : Type) [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] (R : Type) [CommRing R] (M : Matrix n n R)
        (j : n → R),
      (1 + diagonal j * M).det =
        ∑ S : Finset n, (∏ i ∈ S, j i) * (M.submatrix (Subtype.val : S → n) Subtype.val).det) ∧
    (∀ (n : Type) [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] (R : Type) [CommRing R] (M : Matrix n n R)
        (S : Finset n),
      ((1 + diagonal (fun i => (MvPolynomial.X i : MvPolynomial n R)) *
          M.map MvPolynomial.C).det).coeff (∑ i ∈ S, Finsupp.single i 1) =
        (M.submatrix (Subtype.val : S → n) Subtype.val).det) ∧
    (∀ (n m : Type) [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] [Fintype m] [DecidableEq m] (s g : ℝ)
        (X : Matrix n n ℝ) (Y : Matrix m m ℝ),
      0 ≤ det (1 - (s / g) • X) → 0 ≤ det (1 - (s / g) • Y) →
      Law.sourceZ s g (fromBlocks X 0 0 Y) = Law.sourceZ s g X * Law.sourceZ s g Y)
theorems.description:
**The source family for real sources** (Proposition 110 for real `X`, `s`, `g`). With `X = K⁻¹J` and
`Z_{(s,g)} = det(I − (s/g)X)^{−sg}`: the logarithm of `det(I − ε(s/g)X)` is the series `logSeries`
(`P′ = P·L′`, `L(0) = 0`, `P(0) = 1`), so `log Z_{(s,g)}(εX) = −sg·L = Σ_k s^{k+1}g^{1−k}ε^k Tr X^k/k`; two ends
`(+1, g → ∞)` give `exp Tr X`, several vertices `(−1, 1)` give `det(I + X)`, `k` times `(+1, 1)` give
`det(I − X)⁻¹`, and the first coefficient of `log Z_{(s,g)}` is `s² Tr X` in every member; a constant is the
coefficient of `Z` on its word: `det(I + diag(j)M) = Σ_S (∏_{x∈S} j_x) det M[S, S]`, and on the polynomials
in the sources the coefficient of `∏_{x∈S} j_x` is `det M[S, S]`; a composite on the direct sum of its lines'
words is the product, `Z(X ⊕ Y) = Z(X)Z(Y)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.prop_110

source_context.command: open Matrix Polynomial Filter Topology Comparison

theorems.statement:
theorem prop_110 :
    (∀ (n : Type) [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] (s g : ℂ) (X : Matrix n n ℂ),
      Law.sourceZC s g X = (det (1 - (s / g) • X)) ^ (-(s * g))) ∧
    (∀ (n : Type) [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] (s g : ℂ) (X : Matrix n n ℂ), g ≠ 0 →
      (PowerSeries.derivative (R := ℂ)
          ((1 - (Polynomial.X : ℂ[X]) • ((s / g) • X).map Polynomial.C).det : PowerSeries ℂ) =
        ((1 - (Polynomial.X : ℂ[X]) • ((s / g) • X).map Polynomial.C).det : PowerSeries ℂ) *
          PowerSeries.derivative (R := ℂ) (logSeries ((s / g) • X)) ∧
        PowerSeries.constantCoeff (logSeries ((s / g) • X)) = 0) ∧
      (-(s * g)) • logSeries ((s / g) • X) = Law.sourceLogK s g X) ∧
    (∀ (n : Type) [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] (X : Matrix n n ℂ),
      Tendsto (fun g : ℝ => Law.sourceZC 1 (g : ℂ) X) atTop (𝓝 (Complex.exp (trace X))) ∧
      Law.sourceZC (-1) 1 X = det (1 + X) ∧ Law.sourceZC 1 1 X = (det (1 - X))⁻¹) ∧
    (∀ (n : Type) [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] (s g : ℂ) (X : Matrix n n ℂ), g ≠ 0 →
      HasDerivAt (fun ε : ℂ => -(s * g) * Complex.log (det (1 - (ε * (s / g)) • X)))
        (s ^ 2 * trace X) 0) ∧
    (∀ (n : Type) [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] (R : Type) [CommRing R] (M : Matrix n n R)
        (j : n → R),
      (1 + diagonal j * M).det =
        ∑ S : Finset n, (∏ i ∈ S, j i) * (M.submatrix (Subtype.val : S → n) Subtype.val).det) ∧
    (∀ (n : Type) [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] (R : Type) [CommRing R] (M : Matrix n n R)
        (S : Finset n),
      ((1 + diagonal (fun i => (MvPolynomial.X i : MvPolynomial n R)) *
          M.map MvPolynomial.C).det).coeff (∑ i ∈ S, Finsupp.single i 1) =
        (M.submatrix (Subtype.val : S → n) Subtype.val).det) ∧
    (∀ (n m : Type) [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] [Fintype m] [DecidableEq m] (s g : ℂ)
        (X : Matrix n n ℂ) (Y : Matrix m m ℂ),
      Law.sourceLogK s g (fromBlocks X 0 0 Y) = Law.sourceLogK s g X + Law.sourceLogK s g Y ∧
      (∀ᶠ ε in 𝓝 (0 : ℂ),
        Law.sourceZC s g (ε • fromBlocks X 0 0 Y) = Law.sourceZC s g (ε • X) * Law.sourceZC s g (ε • Y))) ∧
    (∀ (n m : Type) [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] [Fintype m] [DecidableEq m] (X : Matrix n n ℂ)
        (Y : Matrix m m ℂ),
      Law.sourceZC (-1) 1 (fromBlocks X 0 0 Y) = Law.sourceZC (-1) 1 X * Law.sourceZC (-1) 1 Y ∧
      Law.sourceZC 1 1 (fromBlocks X 0 0 Y) = Law.sourceZC 1 1 X * Law.sourceZC 1 1 Y)
theorems.description:
**Proposition 110, the source family and the address of a constant.** Over `ℂ` (the theory's `K` and `J` are
complex), with `X = K⁻¹J` and `Z_{(s,g)} = det(I − (s/g)X)^{−sg}`: the logarithm of `det(I − ε(s/g)X)` is the series
`logSeries` (`P′ = P·L′`, `L(0) = 0`), so `log Z_{(s,g)}(εX) = −sg·L = Σ_k s^{k+1}g^{1−k}ε^k Tr X^k/k` for every complex
`s` and `g ≠ 0`; two ends `(+1, g → ∞)` give `exp Tr X`, several vertices `(−1, 1)` give `det(I + X)`, `k` times `(+1, 1)`
give `det(I − X)⁻¹`, and the first coefficient of `log Z_{(s,g)}` is `s² Tr X` in every member; a constant is the
coefficient of `Z` on its word: `det(I + diag(j)M) = Σ_S (∏_{x∈S} j_x) det M[S, S]`, and on the polynomials in the
sources the coefficient of `∏_{x∈S} j_x` is `det M[S, S]`; a composite on the direct sum of its lines' words is the
product: `log Z(X ⊕ Y) = log Z(X) + log Z(Y)` as series, `Z(ε(X ⊕ Y)) = Z(εX)Z(εY)` near `ε = 0` in every member, and
exactly for every `X`, `Y` in the members `(−1, 1)` and `(1, 1)`. The real case is `Law.source_family_real`.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.table_VI
theorems.statement:
theorem table_VI :
    -- F
    (HasSum excursionLaw 1 ∧ HasSum (fun n : ℕ => (n : ℝ) * excursionLaw n) 16 ∧
      (∑' n : ℕ, (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * excursionLaw n) - (∑' n : ℕ, (n : ℝ) * excursionLaw n) ^ 2 = 156 ∧
      (∀ z : ℂ, ‖z‖ ≤ 1 → HasSum (fun n => (excursionLaw n : ℂ) * z ^ n) (excursionGF z)) ∧
      excursionGF 1 = 1 ∧ HasDerivAt excursionGF 16 1) ∧
    -- Φ
    ((∀ z : ℂ, ‖z‖ ≤ 1 → HasSum (fun n => (signedLaw n : ℂ) * z ^ n) (Comparison.Law.Phi z)) ∧
      Comparison.Law.Phi 1 = -1 / 19 ∧ Comparison.Law.Phi (-1) = -1 / 19 ∧
      Comparison.Law.Phi I = -1 / 13 ∧ Comparison.Law.Phi (-I) = -1 / 13) ∧
    -- the visits of one excursion
    (deriv (fun y => excursionF 1 1 y) 1 = 10 ∧ deriv (fun x => excursionF 1 x 1) 1 = 5 ∧
      deriv (deriv (fun y => excursionF 1 1 y)) 1 + deriv (fun y => excursionF 1 1 y) 1 -
          (deriv (fun y => excursionF 1 1 y) 1) ^ 2 = 84 ∧
      deriv (deriv (fun x => excursionF 1 x 1)) 1 + deriv (fun x => excursionF 1 x 1) 1 -
          (deriv (fun x => excursionF 1 x 1) 1) ^ 2 = 12 ∧
      deriv (fun x => deriv (fun y => excursionF 1 x y) 1) 1 -
          deriv (fun y => excursionF 1 1 y) 1 * deriv (fun x => excursionF 1 x 1) 1 = 30 ∧
      -- the same moments counted over the excursions (Prop. 29): `P`, `Q` the symmetric and vector states an excursion meets
      (∀ m, Comparison.System.Existence.statLaw Comparison.System.Existence.fP m =
        (∑ w ∈ excursions m, (Comparison.System.Existence.cP w : ℝ)) / (5 * 4 ^ (m - 1))) ∧
      (∀ m, Comparison.System.Existence.statLaw Comparison.System.Existence.fQ m =
        (∑ w ∈ excursions m, (Comparison.System.Existence.cQ w : ℝ)) / (5 * 4 ^ (m - 1))) ∧
      HasSum (Comparison.System.Existence.statLaw Comparison.System.Existence.fP) 10 ∧
      HasSum (Comparison.System.Existence.statLaw Comparison.System.Existence.fQ) 5 ∧
      Comparison.System.Existence.varP = 84 ∧ Comparison.System.Existence.varQ = 12 ∧
      Comparison.System.Existence.covPQ = 30 ∧
      (∀ w : List (Fin 5), IsExcursion w →
        1 + Comparison.System.Existence.cP w + Comparison.System.Existence.cQ w = w.length) ∧
      deriv (fun y => excursionF 1 1 y) 1 = Comparison.System.Existence.excursionMean Comparison.System.Existence.fP ∧
      deriv (fun x => excursionF 1 x 1) 1 = Comparison.System.Existence.excursionMean Comparison.System.Existence.fQ) ∧
    -- one excursion's visits to the symmetric states and their pole
    ((∀ x : ℂ, ‖x‖ ≤ 1 → HasSum (fun m => (∑ w ∈ excursions m, x ^ Comparison.System.Existence.cP w) / (5 * 4 ^ (m - 1)))
        (x * (1 + x) / (16 - 11 * x - 3 * x ^ 2))) ∧
      (∀ y : ℝ, GP y = excursionF 1 1 y) ∧ (∀ x : ℝ, GP x = x * (1 + x) / (16 - 11 * x - 3 * x ^ 2)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℝ, 16 - 11 * x - 3 * x ^ 2 = -3 * (x - xc) * (x - xc')) ∧
      xc = (Real.sqrt 313 - 11) / 6 ∧ 1 < xc ∧
      (∀ x : ℝ, 0 ≤ x → x ≤ 1 → 0 < 16 - 11 * x - 3 * x ^ 2)) ∧
    -- the transitions of one excursion
    (∀ h : Fin 5, (excursionStates h).card = 74 ∧ ∑ j, alongCount h j = 296 ∧ alongCount h h = 60 ∧
      (∀ j, j ≠ h → alongCount h j = 59) ∧
      ((excursionStates h).filter fun s => h ∉ disagreeSet s.1).card = 34) ∧
    -- the Green function at the critical step
    (WholePicture.greenM = (1 / 32 : ℝ) • ((7 : ℝ) • (1 : Matrix (Fin 16) (Fin 16) ℝ) + A ℝ) -
        (3 / 128 : ℝ) • Matrix.of (fun _ _ => (1 : ℝ)) ∧
      (∀ X : Matrix (Fin 16) (Fin 16) ℝ, WholePicture.lapM * X * WholePicture.lapM = WholePicture.lapM →
        X * WholePicture.lapM * X = X → (WholePicture.lapM * X)ᵀ = WholePicture.lapM * X →
        (X * WholePicture.lapM)ᵀ = X * WholePicture.lapM → X = WholePicture.greenM) ∧
      (∀ f : Fin 16, (disagreeSet f).card = 2 →
        WholePicture.greenM 0 0 + WholePicture.greenM f f - 2 * WholePicture.greenM 0 f = 7 / 16)) ∧
    -- the polar step
    (((B ℝ)ᵀ * B ℝ).charpoly = (X - C (1 : ℝ)) ^ 64 * (X - C (16 : ℝ)) ^ 16 ∧
      WholePicture.absB.IsHermitian ∧ WholePicture.absB * WholePicture.absB = (B ℝ)ᵀ * B ℝ ∧
      WholePicture.absB.charpoly = (X - C (1 : ℝ)) ^ 64 * (X - C (4 : ℝ)) ^ 16 ∧
      WholePicture.absB = (2 : ℝ) • (Real.exp (Real.log 2) • WholePicture.lastDirectionProj +
        Real.exp (-Real.log 2) • (1 - WholePicture.lastDirectionProj)) ∧
      Real.tanh (Real.log 2 / 4) = 3 - 2 * Real.sqrt 2) ∧
    -- the charges of the five directions
    2 * ((∑ s, WholePicture.lineCharge s ^ 2) / 5 - ((∑ s, WholePicture.lineCharge s) / 5) ^ 2) = 8 / 15 ∧
    -- 24/11
    ((L * L).trace / 4 = 24 ∧
      Module.finrank ℂ (Module.End.eigenspace (Matrix.toLin' L) 6) +
        Module.finrank ℂ (Module.End.eigenspace (Matrix.toLin' L) 2) = 11) ∧
    -- the vertical grade and the parallel clocks
    (∀ (p q : ℝ), 0 < p → 0 < q → ∀ D E : Finset (Fin 5),
      Formulas.JDE p q D E = Formulas.CW p q / 72 *
        (D.card * E.card - 5 * ((projD D) * (projD E)).trace)) ∧
    -- one marked arc
    (∀ (p q : State), Continues q p → ∀ θ u : ℂ,
      (1 - u • WholePicture.Bmark p q (Complex.exp (-Complex.I * θ))).det =
        WholePicture.lawPoly.eval u + (Complex.exp (-Complex.I * θ) - 1) * u *
          (Polynomial.derivative WholePicture.lawPoly).eval u / 320)
theorems.description:
**Table VI, the functions of the law, every one counted on the step `B`** (`z = 4u`).
`F`: every excursion closes, `F(1) = Σ f = 1`, after `F′(1) = Σ n f = 16` steps on average, `Var ℓ = 156`.
`Φ`: `Φ(±1) = −1/19`, `Φ(±i) = −1/13`. The visits of one excursion (`F(z, x, y)` with `y` marking a plane and `x` a
line): `E P = 10`, `E Q = 5`, `Var P = 84`, `Var Q = 12`, `Cov(P, Q) = 30`, the moments of the symmetric and
vector states each excursion meets, counted over the excursions (`ℓ = 1 + P + Q`; E's Prop. 29), which the derivatives of `F` are. One excursion's visits to the symmetric states, the sum over the excursions of `x^P` (E's `plane_visits_gf`),
`G_P(x) = x(1 + x)/(16 − 11x − 3x²) = F(1, 1, x)`, with its pole `x_c = (√313 − 11)/6 > 1`. The transitions of one excursion:
`74` states, `M = 296` transitions, `C_h = 60` along the last-step direction, `C_j = 59` along each other line, `34` of the `74` leaving the
last-step direction undivided. `(5 − A)⁺ = (7 + A)/32 − 3J/128` and `b = 7/16`. The polar step (on the canonical step `B ℝ`, `stepR_eq`): `BᵀB` has the eigenvalues `1`
(64 times) and `16` (16 times), `|B| = 1 + 3Π` is symmetric with `|B|² = BᵀB` and the eigenvalues `1` and `4`, and
`|B| = 2(e^ξΠ + e^{−ξ}(1 − Π)) = 2e^{ξ(2Π−I)}` with `ξ = log 2`, `tanh(ξ/4) = 3 − 2√2`. The charges of the five
directions: `c = 2 Var = 8/15`. `Tr L²/4 = 24` against the `1 + 10 = 11` positive vertices. `𝒥_DE = C_W(|D||E| −
5 Tr P_DP_E)/72` for every positive grade weights. One of the `320` arcs marked with a phase:
`D_θ(u) = D(u) + (e^{−iθ} − 1)uD′(u)/320`.
Recognition: the last row is the electron's rotation of the critical zero, `θ/320` per step.

theorems.description: **Every distinction is `Σ t_s γ_s` in the lines of a gauge, with unique real `t`.**

theorems.name: Comparison.System.exists_frame

theorems.name: Comparison.System.frames_differ
theorems.statement:
theorem frames_differ {S : CandidateSystem} (f f' : S.Frame) :
    ∃ U ∈ Sp2, ∀ w : ModelH, f'.e (f.e.symm w) =
      WithLp.toLp 2 ((U : Matrix Four Four ℂ) *ᵥ WithLp.ofLp w)
theorems.description: **Two gauges differ by one rotation of `Sp(2)`.**

theorems.name: Comparison.System.uniqueness
theorems.statement:
theorem uniqueness (S : CandidateSystem) :
    Module.finrank ℂ S.H = 4 ∧
    Module.finrank ℝ S.Q = 5 ∧
    Nonempty S.Frame ∧
    (∀ f : S.Frame, (∀ s, f.lines s ∈ S.Q) ∧
      (∀ s t, f.lines s * f.lines t + f.lines t * f.lines s =
        (if s = t then (2 : ℂ) else 0) • (1 : S.H →ₗ[ℂ] S.H)) ∧
      f.lines 0 * f.lines 1 * f.lines 2 * f.lines 3 * f.lines 4 = 1 ∧
      (∀ a ∈ S.Q, ∃! t : Fin 5 → ℝ, a = ∑ s, (t s : ℂ) • f.lines s)) ∧
    (∀ f f' : S.Frame, ∃ U ∈ Sp2, ∀ w : ModelH, f'.e (f.e.symm w) =
      WithLp.toLp 2 ((U : Matrix Four Four ℂ) *ᵥ WithLp.ofLp w)) ∧
    (∀ v : S.H, S.partner.Θ (Complex.I • v) = -(Complex.I • S.partner.Θ v)) ∧
    Module.finrank ℝ S.H = 8
theorems.description:
**The uniqueness theorem.** A system that satisfies the mathematical form of P1 to P3 is the
quaternionic plane: four complex amplitudes, five directions. For every candidate system `S`:
`dim_ℂ H = 4`; `dim_ℝ Q = 5`; `S` has a gauge, a unitary map onto the model that carries its
conjugate
to `J₀K`; in every gauge the five directions are distinctions with `{γ_s, γ_t} = 2δ_st` and product one,
and every distinction is `Σ t_s γ_s` with unique real `t`; two gauges differ by one rotation of
`Sp(2)`;
and `Θ i = −i Θ`, so `i`, `Θ`, `iΘ` are the quaternion units and `H` has real dimension 8.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.systems_isomorphic

theorem systems_isomorphic (S S' : CandidateSystem) :
    ∃ e : S.H ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] S'.H, ∀ v, e (S.partner.Θ v) = S'.partner.Θ (e v)
theorems.description: **Any two candidate systems are the same up to a unitary map that carries quaternionic structure to quaternionic structure.**

theorems.name: Comparison.System.trace_hol_closed_isFact
theorems.statement:
theorem trace_hol_closed_isFact {X : Type*} {n R : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] [CommRing R]
    (x : X) (rest : List X) (hclosed : (x :: rest).getLast (List.cons_ne_nil x rest) = x) :
    IsFact (fun c : Connection X (Matrix n n R)ˣ =>
      ((hol c (x :: rest) : (Matrix n n R)ˣ) : Matrix n n R).trace)
theorems.description:
**The trace of the holonomy of a closed walk is a fact** (Prop. 32), for every group of
invertible matrices.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.trace_hol_Sp2_isFact

    IsFact (fun c : Connection (Fin 16) Sp2 => (turnMatrix (hol c (x :: rest))).trace)
theorems.description:
**P4 on the sixteen vertices, with the rotations of `Sp(2)`:** the trace of the holonomy of a closed
walk is a fact.

theorems.name: Comparison.System.CandidateSystem.eigenspace_comparison

    (Module.End.eigenspace S.comparison μ).map (f.c2L : P1.TwoThings S.H →ₗ[ℂ] (Two → ℂ)) =
      Module.End.eigenspace (Matrix.toLin' L) μ
theorems.description: **Every gauge carries the eigenspaces of the comparison of `S` onto those of `L`.**

theorems.name: Comparison.System.CandidateSystem.finrank_eigenspace_comparison
theorems.statement:
theorem finrank_eigenspace_comparison {S : CandidateSystem} (f : S.Frame) (μ : ℂ) :
    Module.finrank ℂ (Module.End.eigenspace S.comparison μ) =
      Module.finrank ℂ (Module.End.eigenspace (Matrix.toLin' L) μ)

theorems.name: Comparison.System.CandidateSystem.comparison_spectrum
theorems.statement:
theorem comparison_spectrum (S : CandidateSystem) :
    Module.finrank ℂ (Module.End.eigenspace S.comparison 6) = 1 ∧
    Module.finrank ℂ (Module.End.eigenspace S.comparison 2) = 10 ∧
    Module.finrank ℂ (Module.End.eigenspace S.comparison (-2)) = 5 ∧
    ∀ μ : ℂ, μ ≠ 6 → μ ≠ 2 → μ ≠ -2 → Module.End.eigenspace S.comparison μ = ⊥
theorems.description: **The comparison of every candidate system has the spectrum `6¹ ⊕ 2¹⁰ ⊕ (−2)⁵`.**

    (hH : ∀ t, (Γ t).conjTranspose = Γ t) (hG : ∀ t, Γ t * Γ t = 1) (u : ℝ) (hu0 : 0 ≤ u)

theorems.name: Comparison.System.row_H03

source_context.command: open Real Complex Matrix Comparison Comparison.Law Comparison.System.Completion Comparison.System.Table

theorems.statement:
theorem row_H03 {n : ℕ} (P : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ) (ψ₁ ψ₂ : Fin n → ℂ) (α β : ℂ)
    (h1 : P.mulVec ψ₁ = ψ₁) (h2 : P.mulVec ψ₂ = ψ₂) (n1 : ∑ i, Complex.normSq (ψ₁ i) = 1)
    (n2 : ∑ i, Complex.normSq (ψ₂ i) = 1) (hab : Complex.normSq α + Complex.normSq β = 1) :
    Article.successWithRecords P ψ₁ ψ₂ α β = 1
theorems.description:
**Row H03.** Two orders that both succeed, superposed with amplitudes `α`, `β` and recorded by orthogonal
records, succeed with chance `|α|² + |β|² = 1` (the records remove the interference). Recognition: the success of
two orders added with their record.

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.rank_eq_of_cert
theorems.statement:
theorem rank_eq_of_cert {m n : Type*} [Finite m] [Fintype n] {K : Type*} [Field K]
    (M : Matrix m n K) {r : ℕ} (R : Fin r → m) (Cc : Fin r → n)
    (Q : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r) K) (Y : Matrix (Fin r) n K)
    (hQ : M.submatrix R Cc * Q = 1) (hY : M = M.submatrix id Cc * Y) : M.rank = r
theorems.description:
**A rank from a certificate:** an invertible `r × r` minor and a factorization through `r`
columns give `rank M = r`.

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.homology_finrank_one
theorems.statement:
theorem homology_finrank_one {K : Type*} [Field K] {a b c : Type*} [Fintype b] [Fintype c]
    (f : Matrix a b K) (g : Matrix b c K)
    (hfg : f * g = 0) (h : Fintype.card b = f.rank + g.rank + 1) :
    Module.finrank K (LinearMap.ker f.mulVecLin ⧸
      (LinearMap.range g.mulVecLin).comap (LinearMap.ker f.mulVecLin).subtype) = 1
theorems.description:
**One class:** if `f g = 0` and `dim b = rank f + rank g + 1`, then `ker f / im g` is
one-dimensional.

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.homology_mod_two
theorems.statement:
theorem homology_mod_two :
    Module.finrank (ZMod 2) (LinearMap.ker (0 : Matrix (Fin 0) (Fin 16) (ZMod 2)).mulVecLin ⧸
      (LinearMap.range bd1.mulVecLin).comap
        (LinearMap.ker (0 : Matrix (Fin 0) (Fin 16) (ZMod 2)).mulVecLin).subtype) = 1 ∧
    Module.finrank (ZMod 2) (LinearMap.ker bd1.mulVecLin ⧸
      (LinearMap.range bd2.mulVecLin).comap (LinearMap.ker bd1.mulVecLin).subtype) = 1 ∧
    Module.finrank (ZMod 2) (LinearMap.ker bd2.mulVecLin ⧸
      (LinearMap.range bd3.mulVecLin).comap (LinearMap.ker bd2.mulVecLin).subtype) = 1 ∧
    Module.finrank (ZMod 2) (LinearMap.ker bd3.mulVecLin ⧸
      (LinearMap.range bd4.mulVecLin).comap (LinearMap.ker bd3.mulVecLin).subtype) = 1 ∧
    Module.finrank (ZMod 2) (LinearMap.ker bd4.mulVecLin ⧸
      (LinearMap.range (0 : Matrix (Fin 5) (Fin 0) (ZMod 2)).mulVecLin).comap
        (LinearMap.ker bd4.mulVecLin).subtype) = 1
theorems.description:
**One class in each dimension mod 2:** `dim(ker ∂_k / im ∂_{k+1}) = 1` for `k = 0, 1, 2, 3, 4`
(`∂₀ = 0` on the vertices and `∂₅ = 0` into the four-cells).

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.div_grad
theorems.statement:
theorem div_grad (φ : Fin 16 → ℝ) (x : Fin 16) :
    divR (gradR φ) x = ∑ y, (((if x = y then 5 else 0) - adjZ x y : ℤ) : ℝ) * φ y

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.sum_divR
theorems.statement: theorem sum_divR (θ : Fin 40 → ℝ) : ∑ x, divR θ x = 0

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.laplace_green
theorems.statement:
theorem laplace_green (f : Fin 16 → ℝ) (x : Fin 16) :
    ∑ y, (((if x = y then 5 else 0) - adjZ x y : ℤ) : ℝ) * greenR f y = f x - (∑ y, f y) / 16
theorems.description: **The Green function inverts the Laplacian on functions of mean zero.**

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.divR_thetaCyc
theorems.statement: theorem divR_thetaCyc (θ : Fin 40 → ℝ) (x : Fin 16) : divR (thetaCyc θ) x = 0
theorems.description: **The cyclic part has no divergence.**

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.theta_sub_cyc
theorems.statement: theorem theta_sub_cyc (θ : Fin 40 → ℝ) : θ = thetaCyc θ + gradR (greenR (divR θ))
theorems.description: `θ − θ_cyc` is a gradient.

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.grad_orth
theorems.statement:
theorem grad_orth (φ : Fin 16 → ℝ) (ψ : Fin 40 → ℝ) (hψ : ∀ x, divR ψ x = 0) :
    ∑ l, gradR φ l * ψ l = 0
theorems.description: A gradient is orthogonal to a field without divergence.

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.sqL_cyc_le
theorems.statement: theorem sqL_cyc_le (θ : Fin 40 → ℝ) : sqL (thetaCyc θ) ≤ sqL θ
theorems.description: **The cyclic part is the shortest:** `‖θ_cyc‖² ≤ ‖θ‖²`.

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.cyc_unique
theorems.statement:
theorem cyc_unique (θ : Fin 40 → ℝ) (φ : Fin 16 → ℝ) (ψ : Fin 40 → ℝ) (hψ : ∀ x, divR ψ x = 0)
    (h : θ = gradR φ + ψ) : ψ = thetaCyc θ
theorems.description:
**The cyclic part is the part no gauge transformation removes:** any splitting `θ = grad φ + ψ` with `ψ`
divergence-free has `ψ = θ_cyc`.

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.nsq_nonneg
theorems.statement: theorem nsq_nonneg (v : Fin 16 → ℂ) : 0 ≤ nsq v

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.nsq_pos
theorems.statement: theorem nsq_pos {v : Fin 16 → ℂ} (hv : v ≠ 0) : 0 < nsq v

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.sum_ends
theorems.statement: theorem sum_ends (f : Fin 16 → ℝ) : ∑ l, (f (linkV l) + f (linkU l)) = 5 * ∑ x, f x
theorems.description:
The sum over the links of a function of the head and of the tail is five times the sum over
the vertices.

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.re_term_le
theorems.statement:
theorem re_term_le (e a b : ℂ) (he : ‖e‖ = 1) :
    2 * (e * star a * b).re ≤ Complex.normSq a + Complex.normSq b

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.magForm_le
theorems.statement: theorem magForm_le (θ : Fin 40 → ℝ) (v : Fin 16 → ℂ) : magForm θ v ≤ 5 * nsq v
theorems.description: **The form is at most five times the length:** `magForm θ v ≤ 5‖v‖²`.

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.rayleigh_le_five
theorems.statement:
theorem rayleigh_le_five (θ : Fin 40 → ℝ) (v : {v : Fin 16 → ℂ // v ≠ 0}) :
    magForm θ v / nsq v ≤ 5

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.rayleigh_bdd
theorems.statement:
theorem rayleigh_bdd (θ : Fin 40 → ℝ) :
    BddAbove (Set.range fun v : {v : Fin 16 → ℂ // v ≠ 0} => magForm θ v / nsq v)

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.le_lamMax
theorems.statement:
theorem le_lamMax (θ : Fin 40 → ℝ) {v : Fin 16 → ℂ} (hv : v ≠ 0) :
    magForm θ v ≤ lamMax θ * nsq v

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.lamMax_le
theorems.statement:
theorem lamMax_le (θ : Fin 40 → ℝ) (M : ℝ) (h : ∀ v : Fin 16 → ℂ, v ≠ 0 → magForm θ v ≤ M * nsq v) :
    lamMax θ ≤ M

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.lamMax_le_five
theorems.statement: theorem lamMax_le_five (θ : Fin 40 → ℝ) : lamMax θ ≤ 5

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.nsq_gauge
theorems.statement: theorem nsq_gauge (φ : Fin 16 → ℝ) (v : Fin 16 → ℂ) : nsq (gaugeV φ v) = nsq v

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.gauge_gauge
theorems.statement: theorem gauge_gauge (φ : Fin 16 → ℝ) (v : Fin 16 → ℂ) : gaugeV φ (gaugeV (-φ) v) = v

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.star_exp_real
theorems.statement: theorem star_exp_real (r : ℝ) : star (exp (r * I)) = exp (-(r * I))

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.magForm_gauge
theorems.statement:
theorem magForm_gauge (θ : Fin 40 → ℝ) (φ : Fin 16 → ℝ) (v : Fin 16 → ℂ) :
    magForm (θ + gradR φ) (gaugeV φ v) = magForm θ v
theorems.description: **A gauge transformation moves the phases by a gradient and keeps the form.**

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.lamMax_gauge
theorems.statement: theorem lamMax_gauge (θ : Fin 40 → ℝ) (φ : Fin 16 → ℝ) : lamMax (θ + gradR φ) = lamMax θ
theorems.description: **Renaming does not move the largest value:** `λ_max(A_{θ + grad φ}) = λ_max(A_θ)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.lamMax_cyc
theorems.statement: theorem lamMax_cyc (θ : Fin 40 → ℝ) : lamMax θ = lamMax (thetaCyc θ)
theorems.description: **The largest value depends only on the cyclic part.**

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.lamMax_ge
theorems.statement: theorem lamMax_ge (θ : Fin 40 → ℝ) : 5 - sqL θ / 16 ≤ lamMax θ
theorems.description: **`λ_max(A_θ) ≥ 5 − ‖θ‖²/16`** for every `θ`, from the constant vector.

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.adjC_conjTranspose
theorems.statement: theorem adjC_conjTranspose : adjCᴴ = adjC

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.adjC_sq
theorems.statement: theorem adjC_sq : adjC * adjC = (3 : ℂ) • 1 - (2 : ℂ) • adjC + (2 : ℂ) • onesC

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.one_sub_adjC_sq
theorems.statement:
theorem one_sub_adjC_sq :
    (1 - adjC)ᴴ * (1 - adjC) = (4 : ℂ) • (1 - adjC) + (2 : ℂ) • onesC

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.onesC_mulVec
theorems.statement: theorem onesC_mulVec (y : Fin 16 → ℂ) (hy : ∑ x, y x = 0) : onesC *ᵥ y = 0

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.re_star_self
theorems.statement: theorem re_star_self (w : Fin 16 → ℂ) : (star w ⬝ᵥ w).re = nsq w

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.clebsch_le
theorems.statement:
theorem clebsch_le (y : Fin 16 → ℂ) (hy : ∑ x, y x = 0) :
    (star y ⬝ᵥ (adjC *ᵥ y)).re ≤ nsq y
theorems.description:
**On functions of mean zero the adjacency is at most one:** `Re y†Ay ≤ ‖y‖²`, since
`y†(1 − A)y = ‖(1 − A)y‖²/4` there (`(1 − A)² = 4(1 − A) + 2J`).

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.link_pair_sum
theorems.statement:
theorem link_pair_sum (l : Fin 40) (y : Fin 16 → ℂ) :
    ∑ x, ∑ z, star (y x) * (linkInd l x z : ℂ) * y z =
      star (y (linkV l)) * y (linkU l) + star (y (linkU l)) * y (linkV l)
theorems.description: One link's share of `y†Ay`.

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.magForm_zero_eq
theorems.statement: theorem magForm_zero_eq (y : Fin 16 → ℂ) : magForm 0 y = (star y ⬝ᵥ (adjC *ᵥ y)).re
theorems.description: The form at zero phases is the adjacency's form.

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.split_term
theorems.statement:
theorem split_term (e m a b : ℂ) :
    2 * (e * star (m + a) * (m + b)).re =
      Complex.normSq m * (2 * e.re) + 2 * (star m * (e * b + star e * a)).re +
        2 * (e * star a * b).re

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.magForm_split
theorems.statement:
theorem magForm_split (θ : Fin 40 → ℝ) (m : ℂ) (y : Fin 16 → ℂ) :
    magForm θ (fun x => m + y x) =
      Complex.normSq m * (∑ l, 2 * Real.cos (θ l)) +
        2 * (star m * ∑ l, (exp (θ l * I) * y (linkU l) + exp (-(θ l * I)) * y (linkV l))).re +
        magForm θ y
theorems.description: **The form split into the mean and the rest.**

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.nsq_split
theorems.statement:
theorem nsq_split (m : ℂ) (y : Fin 16 → ℂ) (hy : ∑ x, y x = 0) :
    nsq (fun x => m + y x) = 16 * Complex.normSq m + nsq y

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.sum_ends_c
theorems.statement: theorem sum_ends_c (f : Fin 16 → ℂ) : ∑ l, (f (linkV l) + f (linkU l)) = 5 * ∑ x, f x
theorems.description: The sum over the links of a complex function of the head and of the tail.

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.sum_link_div
theorems.statement:
theorem sum_link_div (ψ : Fin 40 → ℝ) (y : Fin 16 → ℂ) :
    ∑ l, (ψ l : ℂ) * (y (linkV l) - y (linkU l)) = ∑ x, y x * (divR ψ x : ℂ)
theorems.description: `Σ_ℓ ψ_ℓ (y_V − y_U) = Σ_x y_x (div ψ)_x`.

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.cross_term_le
theorems.statement:
theorem cross_term_le (ψ : Fin 40 → ℝ) (hdiv : ∀ x, divR ψ x = 0) (hψ : ∀ l, |ψ l| ≤ 1)
    (y : Fin 16 → ℂ) (hy : ∑ x, y x = 0) :
    ‖∑ l, (exp (ψ l * I) * y (linkU l) + exp (-(ψ l * I)) * y (linkV l))‖ ≤
      ∑ l, ψ l ^ 2 * (‖y (linkU l)‖ + ‖y (linkV l)‖)
theorems.description: **The cross term of a field without divergence on a function of mean zero is of second order.**

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.magForm_rest_le
theorems.statement:
theorem magForm_rest_le (ψ : Fin 40 → ℝ) (c : ℝ) (hψ : ∀ l, |ψ l| ≤ c) (y : Fin 16 → ℂ)
    (hy : ∑ x, y x = 0) : magForm ψ y ≤ (1 + 5 * c) * nsq y
theorems.description: **A small phase moves the form of a function of mean zero by little.**

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.abs_le_sqrt_sqL
theorems.statement: theorem abs_le_sqrt_sqL (ψ : Fin 40 → ℝ) (l : Fin 40) : |ψ l| ≤ Real.sqrt (sqL ψ)

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.norm_le_sqrt_nsq
theorems.statement: theorem norm_le_sqrt_nsq (y : Fin 16 → ℂ) (x : Fin 16) : ‖y x‖ ≤ Real.sqrt (nsq y)

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.two_by_two
theorems.statement:
theorem two_by_two (a b d M S t : ℝ) (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hp : 0 ≤ M - a) (hq : 0 ≤ M - d)
    (hdisc : b ^ 2 ≤ 4 * (M - a) * (M - d)) (_hS : 0 ≤ S) (_ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    a * S ^ 2 + b * S * t + d * t ^ 2 ≤ M * (S ^ 2 + t ^ 2)
theorems.description: **The quadratic estimate of a two-by-two form.**

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.magForm_upper
theorems.statement:
theorem magForm_upper (ψ : Fin 40 → ℝ) (hdiv : ∀ x, divR ψ x = 0) (hsmall : sqL ψ ≤ 1 / 100)
    (v : Fin 16 → ℂ) : magForm ψ v ≤ (5 - sqL ψ / 16 + sqL ψ ^ 2 / 10) * nsq v
theorems.description:
**The upper bound:** for phases without divergence and `‖ψ‖² ≤ 1/100`,
`v†A_ψv ≤ (5 − ‖ψ‖²/16 + ‖ψ‖⁴/10)‖v‖²`.

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.lamMax_upper
theorems.statement:
theorem lamMax_upper (ψ : Fin 40 → ℝ) (hdiv : ∀ x, divR ψ x = 0) (hsmall : sqL ψ ≤ 1 / 100) :
    lamMax ψ ≤ 5 - sqL ψ / 16 + sqL ψ ^ 2 / 10
theorems.description: **`λ_max(A_ψ) ≤ 5 − ‖ψ‖²/16 + ‖ψ‖⁴/10`** for phases without divergence, `‖ψ‖² ≤ 1/100`.

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.ucrit_root
theorems.statement:
theorem ucrit_root (θ : Fin 40 → ℝ) (h4 : 4 ≤ lamMax θ) :
    1 + 4 * ucrit θ ^ 2 = ucrit θ * lamMax θ

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.log_root_bound
theorems.statement:
theorem log_root_bound (lam : ℝ) (h1 : 9 / 2 ≤ lam) (h2 : lam ≤ 5) :
    |Real.log ((lam - Real.sqrt (lam ^ 2 - 16)) / 2) - (5 - lam) / 3| ≤ (5 - lam) ^ 2 / 2
theorems.description:
**The logarithm of the root:** `|log((λ − √(λ² − 16))/2) − (5 − λ)/3| ≤ (5 − λ)²/2` for
`9/2 ≤ λ ≤ 5`.

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.long_range_zero
theorems.statement:
theorem long_range_zero (θ : Fin 40 → ℝ) (hθ : sqL (thetaCyc θ) ≤ 1 / 100) :
    |lamMax θ - (5 - sqL (thetaCyc θ) / 16)| ≤ sqL (thetaCyc θ) ^ 2 / 10 ∧
    1 + 4 * ucrit θ ^ 2 = ucrit θ * lamMax θ ∧
    |Real.log (4 * ucrit θ) - sqL (thetaCyc θ) / 48| ≤ sqL (thetaCyc θ) ^ 2 / 20
theorems.description:
**The long-range zero under a circulation on the links:** with `θ_cyc` the part of the phases
that no gauge transformation removes and `‖θ_cyc‖² ≤ 1/100`,
`|λ_max(A_θ) − (5 − ‖θ_cyc‖²/16)| ≤ ‖θ_cyc‖⁴/10`, `1 + 4u_c² = u_c λ_max(A_θ)` and
`|log 4u_c − ‖θ_cyc‖²/48| ≤ ‖θ_cyc‖⁴/20`: `log 4u_c = ‖θ_cyc‖²/48 + O(θ⁴)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.magAdj_isHermitian
theorems.statement: theorem magAdj_isHermitian (θ : Fin 40 → ℝ) : (magAdj θ).IsHermitian

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.link_pair_sum_phase
theorems.statement:
theorem link_pair_sum_phase (θ : Fin 40 → ℝ) (l : Fin 40) (v : Fin 16 → ℂ) :
    ∑ x, ∑ z, star (v x) *
      ((if x = linkV l then (if z = linkU l then exp (θ l * I) else 0) else 0) +
        (if x = linkU l then (if z = linkV l then exp (-(θ l * I)) else 0) else 0)) * v z =
      star (v (linkV l)) * exp (θ l * I) * v (linkU l) +
        star (v (linkU l)) * exp (-(θ l * I)) * v (linkV l)
theorems.description: One link's share of `v†A_θv`.

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.magForm_eq
theorems.statement:
theorem magForm_eq (θ : Fin 40 → ℝ) (v : Fin 16 → ℂ) :
    (star v ⬝ᵥ (magAdj θ *ᵥ v)).re = magForm θ v
theorems.description: **The form of the matrix is the link sum:** `Re v†A_θv = magForm θ v`.

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.star_self_re
theorems.statement: theorem star_self_re (v : Fin 16 → ℂ) : (star v ⬝ᵥ v).re = nsq v

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.eigen_le_lamMax
theorems.statement:
theorem eigen_le_lamMax (θ : Fin 40 → ℝ) (μ : ℂ) (v : Fin 16 → ℂ) (hv : v ≠ 0)
    (h : magAdj θ *ᵥ v = μ • v) : μ.re ≤ lamMax θ
theorems.description: **Every eigenvalue of `A_θ` is at most `lamMax θ`.**

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.rayleigh_euclid
theorems.statement:
theorem rayleigh_euclid (θ : Fin 40 → ℝ) (x : EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin 16)) :
    RCLike.re (inner ℂ (Matrix.toEuclideanLin (magAdj θ) x) x) / ‖x‖ ^ 2 =
      magForm θ (WithLp.ofLp x) / nsq (WithLp.ofLp x)

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.toEuclidNZ_surjective
theorems.statement: theorem toEuclidNZ_surjective : Function.Surjective toEuclidNZ

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.lamMax_eq_rayleigh
theorems.statement:
theorem lamMax_eq_rayleigh (θ : Fin 40 → ℝ) :
    lamMax θ = ⨆ x : {x : EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin 16) // x ≠ 0},
      RCLike.re (inner ℂ (Matrix.toEuclideanLin (magAdj θ) x) (x : EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin 16))) /
        ‖(x : EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin 16))‖ ^ 2
theorems.description: **`lamMax θ` is the supremum of the Rayleigh quotient of `A_θ` on the Euclidean space.**

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.lamMax_hasEigenvalue
theorems.statement:
theorem lamMax_hasEigenvalue (θ : Fin 40 → ℝ) :
    Module.End.HasEigenvalue (Matrix.toEuclideanLin (magAdj θ)) (lamMax θ : ℂ)
theorems.description:
**`lamMax θ` is an eigenvalue of `A_θ`**, and by `eigen_le_lamMax` the largest:
`λ_max(A_θ)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.turnMat_back
theorems.statement:
theorem turnMat_back (c : Connection (Fin 16) (Matrix.unitaryGroup n ℂ)) (x y : Fin 16) :
    turnMat c y x = (turnMat c x y)ᴴ

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.turnMat_mul_back
theorems.statement:
theorem turnMat_mul_back (c : Connection (Fin 16) (Matrix.unitaryGroup n ℂ)) (x y : Fin 16) :
    turnMat c x y * turnMat c y x = 1

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.transition_eq_comm
theorems.statement: theorem transition_eq_comm (t : Fin 5) (x y : Fin 16) : y = transition t x ↔ x = transition t y

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.connStep_herm
theorems.statement:
theorem connStep_herm (c : Connection (Fin 16) (Matrix.unitaryGroup n ℂ)) (t : Fin 5) :
    (connStep c t)ᴴ = connStep c t
theorems.description: **`Γ_t` is Hermitian.**

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.connStep_sq
theorems.statement:
theorem connStep_sq (c : Connection (Fin 16) (Matrix.unitaryGroup n ℂ)) (t : Fin 5) :
    connStep c t * connStep c t = 1
theorems.description: **`Γ_t` is an involution:** `Γ_t² = 1`.

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.connStep_trivial
theorems.statement:
theorem connStep_trivial (t : Fin 5) :
    connStep (trivialConn (n := n)) t = transitionMat t ⊗ₖ (1 : Matrix n n ℂ)
theorems.description: **The trivial connection gives the transitions:** `Γ_t = transitionMat t ⊗ 1`.

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.law_quad_unitary
theorems.statement:
theorem law_quad_unitary (c : Connection (Fin 16) (Matrix.unitaryGroup n ℂ)) (u : ℝ) (hu : 0 ≤ u)
    (x : Fin 16 × n → ℂ) :
    (1 - u) * (1 - 4 * u) * (star x ⬝ᵥ x).re ≤
      (star x ⬝ᵥ (((1 + 4 * (u : ℂ) ^ 2) • (1 : Matrix (Fin 16 × n) (Fin 16 × n) ℂ) -
        (u : ℂ) • ∑ t, connStep c t) *ᵥ x)).re
theorems.description:
**The law's operator is bounded below for every unitary connection:**
`Re⟨x, ((1 + 4u²) − uΣ_tΓ_t)x⟩ ≥ (1 − u)(1 − 4u)⟨x, x⟩` for `u ≥ 0`.

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.law_weight_pos_unitary
theorems.statement:
theorem law_weight_pos_unitary (c : Connection (Fin 16) (Matrix.unitaryGroup n ℂ)) (u : ℝ)
    (hu0 : 0 ≤ u) (hu : u < 1 / 4) : 0 < (1 - (u : ℂ) • stepOp (connStep c)).det
theorems.description:
**Positivity below the critical step for every unitary connection:** `0 < det(I − uB[U])` for
`0 ≤ u < 1/4`.

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.law_pos_unitary
theorems.statement:
theorem law_pos_unitary (c : Connection (Fin 16) (Matrix.unitaryGroup n ℂ)) (u : ℝ) (hu0 : 0 ≤ u)
    (hu : u < 1 / 4) : 0 < ((1 - (u : ℂ) • stepOp (connStep c)).det)⁻¹
theorems.description: **The law `Z[U] = det(I − uB[U])⁻¹` is positive** for `0 ≤ u < 1/4`, every unitary connection.

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.law_no_zero_unitary
theorems.statement:
theorem law_no_zero_unitary (c : Connection (Fin 16) (Matrix.unitaryGroup n ℂ)) (u : ℂ)
    (hu : ‖u‖ < 1 / 4) : (1 - u • stepOp (connStep c)).det ≠ 0
theorems.description: **No unitary connection gives the law a zero in the open disc `|u| < 1/4`.**

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.eps_frame_Z
theorems.statement:
theorem eps_frame_Z : ∀ c d e f : Fin 4,
    ∑ g, ∑ h, frameZ c d g h * eps4 e f g h = 2 * eps4 e f c d

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.eps_eps_Z
theorems.statement:
theorem eps_eps_Z : ∀ a b e f : Fin 4,
    ∑ c, ∑ d, eps4 a b c d * eps4 e f c d = 2 * frameZ a b e f

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.frame_eps_Z
theorems.statement:
theorem frame_eps_Z : ∀ a b g h : Fin 4,
    ∑ e, ∑ f, frameZ a b e f * eps4 e f g h = 2 * eps4 a b g h

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.eps_eps_left_Z
theorems.statement:
theorem eps_eps_left_Z : ∀ c d g h : Fin 4,
    ∑ a, ∑ b, eps4 a b c d * eps4 a b g h = 2 * frameZ c d g h

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.frame_diag_Z
theorems.statement: theorem frame_diag_Z : ∑ a, ∑ b, (frameZ a b a b - frameZ a b b a) = 24

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.frameZ_antisymm
theorems.statement: theorem frameZ_antisymm : ∀ a b e f : Fin 4, frameZ a b f e = -frameZ a b e f
theorems.description: The frame two-form is antisymmetric in its form pair.

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.sum_pair
theorems.statement: theorem sum_pair (f : Pair → ℝ) : ∑ p, f p = ∑ a, ∑ b, f (a, b)

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.eps_frameP
theorems.statement: theorem eps_frameP (r q : Pair) : ∑ s, frameP r s * epsP q s = 2 * epsP q r

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.eps_epsP
theorems.statement: theorem eps_epsP (p q : Pair) : ∑ r, epsP p r * epsP q r = 2 * frameP p q

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.frame_epsP
theorems.statement: theorem frame_epsP (p s : Pair) : ∑ q, frameP p q * epsP q s = 2 * epsP p s

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.eps_eps_leftP
theorems.statement: theorem eps_eps_leftP (r s : Pair) : ∑ p, epsP p r * epsP p s = 2 * frameP r s

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.contract_frameP
theorems.statement:
theorem contract_frameP (R : Fin 4 → Fin 4 → Fin 4 → Fin 4 → ℝ) :
    ∑ p, ∑ q, onPairs R p q * frameP p q = ∑ a, ∑ b, (R a b a b - R a b b a)
theorems.description: Contracting with the frame: `Σ_{pq} R_{pq} E_{pq} = Σ_{ab} (R_{abab} − R_{abba})`.

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.form_antisymm_diag
theorems.statement:
theorem form_antisymm_diag (R : Fin 4 → Fin 4 → Fin 4 → Fin 4 → ℝ)
    (hR : ∀ a b e f, R a b f e = -R a b e f) :
    ∑ a, ∑ b, (R a b a b - R a b b a) = 2 * scalarR R

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.wedge_R_E
theorems.statement:
theorem wedge_R_E (R : Fin 4 → Fin 4 → Fin 4 → Fin 4 → ℝ)
    (hR : ∀ a b e f, R a b f e = -R a b e f) : wedge (onPairs R) frameP = 2 * scalarR R
theorems.description: **`R ∧ E = 2R`** for a curvature antisymmetric in its form pair.

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.wedge_E_R
theorems.statement:
theorem wedge_E_R (R : Fin 4 → Fin 4 → Fin 4 → Fin 4 → ℝ)
    (hR : ∀ a b e f, R a b f e = -R a b e f) : wedge frameP (onPairs R) = 2 * scalarR R

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.onPairs_frame4
theorems.statement: theorem onPairs_frame4 : onPairs frame4 = frameP

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.wedge_E_E
theorems.statement: theorem wedge_E_E : wedge frameP frameP = 24

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.wedge_expand
theorems.statement:
theorem wedge_expand (X Y : Pair → Pair → ℝ) (t : ℝ) :
    wedge (fun p q => X p q - t * Y p q) (fun p q => X p q - t * Y p q) =
      wedge X X - t * (wedge X Y + wedge Y X) + t ^ 2 * wedge Y Y
theorems.description: The pairing is bilinear: the expansion of `(X − tY) ∧ (X − tY)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.curvature_identity
theorems.statement:
theorem curvature_identity (R : Fin 4 → Fin 4 → Fin 4 → Fin 4 → ℝ)
    (hR : ∀ a b e f, R a b f e = -R a b e f) (ℓ : ℝ) :
    wedge (fun p q => onPairs R p q - frameP p q / ℓ ^ 2)
        (fun p q => onPairs R p q - frameP p q / ℓ ^ 2) - wedge (onPairs R) (onPairs R) =
      -(4 / ℓ ^ 2) * (scalarR R - 6 / ℓ ^ 2)
theorems.description:
**The curvature identity at the last-step direction:** for every curvature `R` antisymmetric in its form pair,
`(R − E/ℓ²) ∧ (R − E/ℓ²) − R ∧ R = −(4/ℓ²)(R − 6/ℓ²)`, `R = Σ_{ab} R_{abab}`.

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.lambda_three
theorems.statement:
theorem lambda_three (ℓ : ℝ) (hℓ : ℓ ≠ 0) (Λ : ℝ) :
    (24 / ℓ ^ 4 = (4 / ℓ ^ 2) * (2 * Λ)) ↔ Λ = 3 / ℓ ^ 2
theorems.description:
**`Λ = 3/ℓ²`:** the volume term `24/ℓ⁴` equals `(4/ℓ²)·2Λ` exactly when `Λ = 3/ℓ²`, so the
identity reads `−(4/ℓ²)(R − 2Λ)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.Eop_eq_pairing
theorems.statement: theorem Eop_eq_pairing : Eop = vecMulVec (relOf J) (star (relOf J))
theorems.description: **`E = |J⟩⟨J|`:** the pairing is the rank-one form on the join `J` read as a two-spinor state.

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.relOf_sum
theorems.statement:
theorem relOf_sum {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (M : ι → Matrix Four Four ℂ) :
    relOf (∑ i ∈ s, M i) = ∑ i ∈ s, relOf (M i)

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.L_on_operator
theorems.statement:
theorem L_on_operator (X : Matrix Four Four ℂ) :
    L *ᵥ ((X ⊗ₖ (1 : Matrix Four Four ℂ)) *ᵥ Ω) =
      (compOp X ⊗ₖ (1 : Matrix Four Four ℂ)) *ᵥ Ω
theorems.description: **The comparison on the two-spinor state `(X ⊗ 1)Ω` is the comparison on the operator `X`.**

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.compOp_relOp
theorems.statement:
theorem compOp_relOp (k : Fin 16) :
    compOp (relOp k) = ((6 : ℂ) - 2 * (disagreeSet k).card) • relOp k
theorems.description: `L(B_k) = (6 − 2|T_k|) B_k` on the sixteen operators of one system.

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.compOp_one
theorems.statement: theorem compOp_one : compOp 1 = (6 : ℂ) • (1 : Matrix Four Four ℂ)
theorems.description: **`L(I) = 6I`:** the singlet.

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.compOp_line
theorems.statement: theorem compOp_line (a : Fin 5) : compOp (γ a) = (-2 : ℂ) • γ a
theorems.description: **`L(γ_a) = −2γ_a`:** the five directions.

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.compOp_plane
theorems.statement: theorem compOp_plane {a b : Fin 5} (hab : a ≠ b) : compOp (γ a * γ b) = (2 : ℂ) • (γ a * γ b)
theorems.description: **`L(γ_aγ_b) = 2γ_aγ_b`** for `a ≠ b`: the ten symmetric states.

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.half_general
theorems.statement:
theorem half_general {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] (P : Matrix n n ℂ) (hP : P * P = P) :
    (1 - P + I • P) * (1 - P + I • P) = 1 - (2 : ℂ) • P
theorems.description:
**The half of a distinction:** for every idempotent `P`, `q = I − P + iP` has
`q² = I − 2P = θ`.

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.half_general_unitary
theorems.statement:
theorem half_general_unitary {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] (P : Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hP : P * P = P) (hH : Pᴴ = P) :
    (1 - P + I • P)ᴴ * (1 - P + I • P) = 1
theorems.description: **The half is unitary:** for a Hermitian idempotent `P`, `q†q = I`.

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.card_inter_eq_sum
theorems.statement:
theorem card_inter_eq_sum (X D : Finset (Fin 6)) :
    (X ∩ D).card = ∑ x ∈ D, if x ∈ X then 1 else 0

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.card_inter_add
theorems.statement:
theorem card_inter_add (D S T : Finset (Fin 6)) :
    (S ∩ D).card + (T ∩ D).card = ((symmDiff S T) ∩ D).card + 2 * (S ∩ T ∩ D).card

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.description_sign
theorems.statement:
theorem description_sign (D S T : Finset (Fin 6)) :
    I ^ (S ∩ D).card * I ^ (T ∩ D).card =
      (-1) ^ (S ∩ T ∩ D).card * I ^ ((symmDiff S T) ∩ D).card
theorems.description:
**A description carries its algebra**, the scalar form:
`i^{|S∩D|} i^{|T∩D|} = (−1)^{|S∩T∩D|} i^{|(S△T)∩D|}` for every division `D` and all words `S, T`.

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.description_carries_product
theorems.statement:
theorem description_carries_product {A : Type*} [Ring A] [Algebra ℂ A]
    (e : Finset (Fin 6) → A) (c : Finset (Fin 6) → Finset (Fin 6) → ℂ)
    (he : ∀ S T, e S * e T = c S T • e (symmDiff S T)) (D S T : Finset (Fin 6)) :
    (I ^ (S ∩ D).card • e S) * (I ^ (T ∩ D).card • e T) =
      ((-1 : ℂ) ^ (S ∩ T ∩ D).card) •
        ((c S T * I ^ ((symmDiff S T) ∩ D).card) • e (symmDiff S T))
theorems.description:
**A description carries its algebra:** in any complex algebra whose words multiply as
`e_S e_T = c(S, T) e_{S△T}` (the Clifford algebra of the six is one), the square root of the sign of a division,
`q_D(e_U) = i^{|U∩D|} e_U`, changes the product of two words by the sign of their common part
inside the division: `q_D(e_S) q_D(e_T) = (−1)^{|S∩T∩D|} q_D(e_S e_T)`, where
`q_D(e_S e_T) = c(S, T) i^{|(S△T)∩D|} e_{S△T}`.

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.hyper6_fifth
theorems.statement: theorem hyper6_fifth : ∀ h k : Fin 5, h ≠ k → ∑ r, hyper6 h k r ^ 5 = 4320

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.three_pairings
theorems.statement: theorem three_pairings : ∀ h : Fin 5, (pairingsBeside h).card = 3
theorems.description: **Three families:** the four lines beside a last-step direction pair in exactly three ways.

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.genIm_trace

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.gen_gram_int

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.genNorm_pos

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.gen12_apply

    gen12 j a b = (((Real.sqrt (genNorm j))⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) *
      ((genRe j a b : ℂ) + I * (genIm j a b : ℂ))

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.gen12_re
theorems.statement:
theorem gen12_re (j : Fin 12) (a b : Fin 5) :

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.gen12_im

theorem gen12_im (j : Fin 12) (a b : Fin 5) :

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.gen12_antiHermitian
theorems.statement: theorem gen12_antiHermitian (j : Fin 12) : (gen12 j)ᴴ = -gen12 j
theorems.description: **The twelve are rotations:** `X_j† = −X_j`.

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.gen12_trace

theorems.description: The twelve have trace zero.

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.gen12_block

theorem gen12_block (j : Fin 12) (a b : Fin 5) (h : inPlane a ≠ inPlane b) :
    gen12 j a b = 0
theorems.description: The twelve keep the split `2 + 3`: no entry joins the plane to the outside lines.

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.sqrt_inv_mul_self
theorems.statement: theorem sqrt_inv_mul_self (n : ℝ) (hn : 0 ≤ n) : (Real.sqrt n)⁻¹ * (Real.sqrt n)⁻¹ = n⁻¹

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.gen12_orthonormal

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.lastDirectionGram_charpoly
theorems.statement:
theorem lastDirectionGram_charpoly :
    lastDirectionGram.charpoly = X ^ 9 * (X - C (1 / 2 : ℝ)) ^ 2 * (X - C (4 / 5 : ℝ))
theorems.description:
**The last-step direction's Gram on `s(u(2) ⊕ u(3))`:** `det(X − G) = X⁹ (X − ½)² (X − 4/5)`: the nonzero
eigenvalues `½, ½, 4/5` (`W⁺, W⁻, Z`) and nine zeros (the photon and the eight colour rotations).

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.source_ratios
theorems.description: At the source `M_W²/M_Z² = (½)/(4/5) = 5/8` and `sin²θ = 1 − 5/8 = 3/8`.

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.penrose_unique
theorems.statement:
theorem penrose_unique {n : Type*} [Fintype n] {R : Type*} [CommRing R]
    (M G₁ G₂ : Matrix n n R)
    (h1 : M * G₁ * M = M) (h2 : G₁ * M * G₁ = G₁) (h3 : (M * G₁)ᵀ = M * G₁)
    (h4 : (G₁ * M)ᵀ = G₁ * M)
    (k1 : M * G₂ * M = M) (k2 : G₂ * M * G₂ = G₂) (k3 : (M * G₂)ᵀ = M * G₂)
    (k4 : (G₂ * M)ᵀ = G₂ * M) : G₁ = G₂
theorems.description:
**The Moore–Penrose inverse is unique:** two matrices that satisfy the four Penrose equations
for `M` are equal.

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.green_identity_right

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.green_col_sum
theorems.statement: theorem green_col_sum : ∀ y : Fin 16, ∑ x, green128 x y = 0

    Matrix.of fun x y => (adjZ x y : ℝ)) - (3 / 128 : ℝ) • Matrix.of fun _ _ => (1 : ℝ)

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.green_mul_lap

theorems.statement: theorem offConst_transpose : offConstᵀ = offConst

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.green_penrose
theorems.statement:

    lapM * greenM * lapM = lapM ∧ greenM * lapM * greenM = greenM ∧
      (lapM * greenM)ᵀ = lapM * greenM ∧ (greenM * lapM)ᵀ = greenM * lapM
theorems.description: **The four Penrose equations for `M = 5 − A` and `G = (7 + A)/32 − 3J/128`.**

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.green_pinv
theorems.statement:
theorem green_pinv (X : Matrix (Fin 16) (Fin 16) ℝ) (h1 : lapM * X * lapM = lapM)
    (h2 : X * lapM * X = X) (h3 : (lapM * X)ᵀ = lapM * X) (h4 : (X * lapM)ᵀ = X * lapM) :
    X = greenM
theorems.description:
**`(5 − A)⁺ = (7 + A)/32 − 3J/128`:** every matrix that satisfies the four Penrose equations for
`5 − A` is `G`.

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.plane_clock_sum

theorem plane_clock_sum : ∀ D E : Finset (Fin 5),

theorems.description: **On the symmetric states:** `Σ (4H_D)(4H_E) = 3(25|D ∩ E| − 5rs)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.line_clock_sum

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.card_planesOf

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.card_lineRelsOf

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.cast_plane_sum
theorems.statement:
theorem cast_plane_sum (D E : Finset (Fin 5)) :
    ∑ S ∈ planesOf, (clock4 D S : ℝ) * (clock4 E S : ℝ) =

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.cast_line_sum

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.mixed_moment_central
theorems.statement:
theorem mixed_moment_central (D E : Finset (Fin 5)) (w2 w4 : ℝ) (hZ : 10 * w2 + 5 * w4 ≠ 0) :
    mixedJ D E w2 w4 =
      clockW w2 w4 * ((D.card : ℝ) * E.card - 5 * (D ∩ E).card) / 72
theorems.description:
**The mixed moment for every central weight:**
`𝒥_DE = 𝒞_W (rs − 5 Tr P_DP_E)/72` with `r = |D|`, `s = |E|`, `Tr P_DP_E = |D ∩ E|`.

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.clock_uniform
theorems.statement: theorem clock_uniform : clockW 1 1 = 1
theorems.description: **At the uniform weight the clock is one** (`Var |S| = 8/9`).

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.crossing_pair_quarter

    mixedJ {0} {1} 1 1 = 1 / 72 ∧ clockW 1 (1 / 2) = 18 / 25 ∧
      mixedJ {0} {1} 1 (1 / 2) = 1 / 100
theorems.description:
**One pair of directions on opposite sides:** `1/72` against the clock `1` at `u = 0`, and `1/100` against `18/25` with
the weights `1/k₂(¼) = 1`, `1/k₄(¼) = 1/2` at `u = ¼`: the ratio `1/72` stays.

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.card_disagreeSet

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.sum_relEntry

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.relEntry_singlet_clock

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.grade_split

theorem grade_split (g : Fin 16 → ℂ) :
    ∑ k, g k = g 0 + ∑ k ∈ planeRels, g k + ∑ k ∈ lineRels, g k ∧
      ∑ k, (relGrade k : ℂ) * g k = 2 * ∑ k ∈ planeRels, g k + 4 * ∑ k ∈ lineRels, g k
theorems.description: The sum over the sixteen splits into the singlet, the symmetric states and the vector states.

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.plane_line_sums
theorems.statement:
theorem plane_line_sums (S T : Matrix (Fin 5) (Fin 5) ℂ) (hT : Tᵀ = T) (htr : T.trace = 0) :
    ∑ k ∈ planeRels, relEntry (clockOp S * clockOp T) k = 3 * (S * T).trace ∧
      ∑ k ∈ lineRels, relEntry (clockOp S * clockOp T) k = (S * T).trace
theorems.description:
**The grade-resolved sums:** `Σ_planes ⟨e_k, H_SH_Te_k⟩ = 3 Tr(ST)`, `Σ_lines ⟨e_k, H_SH_Te_k⟩ =
Tr(ST)` for a symmetric traceless `T`.

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.central_sums

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.wClock_eq
theorems.statement:
theorem wClock_eq (w₂ w₄ : ℂ) :
    wClock w₂ w₄ = 225 * w₂ * w₄ / (10 * w₂ + 5 * w₄) ^ 2

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.central_moment_sum
theorems.statement:
theorem central_moment_sum (g : Fin 16 → ℂ) (g0 : g 0 = 0) (X : ℂ) (h1 : ∑ k, g k = 4 * X)
    (h2 : ∑ k, (relGrade k : ℂ) * g k = 10 * X) (w₂ w₄ μ : ℂ) :
    ∑ k, centralW w₂ w₄ k * ((relGrade k : ℂ) - μ) * g k =
      X * (3 * w₂ * (2 - μ) + w₄ * (4 - μ))
theorems.description:
Any function of the grade on a sum that vanishes at the singlet is read by the two grade-resolved
sums.

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.wMoment_eq
theorems.statement:
theorem wMoment_eq (w₂ w₄ : ℂ) (hZ : 10 * w₂ + 5 * w₄ ≠ 0) (S T : Matrix (Fin 5) (Fin 5) ℂ)
    (hT : Tᵀ = T) (htr : T.trace = 0) :
    wMoment w₂ w₄ S T = -10 * w₂ * w₄ * (S * T).trace / (10 * w₂ + 5 * w₄) ^ 2
theorems.description: **`𝒥_W(S, T) = −10 w₂w₄ Tr(ST)/(10w₂ + 5w₄)²`** for a symmetric traceless `T`.

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.mixed_moment_central_subspaces
theorems.statement:
theorem mixed_moment_central_subspaces (P Q : Matrix (Fin 5) (Fin 5) ℂ) (r s : ℂ) (hQ : Qᵀ = Q)
    (hPr : P.trace = r) (hQs : Q.trace = s) (w₂ w₄ : ℂ) (hZ : 10 * w₂ + 5 * w₄ ≠ 0) :
    wMoment w₂ w₄ (subTurn P r) (subTurn Q s) =
      wClock w₂ w₄ * (r * s - 5 * (P * Q).trace) / 72
theorems.description:
**The mixed moment for every central weight and every two subspaces:**
`𝒥_W(S_D, S_E) = 𝒞_W (rs − 5 Tr P_DP_E)/72`.

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.wMoment_uniform
theorems.statement:
theorem wMoment_uniform (S T : Matrix (Fin 5) (Fin 5) ℂ) (hT : Tᵀ = T) (htr : T.trace = 0) :
    wMoment 1 1 S T = kappa S T
theorems.description: **At the uniform weight the mixed moment is `κ(N, H_S, H_T)`.**

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.Bc_apply
theorems.statement: theorem Bc_apply (p q : State) : Bc p q = if Continues q p then 1 else 0

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.Bc_eq
theorems.statement: theorem Bc_eq : Bc = stepOp transitionMat

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.disagreeSet_inj
theorems.statement: theorem disagreeSet_inj : ∀ k l : Fin 16, disagreeSet k = disagreeSet l → k = l

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.disagreeSet_injective
theorems.statement: theorem disagreeSet_injective : Function.Injective disagreeSet

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.even_sets_are_relations
theorems.statement:
theorem even_sets_are_relations :
    ∀ S : Finset (Fin 5), S.card % 2 = 0 → ∃ k : Fin 16, disagreeSet k = S

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.disagreeSet_card_even
theorems.statement: theorem disagreeSet_card_even : ∀ k : Fin 16, (disagreeSet k).card % 2 = 0

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.relPerm_exists
theorems.statement:
theorem relPerm_exists (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin 5)) (k : Fin 16) :
    ∃! l : Fin 16, disagreeSet l = (disagreeSet k).map π.toEmbedding

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.disagreeSet_relPerm
theorems.statement:
theorem disagreeSet_relPerm (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin 5)) (k : Fin 16) :
    disagreeSet (relPerm π k) = (disagreeSet k).map π.toEmbedding

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.relPerm_injective
theorems.statement: theorem relPerm_injective (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin 5)) : Function.Injective (relPerm π)

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.relPerm_transition
theorems.statement:
theorem relPerm_transition (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin 5)) (t : Fin 5) (k : Fin 16) :
    relPerm π (transition t k) = transition (π t) (relPerm π k)
theorems.description: **A relabelling of the lines carries the transitions:** `π(transition_t k) = transition_{π t}(π k)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.relPerm_zero
theorems.statement: theorem relPerm_zero (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin 5)) : relPerm π 0 = 0

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.transition_comm
theorems.statement: theorem transition_comm : ∀ (r t : Fin 5) (k : Fin 16), transition r (transition t k) = transition t (transition r k)

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.transition_inj'
theorems.statement: theorem transition_inj' (s : Fin 5) {x y : Fin 16} (h : transition s x = transition s y) : x = y

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.continues_mv
theorems.statement:
theorem continues_mv (r : Fin 5) (q p : State) :
    Continues (mvState r q) (mvState r p) ↔ Continues q p

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.continues_pm
theorems.statement:
theorem continues_pm (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin 5)) (q p : State) :
    Continues (pmState π q) (pmState π p) ↔ Continues q p

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.mvState_involutive
theorems.statement: theorem mvState_involutive (r : Fin 5) : Function.Involutive (mvState r)

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.pmState_injective
theorems.statement: theorem pmState_injective (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin 5)) : Function.Injective (pmState π)

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.adj_invariant
theorems.statement:
theorem adj_invariant (σ : State ≃ State) (hσ : ∀ p q, Continues (σ q) (σ p) ↔ Continues q p)
    (u : ℂ) (p q : State) :
    (1 - u • Bc).adjugate (σ q) (σ p) = (1 - u • Bc).adjugate q p
theorems.description: **A symmetry of the step keeps every cofactor of the law.**

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.relation_reach
theorems.statement:
theorem relation_reach : ∀ y : Fin 16,
    y = 0 ∨ (∃ a : Fin 5, y = transition a 0) ∨ ∃ a b : Fin 5, y = transition a (transition b 0)

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.perm_pair
theorems.statement:
theorem perm_pair : ∀ t s : Fin 5, t ≠ s →
    (Equiv.swap 0 t * Equiv.swap 1 (Equiv.swap 0 t s)) 0 = t ∧
      (Equiv.swap 0 t * Equiv.swap 1 (Equiv.swap 0 t s)) 1 = s

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.arc_transition
theorems.statement:
theorem arc_transition (u : ℂ) (r : Fin 5) (y : Fin 16) (t s : Fin 5) :
    (1 - u • Bc).adjugate (transition r y, t) (transition s (transition r y), s) =
      (1 - u • Bc).adjugate (y, t) (transition s y, s)
theorems.description: A transition of the two-spinor state carries the arc `(y, t) → (transition s y, s)` to the arc from `transition r y`.

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.arc_perm
theorems.statement:
theorem arc_perm (u : ℂ) (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin 5)) :
    (1 - u • Bc).adjugate (0, π 0) (transition (π 1) 0, π 1) =
      (1 - u • Bc).adjugate (0, 0) (transition 1 0, 1)
theorems.description:
A relabelling carries the arc `(0, 0) → (transition 1 0, 1)` to the arc
`(0, π 0) → (transition (π 1) 0, π 1)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.arc_cofactor_const
theorems.statement:
theorem arc_cofactor_const (u : ℂ) (y : Fin 16) (t s : Fin 5) (hts : t ≠ s) :
    (1 - u • Bc).adjugate (y, t) (transition s y, s) = (1 - u • Bc).adjugate (0, 0) (transition 1 0, 1)
theorems.description: **Every one of the 320 arcs has the same cofactor in the law.**

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.adj_continues
theorems.statement:
theorem adj_continues (u : ℂ) (i j : State) (h : Continues i j) :
    (1 - u • Bc).adjugate i j = (1 - u • Bc).adjugate (0, 0) (transition 1 0, 1)
theorems.description: The cofactor of any arc `i → j` is the one of the arc `(0, 0) → (transition 1 0, 1)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.trace_adj_B
theorems.statement:
theorem trace_adj_B (u : ℂ) :
    ((1 - u • Bc).adjugate * Bc).trace = 320 * (1 - u • Bc).adjugate (0, 0) (transition 1 0, 1)
theorems.description: **`tr(adj(I − uB) B) = 320 × (the cofactor of one arc)`.**

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.lawPoly_eval
theorems.statement: theorem lawPoly_eval (u : ℂ) : lawPoly.eval u = (1 - u • Bc).det

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.eval_map_one_sub
theorems.statement:
theorem eval_map_one_sub (u : ℂ) :
    (Polynomial.evalRingHom u).mapMatrix (1 - (X : ℂ[X]) • Bc.map C) = 1 - u • Bc

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.lawPoly_deriv
theorems.statement:
theorem lawPoly_deriv (u : ℂ) :
    (derivative lawPoly).eval u = -((1 - u • Bc).adjugate * Bc).trace
theorems.description: **Jacobi:** `D′(u) = −tr(adj(I − uB) B)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.det_mark
theorems.statement:
theorem det_mark (p q : State) (harc : Continues q p) (z u : ℂ) :
    (1 - u • Bmark p q z).det = (1 - u • Bc).det - u * (z - 1) * (1 - u • Bc).adjugate q p
theorems.description: The determinant is affine in the marked entry.

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.one_arc
theorems.statement:
theorem one_arc (p q : State) (harc : Continues q p) (z u : ℂ) :
    (1 - u • Bmark p q z).det =
      lawPoly.eval u + (z - 1) * u * (derivative lawPoly).eval u / 320
theorems.description:
**The one-arc equation:** marking any one of the 320 arcs with the phase `z = e^{−iθ}`,
`D_θ(u) = D(u) + (z − 1) u D′(u)/320`.

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.one_arc_phase
theorems.statement:
theorem one_arc_phase (p q : State) (harc : Continues q p) (θ u : ℂ) :
    (1 - u • Bmark p q (Complex.exp (-Complex.I * θ))).det =
      lawPoly.eval u + (Complex.exp (-Complex.I * θ) - 1) * u * (derivative lawPoly).eval u / 320
theorems.description: The same with `z = e^{−iθ}`.

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.transition_inj
theorems.statement: theorem transition_inj (s : Fin 5) {x y : Fin 16} (h : transition s x = transition s y) : x = y

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.sum_transition_transition
theorems.statement:
theorem sum_transition_transition (s : Fin 5) (x y : Fin 16) :
    ∑ z : Fin 16, (if z = transition s x then (1 : ℝ) else 0) * (if z = transition s y then 1 else 0) =
      if x = y then 1 else 0

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.two_avoid_count
theorems.statement:
theorem two_avoid_count (t t' : Fin 5) :
    ∑ s : Fin 5, (if s ≠ t then (1 : ℝ) else 0) * (if s ≠ t' then 1 else 0) =
      if t = t' then 4 else 3

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.stepR_gram
theorems.statement:
theorem stepR_gram (p q : State) :
    (stepRᵀ * stepR) p q = if p.1 = q.1 then (if p.2 = q.2 then 4 else 3) else 0
theorems.description:
**`BᵀB = I₁₆ ⊗ (I + 3J₅)`**: two states of one two-spinor state share `3` continuations (`4` with
themselves), two states of different two-spinor states none.

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.stepR_gram_proj
theorems.statement: theorem stepR_gram_proj : stepRᵀ * stepR = 1 + (15 : ℝ) • lastDirectionProj

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.lastDirectionProj_symm
theorems.statement: theorem lastDirectionProj_symm : lastDirectionProjᵀ = lastDirectionProj

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.lastDirectionProj_idem
theorems.statement: theorem lastDirectionProj_idem : lastDirectionProj * lastDirectionProj = lastDirectionProj
theorems.description: `Π² = Π`.

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.trace_lastDirectionProj
theorems.statement: theorem trace_lastDirectionProj : lastDirectionProj.trace = 16

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.stepR_gram_symm
theorems.statement: theorem stepR_gram_symm : (stepRᵀ * stepR).IsHermitian

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.stepR_gram_quadratic
theorems.statement:
theorem stepR_gram_quadratic :
    (stepRᵀ * stepR) * (stepRᵀ * stepR) + (-17 : ℝ) • (stepRᵀ * stepR) +
      (16 : ℝ) • (1 : Matrix State State ℝ) = 0

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.trace_stepR_gram
theorems.statement: theorem trace_stepR_gram : (stepRᵀ * stepR).trace = 320

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.stepR_gram_charpoly
theorems.statement:
theorem stepR_gram_charpoly :
    (stepRᵀ * stepR).charpoly = (X - C (1 : ℝ)) ^ 64 * (X - C (16 : ℝ)) ^ 16
theorems.description:
**The singular values of `B`:** `det(X − BᵀB) = (X − 1)⁶⁴ (X − 16)¹⁶`, so `B` has the singular
values `1` (sixty-four times) and `4` (sixteen times).

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.absB_sq
theorems.statement: theorem absB_sq : absB * absB = stepRᵀ * stepR
theorems.description: `|B|² = BᵀB`.

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.absB_symm
theorems.statement: theorem absB_symm : absB.IsHermitian

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.absB_charpoly
theorems.statement: theorem absB_charpoly : absB.charpoly = (X - C (1 : ℝ)) ^ 64 * (X - C (4 : ℝ)) ^ 16
theorems.description: `det(X − |B|) = (X − 1)⁶⁴(X − 4)¹⁶`: the singular values `1` and `4`.

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.absB_polar
theorems.statement:
theorem absB_polar :
    absB = (2 : ℝ) • (Real.exp (Real.log 2) • lastDirectionProj +
      Real.exp (-Real.log 2) • (1 - lastDirectionProj))
theorems.description: **The polar form** `|B| = 2(e^ξ Π + e^{−ξ}(1 − Π))` with `ξ = log 2`.

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.charge3_additive
theorems.statement: theorem charge3_additive : ∀ r : Fin 16, charge3 0 1 r = ∑ s ∈ disagreeSet r, lineCharge3 s

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.charge_additive
theorems.statement: theorem charge_additive (r : Fin 16) : charge 0 1 r = ∑ s ∈ disagreeSet r, lineCharge s
theorems.description: The charge of every two-spinor state is the sum of its lines' charges (the plane `{0, 1}`).

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.charge_current
theorems.statement:
theorem charge_current :
    2 * ((∑ s, lineCharge s ^ 2) / 5 - ((∑ s, lineCharge s) / 5) ^ 2) = 8 / 15
theorems.description: **The charge current two lines carry together:** `c = 2 Var Q = 8/15` over the five directions.

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.twentyfour_eleven
theorems.statement:
theorem twentyfour_eleven :
    (L * L).trace / 4 = 24 ∧
    Module.finrank ℂ (Module.End.eigenspace (Matrix.toLin' L) 6) +
      Module.finrank ℂ (Module.End.eigenspace (Matrix.toLin' L) 2) = 11
theorems.description: **`Tr L²/4 = 24`** traceless rotations against the **`1 + 10 = 11`** positive vertices.

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.linkSign_sq
theorems.statement: theorem linkSign_sq : ∀ l : Fin 40, linkSign l * linkSign l = 1

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.sadjZ_VU
theorems.statement: theorem sadjZ_VU : ∀ l : Fin 40, sadjZ (linkV l) (linkU l) = linkSign l

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.AC_sq
theorems.statement: theorem AC_sq : AC * AC = (5 : ℂ) • (1 : Matrix (Fin 16) (Fin 16) ℂ)

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.resolventW_spec
theorems.statement:
theorem resolventW_spec (w : ℂ) (hw : 1 - 5 * w ^ 2 ≠ 0) :
    (1 - w • AC) * resolventW w = 1
theorems.description: `(I − wA) R = I`: the resolvent is `(I − wA)⁻¹`.

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.trace_single_single
theorems.statement:
theorem trace_single_single (a b c d : Fin 16) :
    (Matrix.single a b (1 : ℂ) * Matrix.single c d 1).trace = if b = c ∧ a = d then 1 else 0

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.trace_M_single_single
theorems.statement:
theorem trace_M_single_single (M : Matrix (Fin 16) (Fin 16) ℂ) (a b c d : Fin 16) :
    (M * Matrix.single a b 1 * Matrix.single c d 1).trace = if b = c then M d a else 0

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.trace_M_single_M_single
theorems.statement:
theorem trace_M_single_M_single (M : Matrix (Fin 16) (Fin 16) ℂ) (a b c d : Fin 16) :
    (M * Matrix.single a b 1 * M * Matrix.single c d 1).trace = M d a * M b c

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.trace_M_single
theorems.statement:
theorem trace_M_single (M : Matrix (Fin 16) (Fin 16) ℂ) (a b : Fin 16) :
    (M * Matrix.single a b 1).trace = M b a

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.linkX_pair
theorems.statement:
theorem linkX_pair : ∀ j k : Fin 40,
    ((if linkU j = linkV k ∧ linkV j = linkU k then 1 else 0) -
      (if linkU j = linkU k ∧ linkV j = linkV k then 1 else 0) -
      (if linkV j = linkV k ∧ linkU j = linkU k then 1 else 0) +
      (if linkV j = linkU k ∧ linkU j = linkV k then 1 else 0) : ℤ) =
      if j = k then -2 else 0
theorems.description: `tr(X_jX_k) = −2δ_{jk}`.

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.linkX_triangle
theorems.statement:
theorem linkX_triangle : ∀ j k : Fin 40,
    ((if linkU j = linkV k then sadjZ (linkU k) (linkV j) else 0) -
      (if linkU j = linkU k then sadjZ (linkV k) (linkV j) else 0) -
      (if linkV j = linkV k then sadjZ (linkU k) (linkU j) else 0) +
      (if linkV j = linkU k then sadjZ (linkV k) (linkU j) else 0) : ℤ) = 0
theorems.description: **No triangles:** `tr(A X_j X_k) = 0`.

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.trace_linkX_linkX
theorems.statement:
theorem trace_linkX_linkX (j k : Fin 40) :
    (linkX j * linkX k).trace = if j = k then -2 else 0

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.trace_AC_linkX_linkX
theorems.statement: theorem trace_AC_linkX_linkX (j k : Fin 40) : (AC * linkX j * linkX k).trace = 0

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.trace_linkX_AC_linkX
theorems.statement: theorem trace_linkX_AC_linkX (j k : Fin 40) : (linkX j * AC * linkX k).trace = 0

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.trace_AC_linkX_AC_linkX
theorems.statement:
theorem trace_AC_linkX_AC_linkX (j k : Fin 40) :
    (linkSign j * linkSign k : ℂ) * (AC * linkX j * AC * linkX k).trace =
      10 * (if j = k then 1 else 0) - 2 * (GZ j k : ℂ)
theorems.description: `s_j s_k tr(AX_jAX_k) = B₄(j, k) = 10δ_{jk} − 2(CᵀC)_{jk}` (`B4Z_eq`).

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.trace_single_ne
theorems.statement: theorem trace_single_ne {a b : Fin 16} (h : a ≠ b) : (Matrix.single a b (1 : ℂ)).trace = 0

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.trace_d2A
theorems.statement: theorem trace_d2A (j : Fin 40) : (d2A j).trace = 0

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.trace_AC_d2A
theorems.statement: theorem trace_AC_d2A (j : Fin 40) : (AC * d2A j).trace = -2

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.hessLaw_eq
theorems.statement:
theorem hessLaw_eq (w : ℂ) (_hw : 1 - 5 * w ^ 2 ≠ 0) (j k : Fin 40) :
    hessLaw w j k = -(2 * w ^ 4 / (1 - 5 * w ^ 2) ^ 2) * (GZ j k : ℂ)
theorems.description:
**The exact second variation of the signed law in the forty link phases:**
`H(w) = −κ(w) CᵀC` with `κ(w) = 2w⁴/(1 − 5w²)²`, for every complex `w` with `1 − 5w² ≠ 0`.

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.kappa_quarters
theorems.description:
**`κ(w) = 2w⁴/(1 − 5w²)²` at the four points `u = i^d/4`:** `1/200` at `w = ±1/5` (the counting points
`u = ±1/4`) and `1/98` at `w = ±i/3` (the amplitude points `u = ±i/4`), `w = u/(1 + 4u²)`.

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.eigvec_ne_zero
theorems.statement:
theorem eigvec_ne_zero {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (i : n) :
    (⇑(hA.eigenvectorBasis i) : n → ℝ) ≠ 0

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.eig_root_quadratic
theorems.statement:
theorem eig_root_quadratic {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (a b : ℝ)
    (h : A * A + a • A + b • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) = 0) (i : n) :
    hA.eigenvalues i ^ 2 + a * hA.eigenvalues i + b = 0
theorems.description: **A quadratic that kills a symmetric matrix kills each eigenvalue.**

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.eig_root_cubic
theorems.statement:
theorem eig_root_cubic {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (a b c : ℝ)
    (h : A * A * A + a • (A * A) + b • A + c • (1 : Matrix n n ℝ) = 0) (i : n) :
    hA.eigenvalues i ^ 3 + a * hA.eigenvalues i ^ 2 + b * hA.eigenvalues i + c = 0
theorems.description: **A cubic that kills a symmetric matrix kills each eigenvalue.**

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.charpoly_of_values
theorems.statement:
theorem charpoly_of_values {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (s : Finset ℝ)
    (hs : ∀ i, hA.eigenvalues i ∈ s) :
    A.charpoly = ∏ x ∈ s, (X - C x) ^ (Finset.univ.filter fun i => hA.eigenvalues i = x).card
theorems.description:
**The characteristic polynomial from the eigenvalue counts:** if every eigenvalue lies in `s`,
`det(X − A) = Π_{x ∈ s} (X − x)^{#{i : λ_i = x}}`.

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.trace_of_values
theorems.statement:
theorem trace_of_values {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (s : Finset ℝ)
    (hs : ∀ i, hA.eigenvalues i ∈ s) :
    A.trace = ∑ x ∈ s, x * (Finset.univ.filter fun i => hA.eigenvalues i = x).card
theorems.description: **The trace from the eigenvalue counts.**

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.card_of_values
theorems.statement:
theorem card_of_values {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (s : Finset ℝ)
    (hs : ∀ i, hA.eigenvalues i ∈ s) :
    ∑ x ∈ s, (Finset.univ.filter fun i => hA.eigenvalues i = x).card = Fintype.card n
theorems.description: **The counts add to the dimension.**

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.rank_of_values
theorems.statement:
theorem rank_of_values {A : Matrix n n ℝ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (s : Finset ℝ)
    (hs : ∀ i, hA.eigenvalues i ∈ s) :
    A.rank = ∑ x ∈ s.erase 0, (Finset.univ.filter fun i => hA.eigenvalues i = x).card
theorems.description: **The rank from the eigenvalue counts:** the nonzero eigenvalues.

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.law_grade_factors
theorems.statement:
theorem law_grade_factors (u : ℂ) :
    (1 - u • stepOp transitionMat).det = (1 - u ^ 2) ^ 24 * kN 0 u * kN 2 u ^ 10 * kN 4 u ^ 5
theorems.description: **`det(I − uB) = (1 − u²)²⁴ k₀ k₂¹⁰ k₄⁵`.**

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.disagree_card_cases
theorems.statement:
theorem disagree_card_cases (U : Fin 16) :
    (disagreeSet U).card = 0 ∨ (disagreeSet U).card = 2 ∨ (disagreeSet U).card = 4

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.meeting_factor_zpow
theorems.statement:
theorem meeting_factor_zpow (u : ℂ) (hu : u ≠ 1) (U : Fin 16) :
    (1 - u • Law.patternK (R := ℂ) (disagreeSet U)).det =
      (1 + u) ^ ((agreeCount U : ℤ) - 1) * (1 - u) ^ ((disagreeCount U : ℤ) - 1) *
        (1 + 4 * u ^ 2 - u * ((agreeCount U : ℂ) - (disagreeCount U : ℂ)))
theorems.description:
**One meeting's factor** `(1 + u)^{a − 1}(1 − u)^{d − 1}[1 + 4u² − u(a − d)]`, with integer
powers.

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.law_over_meetings
theorems.statement:
theorem law_over_meetings (u : ℂ) (hu : u ≠ 1) :
    (1 - u • stepOp transitionMat).det =
      ∏ U : Fin 16, (1 + u) ^ ((agreeCount U : ℤ) - 1) * (1 - u) ^ ((disagreeCount U : ℤ) - 1) *
        (1 + 4 * u ^ 2 - u * ((agreeCount U : ℂ) - (disagreeCount U : ℂ)))
theorems.description:
**The law factors meeting by meeting:**
`det(I − uB) = Π_U (1 + u)^{a_U − 1}(1 − u)^{d_U − 1}[1 + 4u² − u(a_U − d_U)]` for every `u ≠ 1`.

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.kR_plane_quarter
theorems.statement: theorem kR_plane_quarter (N : ℝ) : kR N (-1 / 4) = (5 - N) / 2

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.grade_factors_plane_quarter
theorems.statement:
theorem grade_factors_plane_quarter :
    kR 0 (-1 / 4) = 5 / 2 ∧ kR 2 (-1 / 4) = 3 / 2 ∧ kR 4 (-1 / 4) = 1 / 2
theorems.description: **The grade factors at the point `u = −1/4`:** `k₀, k₂, k₄ = 5/2, 3/2, 1/2`.

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.quarter_factors
theorems.statement:
theorem quarter_factors :
    kN (0 : ℂ) (1 / 4) = 0 ∧ kN (2 : ℂ) (1 / 4) ≠ 0 ∧ kN (4 : ℂ) (1 / 4) ≠ 0 ∧
    (∀ k ∈ ({1, 2, 3} : Finset ℕ), ∀ N ∈ ({0, 2, 4} : Finset ℂ), kN N (I ^ k / 4) ≠ 0)
theorems.description:
**At the four points `u = i^d/4`:** at `u = ¼` only `k₀` vanishes; at `i/4`, `−¼`, `−i/4` no grade factor
vanishes.

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.step_weights_are_grade_factors
theorems.statement:
theorem step_weights_are_grade_factors (S : Finset (Fin 6)) :
    Law.tS S = 1 / kR (gradeS S) (-1 / 4) ∧
      Law.eS S = kR (gradeS S + 2) (-1 / 4) / kR (gradeS S) (-1 / 4)
theorems.description:
**The step weights of every divided set are the grade factors at the point `u = −1/4`:**
`t_S = 1/k_N(−¼)` and `e_S = k_{N+2}(−¼)/k_N(−¼)` with `N = 5 − |L_S|`, at all 64 divided sets.

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.one_crossing_pair
theorems.description:
**One pair of directions on opposite sides**, by its three expressions:
`[−Φ(1)/(1 + Φ(1))]/4 = [−Φ(i)/(1 + Φ(i))]/6 = e_line²/(k_C² − 1) = 1/72`, with `e_line = k₄/k₂` at
the point `u = −1/4` and `k_C = 1/|u| − 1 = 3` the lines outside a plane.

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.gravity_grade_form
theorems.description:
**Gravity's closed form:** `W = k₀(−¼)^{−k_C Eℓ} η^{k_C E_H} = (2/5)⁴⁸(295/296)⁹`, with
`k_C = 3` lines, `Eℓ = 16` steps, `E_H = 3` steps along the last-step direction and `η = 295/296`; it is `Wgrav`.

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.law_transformation
theorems.statement:
theorem law_transformation {n : Type*} [DecidableEq n] (A : Matrix n n ℂ) (u v : ℂ)
    (hu : u ≠ 0) :
    (1 + 4 * v ^ 2) • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) - v • A =
      (v / u) • ((1 + 4 * u ^ 2) • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) - u • A) +
        (1 + 4 * v ^ 2 - v / u * (1 + 4 * u ^ 2)) • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ)
theorems.description:
**The law's own transformation:** `K(v) = a K(u) + b I` with `a = v/u`,
`b = 1 + 4v² − a(1 + 4u²)`, for `K(u) = (1 + 4u²) − uA` and any operator `A`.

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.grade_factor_transformation
theorems.statement:
theorem grade_factor_transformation (N u v : ℂ) (hu : u ≠ 0) :
    kN N v = v / u * kN N u + (1 + 4 * v ^ 2 - v / u * (1 + 4 * u ^ 2))
theorems.description: **The same on the grade factors:** `k_N(v) = a k_N(u) + b`.

theorems.name: Comparison.WholePicture.trace_five_volume
theorems.statement:
theorem trace_five_volume (h a b c d : Fin 5) :
    (γ h * γ a * γ b * γ c * γ d).trace • (1 : Matrix Four Four ℂ) =
      (4 * (lc5 h a b c d : ℂ)) • (γ 0 * γ 1 * γ 2 * γ 3 * γ 4)
theorems.description:
**`tr(γ_hγ_aγ_bγ_cγ_d) = 4ε_{habcd} · (γ₀γ₁γ₂γ₃γ₄)`**, the product of the five directions being a
number.
